text:
Mohabbat-o-Mawaddat ka Aafaqi Usool: Allah Ta'ala apne taqwe ka hukum deta hai ke jism se isi ek hi ki ibadatein ki jayen aur dil mein sirf isi ka khauf rakha jaye, phir apni qudrat-e-kamilah ka bayan farmata hai ke usne tum sab ko ek hi shakhs yani Hazrat Adam (A.S) se paida kiya hai, unki biwi yani Hazrat Hawa (Alaihimas Salam) ko bhi unhi se paida kiya, Aap soye hue thay ke bayin taraf ki pasli ki pichli taraf se Hazrat Hawa ko paida kiya, Aap ne bedaar ho kar unhein dekha aur apni tabiyat ko unki taraf raghib paya aur unhein bhi unse uns paida hua, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain aurat mard se paida ki gayi hai is liye uski haajat-o-shahwat mard mein rakhi gayi hai aur mard zameen se paida kiye gaye hain is liye unki haajat zameen mein rakhi gayi hai. Pas tum apni aurton ko roke rakho, Sahih Hadith mein hai aurat pasli se paida ki gayi hai aur sab se buland pasli sab se zyada tedhi hai pas agar tu use bilkul seedhi karne ko jayega to tod dega aur agar is mein kuch kaji baqi chhodte hue faida uthana chahega to beshak faida utha sakta hai. Phir farmaya un dono se yani Adam aur Hawa se bahut se insaan mard-o-aurat charon taraf duniya mein phaila diye jin ki qismein, sifatein, rang roop, bol chaal mein bahut kuch ikhtilaf hai, jis tarah yeh sab pehle Allah Ta'ala ke qabze mein thay aur phir unhein usne idhar udhar phaila diya, ek waqt un sab ko sameit kar phir apne qabze mein kar ke ek maidan mein jama karega.

Pas Allah se darte raho uski ita'at-o-ibadat baja late raho, isi Allah ke waste se aur isi ke pak naam par tum aapas mein ek dusre se mangte ho, maslan yeh ke in mein tujhe Allah ko yaad dila kar aur rishte ko yaad dila kar yun kehta hoon isi ke naam ki qasmein khate ho aur ahd-o-paiman mazboot karte ho, Allah Jalla Shanahu se dar kar rishton naton ki hifazat karo unhein todo nahin balkay jodo sila-rehmi neki aur sulook aapas mein karte raho arham bhi ek qirat mein hai yani Allah ke naam par aur rishte ke waste se, Allah tumhare tamam ahwal aur a'amal se waqif hai khoob dekh bhal raha hai, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Wallahu 'ala kulli shai'in shaheed) Allah har cheez par gawah aur hazir hai, sahih hadith mein hai Allah Azzawajal ki aisi ibadat kar ke goya tu use dekh raha hai pas agar tu use nahin dekh raha to woh to tujhe dekh hi raha hai, matlab yeh hai ke uska lihaz rakho jo tumhare har uthne baithne chalne phirne par nigran hai, yahan farmaya gaya ke logo tum sab ek hi maa baap ki aulad ho ek dusre par shafqat kiya karo, kamzor aur natwan ka sath do aur unke sath achha sulook karo, Sahih Muslim Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke jab qabila Mudar ke chand log Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas chadrein lapete hue aaye kyunke unke jism par kapda tak na tha to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne khade ho kar namaz-e-zuhr ke baad wa'az bayan farmaya jis mein is ayat ki tilawat ki phir ayat (Ya ayyuhallazina amanuttaqullaha waltanzur nafsun ma qaddamat lighadin wattaqullaha innallaha khabirum bima ta'malun) (59. Al-Hashr: 18) ki tilawat ki phir logon ko khairat karne ki targheeb di chunancha jis se jo hosaka un logon ke liye diya dirham-o-dinar bhi aur khajoor-o-gehun bhi yeh hadith, Musnad aur Sunan mein khutba-e-hajat ke bayan mein hai phir teen ayatein padhin jin mein se ek ayat yahi hai.

Yateemon ki nigahdasht aur chaar shadiyon ki ijazat. Allah Ta'ala yateemon ke waliyon ko hukum deta hai ke jab yateem bulughat aur samajhdari ko pahunch jayen to un ke jo maal tumhare paas ho unhein sonp do, poore poore baghair kami aur khayanat ke un ke hawale karo, apne maalon ke sath mila kar gud-mud kar ke kha jaane ki niyat na rakho, halal rizq jab Allah Rahim tumhein de raha hai phir haram ki taraf kyun munh uthao? Taqdeer ki rozi mil kar hi rahegi apne halal maal chhod kar logon ke maalon ko jo tum par haram hain na lo, dubla patla janwar de kar mota taza na lo, boti de kar bakre ki fikr na karo, raddi de kar achhe ki aur khota de kar khare ki niyat na rakho, pehle log aisa kar liya karte the ke yateemon ki bakriyon ke rewar mein se umda bakri le li aur apni dubli patli bakri de kar ginti poori kar di, khota dirham us ke maal mein daal kar khara nikal liya aur phir samajh liya ke hum ne to bakri ke badle bakri aur dirham ke badle dirham liya hai. Un ke maalon mein apna maal khalt-malt kar ke phir yeh heela kar ke ab imtiyaz kya hai? Un ke maal talaf na karo, yeh bada gunah hai, ek zaeef hadith mein bhi yahi ma'ani aakhri jumle ke marwi hain, Abu Dawood ki hadith mein ek dua mein bhi (hub) ka lafz gunah ke ma'ani mein aaya hai, Hazrat Abu Ayyub ne jab apni biwi sahiba ko talaq dene ka irada kiya tha to Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein farmaya tha ke is talaq mein gunah hai, chunancha woh apne irade se baaz rahe, ek riwayat mein yeh waqia Hazrat Abu Talha aur Umm-e-Sulaim ka marwi hai. Phir farmata hai ke tumhari parwarish mein koi yateem ladki ho aur tum us se nikah karna chahte ho lekin chunke us ka koi aur nahin is liye tum to aisa na karo ke mehar aur haqooq mein kami kar ke use apne ghar daal lo is se baaz raho aur auratein bahut hain jis se chaho nikah kar lo, Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) farmati hain ek yateem ladki thi jis ke paas maal bhi tha aur bagh bhi jis ki parwarish mein woh thi us ne sirf us maal ke lalach mein baghair us ka poora mehar waghera muqarrar karne ke us se nikah kar liya jis par yeh aayat utri mera khayal hai ke is bagh aur maal mein yeh ladki hissa-dar thi, Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Shihab ne Hazrat Ayesha se is aayat ka matlab poocha to aap ne farmaya bhanje, yeh zikr us yateem ladki ka hai jo apne wali ke qabze mein hai us ke maal mein shareek hai aur use us ka maal-o-jamal achha lagta hai chahta hai ke us se nikah kar le lekin jo mehar waghera aur jagah se use milta hai utna yeh nahin deta to use mana kiya ja raha hai ke woh is apni niyat chhod de aur kisi dusri aurat se jis se chahe apna nikah kar le, phir is ke baad logon ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se isi ki babat daryaft kiya aur aayat (Wa yastaftunaka fin-nisa, qulillahu yuftikum feehinna) (4:127).

(An-Nisa: 127) nazil hui wahan farmaya gaya hai ke jab yateem ladki kam maal wali aur kam jamaal wali hoti hai us waqt toh us ke wali us se be-raghbati karte hain phir koi wajah nahin ke maal-o-jamaal par mail ho kar us ke pooray huqooq ada na kar ke us se apna nikah kar lein, haan adl-o-insaf se poora mehar waghera muqarrar karein toh koi haraj nahin, warna phir auraton ki kami nahin aur kisi se jis se chahein izhar-e-nikah kar lein do do auratein apne nikah mein rakhein agar chahein teen teen rakhein agar chahein chaar chaar, jaise aur jagah yeh alfaaz in hi ma'non mein hain, farmata hai aayat (Alhamdu lillahi fatiris samawati wal-ardi ja'ilil mala'ikati rusulan uli ajnihatim mathna wa thulatha wa ruba') (35. Fatir: 1) yani jin farishton ko Allah Ta'ala apna qasid bana kar bhejta hai un mein se ba'az do do paron wale hain ba'az teen teen paron wale ba'az chaar chaar paron wale farishton mein is se zyada par wale farishte bhi hain kyunke daleel se yeh sabit shuda hai, lekin mard ko ek waqt mein chaar se zyada biwiyon ka jama karna mana hai jaise ke is aayat mein majood hai aur jaise ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A aur jamhoor ka qaul hai, yahan Allah Ta'ala apne ehsan aur inaam bayan farma raha hai pas agar chaar se zyada ki ijazat deni manzoor hoti toh zaroor farma diya jata, Hazrat Imam Shafi'i R.H farmate hain hadees jo Quran ki wazahat karne wali hai us ne batla diya hai ke siwaye Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke kisi ke liye chaar se zyada biwiyon ka baik waqt jama karna jaiz nahin isi par ulama-e-kiram ka ijma hai, albatta ba'az Shia ka qaul hai ke nau tak jama karni jaiz hain, balkay ba'az Shia ne toh kaha hai ke nau se bhi zyada jama kar lene mein bhi koi haraj nahin koi tadaad muqarrar hai hi nahin, un ka istidlal ek toh Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke fe'l se hai jaisa ke sahih hadees mein aa chuka hai ke aap ki nau biwiyan thin aur Bukhari Sharif ki mu'allaq hadees ke ba'az rawiyon ne gyarah kaha hai, Hazrat Anas R.A se marwi hai ke aap ne pandrah biwiyon se aqd kiya terah ki rukhsati hui ek waqt mein gyarah biwiyan aap ke paas thin. Inteqal ke waqt aap ki nau biwiyan thin R.A Ajma'een, hamare ulama-e-kiram is ke jawab mein farmate hain ke yeh aap ki khusoosiyat thi ummati ko ek waqt mein chaar se zyada paas rakhne ki ijazat nahin, jaise ke yeh hadeesein is amr par dalalat karti hain, Hazrat Ghailan bin Salma Thaqafi R.A jab musalman hote hain toh un ke paas un ki das biwiyan thin.

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) irshad farmate hain ke in mein se jinhein chaho chaar rakh lo baqi ko chhor do, chunancha unhon ne aisa hi kiya. Phir Hazrat Umar (R.A) ki khilafat ke zamane mein apni in biwiyon ko bhi talaq de di aur apne larkon ko apna maal baant diya. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko jab yeh maloom hua toh aap ne farmaya: Shayad tere shaitan ne baat uchak li aur tere dil mein khayal jama diya ke tu anqareeb marne wala hai, is liye apni biwiyon ko tu ne alag kar diya ke woh tera maal na payein aur apna maal apni aulad mein taqseem kar diya. Main tujhe hukum deta hoon ke apni biwiyon se ruju kar le aur apni aulad se maal wapas le, agar tu ne aisa na kiya toh tere baad teri in mutallaqa biwiyon ko bhi tera waris banaunga kyunke tu ne unhein isi dar se talaq di hai aur maloom hota hai ke teri zindagi bhi ab khatam hone wali hai aur agar tu ne meri baat na mani toh yaad rakh main hukum dunga ke log teri qabr par patthar phenkein jaise ke Abu Righal ki qabr par patthar phenke jate hain (Musnad-e-Ahmad, Shafi, Tirmidhi, Ibn-e-Majah, Dar-e-Qutni, Baihaqi waghera). Marfoo hadith tak toh in sab kitabon mein hai, haan Hazrat Umar (R.A) wala waqea sirf Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hi hai lekin yeh ziyadati hasan hai, agarcheh Imam Bukhari (R.H) ne ise zaeef kaha hai aur is ki asnaad ka dusra tareeqa bata kar is tareeqe ko ghair mehfooz kaha hai magar is taleel mein bhi ikhtilaf hai, Wallahu A'lam. Aur buzurg muhaddiseen ne bhi is par kalam kiya hai lekin Musnad-e-Ahmad wali hadith ke tamam rawi siqa hain aur shart-e-Shaikhain par hain. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh das auratein bhi apne khawand ke sath musalman hui thin, mulahiza ho (Sunan-e-Nasa'i). Is hadith se saaf zahir ho gaya ke agar chaar se zyada ka ek waqt mein nikah mein rakhna jaiz hota toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) un se yeh na farmate ke apni in das biwiyon mein se chaar ko jinhein tum chaho rok lo baqi ko chhor do kyunke yeh sab bhi Islam la chuki thin. Yahan yeh baat bhi khayal mein rakhni chahiye ke Thaqafi ke han toh yeh das auratein bhi maujood thin, is par bhi aap ne chhe alaihida kara dein, phir bhala kaise ho sakta hai ke koi shakhs naye sire se chaar se zyada jama kare? Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam bis-Sawab, chaar se zaid nahin, woh bhi bashart-e-insaf warna ek hi biwi!

Doosri hadith: Abu Dawood, Ibn Majah waghera mein hai Hazrat Amira Asadi (R.A) farmate hain main ne jis waqt Islam qabool kiya mere nikah mein aath auratein thin main ne Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se zikr kiya aap ne farmaya in mein se jin chaar ko chaho rakh lo, is ki sanad hasan hai aur is ke shawahid bhi hain rawiyon ke namon ka her pher waghera aisi riwayaton mein nuqsan deh nahin hota.

Teesri hadith: Musnad-e-Shafi'i mein hai Hazrat Naufal bin Muawiyah (R.A) farmate hain ke main ne jab Islam qabool kiya us waqt meri paanch biwiyan thin mujh se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya in mein se pasand kar ke chaar ko rakh lo aur ek ko alag kar do main ne jo sab se zyada umr ki burhiya aur be-aulad biwi sath saal ki thin unhein talaq de di, pas yeh hadeesein Hazrat Ghailan wali pehli hadith ki shawahid hain jaise ke Hazrat Imam Baihaqi (R.H) ne farmaya.

Phir farmata hai haan agar ek se zyada biwiyon mein adl-o-insaf na ho sakne ka khauf ho to sirf ek hi par iktifa karo aur apni kaneezon se istimta' karo jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Walan tastati'u an ta'dilu bainan-nisa'i walau harastum fala tamilu kullal-maili fatadharuha kal-mu'allaqah) (Surah An-Nisa: 129) yani go tum chaho lekin tum se na ho sake ga ke aurton ke darmiyan poori tarah adl-o-insaf ko qaim rakh sako pas bilkul ek hi taraf jhuk kar doosri ko museebat mein na daal do, haan yaad rahe ke laundiyon mein bari waghera ki taqseem wajib nahin albatta mustahab hai jo kare us ne achha kiya aur jo na kare us par haraj nahin.

Is ke baad ke jumle ke matlab mein ba'az ne to kaha hai ke yeh qareeb hai un ma'ani ke ke tumhare ayal yani faqiri zyada na ho jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa in khiftum) yani agar tumhein faqr ka dar ho, Arabi shair kehta hai: Fama yadri-l-faqiru mata ghinahu wa ma yadri-l-ghani mata ya'il, yani faqir nahin janta ke kab ameer ho jaye ga, aur ameer ko maloom nahin ke kab faqir ban jaye ga, jab koi maskeen mohtaj ho jaye to Arab kehte hain (Aala-r-rajulu) yani yeh shakhs faqir ho gaya, gharz is ma'ani mein yeh lafz musta'mal to hai lekin yahan yeh tafseer kuch zyada achhi nahin maloom hoti, kyunke agar azad aurton ki kasrat faqiri ka ba'is ban sakti hai to laundiyon ki kasrat bhi faqiri ka sabab ho sakti hai, pas sahih qaul jamhoor ka hai ke murad yeh hai ke yeh qareeb hai is se ke tum zulm se bach jao, Arab mein kaha jata hai (Aala fil-hukmi) jabke zulm-o-jor kiya ho, Abu Talib ke mashhoor qaside mein hai.

Bimizan-e-Qist la yakhbasu sha'iratan lahu shahidun min nafsihi ghaira 'a'il. Zameer behtareen tarazu hai, yani aisi tarazu se toltay hain jo ek jau barabar ki bhi kami nahin karta. Us ke paas us ka gawah khud us ka nafs hai jo zalim nahin hai. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke jab Kufiyon ne Hazrat Usman (R.A) par ek khat kuch ilzaam likh kar bheja to un ke jawab mein Khalifa-e-Rasool (ﷺ) ne likha ke (Inni lastu bimizanin a'ool) main zulm ka tarazu nahin hoon. Sahih Ibn-e-Hibban waghera mein ek marfoo hadith is jumla ki tafseer mein marvi hai ke is ka ma'ani hai tum zulm na karo. Abu Hatim (R.H) farmatay hain is ka marfoo hona to khata hai, haan yeh Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ka qaul hai. Isi tarah la ta'ooloo ke yahi ma'ani hain yani tum zulm na karo. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A), Hazrat Ayesha (R.A), Hazrat Mujahid (R.H), Hazrat Ikrama (R.H), Hazrat Hasan (R.H), Hazrat Abu Malik (R.H), Hazrat Abu Zareen (R.H), Hazrat Nakh'i (R.H), Hazrat Sha'bi (R.H), Hazrat Zahhak (R.H), Hazrat Atta Khurasani (R.H), Hazrat Qatada (R.H), Hazrat Suddi (R.H) aur Hazrat Muqatil bin Hayyan (R.H) waghera se bhi marvi hain. Hazrat Ikrama (R.H) ne bhi Abu Talib ka wahi sher pesh kiya hai, Imam Ibn-e-Jareer ne isay riwayat kiya hai aur khud Imam sahab bhi isi ko pasand farmatay hain. Phir farmata hai apni biwiyon ko un ke mehar khush-dili se ada kar diya karo jo bhi muqarrar huay hon aur jin ko tum ne manzoor kiya ho. Haan agar aurat khud apna sara ya thoda bahut mehar apni khushi se mard ko maaf kar de to usay ikhtiyar hai aur is soorat mein beshak mard ko us ka apnay istemaal mein lana halal-e-tayyab hai. Nabi (ﷺ) ke baad kisi ko jaiz nahin ke baghair mehar-e-wajib ke nikah karay na yeh ke jhoot-moot mehar ka naam hi naam ho. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Ali (R.A) ka qaul marvi hai ke tum mein se jab koi bimar paray to usay chahiye ke apni biwi se us ke maal ke teen dirham ya kam-o-besh le, un ka shehad khareed le aur barish ka aasmani pani us mein mila le to teen teen bhala'iyan mil jayengi, aayat (Hani'an Mari'an) to maal aurat aur shifa shehad aur mubarak barish ka pani. Hazrat Abu Saleh (R.H) farmatay hain ke log apni betiyon ka mehar aap letay thay jis par yeh aayat utri aur unhein is se rok diya gaya (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim aur Ibn-e-Jareer). Is hukm ko sun kar logon ne Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ) se poocha ke un ka mehar kya hona chahiye? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya jis cheez par bhi un ke wali razamand ho jayen (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apnay khutbay mein teen martaba farmaya ke bewa aurton ka nikah kar diya karo, ek shakhs ne kharay ho kar poocha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) aisi soorat mein un ka mehar kya hoga? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya jis par un ke ghar walay raazi ho jayen, is ke ek rawi Ibn-e-Sulmani za'eef hain, phir is mein inqita' bhi hai.

Fatir: 1) yani jin farishton ko Allah Ta'ala apna qasid bana kar bhejta hai un mein se ba'az do do paron wale hain ba'az teen teen paron wale ba'az chaar chaar paron wale farishton mein is se zyada par wale farishte bhi hain kyunke daleel se yeh sabit shuda hai, lekin mard ko ek waqt mein chaar se zyada biwiyon ka jama karna mana hai jaise ke is aayat mein majood hai aur jaise ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A aur jamhoor ka qaul hai, yahan Allah Ta'ala apne ehsan aur inaam bayan farma raha hai pas agar chaar se zyada ki ijazat deni manzoor hoti toh zaroor farma diya jata, Hazrat Imam Shafi'i R.H farmate hain hadees jo Quran ki wazahat karne wali hai us ne batla diya hai ke siwaye Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke kisi ke liye chaar se zyada biwiyon ka baik waqt jama karna jaiz nahin isi par ulama-e-kiram ka ijma hai, albatta ba'az Shia ka qaul hai ke nau tak jama karni jaiz hain, balkay ba'az Shia ne toh kaha hai ke nau se bhi zyada jama kar lene mein bhi koi haraj nahin koi tadaad muqarrar hai hi nahin, un ka istidlal ek toh Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke fe'l se hai jaisa ke sahih hadees mein aa chuka hai ke aap ki nau biwiyan thin aur Bukhari Sharif ki mu'allaq hadees ke ba'az rawiyon ne gyarah kaha hai, Hazrat Anas R.A se marwi hai ke aap ne pandrah biwiyon se aqd kiya terah ki rukhsati hui ek waqt mein gyarah biwiyan aap ke paas thin. Inteqal ke waqt aap ki nau biwiyan thin R.A Ajma'een, hamare ulama-e-kiram is ke jawab mein farmate hain ke yeh aap ki khusoosiyat thi ummati ko ek waqt mein chaar se zyada paas rakhne ki ijazat nahin, jaise ke yeh hadeesein is amr par dalalat karti hain, Hazrat Ghailan bin Salma Thaqafi R.A jab musalman hote hain toh un ke paas un ki das biwiyan thin.

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) irshad farmate hain ke in mein se jinhein chaho chaar rakh lo baqi ko chhor do, chunancha unhon ne aisa hi kiya. Phir Hazrat Umar (R.A) ki khilafat ke zamane mein apni in biwiyon ko bhi talaq de di aur apne larkon ko apna maal baant diya. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko jab yeh maloom hua toh aap ne farmaya: Shayad tere shaitan ne baat uchak li aur tere dil mein khayal jama diya ke tu anqareeb marne wala hai, is liye apni biwiyon ko tu ne alag kar diya ke woh tera maal na payein aur apna maal apni aulad mein taqseem kar diya. Main tujhe hukum deta hoon ke apni biwiyon se ruju kar le aur apni aulad se maal wapas le, agar tu ne aisa na kiya toh tere baad teri in mutallaqa biwiyon ko bhi tera waris banaunga kyunke tu ne unhein isi dar se talaq di hai aur maloom hota hai ke teri zindagi bhi ab khatam hone wali hai aur agar tu ne meri baat na mani toh yaad rakh main hukum dunga ke log teri qabr par patthar phenkein jaise ke Abu Righal ki qabr par patthar phenke jate hain (Musnad-e-Ahmad, Shafi, Tirmidhi, Ibn-e-Majah, Dar-e-Qutni, Baihaqi waghera). Marfoo hadith tak toh in sab kitabon mein hai, haan Hazrat Umar (R.A) wala waqea sirf Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hi hai lekin yeh ziyadati hasan hai, agarcheh Imam Bukhari (R.H) ne ise zaeef kaha hai aur is ki asnaad ka dusra tareeqa bata kar is tareeqe ko ghair mehfooz kaha hai magar is taleel mein bhi ikhtilaf hai, Wallahu A'lam. Aur buzurg muhaddiseen ne bhi is par kalam kiya hai lekin Musnad-e-Ahmad wali hadith ke tamam rawi siqa hain aur shart-e-Shaikhain par hain. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh das auratein bhi apne khawand ke sath musalman hui thin, mulahiza ho (Sunan-e-Nasa'i). Is hadith se saaf zahir ho gaya ke agar chaar se zyada ka ek waqt mein nikah mein rakhna jaiz hota toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) un se yeh na farmate ke apni in das biwiyon mein se chaar ko jinhein tum chaho rok lo baqi ko chhor do kyunke yeh sab bhi Islam la chuki thin. Yahan yeh baat bhi khayal mein rakhni chahiye ke Thaqafi ke han toh yeh das auratein bhi maujood thin, is par bhi aap ne chhe alaihida kara dein, phir bhala kaise ho sakta hai ke koi shakhs naye sire se chaar se zyada jama kare? Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam bis-Sawab, chaar se zaid nahin, woh bhi bashart-e-insaf warna ek hi biwi!

Doosri hadith: Abu Dawood, Ibn Majah waghera mein hai Hazrat Amira Asadi (R.A) farmate hain main ne jis waqt Islam qabool kiya mere nikah mein aath auratein thin main ne Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se zikr kiya aap ne farmaya in mein se jin chaar ko chaho rakh lo, is ki sanad hasan hai aur is ke shawahid bhi hain rawiyon ke namon ka her pher waghera aisi riwayaton mein nuqsan deh nahin hota.

Teesri hadith: Musnad-e-Shafi'i mein hai Hazrat Naufal bin Muawiyah (R.A) farmate hain ke main ne jab Islam qabool kiya us waqt meri paanch biwiyan thin mujh se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya in mein se pasand kar ke chaar ko rakh lo aur ek ko alag kar do main ne jo sab se zyada umr ki burhiya aur be-aulad biwi sath saal ki thin unhein talaq de di, pas yeh hadeesein Hazrat Ghailan wali pehli hadith ki shawahid hain jaise ke Hazrat Imam Baihaqi (R.H) ne farmaya.

Phir farmata hai haan agar ek se zyada biwiyon mein adl-o-insaf na ho sakne ka khauf ho to sirf ek hi par iktifa karo aur apni kaneezon se istimta' karo jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Walan tastati'u an ta'dilu bainan-nisa'i walau harastum fala tamilu kullal-maili fatadharuha kal-mu'allaqah) (Surah An-Nisa: 129) yani go tum chaho lekin tum se na ho sake ga ke aurton ke darmiyan poori tarah adl-o-insaf ko qaim rakh sako pas bilkul ek hi taraf jhuk kar doosri ko museebat mein na daal do, haan yaad rahe ke laundiyon mein bari waghera ki taqseem wajib nahin albatta mustahab hai jo kare us ne achha kiya aur jo na kare us par haraj nahin.

Is ke baad ke jumle ke matlab mein ba'az ne to kaha hai ke yeh qareeb hai un ma'ani ke ke tumhare ayal yani faqiri zyada na ho jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa in khiftum) yani agar tumhein faqr ka dar ho, Arabi shair kehta hai: Fama yadri-l-faqiru mata ghinahu wa ma yadri-l-ghani mata ya'il, yani faqir nahin janta ke kab ameer ho jaye ga, aur ameer ko maloom nahin ke kab faqir ban jaye ga, jab koi maskeen mohtaj ho jaye to Arab kehte hain (Aala-r-rajulu) yani yeh shakhs faqir ho gaya, gharz is ma'ani mein yeh lafz musta'mal to hai lekin yahan yeh tafseer kuch zyada achhi nahin maloom hoti, kyunke agar azad aurton ki kasrat faqiri ka ba'is ban sakti hai to laundiyon ki kasrat bhi faqiri ka sabab ho sakti hai, pas sahih qaul jamhoor ka hai ke murad yeh hai ke yeh qareeb hai is se ke tum zulm se bach jao, Arab mein kaha jata hai (Aala fil-hukmi) jabke zulm-o-jor kiya ho, Abu Talib ke mashhoor qaside mein hai.

Bimizan-e-Qist la yakhbasu sha'iratan lahu shahidun min nafsihi ghaira 'a'il. Zameer behtareen tarazu hai, yani aisi tarazu se toltay hain jo ek jau barabar ki bhi kami nahin karta. Us ke paas us ka gawah khud us ka nafs hai jo zalim nahin hai. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke jab Kufiyon ne Hazrat Usman (R.A) par ek khat kuch ilzaam likh kar bheja to un ke jawab mein Khalifa-e-Rasool (ﷺ) ne likha ke (Inni lastu bimizanin a'ool) main zulm ka tarazu nahin hoon. Sahih Ibn-e-Hibban waghera mein ek marfoo hadith is jumla ki tafseer mein marvi hai ke is ka ma'ani hai tum zulm na karo. Abu Hatim (R.H) farmatay hain is ka marfoo hona to khata hai, haan yeh Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ka qaul hai. Isi tarah la ta'ooloo ke yahi ma'ani hain yani tum zulm na karo. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A), Hazrat Ayesha (R.A), Hazrat Mujahid (R.H), Hazrat Ikrama (R.H), Hazrat Hasan (R.H), Hazrat Abu Malik (R.H), Hazrat Abu Zareen (R.H), Hazrat Nakh'i (R.H), Hazrat Sha'bi (R.H), Hazrat Zahhak (R.H), Hazrat Atta Khurasani (R.H), Hazrat Qatada (R.H), Hazrat Suddi (R.H) aur Hazrat Muqatil bin Hayyan (R.H) waghera se bhi marvi hain. Hazrat Ikrama (R.H) ne bhi Abu Talib ka wahi sher pesh kiya hai, Imam Ibn-e-Jareer ne isay riwayat kiya hai aur khud Imam sahab bhi isi ko pasand farmatay hain. Phir farmata hai apni biwiyon ko un ke mehar khush-dili se ada kar diya karo jo bhi muqarrar huay hon aur jin ko tum ne manzoor kiya ho. Haan agar aurat khud apna sara ya thoda bahut mehar apni khushi se mard ko maaf kar de to usay ikhtiyar hai aur is soorat mein beshak mard ko us ka apnay istemaal mein lana halal-e-tayyab hai. Nabi (ﷺ) ke baad kisi ko jaiz nahin ke baghair mehar-e-wajib ke nikah karay na yeh ke jhoot-moot mehar ka naam hi naam ho. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Ali (R.A) ka qaul marvi hai ke tum mein se jab koi bimar paray to usay chahiye ke apni biwi se us ke maal ke teen dirham ya kam-o-besh le, un ka shehad khareed le aur barish ka aasmani pani us mein mila le to teen teen bhala'iyan mil jayengi, aayat (Hani'an Mari'an) to maal aurat aur shifa shehad aur mubarak barish ka pani. Hazrat Abu Saleh (R.H) farmatay hain ke log apni betiyon ka mehar aap letay thay jis par yeh aayat utri aur unhein is se rok diya gaya (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim aur Ibn-e-Jareer). Is hukm ko sun kar logon ne Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ) se poocha ke un ka mehar kya hona chahiye? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya jis cheez par bhi un ke wali razamand ho jayen (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apnay khutbay mein teen martaba farmaya ke bewa aurton ka nikah kar diya karo, ek shakhs ne kharay ho kar poocha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) aisi soorat mein un ka mehar kya hoga? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya jis par un ke ghar walay raazi ho jayen, is ke ek rawi Ibn-e-Sulmani za'eef hain, phir is mein inqita' bhi hai.

Yateemon ki nigahdasht aur chaar shadiyon ki ijazat. Allah Ta'ala yateemon ke waliyon ko hukum deta hai ke jab yateem bulughat aur samajhdari ko pahunch jayen to un ke jo maal tumhare paas ho unhein sonp do, poore poore baghair kami aur khayanat ke un ke hawale karo, apne maalon ke sath mila kar gud-mud kar ke kha jaane ki niyat na rakho, halal rizq jab Allah Rahim tumhein de raha hai phir haram ki taraf kyun munh uthao? Taqdeer ki rozi mil kar hi rahegi apne halal maal chhod kar logon ke maalon ko jo tum par haram hain na lo, dubla patla janwar de kar mota taza na lo, boti de kar bakre ki fikr na karo, raddi de kar achhe ki aur khota de kar khare ki niyat na rakho, pehle log aisa kar liya karte the ke yateemon ki bakriyon ke rewar mein se umda bakri le li aur apni dubli patli bakri de kar ginti poori kar di, khota dirham us ke maal mein daal kar khara nikal liya aur phir samajh liya ke hum ne to bakri ke badle bakri aur dirham ke badle dirham liya hai. Un ke maalon mein apna maal khalt-malt kar ke phir yeh heela kar ke ab imtiyaz kya hai? Un ke maal talaf na karo, yeh bada gunah hai, ek zaeef hadith mein bhi yahi ma'ani aakhri jumle ke marwi hain, Abu Dawood ki hadith mein ek dua mein bhi (hub) ka lafz gunah ke ma'ani mein aaya hai, Hazrat Abu Ayyub ne jab apni biwi sahiba ko talaq dene ka irada kiya tha to Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein farmaya tha ke is talaq mein gunah hai, chunancha woh apne irade se baaz rahe, ek riwayat mein yeh waqia Hazrat Abu Talha aur Umm-e-Sulaim ka marwi hai. Doosri hadith: Abu Dawood, Ibn Majah waghera mein hai Hazrat Amira Asadi (R.A) farmate hain main ne jis waqt Islam qabool kiya mere nikah mein aath auratein thin main ne Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se zikr kiya aap ne farmaya in mein se jin chaar ko chaho rakh lo, is ki sanad hasan hai aur is ke shawahid bhi hain rawiyon ke namon ka her pher waghera aisi riwayaton mein nuqsan deh nahin hota.

Teesri hadith: Musnad-e-Shafi'i mein hai Hazrat Naufal bin Muawiyah (R.A) farmate hain ke main ne jab Islam qabool kiya us waqt meri paanch biwiyan thin mujh se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya in mein se pasand kar ke chaar ko rakh lo aur ek ko alag kar do main ne jo sab se zyada umr ki burhiya aur be-aulad biwi sath saal ki thin unhein talaq de di, pas yeh hadeesein Hazrat Ghailan wali pehli hadith ki shawahid hain jaise ke Hazrat Imam Baihaqi (R.H) ne farmaya.

Phir farmata hai haan agar ek se zyada biwiyon mein adl-o-insaf na ho sakne ka khauf ho to sirf ek hi par iktifa karo aur apni kaneezon se istimta' karo jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Walan tastati'u an ta'dilu bainan-nisa'i walau harastum fala tamilu kullal-maili fatadharuha kal-mu'allaqah) (Surah An-Nisa: 129) yani go tum chaho lekin tum se na ho sake ga ke aurton ke darmiyan poori tarah adl-o-insaf ko qaim rakh sako pas bilkul ek hi taraf jhuk kar doosri ko museebat mein na daal do, haan yaad rahe ke laundiyon mein bari waghera ki taqseem wajib nahin albatta mustahab hai jo kare us ne achha kiya aur jo na kare us par haraj nahin.

Is ke baad ke jumle ke matlab mein ba'az ne to kaha hai ke yeh qareeb hai un ma'ani ke ke tumhare ayal yani faqiri zyada na ho jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa in khiftum) yani agar tumhein faqr ka dar ho, Arabi shair kehta hai: Fama yadri-l-faqiru mata ghinahu wa ma yadri-l-ghani mata ya'il, yani faqir nahin janta ke kab ameer ho jaye ga, aur ameer ko maloom nahin ke kab faqir ban jaye ga, jab koi maskeen mohtaj ho jaye to Arab kehte hain (Aala-r-rajulu) yani yeh shakhs faqir ho gaya, gharz is ma'ani mein yeh lafz musta'mal to hai lekin yahan yeh tafseer kuch zyada achhi nahin maloom hoti, kyunke agar azad aurton ki kasrat faqiri ka ba'is ban sakti hai to laundiyon ki kasrat bhi faqiri ka sabab ho sakti hai, pas sahih qaul jamhoor ka hai ke murad yeh hai ke yeh qareeb hai is se ke tum zulm se bach jao, Arab mein kaha jata hai (Aala fil-hukmi) jabke zulm-o-jor kiya ho, Abu Talib ke mashhoor qaside mein hai.

Bimizan-e-Qist la yakhbasu sha'iratan lahu shahidun min nafsihi ghaira 'a'il. Zameer behtareen tarazu hai, yani aisi tarazu se toltay hain jo ek jau barabar ki bhi kami nahin karta. Us ke paas us ka gawah khud us ka nafs hai jo zalim nahin hai. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke jab Kufiyon ne Hazrat Usman (R.A) par ek khat kuch ilzaam likh kar bheja to un ke jawab mein Khalifa-e-Rasool (ﷺ) ne likha ke (Inni lastu bimizanin a'ool) main zulm ka tarazu nahin hoon. Sahih Ibn-e-Hibban waghera mein ek marfoo hadith is jumla ki tafseer mein marvi hai ke is ka ma'ani hai tum zulm na karo. Abu Hatim (R.H) farmatay hain is ka marfoo hona to khata hai, haan yeh Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ka qaul hai. Isi tarah la ta'ooloo ke yahi ma'ani hain yani tum zulm na karo. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A), Hazrat Ayesha (R.A), Hazrat Mujahid (R.H), Hazrat Ikrama (R.H), Hazrat Hasan (R.H), Hazrat Abu Malik (R.H), Hazrat Abu Zareen (R.H), Hazrat Nakh'i (R.H), Hazrat Sha'bi (R.H), Hazrat Zahhak (R.H), Hazrat Atta Khurasani (R.H), Hazrat Qatada (R.H), Hazrat Suddi (R.H) aur Hazrat Muqatil bin Hayyan (R.H) waghera se bhi marvi hain. Hazrat Ikrama (R.H) ne bhi Abu Talib ka wahi sher pesh kiya hai, Imam Ibn-e-Jareer ne isay riwayat kiya hai aur khud Imam sahab bhi isi ko pasand farmatay hain. Phir farmata hai apni biwiyon ko un ke mehar khush-dili se ada kar diya karo jo bhi muqarrar huay hon aur jin ko tum ne manzoor kiya ho. Haan agar aurat khud apna sara ya thoda bahut mehar apni khushi se mard ko maaf kar de to usay ikhtiyar hai aur is soorat mein beshak mard ko us ka apnay istemaal mein lana halal-e-tayyab hai. Nabi (ﷺ) ke baad kisi ko jaiz nahin ke baghair mehar-e-wajib ke nikah karay na yeh ke jhoot-moot mehar ka naam hi naam ho. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Ali (R.A) ka qaul marvi hai ke tum mein se jab koi bimar paray to usay chahiye ke apni biwi se us ke maal ke teen dirham ya kam-o-besh le, un ka shehad khareed le aur barish ka aasmani pani us mein mila le to teen teen bhala'iyan mil jayengi, aayat (Hani'an Mari'an) to maal aurat aur shifa shehad aur mubarak barish ka pani. Hazrat Abu Saleh (R.H) farmatay hain ke log apni betiyon ka mehar aap letay thay jis par yeh aayat utri aur unhein is se rok diya gaya (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim aur Ibn-e-Jareer). Is hukm ko sun kar logon ne Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ) se poocha ke un ka mehar kya hona chahiye? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya jis cheez par bhi un ke wali razamand ho jayen (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apnay khutbay mein teen martaba farmaya ke bewa aurton ka nikah kar diya karo, ek shakhs ne kharay ho kar poocha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) aisi soorat mein un ka mehar kya hoga? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya jis par un ke ghar walay raazi ho jayen, is ke ek rawi Ibn-e-Sulmani za'eef hain, phir is mein inqita' bhi hai.

Kam-aql aur yateemon ke bare mein ahkamat. Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala logon ko mana farmata hai ke kam-aql biwiyon ko maal ke tasarruf se rokein, maal ko Allah Ta'ala ne tijaraton waghera mein laga kar insaan ka zariya-e-ma'ash banaya hai, is se maloom hua ke kam-aql logon ko un ke maal ke kharch se rok dena chahiye, maslan nabaligh bacha ho ya majnoon-o-deewana ho ya kam-aql bewaqoof ho aur be-deen ho buri tarah apne maal ko luta raha ho, isi tarah aisa shakhs jis par qarz bahut charh gaya ho jise woh apne kul maal se bhi ada nahin kar sakta agar qarz-khwah hakim-e-waqt se darkhwast karein to hakim woh sab maal us ke qabze se le le ga aur use be-dakhal kar de ga. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain yahan (Sufaha) se murad teri aulad aur auratein hain, isi tarah Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood, Hakam bin Utaina, Hasan aur Zahhak R.H se bhi marwi hai ke is se murad auratein aur bache hain, Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair R.H farmate hain yateem murad hain, Mujahid, Ikrama aur Qatada R.H ka qaul hai ke auratein murad hain, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya beshak auratein bewaqoof hain magar jo apne khawand ki itaat-guzar hon, Ibn-e-Marduyah mein bhi yeh hadith mutawwal marwi hai, Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A farmate hain ke is se murad sarkash khadim hain. Phir farmata hai unhein khilao pehnao aur achi baat kaho. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain yani tera maal jis par teri guzar-basar mauqoof hai use apni biwi bachon ko na de daal kar phir un ka haath takta phire balkay apna maal apne qabze mein rakh is ki islah karta reh aur khud apne haath se un ke khane kapre ka bandobast kar aur un ke kharch utha. Hazrat Abu Musa R.A farmate hain teen qisam ke log hain ke woh Allah Ta'ala se dua karte hain lekin Allah Ta'ala qabool nahin farmata, ek woh shakhs jis ki biwi bad-khulq ho aur phir bhi woh use talaq na de, doosra woh shakhs jo apna maal bewaqoof ko de de halankeh Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai bewaqoof ko apna maal na do, teesra woh shakhs jis ka qarz kisi par ho aur us ne is qarz par kisi ko gawah na kiya ho. Un se bhali baat kaho yani un se neki aur sila-rehmi karo, is ayat se maloom hua ke mohtajon se sulook karna chahiye, use jise bil-fa'al tasarruf ka haq na ho us ke khane kapre ki khabar-geeri karni chahiye aur us ke sath narm zabani aur khush-khulqi se pesh aana chahiye. Phir farmaya yateemon ki dekh-bhaal rakho yahan tak ke woh jawani ko pahunch jayein, yahan nikah se murad bulughat hai aur bulughat us waqt sabit hoti hai jab use khaas qisam ke khwab aane lagein jin mein khaas paani uchal kar nikalta hai, Hazrat Ali R.A farmate hain mujhe Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yeh farman bakhoobi yaad hai ke ehtelam ke baad yateemi nahin aur na tamam din raat chup rehna hai.

Doosri hadith mein hai teen qisam ke logon se qalam utha liya gaya hai, bachay se jab tak baligh na ho, sotay se jab tak jaag na jaye, majnoon se jab tak hosh na aajaye, pas ek to alamat-e-bulugh yeh hai doosri alamat-e-bulugh baaz ke nazdeek yeh hai ke pandrah saal ki umar hojaye is ki daleel Bukhari Muslim ki Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar wali hadith hai jis mein woh farmatay hain ke Uhud wali larai mein mujhe Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne sath is liye nahin liya tha ke us waqt meri umar chaudah saal ki thi aur Khandaq ki larai mein jab mein hazir kiya gaya to aap ne qabool farma liya us waqt mein pandrah saal ka tha. Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H) ko jab yeh hadith pohanchi to aap ne farmaya nabaligh baligh ki had yahi hai, teesri alamat-e-bulughat ki zer-e-naaf ke baalon ka nikalna hai, is mein ulama ke teen qaul hain ek yeh ke alamat-e-bulugh hai doosray yeh ke nahin teesray yeh ke musalmanon mein nahin aur zimmiyon mein hai is liye ke mumkin hai kisi dawa se yeh baal jald nikal aatay hon aur zimmi par jawab hotay hi jizya lag jata hai to woh isay kyun istemaal karne laga? Lekin sahih baat yeh hai ke sab ke haq mein yeh alamat-e-bulughat hai kyunke awwalan to jabli amr hai ilaj-e-moalija ka ehtemal bohat door ka ehtemal hai theek yahi hai ke yeh baal apne waqt par hi nikalte hain, doosri daleel Musnad-e-Ahmed ki hadith hai, jis mein Hazrat Atiya Qurzi ka bayan hai ke Banu Quraiza ki larai ke baad hum log Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samnay pesh kiye gaye to aap ne hukum diya ke ek shakhs dekhay jis ke yeh baal nikal aaye hon usay qatl kardiya jaye aur na niklay hon usay chhor diya jaye chunancha yeh baal mere bhi na niklay thay mujhe chhor diya gaya, Sunan-e-Arba mein bhi yeh hadith hai aur Imam Tirmidhi isay Hasan Sahih farmatay hain, Hazrat Saad ke faislay par raazi ho kar yeh qabeela larai se baaz aaya tha phir Hazrat Saad ne yeh faisla kiya ke in mein se larnay walay to qatl kar diye jayen aur bachay qaidi bana liye jayen. Garaib-e-Abi Ubaid mein hai ke ek larkay ne ek naujawan larki ki nisbat kaha ke mein ne is se badkari ki hai darasal yeh tohmat thi Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne usay tohmat ki had lagani chahi lekin farmaya dekh lo agar us ke zer-e-naaf ke baal ug aaye hon to us par had jaari kardo warna nahin dekha to agay na thay chunancha us par se had hata di. Phir farmata hai jab tum dekho ke yeh apne deen ki salahiyat aur maal ki hifazat ke laiq hogaye hain to un ke waliyon ko chahiye ke un ke maal unhein de dein. Baghair zaroori haajat ke sirf is dar se ke yeh baray hotay hi apna maal hum se le lenge to hum is se pehlay hi un ke maal ko khatam kardein un ka maal na khao.

Jise zaroorat na ho, khud ameer ho, khata peeta ho to use to chahiye ke un ke maal mein se kuch bhi na le, murdar aur bahe hue khoon ki tarah yeh maal un par haram-e-mehaz hai, haan agar wali maskeen mohtaj ho to beshak use jaiz hai ke apni parwarish ke haq ke mutabiq waqt ki haajat aur dastoor ke mojib is maal mein se kha pi le, apni haajat ko dekhiye aur apni mehnat ko, agar haajat mehnat se kam ho to haajat ke mutabiq le aur agar mehnat haajat se kam ho to mehnat ka badla le le, phir aisa wali agar maldar ban jaye to use is khaye hue aur liye hue maal ko wapas karna padega ya nahin? Is mein do qaul hain, ek to yeh ke wapas na dena hoga is liye ke us ne apne kaam ke badle le liya hai, Imam Shafi R.H ke sathiyon ke nazdeek yahi sahih hai, is liye ke aayat mein baghair badal ke mubah qarar diya hai aur Musnad-e-Ahmad waghera mein hai ke ek shakhs ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ mere paas maal nahin, ek yateem meri parwarish mein hai to kya main us ke khane se kha sakta hoon? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya haan, is yateem ka maal apne kaam mein la sakta hai basharte ke haajat se zyada na uda, na jama kar, na yeh ho ke apne maal ko to bacha rakhe aur us ke maal ko khata chala jaye, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein bhi aisi hi riwayat hai, Ibn-e-Hibban waghera mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Huzoor ﷺ se sawal kiya ke main apne yateem ko adab sikhane ke liye zarooratan kis cheez se maroon? Farmaya jis se tu apne bache ko tanbeeh karta hai, apna maal bacha kar us ka maal kharch na kar, na us ke maal se daulat-mand banne ki koshish kar, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se kisi ne poocha ke mere paas bhi oont hain aur mere haan jo yateem pal rahe hain un ke bhi oont hain, main apni oontniyan doodh peene ke liye faqiron ko tohfa de deta hoon to kya mere liye jaiz hai ke in yateemon ki oontniyon ka doodh pi loon?

Aap ne farmaya agar un yateemon ki gum shuda oontniyon ki ko toh dhoond lata hai un ke charay pani ki khabar geeri rakhta hai un ke hauz durust karta rehta hai aur un ki nigahbani kiya karta hai toh beshak doodh se nafa bhi utha lekin is tarah ke na un ke bachon ko nuqsan pohanche na haajat se zyada le, (Muwatta Malik). Hazrat Atta bin Rabah, Hazrat Ikrimah, Hazrat Ibrahim Nakh'i, Hazrat Atiyyah Aufi, Hazrat Hasan Basri (Rahimahumullah) ka yahi qaul hai. Dusra qaul yeh hai ke tang dasti ke door ho jane ke baad woh maal yateem ko wapas dena pare ga is liye ke asal toh muman'at hai albatta ek wajah se jawaz ho gaya tha jab woh wajah jati rahi toh is ka badal dena pare ga jaise koi bebas aur muztar ho kar kisi ghair ka maal kha le lekin haajat ke nikal jane ke baad agar achha waqt aaya toh use wapas dena hoga, dusri daleel yeh hai ke Hazrat Umar (R.A) jab takht-e-khilafat par baithe toh elaan farmaya tha ke meri haisiyat yahan yateem ke wali ki haisiyat hai agar mujhe zaroorat hi na hui toh main Bait-ul-Maal se kuch na loonga aur agar mohtaji hui toh bator qarz loonga jab aasani hui phir wapas kar doonga (Ibn Abi Dunya) yeh hadith Saeed bin Mansoor mein bhi hai aur is ki asnad sahih hai, Baihaqi mein bhi yeh hadith hai, Ibn Abbas se aayat ke is jumla ki tafseer mein marwi hai ke bator qarz khaye aur bhi mufassireen se yeh marwi hai, Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas farmate hain ma'roof se khane ka matlab yeh hai ke teen ungliyon se khaye aur riwayat mein aap se yeh marwi hai ke woh apne hi maal ko sirf apni zaroorat poori ho jane ke laiq hi kharch kare taake use yateem ke maal ki haajat hi na pare, Hazrat Aamir Sha'bi farmate hain agar aisi bebasi ho jis mein murdar khana jaiz ho jata hai toh beshak kha le lekin phir ada karna hoga, Yahya bin Saeed Ansari aur Rabee'ah se is ki tafseer yun marwi hai ke agar yateem faqeer ho toh is ka wali is ki zaroorat ke muwafiq de aur phir is wali ko kuch na mile ga, lekin ibarat yeh theek nahin baithta is liye ke is se pehle yeh jumla bhi hai ke jo ghani ho woh kuch na le, ya'ni jo wali ghani ho toh yahan bhi yahi matlab hoga jo wali faqeer ho na yeh ke jo yateem faqeer ho, dusri aayat mein hai aayat (Wala taqrabu malal yatimi illa billati hiya ahsanu hatta yablugha ashuddah) (6. Al-An'am: 152) ya'ni yateem ke maal ke qareeb bhi na jao haan bator islah ke phir agar tumhein haajat ho toh hasb-e-haajat batareeq-e-ma'roof is mein se khao piyo phir auliya se kaha jata hai ke jab woh balughat ko pohanch jayen aur tum dekh lo ke un mein tameez aa chuki hai toh gawah rakh kar un ke maal un ke supurd kar do, taake inkar karne ka waqt hi na aaye, yun toh darasal saccha shahid aur poora nigran aur bareek hisab lene wala Allah hi hai woh khoob janta hai ke wali ne yateem ke maal mein niyat kaisi rakhi?

Aya khurd burd kiya, tabah-o-barbad kiya, jhoot sach hisab likha aur diya, ya saaf dil aur nek niyati se nihayat chaukasi aur safai se uske maal ka poora poora khayal rakha aur hisab kitab saaf rakha, in sab baton ka haqiqi ilm to usi Dana-o-Bina nigran-o-negahban ko hai. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) se farmaya: Ae Abu Zar! Main tumhein natawan pata hoon aur jo apne liye chahta hoon wahi tere liye bhi pasand karta hoon, khabardar! Hargiz do shakhson ka bhi sardar aur ameer na banna, na kabhi kisi yateem ka wali banna.

Wirasat ke masail: Mushrikeen-e-Arab ka dastoor tha ke jab koi mar jata to uski bari aulad ko uska maal mil jata, choti aulad aur auratein bilkul mehroom rehtin. Islam ne yeh hukm nazil farma kar sab ki musawiyana haisiyat qaim kar di ke waris to sab honge, khwah qarabat-e-haqiqi ho ya khwah qarabat-e-haqiqi ho ya khwah ba-wajah-e-aqd-e-zaujiat ke ho ya ba-wajah-e-nisbat-e-azadi ho, hissa sab ko milega go kam-o-besh ho. "Umm-e-Kajja" Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir ho kar arz karti hain ke Huzoor mere do larke hain, unke walid faut ho gaye hain, unke paas ab kuch nahin. Pas yeh ayat nazil hui. Yehi hadith dusre alfaz se miras ki aur dono ayaton ki tafsir mein bhi anqareeb Insha'Allah aayegi, Wallahu A'lam.

Dusri ayat ka matlab yeh hai ke jab kisi marne wale ka wirsa batne lage aur wahan uska koi door ka rishtedar bhi aa jaye jiska koi hissa muqarrar na ho aur yateem-o-masakeen aa jayen to unhein bhi kuch na kuch de do. Ibtida-e-Islam mein to yeh wajib tha aur baaz kehte hain mustahab tha aur ab bhi yeh hukm baqi hai ya nahin? Is mein bhi do qaul hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) to ise baqi batate hain. Hazrat Mujahid, Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood, Hazrat Abu Musa, Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Abu Bakr, Hazrat Abu Al-Aliyah, Hazrat Sha'bi, Hazrat Hasan, Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair, Hazrat Ibn-e-Sirin, Hazrat Atta bin Abu Rabah, Hazrat Zuhri, Hazrat Yahya bin Ma'mar (Rahimahumullah) bhi baqi batate hain, balkeh yeh hazrat siwaye Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ke wujoob ke qail hain. Hazrat Ubaidah ek wasiyat ke wali thay. Unhon ne ek bakri zibah ki aur teenon qismon ke logon ko khilayi aur farmaya agar yeh ayat na hoti to yeh bhi mera maal tha. Hazrat Urwah ne Hazrat Mus'ab ke maal ki taqseem ke waqt bhi diya. Hazrat Zuhri ka bhi qaul hai ke yeh ayat muhkam hai, mansookh nahin. Ek riwayat mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke yeh wasiyat par mauqoof hai. Chunancha jab Abdur Rahman bin Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) ke inteqal ke baad unke sahibzade Hazrat Abdullah ne apne baap ka wirsa taqseem kiya aur yeh waqia Hazrat Mai Ayesha (R.A) ki maujoodgi ka hai to ghar mein jitne maskeen aur qarabat-dar thay sab ko diya aur isi ayat ki tilawat ki. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ko jab yeh maloom hua to farmaya usne theek nahin kiya, is ayat se to murad yeh hai ke jab marne wale ne iski wasiyat ki ho (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Baaz hazrat ka qaul hai ke yeh ayat bilkul mansookh hi hai, maslan Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yeh ayat mansookh hai aur nasikh ayat (Yusikumullahu fi auladikum, liz-zakari mislu hazzil-unsayain) (4:11) hai.

(An-Nisa: 11) hai, hissay muqarrar honay se pehlay yeh hukum tha phir jab hissay muqarrar ho chukay aur har haqdar ko khud Allah Ta'ala ne haq pohancha diya toh ab sadaqah sirf wohi reh gaya jo marnay wala keh gaya ho. Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyab (R.H) bhi yahi farmatay hain ke haan agar wasiyat un logon ke liye ho toh aur baat hai warna yeh aayat mansookh hai, jumhoor ka aur charon imamon ka yahi mazhab hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ne yahan ek ajeeb qaul ikhtiyar kiya hai, un ki lambi aur kayi baar ki tehreer ka mahasil yeh hai ke maal-e-wasiyat ki taqseem ke waqt jab mayyat ke rishtedar aa jayen toh unhein bhi de do aur yateem maskeen jo aa gaye hon un se narm kalam-i aur achhay jawab se pesh aao, lekin is mein nazar hai wallahu aalam. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) waghera farmatay hain taqseem se murad yahan wirsay ki taqseem hai, pas yeh qaul Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ke khilaf hai. Hadees-e-Shareef mein hai jis maal mein sadaqah mil jaye yani jo shakhs apnay maal se sadaqah na de us ka maal is wajah se gharat ho jata hai.

Phir farmata hai darein woh log jo agar apne peeche chhor jayein yani ek shakhs apni maut ke waqt wasiyat kar raha hai aur is mein apne warison ko zarar pahuncha raha hai toh is wasiyat ke sunne wale ko chahiye ke Allah ka khauf kare aur use theek baat ki rehnumai kare. Is ke warison ke liye aisi bhalai chahe jaise apne warison ke sath bhalai karana chahta hai jab ke un ki barbadi aur tabahi ka khauf ho. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke jab Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hazrat Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas (R.A) ke paas un ki bimari ke zamane mein un ki ayadat ko gaye aur Hazrat Sa'ad (R.A) ne kaha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere paas maal bahut hai aur sirf meri ek ladki hi mere peeche hai toh agar aap ijazat dein toh main apne maal ki do-tihai Allah ki raah mein sadqa kar doon? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya nahin. Unhon ne kaha phir ek tihai ki ijazat dijiye. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya khair lekin hai yeh bhi zyada, toh agar apne peeche apne warison ko tawangar chhor kar jaye is se behtar hai toh ke tu unhein faqeer chhor kar jaye ke woh dusron ke samne haath phailate phirein. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain log ek tihai se bhi kam yani chauthai ki hi wasiyat karein toh achha hai is liye ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne tihai ko bhi zyada farmaya hai. Dusra matlab is ayat ka yeh bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke tum yateemon ka utna hi khayal rakho jitna tumhari chhoti aulad ka tumhare marne ke baad chahte ho aur log khayal rakhein jis tarah tum nahin chahte ke un ke maal dusre zulm se kha jayein aur woh baligh ho kar faqeer reh jayein isi tarah tum dusron ki auladon ke maal na kha jao. Yeh matlab bhi bahut umda hai isi liye is ke baad hi yateemon ka maal na-haq maar lene walon ki saza bayan farmayi, ke yeh log apne pet mein angare bharne wale aur jahannum-e-wasil hone wale hain. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya saat gunahon se bacho jo halakat ka ba'is hain. Pucha gaya kya kya? Farmaya Allah ke sath shirk, jadu, be-wajah qatl, sood khori, yateem ka maal kha jana, jihad se peeth morna, bhooli bhali na-waqif aurton par tohmat lagana. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Sahaba (R.A) ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se Me'raj ki raat ka waqea pucha jis mein aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke main ne bahut se logon ko dekha ke un ke hont neeche latak rahe hain aur farishte unhein ghaseet kar un ka munh khoob khol dete hain phir jahannum ke garam patthar un mein thons dete hain jo un ke pet mein utar kar peeche ke raste se nikal jate hain aur woh be-tarah cheekh chilla rahe hain haye haye macha rahe hain. Main ne Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) se pucha yeh kaun log hain?

Kaha yeh yateemon ka maal kha jaane waale hain jo apne peton mein aag bhar rahe hain aur anqareeb jahannam mein jayenge, Hazrat Suddi (R.H) farmate hain yateem ka maal kha jaane waala qayamat ke roz apni qabr se is tarah uthaya jayega ke uske munh, aankhon, nathnon aur roo'ein roo'ein se aag ke shole nikal rahe honge, har shakhs dekhte hi pehchan lega ke isne kisi yateem ka maal na-haq kha rakha hai. Ibn Marduyah mein ek marfoo hadith bhi isi mazmoon ke qareeb qareeb marwi hai aur hadith mein hai main tumhein wasiyat karta hoon ke in dono za'eefon ka maal pahuncha do auraton ka aur yateem ka, inke maal se bacho, Surah Al-Baqarah mein yeh riwayat guzar chuki hai ke jab yeh aayat utri to jin ke paas yateem the unhon ne unka anaaj paani bhi alag kar diya, ab umooman aisa hota ke khaane peene ki unki koi cheez bach rehti to ya to dusre waqt isi baasi cheez ko khaate ya sadne ke baad phenk di jaati, ghar waalon mein se koi isey haath bhi na lagata tha, yeh baat dono taraf na-gawaar guzri, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke saamne bhi iska zikr aaya hai, is par aayat (وَيَسْــَٔـلُوْنَكَ عَنِ الْيَتٰمٰي ۭ قُلْ اِصْلَاحٌ لَّھُمْ خَيْرٌ ۭوَاِنْ تُخَالِطُوْھُمْ فَاِخْوَانُكُمْ) (2. Phir farmata hai darein woh log jo agar apne peeche chhor jayein yani ek shakhs apni maut ke waqt wasiyat kar raha hai aur is mein apne warison ko zarar pahuncha raha hai toh is wasiyat ke sunne wale ko chahiye ke Allah ka khauf kare aur use theek baat ki rehnumai kare. Is ke warison ke liye aisi bhalai chahe jaise apne warison ke sath bhalai karana chahta hai jab ke un ki barbadi aur tabahi ka khauf ho. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke jab Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hazrat Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas (R.A) ke paas un ki bimari ke zamane mein un ki ayadat ko gaye aur Hazrat Sa'ad (R.A) ne kaha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere paas maal bahut hai aur sirf meri ek ladki hi mere peeche hai toh agar aap ijazat dein toh main apne maal ki do-tihai Allah ki raah mein sadqa kar doon? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya nahin. Unhon ne kaha phir ek tihai ki ijazat dijiye. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya khair lekin hai yeh bhi zyada, toh agar apne peeche apne warison ko tawangar chhor kar jaye is se behtar hai toh ke tu unhein faqeer chhor kar jaye ke woh dusron ke samne haath phailate phirein. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain log ek tihai se bhi kam yani chauthai ki hi wasiyat karein toh achha hai is liye ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne tihai ko bhi zyada farmaya hai. Fuqaha farmate hain agar mayyat ke waris ameer hon tab toh khair tihai ki wasiyat karna mustahab hai aur agar faqeer hon toh is se kam ki wasiyat karna mustahab hai.

Dusra matlab is ayat ka yeh bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke tum yateemon ka utna hi khayal rakho jitna tumhari chhoti aulad ka tumhare marne ke baad chahte ho aur log khayal rakhein jis tarah tum nahin chahte ke un ke maal dusre zulm se kha jayein aur woh baligh ho kar faqeer reh jayein isi tarah tum dusron ki auladon ke maal na kha jao. Yeh matlab bhi bahut umda hai isi liye is ke baad hi yateemon ka maal na-haq maar lene walon ki saza bayan farmayi, ke yeh log apne pet mein angare bharne wale aur jahannum-e-wasil hone wale hain. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya saat gunahon se bacho jo halakat ka ba'is hain. Pucha gaya kya kya? Farmaya Allah ke sath shirk, jadu, be-wajah qatl, sood khori, yateem ka maal kha jana, jihad se peeth morna, bhooli bhali na-waqif aurton par tohmat lagana. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Sahaba (R.A) ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se Me'raj ki raat ka waqea pucha jis mein aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke main ne bahut se logon ko dekha ke un ke hont neeche latak rahe hain aur farishte unhein ghaseet kar un ka munh khoob khol dete hain phir jahannum ke garam patthar un mein thons dete hain jo un ke pet mein utar kar peeche ke raste se nikal jate hain aur woh be-tarah cheekh chilla rahe hain haye haye macha rahe hain. Main ne Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) se pucha yeh kaun log hain?

Kaha yeh yateemon ka maal kha jaane waale hain jo apne peton mein aag bhar rahe hain aur anqareeb jahannam mein jayenge, Hazrat Suddi (R.H) farmate hain yateem ka maal kha jaane waala qayamat ke roz apni qabr se is tarah uthaya jayega ke uske munh, aankhon, nathnon aur roo'ein roo'ein se aag ke shole nikal rahe honge, har shakhs dekhte hi pehchan lega ke isne kisi yateem ka maal na-haq kha rakha hai. Ibn Marduyah mein ek marfoo hadith bhi isi mazmoon ke qareeb qareeb marwi hai aur hadith mein hai main tumhein wasiyat karta hoon ke in dono za'eefon ka maal pahuncha do auraton ka aur yateem ka, inke maal se bacho, Surah Al-Baqarah mein yeh riwayat guzar chuki hai ke jab yeh aayat utri to jin ke paas yateem the unhon ne unka anaaj paani bhi alag kar diya, ab umooman aisa hota ke khaane peene ki unki koi cheez bach rehti to ya to dusre waqt isi baasi cheez ko khaate ya sadne ke baad phenk di jaati, ghar waalon mein se koi isey haath bhi na lagata tha, yeh baat dono taraf na-gawaar guzri, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke saamne bhi iska zikr aaya hai, is par aayat (وَيَسْــَٔـلُوْنَكَ عَنِ الْيَتٰمٰي ۭ قُلْ اِصْلَاحٌ لَّھُمْ خَيْرٌ ۭوَاِنْ تُخَالِطُوْھُمْ فَاِخْوَانُكُمْ) (2. Al-Baqarah: 220) utri jiska matlab yeh hai ke jis kaam mein yateemon ki behtari samjho karo, chunancha iske baad phir khaana paani ek saath hua.

"Umm-e-Kajja" Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir ho kar arz karti hain ke Huzoor mere do larke hain, unke walid faut ho gaye hain, unke paas ab kuch nahin.
