Phir farmata hai darein woh log jo agar apne peeche chhor jayein yani ek shakhs apni maut ke waqt wasiyat kar raha hai aur is mein apne warison ko zarar pahuncha raha hai toh is wasiyat ke sunne wale ko chahiye ke Allah ka khauf kare aur use theek baat ki rehnumai kare. Is ke warison ke liye aisi bhalai chahe jaise apne warison ke sath bhalai karana chahta hai jab ke un ki barbadi aur tabahi ka khauf ho. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke jab Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hazrat Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas (R.A) ke paas un ki bimari ke zamane mein un ki ayadat ko gaye aur Hazrat Sa'ad (R.A) ne kaha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere paas maal bahut hai aur sirf meri ek ladki hi mere peeche hai toh agar aap ijazat dein toh main apne maal ki do-tihai Allah ki raah mein sadqa kar doon? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya nahin. Unhon ne kaha phir ek tihai ki ijazat dijiye. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya khair lekin hai yeh bhi zyada, toh agar apne peeche apne warison ko tawangar chhor kar jaye is se behtar hai toh ke tu unhein faqeer chhor kar jaye ke woh dusron ke samne haath phailate phirein. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain log ek tihai se bhi kam yani chauthai ki hi wasiyat karein toh achha hai is liye ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne tihai ko bhi zyada farmaya hai. Fuqaha farmate hain agar mayyat ke waris ameer hon tab toh khair tihai ki wasiyat karna mustahab hai aur agar faqeer hon toh is se kam ki wasiyat karna mustahab hai.

Dusra matlab is ayat ka yeh bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke tum yateemon ka utna hi khayal rakho jitna tumhari chhoti aulad ka tumhare marne ke baad chahte ho aur log khayal rakhein jis tarah tum nahin chahte ke un ke maal dusre zulm se kha jayein aur woh baligh ho kar faqeer reh jayein isi tarah tum dusron ki auladon ke maal na kha jao. Yeh matlab bhi bahut umda hai isi liye is ke baad hi yateemon ka maal na-haq maar lene walon ki saza bayan farmayi, ke yeh log apne pet mein angare bharne wale aur jahannum-e-wasil hone wale hain. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya saat gunahon se bacho jo halakat ka ba'is hain. Pucha gaya kya kya? Farmaya Allah ke sath shirk, jadu, be-wajah qatl, sood khori, yateem ka maal kha jana, jihad se peeth morna, bhooli bhali na-waqif aurton par tohmat lagana. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Sahaba (R.A) ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se Me'raj ki raat ka waqea pucha jis mein aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke main ne bahut se logon ko dekha ke un ke hont neeche latak rahe hain aur farishte unhein ghaseet kar un ka munh khoob khol dete hain phir jahannum ke garam patthar un mein thons dete hain jo un ke pet mein utar kar peeche ke raste se nikal jate hain aur woh be-tarah cheekh chilla rahe hain haye haye macha rahe hain. Main ne Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) se pucha yeh kaun log hain?

Kaha yeh yateemon ka maal kha jaane waale hain jo apne peton mein aag bhar rahe hain aur anqareeb jahannam mein jayenge, Hazrat Suddi (R.H) farmate hain yateem ka maal kha jaane waala qayamat ke roz apni qabr se is tarah uthaya jayega ke uske munh, aankhon, nathnon aur roo'ein roo'ein se aag ke shole nikal rahe honge, har shakhs dekhte hi pehchan lega ke isne kisi yateem ka maal na-haq kha rakha hai. Ibn Marduyah mein ek marfoo hadith bhi isi mazmoon ke qareeb qareeb marwi hai aur hadith mein hai main tumhein wasiyat karta hoon ke in dono za'eefon ka maal pahuncha do auraton ka aur yateem ka, inke maal se bacho, Surah Al-Baqarah mein yeh riwayat guzar chuki hai ke jab yeh aayat utri to jin ke paas yateem the unhon ne unka anaaj paani bhi alag kar diya, ab umooman aisa hota ke khaane peene ki unki koi cheez bach rehti to ya to dusre waqt isi baasi cheez ko khaate ya sadne ke baad phenk di jaati, ghar waalon mein se koi isey haath bhi na lagata tha, yeh baat dono taraf na-gawaar guzri, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke saamne bhi iska zikr aaya hai, is par aayat (وَيَسْــَٔـلُوْنَكَ عَنِ الْيَتٰمٰي ۭ قُلْ اِصْلَاحٌ لَّھُمْ خَيْرٌ ۭوَاِنْ تُخَالِطُوْھُمْ فَاِخْوَانُكُمْ) (2. Al-Baqarah: 220) utri jiska matlab yeh hai ke jis kaam mein yateemon ki behtari samjho karo, chunancha iske baad phir khaana paani ek saath hua.

Mazeed masail-e-meeras jin ka har Musalman ko jaanna farz hai yeh ayat-e-karima aur us ke baad ki ayat aur is surat ke khatma ki ayat ilm-e-faraiz ki ayatein hain, yeh poora ilm in ayaton aur meeras ki ahadees se istinbat kiya gaya hai, jo hadeesein in ayaton ki goya tafsir aur tauzeeh hain, yahan hum is ayat ki tafsir likhte hain baqi jo meeras ke masail ki poori taqreer hai aur is mein jin dalail ki samajh mein jo kuch ikhtilaf hua hai us ke bayan karne ki munasib jagah ahkam ki kitabein hain na ke tafsir, Allah Ta'ala hamari madad farmaye, ilm-e-faraiz seekhne ki raghbat mein bohat si hadeesein aayi hain, in ayaton mein jin faraiz ka bayan hai yeh sab se zyada ahem hain, Abu Dawood aur Ibn-e-Majah mein hai ilm darasal teen hain aur is ke maswa fazool bharti hai, ayat-e-quraniya jo mazboot hain aur jin ke ahkam baqi hain, sunnat-e-qaima yani jo ahadees-e-sabit shuda hain aur fareeza-e-aadila yani masail-e-meeras jo in do se sabit hain. Ibn-e-Majah ki dusri zaeef sanad wali hadees mein hai ke faraiz seekho aur dusron ko sikhao. Yeh nisf ilm hai aur yeh bhool jate hain aur yahi pehli woh cheez hai jo meri ummat se chhin jaye gi, Hazrat Ibn-e-Uyaina (R.H) farmate hain ise aadha ilm is liye kaha gaya hai ke tamam logon ko umooman yeh pesh aate hain, Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein is ayat ki tafsir mein Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) se marvi hai ke main bimar tha An-Hazrat (ﷺ) aur Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) meri bimar pursi ke liye Banu Salma ke mohallay mein piyada pa tashreef laye main us waqt behosh tha aap ne pani mangwa kar wazu kiya phir wazu ke pani ka chheenta mujhe diya jis se mujhe hosh aaya, to main ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) main apne maal ki taqseem kis tarah karoon?

Is par Ayat-e-Sharifa nazil hui, Sahih Muslim Sharif, Nasai Sharif waghera mein bhi yeh hadith majood hai, Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi, Ibn Majah, Musnad-e-Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal waghera mein marvi hai ke Hazrat Sa'ad bin Rabi (R.A) ki biwi sahiba (R.A) Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke paas aayin aur kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) yeh dono Hazrat Sa'ad ki ladkiyan hain, in ke walid aap ke sath Jang-e-Uhud mein shareek thay aur wahin shaheed hue, in ke chacha ne in ka kul maal le liya hai, in ke liye kuch nahin chhora aur yeh zahir hai ke in ke nikah baghair maal ke nahin ho sakte, aap ne farmaya is ka faisla khud Allah kare ga, chunancha Ayat-e-Meeras nazil hui, aap ne in ke chacha ke paas aadmi bhej kar hukum bheja ke do tihaiyan (2/3) to in dono ladkiyon ko do aur athwan hissa (1/8) in ki maa ko do aur baqi maal tumhara hai. Ba-zahir aisa maloom hota hai ke Hazrat Jabir ke sawal par is Surat ki aakhri Ayat utri hogi jaise anqareeb aa raha hai Insha'Allah Ta'ala, is liye ke in ke waris sirf in ki behnein hi thin, ladkiyan thin hi nahin, woh to Kalala thay aur yeh Ayat isi bare mein yani Hazrat Sa'ad bin Rabi ke wirsay ke bare mein nazil hui hai aur is ke rawi bhi khud Hazrat Jabir hain. Haan, Hazrat Imam Bukhari (R.H) ne is hadith ko isi Ayat ki tafsir mein warid kiya hai is liye hum ne bhi in ki tabedari ki, Wallahu A'alam. Matlab Ayat ka yeh hai ke Allah Ta'ala tumhein tumhari aulad ke bare mein adl sikhata hai, Ahl-e-Jahiliyat tamam maal ladkon ko dete thay aur ladkiyan khali hath reh jati thin to Allah Ta'ala ne in ka hissa bhi muqarrar kar diya. Haan, dono ke hisson mein farq rakha, is liye ke mardon ke zimma jo zarooriyaat hain woh auraton ke zimma nahin, maslan apne muta'alliqeen ke khane peene aur kharch-o-akhrajat ki kafalat, tijarat aur kasb aur isi tarah ki aur mushaqqatein, to unhein in ki haajat ke mutabiq auraton se doguna dilwaya. Ba'az dana buzurgon ne yahan ek nihayat bareek nukta bayan kiya hai ke Allah Ta'ala apne bandon par ba-nisbat maa baap ke bhi zyada meharban hai, maa baap ko in ki auladon ke bare mein wasiyat kar raha hai, pas maloom hua ke maa baap apni aulad par itne meharban nahin jitna meharban hamara Khaliq apni makhlooq par hai. Chunancha ek Sahih hadith mein hai ke qaidiyon mein se ek aurat ka bacha us se chhoot gaya, woh paglon ki tarah use dhoondti phirti thi aur jaise hi mila apne seene se laga kar use doodh pilane lagi, Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) ne yeh dekh kar apne as-haab se farmaya bhala batao to kya yeh aurat bawajood apne ikhtiyar ke apne bache ko aag mein daal degi? Logon ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) hargiz nahin, aap ne farmaya Allah ki qasam Allah Ta'ala apne bandon par is se bhi zyada meharban hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke pehle hissa-dar maal ka sirf ladka tha, maa baap ko bator-e-wasiyat ke kuch mil jata tha, Allah Ta'ala ne ise mansookh kiya aur ladke ko ladki se doguna dilwaya aur maa baap ko chhatta-chhatta hissa dilwaya aur teesra hissa bhi aur biwi ko athwan hissa aur chautha hissa aur khawand ko aadha aur pao.

Farmate hain meeras ke ahkaam utarne par baaz logon ne kaha yeh achi baat hai ke aurat ko chautha aur aathwan hissa dilwaya ja raha hai aur ladki ko aadhon-aadh dilwaya ja raha hai aur nanhe nanhe bachon ka hissa muqarrar kiya ja raha hai halankeh in mein se koi bhi na ladai mein nikal sakta hai, na maal-e-ghaneemat la sakta hai acha tum is hadith se khamoshi barto shayad Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh bhool jaye hamare kehne ki wajah se aap in ahkaam ko badal dein, phir unhon ne aap se kaha ke aap ladki ko us ke baap ka aadha maal dilwa rahe hain halankeh na woh ghode par baithne ke laiq na dushman se ladne ke qabil, aap bache ko virsa dila rahe hain bhala woh kya faida pahuncha sakta hai? Yeh log jahiliyat ke zamane mein aisa hi karte the ke meeras sirf use dete the jo ladne marne ke qabil ho sab se bade ladke ko waris qarar dete the (agar marne wale ke ladke ladkiyan dono ho to farma diya ke ladki ko jitna aaye us se doguna ladke ko diya jaye yani ek ladki ek ladka hai to kul maal ke teen hisse kar ke do hisse ladke ko aur ek hissa ladki ko de diya jaye aur agar sirf ladki ko de diya jaye ab bayan farmata hai ke agar sirf ladkiyan hon to unhein kya milega? Mutarjim) lafz 'fauq' ko baaz log zaid batate hain jaise aayat (Fadribu fauqal-a'naqi wadribu minhum kulla banan) (8. Al-Anfal: 12) aayat mein lafz fauq zaid hai lekin hum yeh nahin maante na is aayat mein na is aayat mein, kyunke Quran mein koi aisi zaid cheez nahin hai jo mahaz be-faida ho Allah ke kalam mein aisa hona muhaal hai, phir yeh bhi khayal farmaiye ke agar aisa hi hota to us ke baad aayat (falahunna) na aata balkeh (falahuma) aata. Haan ise hum jaante hain ke agar ladkiyan do se zyada na hon yani sirf do hon to bhi yahi hukm hai yani unhein bhi do sulus milega kyunke dusri aayat mein do behnon ko do sulus dilwaya gaya hai aur jabkeh do behnein do sulus paati hain to do ladkiyon ko do sulus kyun na milega? Un ke liye to do tihai bator-e-aula hona chahiye, aur hadith mein aa chuka hai do ladkiyon ko Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne do tihai maal-e-tarka ka dilwaya jaisa ke is aayat ki shaan-e-nuzool ke bayan mein Hazrat Sa'ad (R.A) ki ladkiyon ke zikr mein is se pehle bayan ho chuka hai pas Kitab-o-Sunnat se yeh sabit ho gaya isi tarah is ki daleel yeh bhi hai ke ek ladki agar ho yani ladka na hone ki surat mein to use aadhon-aadh dilwaya gaya hai pas agar do ko bhi aadha hi dene ka hukm karna maqsood hota to yahin bayan hojata jab ek ko alag kar diya to maloom hua ke do ka hukm wahi hai jo do se zaid ka hai Wallahu A'lam.

Phir maa baap ka hissa bayan ho raha hai un ke wirsay ki mukhtalif soortein hain, ek toh yeh ke marne wale ki aulad ek ladki se zyada ho aur maa baap bhi hon toh unhein chatha chatha hissa mile ga yani chatha hissa maa ko aur chatha hissa baap ko, agar marne wale ki sirf ek ladki hi hai toh aadha maal toh woh ladki le le gi aur chatha hissa maa le le gi chatha hissa baap ko mile ga aur chatha hissa jo baqi raha woh bhi bator-e-asaba baap ko mil jaye ga pas is halat mein baap farz aur taseeb dono ko jama kar le ga yani muqarrara chatha hissa aur bator-e-asaba bachat ka maal. Dusri surat yeh hai ke sirf maa baap hi waris hon toh maa ko teesra hissa mil jaye ga aur baqi ka kul maa baap ko bator-e-asaba ke mil jaye ga toh goya do sulus maal us ke hath lage ga yani ba-nisbat maal ke dugna baap ko mil jaye ga. Ab agar marne wali aurat ka khawand bhi hai marne wale mard ki biwi hai yani aulad nahin sirf maa baap hain aur khawand se ya biwi toh is par toh ittefaq hai ke khawand ko aadha aur biwi ko pao mile ga, phir ulama ka is mein ikhtilaf hai ke maa ko is surat mein is ke baad kya mile ga? Teen qaul hain, ek toh yeh ke jo maal baqi raha us mein se teesra hissa mile ga dono suraton mein yani khwah aurat khawand chhod kar mari ho khwah mard aurat chhod kar mara ho is liye ke baqi ka maal un ki nisbat se goya kul maal hai aur maa ka hissa baap se aadha hai toh is baqi ke maal se teesra hissa yeh le le aur woh teesre hissay jo baqi rahe woh baap le le ga. Hazrat Umar (R.A), Hazrat Usman (R.A) aur ba-aitbar-e-zyada sahih riwayat Hazrat Ali (R.A) ka yahi faisla hai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) aur Hazrat Zaid bin Sabit (R.A) ka yahi qaul hai, saton fuqaha aur charon imamon aur jumhoor-e-ulama ka bhi fatwa hai. Dusra qaul yeh hai ke in dono suraton mein bhi maa ko kul maal ka sulus mil jaye ga, is liye ke aayat aam hai khawand biwi ke sath ho toh aur na ho toh aam taur par mayyat ki aulad na hone ki surat mein maa ko sulus dilwaya gaya hai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka yahi qaul hai, Hazrat Ali (R.A) aur Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal (R.A) se bhi isi tarah marwi hai.

Hazrat Shuraih aur Hazrat Dawood Zahiri bhi yahi farmate hain, Hazrat Abu Al-Hussain bin Laban Basri bhi apni kitab Eijaz mein jo ilm-e-faraiz ke bare mein hai isi qaul ko pasand karte hain, lekin is qaul mein nazar hai balkeh yeh qaul zaeef hai kyunke aayat ne is ka yeh hissa us waqt muqarrar farmaya hai jabkeh kul maal ki virasat sirf maa baap ko hi pahunchti ho, aur jabkeh zauj ya zauja se aur woh apne muqarrara hisse ke mustahiq hain toh phir jo baqi reh jayega beshak woh un dono hi ka hissa hai toh is mein sulus milega, kyunke is aurat ko kul maal ki chauthai milegi agar kul maal ke barah hisse kiye jayen toh teen hisse toh yeh legi aur chaar hisse maa ko milega baqi bache paanch hisse woh baap le lega lekin agar aurat mari hai aur us ka khawand maujood hai toh maa ko baqi maal ka teesra hissa milega agar kul maal ka teesra hissa is surat mein bhi maa ko dilwaya jaye toh use baap se bhi zyada pahunch jata hai maslan mayyat ke maal ke chhe hisse kiye teen toh khawand le gaya do maa le gayi toh baap ke palle ek hi padega jo maa se bhi thoda hai, is liye is surat mein chhe mein se teen toh khawand ko diye jayenge ek maa ko aur do baap ko, Hazrat Imam Ibn-e-Sirin R.H ka yahi qaul hai, yun samajhna chahiye ke yeh qaul do qaulon se murakkab hai, zaeef yeh bhi hai aur sahih qaul pehla hi hai wallahu aalam, maa baap ke ahwal mein se teesra haal yeh hai ke woh bhaiyon ke sath hon khwah woh sagay bhai hon ya sirf baap ki taraf se ya sirf maa ki taraf se toh woh baap ke hote hue apne bhai ke virsay mein kuch payenge nahin lekin haan maa ko tihai se hata kar chhatta hissa dilwayenge aur agar koi aur waris hi na ho aur sirf maa ke sath baap hi ho toh baqi maal kul ka kul baap le lega aur bhai bhi shariat mein bahut se bhaiyon ke mutaradif hain jamhoor ka yahi qaul hai, haan Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se marvi hai ke aap ne ek martaba Hazrat Usman R.A se kaha ke do bhai maa ko sulus se hata kar sudus tak nahin le jate Quran mein ukhuwwat jama ka lafz hai do bhai agar murad hote ikhwan kaha jata khalifa-e-salis ne jawab diya ke pehle hi se yeh chala aata hai aur charon taraf yeh masla isi tarah pahuncha hua hai tamam log is ke aamil hain main ise nahin badal sakta, awwalan toh yeh asar sabit hi nahin is ke rawi Hazrat Sho'ba ke bare mein Hazrat Imam Malik R.H ki jarah maujood hai phir yeh qaul Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka na hone ki dusri daleel yeh hai ke khud Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ke khas as-haab aur aala shagird bhi is ke khilaf hain Hazrat Zaid R.A farmate hain do ko bhi ukhuwwat kaha jata hai, Alhamdulillah main ne is maslay ko puri tarah ek alaihda risalay mein likha hai Hazrat Saeed bin Qatada R.H se bhi isi tarah marvi hai, haan mayyat ka agar ek hi bhai ho toh maa ko teesray hissay se hata nahin sakta, ulama-e-kiram ka farman hai ke is mein hikmat yeh hai ke mayyat ke bhaiyon ki shadiyon ka aur khane peene waghera ka kul kharch baap ke zimmay hai na ke maa ke zimmay is liye muqtazaye hikmat yahi tha ke baap ko zyada diya jaye, yeh taujeeh bahut hi umdah hai, lekin Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se ba-sanad-e-sahih marvi hai ke yeh chhatta hissa jo maa ka kam ho gaya unhein de diya jayega yeh qaul shaaz hai Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H farmate hain Hazrat Abdullah R.A ka yeh qaul tamam ummat ke khilaf hai, Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka qaul hai ke kalala use kehte hain jis ka beta aur baap na ho.

Phir farmaya wasiyat aur qarz ke baad taqseem-e-meeras hogi, tamam salaf-o-khalaf ka ijma hai ke qarz wasiyat par muqaddam hai aur fahwa-e-ayat ko bhi agar baghaur dekha jaye toh yahi maloom hota hai, Tirmidhi waghera mein hai Hazrat Ali bin Abu Talib (R.A) farmate hain tum Quran mein wasiyat ka hukum pehle parhte ho aur qarz ka baad mein lekin yaad rakhna ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne qarz pehle ada karaya hai, phir wasiyat jaari ki hai, ek maa zaad bhai aapas mein waris honge baghair allati bhaiyon ke, aadmi apne sagay bhai ka waris hoga na uska jis ki maa dusri ho, yeh hadith sirf Hazrat Haris se marwi hai aur un par baaz muhaddiseen ne jarah ki hai, lekin yeh hafiz-e-faraiz thay is ilm mein aap ko khaas dilchaspi aur dastaras thi aur hisab ke baray mahir thay wallahu aalam. Phir farmaya ke hum ne baap beton ko asal meeras mein apna apna muqarrara hissa lene wala banaya aur jahiliyat ki rasm hata di balkay Islam mein bhi pehle bhi aisa hi hukum tha ke maal aulad ko mil jata maa baap ko sirf bator-e-wasiyat ke milta tha jaise Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se pehle bayan ho chuka yeh mansookh kar ke ab yeh hukum hua tumhein yeh nahin maloom ke tumhein baap se zyada nafa pahunche ga ya aulad nafa degi umeed dono se nafa ki hai yaqeen kisi par bhi ek se zyada nahin, mumkin hai baap se zyada beta kaam aaye aur nafa pahunchaye aur mumkin hai betay se zyada baap se nafa pahunche aur woh kaam aaye, phir farmata hai yeh muqarrara hissay aur meeras ke yeh ahkaam Allah ki taraf se farz hain is mein kisi kami peshi ki kisi umeed ya kisi khauf se gunjaish nahin na kisi ko mehroom kar dena laiq se na kisi ko zyada dilwa dena, Allah Ta'ala Aleem-o-Hakeem hai jo jis ka mustahiq hai usay utna dilwata hai har cheez ki jagah ko woh bakhoobi jaanta hai tumhare nafa nuqsan ka usay poora ilm hai us ka koi kaam aur koi hukum hikmat se khaali nahin tumhein chahiye ke us ke ahkaam us ke farman maante chale jao.

Wirasat ki mazeed tafseelat Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke ae mard-o-tumhari auratein jo chhod kar marein agar un ki aulad na ho to is mein se aadho-aad hissa tumhara hai aur agar un ke baal bachche hon to tumhein chauthai milega, wasiyat aur qarz ke baad. Tarteeb is tarah hai pehle qarz ada kiya jaye phir wasiyat poori ki jaye phir wirsa taqseem ho, yeh aisa masla hai jis par tamam ulama-e-ummat ka ijma hai, pote bhi is masle mein hukm mein betiyon ki hi tarah hain balkay un ki aulad dar aulad ka bhi yahi hukm hai ke un ki maujoodgi mein khawand ko chauthai milega. Phir auraton ko hissa bataya ke unhein ya chauthai milega ya aathwan hissa, chauthai to is halat mein ke marne wale khawand ki aulad na ho, aur aathwan hissa is halat mein ke aulad ho, is chauthai ya aathwein hisse mein marne wale ki sab biwiyan shamil hain, chaar hon to un mein yeh hissa barabar barabar taqseem ho jaye ga, teen ya do hon tab bhi aur agar ek ho to usi ka yeh hissa hai. Ayat (min ba'di wasiyyatin) ki tafseer is se pehli ayat mein guzar chuki hai.

(Kalala) mushtaq hai ikleel se. Ikleel kehte hain us taaj waghera ko jo sar ko har taraf se gher le, yahan murad yeh hai ke us ke waris ird-gird hashia ke log hain asal aur far'a yani jar ya shaakh nahin. Sirf Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) se Kalala ka ma'ani poocha jata hai to aap farmate hain main apni raye se jawab deta hoon agar theek ho to Allah ki taraf se hai aur agar ghalat ho to meri aur shaitan ki taraf se hai aur Allah aur Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is se bari-uz-zimma hain. Kalala woh hai jis ka na larka ho na baap. Hazrat Umar (R.A) jab khalifa hue to aap ne bhi is se muwafiqat ki aur farmaya mujhe Abu Bakr ki raye se khilaf karte hue sharm aati hai (Ibn-e-Jareer waghera). Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka sab se aakhri zamana paane wala main hoon, main ne aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna farmate the baat wohi hai jo main ne kahi. Theek aur durust yahi hai ke Kalala use kehte hain jis ka na walad ho na walid. Hazrat Ali, Ibn-e-Masood, Ibn-e-Abbas, Zaid bin Sabit (Razi Allahu Anhum / R.A), Sha'bi, Nakh'i, Hasan, Qatada, Jabir bin Zaid, Hakam (Rahimahumullah / R.H) bhi yahi farmate hain. Ahl-e-Madina, Ahl-e-Kufa, Ahl-e-Basra ka bhi yahi qaul hai. Saaton fuqaha, charon imam aur jamhoor-e-salaf-o-khalaf balkay tamam yahi farmate hain. Bohat se buzurgon ne is par ijma naqal kiya hai aur ek marfoo hadith mein bhi yahi aaya hai. Ibn-e-Lubaab farmate hain ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas se yeh bhi marwi hai ke Kalala woh hai jis ki aulad na ho lekin sahih qaul pehla hi hai aur mumkin hai ke raawi ne murad samjhi hi na ho. Phir farmaya ke us ka bhai ya behen ho yani maa zaad, jaise ke Sa'ad bin Waqas waghera ba'az salaf ki qira'at hai. Hazrat Siddiq waghera se bhi yahi tafseer marwi hai to un mein se har ek ke liye chatha hissa hai agar zyada hon to ek sulus mein sab shareek hain. Maa zaad bhai baqi warison se kayi wajah se mukhtalif hain. Ek to yeh ke yeh bawajood apne wirsay ke dilane wale ke bhi waris hote hain maslan maa. Dusre yeh ke un ke mard-o-aurat yani behen bhai meeras mein barabar hain. Teesre yeh ke yeh isi waqt waris hote hain jabke mayyat Kalala ho, pas baap dada ki yani pote ki maujoodgi mein yeh waris nahin hote. Chauthe yeh ke unhein sulus se zyada nahin milta to goya kitne hi hon mard hon ya aurat. Hazrat Umar ka faisla hai ke maa zaad behen bhai ka wirsa aapas mein is tarah bate ga ke mard ke liye dohra aur aurat ke liye akahra. Hazrat Zahri farmate hain Hazrat Umar aisa faisla nahin kar sakte ta-waqt-e-ke unhon ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yeh suna ho. Aayat mein itna to saaf hai ke agar is se zyada hon to sulus mein shareek hain. Is surat mein ulama ka ikhtilaf hai ke agar mayyat ke warison mein khawand ho aur maa ho ya dadi ho aur do maa zaad bhai hon aur ek ya ek se zyada baap ki taraf se bhai hon to jamhoor to kehte hain ke is surat mein khawand ko aadha mile ga aur maa ya dadi ko chatha hissa mile ga aur maa zaad bhai ko tihayi mile ga aur isi mein sagay bhai bhi shamil hon ge qadr-e-mushtarak ke taur par jo maa zaad bhai hai. Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ke zamana mein ek aisi hi surat pesh aayi thi to aap ne khawand ko aadha dilwaya aur sulus maa zaad bhaiyon ko dilwaya to sagay bhaiyon ne bhi apne tayin pesh kiya aap ne farmaya tum un ke sath shareek ho. Hazrat Usman se bhi isi tarah shareek kar dena marwi hai, aur do riwayaton mein se ek riwayat aisi hai. Ibn-e-Masood aur Zaid bin Sabit aur Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se bhi marwi hai. Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyab, Qazi Shuraih, Masrooq, Taoos, Muhammad bin Sireen, Ibrahim Nakh'i, Umar bin Abdul Aziz, Sauri aur Shareek (Rahimahumullah / R.H) ka qaul bhi yahi hai. Imam Malik aur Imam Shafi'i aur Imam Ishaq bin Rahwiya bhi isi taraf gaye hain. Haan Hazrat Ali bin Abu Talib (R.A) is mein shirkat ke qail na the balkay aap aulad-e-umm ko is halat mein sulus dilwate the aur ek maa baap ki aulad ko kuch nahin dilwate the is liye ke yeh asaba hain aur asaba us waqt paate hain jab zawi-ul-farz se bach jaye. Balkay Wakee bin Jarrah kehte hain Hazrat Ali se is ke khilaf marwi hi nahin. Hazrat Ubay bin Ka'ab, Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari ka qaul bhi yahi hai. Ibn-e-Abbas se bhi mashhoor yahi hai. Sha'bi, Ibn-e-Abi Laila, Abu Hanifa, Abu Yusuf, Muhammad bin Hasan, Hasan bin Ziyad, Zufar bin Huzail, Imam Ahmad, Yahya bin Adam, Na'eem bin Hammad, Abu Saur, Dawood Zahiri bhi isi taraf gaye hain. Abu-ul-Hasan bin Laban Farzi ne bhi isi ko ikhtiyar kiya hai, mulahiza ho un ki kitab Al-Ijaaz. Phir farmaya yeh wasiyat ke jaari karne ke baad hai. Wasiyat aisi ho jis mein khilaf-e-adl na ho, kisi ko zarar aur nuqsan na pohanchaya gaya ho na kisi par jabr-o-zulm kiya gaya ho. Kisi waris ka na wirsa mara gaya ho na kam-o-besh kiya gaya ho. Is ke khilaf wasiyat karne wala aur aisi khilaf-e-shara wasiyat mein koshish karne wala Allah ke hukum aur us ki shariyat mein is ke khilaf karne wala aur is se larnay wala hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain wasiyat mein kisi ko zarar-o-nuqsan pohanchana kabeera gunah hai (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Nasai mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ka qaul bhi isi tarah marwi hai. Ba'az riwayaton mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas se is farman ke baad aayat ke is tukray ki tilawat karna bhi marwi hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer ke qaul ke mutabiq theek baat yahi hai ke yeh marfoo hadith nahin mauqoof qaul hai. Aima-e-Kiram ka is mein ikhtilaf hai ke waris ke liye jo iqrar mayyat kar jaye aaya woh sahih hai ya nahin?

Baaz kehte hain sahih nahin hai is liye ke is mein tohmat lagne ki gunjaish hai, Hadith-e-Sharif mein ba-sanad sahih aa chuka hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne har haqdar ko us ka haq pahuncha diya hai ab waris ke liye koi wasiyat nahin, Malik, Ahmad bin Hanbal, Abu Hanifa ka qaul yahi hai, Shafi'i ka bhi pehla qaul yahi tha lekin aakhri qaul yeh hai ke iqrar karna sahih mana jaye ga, Ta'oos, Hasan, Umar bin Abdul Aziz ka qaul bhi yahi hai, Hazrat Imam Bukhari (R.H) bhi isi ko pasand karte hain aur apni kitab Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein isi ko tarjeeh dete hain, un ki daleel ek yeh riwayat bhi hai ke Hazrat Rafi bin Khadij (R.A) ne wasiyat ki ke Fazariya ne jis cheez par apne darwaze band kar rakhe hon woh na khole jayen, Hazrat Imam Bukhari (R.H) ne phir farmaya hai ke baaz log kehte hain ba-sabab warison ke sath badgumani ke is ka yeh iqrar jaiz nahin, lekin main kehta hoon ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne to farmaya hai badgumani se bacho badgumani to sab se zyada jhoot hai, Quran-e-Karim mein farman-e-Allah majood hai ke Allah Ta'ala tumhein hukum deta hai ke jis ki jo amanat ho woh pahuncha do, is mein waris aur ghair waris ki koi takhsees nahin, yeh yaad rahe ke yeh ikhtilaf us waqt hai jab iqrar fil-waqai sahih ho aur nafs-ul-amr ke mutabiq ho aur agar sirf heela saazi ho aur baaz warison ko zyada dene aur baaz ko kam pahunchane ke liye ek bahana bana liya ho to bil-ijma ise pura karna haram hai aur is aayat ke saaf alfaaz bhi is ki hurmat ka fatwa dete hain (iqrar fil-waqai sahih hone ki surat mein is ka pura karna zaroori hai jaisa ke dusri jamaat ka qaul hai aur jaisa ke Hazrat Imam Bukhari (R.H) ka mazhab hai. Mutarjim) phir farmaya yeh Allah Azza-wa-Jal ke ahkaam hain Allah Azeem-o-Aala ilm-o-hilm wala hai.

Nafarmanon ka hashr aur jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala ki aur uske Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nafarmani kare aur uski muqarrar ki hui haddon se aage nikal jaye use woh Jahannam mein daal dega jis mein hamesha rahega, aison ke liye ahanat karne wala azab hai, yani yeh faraiz aur yeh miqdar jise Allah Ta'ala ne muqarrar kiya hai aur mayyat ke warison ko unki qarabat ki nazdeeki aur unki haajat ke mutabiq jitna jise dilwaya hai yeh sab Allah Zul-Karam ki hudood hain tum in haddon ko na todo na is se aage badho. Jo shakhs Allah Azzawajal ke in ahkaam ko maan le, koi heela hawala kar ke kisi waris ko kam-besh dilwane ki koshish na kare, hukm-e-Ilahi aur fareeza-e-Ilahi joon ka toon baja laye, Allah ka wada hai ke woh use hamesha behne wali nehron ki Jannat mein dakhil karega, yeh kamyab naseeb-war aur maqsad ko pahunchne wala aur murad ko paane wala hoga, aur jo Allah ke kisi hukm ko badal de, kisi waris ke wirse ko kam-o-besh kar de, raza-e-Ilahi ko pesh-e-nazar na rakhe balkay uske hukm ko radd kar de aur uske khilaf amal kare, woh Allah ki taqseem ko achi nazar se nahin dekhta aur uske hukm ko adl nahin samajhta to aisa shakhs hamesha rehne wali ruswai aur ahanat wale dard-naak aur haibat-naak azabon mein mubtala rahega. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke ek shakhs sattar saal tak neki ke amal karta rehta hai phir wasiyat ke waqt zulm-o-sitam karta hai, uska khatma bure amal par hota hai aur woh jahannami ban jata hai aur ek shakhs burai ka amal sattar saal tak karta rehta hai phir apni wasiyat mein adl karta hai aur khatma uska behtar ho jata hai to Jannat mein dakhil ho jata hai, phir is hadith ke rawi Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain is aayat ko padho: Aayat (Tilka hududullahi wa man yuti'illaha wa rasulahu yudkhilhu jannatin tajri min tahtiha al-anharu khalidina fiha wa zalikal fawzul azim. 13. Wa man ya'siillaha wa rasulahu wa yata'adda hududahu yudkhilhu naran khalidan fiha wa lahu azabun muhin. 14.) (Surah An-Nisa: 13-14) se azab (muhin) tak. Sunan Abi Dawood ke baab 'Al-Idrar fil Wasiyyah' mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke ek mard ya aurat Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at mein saath saal tak lage rahe hain phir maut ke waqt wasiyat mein koi kami beshi kar jate hain to unke liye Jahannam wajib ho jati hai, phir Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ne aayat (min ba'di wasiyyatin) se aakhir aayat tak padhi. Tirmidhi aur Ibn Majah mein bhi yeh hadith hai, Imam Tirmidhi ise ghareeb kehte hain, Musnad Ahmad mein yeh hadith tamam-o-kamal ke sath maujood hai.

Wa man ya'siillaha wa rasulahu wa yata'adda hududahu yudkhilhu naran khalidan fiha wa lahu azabun muhin. 14.) (Surah An-Nisa: 13-14) se azab (muhin) tak. Sunan Abi Dawood ke baab 'Al-Idrar fil Wasiyyah' mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke ek mard ya aurat Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at mein saath saal tak lage rahe hain phir maut ke waqt wasiyat mein koi kami beshi kar jate hain to unke liye Jahannam wajib ho jati hai, phir Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ne aayat (min ba'di wasiyyatin) se aakhir aayat tak padhi. Tirmidhi aur Ibn Majah mein bhi yeh hadith hai, Imam Tirmidhi ise ghareeb kehte hain, Musnad Ahmad mein yeh hadith tamam-o-kamal ke sath maujood hai.

Siyah-kar aurat aur us ki saza: Ibtida-e-Islam mein yeh hukm tha ke jab aadil gawahon ki sachi gawahi se kisi aurat ki siyah-kari sabit ho jaye to use ghar se bahar na nikalne diya jaye, ghar mein hi qaid kar diya jaye aur janam qaid yani maut se pehle use chhora na jaye. Is faisla ke baad yeh aur baat hai ke Allah un ke liye koi aur rasta paida kar de. Phir jab dusri surat ki saza tajweez hui to woh mansookh ho gayi aur yeh hukm bhi mansookh hua. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain jab tak Surah Noor ki aayat nahin utri thi zina-kar aurat ke liye yahi hukm raha, phir is aayat mein shadi-shuda ko rajam karne yani patthar maar maar kar maar dalne aur be-shadi-shuda ko kore maarne ka hukm utra. Hazrat Ikrama, Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair, Hazrat Hasan, Hazrat Atta Khurasani, Hazrat Abu Saleh, Hazrat Qatada, Hazrat Zaid bin Aslam aur Hazrat Zahhak ka bhi yahi qaul hai ke yeh aayat mansookh hai aur is par sab ka ittefaq hai. Hazrat Ubada bin Samit R.A farmate hain ke Rasool Allah ﷺ par jab wahi utarti to aap ﷺ par is ka bada asar hota aur takleef mehsoos hoti aur chehre ka rang badal jata. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne ek din apne Nabi ﷺ par wahi nazil farmayi, kaifiyat-e-wahi se nikle to aap ﷺ ne farmaya mujh se hukm-e-Ilahi lo, Allah Ta'ala ne siyah-kar auraton ke liye rasta nikal diya hai. Agar shadi-shuda aurat ya shadi-shuda mard se is jurm ka irtikab ho to ek sau kore aur pattharon se maar dalna aur ghair shadi-shuda hon to ek sau kore aur ek saal ki jala-watni (Muslim waghera). Tirmidhi waghera mein bhi yeh hadith alfaaz mein kuch tabdili ke sath marwi hai, Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Sahih kehte hain, isi tarah Abu Dawood mein bhi. Ibn-e-Marduyah ki ghareeb hadith mein kunware aur byahe hue ke hukm ke sath hi yeh bhi hai ke dono agar burhe hon to unhein rajam kar diya jaye lekin yeh hadith ghareeb hai. Tabrani mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya Surah Nisa ke utarne ke baad ab rok rakhne ka yani auraton ko gharon mein qaid rakhne ka hukm nahin raha. Imam Ahmad ka mazhab is hadith ke mutabiq yahi hai ke zani shadi-shuda ko kore bhi lagaye jayenge aur rajam bhi kiya jayega aur jamhoor kehte hain kore nahin lagenge sirf rajam kiya jayega is liye ke Nabi ﷺ ne Hazrat Ma'iz R.A ko aur Ghamidiyah aurat ko rajam kiya lekin kore nahin mare, isi tarah do yahudiyon ko bhi aap ﷺ ne rajam ka hukm diya aur rajam se pehle bhi unhein kore nahin lagwaye. Phir jamhoor ke is qaul ke mutabiq maloom hua ke unhein kore lagane ka hukm mansookh hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Phir farmaya is behayai ke kaam ko do mard agar aapas mein karein unhein eeza pahunchao yani bura bhala keh kar sharm waghera dila kar jotiyan laga kar, yeh hukm bhi isi tarah par raha yahan tak ke ise bhi Allah Ta'ala ne koday aur rajam se mansookh farmaya, Hazrat Ikrama, Atta, Hasan, Abdullah bin Kaseer farmate hain is se murad bhi mard-o-aurat hain, Suddi farmate hain murad woh naujawan mard hain jo shadi shuda na hon, Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain liwat ke bare mein yeh aayat hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain jise tum looti fe'l karte dekho to fa'il maf'ool dono ko qatl kar daalo, han agar yeh dono baaz aa jayen apni badkari se tauba karein apne a'maal ki islaah kar lein aur theek thaak ho jayen to ab unke saath drusht kalami aur sakhti se pesh na aao, is liye ke gunah se tauba kar lene wala misl gunah na karne wale ke hai. Allah Ta'ala tauba qabool karne wala aur darguzar karne wala hai, Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain agar kisi ki laundi badkari kare to uska maalik use hadd laga de aur daant dapat na kare, yani hadd lag jaane ke baad phir use aar na dilaya kare kyunke hadd kaffara hai.

Aalam-e-naz'a se pehle tauba? Matlab yeh hai ke Allah Subhanah-o-Ta'ala apne un bandon ki tauba qabool farmata hai jo nawaqifiyat ki wajah se koi bura kaam kar baithein phir tauba kar lein, go yeh tauba farishta-e-maut ko dekh lene ke baad aalam-e-naz'a se pehle ho. Hazrat Mujahid R.H waghera farmate hain jo bhi qasdan ya ghalti se Allah Ta'ala ki nafarmani kare woh jahil hai jab tak ke us se baaz na aa jaye. Abul Aaliyah R.H farmate hain Sahaba-e-Kiram R.A farmaya karte the ke banda jo gunah kare woh jahalat hai, Hazrat Qatadah R.H bhi Sahaba ke majmay se is tarah ki riwayat karte hain, Atta R.H aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se bhi isi tarah marwi hai.

Tauba jaldi kar lene ki tafsir mein manqool hai ke Malik-ul-Maut ko dekh lene se pehle, aalam-e-sakrat ke qareeb murad hai, apni sehat mein tauba kar leni chahiye, ghar-gharay ke waqt se pehle ki tauba qabool hai. Hazrat Ikrimah R.H farmate hain saari duniya qareeb hi hai, is ke mutaliq hadeesein suniye, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ki tauba qabool farmata hai jab tak saanson ka tootna shuru na ho, (Tirmidhi). Jo bhi momin banda apni maut se mahina bhar pehle tauba kar le us ki tauba Allah Ta'ala qabool farma leta hai, yahan tak ke us ke baad bhi, balkay maut se ek din pehle tak bhi, balkay ek saans pehle bhi jo bhi ikhlas aur sachai ke sath apne Rab ki taraf jhuke Allah Ta'ala use qabool farmata hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr R.A farmate hain jo apni maut se ek saal pehle tauba kare Allah Ta'ala us ki tauba qabool farmata hai aur jo mahina bhar pehle tauba kare Allah Ta'ala us ki tauba bhi qabool farmata hai aur jo hafta bhar pehle tauba kare Allah Ta'ala us ki tauba bhi qabool farmata hai aur jo ek din pehle tauba kare Allah Ta'ala us ki tauba bhi qabool farmata hai. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Ayyub R.H ne yeh aayat padhi to aap ne farmaya wahi kehta hoon jo Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke chaar Sahabi R.A jama hue, un mein se ek ne kaha main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna hai jo shakhs apni maut se ek din pehle bhi tauba kar le Allah Ta'ala us ki tauba qabool farmata hai, dusre ne poocha kya sach much tum ne Huzoor ﷺ se aise hi suna hai? Us ne kaha haan, to dusre ne kaha tum ne yeh suna hai?

Us ne kaha haan, us ne kaha main ne toh Huzoor ﷺ se yahan tak suna hai ke jab tak us ke narkhare mein rooh na aa jaye tauba ke darwaze us ke liye bhi khule rehte hain, Ibn-e-Marduyah mein marwi hai ke jab tak jaan nikalte hue gale se nikalne wali aawaz shuru na ho tab tak tauba qabool hai, kayi ek mursal ahadees mein bhi yeh mazmoon hai, Hazrat Abu Qilabah R.A farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne jab Iblees par la'nat nazil farmayi toh us ne mohlat talab ki aur kaha teri izzat aur tere jalal ki qasam ke Ibn-e-Adam ke jism mein jab tak rooh rahegi main us ke dil se na niklunga, Allah Ta'ala Azza-wa-Jal ne farmaya mujhe apni izzat aur apne jalal ki qasam ke main bhi jab tak us mein rooh rahegi us ki tauba qabool karunga, ek marfoo hadith mein bhi is ke qareeb qareeb marwi hai pas in tamam ahadees se maloom hota hai ke jab tak banda zinda hai aur use apni hayati ki umeed hai tab tak woh Allah Ta'ala ki taraf jhuke tauba kare toh Allah Ta'ala us ki tauba qabool farmata hai aur us par ruju karta hai Allah Ta'ala is mein Aleem-o-Hakeem hai, haan jab zindagi se mayoos ho jaye farishton ko dekh le aur rooh badan se nikal kar halq tak pahunch jaye seene mein ghutan lage halq mein atke sanson se gharghara shuru ho toh us ki tauba qabool nahin hoti. Isi liye is ke baad farmaya ke marte dam tak jo gunahon par ada rahe aur maut dekh kar kehne lage ke ab main tauba karta hoon toh aise shakhs ki tauba qabool nahin hoti, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (FALAMMA RA'AW BA'SANA QALU AMANNA BILLAHI WAHDAHU WA KAFARNA BIMA KUNNA BIHI MUSHRIKEEN) (40. Ghafir: 84) (do aayaton tak) matlab yeh hai ke hamare azabon ka mu'aina kar lene ke baad imaan ka iqrar karna koi nafa nahin deta aur jagah hai aayat (YAUMA YATI BA'DU AYATI RABBIKA LA YANFA'U NAFSAN IMANUHA LAM TAKUN AMANAT MIN QABLU AW KASABAT FI IMANIHA KHAIRA, QULINTAZIRU INNA MUNTAZIRUN) (6. Al-An'am: 158) matlab yeh hai ke jab makhlooq suraj ko maghrib ki taraf se chadhte hue dekh le gi us waqt jo imaan laye ya nek amal kare use na us ka amal nafa de ga na us ka imaan. Phir farmata hai ke kufr-o-shirk par marne wale ko bhi nadamat-o-tauba koi faida na de gi na hi is ka fidiya aur badla qabool kiya jaye ga chahe zameen bhar kar sona dena chahe Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A waghaira farmate hain yeh aayat ahl-e-shirk ke bare mein nazil hui hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain Allah Ta'ala apne bande ki tauba qabool karta hai aur use bakhsh deta hai jab tak parda na pad jaye pucha gaya parda padne se kya matlab hai? Farmaya shirk ki halat mein jaan nikal jana. Aise logon ke liye Allah Ta'ala ne sakht dard-naak almanaak hamesha rehne wale azab tayyar kar rakhe hain.

Aurat par zulm ka khatma. Sahih Bukhari mein hai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke qabl-e-Islam jab koi shakhs mar jata to us ke waris us ki aurat ke poore haqdar samjhe jate. Agar un mein se koi chahta to apne nikah mein le leta, agar woh chahte to dusre kisi ke nikah mein de dete, agar chahte to nikah hi na karne dete. Maike walon se zyada us aurat ke haqdar sasural wale hi gine jate the. Jahiliyat ki is rasm ke khilaf yeh aayat nazil hui. Dusri riwayat mein yeh bhi aaya hai ke woh log us aurat ko majboor karte ke woh mehar ke haq se dast-bardar ho jaye ya yunhi be-nikahi baithi rahe. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke us aurat ka khawand marte hi koi bhi aa kar us par apna kapda daal deta aur wahi us ka mukhtar samjha jata. To riwayat mein hai ke yeh kapda dalne wala use haseen pata to apne nikah mein le leta, agar yeh badsurat hoti to use yunhi roke rakhta yahan tak ke mar jaye, phir us ke maal ka waris banta. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke marne wale ka koi gehra dost kapda daal deta, phir agar woh aurat kuch fidiya aur badla de to woh use nikah karne ki ijazat deta warna yunhi mar jati. Hazrat Zaid bin Aslam farmate hain ahl-e-Madina ka yeh dastoor tha ke waris us aurat ke bhi waris ban jate. Garaz yeh log auraton ke sath bade buri tarah pesh aate the yahan tak ke talaq dete waqt bhi shart kar lete the ke jahan main chahun tera nikah ho. Is tarah ki qaid-o-band se rihai pane ki phir yeh surat hoti ke woh aurat kuch de kar jaan chhudati. Allah Ta'ala ne mominon ko is se mana farma diya. Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai ke jab Abu Qais bin Aslat ka inteqal hua to un ke bete ne un ki biwi se nikah karna chaha jaise ke jahiliyat mein yeh dastoor tha, is par yeh aayat nazil hui. Hazrat Atta farmate hain ke kisi bache ki sambhal par use laga dete the. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain jab koi mar jata to us ka ladka us ki biwi ka zyada haqdar samjha jata, agar chahta khud apni sauteli maa se nikah kar leta aur agar chahta dusre ke nikah mein de deta maslan bhai ke, bhatije ya jis ko chahe. Hazrat Ikrama ki riwayat mein hai ke Abu Qais ki jis biwi ka naam Kabina tha (R.A), us ne is surat ki khabar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko di ke yeh log na mujhe warison mein shumar kar ke mere khawand ka wirsa dete hain na mujhe chhodte hain ke main aur kahin apna nikah kar lun, is par yeh aayat nazil hui. Ek riwayat mein hai ke kapda dalne ki rasm se pehle hi agar koi aurat bhag khadi ho aur apne maike aa jaye to woh chhoot jati thi. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain jo yateem bachi un ki wilayat mein hoti use yeh roke rakhte the is umeed par ke jab hamari biwi mar jayegi hum us se nikah kar lenge ya apne ladke se us ka nikah kara denge. In sab aqwal se maloom hua ke un tamam suraton ki is aayat mein Allah Ta'ala ne mumanat kar di aur auraton ki jaan is museebat se chhudadi. Wallahu A'lam.

Irshad hai auraton ki bod-o-bash mein unhein tang kar ke takleef de de kar majboor na karo ke woh apna sara mehar chhor dein ya is mein se kuch chhor dein ya apne kisi aur wajibi haq waghera se dast-bardar hone par amada hojayen kyunke unhein sataya aur majboor kiya ja raha hai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke aurat napasand hai dil nahin mila chhor dena chahta hai to is surat mein haq-e-mehar ke alawa bhi waghera tamam huqooq dene parenge is surat-e-haal se bachne ke liye use satana ya tarah tarah se tang karna taake woh khud apne huqooq chhor kar chale jane par amada hojaye aisa rawayya ikhtiyar karne se Quran-e-Pak ne musalmanon ko rok diya. Ibn-e-Sulaimani (R.H) farmate hain in dono ayaton mein se pehli ayat amr-e-jahiliyat ko khatam karne aur dusri amr-e-Islam ki islah ke liye nazil hui, Ibn-e-Mubarak (R.H) bhi yahi farmate hain. Magar is surat mein ke un se khuli behayai ka kaam sadir hojaye, is se murad baqol aksar mufassireen sahaba, tabieen waghera zina-kari hai, yani is surat mein jaiz hai ke us se mehar lota lena chahiye aur use tang kare taake khula par razamand ho, jaise Surah Baqarah ki ayat mein hai ayat (Yaa ayyuhallazina aamanu la yahillu lakum an tarisun-nisaa karhan wa la ta'duluhunna litazhabu bibadi ma ataitumuhunna illa an ya'tina bifahishatin mubayyinah) (Surah An-Nisa: 19) yani tumhein halal nahin ke tum unhein diye hue mein se kuch bhi le lo magar is halat mein dono ko Allah ki haddein qaim na rakh sakne ka khauf ho. Baaz buzurgon ne farmaya hai ayat (Fahishatin mubayyinah) se murad khawand ke khilaf kaam karna us ki nafarmani karna bad-zabani kaj-khulqi karna huqooq-e-zaujiat achi tarah ada na karna waghera hai, Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) farmate hain ayat ke alfaz aam hain zina ko aur tamam mazkoora awamil bhi shamil hain yani in tamam suraton mein khawand ko mubah hai ke use tang kare taake woh apna kul haq ya thora haq chhor de aur phir yeh use alag kar de Imam sahab ka yeh farman bahut hi munasib hai wallahu a'lam, yeh riwayat bhi pehle guzar chuki hai ke yahan is ayat ke utarne ka sabab wahi jahiliyat ki rasm hai jis se Allah ne mana farma diya, is se maloom hota hai ke yeh pura bayan jahiliyat ki rasm ko Islam mein se kharij karne ke liye hua hai, Ibn-e-Zaid (R.H) farmate hain Makkah ke Quraish mein yeh riwaj tha ke kisi shakhs ne kisi sharif aurat se nikah kiya muwafiqat na hui to use talaq de di lekin yeh shart kar leta tha ke baghair us ki ijazat ke yeh dusri jagah nikah nahin kar sakti is baat par gawah muqarrar hojate aur iqrar-nama likh liya jata ab agar kahin se paigham aaye aur woh aurat razi ho to yeh kehta mujhe itni raqam de to main tujhe nikah ki ijazat dunga agar woh ada kar deti to khair warna yun na use qaid rakhta aur dusra nikah na karne deta is ki muman'at is ayat mein nazil hui, baqol Mujahid (R.H) yeh hukm aur Surah Baqarah ki ayat ka hukm dono ek hi hain.

Phir farmaya aurton ke sath khush-sulooki ka rawayya rakho un ke sath achha bartao barto, narm baat kaho nek sulook karo apni halat bhi apni taqat ke mutabiq achhi rakho, jaise tum chahte ho ke woh tumhare liye bani sanwari hui achhi halat mein rahe tum khud apni halat bhi achhi rakho jaise aur jagah farmaya aayat (Wa lahunna mislul-lazi alaihinna bil-ma'roofi wa lir-rijali alaihinna darajatun wallahu Azizun Hakim) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 228) jaise tumhare huqooq un par hain un ke huqooq bhi tum par hain. Behtareen zauj mohtaram Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain tum mein se behtar shakhs woh hai jo apni ghar wali ke sath behtar se behtar sulook karne wala ho main apni biwiyon se bahut achha rawayya rakhta hoon, Nabi Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni biwiyon ke sath bahut lutf-o-khushi bahut narm akhlaqi aur khanda peshani se pesh aate the, unhein khush rakhte the un se hansi dil-lagi ki baatein kiya karte the, un ke dil apni mutthi mein rakhte the, unhein achhi tarah khane peene ko dete the kushada dili ke sath un par kharch karte the aisi khush-tabai ki baatein bayan farmate jin se woh hans detin, aisa bhi hua hai ke Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ke sath Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne daud lagayi us daud mein Ayesha Siddiqa aage nikal gayin kuch muddat baad phir daud lagi ab ke Hazrat Ayesha peeche reh gayin to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya mamla barabar ho gaya, is se bhi Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka matlab yeh tha ke Hazrat Siddiqa khush rahein un ka dil behle jis biwi sahiba ke yahan Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko raat guzarni hoti wahin Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki kul biwiyan jama ho jatin do ghari baithtin baat-cheet hoti kabhi aisa bhi hota ke un sab ke sath hi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) raat ka khana tanawul farmate phir sab apne apne ghar chali jatin aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) wahin aaram farmate jin ki bari hoti, apni biwi sahiba ke sath ek hi chadar mein sote kurta nikal daalte sirf tehband bandha hua hota Isha ki namaz ke baad ghar ja kar do ghari idhar udhar ki kuch baatein karte jis se ghar waliyon ka jee khush hota al-gharaz nihayat hi mohabbat pyar ke sath apni biwiyon ko Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) rakhte the. Pas musalmanon ko bhi chahiye ke apni biwiyon ke sath achhi tarah raazi khushi mohabbat pyar se rahein, Allah Ta'ala farmata hai farman-bardari ka dusra naam achhai hai, is ke tafseeli ahkaam ki jagah tafseer nahin balkay isi mazmoon ki kitabein hain wal-hamdulillah phir farmata hai ke bawajood jee na chahne ke bhi aurton se achhi bod-o-bash rakhne mein bahut mumkin hai ke Allah Ta'ala bahut bari bhalai ata farmaye, mumkin hai nek aulad ho jaye aur is se Allah Ta'ala bahut si bhalaiyan naseeb kare, sahih hadith mein hai momin mard momina aurat ko alag na kare agar us ki ek aadh baat se naraz hoga to ek aadh khaslat achhi bhi hogi. Phir farmata hai ke jab tum mein se koi apni biwi ko talaq dena chahe aur us ki jagah dusri aurat se nikah karna chahe to use diye hue mehar mein se kuch bhi wapas na le chahe khazana ka khazana diya hua ho.

Haq-e-mahar ke masail Surah Al-e-Imran ki tafsir mein Qintar ka pura bayan guzar chuka hai is liye yahan dobara bayan karne ki zaroorat nahin, is se sabit hota hai ke mahar mein bahut sara maal dena bhi jaiz hai, Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ne pehle bahut lambe chaure mahar se mana farma diya tha phir apne qaul se ruju kiya, jaise ke Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke aap ne farmaya aurton ke mahar bandhne mein ziyadati na karo agar yeh dunyawi taur par koi bhi cheez hoti ya Allah ke nazdeek yeh taqwa ki cheez hoti to tum sab se pehle is par Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) amal karte. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apni kisi biwi ka ya apni kisi beti ka mahar barah auqiya se ziyada muqarrar nahin kiya (taqreeban sawa sau rupiya). Insaan ziyada mahar bandh kar phir museebat mein par jata hai yahan tak ke rafta rafta us ki biwi use bojh maloom hone lagti hai aur us ke dilon mein us ki dushmani baith jati hai aur kehne lagta hai ke tu ne to mere kandhe par mashk latka di, yeh hadith bahut si kitabon mein mukhtalif alfaz se marwi hai. Ek mein hai ke aap ne mimbar-e-Nabwi par khade ho kar farmaya logo tum ne kyun lambe chaure mahar bandhne shuru kar diye hain? Rasool Allah (ﷺ) aur aap ke zamana ke aap ke ashab ne to char sau dirham (taqreeban sau rupiya) mahar bandha hai agar yeh taqwa aur karamat ke zaad hone ka sabab hota to tum ziyada haq-e-mahar ada karne mein bhi un par sabqat nahin le sakte the. Khabardar aaj se main na sunoon ke kisi ne char sau dirham se ziyada ka mahar muqarrar kiya. Yeh farma kar aap neeche utar aaye to ek Quraishi khatoon samne aayin aur kehne lagin Amir-ul-Momineen kya aap ne char sau dirham se ziyada ke haq-e-mahar se logon ko mana farma diya hai? Aap ne farmaya haan. Kaha kya aap ne Allah ka kalam jo us ne nazil farmaya hai nahin suna? Kaha woh kya? Kaha suniye Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala farmata hai ayat (Wa ataitum ihdahunna qintaran fala ta'khuzu minhu shai'an atakhuzunahu buhtanan wa ithman mubina) (Surah An-Nisa: 20) tum ne unhein khazana diya ho. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya Allah mujhe maaf farma, Umar se to har shakhs ziyada samajhdar hai. Phir wapas usi waqt mimbar par khade ho kar logon se farmaya logo main ne tumhein char sau dirham se ziyada ke mahar se rok diya tha lekin ab kehta hoon jo shakhs apne maal mein se mahar mein jitna chahe de apni khushi se jitna mahar muqarrar karna chahe kare main nahin rokta, aur ek riwayat mein us aurat ka ayat ko is tarah parhna marwi hai ayat (Wa ataitum ihdahunna qintaran fala ta'khuzu minhu shai'an) (Surah An-Nisa: 20).

(An-Nisa: 20) (Min Zahab) Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood R.A ki qira'at mein bhi isi tarah hai aur Hazrat Umar R.A ka yeh farmana bhi marwi hai ke ek aurat Umar R.A par ghalib aa gayi aur riwayat mein hai ke Aap ﷺ ne farmaya tha: "Ghozi-ul-Qissa" yani Yazid bin Haseen Harisi ki beti ho phir bhi mehar is ka zyada muqarrar na karo aur agar tum ne aisa kiya to woh zaid raqam mein Bait-ul-Maal ke liye le loonga. Is par ek daraz qad chauri naak wali aurat ne kaha: Hazrat! Aap yeh hukm nahin de sakte. Phir Allah Ta'ala ka irshad hai ke tum apni biwi ko diya hua haq-e-mehar wapas kaise le sakte ho? Jabke tum ne us se faida uthaya ya zaroorat poori ki, woh tum se aur tum us se mil gaye, yani miyan-biwi ke talluqat bhi qaim ho gaye. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki is hadith mein hai: Ek shakhs ne apni biwi par zina ka ilzam lagaya aur Huzoor ﷺ ke samne pesh hua. Biwi ne bhi apne beganah hone aur shohar ne apne sacha hone ki qasam khai, phir un dono ka qasmein khana aur us ke baad Aap ﷺ ka yeh farman ke Allah Ta'ala ko bakhoobi ilm hai ke tum dono mein se kaun jhoota hai? Kya tum mein se koi ab bhi tauba karta hai? Teen dafa farmaya, to us mard ne kaha: Main ne jo maal is ke mehar mein diya hai us ki babat kya farmate hain?

Aap ne farmaya isi ke badle toh yeh tere liye halal hui thin ab agar tu ne is par jhooti tohmat lagayi hai toh phir aur namumkin baat hogi. Isi tarah ek aur hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Nufra ne ek kunwari ladki se nikah kiya, jab us se mile toh dekha ke use zina ka haml hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se zikr kiya, aap ne use alag kara diya aur mehar dilwa diya aur aurat ko kode maarne ka hukum diya aur farmaya jo bacha hoga woh tera ghulam hoga aur mehar toh us ki hillat ka sabab tha (Abu Dawood). Garz ayat ka matlab bhi yahi hai ke aurat us ke bete par haram ho jati hai, is par ijma hai. Hazrat Abu Qais ne un ki biwi se nikah ki khwahish ki jo un ki soteli maa thin, is par is biwi sahiba ne farmaya beshak tu apni qoum mein nek hai lekin main toh tujhe apna beta shumar karti hoon, khair main Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas jati hoon jo woh hukum farmayein. Woh hazir huin aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko sari kaifiyat bayan ki, aap ne farmaya apne ghar laut jao. Phir yeh ayat utri ke jis se baap ne nikah kiya us se bete ka nikah haram hai. Aise waqiyat aur bhi us waqt maujood the jinhein is irade se baaz rakha gaya, ek toh yahi Abu Qais wala waqia, un biwi sahiba ka naam Umm-e-Ubaidullah Zamra tha. Dusra waqia Khalaf ka tha, un ke ghar mein Abu Talha ki sahibzadi thin, us ke inteqal ke baad us ke ladke Safwan ne use apne nikah mein lana chaha tha. Suhaili mein likha hai jahiliyat mein is nikah ka mamool tha jise baqaida nikah samjha jata tha aur bilkul halal gina jata tha, isi liye yahan bhi farmaya gaya ke jo pehle guzar chuka so guzar chuka, jaise do behnon ko nikah mein jama karne ki hurmat ko bayan farma kar bhi yahi kiya gaya. Kinana bin Khuzaima ne apne baap ki biwi se nikah kiya tha, Nasr isi ke batan se paida hua tha. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke meri upar ki nasl bhi baqaida nikah se hi hai na ke zina se, toh maloom hua ke yeh rasm un mein barabar jaari thi aur jaiz thi aur ise nikah shumar karte the. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain jahiliyat wale bhi jin jin rishton ko Allah Ta'ala ne haram kiya hai, soteli maa aur do behnon ko ek sath nikah mein rakhne ke siwa sab ko haram hi jante the, pas Allah Ta'ala ne apne Kalam-e-Pak mein in dono rishton ko bhi haram thahraya. Hazrat Ata aur Hazrat Qatada (R.H) bhi yahi farmate hain. Yaad rahe ke Suhaili ne Kinana ka jo waqia naqal kiya hai woh gaur talab hai, bilkul sahi nahin, Wallahu A'lam. Bahar-e-surat yeh rishta ummat-e-muslima par haram hai aur nihayat qabeeh amr hai. Yahan tak ke farmaya yeh nihayat fahash bura kaam bughz ka hai. Donon miyan biwi mein khalwat-o-sohbat ho chuki hai phir mehar wapas lena kya ma'ani rakhta hai.

Phir farmaya ke aqd-e-nikah jo mazboot ahd-o-paiman hai is mein tum jakre ja chuke ho, Allah ka yeh farman tum sun chuke ho ke basao toh achi tarah aur alag karo toh umda tariqe se. Chunancha hadith mein bhi hai ke tum in aurton ko Allah ki amanat ke tor pe lete ho aur in ko apne liye Allah Ta'ala ka kalma parh kar yani nikah ke khutba-e-tashahhud se halal karte ho. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko mi'raj wali raat jab behtareen in'amat ata hue, in mein ek yeh bhi tha ke aap se farmaya gaya teri ummat ka koi khutba jaiz nahin jab tak woh is amr ki gawahi na dein ke tu mera banda aur mera rasool hai (Ibn Abi Hatim). Nikah ke ahkamat Sahih Muslim Sharif mein Hazrat Jabir (R.A) se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne Hajjat-ul-Wida ke khutba mein farmaya tum ne aurton ko Allah ki amanat ke tor pe liya hai aur unhein Allah Ta'ala ke kalma se apne liye halal kiya hai. Is ke baad Allah Ta'ala soteli maon ki hurmat bayan farmata hai aur un ki ta'zeem aur tauqeer zahir karta hai yahan tak ke baap ne kisi aurat se sirf nikah kiya abhi woh rukhsat ho kar bhi nahin aayi magar talaq ho gayi ya baap mar gaya waghera toh bhi woh sabab aur bura rasta hai aur jagah farma hai ayat (WALA TAQRA-BUL FAWAHISH MA ZAHARA MINHA WAMA BATAN) (6. Al-An'am: 151) yani kisi burai, behayai aur fahash kaam ke qareeb bhi na jao ya woh bilkul zahir ho khwah posheeda ho aur farman hai ayat (WALA TAQRA-BUZ ZINA INNAHU KANA FAHISHATAN WASA-A SABILA) (17. Al-Isra: 32) zina ke qareeb na jao yaqeenan woh fahash kaam aur buri rah hai. Yahan mazeed farmaya ke yeh kaam bare bughz ka bhi hai yani fi nafsihi bhi bara bura amr hai is se baap bete mein adawat par jati hai aur dushmani qaim ho jati hai, yahi mushahida mein aaya hai aur umooman yeh bhi likha gaya hai ke jo shakhs kisi aurat se doosra nikah karta hai woh is ke pehle khawand se bughz hi rakhta hai. Yahi wajah hai ke An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyan Ummahat-ul-Momineen qarar de di gayin aur ummat par misl maa ke haram ki gayin kyunke woh Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyan hain aur aap misl baap ke hain, balkay ijma'an sabit hai ke aap ke haq baap dada ke huqooq se bhi bohat zyada aur bohat bare hain balkay aap ki mohabbat khud apni janon ki mohabbat par bhi muqaddam hai, salawatullahi wa salamuhu alaih. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh kaam Allah ke bughz ka mojib hai aur bura rasta hai. Ab jo aisa kaam kare woh deen se murtad hai use qatl kar diya jaye aur is ka maal Bait-ul-Maal mein bator-e-fai ke dakhil kar liya jaye. Sunan aur Musnad-e-Ahmad mein marwi hai ke ek sahabi ko Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is shakhs ki taraf bheja jis ne apne baap ki biwi se baap ke baad nikah kiya tha ke use qatl kar dalo aur is ke maal par qabza kar lo. Hazrat Bara bin Azib farmate hain ke mere chacha Haris bin Umair apne hath mein Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka diya hua jhanda le kar mere paas se guzre main ne poocha ke chacha huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aap ko kahan bheja hai?

Farmaya us shakhs ki taraf jis ne apne baap ki biwi se nikah kiya hai mujhe hukm hai ke main us ki gardan maaroon (Musnad-e-Ahmad).

Sauteli maa se nikah haram hai. Masla: Is par toh ulama ka ijma hai ke jis aurat se baap ne mubashirat kar li khwah nikah kar ke, khwah malkiyat mein la kar, khwah shuba se, woh aurat bete par haram hai. Haan agar jima na hua ho toh sirf mubashirat hui ho ya woh aaza dekhe hon jin ka dekhna ajnabi hone ki surat mein halal na tha toh is mein ikhtilaf hai. Imam Ahmad toh is surat mein bhi us aurat ko ladke par haram batate hain.

Hafiz Ibn-e-Asakir ke is waqiye se bhi is riwayat ki tasdeeq hoti hai ke Hazrat Khadij Humsi ne jo Hazrat Muawiya ke maula the, Hazrat Muawiya ke liye ek laundi kharidi jo gore rang ki aur khubsurat thi. Use barahna un ke paas bhej diya. Un ke haath mein ek chhadi thi, us se ishara kar ke kehne lage achha nafa tha agar yeh malboos hoti. Phir kehne lage ise Yazid bin Muawiya ke paas le jao. Phir kaha nahin nahin thahro, Rabia bin Amr Harsi ko mere paas bula lao, yeh bade faqih the. Jab aaye toh Hazrat Muawiya ne un se yeh masla poocha ke main ne is aurat ke yeh aaza-e-makhsoos dekhe hain, yeh barahna thi. Ab main ise apne ladke Yazid ke paas bhejna chahta hoon toh kya us ke liye yeh halal hai? Hazrat Rabia ne farmaya Amir-ul-Momineen aisa na kijiye, yeh us ke qabil nahin rahi. Farmaya tum theek kehte ho, achha jao Abdullah bin Masada Fazari ko bula lao. Woh aaye, woh toh gandum-goon rang ke the. Us se Hazrat Muawiya ne farmaya is laundi ko main tumhein deta hoon taake tumhari aulad safed rang paida ho. Yeh Abdullah bin Masada woh hain jinhein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Fatima ko diya tha, aap ne unhein pala, parwarish kiya, phir Allah Ta'ala ke naam se azaad kar diya, phir yeh Hazrat Muawiya ke paas chale aaye the.

Aurat par zulm ka khatma. Sahih Bukhari mein hai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke qabl-e-Islam jab koi shakhs mar jata to us ke waris us ki aurat ke poore haqdar samjhe jate. Agar un mein se koi chahta to apne nikah mein le leta, agar woh chahte to dusre kisi ke nikah mein de dete, agar chahte to nikah hi na karne dete. Maike walon se zyada us aurat ke haqdar sasural wale hi gine jate the. Jahiliyat ki is rasm ke khilaf yeh aayat nazil hui. Dusri riwayat mein yeh bhi aaya hai ke woh log us aurat ko majboor karte ke woh mehar ke haq se dast-bardar ho jaye ya yunhi be-nikahi baithi rahe. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke us aurat ka khawand marte hi koi bhi aa kar us par apna kapda daal deta aur wahi us ka mukhtar samjha jata. To riwayat mein hai ke yeh kapda dalne wala use haseen pata to apne nikah mein le leta, agar yeh badsurat hoti to use yunhi roke rakhta yahan tak ke mar jaye, phir us ke maal ka waris banta. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke marne wale ka koi gehra dost kapda daal deta, phir agar woh aurat kuch fidiya aur badla de to woh use nikah karne ki ijazat deta warna yunhi mar jati. Hazrat Zaid bin Aslam farmate hain ahl-e-Madina ka yeh dastoor tha ke waris us aurat ke bhi waris ban jate. Garaz yeh log auraton ke sath bade buri tarah pesh aate the yahan tak ke talaq dete waqt bhi shart kar lete the ke jahan main chahun tera nikah ho. Is tarah ki qaid-o-band se rihai pane ki phir yeh surat hoti ke woh aurat kuch de kar jaan chhudati. Allah Ta'ala ne mominon ko is se mana farma diya. Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai ke jab Abu Qais bin Aslat ka inteqal hua to un ke bete ne un ki biwi se nikah karna chaha jaise ke jahiliyat mein yeh dastoor tha, is par yeh aayat nazil hui. Hazrat Atta farmate hain ke kisi bache ki sambhal par use laga dete the. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain jab koi mar jata to us ka ladka us ki biwi ka zyada haqdar samjha jata, agar chahta khud apni sauteli maa se nikah kar leta aur agar chahta dusre ke nikah mein de deta maslan bhai ke, bhatije ya jis ko chahe. Hazrat Ikrama ki riwayat mein hai ke Abu Qais ki jis biwi ka naam Kabina tha (R.A), us ne is surat ki khabar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko di ke yeh log na mujhe warison mein shumar kar ke mere khawand ka wirsa dete hain na mujhe chhodte hain ke main aur kahin apna nikah kar lun, is par yeh aayat nazil hui. Ek riwayat mein hai ke kapda dalne ki rasm se pehle hi agar koi aurat bhag khadi ho aur apne maike aa jaye to woh chhoot jati thi. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain jo yateem bachi un ki wilayat mein hoti use yeh roke rakhte the is umeed par ke jab hamari biwi mar jayegi hum us se nikah kar lenge ya apne ladke se us ka nikah kara denge. In sab aqwal se maloom hua ke un tamam suraton ki is aayat mein Allah Ta'ala ne mumanat kar di aur auraton ki jaan is museebat se chhudadi. Wallahu A'lam.

Irshad hai auraton ki bod-o-bash mein unhein tang kar ke takleef de de kar majboor na karo ke woh apna sara mehar chhor dein ya is mein se kuch chhor dein ya apne kisi aur wajibi haq waghera se dast-bardar hone par amada hojayen kyunke unhein sataya aur majboor kiya ja raha hai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke aurat napasand hai dil nahin mila chhor dena chahta hai to is surat mein haq-e-mehar ke alawa bhi waghera tamam huqooq dene parenge is surat-e-haal se bachne ke liye use satana ya tarah tarah se tang karna taake woh khud apne huqooq chhor kar chale jane par amada hojaye aisa rawayya ikhtiyar karne se Quran-e-Pak ne musalmanon ko rok diya. Ibn-e-Sulaimani (R.H) farmate hain in dono ayaton mein se pehli ayat amr-e-jahiliyat ko khatam karne aur dusri amr-e-Islam ki islah ke liye nazil hui, Ibn-e-Mubarak (R.H) bhi yahi farmate hain. Magar is surat mein ke un se khuli behayai ka kaam sadir hojaye, is se murad baqol aksar mufassireen sahaba, tabieen waghera zina-kari hai, yani is surat mein jaiz hai ke us se mehar lota lena chahiye aur use tang kare taake khula par razamand ho, jaise Surah Baqarah ki ayat mein hai ayat (Yaa ayyuhallazina aamanu la yahillu lakum an tarisun-nisaa karhan wa la ta'duluhunna litazhabu bibadi ma ataitumuhunna illa an ya'tina bifahishatin mubayyinah) (Surah An-Nisa: 19) yani tumhein halal nahin ke tum unhein diye hue mein se kuch bhi le lo magar is halat mein dono ko Allah ki haddein qaim na rakh sakne ka khauf ho. Baaz buzurgon ne farmaya hai ayat (Fahishatin mubayyinah) se murad khawand ke khilaf kaam karna us ki nafarmani karna bad-zabani kaj-khulqi karna huqooq-e-zaujiat achi tarah ada na karna waghera hai, Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) farmate hain ayat ke alfaz aam hain zina ko aur tamam mazkoora awamil bhi shamil hain yani in tamam suraton mein khawand ko mubah hai ke use tang kare taake woh apna kul haq ya thora haq chhor de aur phir yeh use alag kar de Imam sahab ka yeh farman bahut hi munasib hai wallahu a'lam, yeh riwayat bhi pehle guzar chuki hai ke yahan is ayat ke utarne ka sabab wahi jahiliyat ki rasm hai jis se Allah ne mana farma diya, is se maloom hota hai ke yeh pura bayan jahiliyat ki rasm ko Islam mein se kharij karne ke liye hua hai, Ibn-e-Zaid (R.H) farmate hain Makkah ke Quraish mein yeh riwaj tha ke kisi shakhs ne kisi sharif aurat se nikah kiya muwafiqat na hui to use talaq de di lekin yeh shart kar leta tha ke baghair us ki ijazat ke yeh dusri jagah nikah nahin kar sakti is baat par gawah muqarrar hojate aur iqrar-nama likh liya jata ab agar kahin se paigham aaye aur woh aurat razi ho to yeh kehta mujhe itni raqam de to main tujhe nikah ki ijazat dunga agar woh ada kar deti to khair warna yun na use qaid rakhta aur dusra nikah na karne deta is ki muman'at is ayat mein nazil hui, baqol Mujahid (R.H) yeh hukm aur Surah Baqarah ki ayat ka hukm dono ek hi hain.

Phir farmaya aurton ke sath khush-sulooki ka rawayya rakho un ke sath achha bartao barto, narm baat kaho nek sulook karo apni halat bhi apni taqat ke mutabiq achhi rakho, jaise tum chahte ho ke woh tumhare liye bani sanwari hui achhi halat mein rahe tum khud apni halat bhi achhi rakho jaise aur jagah farmaya aayat (Wa lahunna mislul-lazi alaihinna bil-ma'roofi wa lir-rijali alaihinna darajatun wallahu Azizun Hakim) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 228) jaise tumhare huqooq un par hain un ke huqooq bhi tum par hain. Behtareen zauj mohtaram Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain tum mein se behtar shakhs woh hai jo apni ghar wali ke sath behtar se behtar sulook karne wala ho main apni biwiyon se bahut achha rawayya rakhta hoon, Nabi Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni biwiyon ke sath bahut lutf-o-khushi bahut narm akhlaqi aur khanda peshani se pesh aate the, unhein khush rakhte the un se hansi dil-lagi ki baatein kiya karte the, un ke dil apni mutthi mein rakhte the, unhein achhi tarah khane peene ko dete the kushada dili ke sath un par kharch karte the aisi khush-tabai ki baatein bayan farmate jin se woh hans detin, aisa bhi hua hai ke Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ke sath Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne daud lagayi us daud mein Ayesha Siddiqa aage nikal gayin kuch muddat baad phir daud lagi ab ke Hazrat Ayesha peeche reh gayin to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya mamla barabar ho gaya, is se bhi Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka matlab yeh tha ke Hazrat Siddiqa khush rahein un ka dil behle jis biwi sahiba ke yahan Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko raat guzarni hoti wahin Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki kul biwiyan jama ho jatin do ghari baithtin baat-cheet hoti kabhi aisa bhi hota ke un sab ke sath hi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) raat ka khana tanawul farmate phir sab apne apne ghar chali jatin aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) wahin aaram farmate jin ki bari hoti, apni biwi sahiba ke sath ek hi chadar mein sote kurta nikal daalte sirf tehband bandha hua hota Isha ki namaz ke baad ghar ja kar do ghari idhar udhar ki kuch baatein karte jis se ghar waliyon ka jee khush hota al-gharaz nihayat hi mohabbat pyar ke sath apni biwiyon ko Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) rakhte the. Pas musalmanon ko bhi chahiye ke apni biwiyon ke sath achhi tarah raazi khushi mohabbat pyar se rahein, Allah Ta'ala farmata hai farman-bardari ka dusra naam achhai hai, is ke tafseeli ahkaam ki jagah tafseer nahin balkay isi mazmoon ki kitabein hain wal-hamdulillah phir farmata hai ke bawajood jee na chahne ke bhi aurton se achhi bod-o-bash rakhne mein bahut mumkin hai ke Allah Ta'ala bahut bari bhalai ata farmaye, mumkin hai nek aulad ho jaye aur is se Allah Ta'ala bahut si bhalaiyan naseeb kare, sahih hadith mein hai momin mard momina aurat ko alag na kare agar us ki ek aadh baat se naraz hoga to ek aadh khaslat achhi bhi hogi. Phir farmata hai ke jab tum mein se koi apni biwi ko talaq dena chahe aur us ki jagah dusri aurat se nikah karna chahe to use diye hue mehar mein se kuch bhi wapas na le chahe khazana ka khazana diya hua ho.

Haq-e-mahar ke masail Surah Al-e-Imran ki tafsir mein Qintar ka pura bayan guzar chuka hai is liye yahan dobara bayan karne ki zaroorat nahin, is se sabit hota hai ke mahar mein bahut sara maal dena bhi jaiz hai, Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ne pehle bahut lambe chaure mahar se mana farma diya tha phir apne qaul se ruju kiya, jaise ke Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke aap ne farmaya aurton ke mahar bandhne mein ziyadati na karo agar yeh dunyawi taur par koi bhi cheez hoti ya Allah ke nazdeek yeh taqwa ki cheez hoti to tum sab se pehle is par Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) amal karte. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apni kisi biwi ka ya apni kisi beti ka mahar barah auqiya se ziyada muqarrar nahin kiya (taqreeban sawa sau rupiya). Insaan ziyada mahar bandh kar phir museebat mein par jata hai yahan tak ke rafta rafta us ki biwi use bojh maloom hone lagti hai aur us ke dilon mein us ki dushmani baith jati hai aur kehne lagta hai ke tu ne to mere kandhe par mashk latka di, yeh hadith bahut si kitabon mein mukhtalif alfaz se marwi hai. Ek mein hai ke aap ne mimbar-e-Nabwi par khade ho kar farmaya logo tum ne kyun lambe chaure mahar bandhne shuru kar diye hain? Rasool Allah (ﷺ) aur aap ke zamana ke aap ke ashab ne to char sau dirham (taqreeban sau rupiya) mahar bandha hai agar yeh taqwa aur karamat ke zaad hone ka sabab hota to tum ziyada haq-e-mahar ada karne mein bhi un par sabqat nahin le sakte the. Khabardar aaj se main na sunoon ke kisi ne char sau dirham se ziyada ka mahar muqarrar kiya. Yeh farma kar aap neeche utar aaye to ek Quraishi khatoon samne aayin aur kehne lagin Amir-ul-Momineen kya aap ne char sau dirham se ziyada ke haq-e-mahar se logon ko mana farma diya hai? Aap ne farmaya haan. Kaha kya aap ne Allah ka kalam jo us ne nazil farmaya hai nahin suna? Kaha woh kya? Kaha suniye Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala farmata hai ayat (Wa ataitum ihdahunna qintaran fala ta'khuzu minhu shai'an atakhuzunahu buhtanan wa ithman mubina) (Surah An-Nisa: 20) tum ne unhein khazana diya ho. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya Allah mujhe maaf farma, Umar se to har shakhs ziyada samajhdar hai. Phir wapas usi waqt mimbar par khade ho kar logon se farmaya logo main ne tumhein char sau dirham se ziyada ke mahar se rok diya tha lekin ab kehta hoon jo shakhs apne maal mein se mahar mein jitna chahe de apni khushi se jitna mahar muqarrar karna chahe kare main nahin rokta, aur ek riwayat mein us aurat ka ayat ko is tarah parhna marwi hai ayat (Wa ataitum ihdahunna qintaran fala ta'khuzu minhu shai'an) (Surah An-Nisa: 20).

(An-Nisa: 20) (Min Zahab) Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood R.A ki qira'at mein bhi isi tarah hai aur Hazrat Umar R.A ka yeh farmana bhi marwi hai ke ek aurat Umar R.A par ghalib aa gayi aur riwayat mein hai ke Aap ﷺ ne farmaya tha: "Ghozi-ul-Qissa" yani Yazid bin Haseen Harisi ki beti ho phir bhi mehar is ka zyada muqarrar na karo aur agar tum ne aisa kiya to woh zaid raqam mein Bait-ul-Maal ke liye le loonga. Is par ek daraz qad chauri naak wali aurat ne kaha: Hazrat! Aap yeh hukm nahin de sakte. Phir Allah Ta'ala ka irshad hai ke tum apni biwi ko diya hua haq-e-mehar wapas kaise le sakte ho? Jabke tum ne us se faida uthaya ya zaroorat poori ki, woh tum se aur tum us se mil gaye, yani miyan-biwi ke talluqat bhi qaim ho gaye. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki is hadith mein hai: Ek shakhs ne apni biwi par zina ka ilzam lagaya aur Huzoor ﷺ ke samne pesh hua. Biwi ne bhi apne beganah hone aur shohar ne apne sacha hone ki qasam khai, phir un dono ka qasmein khana aur us ke baad Aap ﷺ ka yeh farman ke Allah Ta'ala ko bakhoobi ilm hai ke tum dono mein se kaun jhoota hai? Kya tum mein se koi ab bhi tauba karta hai? Teen dafa farmaya, to us mard ne kaha: Main ne jo maal is ke mehar mein diya hai us ki babat kya farmate hain?

Aap ne farmaya isi ke badle toh yeh tere liye halal hui thin ab agar tu ne is par jhooti tohmat lagayi hai toh phir aur namumkin baat hogi. Isi tarah ek aur hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Nufra ne ek kunwari ladki se nikah kiya, jab us se mile toh dekha ke use zina ka haml hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se zikr kiya, aap ne use alag kara diya aur mehar dilwa diya aur aurat ko kode maarne ka hukum diya aur farmaya jo bacha hoga woh tera ghulam hoga aur mehar toh us ki hillat ka sabab tha (Abu Dawood). Garz ayat ka matlab bhi yahi hai ke aurat us ke bete par haram ho jati hai, is par ijma hai. Hazrat Abu Qais ne un ki biwi se nikah ki khwahish ki jo un ki soteli maa thin, is par is biwi sahiba ne farmaya beshak tu apni qoum mein nek hai lekin main toh tujhe apna beta shumar karti hoon, khair main Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas jati hoon jo woh hukum farmayein. Woh hazir huin aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko sari kaifiyat bayan ki, aap ne farmaya apne ghar laut jao. Phir yeh ayat utri ke jis se baap ne nikah kiya us se bete ka nikah haram hai. Aise waqiyat aur bhi us waqt maujood the jinhein is irade se baaz rakha gaya, ek toh yahi Abu Qais wala waqia, un biwi sahiba ka naam Umm-e-Ubaidullah Zamra tha. Dusra waqia Khalaf ka tha, un ke ghar mein Abu Talha ki sahibzadi thin, us ke inteqal ke baad us ke ladke Safwan ne use apne nikah mein lana chaha tha. Suhaili mein likha hai jahiliyat mein is nikah ka mamool tha jise baqaida nikah samjha jata tha aur bilkul halal gina jata tha, isi liye yahan bhi farmaya gaya ke jo pehle guzar chuka so guzar chuka, jaise do behnon ko nikah mein jama karne ki hurmat ko bayan farma kar bhi yahi kiya gaya. Kinana bin Khuzaima ne apne baap ki biwi se nikah kiya tha, Nasr isi ke batan se paida hua tha. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke meri upar ki nasl bhi baqaida nikah se hi hai na ke zina se, toh maloom hua ke yeh rasm un mein barabar jaari thi aur jaiz thi aur ise nikah shumar karte the. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain jahiliyat wale bhi jin jin rishton ko Allah Ta'ala ne haram kiya hai, soteli maa aur do behnon ko ek sath nikah mein rakhne ke siwa sab ko haram hi jante the, pas Allah Ta'ala ne apne Kalam-e-Pak mein in dono rishton ko bhi haram thahraya. Hazrat Ata aur Hazrat Qatada (R.H) bhi yahi farmate hain. Yaad rahe ke Suhaili ne Kinana ka jo waqia naqal kiya hai woh gaur talab hai, bilkul sahi nahin, Wallahu A'lam. Bahar-e-surat yeh rishta ummat-e-muslima par haram hai aur nihayat qabeeh amr hai. Yahan tak ke farmaya yeh nihayat fahash bura kaam bughz ka hai. Donon miyan biwi mein khalwat-o-sohbat ho chuki hai phir mehar wapas lena kya ma'ani rakhta hai.

Phir farmaya ke aqd-e-nikah jo mazboot ahd-o-paiman hai is mein tum jakre ja chuke ho, Allah ka yeh farman tum sun chuke ho ke basao toh achi tarah aur alag karo toh umda tariqe se. Chunancha hadith mein bhi hai ke tum in aurton ko Allah ki amanat ke tor pe lete ho aur in ko apne liye Allah Ta'ala ka kalma parh kar yani nikah ke khutba-e-tashahhud se halal karte ho. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko mi'raj wali raat jab behtareen in'amat ata hue, in mein ek yeh bhi tha ke aap se farmaya gaya teri ummat ka koi khutba jaiz nahin jab tak woh is amr ki gawahi na dein ke tu mera banda aur mera rasool hai (Ibn Abi Hatim). Nikah ke ahkamat Sahih Muslim Sharif mein Hazrat Jabir (R.A) se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne Hajjat-ul-Wida ke khutba mein farmaya tum ne aurton ko Allah ki amanat ke tor pe liya hai aur unhein Allah Ta'ala ke kalma se apne liye halal kiya hai. Is ke baad Allah Ta'ala soteli maon ki hurmat bayan farmata hai aur un ki ta'zeem aur tauqeer zahir karta hai yahan tak ke baap ne kisi aurat se sirf nikah kiya abhi woh rukhsat ho kar bhi nahin aayi magar talaq ho gayi ya baap mar gaya waghera toh bhi woh sabab aur bura rasta hai aur jagah farma hai ayat (WALA TAQRA-BUL FAWAHISH MA ZAHARA MINHA WAMA BATAN) (6. Al-An'am: 151) yani kisi burai, behayai aur fahash kaam ke qareeb bhi na jao ya woh bilkul zahir ho khwah posheeda ho aur farman hai ayat (WALA TAQRA-BUZ ZINA INNAHU KANA FAHISHATAN WASA-A SABILA) (17. Al-Isra: 32) zina ke qareeb na jao yaqeenan woh fahash kaam aur buri rah hai. Yahan mazeed farmaya ke yeh kaam bare bughz ka bhi hai yani fi nafsihi bhi bara bura amr hai is se baap bete mein adawat par jati hai aur dushmani qaim ho jati hai, yahi mushahida mein aaya hai aur umooman yeh bhi likha gaya hai ke jo shakhs kisi aurat se doosra nikah karta hai woh is ke pehle khawand se bughz hi rakhta hai. Yahi wajah hai ke An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyan Ummahat-ul-Momineen qarar de di gayin aur ummat par misl maa ke haram ki gayin kyunke woh Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyan hain aur aap misl baap ke hain, balkay ijma'an sabit hai ke aap ke haq baap dada ke huqooq se bhi bohat zyada aur bohat bare hain balkay aap ki mohabbat khud apni janon ki mohabbat par bhi muqaddam hai, salawatullahi wa salamuhu alaih. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh kaam Allah ke bughz ka mojib hai aur bura rasta hai. Ab jo aisa kaam kare woh deen se murtad hai use qatl kar diya jaye aur is ka maal Bait-ul-Maal mein bator-e-fai ke dakhil kar liya jaye. Sunan aur Musnad-e-Ahmad mein marwi hai ke ek sahabi ko Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is shakhs ki taraf bheja jis ne apne baap ki biwi se baap ke baad nikah kiya tha ke use qatl kar dalo aur is ke maal par qabza kar lo. Hazrat Bara bin Azib farmate hain ke mere chacha Haris bin Umair apne hath mein Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka diya hua jhanda le kar mere paas se guzre main ne poocha ke chacha huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aap ko kahan bheja hai?

Farmaya us shakhs ki taraf jis ne apne baap ki biwi se nikah kiya hai mujhe hukm hai ke main us ki gardan maaroon (Musnad-e-Ahmad).

Sauteli maa se nikah haram hai. Masla: Is par toh ulama ka ijma hai ke jis aurat se baap ne mubashirat kar li khwah nikah kar ke, khwah malkiyat mein la kar, khwah shuba se, woh aurat bete par haram hai. Haan agar jima na hua ho toh sirf mubashirat hui ho ya woh aaza dekhe hon jin ka dekhna ajnabi hone ki surat mein halal na tha toh is mein ikhtilaf hai. Imam Ahmad toh is surat mein bhi us aurat ko ladke par haram batate hain.

Hafiz Ibn-e-Asakir ke is waqiye se bhi is riwayat ki tasdeeq hoti hai ke Hazrat Khadij Humsi ne jo Hazrat Muawiya ke maula the, Hazrat Muawiya ke liye ek laundi kharidi jo gore rang ki aur khubsurat thi. Use barahna un ke paas bhej diya. Un ke haath mein ek chhadi thi, us se ishara kar ke kehne lage achha nafa tha agar yeh malboos hoti. Phir kehne lage ise Yazid bin Muawiya ke paas le jao. Phir kaha nahin nahin thahro, Rabia bin Amr Harsi ko mere paas bula lao, yeh bade faqih the. Jab aaye toh Hazrat Muawiya ne un se yeh masla poocha ke main ne is aurat ke yeh aaza-e-makhsoos dekhe hain, yeh barahna thi. Ab main ise apne ladke Yazid ke paas bhejna chahta hoon toh kya us ke liye yeh halal hai? Hazrat Rabia ne farmaya Amir-ul-Momineen aisa na kijiye, yeh us ke qabil nahin rahi. Farmaya tum theek kehte ho, achha jao Abdullah bin Masada Fazari ko bula lao. Woh aaye, woh toh gandum-goon rang ke the. Us se Hazrat Muawiya ne farmaya is laundi ko main tumhein deta hoon taake tumhari aulad safed rang paida ho. Yeh Abdullah bin Masada woh hain jinhein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Fatima ko diya tha, aap ne unhein pala, parwarish kiya, phir Allah Ta'ala ke naam se azaad kar diya, phir yeh Hazrat Muawiya ke paas chale aaye the.

Aurat par zulm ka khatma. Sahih Bukhari mein hai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke qabl-e-Islam jab koi shakhs mar jata to us ke waris us ki aurat ke poore haqdar samjhe jate. Agar un mein se koi chahta to apne nikah mein le leta, agar woh chahte to dusre kisi ke nikah mein de dete, agar chahte to nikah hi na karne dete. Maike walon se zyada us aurat ke haqdar sasural wale hi gine jate the. Jahiliyat ki is rasm ke khilaf yeh aayat nazil hui. Dusri riwayat mein yeh bhi aaya hai ke woh log us aurat ko majboor karte ke woh mehar ke haq se dast-bardar ho jaye ya yunhi be-nikahi baithi rahe. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke us aurat ka khawand marte hi koi bhi aa kar us par apna kapda daal deta aur wahi us ka mukhtar samjha jata.
