To riwayat mein hai ke yeh kapda dalne wala use haseen pata to apne nikah mein le leta, agar yeh badsurat hoti to use yunhi roke rakhta yahan tak ke mar jaye, phir us ke maal ka waris banta. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke marne wale ka koi gehra dost kapda daal deta, phir agar woh aurat kuch fidiya aur badla de to woh use nikah karne ki ijazat deta warna yunhi mar jati. Hazrat Zaid bin Aslam farmate hain ahl-e-Madina ka yeh dastoor tha ke waris us aurat ke bhi waris ban jate. Garaz yeh log auraton ke sath bade buri tarah pesh aate the yahan tak ke talaq dete waqt bhi shart kar lete the ke jahan main chahun tera nikah ho. Is tarah ki qaid-o-band se rihai pane ki phir yeh surat hoti ke woh aurat kuch de kar jaan chhudati. Allah Ta'ala ne mominon ko is se mana farma diya. Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai ke jab Abu Qais bin Aslat ka inteqal hua to un ke bete ne un ki biwi se nikah karna chaha jaise ke jahiliyat mein yeh dastoor tha, is par yeh aayat nazil hui. Hazrat Atta farmate hain ke kisi bache ki sambhal par use laga dete the. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain jab koi mar jata to us ka ladka us ki biwi ka zyada haqdar samjha jata, agar chahta khud apni sauteli maa se nikah kar leta aur agar chahta dusre ke nikah mein de deta maslan bhai ke, bhatije ya jis ko chahe. Hazrat Ikrama ki riwayat mein hai ke Abu Qais ki jis biwi ka naam Kabina tha (R.A), us ne is surat ki khabar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko di ke yeh log na mujhe warison mein shumar kar ke mere khawand ka wirsa dete hain na mujhe chhodte hain ke main aur kahin apna nikah kar lun, is par yeh aayat nazil hui. Ek riwayat mein hai ke kapda dalne ki rasm se pehle hi agar koi aurat bhag khadi ho aur apne maike aa jaye to woh chhoot jati thi. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain jo yateem bachi un ki wilayat mein hoti use yeh roke rakhte the is umeed par ke jab hamari biwi mar jayegi hum us se nikah kar lenge ya apne ladke se us ka nikah kara denge. In sab aqwal se maloom hua ke un tamam suraton ki is aayat mein Allah Ta'ala ne mumanat kar di aur auraton ki jaan is museebat se chhudadi. Wallahu A'lam.

Irshad hai auraton ki bod-o-bash mein unhein tang kar ke takleef de de kar majboor na karo ke woh apna sara mehar chhor dein ya is mein se kuch chhor dein ya apne kisi aur wajibi haq waghera se dast-bardar hone par amada hojayen kyunke unhein sataya aur majboor kiya ja raha hai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke aurat napasand hai dil nahin mila chhor dena chahta hai to is surat mein haq-e-mehar ke alawa bhi waghera tamam huqooq dene parenge is surat-e-haal se bachne ke liye use satana ya tarah tarah se tang karna taake woh khud apne huqooq chhor kar chale jane par amada hojaye aisa rawayya ikhtiyar karne se Quran-e-Pak ne musalmanon ko rok diya. Ibn-e-Sulaimani (R.H) farmate hain in dono ayaton mein se pehli ayat amr-e-jahiliyat ko khatam karne aur dusri amr-e-Islam ki islah ke liye nazil hui, Ibn-e-Mubarak (R.H) bhi yahi farmate hain. Magar is surat mein ke un se khuli behayai ka kaam sadir hojaye, is se murad baqol aksar mufassireen sahaba, tabieen waghera zina-kari hai, yani is surat mein jaiz hai ke us se mehar lota lena chahiye aur use tang kare taake khula par razamand ho, jaise Surah Baqarah ki ayat mein hai ayat (Yaa ayyuhallazina aamanu la yahillu lakum an tarisun-nisaa karhan wa la ta'duluhunna litazhabu bibadi ma ataitumuhunna illa an ya'tina bifahishatin mubayyinah) (Surah An-Nisa: 19) yani tumhein halal nahin ke tum unhein diye hue mein se kuch bhi le lo magar is halat mein dono ko Allah ki haddein qaim na rakh sakne ka khauf ho. Baaz buzurgon ne farmaya hai ayat (Fahishatin mubayyinah) se murad khawand ke khilaf kaam karna us ki nafarmani karna bad-zabani kaj-khulqi karna huqooq-e-zaujiat achi tarah ada na karna waghera hai, Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) farmate hain ayat ke alfaz aam hain zina ko aur tamam mazkoora awamil bhi shamil hain yani in tamam suraton mein khawand ko mubah hai ke use tang kare taake woh apna kul haq ya thora haq chhor de aur phir yeh use alag kar de Imam sahab ka yeh farman bahut hi munasib hai wallahu a'lam, yeh riwayat bhi pehle guzar chuki hai ke yahan is ayat ke utarne ka sabab wahi jahiliyat ki rasm hai jis se Allah ne mana farma diya, is se maloom hota hai ke yeh pura bayan jahiliyat ki rasm ko Islam mein se kharij karne ke liye hua hai, Ibn-e-Zaid (R.H) farmate hain Makkah ke Quraish mein yeh riwaj tha ke kisi shakhs ne kisi sharif aurat se nikah kiya muwafiqat na hui to use talaq de di lekin yeh shart kar leta tha ke baghair us ki ijazat ke yeh dusri jagah nikah nahin kar sakti is baat par gawah muqarrar hojate aur iqrar-nama likh liya jata ab agar kahin se paigham aaye aur woh aurat razi ho to yeh kehta mujhe itni raqam de to main tujhe nikah ki ijazat dunga agar woh ada kar deti to khair warna yun na use qaid rakhta aur dusra nikah na karne deta is ki muman'at is ayat mein nazil hui, baqol Mujahid (R.H) yeh hukm aur Surah Baqarah ki ayat ka hukm dono ek hi hain.

Phir farmaya aurton ke sath khush-sulooki ka rawayya rakho un ke sath achha bartao barto, narm baat kaho nek sulook karo apni halat bhi apni taqat ke mutabiq achhi rakho, jaise tum chahte ho ke woh tumhare liye bani sanwari hui achhi halat mein rahe tum khud apni halat bhi achhi rakho jaise aur jagah farmaya aayat (Wa lahunna mislul-lazi alaihinna bil-ma'roofi wa lir-rijali alaihinna darajatun wallahu Azizun Hakim) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 228) jaise tumhare huqooq un par hain un ke huqooq bhi tum par hain. Behtareen zauj mohtaram Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain tum mein se behtar shakhs woh hai jo apni ghar wali ke sath behtar se behtar sulook karne wala ho main apni biwiyon se bahut achha rawayya rakhta hoon, Nabi Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni biwiyon ke sath bahut lutf-o-khushi bahut narm akhlaqi aur khanda peshani se pesh aate the, unhein khush rakhte the un se hansi dil-lagi ki baatein kiya karte the, un ke dil apni mutthi mein rakhte the, unhein achhi tarah khane peene ko dete the kushada dili ke sath un par kharch karte the aisi khush-tabai ki baatein bayan farmate jin se woh hans detin, aisa bhi hua hai ke Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ke sath Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne daud lagayi us daud mein Ayesha Siddiqa aage nikal gayin kuch muddat baad phir daud lagi ab ke Hazrat Ayesha peeche reh gayin to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya mamla barabar ho gaya, is se bhi Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka matlab yeh tha ke Hazrat Siddiqa khush rahein un ka dil behle jis biwi sahiba ke yahan Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko raat guzarni hoti wahin Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki kul biwiyan jama ho jatin do ghari baithtin baat-cheet hoti kabhi aisa bhi hota ke un sab ke sath hi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) raat ka khana tanawul farmate phir sab apne apne ghar chali jatin aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) wahin aaram farmate jin ki bari hoti, apni biwi sahiba ke sath ek hi chadar mein sote kurta nikal daalte sirf tehband bandha hua hota Isha ki namaz ke baad ghar ja kar do ghari idhar udhar ki kuch baatein karte jis se ghar waliyon ka jee khush hota al-gharaz nihayat hi mohabbat pyar ke sath apni biwiyon ko Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) rakhte the. Pas musalmanon ko bhi chahiye ke apni biwiyon ke sath achhi tarah raazi khushi mohabbat pyar se rahein, Allah Ta'ala farmata hai farman-bardari ka dusra naam achhai hai, is ke tafseeli ahkaam ki jagah tafseer nahin balkay isi mazmoon ki kitabein hain wal-hamdulillah phir farmata hai ke bawajood jee na chahne ke bhi aurton se achhi bod-o-bash rakhne mein bahut mumkin hai ke Allah Ta'ala bahut bari bhalai ata farmaye, mumkin hai nek aulad ho jaye aur is se Allah Ta'ala bahut si bhalaiyan naseeb kare, sahih hadith mein hai momin mard momina aurat ko alag na kare agar us ki ek aadh baat se naraz hoga to ek aadh khaslat achhi bhi hogi. Phir farmata hai ke jab tum mein se koi apni biwi ko talaq dena chahe aur us ki jagah dusri aurat se nikah karna chahe to use diye hue mehar mein se kuch bhi wapas na le chahe khazana ka khazana diya hua ho.

Haq-e-mahar ke masail Surah Al-e-Imran ki tafsir mein Qintar ka pura bayan guzar chuka hai is liye yahan dobara bayan karne ki zaroorat nahin, is se sabit hota hai ke mahar mein bahut sara maal dena bhi jaiz hai, Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ne pehle bahut lambe chaure mahar se mana farma diya tha phir apne qaul se ruju kiya, jaise ke Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke aap ne farmaya aurton ke mahar bandhne mein ziyadati na karo agar yeh dunyawi taur par koi bhi cheez hoti ya Allah ke nazdeek yeh taqwa ki cheez hoti to tum sab se pehle is par Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) amal karte. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apni kisi biwi ka ya apni kisi beti ka mahar barah auqiya se ziyada muqarrar nahin kiya (taqreeban sawa sau rupiya). Insaan ziyada mahar bandh kar phir museebat mein par jata hai yahan tak ke rafta rafta us ki biwi use bojh maloom hone lagti hai aur us ke dilon mein us ki dushmani baith jati hai aur kehne lagta hai ke tu ne to mere kandhe par mashk latka di, yeh hadith bahut si kitabon mein mukhtalif alfaz se marwi hai. Ek mein hai ke aap ne mimbar-e-Nabwi par khade ho kar farmaya logo tum ne kyun lambe chaure mahar bandhne shuru kar diye hain? Rasool Allah (ﷺ) aur aap ke zamana ke aap ke ashab ne to char sau dirham (taqreeban sau rupiya) mahar bandha hai agar yeh taqwa aur karamat ke zaad hone ka sabab hota to tum ziyada haq-e-mahar ada karne mein bhi un par sabqat nahin le sakte the. Khabardar aaj se main na sunoon ke kisi ne char sau dirham se ziyada ka mahar muqarrar kiya. Yeh farma kar aap neeche utar aaye to ek Quraishi khatoon samne aayin aur kehne lagin Amir-ul-Momineen kya aap ne char sau dirham se ziyada ke haq-e-mahar se logon ko mana farma diya hai? Aap ne farmaya haan. Kaha kya aap ne Allah ka kalam jo us ne nazil farmaya hai nahin suna? Kaha woh kya? Kaha suniye Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala farmata hai ayat (Wa ataitum ihdahunna qintaran fala ta'khuzu minhu shai'an atakhuzunahu buhtanan wa ithman mubina) (Surah An-Nisa: 20) tum ne unhein khazana diya ho. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya Allah mujhe maaf farma, Umar se to har shakhs ziyada samajhdar hai. Phir wapas usi waqt mimbar par khade ho kar logon se farmaya logo main ne tumhein char sau dirham se ziyada ke mahar se rok diya tha lekin ab kehta hoon jo shakhs apne maal mein se mahar mein jitna chahe de apni khushi se jitna mahar muqarrar karna chahe kare main nahin rokta, aur ek riwayat mein us aurat ka ayat ko is tarah parhna marwi hai ayat (Wa ataitum ihdahunna qintaran fala ta'khuzu minhu shai'an) (Surah An-Nisa: 20).

(An-Nisa: 20) (Min Zahab) Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood R.A ki qira'at mein bhi isi tarah hai aur Hazrat Umar R.A ka yeh farmana bhi marwi hai ke ek aurat Umar R.A par ghalib aa gayi aur riwayat mein hai ke Aap ﷺ ne farmaya tha: "Ghozi-ul-Qissa" yani Yazid bin Haseen Harisi ki beti ho phir bhi mehar is ka zyada muqarrar na karo aur agar tum ne aisa kiya to woh zaid raqam mein Bait-ul-Maal ke liye le loonga. Is par ek daraz qad chauri naak wali aurat ne kaha: Hazrat! Aap yeh hukm nahin de sakte. Phir Allah Ta'ala ka irshad hai ke tum apni biwi ko diya hua haq-e-mehar wapas kaise le sakte ho? Jabke tum ne us se faida uthaya ya zaroorat poori ki, woh tum se aur tum us se mil gaye, yani miyan-biwi ke talluqat bhi qaim ho gaye. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki is hadith mein hai: Ek shakhs ne apni biwi par zina ka ilzam lagaya aur Huzoor ﷺ ke samne pesh hua. Biwi ne bhi apne beganah hone aur shohar ne apne sacha hone ki qasam khai, phir un dono ka qasmein khana aur us ke baad Aap ﷺ ka yeh farman ke Allah Ta'ala ko bakhoobi ilm hai ke tum dono mein se kaun jhoota hai? Kya tum mein se koi ab bhi tauba karta hai? Teen dafa farmaya, to us mard ne kaha: Main ne jo maal is ke mehar mein diya hai us ki babat kya farmate hain?

Aap ne farmaya isi ke badle toh yeh tere liye halal hui thin ab agar tu ne is par jhooti tohmat lagayi hai toh phir aur namumkin baat hogi. Isi tarah ek aur hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Nufra ne ek kunwari ladki se nikah kiya, jab us se mile toh dekha ke use zina ka haml hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se zikr kiya, aap ne use alag kara diya aur mehar dilwa diya aur aurat ko kode maarne ka hukum diya aur farmaya jo bacha hoga woh tera ghulam hoga aur mehar toh us ki hillat ka sabab tha (Abu Dawood). Garz ayat ka matlab bhi yahi hai ke aurat us ke bete par haram ho jati hai, is par ijma hai. Hazrat Abu Qais ne un ki biwi se nikah ki khwahish ki jo un ki soteli maa thin, is par is biwi sahiba ne farmaya beshak tu apni qoum mein nek hai lekin main toh tujhe apna beta shumar karti hoon, khair main Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas jati hoon jo woh hukum farmayein. Woh hazir huin aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko sari kaifiyat bayan ki, aap ne farmaya apne ghar laut jao. Phir yeh ayat utri ke jis se baap ne nikah kiya us se bete ka nikah haram hai. Aise waqiyat aur bhi us waqt maujood the jinhein is irade se baaz rakha gaya, ek toh yahi Abu Qais wala waqia, un biwi sahiba ka naam Umm-e-Ubaidullah Zamra tha. Dusra waqia Khalaf ka tha, un ke ghar mein Abu Talha ki sahibzadi thin, us ke inteqal ke baad us ke ladke Safwan ne use apne nikah mein lana chaha tha. Suhaili mein likha hai jahiliyat mein is nikah ka mamool tha jise baqaida nikah samjha jata tha aur bilkul halal gina jata tha, isi liye yahan bhi farmaya gaya ke jo pehle guzar chuka so guzar chuka, jaise do behnon ko nikah mein jama karne ki hurmat ko bayan farma kar bhi yahi kiya gaya. Kinana bin Khuzaima ne apne baap ki biwi se nikah kiya tha, Nasr isi ke batan se paida hua tha. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke meri upar ki nasl bhi baqaida nikah se hi hai na ke zina se, toh maloom hua ke yeh rasm un mein barabar jaari thi aur jaiz thi aur ise nikah shumar karte the. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain jahiliyat wale bhi jin jin rishton ko Allah Ta'ala ne haram kiya hai, soteli maa aur do behnon ko ek sath nikah mein rakhne ke siwa sab ko haram hi jante the, pas Allah Ta'ala ne apne Kalam-e-Pak mein in dono rishton ko bhi haram thahraya. Hazrat Ata aur Hazrat Qatada (R.H) bhi yahi farmate hain. Yaad rahe ke Suhaili ne Kinana ka jo waqia naqal kiya hai woh gaur talab hai, bilkul sahi nahin, Wallahu A'lam. Bahar-e-surat yeh rishta ummat-e-muslima par haram hai aur nihayat qabeeh amr hai. Yahan tak ke farmaya yeh nihayat fahash bura kaam bughz ka hai. Donon miyan biwi mein khalwat-o-sohbat ho chuki hai phir mehar wapas lena kya ma'ani rakhta hai.

Phir farmaya ke aqd-e-nikah jo mazboot ahd-o-paiman hai is mein tum jakre ja chuke ho, Allah ka yeh farman tum sun chuke ho ke basao toh achi tarah aur alag karo toh umda tariqe se. Chunancha hadith mein bhi hai ke tum in aurton ko Allah ki amanat ke tor pe lete ho aur in ko apne liye Allah Ta'ala ka kalma parh kar yani nikah ke khutba-e-tashahhud se halal karte ho. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko mi'raj wali raat jab behtareen in'amat ata hue, in mein ek yeh bhi tha ke aap se farmaya gaya teri ummat ka koi khutba jaiz nahin jab tak woh is amr ki gawahi na dein ke tu mera banda aur mera rasool hai (Ibn Abi Hatim). Nikah ke ahkamat Sahih Muslim Sharif mein Hazrat Jabir (R.A) se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne Hajjat-ul-Wida ke khutba mein farmaya tum ne aurton ko Allah ki amanat ke tor pe liya hai aur unhein Allah Ta'ala ke kalma se apne liye halal kiya hai. Is ke baad Allah Ta'ala soteli maon ki hurmat bayan farmata hai aur un ki ta'zeem aur tauqeer zahir karta hai yahan tak ke baap ne kisi aurat se sirf nikah kiya abhi woh rukhsat ho kar bhi nahin aayi magar talaq ho gayi ya baap mar gaya waghera toh bhi woh sabab aur bura rasta hai aur jagah farma hai ayat (WALA TAQRA-BUL FAWAHISH MA ZAHARA MINHA WAMA BATAN) (6. Al-An'am: 151) yani kisi burai, behayai aur fahash kaam ke qareeb bhi na jao ya woh bilkul zahir ho khwah posheeda ho aur farman hai ayat (WALA TAQRA-BUZ ZINA INNAHU KANA FAHISHATAN WASA-A SABILA) (17. Al-Isra: 32) zina ke qareeb na jao yaqeenan woh fahash kaam aur buri rah hai. Yahan mazeed farmaya ke yeh kaam bare bughz ka bhi hai yani fi nafsihi bhi bara bura amr hai is se baap bete mein adawat par jati hai aur dushmani qaim ho jati hai, yahi mushahida mein aaya hai aur umooman yeh bhi likha gaya hai ke jo shakhs kisi aurat se doosra nikah karta hai woh is ke pehle khawand se bughz hi rakhta hai. Yahi wajah hai ke An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyan Ummahat-ul-Momineen qarar de di gayin aur ummat par misl maa ke haram ki gayin kyunke woh Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyan hain aur aap misl baap ke hain, balkay ijma'an sabit hai ke aap ke haq baap dada ke huqooq se bhi bohat zyada aur bohat bare hain balkay aap ki mohabbat khud apni janon ki mohabbat par bhi muqaddam hai, salawatullahi wa salamuhu alaih. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh kaam Allah ke bughz ka mojib hai aur bura rasta hai. Ab jo aisa kaam kare woh deen se murtad hai use qatl kar diya jaye aur is ka maal Bait-ul-Maal mein bator-e-fai ke dakhil kar liya jaye. Sunan aur Musnad-e-Ahmad mein marwi hai ke ek sahabi ko Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is shakhs ki taraf bheja jis ne apne baap ki biwi se baap ke baad nikah kiya tha ke use qatl kar dalo aur is ke maal par qabza kar lo. Hazrat Bara bin Azib farmate hain ke mere chacha Haris bin Umair apne hath mein Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka diya hua jhanda le kar mere paas se guzre main ne poocha ke chacha huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aap ko kahan bheja hai?

Farmaya us shakhs ki taraf jis ne apne baap ki biwi se nikah kiya hai mujhe hukm hai ke main us ki gardan maaroon (Musnad-e-Ahmad).

Sauteli maa se nikah haram hai. Masla: Is par toh ulama ka ijma hai ke jis aurat se baap ne mubashirat kar li khwah nikah kar ke, khwah malkiyat mein la kar, khwah shuba se, woh aurat bete par haram hai. Haan agar jima na hua ho toh sirf mubashirat hui ho ya woh aaza dekhe hon jin ka dekhna ajnabi hone ki surat mein halal na tha toh is mein ikhtilaf hai. Imam Ahmad toh is surat mein bhi us aurat ko ladke par haram batate hain.

Hafiz Ibn-e-Asakir ke is waqiye se bhi is riwayat ki tasdeeq hoti hai ke Hazrat Khadij Humsi ne jo Hazrat Muawiya ke maula the, Hazrat Muawiya ke liye ek laundi kharidi jo gore rang ki aur khubsurat thi. Use barahna un ke paas bhej diya. Un ke haath mein ek chhadi thi, us se ishara kar ke kehne lage achha nafa tha agar yeh malboos hoti. Phir kehne lage ise Yazid bin Muawiya ke paas le jao. Phir kaha nahin nahin thahro, Rabia bin Amr Harsi ko mere paas bula lao, yeh bade faqih the. Jab aaye toh Hazrat Muawiya ne un se yeh masla poocha ke main ne is aurat ke yeh aaza-e-makhsoos dekhe hain, yeh barahna thi. Ab main ise apne ladke Yazid ke paas bhejna chahta hoon toh kya us ke liye yeh halal hai? Hazrat Rabia ne farmaya Amir-ul-Momineen aisa na kijiye, yeh us ke qabil nahin rahi. Farmaya tum theek kehte ho, achha jao Abdullah bin Masada Fazari ko bula lao. Woh aaye, woh toh gandum-goon rang ke the. Us se Hazrat Muawiya ne farmaya is laundi ko main tumhein deta hoon taake tumhari aulad safed rang paida ho. Yeh Abdullah bin Masada woh hain jinhein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Fatima ko diya tha, aap ne unhein pala, parwarish kiya, phir Allah Ta'ala ke naam se azaad kar diya, phir yeh Hazrat Muawiya ke paas chale aaye the.

Aurat par zulm ka khatma. Sahih Bukhari mein hai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke qabl-e-Islam jab koi shakhs mar jata to us ke waris us ki aurat ke poore haqdar samjhe jate. Agar un mein se koi chahta to apne nikah mein le leta, agar woh chahte to dusre kisi ke nikah mein de dete, agar chahte to nikah hi na karne dete. Maike walon se zyada us aurat ke haqdar sasural wale hi gine jate the. Jahiliyat ki is rasm ke khilaf yeh aayat nazil hui. Dusri riwayat mein yeh bhi aaya hai ke woh log us aurat ko majboor karte ke woh mehar ke haq se dast-bardar ho jaye ya yunhi be-nikahi baithi rahe. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke us aurat ka khawand marte hi koi bhi aa kar us par apna kapda daal deta aur wahi us ka mukhtar samjha jata. To riwayat mein hai ke yeh kapda dalne wala use haseen pata to apne nikah mein le leta, agar yeh badsurat hoti to use yunhi roke rakhta yahan tak ke mar jaye, phir us ke maal ka waris banta. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke marne wale ka koi gehra dost kapda daal deta, phir agar woh aurat kuch fidiya aur badla de to woh use nikah karne ki ijazat deta warna yunhi mar jati. Hazrat Zaid bin Aslam farmate hain ahl-e-Madina ka yeh dastoor tha ke waris us aurat ke bhi waris ban jate. Garaz yeh log auraton ke sath bade buri tarah pesh aate the yahan tak ke talaq dete waqt bhi shart kar lete the ke jahan main chahun tera nikah ho. Is tarah ki qaid-o-band se rihai pane ki phir yeh surat hoti ke woh aurat kuch de kar jaan chhudati. Allah Ta'ala ne mominon ko is se mana farma diya. Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai ke jab Abu Qais bin Aslat ka inteqal hua to un ke bete ne un ki biwi se nikah karna chaha jaise ke jahiliyat mein yeh dastoor tha, is par yeh aayat nazil hui. Hazrat Atta farmate hain ke kisi bache ki sambhal par use laga dete the. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain jab koi mar jata to us ka ladka us ki biwi ka zyada haqdar samjha jata, agar chahta khud apni sauteli maa se nikah kar leta aur agar chahta dusre ke nikah mein de deta maslan bhai ke, bhatije ya jis ko chahe. Hazrat Ikrama ki riwayat mein hai ke Abu Qais ki jis biwi ka naam Kabina tha (R.A), us ne is surat ki khabar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko di ke yeh log na mujhe warison mein shumar kar ke mere khawand ka wirsa dete hain na mujhe chhodte hain ke main aur kahin apna nikah kar lun, is par yeh aayat nazil hui. Ek riwayat mein hai ke kapda dalne ki rasm se pehle hi agar koi aurat bhag khadi ho aur apne maike aa jaye to woh chhoot jati thi. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain jo yateem bachi un ki wilayat mein hoti use yeh roke rakhte the is umeed par ke jab hamari biwi mar jayegi hum us se nikah kar lenge ya apne ladke se us ka nikah kara denge. In sab aqwal se maloom hua ke un tamam suraton ki is aayat mein Allah Ta'ala ne mumanat kar di aur auraton ki jaan is museebat se chhudadi. Wallahu A'lam.

Irshad hai auraton ki bod-o-bash mein unhein tang kar ke takleef de de kar majboor na karo ke woh apna sara mehar chhor dein ya is mein se kuch chhor dein ya apne kisi aur wajibi haq waghera se dast-bardar hone par amada hojayen kyunke unhein sataya aur majboor kiya ja raha hai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke aurat napasand hai dil nahin mila chhor dena chahta hai to is surat mein haq-e-mehar ke alawa bhi waghera tamam huqooq dene parenge is surat-e-haal se bachne ke liye use satana ya tarah tarah se tang karna taake woh khud apne huqooq chhor kar chale jane par amada hojaye aisa rawayya ikhtiyar karne se Quran-e-Pak ne musalmanon ko rok diya. Ibn-e-Sulaimani (R.H) farmate hain in dono ayaton mein se pehli ayat amr-e-jahiliyat ko khatam karne aur dusri amr-e-Islam ki islah ke liye nazil hui, Ibn-e-Mubarak (R.H) bhi yahi farmate hain. Magar is surat mein ke un se khuli behayai ka kaam sadir hojaye, is se murad baqol aksar mufassireen sahaba, tabieen waghera zina-kari hai, yani is surat mein jaiz hai ke us se mehar lota lena chahiye aur use tang kare taake khula par razamand ho, jaise Surah Baqarah ki ayat mein hai ayat (Yaa ayyuhallazina aamanu la yahillu lakum an tarisun-nisaa karhan wa la ta'duluhunna litazhabu bibadi ma ataitumuhunna illa an ya'tina bifahishatin mubayyinah) (Surah An-Nisa: 19) yani tumhein halal nahin ke tum unhein diye hue mein se kuch bhi le lo magar is halat mein dono ko Allah ki haddein qaim na rakh sakne ka khauf ho. Baaz buzurgon ne farmaya hai ayat (Fahishatin mubayyinah) se murad khawand ke khilaf kaam karna us ki nafarmani karna bad-zabani kaj-khulqi karna huqooq-e-zaujiat achi tarah ada na karna waghera hai, Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) farmate hain ayat ke alfaz aam hain zina ko aur tamam mazkoora awamil bhi shamil hain yani in tamam suraton mein khawand ko mubah hai ke use tang kare taake woh apna kul haq ya thora haq chhor de aur phir yeh use alag kar de Imam sahab ka yeh farman bahut hi munasib hai wallahu a'lam, yeh riwayat bhi pehle guzar chuki hai ke yahan is ayat ke utarne ka sabab wahi jahiliyat ki rasm hai jis se Allah ne mana farma diya, is se maloom hota hai ke yeh pura bayan jahiliyat ki rasm ko Islam mein se kharij karne ke liye hua hai, Ibn-e-Zaid (R.H) farmate hain Makkah ke Quraish mein yeh riwaj tha ke kisi shakhs ne kisi sharif aurat se nikah kiya muwafiqat na hui to use talaq de di lekin yeh shart kar leta tha ke baghair us ki ijazat ke yeh dusri jagah nikah nahin kar sakti is baat par gawah muqarrar hojate aur iqrar-nama likh liya jata ab agar kahin se paigham aaye aur woh aurat razi ho to yeh kehta mujhe itni raqam de to main tujhe nikah ki ijazat dunga agar woh ada kar deti to khair warna yun na use qaid rakhta aur dusra nikah na karne deta is ki muman'at is ayat mein nazil hui, baqol Mujahid (R.H) yeh hukm aur Surah Baqarah ki ayat ka hukm dono ek hi hain.

Phir farmaya aurton ke sath khush-sulooki ka rawayya rakho un ke sath achha bartao barto, narm baat kaho nek sulook karo apni halat bhi apni taqat ke mutabiq achhi rakho, jaise tum chahte ho ke woh tumhare liye bani sanwari hui achhi halat mein rahe tum khud apni halat bhi achhi rakho jaise aur jagah farmaya aayat (Wa lahunna mislul-lazi alaihinna bil-ma'roofi wa lir-rijali alaihinna darajatun wallahu Azizun Hakim) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 228) jaise tumhare huqooq un par hain un ke huqooq bhi tum par hain. Behtareen zauj mohtaram Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain tum mein se behtar shakhs woh hai jo apni ghar wali ke sath behtar se behtar sulook karne wala ho main apni biwiyon se bahut achha rawayya rakhta hoon, Nabi Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni biwiyon ke sath bahut lutf-o-khushi bahut narm akhlaqi aur khanda peshani se pesh aate the, unhein khush rakhte the un se hansi dil-lagi ki baatein kiya karte the, un ke dil apni mutthi mein rakhte the, unhein achhi tarah khane peene ko dete the kushada dili ke sath un par kharch karte the aisi khush-tabai ki baatein bayan farmate jin se woh hans detin, aisa bhi hua hai ke Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ke sath Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne daud lagayi us daud mein Ayesha Siddiqa aage nikal gayin kuch muddat baad phir daud lagi ab ke Hazrat Ayesha peeche reh gayin to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya mamla barabar ho gaya, is se bhi Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka matlab yeh tha ke Hazrat Siddiqa khush rahein un ka dil behle jis biwi sahiba ke yahan Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko raat guzarni hoti wahin Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki kul biwiyan jama ho jatin do ghari baithtin baat-cheet hoti kabhi aisa bhi hota ke un sab ke sath hi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) raat ka khana tanawul farmate phir sab apne apne ghar chali jatin aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) wahin aaram farmate jin ki bari hoti, apni biwi sahiba ke sath ek hi chadar mein sote kurta nikal daalte sirf tehband bandha hua hota Isha ki namaz ke baad ghar ja kar do ghari idhar udhar ki kuch baatein karte jis se ghar waliyon ka jee khush hota al-gharaz nihayat hi mohabbat pyar ke sath apni biwiyon ko Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) rakhte the. Pas musalmanon ko bhi chahiye ke apni biwiyon ke sath achhi tarah raazi khushi mohabbat pyar se rahein, Allah Ta'ala farmata hai farman-bardari ka dusra naam achhai hai, is ke tafseeli ahkaam ki jagah tafseer nahin balkay isi mazmoon ki kitabein hain wal-hamdulillah phir farmata hai ke bawajood jee na chahne ke bhi aurton se achhi bod-o-bash rakhne mein bahut mumkin hai ke Allah Ta'ala bahut bari bhalai ata farmaye, mumkin hai nek aulad ho jaye aur is se Allah Ta'ala bahut si bhalaiyan naseeb kare, sahih hadith mein hai momin mard momina aurat ko alag na kare agar us ki ek aadh baat se naraz hoga to ek aadh khaslat achhi bhi hogi. Phir farmata hai ke jab tum mein se koi apni biwi ko talaq dena chahe aur us ki jagah dusri aurat se nikah karna chahe to use diye hue mehar mein se kuch bhi wapas na le chahe khazana ka khazana diya hua ho.

Haq-e-mahar ke masail Surah Al-e-Imran ki tafsir mein Qintar ka pura bayan guzar chuka hai is liye yahan dobara bayan karne ki zaroorat nahin, is se sabit hota hai ke mahar mein bahut sara maal dena bhi jaiz hai, Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ne pehle bahut lambe chaure mahar se mana farma diya tha phir apne qaul se ruju kiya, jaise ke Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke aap ne farmaya aurton ke mahar bandhne mein ziyadati na karo agar yeh dunyawi taur par koi bhi cheez hoti ya Allah ke nazdeek yeh taqwa ki cheez hoti to tum sab se pehle is par Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) amal karte. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apni kisi biwi ka ya apni kisi beti ka mahar barah auqiya se ziyada muqarrar nahin kiya (taqreeban sawa sau rupiya). Insaan ziyada mahar bandh kar phir museebat mein par jata hai yahan tak ke rafta rafta us ki biwi use bojh maloom hone lagti hai aur us ke dilon mein us ki dushmani baith jati hai aur kehne lagta hai ke tu ne to mere kandhe par mashk latka di, yeh hadith bahut si kitabon mein mukhtalif alfaz se marwi hai. Ek mein hai ke aap ne mimbar-e-Nabwi par khade ho kar farmaya logo tum ne kyun lambe chaure mahar bandhne shuru kar diye hain? Rasool Allah (ﷺ) aur aap ke zamana ke aap ke ashab ne to char sau dirham (taqreeban sau rupiya) mahar bandha hai agar yeh taqwa aur karamat ke zaad hone ka sabab hota to tum ziyada haq-e-mahar ada karne mein bhi un par sabqat nahin le sakte the. Khabardar aaj se main na sunoon ke kisi ne char sau dirham se ziyada ka mahar muqarrar kiya. Yeh farma kar aap neeche utar aaye to ek Quraishi khatoon samne aayin aur kehne lagin Amir-ul-Momineen kya aap ne char sau dirham se ziyada ke haq-e-mahar se logon ko mana farma diya hai? Aap ne farmaya haan. Kaha kya aap ne Allah ka kalam jo us ne nazil farmaya hai nahin suna? Kaha woh kya? Kaha suniye Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala farmata hai ayat (Wa ataitum ihdahunna qintaran fala ta'khuzu minhu shai'an atakhuzunahu buhtanan wa ithman mubina) (Surah An-Nisa: 20) tum ne unhein khazana diya ho. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya Allah mujhe maaf farma, Umar se to har shakhs ziyada samajhdar hai. Phir wapas usi waqt mimbar par khade ho kar logon se farmaya logo main ne tumhein char sau dirham se ziyada ke mahar se rok diya tha lekin ab kehta hoon jo shakhs apne maal mein se mahar mein jitna chahe de apni khushi se jitna mahar muqarrar karna chahe kare main nahin rokta, aur ek riwayat mein us aurat ka ayat ko is tarah parhna marwi hai ayat (Wa ataitum ihdahunna qintaran fala ta'khuzu minhu shai'an) (Surah An-Nisa: 20).

(An-Nisa: 20) (Min Zahab) Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood R.A ki qira'at mein bhi isi tarah hai aur Hazrat Umar R.A ka yeh farmana bhi marwi hai ke ek aurat Umar R.A par ghalib aa gayi aur riwayat mein hai ke Aap ﷺ ne farmaya tha: "Ghozi-ul-Qissa" yani Yazid bin Haseen Harisi ki beti ho phir bhi mehar is ka zyada muqarrar na karo aur agar tum ne aisa kiya to woh zaid raqam mein Bait-ul-Maal ke liye le loonga. Is par ek daraz qad chauri naak wali aurat ne kaha: Hazrat! Aap yeh hukm nahin de sakte. Phir Allah Ta'ala ka irshad hai ke tum apni biwi ko diya hua haq-e-mehar wapas kaise le sakte ho? Jabke tum ne us se faida uthaya ya zaroorat poori ki, woh tum se aur tum us se mil gaye, yani miyan-biwi ke talluqat bhi qaim ho gaye. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki is hadith mein hai: Ek shakhs ne apni biwi par zina ka ilzam lagaya aur Huzoor ﷺ ke samne pesh hua. Biwi ne bhi apne beganah hone aur shohar ne apne sacha hone ki qasam khai, phir un dono ka qasmein khana aur us ke baad Aap ﷺ ka yeh farman ke Allah Ta'ala ko bakhoobi ilm hai ke tum dono mein se kaun jhoota hai? Kya tum mein se koi ab bhi tauba karta hai? Teen dafa farmaya, to us mard ne kaha: Main ne jo maal is ke mehar mein diya hai us ki babat kya farmate hain?

Aap ne farmaya isi ke badle toh yeh tere liye halal hui thin ab agar tu ne is par jhooti tohmat lagayi hai toh phir aur namumkin baat hogi. Isi tarah ek aur hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Nufra ne ek kunwari ladki se nikah kiya, jab us se mile toh dekha ke use zina ka haml hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se zikr kiya, aap ne use alag kara diya aur mehar dilwa diya aur aurat ko kode maarne ka hukum diya aur farmaya jo bacha hoga woh tera ghulam hoga aur mehar toh us ki hillat ka sabab tha (Abu Dawood). Garz ayat ka matlab bhi yahi hai ke aurat us ke bete par haram ho jati hai, is par ijma hai. Hazrat Abu Qais ne un ki biwi se nikah ki khwahish ki jo un ki soteli maa thin, is par is biwi sahiba ne farmaya beshak tu apni qoum mein nek hai lekin main toh tujhe apna beta shumar karti hoon, khair main Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas jati hoon jo woh hukum farmayein. Woh hazir huin aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko sari kaifiyat bayan ki, aap ne farmaya apne ghar laut jao. Phir yeh ayat utri ke jis se baap ne nikah kiya us se bete ka nikah haram hai. Aise waqiyat aur bhi us waqt maujood the jinhein is irade se baaz rakha gaya, ek toh yahi Abu Qais wala waqia, un biwi sahiba ka naam Umm-e-Ubaidullah Zamra tha. Dusra waqia Khalaf ka tha, un ke ghar mein Abu Talha ki sahibzadi thin, us ke inteqal ke baad us ke ladke Safwan ne use apne nikah mein lana chaha tha. Suhaili mein likha hai jahiliyat mein is nikah ka mamool tha jise baqaida nikah samjha jata tha aur bilkul halal gina jata tha, isi liye yahan bhi farmaya gaya ke jo pehle guzar chuka so guzar chuka, jaise do behnon ko nikah mein jama karne ki hurmat ko bayan farma kar bhi yahi kiya gaya. Kinana bin Khuzaima ne apne baap ki biwi se nikah kiya tha, Nasr isi ke batan se paida hua tha. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke meri upar ki nasl bhi baqaida nikah se hi hai na ke zina se, toh maloom hua ke yeh rasm un mein barabar jaari thi aur jaiz thi aur ise nikah shumar karte the. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain jahiliyat wale bhi jin jin rishton ko Allah Ta'ala ne haram kiya hai, soteli maa aur do behnon ko ek sath nikah mein rakhne ke siwa sab ko haram hi jante the, pas Allah Ta'ala ne apne Kalam-e-Pak mein in dono rishton ko bhi haram thahraya. Hazrat Ata aur Hazrat Qatada (R.H) bhi yahi farmate hain. Yaad rahe ke Suhaili ne Kinana ka jo waqia naqal kiya hai woh gaur talab hai, bilkul sahi nahin, Wallahu A'lam. Bahar-e-surat yeh rishta ummat-e-muslima par haram hai aur nihayat qabeeh amr hai. Yahan tak ke farmaya yeh nihayat fahash bura kaam bughz ka hai. Donon miyan biwi mein khalwat-o-sohbat ho chuki hai phir mehar wapas lena kya ma'ani rakhta hai.

Phir farmaya ke aqd-e-nikah jo mazboot ahd-o-paiman hai is mein tum jakre ja chuke ho, Allah ka yeh farman tum sun chuke ho ke basao toh achi tarah aur alag karo toh umda tariqe se. Chunancha hadith mein bhi hai ke tum in aurton ko Allah ki amanat ke tor pe lete ho aur in ko apne liye Allah Ta'ala ka kalma parh kar yani nikah ke khutba-e-tashahhud se halal karte ho. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko mi'raj wali raat jab behtareen in'amat ata hue, in mein ek yeh bhi tha ke aap se farmaya gaya teri ummat ka koi khutba jaiz nahin jab tak woh is amr ki gawahi na dein ke tu mera banda aur mera rasool hai (Ibn Abi Hatim). Nikah ke ahkamat Sahih Muslim Sharif mein Hazrat Jabir (R.A) se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne Hajjat-ul-Wida ke khutba mein farmaya tum ne aurton ko Allah ki amanat ke tor pe liya hai aur unhein Allah Ta'ala ke kalma se apne liye halal kiya hai. Is ke baad Allah Ta'ala soteli maon ki hurmat bayan farmata hai aur un ki ta'zeem aur tauqeer zahir karta hai yahan tak ke baap ne kisi aurat se sirf nikah kiya abhi woh rukhsat ho kar bhi nahin aayi magar talaq ho gayi ya baap mar gaya waghera toh bhi woh sabab aur bura rasta hai aur jagah farma hai ayat (WALA TAQRA-BUL FAWAHISH MA ZAHARA MINHA WAMA BATAN) (6. Al-An'am: 151) yani kisi burai, behayai aur fahash kaam ke qareeb bhi na jao ya woh bilkul zahir ho khwah posheeda ho aur farman hai ayat (WALA TAQRA-BUZ ZINA INNAHU KANA FAHISHATAN WASA-A SABILA) (17. Al-Isra: 32) zina ke qareeb na jao yaqeenan woh fahash kaam aur buri rah hai. Yahan mazeed farmaya ke yeh kaam bare bughz ka bhi hai yani fi nafsihi bhi bara bura amr hai is se baap bete mein adawat par jati hai aur dushmani qaim ho jati hai, yahi mushahida mein aaya hai aur umooman yeh bhi likha gaya hai ke jo shakhs kisi aurat se doosra nikah karta hai woh is ke pehle khawand se bughz hi rakhta hai. Yahi wajah hai ke An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyan Ummahat-ul-Momineen qarar de di gayin aur ummat par misl maa ke haram ki gayin kyunke woh Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyan hain aur aap misl baap ke hain, balkay ijma'an sabit hai ke aap ke haq baap dada ke huqooq se bhi bohat zyada aur bohat bare hain balkay aap ki mohabbat khud apni janon ki mohabbat par bhi muqaddam hai, salawatullahi wa salamuhu alaih. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh kaam Allah ke bughz ka mojib hai aur bura rasta hai. Ab jo aisa kaam kare woh deen se murtad hai use qatl kar diya jaye aur is ka maal Bait-ul-Maal mein bator-e-fai ke dakhil kar liya jaye. Sunan aur Musnad-e-Ahmad mein marwi hai ke ek sahabi ko Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is shakhs ki taraf bheja jis ne apne baap ki biwi se baap ke baad nikah kiya tha ke use qatl kar dalo aur is ke maal par qabza kar lo. Hazrat Bara bin Azib farmate hain ke mere chacha Haris bin Umair apne hath mein Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka diya hua jhanda le kar mere paas se guzre main ne poocha ke chacha huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aap ko kahan bheja hai?

Farmaya us shakhs ki taraf jis ne apne baap ki biwi se nikah kiya hai mujhe hukm hai ke main us ki gardan maaroon (Musnad-e-Ahmad).

Sauteli maa se nikah haram hai. Masla: Is par toh ulama ka ijma hai ke jis aurat se baap ne mubashirat kar li khwah nikah kar ke, khwah malkiyat mein la kar, khwah shuba se, woh aurat bete par haram hai. Haan agar jima na hua ho toh sirf mubashirat hui ho ya woh aaza dekhe hon jin ka dekhna ajnabi hone ki surat mein halal na tha toh is mein ikhtilaf hai. Imam Ahmad toh is surat mein bhi us aurat ko ladke par haram batate hain.

Hafiz Ibn-e-Asakir ke is waqiye se bhi is riwayat ki tasdeeq hoti hai ke Hazrat Khadij Humsi ne jo Hazrat Muawiya ke maula the, Hazrat Muawiya ke liye ek laundi kharidi jo gore rang ki aur khubsurat thi. Use barahna un ke paas bhej diya. Un ke haath mein ek chhadi thi, us se ishara kar ke kehne lage achha nafa tha agar yeh malboos hoti. Phir kehne lage ise Yazid bin Muawiya ke paas le jao. Phir kaha nahin nahin thahro, Rabia bin Amr Harsi ko mere paas bula lao, yeh bade faqih the. Jab aaye toh Hazrat Muawiya ne un se yeh masla poocha ke main ne is aurat ke yeh aaza-e-makhsoos dekhe hain, yeh barahna thi. Ab main ise apne ladke Yazid ke paas bhejna chahta hoon toh kya us ke liye yeh halal hai? Hazrat Rabia ne farmaya Amir-ul-Momineen aisa na kijiye, yeh us ke qabil nahin rahi. Farmaya tum theek kehte ho, achha jao Abdullah bin Masada Fazari ko bula lao. Woh aaye, woh toh gandum-goon rang ke the. Us se Hazrat Muawiya ne farmaya is laundi ko main tumhein deta hoon taake tumhari aulad safed rang paida ho. Yeh Abdullah bin Masada woh hain jinhein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Fatima ko diya tha, aap ne unhein pala, parwarish kiya, phir Allah Ta'ala ke naam se azaad kar diya, phir yeh Hazrat Muawiya ke paas chale aaye the.

Kaun si auratein mardon par haram hain? Nasabi, raza'i aur sasurali rishte se jo auratein mard par haram hain un ka bayan aayat-e-karima mein ho raha hai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain saat auratein ba-wajah-e-nasab haram hain aur saat ba-wajah-e-sasural ke, phir aap ne is aayat ki tilawat ki jis mein behan ki ladkiyon tak nasabi rishton ka zikr hai. Jamhoor ulama-e-kiram ne is aayat se istidlal kiya hai ke zina se jo ladki paida hui woh bhi us zani par haram hai kyunke yeh bhi beti hai aur betiyan haram hain, yahi mazhab Abu Hanifa, Malik aur Ahmad bin Hanbal (R.H) ka hai, Imam Shafi (R.H) se kuch is ki ibahat mein bhi behas ki gayi hai is liye ke shar'an yeh beti nahin, pas jaise ke virse ke hawaley se yeh beti ke hukm se kharij hai aur virsa nahin pati isi tarah is aayat-e-hurmat mein bhi woh dakhil nahin hai, wallahu a'lam. (Sahih mazhab wahi hai jis par jamhoor hain. - Mutarjim). Phir farmata hai ke jis tarah tum par tumhari saghi maa haram hai isi tarah raza'i maa bhi haram hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke raza'at bhi use haram karti hai jise wiladat haram karti hai. Sahih Muslim mein hai raza'at se bhi woh haram hai jo nasab se hai. Ba'az fuqaha ne is mein se chaar suratein, ba'az ne chhay suratein makhsoos ki hain jo ahkaam ki furoo ki kitabon mein mazkoor hain lekin tahqiqi baat yeh hai ke is mein se kuch bhi makhsoos nahin is liye ke isi ke manind ba'az suratein nasab mein bhi payi jati hain aur un suraton mein se ba'az sirf sasurali rishta ki wajah se haram hain, lehaza hadith par aitraz kharij az behas hai, walhamdulillah.

Aaimma ka is mein bhi ikhtilaf hai ke kitni martaba doodh peene se hurmat-e-sabat hoti hai, baaz toh kehte hain ke tadaad muayyan nahin doodh peete hi hurmat sabit ho gayi Imam Malik yahi farmate hain, Ibn-e-Umar, Saeed bin Musayyab, Urwah bin Zubair aur Zuhri ka qaul bhi yahi hai, daleel yeh hai ke raza'at yahan aam hai. Baaz kehte hain teen martaba jab piye toh hurmat sabit ho gayi, jaise ke Sahih Muslim mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ek martaba ka choosna ya do martaba ka pi lena haram nahin karta, yeh hadith mukhtalif alfaaz se marwi hai, Imam Ahmad, Ishaq bin Rahuyah, Abu Ubaidah, Abu Saur bhi yahi farmate hain, Hazrat Ali (R.A), Hazrat Aishah (R.A), Hazrat Umm-ul-Fazl (R.A), Hazrat Ibn-e-Zubair (R.A), Sulaiman bin Yasar, Saeed bin Jubair (Rahimahumullah) se bhi yahi marwi hai.

Baaz kehte hain paanch martaba ke doodh peene se hurmat sabit hoti hai is se kam nahin, is ki daleel Sahih Muslim ki yeh riwayat hai, Hazrat Aishah Siddiqah (R.A) farmati hain ke pehle Quran mein das martaba ki doodh pilai par hurmat ka hukum utra tha phir woh mansookh ho kar paanch reh gaye, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke faut hone tak woh Quran mein parha jata raha. Dusri daleel Sahla bint-e-Suhail ki riwayat hai ke un ko Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hukum diya ke Hazrat Salim ko jo Hazrat Abu Huzaifah ke maula thay paanch martaba doodh pila dein, Hazrat Aishah (R.A) isi hadith ke mutabiq jis aurat ke ghar kisi ka aana jana dekhtin use yahi hukum detin, Imam Shafi (R.H) aur un ke as-haab ka farman bhi yahi hai ke paanch martaba doodh peena motabar hai (mutarjim ki tehqeeq mein bhi rajeh qaul yahi hai wallahu a'lam).

Yeh bhi yaad rahe ke jamhoor ka mazhab yeh hai ke yeh raza'at doodh chhutne se pehle yani do saal ke andar andar ki umar mein ho, is ka mufassal bayan aayat (haulain-e-kamilain) ki tafsir mein Surah Al-Baqarah mein guzar chuka hai. Phir is mein bhi ikhtilaf hai ke is raza'at ka asar raza'i maa ke khawand tak bhi pahunche ga ya nahin? Toh jamhoor ka aur aaimma-e-arba'a ka farman toh yeh hai ke pahunche ga aur baaz salaf ka qaul hai ke sirf doodh pilane wali tak hi rahe ga aur raza'i baap tak nahin pahunche ga, is ki tafseel ki jagah ahkaam ki bari bari kitabein hain na ke tafsir (sahih qaul jamhoor ka hai wallahu a'lam).

(Mutarjim) Phir farmata hai saas haram hai jis ladki se nikah hua mujarrad nikah hone ke sabab uski maa us par haram ho gayi khwah sohbat kare ya na kare, haan jis aurat ke sath nikah karta hai aur uski ladki uske agle khawand se uske sath hai to agar us se sohbat ki to woh ladki haram hogi agar mujamat se pehle hi us aurat ko talaq de di to woh ladki us par haram nahin, isi liye is aayat mein yeh qaid lagayi. Baaz logon ne zameer ko saas aur uski parwarish ki hui ladkiyon dono ki taraf lautaya hai woh kehte hain ke saas bhi us waqt haram hoti hai jab uski ladki se uske damad ne khalwat ki warna nahin, sirf aqd se na to aurat ki maa haram hoti hai na aurat ki beti. Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain ke jis shakhs ne kisi ladki se nikah kiya phir dukhool se pehle hi talaq de di to woh uski maa se nikah kar sakta hai jaise ke rabiba ladki se uski maa ko isi tarah ki talaq dene ke baad nikah kar sakta hai. Hazrat Zaid bin Sabit (R.A) se bhi yahi manqool hai. Ek aur riwayat mein bhi aap se marwi hai aap farmate thay jab woh aurat ghair madkhoola mar jaye aur yeh khawand uski meeras le le to phir uski maa ko lana makrooh hai haan agar dukhool se pehle talaq de di hai to agar chahe nikah kar sakta hai. Hazrat Abu Bakr bin Kinana (R.H) farmate hain ke mera nikah mere baap ne Taif ki ek aurat se karaya abhi rukhsati nahin hui thi ke uska baap mera chacha faut ho gaya uski biwi yani meri saas bewa ho gayi woh bahut maal-dar thin mere baap ne mujhe mashwara diya ke is ladki ko chhod doon aur uski maa se nikah kar loon main ne Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se yeh masla poocha to aap ne farmaya tumhare liye yeh jaiz hai phir main ne Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se poocha to unhon ne farmaya yeh jaiz nahin main ne apne walid se zikr kiya unhon ne to Ameer Muawiya (R.A) ko hi sawal kiya. Hazrat Ameer Muawiya (R.A) ne tahreer farmaya ke main na to haram ko halal karoon na halal ko haram tum jaano aur tumhara kaam tum halat dekh rahe ho mamla ke tamam pehlu tumhari nigahon ke samne hain. Auratein is ke alawa bhi bahut hain.

Garaz na ijazat di na inkar kiya chunancha mere baap ne apna khayal us ki maa ki taraf se hata liya. Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair R.A farmate hain ke aurat ki ladki aur aurat ki maa ka hukum ek hi hai agar aurat se dukhol na kiya ho to yeh dono halal hain, lekin is ki asnad mein mubham rawi hai, Hazrat Mujahid R.H ka bhi yahi qaul hai, Ibn Jubair aur Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A bhi isi taraf gaye hain, Hazrat Muawiyah R.A ne is mein tawaqquf farmaya hai. Shafiyon mein se Abu-l-Hasan Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Sabuni se bhi ba-qaul-e-Rafai yahi marwi hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood R.A se bhi isi ke misl marwi hai lekin phir aap ne apne is qaul se ruju kar liya hai. Tabrani mein hai ke qabila Fazara ki shakh qabila Banu Kamkh ke ek shakhs ne ek aurat se nikah kiya phir us ki bewa maa ke husn par farefta hua to Hazrat Ibn Masood R.A se masala poocha ke kya mujhe us ki maa se nikah karna jaiz hai? Aap ne farmaya haan, chunancha us ne us ladki ko talaq de kar us ki maa se nikah kar liya, us se aulad bhi hui. Phir Hazrat Ibn Masood R.A Madina aaye aur is masala ki tehqeeq ki to maloom hua ke yeh halal nahin, chunancha aap wapas Koofe gaye aur us se kaha ke is aurat ko alag kar de yeh tujh par haram hai, us ne is farman ki tameel ki aur use alag kar diya. Jamhoor-e-Ulama is taraf hain, ladki to sirf aqd-e-nikah se haram nahin hoti ta-waqt-e-ke us ki maa se mubashirat na ki ho, haan maa sirf ladki ke aqd-e-nikah hote hi haram ho jati hai go mubashirat na hui ho. Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain ke jab koi shakhs apni biwi ko dukhol se pehle talaq de de ya woh aurat mar jaye to us ki maa us par halal nahin, chunke mubham hai is liye use na-pasand farmaya. Hazrat Ibn Masood, Imran bin Husain, Masrooq, Taoos, Ikrama, Ata, Hasan, Makhool, Ibn Sirin, Qatada aur Zuhri R.H se bhi isi tarah marwi hai, charon imamon, saton fuqaha aur jamhoor-e-ulama-e-salaf-o-khalaf ka yahi mazhab hai, Walhamdulillah. Imam Ibn Juraij R.H farmate hain theek qaul inhi hazrat ka hai jo saas ko dono suraton mein haram batlate hain is liye ke Allah Ta'ala ne un ki hurmat ke sath dukhol ki shart nahin lagayi jaise ke ladki ki maa ke liye yeh shart lagayi hai, phir is par ijma hai jo aisi daleel hai ke is ka khilaf karna us waqt jaiz hi nahin jab ke is par ittefaq ho aur ek ghareeb hadith mein bhi yeh marwi hai go is ki sanad mein kalam hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya jabke koi mard kisi aurat se nikah kare agar us ne us ki maa se nikah kiya hai phir milne se pehle hi use talaq de di hai to agar chahe us ki ladki se nikah kar sakta hai, go is hadith ki sanad kamzor hai lekin is masala par ijma ho chuka hai jo is ki sehat par aisa gawah hai jis ke baad dusri gawahi ki zaroorat nahin, theek masala yahi hai wallahu a'alam.

(Mutarjim) Phir farmata hai tumhari parwarish ki hui woh ladkiyan jo tumhari god mein hon woh bhi tum par haram hain bashart-e-ke tum ne un soteli ladkiyon ki maa se sohbat ki ho. Jamhoor ka farman hai ke khwah god mein pali hon haram hain. Chunke umooman aisi ladkiyan apni maa ke sath hi hoti hain aur apne sotile baapon ke yahan hi parwarish pati hain is liye yeh keh diya gaya hai, yeh koi qaid nahin jaise is aayat mein hai aayat (Wala tukrihu fatayatikum alal-bughai in aradna tahassuna) yani tumhari londiyan agar pakdaman rehna chahti hon to tum unhein badkari par bebas na karo, yahan bhi yeh qaid ke agar woh pakdaman rehna chahein sirf ba-aitibar-e-waqia ke ghalba ke hai, yeh nahin ke agar woh khud aisi na hon to unhein badkari par aamada karo, isi tarah is aayat mein hai ke god mein chahe na hon phir bhi haram hi hain. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Hazrat Umm-e-Habiba R.A ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) aap meri behan Abu Sufyan ki ladki Izza se nikah kar lijiye. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya kya tum yeh chahti ho? Umm-ul-Momineen R.A ne kaha haan, main aap ko khali to rakh nahin sakti phir main is bhalai mein apni behan ko hi kyun na shamil karoon? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya un ki woh beti jo Umm-e-Salama R.A se hai? Kaha haan. Farmaya awwalan to woh mujh par is wajah se haram hai ke woh meri rabiba hai jo mere yahan parwarish pa rahi hai, dusri yeh ke agar aisa na hota to bhi woh mujh par haram thin is liye ke woh mere doodh sharik bhai ki beti meri bhatiji hain. Mujhe aur us ke baap Abu Salama R.A ko Thauiba ne doodh pilaya hai. Khabardar apni betiyan aur apni behanein mujh par pesh na karo. Bukhari ki riwayat mein yeh alfaaz hain ke agar mera nikah Umm-e-Salama R.A se na hua hota to bhi woh mujh par halal na thin, yani sirf nikah ko aap (ﷺ) ne hurmat ka asal qarar diya. Yehi mazhab charon imamon, saton faqihon aur jamhoor-e-salaf-o-khalaf ka hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke agar woh us ke yahan parwarish pati ho to bhi haram hai warna nahin. Hazrat Malik bin Aus bin Hadthan R.H farmate hain meri biwi aulad chhor kar mar gayin, mujhe un se bahut mohabbat thi is wajah se un ki maut ka mujhe bada sadma hua. Hazrat Ali R.A se meri ittefaqiya mulaqat hui to aap ne mujhe maghmoom pa kar daryaft kiya ke kya baat hai? Main ne waqia sunaya to aap ne farmaya tujh se pehle khawand se bhi us ki koi aulad hai? Main ne kaha haan ek ladki hai aur woh Taif mein rehti hai. Farmaya phir us se nikah kar lo. Main ne Quran-e-Kareem ki aayat padhi ke phir us ka kya matlab hoga? Aap ne farmaya yeh to us waqt hai jabke us ne tere yahan parwarish payi ho aur woh ba-qaul tumhare Taif mein rehti hai, tere paas hai hi nahin. Go is ki asnad sahih hai lekin yeh qaul bilkul ghareeb hai. Hazrat Imam Malik R.H ka bhi yehi qaul bataya hai, Ibn-e-Hazm R.H ne bhi isi ko ikhtiyar kiya hai. Hamare Sheikh Hafiz Abu Abdullah Nasbi R.H ne hum se kaha ke main ne yeh baat Sheikh Imam Taqi-ud-Din Ibn-e-Taimiyah R.H ke samne pesh ki to aap ne ise bahut mushkil mehsoos kiya aur tawaqquf farmaya, Wallahu A'lam.

Hujoor se murad ghar hai jaise ke Hazrat Abu Ubaidah R.A se marvi hai ke haan jo kaneez malkiyat mein ho aur us ke sath us ki ladki ho us ke bare mein Hazrat Umar R.A se sawal hua ke ek ke baad dusri jaiz hogi ya nahin? To aap ne farmaya ise pasand nahin karta, is ki sanad munqata hai, Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A ne aise hi sawal ke jawab mein farmaya hai ek aayat se yeh halal maloom hoti hai dusri aayat se haram is liye main to aisa hargiz na karoon, Sheikh Abu Umar bin Abdullah R.H farmate hain ke ulama mein is masla mein koi ikhtilaf nahin ke kisi ko halal nahin ke kisi aurat se phir us ki ladki se bhi isi malkiyat ki bina par wati kare is liye ke Allah Ta'ala ne ise nikah mein bhi haram qarar de diya hai yeh aayat mulahiza ho aur ulama ke nazdeek malkiyat ahkam-e-nikah ke tabe hai magar jo riwayat Hazrat Umar R.A aur Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se ki jati hai lekin aimma-e-fatawa aur un ke tabieen mein se koi bhi is par muttafiq nahin. Hazrat Qatadah R.H farmate hain rabibah ki ladki aur us ladki ki ladki is tarah jis qadar neeche yeh rishta chala jaye sab haram hain, Hazrat Abu Aliyah R.H se bhi isi tarah yeh riwayat Qatadah marvi hai aayat (Dakhaltum bihinna) se murad Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A to farmate hain un se nikah karna hai Hazrat Ata R.H farmate hain ke woh rukhsat kar diye jayen kapda hata diya jaye chhed ho jaye aur irade se mard baith jaye Ibn Juraij R.H ne sawal kiya ke agar yeh kaam aurat hi ke ghar mein hua ho farmaya wahan yahan dono ka hukum ek hi hai aisa agar ho gaya to us ki ladki us par haram ho gayi. Imam Ibn Jarir R.H farmate hain ke sirf khalwat aur tanhai ho jane se us ki ladki ki hurmat sabit nahin hoti agar mubashirat karne aur hath lagane se aur shahwat se us ke uzu ki taraf dekhne se pehle hi talaq de di hai to tamam ke ijma se yeh baat sabit hoti hai ke ladki us par haram na hogi ta-waqte-ke jima na hua ho. Phir farmaya tumhari bahuyen bhi tum par haram hain jo tumhari aulad ki biwiyan hon yani le-palak ladkon ki biwiyan haram nahin, haan sagay ladke ki biwi yani bahu apne kasar par haram hai jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Falamma qada Zaidun minha wataran zawwajnakaha likaila yakuna 'alal-mu'mineena harajun fi azwaji ad'iya'ihim al-aayah), yani jab Zaid R.A ne us se apni hajat puri kar li to hum ne use tere nikah mein de diya taake mominon par un ke le-palak ladkon ki biwiyon ke bare mein koi tangi na rahe, Hazrat Ata R.H farmate hain ke hum suna karte the ke jab Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ne Hazrat Zaid R.A ki biwi se nikah kar liya to Makkah ke mushrikon ne kain-kain shuru kar di is par yeh aayat aur aayat (Wa ma ja'ala ad'iya'akum abna'akum) (Surah Al-Ahzab: 4) aur aayat (Ma kana Muhammadun aba ahadin min rijalikum wa lakin Rasulallahi wa khataman-nabiyyin, wa kanallahu bikulli shai'in 'alima) (Surah Al-Ahzab: 40) nazil huin yani beshak salbi ladke ki biwi haram hai.

Tumhare liye palak ladke shar'an tumhari aulad ke hukm mein nahin, Anhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mein se kisi mard ke baap nahin. Hasan bin Muhammad (R.H) farmate hain ke yeh ayatein mubham hain jaise tumhare ladkon ki biwiyan tumhari sasen, Hazrat Ta'oos, Ibrahim, Zuhri aur Makhool (R.H) se bhi isi tarah marwi hai. Mere khayal mein mubham se murad aam hain, yani madkhool biha aur ghair madkhool dono hi shamil hain aur sirf nikah karte hi hurmat sabit ho jati hai, khwah sohbat hui ho ya na hui ho. Is masle par ittefaq hai. Agar koi shakhs sawal kare ke raza'i bete ki hurmat kaise sabit hogi kyunke aayat mein to sulbi bete ka zikr hai, to jawab yeh hai ke woh hurmat Anhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki is hadith se sabit hai ke aap ne farmaya: "Raza'at se woh haram hai jo nisbat se haram hai." Jamhoor ka mazhab yahi hai ke raza'i bete ki biwi bhi haram hai, baaz logon ne to is par ijma naqal kiya hai.

Phir farmata hai do behnon ka nikah mein jama karna bhi tum par haram hai, isi tarah malkiyat ki londiyon ka hukm hai ke do behnon se ek hi waqt wati haram hai, magar jahiliyat ke zamane mein jo ho chuka us se hum darguzar karte hain, pas maloom hua ke ab yeh kaam aayinda kisi waqt jaiz nahin, jaise aur jagah hai aayat: (La yazuqoona feeha al-mawta illal mawtatal oola, wa waqahum azabal jaheem) (44. Ad-Dukhan: 56), yani wahan maut nahin aayegi, haan pehli maut jo aani thi so aa chuki, to maloom hua ke ab aayinda kabhi maut nahin aayegi. Sahaba, Tabi'een, A'imma aur Salaf-o-Khalaf ke ulama-e-kiram ka ijma hai ke do behnon se ek sath nikah karna haram hai aur jo shakhs musalman ho aur uske nikah mein do behnen hon to use ikhtiyar diya jayega ke ek ko rakh le aur dusri ko talaq de de aur yeh use karna hi padega. Hazrat Feroz (R.A) farmate hain: Main jab musalman hua to mere nikah mein do auratein thin jo aapas mein behnen thin, pas Anhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujhe hukm diya ke in mein se ek ko talaq de do (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ibn-e-Majah, Abu Dawood aur Tirmidhi mein bhi yeh hadith hai. Tirmidhi mein bhi yeh hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "In mein se jise chaho ek ko rakh lo aur ek ko talaq de do." Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan kehte hain. Ibn-e-Majah mein Abu Khirash ka aisa waqiya bhi mazkoor hai, mumkin hai ke Zahhak bin Feroz ki kuniyat Abu Khirash ho aur yeh waqiya ek hi ho aur iske khilaf bhi mumkin hai. Hazrat Dailami (R.A) ne Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se arz kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Mere nikah mein do behnen hain, aap ne farmaya: "In mein se jise chaho ek ko talaq de do" (Ibn-e-Marduyah). Pas Dailami se murad Zahhak bin Feroz hain (R.A), yeh Yaman ke un sardaron mein se the jinhon ne Aswad Ansi mutanabbi mal'oon ko qatl kiya. Chunancha do londiyon ko jo aapas mein saggi behnen hon ek sath jama karna, un se wati karna bhi haram hai, iski daleel is aayat ka umoom hai jo biwiyon aur londiyon par mushtamil hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) se iska sawal hua to aap ne makrooh bataya, sail ne kaha Quran mein jo hai aayat (Illa ma malakat aymanukum) (4. An-Nisa: 24).

(An-Nisa: 24) Ya'ni woh jo jin ke tumhare dayein haath maalik hain. Is par Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood (R.A) ne farmaya tera oont bhi toh tere daahne haath ki malkiyat mein hai. Jamhoor ka qaul bhi yahi mashhoor hai aur A'imma-e-Arba'a waghera bhi yahi farmate hain, go ba'az salaf ne is mas'ala mein tawaqquf farmaya hai. Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) se jab yeh mas'ala poocha gaya toh aap ne farmaya ek aayat isay halal karti hai, doosri haram, mein toh is se mana karta hoon. Sail wahan se nikla toh raaste mein ek sahabi se mulaqat hui, us ne un se bhi yahi sawal kiya. Unhon ne farmaya agar mujhe kuch ikhtiyar hota toh mein aisa karne wale ko ibrat-naak saza deta. Hazrat Imam Malik (R.H) farmate hain mera gumaan hai ke yeh farmane wale ghaliban Ali (R.A) ka naam is liye nahin liya ke woh Abdul Malik bin Marwan ka musahib tha aur un logon par aap ka naam bhaari padta tha. Hazrat Ilyas bin Aamir kehte hain mein ne Hazrat Ali bin Abi Talib (R.A) se sawal kiya ke meri malkiyat mein do laundiyan hain, dono aapas mein saggi behnein hain, ek se mein ne ta'alluqat qaim kar rakhe hain aur mere haan us se aulad bhi hui hai, ab mera jee chahta hai ke us ki behan se jo meri laundi hai apne ta'alluqat qaim karoon toh farmaiye shariyat ka is mein kya hukm hai? Aap ne farmaya pehli laundi ko azaad kar ke phir us ki behan se yeh ta'alluqat qaim kar sakte ho. Us ne kaha aur log toh kehte hain ke mein us ka nikah kara doon phir us ki behan se mil sakta hoon. Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne farmaya dekho is soorat mein bhi kharabi hai, woh yeh ke agar us ka khawand usay talaq de de ya inteqal kar jaye toh woh phir laut kar tumhari taraf aa jaye gi, isay toh azaad kar dene mein hi salamti hai. Phir aap ne mera haath pakad kar farmaya suno azaad aurton aur laundiyon ke ahkaam-e-hillat-o-hurmat ke lihaz se yaksan hain, haan albatta tadaad mein farq hai, ya'ni azaad aurtein chaar se zyada jama nahin kar sakte aur laundiyon mein koi tadaad ki qaid nahin aur doodh pilayi ke rishta se bhi is rishta ki woh tamam aurtein haram ho jati hain jo nasl aur nasab ki wajah se haram hain. (Is ke baad Tafsir Ibn-e-Kathir ke asal Arabi nuskhe mein kuch ibarat chhooti hui hai, ba-zahir aisa maloom hota hai ke woh ibarat yun hogi ke yeh riwayat aisi hai ke agar koi shakhs mashriq se ya maghrib se sirf is riwayat ko sunne ke liye safar kar ke aaye aur sun ke jaye toh bhi is ka safar is ke liye sood-mand rahe ga aur us ne goya bahut saste daamon besh-baha cheez hasil ki. Wallahu A'lam).

(Mutarjim) Yeh yaad rahe ke Hazrat Ali R.A se bhi isi tarah marwi hai jis tarah Hazrat Usman R.A se marwi hai. Chunancha Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai ke aap ne farmaya do laundiyon ko jo aapas mein behnein hon ek hi waqt jama kar ke un se mubashirat karna ek aayat se haram hota hai aur dusri se halal. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain laundiyan mujh par meri qarabat ki wajah se jo un se hai baaz aur laundiyon ko haram kar deti hain lekin unhein khud aapas mein jo qarabat ho us se mujh par haram nahin hotin. Jahiliyat wale bhi un aurton ko haram samajhte thay jinhein tum haram samajhte ho magar apne baap ki biwi ko jo un ki saghi maa na ho aur do behnon ko ek saath ek waqt mein nikah mein jama karna woh haram nahin samajhte thay lekin Islam ne aa kar un dono ko bhi haram qarar diya. Is wajah se un dono ki hurmat ke bayan ke saath hi farma diya ke jo nikah ho chuke woh ho chuke. Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ud R.A farmate hain ke jo azaad aurtein haram hain wahi laundiyan bhi haram hain, haan tadaad mein hukm ek nahin yani azaad aurtein chaar se zyada jama nahin kar sakte, laundiyon ke liye yeh had nahin. Hazrat Sha'bi R.H bhi yahi farmate hain. Abu Amr farmate hain Hazrat Usman R.A ne is baare mein jo farmaya hai wahi salaf ki ek jamaat bhi kehti hai jin mein se Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A bhi hain lekin awwalan to is ki naqal mein khud unhi hazraat se bahut kuch ikhtilaf hua hai, dusre yeh ke is qaul ki taraf samajhdar pukhta kaar ulama-e-kiram ne mutlaqan tawajjuh nahin farmayi aur na ise qubool kiya. Hijaz, Iraq, Shaam balkay mashriq-o-maghrib ke tamam fuqaha is ke khilaf hain siwaye un chand ke jinhon ne alfaaz ko dekh, soch samajh aur gaur-o-khauz kiye baghair un se alaidgi ikhtiyar ki hai aur is ijma ki mukhalifat ki hai. Kaamil ilm walon aur sachi samajh boojh walon ka to ittefaq hai ke do behnon ko jis tarah nikah mein jama nahin kar sakte do laundiyon ko bhi jo aapas mein behnein hon ba-wajah-e-malkiyat ke ek saath nikah mein nahin la sakte. Isi tarah musalmanon ka ijma hai ke is aayat mein maa, beti, behn waghera haram ki gayi hain, un se jis tarah nikah haram hai isi tarah agar yeh laundiyan ban kar ma-tahti mein hon to bhi jinsi ikhtilat haram hai. Garz nikah aur malkiyat ke baad ki dono halaton mein yeh sab ki sab barabar hain, na un se nikah kar ke mel-jol halal na malkiyat ke baad mel-jol halal. Isi tarah theek yahi hukm hai ke do behnon ke jama karne, saas aur dusre khawand se apni aurat ki ladki ho us ke baare mein khud un ke jamhoor ka bhi yahi mazhab hai aur yahi daleel un chand mukhalifeen par poori sanad aur kaamil hujjat hai. Al-garz do behnon ko ek waqt nikah mein rakhna bhi haram aur do behnon ko bator-e-laundi keh kar un se milna julna bhi haram.

Maidan-e-jang se qabze mein aane wali auratein aur... mut'a yani khawandon wali auratein bhi haram hain, haan kuffar auratein jo maidan-e-jang mein qaid ho kar tumhare qabze mein aayen toh ek haiz guzarne ke baad woh tum par halal hain, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri (R.A) se riwayat hai ke jang-e-Autas mein qaid ho kar aisi auratein aayen jo khawandon waliyan thin toh hum ne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se un ki babat sawal kiya tab yeh aayat utri hum par un se milna halal kiya gaya, Tirmidhi, Ibn-e-Majah aur Sahih Muslim waghera mein bhi yeh hadith hai, Tabrani ki riwayat mein hai ke yeh waqia jang-e-Khaibar ka hai, Salaf ki ek jamaat is aayat ke umoom se istidlal kar ke farmati hai ke laundi ko bech dalna hi us ke khawand ki taraf se use talaq-e-kamil ke mutaradif hai, Ibrahim se jab yeh masla poocha gaya toh Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) ne farmaya jab koi khawand wali laundi bechi jaye toh us ke jism ka zyada haqdar us ka malik hai, Hazrat Ubay bin Ka'ab, Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ka bhi yahi fatwa hai ke us ka bikna hi us ki talaq hai, Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke laundi ki talaqein chhay hain, bechna bhi talaq hai, azaad karna bhi, hiba karna bhi, barat karna bhi aur us ke khawand ka talaq dena bhi (yeh paanch suratein toh bayan huin chhati surat na Tafsir Ibn-e-Kathir mein hai na Ibn-e-Jarir mein. Mutarjim) Hazrat Ibn-e-Musayyab farmate hain ke khawand wali auraton se nikah haram hai lekin laundiyan un ki talaq un ka bik jana hai, Hazrat Muammar aur Hazrat Hasan bhi yahi farmate hain in buzurgon ka toh yeh qaul hai lekin jumhoor in ke mukhalif hain woh farmate hain ke bechna talaq nahin is liye ke kharidar bechne wale ka naib hai aur bechne wala is nafa ko apni malkiyat se nikal kar bech raha hai, un ki daleel Hazrat Bareera wali hadith hai jo Bukhari-o-Muslim waghera mein hai ke Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ne jab unhein khareed kar azaad kar diya toh un ka nikah Mughees se faskh nahin hua balki Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein faskh karne aur baqi rakhne ka ikhtiyar diya aur Hazrat Bareera ne faskh karne ko pasand kiya yeh waqia mashhoor hai, pas agar bik jana hi talaq hota jaise in buzurgon ka qaul hai toh Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hazrat Bareera ko un ke bik jane ke baad apne nikah ke baqi rakhne na rakhne ka ikhtiyar na dete, ikhtiyar dena nikah ke baqi rehne ki daleel hai, toh aayat mein murad sirf woh auratein hain jo jihad mein qabze mein aayen wallahu a'alam. Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke muhsanat se murad pak daman auratein hain yani afifa auratein jo tum par haram hain jab tak ke tum nikah aur gawah aur mehar aur wali se un ki ismat ke malik na ban jao khwah ek ho khwah do khwah teen khwah char, Abu Al-Aliyah aur Taoos yahi matlab bayan farmate hain. Umar aur Ubaid farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke char se zaid auratein tum par haram hain haan kaneezon mein yeh ginti nahin.

Phir farmaya ke yeh hurmat Allah Ta'ala ne tum par likh di hai yani chaar ki pas tum is ki kitab ko lazim pakro aur is ki had se aage na barho, is ki shariat aur is ke faraiz ke paband raho, yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke haram auratein Allah Ta'ala ne apni kitab mein zahir kar dein. Phir farmata hai ke jin auraton ka haram hona bayan kar diya gaya un ke ilawa aur sab halal hain, ek matlab yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke in chaar se kam tum par halal hain, lekin yeh qaul door ka qaul hai aur sahih matlab pehla hi hai aur yahi Hazrat Ata ka qaul hai, Hazrat Qatada is ka yeh matlab bayan karte hain ke is se murad laundiyan hain, yahi aayat un logon ki daleel hai jo do behnon ke jama karne ki hillat ke qail hain aur un ki bhi jo kehte hain ke ek aayat isay halal karti hai aur dusri haram. Phir farmaya tum in halal auraton ko apne maal se hasil karo chaar tak to azaad auratein aur laundiyan baghair ta'ayyun ke lekin ho ba-tareeq-e-shar'a. Isi liye farmaya zina-kari se bachne ke liye aur sirf shahwat-rani maqsood nahin hona chahiye. Phir farmaya ke jin auraton se tum faida uthao un ke is faida ke muqabla mein mehar de diya karo, jaise aur aayat mein hai Wa kaifa ta'khuzunahu wa qad afza ba'zukum ila ba'z (4:21) yani tum mehar ko auraton se kaise lo ge halankeh ek dusre se mil chuke ho aur farmaya Wa aatun-nisaa saduqatihinna nihlatan (4:4) auraton ke mehar bakhushi de diya karo aur jagah farmaya Wa la yahillu lakum an ta'khuzu mimma ataitumuhunna shai'an (2:229) al-aayat, tum ne jo kuch auraton ko de diya ho is mein se wapas lena tum par haram hai, is aayat se nikah-e-mut'a par istidlal kiya hai beshak mut'a ibtida-e-Islam mein mashroo tha lekin phir mansookh ho gaya, Imam Shafi aur ulama-e-kiram ki ek jamaat ne farmaya hai ke do martaba mut'a mubah hua phir mansookh hua. Ba'z kehte hain is se bhi zyada baar mubah aur mansookh hua, aur ba'z ka qaul hai ke sirf ek baar mubah hua phir mansookh ho gaya phir mubah nahin hua.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A aur chand deegar Sahaba R.A se zaroorat ke waqt is ki ibahat marwi hai, Hazrat Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal R.H se bhi ek riwayat aisi hi marwi hai. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A, Ubayy bin Ka'ab R.A, Saeed bin Jubair R.H aur Suddi R.H se 'minhun' ke baad 'ila ajalin musamma' ki qirat marwi hai. Mujahid R.H farmate hain yeh aayat nikah-e-mut'ah ki babat nazil hui hai, lekin jumhoor is ke barkhilaf hain aur is ka behtareen faisla Bukhari-o-Muslim ki Hazrat Ali R.A wali riwayat kar deti hai jis mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne Khaibar wale din nikah-e-mut'ah se aur gharelu gadhon ke gosht se mana farma diya. Is hadith ke alfaaz kutub-e-ahkam mein muqarrar hain. Sahih Muslim Shareef mein Hazrat Sabra bin Ma'bad Juhani R.A se marwi hai ke Fatah-e-Makkah ke ghazwa mein woh Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ke sath thay, Aap ﷺ ne irshad farmaya: "Ae logo! Main ne tumhein aurton se mut'ah karne ki rukhsat di thi, yaad rakho beshak ab Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne ise Qayamat tak ke liye haram kar diya hai, jis ke paas is qisam ki koi aurat ho to use chahiye ke use chhod de aur tum ne jo kuch unhein de rakha ho us mein se un se kuch na lo." Sahih Muslim Shareef ki ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Aap ﷺ ne Hajjat-ul-Wida mein yeh farmaya tha. Yeh hadith kayi alfaaz se marwi hai, jin ki tafseel ki jagah ahkam ki kitabein hain. Phir farmaya ke taqarrur ke baad bhi agar tum ba-razamandi kuch tay kar lo to koi haraj nahin. Agle jumle ko mut'ah par mahmool karne wale to is ka yeh matlab bayan karte hain ke jab muddat-e-muqarrara guzar jaye phir muddat ko badha lene aur jo diya ho us ke ilawa aur kuch dene mein koi gunah nahin. Suddi R.H kehte hain agar chahe to pehle ke muqarrar mehar ke baad jo de chuka hai waqt ke khatam hone se peshtar phir keh de ke main itni itni muddat ke liye phir mut'ah karta hoon, pas agar us ne reham ki pakeezgi se pehle din badha liye to jab muddat poori ho jaye to phir is ka koi dabao nahin, woh aurat alag ho jaye gi aur haiz tak thehar kar apne reham ki safai kar le gi, in dono mein meeras nahin, na yeh aurat is mard ki waris, na yeh mard is aurat ka. Aur jin hazrat ne is jumla ko nikah-e-masnoon ke mehar ke musdaq kaha hai un ke nazdeek to matlab saaf hai ke is mehar ki adaigi takeedan bayan ho rahi hai, jaise farmaya mehar ba-aasani aur ba-khushi de diya karo. Agar mehar ke muqarrar ho jane ke baad aurat apne poore haq ko ya thode se haq ko chhod de, saaf kar de, us se dast-bardar ho jaye to miyan-biwi mein se kisi par koi gunah nahin. Hazrat Hazrami R.H farmate hain ke log iqrar dete hain phir mumkin hai ke tangi ho jaye to agar aurat apna haq chhod de to jaiz hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H bhi isi qaul ko pasand karte hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain murad yeh hai ke mehar ki raqam poori poori us ke hawale kar de phir use basne aur alag hone ka poora poora ikhtiyar de. Phir irshad hota hai ke Allah Aleem-o-Hakeem hai, un ke ahkam mein jo hillat-o-hurmat ke mutaliq hain, jo rahmaten hain aur jo maslahatein hain unhein wohi bakhoobi jaanta hai.

Azad aurton se nikah aur kaneezon se mutaliq hidayaat irshad hota hai ke jise azad musalman aurton se nikah karne ki wus'at qudrat na ho, Rabee'a farmate hain tool se murad qasd-o-khwahish yani londi se nikah ki khwahish, Ibn-e-Jareer ne is qaul ko warid karke phir ise khud hi tod diya hai, matlab yeh ke aise halaat mein musalmanon ki malkiyat mein jo londiyan hain un se woh nikah karlein, tamam kamon ki haqeeqat Allah Ta'ala par wazeh hai, tum haqaiq ko sirf sathi nigah se dekhte ho, tum sab azad aur ghulam imani rishte mein ek ho, londi ka wali uska sardar hai uski ijazat ke baghair uska nikah mun'aqid nahin hosakta, isi tarah ghulam bhi apne sardar ki razamandi hasil kiye baghair apna nikah nahin karsakta. Hadees mein hai jo ghulam baghair apne aqa ki ijazat ke apna nikah karle woh zani hai, haan agar kisi londi ki malika koi aurat ho to uski ijazat se us londi ka nikah woh karaye jo aurat ka nikah karasakta hai, kyunke hadees mein hai aurat aurat ka nikah na karaye na aurat apna nikah karaye, woh auratein zina-kar hain jo apna nikah aap karti hain.

Phir farmaya aurton ke mehar khush-dili se de diya karo, ghata kar kam karke takleef pahuncha kar londi samajh kar kami karke na do, phir farmata hai ke dekh liya karo yeh auratein badkari ki taraf az-khud mail na hon, na aisi hon agar koi un ki taraf mail ho to yeh jhuk jayen, yani na to alaniya zina-kar hon na khufiya bad-kirdar hon ke idhar udhar aashnaiyan karti phiren aur chup-chap dost aashna banati phiren, jo aisi bad-atwar hon un se nikah karne ko Allah Ta'ala mana farma raha hai. Ihsan ki dusri qira'at ahsan bhi hai, kaha gaya hai ke dono ka ma'ani ek hi hai, yahan ihsan se murad Islam hai ya nikah wali ho jana hai, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki ek marfoo hadith mein hai ke un ka ihsan Islam aur iffat hai lekin yeh hadith munkar hai is mein za'f bhi hai aur ek rawi ka naam nahin, aisi hadith hujjat ke laiq nahin hoti, dusra qaul yani ihsan se murad nikah hai Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas, Mujahid, Ikrama, Ta'oos, Saeed bin Jubair, Hasan, Qatada waghera ka yahi qaul hai, Imam Shafi'i (R.H) se bhi Abu Ali Tabri ne apni kitab Eizah mein yahi naqal kiya hai, Mujahid farmate hain londi ka muhsan hona yeh hai ke woh kisi azad ke nikah mein chali jaye, isi tarah ghulam ka ihsan yeh hai ke woh kisi azad muslima se nikah karle, Ibn-e-Abbas se bhi yeh manqool hai, Sha'bi aur Nakh'i bhi yahi kehte hain, yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke un dono qira'aton ke aitbar se ma'ani bhi badal jate hain, ihsan se murad to nikah hai aur ahsan se murad Islam hai, Imam Ibn-e-Jarir isi ko pasand farmate hain, lekin bazahir murad yahan nikah karna hai wallahu a'lam, isi liye ke siyaq-e-ayat ki dalalat isi par hai, iman ka zikr to lafzon mein majood hai. Bahar-do surat jumhoor ke mazhab ke mutabiq ayat ke ma'ani mein bhi ishkal baqi hai is liye ke jumhoor ka qaul hai ke londi ko zina ki wajah se pachaas koday lagaye jayenge khwah woh muslima ho ya kafira ho shadi-shuda ya ghair shadi-shuda ho bawajood yeh ke ayat ke mafhoom ka taqaza yeh hai ke ghair muhsana londi par had hi na ho, pas is ke mukhtalif jawabat diye gaye hain, jumhoor ka qaul hai ke beshak "jo bola gaya" mafhoom par muqaddam hai is liye hum ne un aam ahadith ko jin mein londiyon ko had maarne ka bayan hai is ayat ke mafhoom par muqaddam kiya, Sahih Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne apne khutbay mein farmaya logo apni londiyon par hadein qaim rakho khwah woh muhsana hon ya na hon Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujhe apni londi ke zina par had maarne ko farmaya chunke woh nifas mein thi is liye mujhe dar laga ke kahin had ke koday lagne se yeh mar na jaye chunancha main ne us waqt use had na lagayi aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein waqia bayan kiya to aap ne farmaya tum ne achha kiya jab tak woh theek-thak na ho jaye had na marna, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke aap ne farmaya jab yeh nifas se farigh ho to use pachaas koday lagana.

Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain main ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna farmate thay jab tum mein se kisi ki laundi zina kare aur zina zahir ho jaye to use woh had mare aur bura bhala na kahe phir agar dobara zina kare to bhi had lagaye aur daant jhirak na kare, phir agar teesri martaba zina kare aur zahir ho to use bech dale agarche ek rassi ke tukde ke badle hi ho, aur Sahih Muslim mein hai ke jab teen baar yeh fe'l us se sarzad ho to chauthi dafa farokht kar dale, Abdullah bin Ayyash bin Abu Rabia Fahrumi farmate hain ke hum chand Quraish naujawanon ko Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ne amarat ki laundiyon se kayi ek par had jaari karne ko farmaya hum ne unhein zina ki had mein pachaas pachaas kode lagaye. Dusra jawab un ka hai jo is baat ki taraf gaye hain ke laundi par ihsan baghair had nahin woh farmate hain ke yeh marna sirf bator-e-adab sikhane aur baaz rakhne ke hai, Ibn Abbas (R.A) isi taraf gaye hain, Ta'oos, Saeed, Abu Ubaid, Dawood Zahiri ka mazhab bhi yahi hai un ki badi daleel mafhoom-e-ayat hai aur yeh shart hai mafhoom-on mein se hai aur aksar ke nazdeek yeh mehez hujjat hai is liye un ke nazdeek ek umoom par muqaddam ho sakta hai aur Abu Huraira (R.A) aur Zaid bin Khalid (R.A) ki hadith jis mein hai ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha gaya ke jab laundi zina kare aur woh muhsana na ho yani us ka nikah na hua ho to kya jaye? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar woh zina kare to use had lagao phir zina kare to phir kode lagao phir bech dalo go ek rassi ke tukde ke qeemat par hi kyun na bechna pade, rawi-e-hadith Ibn Shahab farmate hain nahin janta ke teesri martaba ke baad yeh farmaya ya chauthi martaba ke baad. Pas is hadith ke mutabiq woh jawab dete hain ke dekho yahan ki had ki miqdar aur kodon ki tadaad bayan nahin farmayi jaise ke muhsana ke bare mein saaf farma diya hai aur jaise ke Quran mein muqarrar tor par farmaya gaya ke muhsanat ki nisbat nisf had un par hai, pas ayat-o-hadith mein is tarah tatbeeq dena wajib ho gayi wallahu a'lam.

Is se bhi zyada sarahat wali woh riwayat hai jo Saeed bin Mansoor ne barwayat Ibn Abbas naqal ki hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya kisi laundi par hadd nahin jab tak ke woh ihsan wali na ho jaye yani jab tak nikah wali na ho jaye pas jab khawand wali ban jaye to us par aadhi hadd hai ba-nisbat us hadd ke jo azad nikah waliyon par hai, yeh hadith Ibn Khuzaima mein bhi hai lekin woh farmate hain isay marfoo kehna khata hai yeh mauqoof hai yani Hazrat Ibn Abbas ka qaul hai, Baihaqi mein bhi yeh riwayat hai aur aap ka bhi yahi faisla hai aur kehte hain ke Hazrat Ali (R.A) aur Hazrat Umar (R.A) wali hadeesain ek waqiye ka faisla hain, aur Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) wali hadith dusre waqiye ka faisla hain aur Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) wali hadith ke bhi kayi jawabat hain ek to yeh ke yeh mahmool hai us laundi par jo shadi shuda ho is tarah un dono ahadees mein tatbiq aur jama ho jati hai dusre yeh ke is hadith mein lafz hadd kisi rawi ka dakhil kiya hua hai aur us ki daleel jawab ka fiqra hai, teesra jawab yeh hai ke yeh hadith do sahabiyon ki hai aur woh hadith sirf ek sahabi ki hai aur ek wali par do wali muqaddam hai, aur isi tarah yeh hadith Nasai mein bhi marwi hai aur Muslim ki shart par us ki sanad hai ke Hazrat Abbad bin Tameem apne chacha se jo Badri sahabi thay riwayat karte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai ke jab laundi zina kare to usay koray lagao phir jab zina kare to koray maro phir jab zina kare to koray lagao phir jab zina kare to bech do agarche ek rassi ke tukray ke badlay hi bechna paray. Chautha jawab yeh hai ke yeh bhi ba'eed nahin ke kisi rawi ne jald ko hadd khayal kar liya ho ya lafz hadd ka itlaq kar diya ho aur us ne jald ko hadd khayal kar liya ho ya lafz hadd ka itlaq tadeeb ke taur par saza dene par kar diya ho jaise ke lafz hadd ka itlaq us saza par bhi kiya gaya hai jo bimar zani ko khajoor ka ek khosha mara gaya tha jis mein ek sau choti choti shakhein thin, aur jaise ke lafz hadd ka itlaq us shakhs par bhi kiya gaya hai jis ne apni biwi ko us laundi ke sath zina kiya jise biwi ne us ke liye halal kar diya tha halankeh usay sau koron ka lagna tazeer ke taur par sirf ek saza hai jaise ke Imam Ahmad (R.H) waghera salaf ka khayal hai. Hadd-e-haqiqi sirf yeh hai ke kunwaray ko sau koray aur shadi shuda huay ko rajam wallahu a'lam. Ibn Majah waghera mein Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) ka farman hai ke laundi ne jab tak nikah nahin kiya usay zina par mara na jaye, is ki asnad to sahih hai lekin ma'ni do ho sakte hain ek to yeh ke bilkul mara hi na jaye na hadd na aur kuch to yeh qaul bilkul ghareeb hai, mumkin hai ayat ke alfaz par nazar karke yeh fatwa de diya ho aur hadith na pohanchi ho, dusre ma'ni yeh hain ke hadd ke taur par na mara jaye agar yeh ma'ni murad liye jayen to is ke khilaf nahin ke aur koi saza ki jaye, pas yeh qayas Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) waghera ke fatway ke mutabiq ho jaye ga wallahu a'lam.

Teesra jawab yeh hai ke aayat mein dalalat hai ke muhsana laundi par ba-nisbat azaad aurat ke aadhi had hai, lekin muhsana hone se pehle Kitab-o-Sunnat ke umoom mein yeh bhi shamil hai ke use bhi sau kore maare jayen jaise Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ka farman hai (AZ-ZANIYATU WAZ-ZANI FAJ-LIDU KULLA WAHIDIM MINHUMA MI'ATA JALDA) (24. An-Nur: 2) yani zina-kar aurat zina-kar mard ko har ek ko sau sau kore maaro aur jaise hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain meri baat le lo meri baat samajh lo Allah ne un ke liye rasta nikal liya agar dono janib ghair-shadi-shuda hain to sau kore aur ek saal ki jala-watni aur agar dono taraf shadi-shuda hain to sau kore aur pathron se rajam kar dena.
