Ek riwayat mein hai keh aur logon ne Huzoor (ﷺ) se yeh waqia bayan kiya tab aap ke daryaft karne par Hazrat Amr bin Aas ne uzr pesh kiya. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai jo shakhs kisi lohay se khudkushi karega woh Qayamat tak Jahannam ki aag mein lohay se khudkushi karta rahega, aur jo jaan boojh kar mar jaane ki niyat se zehar kha lega woh hamesha hamesha Jahannam ki aag mein zehar khata rahega aur riwayat mein hai keh jo shakhs apne tayin jis cheez se qatl karega woh Qayamat wale din usi cheez se azab kiya jayega. Huzoor (ﷺ) ka irshad hai keh tum se pehle ke logon mein se ek shakhs ko zakhm lage, us ne chhuri se apna haath kaat dala, tamam khoon beh gaya aur woh isi mein mar gaya toh Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne farmaya mere bande ne apne tayin fana karne mein jaldi ki isi wajah se main ne us par Jannat ko haram kiya. Isi liye Allah Ta'ala yahan farmata hai jo shakhs bhi zulm-o-ziyadati ke sath haram jaante hue is ka irtikab kare, dalirana taur se haram par kaar-band rahe woh jahannami hai. Pas har aqalmand ko is sakht tanbeeh se darna chahiye, dil ke kaan khol kar Allah Ta'ala ke is farman ko sun kar haram kariyon se ijtinab karna chahiye.

Phir farmata hai ke agar tum bade bade gunahon se bachte rahoge toh hum tumhare chhote chhote gunah maaf farma denge aur tumhein Jannati bana denge. Hazrat Anas (R.A) se marfoo'an marwi hai ke is tarah ki koi aur sakht wa'idein mili jis ki tameel mein tumhein apne ahl-o-maal se alag ho jana chahiye, phir hum us ke liye apne ahl-o-maal se juda na ho jayen ke woh hamare kabeera gunahon ke... woh hamare chhote mote gunahon se maaf farmata hai, phir is aayat ki tilawat ki. Is aayat ke mutaliq bahut si hadeesein bhi hain, thodi bahut hum yahan bayan karte hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Hazrat Salman Farsi (R.A) se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, jante ho Jumma ka din kya hai? Main ne jawab diya ke yeh woh din hai jis mein Allah Ta'ala ne hamare baap ko paida kiya. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya magar ab jo main janta hoon woh bhi sun lo, jo shakhs is din achi tarah ghusl karke namaz-e-Jumma ke liye masjid mein aaye aur namaz khatam hone tak khamosh rahe toh us ka yeh amal agle Jumma tak ke gunahon ka kaffara ho jata hai jab tak ke woh qatl se bacha. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke ek martaba Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne khutba sunate hue farmaya, us Allah ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai, teen martaba yahi farmaya, phir sar neecha kar liya, hum sab ne bhi sar neecha kar liya aur hum sab rone lage, hamare dilon mein kanpne lage ke Allah jaane Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne kis cheez ke liye qasam khai hai aur phir kyun khamoshi ikhtiyar ki hai? Thodi der ke baad aap (ﷺ) ne sar uthaya aur aap ka chehra bashash tha jis se hum is qadar khush hue ke agar hamein surkh rang ke oont milte toh is qadar khush na hote. Ab aap (ﷺ) farmane lage, jo banda panchhon namazein padhe, Ramzan ke roze rakhe, Zakat ada karta rahe aur saat kabeera gunahon se bacha rahe, us ke liye Jannat ke sab darwaze khul jayenge aur use kaha jayega ke salamti ke sath is mein dakhil ho jao. Saat kabeera gunah, jin saat gunahon ka is mein zikr hai un ki tafseel Bukhari Muslim mein is tarah hai: Gunahon se bacho jo halak karne wale hain. Poocha gaya ke Huzoor (ﷺ) woh kaun se gunah hain? Farmaya: Allah ke sath shirk karna aur jis ka qatl haram ho use qatl karna, haan kisi shar'i wajah se us ka khoon halal ho gaya ho toh aur baat hai. Jadoo karna, sood khana aur yateem ka maal khana aur maidan-e-jang se kuffar ke muqable mein peeth dikhana aur bhooli bhali paak daman musalman aurton par tohmat lagana. Ek riwayat mein jadoo ke badle hijrat karke phir wapas apne des mein qayam kar lena hai. Yeh yaad rahe ke in saat gunahon ko kabeera kehne se yeh matlab nahin ke kabeera gunah sirf yahi hain jaise ke ba'az aur logon ka khayal hai jin ke nazdeek mafhoom-e-mukhalif motabar hai. Dar-asal yeh bahut intehai be-ma'ni qaul aur ghalat usool hai, bil-khusoos us waqt jabke is ke khilaf dalail majood hon aur yahan toh saaf lafzon mein aur kabeera gunahon ka bhi zikr majood hai. Mandarja zail hadeesein mulahiza hon.

Mustadrak Hakim mein hai ke Hajjat-ul-Wida mein Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Logo sun lo! Allah Ta'ala ke wali sirf namazi hi hain jo panchhon waqt ki farz namazon ko baqaida baja late hain, jo Ramazan Sharif ke rozay rakhte hain, sawab hasil karne ki niyat rakhte hain aur farz jaan kar hansi khushi zakat ada karte hain aur in tamam kabira gunahon se door rehte hain jin se Allah Ta'ala ne rok diya hai. Ek shakhs ne poocha: Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Woh kabira gunah kya hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Shirk, qatl, maidan-e-jang se bhagna, maal-e-yateem khana, sood khori, pakdamnon par tohmat lagana, maa baap ki nafarmani karna, Baitullah-ul-Haram ki hurmat ko torna jo zindagi aur maut mein tumhara qibla hai. Suno! Jo shakhs martay dam tak in baray gunahon se ijtinab karta rahe aur namaz-o-zakat ki pabandi karta rahe, woh Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath jannat mein sonay ke mehlon mein hoga. Hazrat Taisala bin Mayaman farmate hain: Mujh se ek gunah ho gaya jo mere nazdeek kabira tha, main ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) se is ka zikr kiya to aap ne farmaya: Woh kabira gunah nahin, kabira gunah nau (9) hain: Allah ke sath shirk karna, kisi ko bila wajah maar dalna, maidan-e-jang mein dushmanan-e-deen ko peeth dikhana, pakdaman aurton ko tohmat lagana, sood khana, yateem ka maal zulm se kha jana, Masjid-e-Haram mein ilhad phailana aur maa baap ko nafarmani ke sabab rulana. Hazrat Taisala (R.H) farmate hain ke is bayan ke baad bhi Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) ne mehsoos kiya ke khauf kam nahin hua to farmaya: Kya tumhare dilon mein jahannam ki aag mein dakhil hone ka dar aur jannat mein jaane ki chahat hai? Main ne kaha: Bahut zyada. Farmaya: Kya tumhare maa baap zinda hain? Main ne kaha: Sirf walida hayat hain. Farmaya: Bas tum un se narm kalami se bola karo aur unhein khana khilate raha karo aur in kabira gunahon se bachte raha karo to tum yaqeenan jannat mein jao ge. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Taisala bin Ali Nahdi, Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se maidan-e-Arafat mein Arafah ke din peelu ke darakht talay milay thay, us waqt Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) apne sar aur chehray par pani baha rahe thay. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke jab Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ne tohmat lagane ka zikr kiya to main ne poocha: Kya yeh bhi misl-e-qatl ke bahut bada gunah hai? Aap ne farmaya: Haan, haan! Aur in gunahon ke zikr mein jadoo ka zikr bhi hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke meri un ki mulaqat shaam ke waqt hui thi aur main ne un se kabair ke bare mein sawal kiya to unhon ne farmaya: Main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke kabair saat (7) hain. Main ne poocha: Kya kya? To farmaya: Shirk aur tohmat lagana. Main ne kaha: Kya yeh bhi misl-e-khoon-e-nahaq ke hai?

Farmaya haan haan aur kisi momin ko be-sabab maar daalna, ladai se bhaagna, jaadu aur sood-khwari, maal-e-yateem khaana, walidain ki nafarmani aur Baitullah mein ilhaad phailana jo zindagi mein aur maut mein tumhara qibla hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo Allah ka banda Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek na kare, namaz qaim rakhe, zakat ada kare, Ramzan ke rozay rakhe aur kabeera gunahon se bache woh jannati hai. Ek shakhs ne poocha kabair kya hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah ke saath shirk karna, musalman ko qatl karna, ladai wale din bhaag khada hona. Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Ahl-e-Yaman ko ek kitaab likhwa kar bhajwai jis mein faraiz aur sunan ki tafseelat thin, diyat yani jurmanon ke ahkaam thay aur yeh kitaab Hazrat Amr bin Hazm (R.A) ke haath Ahl-e-Yaman ko bhajwai gayi thi. Is kitaab mein yeh bhi tha ke Qayamat ke din tamam kabeera gunahon mein sab se bada kabeera gunah yeh hai ke insaan Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek kare aur imandaar shakhs ka qatl baghair haq ke aur Allah ki raah mein jihad ke maidan mein ja kar ladte hue namardi se jaan bachane ki khatir bhaag khada hona aur maa baap ki nafarmani karna aur na-karda gunah aurton par ilzaam lagana aur jaadu seekhna aur sood khana aur maal-e-yateem barbaad karna. Ek aur riwayat mein kabeera gunahon ke bayan mein jhooti baat ya jhooti shahadat bhi hai aur hadith mein hai ke kabeera gunahon ke bayan ke waqt Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tek laga kar baithe hue thay lekin jab yeh bayan farmaya ke jhooti gawahi aur jhooti baat, us waqt Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) takiye se hat gaye aur bade zor se is baat ko bayan farmaya aur baar baar isi ko dohrate rahe yahan tak ke hum ne dil mein socha kaash ab Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) na dohraein. Bukhari Muslim mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) ne Janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft kiya ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kaunsa gunah sab se bada hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke tu Allah Ta'ala ka kisi ko shareek kare yeh jaante hue ke tujhe sirf usi ne paida kiya hai? Main ne poocha is ke baad? Farmaya yeh ke tu apne bache ko is dar se qatl kar de ke woh tere saath khaye ga, main ne poocha phir kaunsa gunah bada hai? Farmaya yeh ke tu apni padosan se badkari kare. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh (وَالَّذِيْنَ لَا يَدْعُوْنَ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰــهًا اٰخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُوْنَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِيْ حَرَّمَ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا بالْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُوْنَ ۚ وَمَنْ يَّفْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ يَلْقَ اَثَامًا 68؀ۙ يُّضٰعَفْ لَهُ الْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِيْهٖ مُهَانًا 69؀ ڰ اِلَّا مَنْ تَابَ وَاٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا فَاُولٰۗىِٕكَ يُبَدِّلُ اللّٰهُ سَـيِّاٰتِهِمْ حَسَنٰتٍ ۭ وَكَان اللّٰهُ غَفُوْرًا رَّحِيْمًا 70؀) 25 tilawat farmayi.

(Al-Furqan: 68 ta 70) tak parhi. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr bin Al-Aas (R.A) Masjid-ul-Haram mein Hateem ke andar baithe hue thay, jo ek shakhs ne sharab ke bare mein sawal kiya to aap ne farmaya: Mujh jaisa burha bari umr ka aadmi is jagah baith kar Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par jhoot nahin bol sakta. Sharab ka peena tamam gunahon se bara gunah hai? Yeh kaam tamam khabasaton ki maa hai. Sharabi tarik-e-namaz hota hai, woh apni maa aur khala aur phuphi se bhi badkari karne se nahin chukta. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai.

Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A), Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) aur dusre bahut se Sahaba (Razi Allahu Anhum) ek martaba ek majlis mein baithe hue thay, wahan kabeera gunahon ka zikr nikla ke sab se bara gunah kya hai? To kisi ke paas musaddiqah jawab na tha, is liye unhon ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) ko bheja ke tum ja kar Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr bin Al-Aas (R.A) se daryaft kar aao. Main gaya to unhon ne jawab diya ke sab se bara gunah sharab peena hai. Main ne wapas aa kar is majlis mein yeh jawab suna diya. Is par ahl-e-majlis ko taskeen na hui aur sab hazrat uth kar Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr bin Al-Aas (R.A) ke ghar chale aur khud un se daryaft kiya, to unhon ne bayan kiya ke logon ne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne ek waqia bayan kiya ke Bani Israel ke badshahon mein se ek ne ek shakhs ko giraftar kiya, phir us se kaha ke ya to tu apni jaan se hath dho daal ya in kamon mein se kisi ek ko kar, yani ya to sharab pee ya khoon-e-na-haq kar ya zina kar ya suar ka gosht kha. Is gaur-o-tafakkur ke baad us ne jaan jaane ke dar se sharab ko halki cheez samajh kar peena manzoor kar liya. Jab sharab pee li to phir nasha mein woh un tamam kamon ko kar guzra jin se woh pehle ruka tha.

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh waqia gosh-guzar farma kar hum se farmaya: Jo shakhs sharab peeta hai, Allah Ta'ala us ki namazein chalees raat tak qabool nahin farmata aur jo sharab peene ki aadat mein hi mar jaye aur us ke masana mein thori si sharab ho, us par Allah Jannat ko haram kar deta hai. Agar sharab peene ke baad chalees raton ke andar andar mare to us ki maut jahiliyat ki maut hoti hai. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai. Ek aur hadith mein jhooti qasam ko bhi Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kabeera gunahon mein shumar farmaya hai (Bukhari waghera). Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein jhooti qasam ke bayan ke baad yeh farman bhi hai ke jo shakhs Allah ki qasam kha kar koi baat kahe aur us ne machhar ke par barabar ziyadati ki, us ke dil mein ek siyah daagh ho jata hai jo Qayamat tak baqi rehta hai.

Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke insaan ka apne maa baap ko gaali dena kabeera gunah hai. Logon ne poocha: Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne maa baap ko kaise gaali de ga? Aap ne farmaya: Is tarah ke us ne dusre ke baap ko gaali di, us ne is ke baap ko; us ne is ki maa ko bura kaha, us ne is ki maa ko. Bukhari Shareef mein hai: Sab se bara kabeera gunah yeh hai ke aadmi apne maa baap par laanat kare. Logon ne kaha: Yeh kaise ho sakta hai? Farmaya: Dusre ke maa baap ko keh kar apne maa baap ko kehwana.

Sahih hadith mein hai musalman ko gaali dena fasiq bana deta hai aur usey qatl karna kufr hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Akbar-ul-Kaba'ir yani tamam kabira gunahon mein bada gunah kisi musalman ki aabroo rezi karna hai aur ek gaali ke badle do gaaliyan dena hai. Tirmidhi mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jis shakhs ne do namazon ko uzr ke baghair jama kiya woh kabira gunahon ke darwazon mein se ek darwaze mein ghusa. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ki kitab jo hamare samne padhi gayi us mein yeh bhi tha ke do namazon ko baghair shar'i uzr ke jama karna kabira gunah hai, aur ladai ke maidan se bhaag khada hona aur loot khasoot karna bhi kabira gunah hai, al-gharaz Zuhr-Asr ya Maghrib-Isha pehle waqt ya pichle waqt baghair kisi shar'i rukhsat ke jama karke padhna kabira gunah hai. Phir jo shakhs ke bilkul hi na padhe us ke gunah ka to kya thikana hai? Chunancha Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai ke bande aur shirk ke darmiyan namaz ka chhod dena hai, Sunan ki ek hadith mein hai ke hum mein aur kafir mein farq karne wali cheez namaz ka chhod dena hai, jis ne ise chhoda us ne kufr kiya aur riwayat mein Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yeh farman bhi manqool hai ke jis ne Asr ki namaz tark kardi us ke a'maal gharat hue aur hadith mein hai jis se Asr ki namaz faut hui goya us ka maal us ka ahl-o-iyaal bhi halak ho gaye, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya ke kabira gunah kya kya hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah ke sath shirk karna, Allah ki ne'mat aur us ki rahmat se na-umeed hona aur us ki khufiya tadbiron se be-khauf ho jana aur yeh sab se bada gunah hai isi ke misl ek riwayat aur bhi Bazzar mein marwi hai lekin zyada theek yeh hai ke woh Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) par mauqoof hai, Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) farmate hain sab se kabira gunah Allah Azza-wa-Jal ke sath bad-gumani karna hai, yeh riwayat bahut hi ghareeb hai, pehle woh hadith bhi guzar chuki hai jis mein hijrat ke baad kafaristan mein aakar basne ko bhi kabira gunah farmaya hai, yeh hadith Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai, saat kabira gunahon mein ise bhi gina gaya hai lekin is ki asnaad mein ikhtilaf hai aur ise marfoo' kehna bilkul ghalat hai theek baat wahi hai jo Tafsir-e-Ibn-e-Jarir mein marwi hai ke Hazrat Ali (R.A) Koofe ki masjid mein ek martaba mimbar par khade ho kar logon ko khutba suna rahe the jis mein farmaya logo kabira gunah saat hain ise sun kar log cheekh uthe aap ne isi ko phir dohraya phir dohraya phir farmaya tum mujh se un ki tafseel kyun nahin poochte? Logon ne kaha Ameer-ul-Momineen farmaiye woh kya hain? Aap (R.A) ne farmaya Allah ke sath shirk karna, jis jaan ko maar dalna Allah ne haram kiya hai use maar dalna, pakdaman aurton par tohmat lagana, yateem ka maal khana, sood khori karna, ladai ke din peeth dikhana aur hijrat ke baad phir dar-ul-kufr mein aa basna.

Rawi-e-Hadith Hazrat Muhammad bin Sahl (R.H) ne apne walid Hazrat Sahl bin Khaisama (R.H) se poocha ke ise kabira gunahon mein kaise dakhil kiya toh jawab mila ke pyare bache is se barh kar sitam kya hoga? Ke ek shakhs hijrat karke musalmanon mein mile maal-e-ghanimat mein iska hissa muqarrar hojaye, mujahideen mein iska naam darj kardiya jaye, phir woh in tamam cheezon ko chor kar a'arabi ban jaye aur dar-ul-kufr mein chala jaye aur jaisa tha waisa hi hojaye. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne Hujjat-ul-Wida ke khutba mein farmaya khabardar! khabardar! Allah ke sath kisi ko shareek na karo, khoon-e-na-haq se bacho (haan shar'i ijazat aur cheez hai), zina-kari na karo, chori na karo. Woh hadith pehle guzar chuki hai jis mein hai ke wasiyat karne mein kisi ko nuqsan pohanchana bhi kabira gunah hai. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke sahaba ne ek martaba kabira gunahon ko dohraya ke Allah ke sath shareek karna, yateem ka maal khana, larai se bhag khara hona, pakdaman be-gunah aurton par tohmat lagana, maa baap ki nafarmani karna, jhoot bolna, dhoka dena, khayanat karna, jadu karna, sood khana ye sab kabira gunah hain, toh Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya aur is gunah ko kya kahoge? Jo log Allah ke ahd aur apni qasmon ko thori thori qeemat par bechte phirte hain aakhir aayat tak aap ne tilawat ki. Iski asnad mein za'f hai aur ye hadith hasan hai, pas in tamam ahadith mein kabira gunahon ka zikr majood hai. Ab is bare mein Salaf-e-Saliheen (Rahimahumullah) ke jo aqwal hain woh mulahiza hon, Ibn-e-Jarir mein manqool hai chand logon ne Misr mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) se poocha ke bohat si baatein Kitabullah mein hum aisi paate hain ke jin par hamara amal nahin is liye hum Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar (R.A) se is bare mein daryaft karna chahte hain, Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) unhein le kar Madina aaye apne walid se mile aap ne poocha kab aaye ho? Jawab diya ke chand din hue. Poocha ijazat se aaye ho? Iska bhi jawab diya phir apne sath aane wale logon ka zikr aur maqsad bayan kiya aap ne farmaya inhein jama karo sabhi ko unke paas laye aur un mein se har ek ko Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne poocha tujhe Allah aur Islam-e-Haq ki qasam batao tum ne poora Quran-e-Kareem parha hai? Usne kaha haan farmaya kya tu ne ise apne dil mein mehfooz karliya hai usne kaha nahin aur agar haan kehta toh Hazrat Umar (R.A) use kama-haqqahu dalail se aajiz kardete phir farmaya kya tum sab ne Quran-e-Hakeem ke mafhoom ko nigahon mein, zaban mein aur a'amal mein dhaal liya hai phir ek ek se yahi sawal kiya phir farmaya tum Umar ko is mushaqqat mein dalna chahte ho ke logon ko bilkul Kitabullah ke mutabiq hi theek thak karde, hamare Rabb ko pehle se hi hamari khataon ka ilm tha phir aap ne aayat "In tajtanibu..." (4:31) ki tilawat ki. Phir farmaya kya ahl-e-Madina ko tumhare aane ka maqsad maloom hai? Unhon ne kaha nahin farmaya agar unhein bhi iska ilm hota toh mujhe is bare mein unhein bhi wa'az karna parta.

Is ki asnaad hasan hai aur matan bhi, go yeh riwayat hasan ki Hazrat Umar (R.A) se hai jis mein inqita hai lekin phir bhi itne se nuqsan par is ki poori shohrat bhari hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hi Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain kabira gunah yeh hain: Allah ke sath sharik karna, kisi ko maar dalna, yateem ka maal khana, pakdaman aurton ko tohmat lagana, ladai se bhag jana, hijrat ke baad dar-ul-kufr mein qayam kar lena, jadu karna, maa baap ki nafarmani karna, sood khana, jamaat se juda hona, kharid-o-farokht ka ahd tod dena. Pehle guzar chuka hai ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) farmate hain bade se bada gunah Allah ke sath sharik karna hai aur Allah Ta'ala ki wus'at-e-rahmat se mayus hona aur Allah ki rahmat se na-umeed hona hai aur Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki posheeda tadbiron se be-khauf hona hai. Ibn-e-Jarir mein aap hi se riwayat hai ke Surah Nisa ki shuru aayat se lekar tees aayaton tak kabira gunah ka bayan hai, phir aap ne (In tajtanibu kabaira ma tunhawna anhu nukaffir ankum sayyi'atikum wa nudkhilkum mudkhalan karima) (Surah An-Nisa: 31) ki tilawat ki. Hazrat Buraidah (R.A) farmate hain kabira gunah Allah ke sath sharik karna, maa baap ko na-khush karna, asoodgi ke baad ke bache hue pani ko hajat-mandon se rok rakhna, apne paas ke nar janwar ko kisi ki mada ke liye baghair kuch liye na dena. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki ek marfu hadith mein hai bacha hua pani na roka jaye aur na bachi hui ghaas roki jaye, aur riwayat mein hai teen qisam ke gunahgaron ki taraf Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala nazar-e-rahmat se na dekhega aur na hi un ki fard-e-jurm hataye ga balkeh un ke liye dard-naak azab hain, ek woh shakhs jo jungle mein bache hue pani par qabza karke musafiron ko is se roke. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai jo shakhs zaid pani ko aur zaid ghaas ko rok rakhe Allah Qayamat ke din us par apna fazl nahin karega. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) farmati hain kabira gunah woh hain jo aurton se bai'at lene ke zikr mein bayan hue hain, yani (Ya ayyuhan-nabiyyu iza ja'akal mu'minatu yubayi'anaka ala an la yushrikna billahi shay'an wa la yasriqna wa la yaznina wa la yaqtulna awladahunna wa la ya'tina bibuhtanin yaftarinnahu baina aydihinna wa arjulihinna wa la ya'sinaka fi ma'rufin fabayi'hunna wastaghfir lahunnallaha innallaha Ghafurur Rahim) (Surah Al-Mumtahinah: 12) mein. Hazrat Anas bin Malik (R.A) is aayat ko Allah Ta'ala ke azeem-ush-shan ehsanon mein bayan farmate hain aur is par badi khushnudi ka izhar farmate hain, yani (In tajtanibu kabaira ma tunhawna anhu nukaffir ankum sayyi'atikum wa nudkhilkum mudkhalan karima) (Surah An-Nisa: 31) ko.

Ek martaba Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ke samne logon ne kaha kabira gunah saat hain, aap ne kayi kayi martaba farmaya saat hain, dusri riwayat mein hai aap ne farmaya saat halka darja hai warna sattar hain, ek aur shakhs ke kehne par aap ne farmaya woh saat sau tak hain aur saat bahut hi qareeb hain. Haan yeh yaad rakho ke istighfar ke baad kabira gunah kabira nahin rehta aur israr aur takrar se saghira gunah saghira nahin rehta. Aur sanad se marwi hai ke aap ne farmaya jis gunah par bhi jahannam ki wa'eed Allah Ta'ala ke ghazab, la'nat ya azab ki hai woh kabira gunah hai aur riwayat mein hai jis kaam se Allah mana farma de uska karna kabira gunah hai yani kaam mein bhi Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki nafarmani ho woh bada gunah hai. Tabi'een ke aqwal bhi mulahiza hon, Ubaida (R.H) farmate hain kabira gunah yeh hain: Allah Ta'ala ke sath shirk, qatl-e-nafs baghair haq, maidan-e-jihad mein peeth pherna, yateem ka maal udana, sood khori, bohtan bazi, hijrat ke baad watan dosti. Rawi-e-hadith Ibn-e-Aun ne apne ustad Muhammad se pucha kya jadu kabira gunah mein nahin? Farmaya yeh bohtan mein aa gaya, yeh lafz bahut si buraiyon par mushtamil hai. Hazrat Ubaid bin Umair (R.H) ne kabira gunahon par ayat-e-qurani bhi tilawat karke sunayen. Shirk par (Waman yushrik billahi fakannama kharra minas-sama-i fatakhtafuhut-tairu aw tahwi bihir-rihu fi makani-n sahiq) (22. Al-Hajj: 31) yani Allah ke sath shirk karne wala goya aasman se gir pada aur use parinday lapak le jayen ya hawa use door daraz na-maloom aur badtareen jagah phenk de. Yateem ke maal par (Innal-lazina ya'kuluna amwalal-yatama zulman...) yani jo log zulm se yateemon ka maal hadap kar lete hain woh sab pet mein jahannam ke angaray bharte hain. Sood khwari par (Allazina ya'kulunar-riba la yaqumuna illa kama yaqumul-lazi yatakhabbatuhush-shaitanu minal-mass) (2. Al-Baqarah: 275) yani jo log sood khwari karte hain woh qayamat ke din makhboot-ul-hawas aur pagal ban kar khade honge. Bohtan par (Innal-lazina yarmunal-muhsanatil-ghafilatil-mu'minati lu'inu fiddunya wal-akhirati walahum azabun azim) (24. An-Nur: 23) jo log pakdaman be-khabar ba-iman aurton par tohmat lagayen. Maidan-e-jang se bhagne par (Ya ayyuhallazina amanu iza laqitumullazina kafaru zahfan) iman walo jab kafiron se muqabla ho jaye to peeth na dikhao. Hijrat ke baad kafristan mein qayam karne par (Innal-lazina-rtaddu 'ala adbarihim mim ba'di ma tabayyana lahumul-huda ash-shaitanu sawwala lahum wa amla lahum) (47. Muhammad: 25) yani log hidayat ke baad murtad ho jayen. Qatl-e-momin par (Waman yaqtul mu'minan muta'ammidan fajaza-uhu jahannamu khalidan fiha) yani jo shakhs kisi musalman ko jaan boojh kar maar dale uski saza jahannam ka abadi dakhla hai.

Hazrat Ata R.H se bhi kabira gunahon ka bayan majood hai aur is mein jhooti gawahi hai, Hazrat Mughira R.H farmate hain yeh kaha jata tha ke Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.A aur Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A ko bura kehna bhi kabira gunah hai, main kehta hoon ulama ki ek jamaat ne use kafir kaha hai jo Sahaba Rizwanullahi Alaihim Ajma'een ko bura kahe, Hazrat Imam Malik bin Anas R.H se yeh marwi hai, Imam Muhammad bin Sirin R.H farmate hain main yeh bawar nahin kar sakta ke kisi ke dil mein Rasoolullah ﷺ ki mohabbat ho aur woh Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.A se dushmani rakhe (Tirmidhi). Hazrat Zaid bin Aslam R.H is ayat ki tafsir mein farmate hain kabair yeh hain: Allah ke sath shirk karna, Allah ki ayaton aur us ke Rasoolon se kufr karna, jadoo karna, aulad ko maar dalna, Allah Ta'ala se aulad aur biwi ki nisbat dena aur isi jaise woh a'maal aur woh aqwal hain jin ke baad koi neki qabool nahin hoti. Haan, kuch aise gunah hain jin ke sath deen reh sakta hai aur amal qabool ho sakta hai, aise gunahon ko neki ke badle Allah Azza-wa-Jal maaf farma deta hai. Hazrat Qatada R.H farmate hain: Allah Ta'ala ne maghfirat ka wada un se kiya hai jo kabira gunahon se bachein aur hum se yeh bhi zikr kiya gaya hai ke An-Hazrat ﷺ ne farmaya hai ke kabira gunah se bacho, theek-thaak aur durust raho aur khush khabri suno. Musnad Abdur Razzaq mein ba-sanad sahih Rasool-e-Kareem ﷺ se marwi hai ke Aap ﷺ ne farmaya meri shafa'at sirf muttaqiyon aur mominon ke liye? Nahin nahin, balki woh khata-karon aur gunahon se aalooda logon ke liye bhi hai. Ab ulama-e-kiram ke aqwal suniye jin mein yeh bataya gaya hai ke kabira gunah kise kehte hain; ba'az to kehte hain kabira gunah woh hai jis par hadd-e-shar'i ho. Ba'az kehte hain jis par Quran mein ya Hadith mein kisi saza ka zikr ho. Ba'az ka qaul hai jis se deendari kam hoti ho aur diyanat-dari mein kami waqay hoti ho. Qazi Abu Saeed Harwi R.H farmate hain jis ka haram hona lafzon se sabit ho aur jis nafarmani par koi hadd ho jaise qatl waghera, isi tarah har fareeza ka tark aur jhooti gawahi aur jhooti riwayat aur jhooti qasam.

Qazi Rubani farmate hain kabair saath hain: be-wajah kisi ko maar dalna, zina, liwatat, sharab noshi, chori, ghasb, tohmat aur ek aathwein gawahi aur isi ke sath yeh bhi shamil kiye gaye hain: sood khwari, Ramzan ke rozay ka bila uzr tark kar dena, jhooti qasam, qata-e-rahmi, maa baap ki nafarmani, jihad se bhagna, yateem ka maal khana, naap tol mein khayanat karna, namaz waqt se pehle ya waqt guzar ke be-uzr ada karna, musalman ko be-wajah marna, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par jaan kar jhoot bandhna, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sahabiyon ko gaali dena aur qudrat ke bhali baton ka hukum na karna, buri baton se na rokna, Quran seekh kar bhool jana, jandar cheez ko aag se jalana, aurat ka apne khawand ke paas be-sabab na aana, Rabb ki rahmat se na-umeed ho jana, Allah ke makr se be-khauf ho jana, ahl-e-ilm aur amilan-e-Quran ki buraiyan karna, zihar karna, suar ka gosht khana, murdar khana, haan agar ba-wajah-e-zarurat aur iztirab ke khaya ho to adwiyat ke misdaq hai. Imam Shafi'i (R.H) farmate hain in mein se ba'az mein tawaqquf ki gunjaish hai? Kabair ke bare mein buzurgan-e-deen ne bohat si kitabein bhi tasneef farmayi hain, hamare Sheikh Hafiz Abu Abdullah Zahabi (R.H) ne bhi ek kitab likhi hai jis mein sattar kabira gunah ginuwaye hain. Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke kabira gunah woh hai jis par Shari' (A.S) ne jahannam ki wa'eed sunayi hai. Is qisam ke gunah hi agar gine jayen to bohat niklenge aur agar kabira gunah har us kaam ko kaha jaye jis se Shari' (A.S) ne rok diya hai to bohat hi ho jayenge. Wallahu A'lam.

Jaiz Rashk aur Jawab-e-Ba-Sawab

Hazrat Umm-e-Salama (R.A) ne ek martaba kaha tha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) mard jihad karte hain aur hum auratein is sawab se mehroom hain, isi tarah meeras mein bhi hamein ba-nisbat mardon ke aadha milta hai, is par yeh aayat nazil hui (Tirmidhi). Aur riwayat mein hai ke is ke baad phir (Anni la uzio amala amilin minkum min zakarin au unsa, ba'dukum min ba'd) (Surah Al-Imran: 195) utri. Aur yeh bhi riwayat mein hai ke auraton ne yeh aarzoo ki thi ke kaash ke hum bhi mard hote to jihad mein jaate. Aur riwayat mein hai ke ek aurat ne khidmat-e-Nabwi mein hazir ho kar kaha tha ke dekhiye mard ko do auraton ke barabar hissa milta hai, do auraton ki shahadat misl ek mard ke samjhi jaati hai, go phir is tanasub se amlan ek neki ki aadhi neki reh jaati hai, is par yeh aayat nazil hui. Suddi (R.H) farmate hain mardon ne kaha tha ke jab dohre hisse ke maalik hum hain to dohra ajr bhi hamein nahin milta? Aur auraton ne darkhwast ki thi ke jab hum par jihad farz hi nahin hamein to shahadat ka sawab kyun nahin milta? Is par Allah Ta'ala ne donon ko roka aur hukm diya ke mera fazl talab karte raho.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se yeh matlab bayan kiya gaya hai ke insaan yeh aarzoo na kare ke kaash ke falan ka maal aur aulad mera hota. Is par is hadith se koi ishkal sabit nahin ho sakta jis mein hai ke hasad ke qabil sirf do hain: ek maaldar jo rah-e-Allah apna maal lutata hai aur dusra kehta hai kaash ke mere paas bhi maal hota to main bhi isi tarah fi-sabilillah kharch karta rehta, pas yeh donon Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek ajr mein barabar hain. Is liye ke yeh mamnoo nahin, yani aisi neki ki hirs buri nahin, kisi nek kaam hasil hone ki tamanna ya hirs karna mahmood hai. Is ke bar-aks kisi ki cheez apne qabze mein lene ki niyat karna har tarah mazmoom hai. Jis tarah deeni fazeelat hasil karne ki hirs jaiz rakhi hai aur dunyawi fazeelat ki tamanna na-jaiz hai.

Phir farmaya har ek ko is ke amal ka badla milega, khair ke badle khair aur shar ke badle shar. Aur yeh bhi murad ho sakti hai ke har ek ko is ke haq ke mutabiq virsa diya jaata hai. Phir irshad hota hai ke hum se hamara fazl maangte raha karo, aapas mein ek dusre ki fazeelat ki tamanna be-sood amr hai. Haan mujh se mera fazl talab karo to main bakheel nahin, Kareem hoon, Wahhab hoon, doonga aur bahut kuch doonga. Janab-e-Rasool (ﷺ) farmate hain: Logo! Allah Ta'ala se is ka fazl talab karo, Allah se maangna Allah ko bahut pasand hai. Yaad rakho sab se aala ibadat kushadgi aur wus'at-o-rahmat ka intezar karna aur is ki umeed rakhna hai. Allah Aleem hai, use khoob maloom hai ke kaun diye jaane ke qabil hai aur kaun faqiri ke laiq hai aur kaun aakhirat ki nematon ka mustahiq hai aur kaun wahan ki ruswaiyon ka saza-war hai, use is ke asbaab aur use is ke wasail woh muhayya aur aasaan kar deta hai.

Mas'ala-e-Wirasat mein Mawali? Waris aur Asaba ki wazahat-o-islahat. Bohat se mufassireen se marwi hai ke Mawali se murad waris hain, baaz kehte hain Asaba murad hain? Chacha ki aulad ko bhi Mawali kaha jata hai jaise Hazrat Fazl bin Abbas ke sher mein hai. Pas matlab ayat ka yeh hua ke ae logo! Tum mein se har ek ke liye hum ne Asaba muqarrar kar diye hain jo is maal ke waris honge jise un ke maa baap aur qarabatdar chhor marein aur tumhare munh bole bhai hain tum jin ki qasmein kha kar bhai bane ho aur woh tumhare bhai bane hain unhein un ki miras ka hissa do jaise ke qasmon ke waqt tum mein ahd-o-paiman ho chuka tha, yeh hukm ibtida-e-Islam mein tha phir mansookh ho gaya aur hukm hua ke jin se ahd-o-paiman hue woh nibhaye jayen aur bhoolay na jayen lekin miras unhein nahin milegi. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke Mawali se murad waris hain aur baad ke jumla se murad yeh hai ke Muhajireen jab Madina Sharif mein tashreef laye to yeh dastoor tha ke har Muhajir apne Ansari bhai band ka waris hota us ke zu-rahm rishtedar waris na hote pas ayat ne is tareeqay ko mansookh qarar diya aur hukm hua ke un ki madad karo unhein faida pohanchao un ki khair khwahi karo lekin miras unhein nahin milegi han wasiyat kar jao. Qabl az Islam yeh dastoor tha ke do shakhson mein ahd-o-paiman ho jata tha ke main tera waris aur tu mera waris isi tarah qabail-e-Arab ahd-o-paiman kar lete thay pas Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jahiliyat ki qasmein aur is qisam ke ahd is ayat ne mansookh qarar de diye aur farmaya muahidon walon ki ba-nisbat zi-rahm rishtedar Kitabullah ke hukm se zyada tarjeeh ke mustahiq hain. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jahiliyat ki qasmon aur ahdon ke bare mein yahan tak takeed farmayi ke agar mujhe surkh oont diye jayen aur is qisam ke torne ko kaha jaye jo Dar-un-Nadwa mein hui thi to main ise bhi pasand nahin karta, Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain main apne bachpanay mein apne mamuon ke sath Half-e-Tayyibeen mein shamil tha main is qisam ko surkh oonton ke badlay bhi torna pasand nahin karta pas yaad rahe ke Quraish-o-Ansar mein jo talluq Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne qaim kiya tha woh sirf ulfat-o-yaganat paida karne ke liye tha, logon ke sawal ke jawab mein bhi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yeh farman marwi hai ke jahiliyat ke half nibhayo.

Lekin ab Islam mein rasm-e-half kaal-adam qarar de di gayi hai. Fatah-e-Makkah wale din bhi Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne khade ho kar apne khutba mein isi baat ka elaan farmaya. Dawood bin Husain (R.H) kehte hain main Hazrat Umm-e-Sa'ad bint-e-Rabee (R.A) se Quran padhta tha, mere saath un ke pote Musa bin Sa'ad bhi padhte the jo Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) ki god mein yateemi ke ayyam guzar rahe the. Main ne jab is aayat mein 'aaqadat' padha to mujhe meri ustani ji ne roka aur farmaya 'aqadat' padho aur yaad rakho yeh aayat Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) aur un ke sahibzade Hazrat Abdur Rahman (R.A) ke bare mein nazil hui hai ke Abdur Rahman Islam ke munkir the. Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ne qasam kha li ke unhein waris na karenge. Bil-aakhir jab yeh musalmanon ke be-inteha husn-e-a'maal se Islam ki taraf aamada hue aur musalman ho gaye to Janab-e-Siddiq (R.A) ko hukm hua ke unhein un ke virse ke hisse se mehroom na farmayein. Lekin yeh qaul ghareeb hai aur sahih qaul pehla hi hai. Al-gharaz is aayat aur in ahadees se un ka qaul rad hota hai jo qasam aur wadon ki bina par aaj bhi virsa pahunchne ke qail hain, jaise ke Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) aur un ke sathiyon ka khayal hai aur Imam Ahmad (R.H) se bhi is qisam ki ek riwayat hai. Jise jumhoor aur Imam Malik (R.H) aur Imam Shafi (R.H) ne sahih qarar diya hai aur mashhoor qaul ki bina par Imam Ahmad (R.H) ka bhi ise sahih maante hain. Pas aayat mein irshad hai ke har shakhs ke waris us ke qarabati log hain aur koi nahin. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain hissa-dar warison ko un ke hisson ke mutabiq de kar phir jo bach rahe to asaba ko mile aur waris woh hain jin ka zikr faraiz ki do aayaton mein hai aur jin se tum se mazboot ahd-o-paiman aur qasmon ka tabadla hai, yani is aayat ke nazil hone se pehle ke wade aur qasmein hon khwah is aayat ke utarne ke baad hon sab ka yahi hukm hai ke aise half-bardaron ko meeras na mile. Aur ba-qaul Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) un ka hissa nusrat, imdad, khair-khwahi aur wasiyat hai meeras nahin. Aap farmate hain log ahd-o-paiman kar liya karte the ke un mein se jo pehle marega baad wala us ka waris banega. Pas Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne (وَاُولُوا الْاَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ اَوْلٰى بِبَعْضٍ فِيْ كِتٰبِ اللّٰهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُهٰجِرِيْنَ اِلَّآ اَنْ تَفْعَلُوْٓا اِلٰٓى اَوْلِيٰۗىِٕكُمْ مَّعْرُوْفًا) (Surah Al-Ahzab: 6) nazil farma kar hukm diya ke zi-rahm mahram ek se aula hai, albatta apne doston ke saath husn-e-sulook karo yani agar un se maal ka teesra hissa dene ki wasiyat kar jao to jaiz hai. Yahi ma'roof-o-mashhoor amr aur bahut se salaf se bhi marwi hai ke yeh aayat mansookh hai aur nasikh (وَاُولُوا الْاَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ اَوْلٰى بِبَعْضٍ فِيْ كِتٰبِ اللّٰهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُهٰجِرِيْنَ اِلَّآ اَنْ تَفْعَلُوْٓا اِلٰٓى اَوْلِيٰۗىِٕكُمْ مَّعْرُوْفًا) (Surah Al-Ahzab: 6) wali hai. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) farmate hain unhein un ka hissa do yani meeras.

Hazrat Abu Bakr R.A ek sahib ko apna beta banate thay aur unhein apni jaidad ka jaiz waris qarar dete thay, pas Allah Ta'ala ne unka hissa wasiyat mein toh barqarar rakha, miras ka mustahiq mawali yani zi-rahm mahram rishtedaron aur asaba ko qarar de diya aur sabiqah rasm ko napasand farmaya ke sirf zabani dawaon aur banaye hue beton ko virsa na diya jaye, haan unke liye wasiyat mein se de sakte ho. Imam Ibn Jarir R.H farmate hain mere nazdeek mukhtar qaul yeh hai ke unhein hissa do yani nusrat, nasihat aur ma'oonat ka, yeh nahin ke unhein unke virsa ka hissa do, toh yeh ma'ni karne se phir ayat ko mansookh batlane ki wajah baqi nahin rehti na yeh kehna padta hai ke yeh hukm pehle tha ab nahin raha. Balkeh ayat ki dalalat sirf isi amr par hai ke jo ahd-o-paiman aapas mein imdad-o-ianat ke, khair-khwahi aur bhalai ke hote thay unhein wafa karo, pas yeh ayat muhkam aur ghair-mansookh hai. Lekin Imam sahab ke qaul mein zara ishkal hai isliye ke is mein toh shak nahin ke ba'az ahd-o-paiman sirf nusrat-o-imdad ke hi hote thay lekin is mein bhi shak nahin ke ba'az ahd-o-paiman virse ke bhi hote thay jaise ke bahut se salaf-e-saliheen se marvi hai aur jaise ke Ibn Abbas R.A ki tafsir bhi manqool hai. Jis mein unhon ne saaf farmaya hai ke muhajir ansar ka waris hota tha, uske qarabati log waris nahin hote thay na zi-rahm rishtedar waris hote thay yahan tak ke yeh mansookh ho gaya, phir Imam sahab kaise farma sakte hain ke yeh ayat muhkam aur ghair-muhkam mansookh hai, Wallahu Ta'ala A'lam.

Mard aurton se afzal kyun? Janab-e-Bari irshad farmata hai ke mard aurat ka hakim, raees aur sardar hai, har tarah se us ka muhafiz-o-muawin hai. Isi liye ke mard aurton se afzal hain. Yehi wajah hai ke nabuwwat hamesha mardon mein rahi, ba-ainah shar'i taur par khalifa bhi mard hi ban sakta hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Woh log kabhi nijat nahin pa sakte jo apna wali kisi aurat ko banayen. (Sahih Bukhari). Isi tarah har tarah ka mansab-e-qaza waghera bhi mardon ke laiq hi hain.

Dusri wajah fazilat ki yeh hai ke mard aurton par apna maal kharch karte hain jo Kitab-o-Sunnat se un ke zimma hai, maslan mehar, naan-o-nafaqa aur deegar zarooriyaat ka pura karna. Pas mard fi-nafsihi bhi afzal hai aur ba-aitibar-e-nafa ke aur haajat-barari ke bhi us ka darja bada hai. Isi bina par mard ko aurat par sardar muqarrar kiya gaya, jaise aur jagah farman hai: (وَلِلرِّجَالِ عَلَيْهِنَّ دَرَجَةٌ ۭ وَاللّٰهُ عَزِيْزٌ حَكِيْمٌ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 228).

Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke aurton ko mardon ki itaat karni padegi, us ke baal-bachon ki nigahdasht, us ke maal ki hifazat waghera us ka kaam hai. Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain, ek aurat ne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne apne khawand ki shikayat ki. Ek Ansari (R.A) apni biwi sahiba ko liye hue hazir-e-khidmat hue, us aurat ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha: Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Mere is khawand ne mujhe thappad mara hai. Pas aap ne badla lene ka hukm diya hi tha jo yeh aayat utri aur badla na dilwaya gaya. Ek aur riwayat hai ke ek Ansari (R.A) apni biwi sahiba ko liye hue hazir-e-khidmat hue, us aurat ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha: Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Mere is khawand ne mujhe thappad mara jis ka nishan ab tak mere chehre par maujood hai. Aap ne farmaya: Use haq na tha. Wahin yeh aayat utri ke adab sikhane ke liye mard aurton par hakim hain. To aap ne farmaya: Main ne aur chaha tha aur Allah Ta'ala ne aur chaha.

Shu'ba (R.H) farmate hain maal kharch karne se murad mehar ka ada karna hai. Dekho agar mard aurat par zina-kari ki tohmat lagaye to li'an ka hukm hai aur agar aurat apne mard ki nisbat yeh baat kahe aur sabit na kar sake to use kode lagenge. Pas aurton mein se nek-nafs woh hain jo apne khawandon ki itaat-guzar hon, apne nafs aur khawand ke maal ki hifazat-waliyan hon, jise khud Allah Ta'ala ne mehfooz rakhne ka hukm diya hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Behtar aurat woh hai ke jab us ka khawand us ki taraf dekhe woh use khush kar de aur jab hukm de baja laye aur jab kahin bahar jaye to apne nafs ko burai se mehfooz rakhe aur apne khawand ke maal ki muhafizat kare. Phir aap ne is aayat ki tilawat farmai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke aap ne is aayat ki tilawat farmai.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jab koi paanchon waqt namaz ada kare, Ramzan ke rozay rakhe, apni sharmgah ki hifazat kare, apne khawand ki farmanbardari kare, us se kaha jaye ga ke Jannat ke jis darwaze se tu chahe Jannat mein chali ja. Phir farmaya jin aurton ki sarkashi se daro yani jo tum se buland hona chahti ho, nafarmani karti ho, be-parwahi barat-ti ho, dushmani rakhti ho, toh pehle toh use zabani nasihat karo, har tarah samjhao, utaar charhao batao, Allah ka khauf dilao, huqooq-e-zaujiat yaad dilao. Us se kaho ke dekho khawand ke itne huqooq hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke agar main kisi ko hukm kar sakta ke woh maswa-e-Allah Ta'ala ke dusre ko sajda kare, toh aurat ko hukm karta ke woh apne khawand ko sajda kare. Woh apne shohar ko sajda kare kyunke sab se bada haq us par usi ka hai. Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke jab koi shakhs apni biwi ko apne bistare par bulaye aur woh inkar kar de, toh subah tak farishtay us par laanat bhejte rehte hain. Sahih Muslim mein hai ke jis raat koi aurat rooth kar apne khawand ke bistar ko chhore rahe, toh subah tak Allah ki rahmat ke farishtay us par laanatein nazil karte rehte hain. Toh yahan irshad farmata hai ke aisi nafarman aurton ko pehle toh samjhao bujhao, phir bistaron se alag karo. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yani sulaye toh bistar hi par magar khud us se karwat mod le aur mujamat na kare, baat cheet aur kalam bhi tark kar sakta hai aur yeh aurat ki badi bhari saza hai. Baaz mufassireen farmate hain saath sulana hi chhor de. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal hota hai ke aurat ka haq us ke miyan par kya hai? Farmaya yeh ke jab tu kha toh use bhi khila, jab tu pehan toh use bhi pehna, us ke munh par na maar, galiyan na de aur ghar se alag na kar. Gussa mein agar tu us se bator-e-saza baat cheet tark kare toh bhi use ghar se na nikal. Phir farmaya us se bhi agar theek thaak na ho toh tumhein ijazat hai ke yunhi si daant-dapat aur maar-peet se bhi rah-e-raast par lao. Sahih Muslim mein Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke Hujjat-ul-Wida ke khutba mein hai ke aurton ke bare mein farmaya Allah Ta'ala se darte raha karo, woh tumhari khidmat-guzar aur matahat hain. Tumhara haq un par yeh hai ke jis ke aane jaane se tum khafa ho use na aane dein, agar woh aisa na karein toh unhein yunhi se tanbeeh bhi tum kar sakte ho lekin sakht maar jo zahir ho nahin maar sakte. Tum par un ka haq yeh hai ke unhein khilate pilate pehnate urhate raho. Pas aisi maar na marni chahiye jis ka nishan baqi rahe, jis se koi uzw toot jaye ya koi zakhm aaye. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke us par bhi agar woh baaz na aaye toh fidiya lo aur talaq de do.

Ek hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah ki londiyon ko maro nahin. Is ke baad ek martaba Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) aaye aur arz karne lage Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) auratein aap ke is hukm ko sun kar bahut si auratein shikayatein le kar An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aayin to aap ne logon se farmaya suno mere paas aurton ki faryad pahunchi yaad rakho tum mein se jo apni aurton ko zad-o-kob karte hain woh achhe aadmi nahin (Abu Dawood waghera). Hazrat Ash'as (R.H) farmate hain ek martaba main Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ka mehman hua ittefaqan us roz miyan-biwi mein kuch nachaqi ho gayi aur Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne apni biwi sahiba ko mara phir mujh se farmane lage Ash'as teen baatein yaad rakh jo main ne An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sun kar yaad rakhi hain ek to yeh ke mard se yeh na poocha jaye ga ke us ne apni aurat ko kis bina par mara? Doosri yeh ke Witr parhe baghair sona mat aur teesri baat rawi ke zehan se nikal gayi (Nasa'i). Phir farmaya agar ab bhi auratein tumhari farmanbardar ban jayen to tum un par kisi qisam ki sakhti na karo na maro peeto na bezari ka izhar karo. Allah bulandiyon aur baraiyon wala hai. Ya'ni agar aurton ki taraf se qasoor sarzad huye baghair ya qasoor ke baad theek ho jane ke bawajood bhi tum ne unhein sataya to yaad rakho un ki madad par un ka inteqam lene ke liye Allah Ta'ala hai aur yaqeenan woh bahut zor-o-zabardast hai.

Miyan biwi musalahat ki koshish aur islah ke usool. Upar is surat ko bayan farmaya ke agar nafarmani aur kaj-bahsi aurton ki janib se ho, ab yahan is surat ka bayan ho raha hai ke agar dono ek dusre se nalan hon to kya kiya jaye? Pas Ulama-e-Kiram farmate hain ke aisi halat mein hakim siqa samajhdar shakhs ko muqarrar kare jo yeh dekhe ke zulm-o-ziyadti kis tarah se hai? Is zalim ko zulm se roke, agar is par bhi koi behtari ki surat na nikle to aurat walon mein se ek uski taraf se aur mard walon mein se ek behtar shakhs uski janib se munsif muqarrar kar de aur dono mil kar tahqiqat karein aur jis amr mein maslahat samjhein uska faisla kar dein, yani khwah alag kara dein khwah mel-milap kara dein, lekin shari' ne to isi amr ki taraf targheeb dilayi hai ke jahan tak ho sake koshish karein ke koi shakal nibah ki nikal aaye. Agar un dono ki tahqiq mein khawand ki taraf se burayi bahut ho to uski aurat ko us se alag kar lein aur use majboor karenge ke apni aadat theek hone tak us se alag rahe aur uske kharch-o-akhrajat ada karta rahe aur agar shararat aurat ki taraf se sabit ho to use nan-o-nafaqa nahin dilayein aur khawand se hansi khushi basar karne par majboor karenge. Isi tarah agar woh talaq ka faisla dein to khawand ko talaq deni padegi, agar woh aapas mein basne ka faisla karein to bhi unhein manna padega. Balkeh Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain agar dono panch is amr par muttafiq honge ke unhein razamandi ke sath ek dusre se apne talluqat nibhane chahiyein aur is faisle ke baad ek ka inteqal ho gaya to jo razi tha woh uski jaidad ka waris banega lekin jo naraz tha use uska virsa nahin milega (Ibn-e-Jarir). Ek aise hi jhagde mein Hazrat Usman (R.A) ne Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) aur Hazrat Mu'awiyah (R.A) ko munsif muqarrar kiya tha aur farmaya tha ke agar tum in mein mel-milap karna chaho to mel hoga aur agar judayi karana chaho to judayi ho jayegi. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Aqeel bin Abu Talib ne Fatimah bint-e-Utbah bin Rabi'ah se nikah kiya to usne kaha to woh puchti Utbah bin Rabi'ah aur Shaibah bin Rabi'ah kahan hain?

Yeh farmate teri baayin janib jahannam mein, is par woh bigar kar apne kapre theek kar letin. Ek martaba Hazrat Usman R.A ke paas aayin aur waqia bayan kiya, Khalifatul Muslimeen is par hanse aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A aur Hazrat Muawiyah R.A ko un ka panch muqarrar kiya. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A toh farmate the in dono mein alaihadgi kara di jaye, lekin Hazrat Muawiyah R.A farmate the, Bani Abd-e-Manaf mein yeh alaihadgi main napasand karta hoon. Ab yeh dono hazrat Hazrat Aqeel R.A ke ghar aaye, dekha toh darwaza band hai aur dono miyan-biwi andar hain, yeh dono laut gaye. Musnad-e-Abdur Razzaq mein hai ke Hazrat Ali R.A ki khilafat ke zamane mein ek miyan-biwi apni nachaqi ka jhagda le kar aaye, us ke sath us ki baradri ke log the aur us ke hamrah us ke gharane ke log bhi. Ali R.A ne dono jamaton mein se ek-ek ko chuna aur unhein munsif muqarrar kar diya, phir dono panchon se kaha jante bhi ho tumhara kaam kya hai? Tumhara mansab yeh hai ke agar chaho dono mein ittefaq kara do aur agar chaho toh alag-alag kara do. Yeh sun kar aurat ne toh kaha main Allah Ta'ala ke faisle par raazi hoon khwah milaap ki surat mein ho ya judai ki surat mein. Mard kehne laga mujhe judai namanzur hai, is par Hazrat Ali R.A ne farmaya nahin nahin Allah ki qasam tujhe dono suratein manzoor karni paren gi. Pas ulama ka ijma hai ke aisi surat mein un dono munsifon ko dono ikhtiyar hain, yahan tak ke Hazrat Ibrahim Nakh'i R.H farmate hain ke unhein ijtima ka ikhtiyar hai tafreeq ka nahin. Hazrat Imam Malik R.H se bhi yahi qaul marwi hai, haan Ahmad, Abu Saur aur Dawood ka bhi yahi mazhab hai. Un ki daleel (In yureeda islahan yuwaffiqillahu bainahuma) (Surah An-Nisa: 35) wala jumla hai ke un mein tafreeq ka zikr nahin. Haan agar yeh dono dono janib se wakeel hain toh beshak un ka hukm jam'a aur tafreeq dono mein naafiz hoga. Is mein kisi ko phir yeh bhi khayal rahe ke yeh dono panch hakim ki janib se muqarrar honge aur faisla karenge chahe un se fareeqain naraz hon ya yeh dono miyan-biwi ki taraf se un ko banaye hue wakeel honge. Jamhoor ka mazhab toh pehla hai aur daleel yeh hai ke un ka naam Quran-e-Hakeem ne 'Hakam' rakha hai aur hakam ke faisle se koi khush ya na-khush bahar-surat us ka faisla qat'i hoga. Aayat ke zahiri alfaaz bhi jamhoor ke sath hi hain, Imam Shafi'i R.H ka naya qaul bhi yahi hai aur Imam Abu Hanifa aur un ke as-haab ka bhi yahi qaul hai. Lekin mukhalif garoh kehta hai ke agar yeh hakam ki surat mein hote toh phir Hazrat Ali R.A us khawand ko kyun farmate? Ke jis tarah aurat ne dono suraton ko manne ka iqrar kiya hai aur isi tarah tu bhi na maane toh tu jhoota hai. Wallahu A'lam. Imam Ibn-e-Abdul Barr R.H farmate hain ulama-e-kiram ka ijma hai ke dono panchon ka qaul jab mukhtalif ho toh dusre ke qaul ka koi aitbaar nahin aur is amr par bhi ijma hai ke yeh ittefaq karana chahein toh un ka faisla naafiz hai, haan agar woh judai karana chahein toh bhi un ka faisla naafiz hai ya nahin?

Is mein ikhtilaf hai lekin jamhoor ka mazhab yahi hai ke is mein bhi un ka faisla naafiz hai go unhein wakeel na banaya gaya ho.

Huqooq-ul-Ibad aur Huqooq-ullah. Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala apni ibadat ka hukum deta hai aur apni tauheed ke manne ko farmata hai aur apne sath kisi ko shareek karne se rokta hai, is liye ke jab Khaliq, Razzaq, ne'matein dene wala, tamam makhlooq par har waqt aur har haal mein inaam ki barish barsane wala sirf wahi hai to laiq-e-ibadat bhi sirf wahi hua. Hazrat Mu'az (R.A) se Janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ) bahut zyada janne wale hain, aap ne farmaya: "Yeh ke woh usi ki ibadat karein, usi ke sath kisi ko shareek na thahrayein, phir farmaya jante ho jab bande yeh karein to un ka haq Allah Ta'ala ke zimme kya hai? Yeh ke unhein woh azab na kare." Phir farmata hai maa-baap ke sath ehsan karte raho, wahi tumhare adam se wajood mein aane ka sabab bane hain. Quran-e-Kareem ki bahut si aayaton mein Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala ne apni ibadat ke sath hi maa-baap se sulook-o-ehsan karne ka hukum diya hai, jaise farmaya: (Anishkur li waliwalidayk) (Surah Luqman: 14) aur (Waqada Rabbuka alla ta'budu illa iyyahu wa bilwalidayni ihsana) (Surah Al-Isra: 23). Yahan bhi yeh bayan farma kar phir hukum deta hai ke apne rishtedaron se bhi sulook-o-ehsan karte raho. Hadees mein hai maskeen aur sadqa dena aur sila-rehmi karna bhi isi husn-e-sulook ki shakh hai. Phir hukum hota hai ke yateemon ke sath bhi sulook-o-ehsan karo, is liye ke un ki khabar-geeri karne wala, un ke sar par mohabbat se hath pherne wala, un ke naaz-laad uthane wala, nahin mohabbat ke sath khilane pilane wala un ke sar se uth gaya hai. Phir maskeenon ke sath neki karne ka irshad kiya ke woh haajat-mand hain, hath mein mohtaj hain, un ki zarooratein tum poori karo, un ki ehtiyaaj tum rafa karo, un ke kaam tum kar diya karo. Faqeer-o-maskeen ka poora bayan Surah Bara'at ki tafseer mein aayega Insha'Allah. Padosiyon ke huqooq: Apne padosiyon ka khayal rakho, un ke sath bhi bartao aur nek sulook rakho, khwah woh qarabat-dar hon ya na hon, khwah Musalman ya Yahood-o-Nasrani hon. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke 'Jaar-e-Zil-Qurba' se murad biwi hai aur 'Jaar-ul-Junub' se murad mard rafeeq-e-safar hai. Padosiyon ke haq mein bahut si hadeesein aayi hain, kuch sun lijiye. Musnad-e-Ahmed mein bayan hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain: "Mujhe Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) padosiyon ke bare mein yahan tak wasiyat-o-nasihat karte hain ke mujhe guman hua ke shayad yeh padosiyon ko waris bana denge." Farmate hain: "Behtar saathi Allah ke nazdeek woh hai jo apne hamrahiyon ke sath khush-sulook zyada ho aur padosiyon ko waris bana denge." Farmate hain: "Behtar saathi Allah ke nazdeek woh hai jo hamsayon se nek sulook mein zyada ho." Farmate hain: "Insaan ko na chahiye ke apne padosi ki aasoodgi baghair khud shikam-seer ho jaye." Ek martaba aap (ﷺ) ne Sahaba (R.A) se sawal kiya: "Zina ke bare mein tum kya kehte ho?"

Logon ne kaha woh haram hai, Allah ne aur uske Rasool ne ise haram kiya hai aur Qayamat tak woh haram hi rahega. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya suno, das auraton se zinakari karne wala us shakhs ke gunah se kam gunahgar hai jo apne padosi ki aurat se zina kare. Phir daryaft farmaya tum chori ki nisbat kya kehte ho? Unhon ne jawab diya ke ise bhi Allah Ta'ala ne aur uske Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne haram kiya hai aur woh bhi Qayamat tak haram hai. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya suno, das gharon se chori karne wale ka gunah us shakhs ke gunah se halka hai jo apne padosi ke ghar se kuch churaye. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) sawal karte hain ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Kaun sa gunah sab se bada hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Yeh ke tu Allah ke sath shareek thehraye halankeh usi ek ne tujhe paida kiya hai. Main ne poocha phir kaun sa? Farmaya: Yeh ke tu apni padosan se zinakari kare.

Ek Ansari Sahabi (R.A) farmate hain, An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hone ke liye ghar se chala, wahan pahunch kar dekhta hoon ke ek sahib khade hain aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) un ki taraf mutawajjeh hain. Main ne khayal kiya ke shayad unhein aap se kuch kaam hoga. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khade hain aur un se baatein ho rahi hain, badi der ho gayi yahan tak ke mujhe aap ke thak jaane ke khayal ne bechain kar diya. Bahut der ke baad aap laute aur mere paas aaye. Main ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Tum ne unhein dekha? Main ne kaha haan, khoob achi tarah dekha. Farmaya: Jaante ho woh kaun the? Woh Jibraeel (A.S) the, mujhe padosiyon ke huqooq ki takeed karte rahe yahan tak un ke huqooq bayan kiye ke mujhe khatka hua ke ghaliban aaj toh padosi ko waris thehra denge (Musnad-e-Ahmad).

Musnad-e-Abd bin Humaid mein hai, Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain, ek shakhs Awali-e-Madina se aaya, us waqt Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur Hazrat Jibraeel (Alaihis Salam) us jagah namaz padh rahe the jahan janazon ki namaz padhi jaati hai. Jab aap farigh hue toh us shakhs ne kaha, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath yeh doosra shakhs kaun namaz padh raha tha? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Tum ne unhein dekha? Us ne kaha haan. Farmaya: Tu ne bahut badi bhalai dekhi, yeh Jibraeel (A.S) the, mujhe padosi ke baare mein wasiyat karte rahe yahan tak ke main ne dekha ke anqareeb ise waris bana denge.

Aathvin hadith Bazzar mein hai, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Padosi teen qisam ke hain, ek haq wale yani adna, do haq wale aur teen haq wale yani aala. Ek haq wala woh hai jo mushrik ho aur us se rishtedari na ho. Do haq wala woh hai jo Musalman ho aur rishtedar na ho, ek haq Islam, doosra haq pados. Teen haq wala woh hai jo Musalman bhi ho, padosi bhi ho aur rishte naate ka bhi ho, toh haq-e-Islam, haq-e-hamsayegi, haq-e-silah-rehmi, teen teen haq us ke ho gaye. Hadith Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft kiya ke mere do padosi hain, main ek ko hadiya bhejna chahti hoon toh kise bhejwaoon? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Jis ka darwaza qareeb ho.

Daswin hadith Tabrani mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne wazu kiya, logon ne aap ke wazu ke pani ko lena aur malna shuru kiya. Aap ne poocha aisa kyun karte ho? Unhon ne kaha Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ) ki mohabbat mein. Aap ne farmaya jisay yeh khush lagay ke Allah aur us ka Rasool us se mohabbat karein to usay chahiye ke jab baat kare sach kare aur jab amanat diya jaye to ada kare. (Tafsir Ibn Kathir mein yeh hadith yahin par khatam hai lekin shayad agla jumla is ka sahwan reh gaya hai jis ka sahi talluq is masla se hai woh yeh ke usay chahiye parosi ke sath sulook-o-ehsan kare. Mutarjim). Gyarhwin hadith Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Qayamat ke din sab se pehle jo jhagda Allah ke samne pesh hoga woh do parosiyon ka hoga. Phir hukm hota hai sahib-bil-jannat ke sath sulook karne ka. Is se murad bohat se mufassireen ke nazdeek aurat hai aur bohat se farmate hain murad safar ka sathi hai aur yeh bhi marwi hai ke is se murad dost aur sathi hai aam is se ke safar mein ho ya qayam ki halat mein. Ibn-e-Sabeel se murad mehman hai aur yeh bhi jo safar mein kahin theher gaya ho, agar mehman bhi yahan murad li jaye ke safar mein jate jate mehman bana to dono ek ho gaye, is ka poora bayan Surah Bara'at ki tafsir mein aa raha hai Insha'Allah Ta'ala.

Ghulamon ke bare mein ehkamat:
Phir ghulamon ke bare mein farmaya ja raha hai ke un ke sath bhi nek sulook rakho is liye ke woh ghareeb tumhare hathon aseer hai, us par to tumhara kamil ikhtiyar hai to tumhein chahiye ke us par reham khao aur us ki zaroorat ka apne imkan bhar khayal rakho. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) to apne aakhri marz-ul-maut mein bhi apni ummat ko is ki wasiyat farma gaye, farmate hain: Logon namaz ka aur ghulamon ka khoob khayal rakhna, baar baar isi ko farmate rahe yahan tak ke zaban rukne lagi. Musnad ki hadith mein hai aap farmate hain to jo khud khaye woh bhi sadaqa hai, jo apne bachon ko khilaye woh bhi sadaqa hai, jo apni biwi ko khilaye woh bhi sadaqa hai, jo apne khadim ko khilaye woh bhi sadaqa hai. Muslim mein hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) ne ek martaba darogha se farmaya ke kya ghulamon ko tum ne un ki khorak de di?

Us ne kaha ab tak nahin di. Farmaya jao de kar aao. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya hai insaan ko yahi gunah kaafi hai ke jin ki khorak ka woh maalik hai un se rok rakhe. Muslim mein hai mamlooka matahat ka haq hai ke use khilaya pilaya pehnaya urhaya jaye aur us ki taqat se zyada kaam us se na liya jaye. Bukhari Sharif mein hai jab tum mein se kisi ka khadim us ka khana le kar aaye to tumhein chahiye ke agar sath bitha kar nahin khilate to kam az kam use luqma do luqma de do, khayal karo ke us ne pakane ki garmi aur takleef uthayi hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke chahiye to yeh ke use apne sath bitha kar khilaye aur agar khana kam ho to luqma do luqmay hi de diya karo. Aap farmate hain tumhare ghulam bhi tumhare bhai hain, Allah Ta'ala ne unhein tumhare matahat kar diya hai, pas jis ke hath talay us ka bhai ho use apne khane se khilaye aur apne pehne mein se pehnaye aur aisa kaam na kare ke woh aajiz ho jaye, agar koi aisa hi mushkil kaam aapade to khud bhi us ka sath de (Bukhari, Muslim). Phir farmaya ke khudbeen, mu'ajib, mutakabbir, khud pasand, logon par apni fauqiyat jatane wala, apne aap ko tolne wala, apne tayin dusron se behtar janne wala Allah ka pasandida banda nahin. Woh go apne aap ko bada samjhe lekin Allah Ta'ala ke han woh zaleel hai, logon ki nazron mein woh haqeer hai. Bhala kitna andher hai ke khud to agar kisi se sulook kare to apna ehsan us par rakhe lekin Rabb ki nematon ka jo Allah Ta'ala ne use de rakhi hain shukr baja na laye, logon mein baith kar fakhr kare ke main itna bada aadmi hoon mere paas yeh bhi hai aur woh bhi hai. Hazrat Abu Raja Harvi (R.H) farmate hain ke har bad-khulq mutakabbir aur khud pasand hota hai, phir isi aayat ko tilawat kiya aur farmaya har maa baap ka nafarman sarkash aur bad-naseeb hota hai, phir aap ne (وَاجْعَلْنِيْ بَرًّاۢ بِوَالِدَتِيْ ۡ وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِيْ جَبَّارًا شَقِيًّا) (19. Maryam: 32) padhi. Hazrat Awam bin Haushab (R.H) bhi yahi farmate hain. Hazrat Mutarrif (R.H) farmate hain mujhe Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) ki ek riwayat mili thi, mere dil mein tamanna thi ke kisi waqt khud Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) se mil kar is riwayat ko unhi ki zabani sunoon, chunancha ek martaba mulaqat ho gayi to main ne kaha mujhe yeh khabar mili hai ke aap Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki ek hadith bayan farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala teen qisam ke logon ko dost rakhta hai aur teen qisam ke logon ko na-pasand farmata hai. Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) ne farmaya haan yeh sach hai, main bhala apne Khaleel (ﷺ) par bohtan kaise bandh sakta hoon? Aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya ise to tum Kitabullah mein paate bhi ho. Banu Hujeem ka ek shakhs Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ) se kehta hai mujhe kuch nasihat kijiye, aap ne farmaya kapda takhne se neecha na latkao kyunke yeh takabbur aur khud pasandi hai jise Allah na-pasand rakhta hai.

Allah Ta'ala ki rah mein kharch se katrane wale bakhil log. Irshad hota hai ke jo log Allah ki khushnudi ke mauqa par maal kharch karne se ji churate hain maslan maa baap ko dena, qarabat-daron se achha sulook nahin karte, yateem, maskeen, padosi, rishtedar, ghair rishtedar padosi, saathi, musafir, ghulam aur mat-hat ko un ki mohtaji ke waqt fi sabilillah nahin dete, itna hi nahin balkeh logon ko bhi bukhal aur fi sabilillah kharch na karne ka mashwara dete hain. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai kaunsi bimari bukhal ki bimari se barh kar hai? Aur hadith mein hai logo bakhili se bacho isi ne tum se aglon ko takht-o-taraj kiya, isi ke baais un se qata-rehmi aur fisq-o-fujoor jaise bure kaam numaya hue. Phir farmaya yeh log in dono buraiyon ke sath hi sath ek teesri burai ke bhi murtakib hain yani Allah ki nematon ko chupate hain, unhein zahir nahin karte, na un ke khane peene mein woh zahir hoti hain, na pehne orhne mein, na dene lene mein. Jaise aur jagah hai (Innal insana lirabbihi lakanood, wa innahu ala zalika lashahid) (Surah Al-Adiyat: 6-7) yani insan apne Rab ka nashukra hai aur woh khud hi apni is halat aur is khaslat par gawah hai. Phir (Wa innahu lihubbil khairi lashadeed) (Surah Al-Adiyat: 8) woh maal ki mohabbat mein mast hai, pas yahan bhi farman hai ke Allah ke fazl ko yeh chupata rehta hai. Phir unhein dhamkaya jata hai ke kafiron ke liye hum ne ihanat-amez azab tayyar kar rakhe hain. Kufr ke ma'ani hain posheeda rakhna aur chhupa lena, pas bakhil bhi Allah ki nematon ka chupane wala, un par parda daal rakhne wala, balkeh un ka inkar karne wale qarar diye gaye hain, pas woh nematon ka kafir hua. Hadith mein hai Allah jab kisi bande par apni nemat in'am farmata hai to chahta hai ke us ka asar us par zahir ho. Dua-e-Nabvi (ﷺ) mein hai (Hadith: Waj'alna shakireena lini'matika muthneena biha alaika qabiliha wa atimmaha alaina) Aye Allah! Hamein apni nematon par shukr-guzar bana aur un ki wajah se hamein apna sana-khwan bana, un ka qabool karne wala bana aur un ki nematon ko hamein bharpoor ata farma. Ba'az salaf ka qaul hai ke yeh ayat yahudiyon ke us bukhal ke bare mein hai jo woh apni kitab mein Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ) ki sifat ke chupane mein karte the, isi liye is ke aakhir mein hai ke kafiron ke liye zillat-amez azab hum ne tayyar kar rakhe hain. Koi shak nahin ke is ayat ka itlaq un par bhi ho sakta hai lekin yeh bazahir yahan maal ka bukhal bayan ho raha hai go ilm ka bukhal bhi is mein bator-e-aula dakhil hai. Khayal kijiye ke bayan-e-ayat aqriba-o-zu'afa ko maal dene ke bare mein hai, isi tarah is ke baad wali ayat mein riyakari ke taur par fi sabilillah maal dene ki muzammat bhi bayan ki ja rahi hai.

Pehle un ka bayan hua jo mumsik aur bakheel hain, kori kori ko danton se thaam rakhte hain, phir un ka bayan hua jo dete toh hain lekin badniyati aur duniya mein apni wah-wah hone ki khatir dete hain. Chunancha ek hadith mein hai ke jin teen qisam ke logon se jahannam ki aag sulgayi jayegi woh yahi riyakar honge; riyakar aalim, riyakar ghazi, riyakar sakhi. Aisa sakhi kahega, "Bari Ta'ala! Teri har har rah mein main ne apna maal kharch kiya." Toh use Allah Ta'ala ki janab se jawab milega ke, "Tu jhoota hai, tera irada toh sirf yeh tha ke tu sakhi aur jawad mashhoor ho jaye." So woh ho chuka, yani tera maqsood duniya ki shohrat thi, woh main ne tujhe duniya mein hi de chuka, pas teri murad hasil ho chuki. Aur hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Adi bin Hatim (R.A) se farmaya ke tere baap ne apni sakhawat se jo chahta tha woh use mil gaya. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal hota hai ke Abdullah bin Jud'an toh bada sakhi tha jis ne masakeen-o-fuqra ke sath bade sulook kiye aur nam-e-Allah bahut se ghulam azad kiye, toh kya use in ka nafa na milega? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Nahin, us ne toh umr bhar mein ek din bhi na kaha ke ae Allah! Mere gunahon ko Qayamat ke din maaf farma dena." Isi liye yahan bhi farmata hai ke un ka iman Allah aur Qayamat par nahin, warna shaitan ke phande mein na phans jate aur bad ko bhala na samajh baithte. Yeh shaitan ke sathi hain aur shaitan un ka sathi hai. Sathi ki burai par un ki burai bhi soch lo. Arab shayar kehta hai:
Anil mar'i la tas'al wa sal an qareenihi, fakullu qareenin bil muqarini yaqtadi.
Insaan ke bare mein na pooch, us ke sathiyon ka haal daryaft kar le. Har sathi apne sathi ka hi pairu-kar hota hai. Phir irshad farmata hai ke unhein Allah par iman lane aur sahih rah par chalne aur riyakari ko chhod dene aur ikhlas-o-yaqeen par qaim ho jane se kaunsi cheez mani hai? Un ka is mein kya nuqsan hai? Balkeh sarasar faida hai ke un ki aaqibat sanwar jayegi. Yeh kyun Allah ki rah mein maal kharch karne se tang-dili kar rahe hain? Allah ki mohabbat aur us ki razamandi hasil karne ki koshish kyun nahin karte? Allah unhein khoob janta hai, un ki bhali aur buri niyaton ka use ilm hai. Ahl-e-taufeeq aur ghair ahl-e-taufeeq sab us par zahir hain. Woh bhalon ko amal-e-saleh ki taufeeq ata farma kar apni khushnudi ke kaam un se le kar apni qurbat unhein ata farmata hai aur buron ko apni aali janab aur zabardast sarkari se dhakel deta hai jis se un ki duniya aur aakhirat barbad hoti hai, Aiyazubillahi min zalik.

Allah Ta'ala ki rah mein kharch se katrane wale bakhil log. Jaise aur jagah hai (Innal insana lirabbihi lakanood, wa innahu ala zalika lashahid) (Surah Al-Adiyat: 6-7) yani insan apne Rab ka nashukra hai aur woh khud hi apni is halat aur is khaslat par gawah hai. Phir (Wa innahu lihubbil khairi lashadeed) (Surah Al-Adiyat: 8) woh maal ki mohabbat mein mast hai, pas yahan bhi farman hai ke Allah ke fazl ko yeh chupata rehta hai. Phir unhein dhamkaya jata hai ke kafiron ke liye hum ne ihanat-amez azab tayyar kar rakhe hain. Kufr ke ma'ani hain posheeda rakhna aur chhupa lena, pas bakhil bhi Allah ki nematon ka chupane wala, un par parda daal rakhne wala, balkeh un ka inkar karne wale qarar diye gaye hain, pas woh nematon ka kafir hua. Hadith mein hai Allah jab kisi bande par apni nemat in'am farmata hai to chahta hai ke us ka asar us par zahir ho. Dua-e-Nabvi (ﷺ) mein hai (Hadith: Waj'alna shakireena lini'matika muthneena biha alaika qabiliha wa atimmaha alaina) Aye Allah! Hamein apni nematon par shukr-guzar bana aur un ki wajah se hamein apna sana-khwan bana, un ka qabool karne wala bana aur un ki nematon ko hamein bharpoor ata farma. Ba'az salaf ka qaul hai ke yeh ayat yahudiyon ke us bukhal ke bare mein hai jo woh apni kitab mein Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ) ki sifat ke chupane mein karte the, isi liye is ke aakhir mein hai ke kafiron ke liye zillat-amez azab hum ne tayyar kar rakhe hain. Koi shak nahin ke is ayat ka itlaq un par bhi ho sakta hai lekin yeh bazahir yahan maal ka bukhal bayan ho raha hai go ilm ka bukhal bhi is mein bator-e-aula dakhil hai. Khayal kijiye ke bayan-e-ayat aqriba-o-zu'afa ko maal dene ke bare mein hai, isi tarah is ke baad wali ayat mein riyakari ke taur par fi sabilillah maal dene ki muzammat bhi bayan ki ja rahi hai.

Pehle un ka bayan hua jo mumsik aur bakheel hain, kori kori ko danton se thaam rakhte hain, phir un ka bayan hua jo dete toh hain lekin badniyati aur duniya mein apni wah-wah hone ki khatir dete hain. Chunancha ek hadith mein hai ke jin teen qisam ke logon se jahannam ki aag sulgayi jayegi woh yahi riyakar honge; riyakar aalim, riyakar ghazi, riyakar sakhi. Aisa sakhi kahega, "Bari Ta'ala! Teri har har rah mein main ne apna maal kharch kiya." Toh use Allah Ta'ala ki janab se jawab milega ke, "Tu jhoota hai, tera irada toh sirf yeh tha ke tu sakhi aur jawad mashhoor ho jaye." So woh ho chuka, yani tera maqsood duniya ki shohrat thi, woh main ne tujhe duniya mein hi de chuka, pas teri murad hasil ho chuki. Aur hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Adi bin Hatim (R.A) se farmaya ke tere baap ne apni sakhawat se jo chahta tha woh use mil gaya. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal hota hai ke Abdullah bin Jud'an toh bada sakhi tha jis ne masakeen-o-fuqra ke sath bade sulook kiye aur nam-e-Allah bahut se ghulam azad kiye, toh kya use in ka nafa na milega? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Nahin, us ne toh umr bhar mein ek din bhi na kaha ke ae Allah! Mere gunahon ko Qayamat ke din maaf farma dena." Isi liye yahan bhi farmata hai ke un ka iman Allah aur Qayamat par nahin, warna shaitan ke phande mein na phans jate aur bad ko bhala na samajh baithte. Yeh shaitan ke sathi hain aur shaitan un ka sathi hai. Sathi ki burai par un ki burai bhi soch lo. Arab shayar kehta hai:
Anil mar'i la tas'al wa sal an qareenihi, fakullu qareenin bil muqarini yaqtadi.
Insaan ke bare mein na pooch, us ke sathiyon ka haal daryaft kar le. Har sathi apne sathi ka hi pairu-kar hota hai. Phir irshad farmata hai ke unhein Allah par iman lane aur sahih rah par chalne aur riyakari ko chhod dene aur ikhlas-o-yaqeen par qaim ho jane se kaunsi cheez mani hai? Un ka is mein kya nuqsan hai? Balkeh sarasar faida hai ke un ki aaqibat sanwar jayegi. Yeh kyun Allah ki rah mein maal kharch karne se tang-dili kar rahe hain? Allah ki mohabbat aur us ki razamandi hasil karne ki koshish kyun nahin karte? Allah unhein khoob janta hai, un ki bhali aur buri niyaton ka use ilm hai. Ahl-e-taufeeq aur ghair ahl-e-taufeeq sab us par zahir hain. Woh bhalon ko amal-e-saleh ki taufeeq ata farma kar apni khushnudi ke kaam un se le kar apni qurbat unhein ata farmata hai aur buron ko apni aali janab aur zabardast sarkari se dhakel deta hai jis se un ki duniya aur aakhirat barbad hoti hai, Aiyazubillahi min zalik.

Allah Ta'ala ki rah mein kharch se katrane wale bakhil log. Irshad hota hai ke jo log Allah ki khushnudi ke mauqa par maal kharch karne se ji churate hain maslan maa baap ko dena, qarabat-daron se achha sulook nahin karte, yateem, maskeen, padosi, rishtedar, ghair rishtedar padosi, saathi, musafir, ghulam aur mat-hat ko un ki mohtaji ke waqt fi sabilillah nahin dete, itna hi nahin balkeh logon ko bhi bukhal aur fi sabilillah kharch na karne ka mashwara dete hain. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai kaunsi bimari bukhal ki bimari se barh kar hai? Aur hadith mein hai logo bakhili se bacho isi ne tum se aglon ko takht-o-taraj kiya, isi ke baais un se qata-rehmi aur fisq-o-fujoor jaise bure kaam numaya hue. Phir farmaya yeh log in dono buraiyon ke sath hi sath ek teesri burai ke bhi murtakib hain yani Allah ki nematon ko chupate hain, unhein zahir nahin karte, na un ke khane peene mein woh zahir hoti hain, na pehne orhne mein, na dene lene mein.
