Bemisaal kharidar? Bari Ta'ala Rabb-ul-Alameen farmata hai ke main kisi par zulm nahin karta, kisi ki neki ko zaya nahin karta, balkay barha charha kar Qayamat ke roz is ka ajar-o-sawab ata farmaunga jaise aur ayat mein hai (Wa nada'ul mawazinal qista liyawmil qiyamati fala tuzlamu nafsun shai'an) (21. Al-Anbiya: 47) hum adl ki tarazu rakhenge. Aur farmaya ke Hazrat Luqman ne apne sahibzaday se farmaya tha (Ya bunayya innaha in taku misqala habbatin min khardalin fatakun fi sakhratin aw fis samawati aw fil ardi ya'ti bihallah, innallaha Latifun Khabir) (31. Luqman: 16) ae betay agar koi cheez rai ke danay barabar ho go woh kisi patthar mein ya asmanon mein ho ya zameen ke andar ho Allah usey la hazir karega, beshak Allah Ta'ala bareek been kharidar hai. Aur jagah farmaya (Yawma'izin yassdurun nasu ashtatan liyuraw a'malahum) (99. Az-Zalzalah: 6) us din log apne mukhtalif ahwal par lautenge taake unhein un ke a'mal dikhaye jayen pas jis ne zarra barabar neki ki hogi woh usey dekh lega aur jis ne zarra barabar burai ki hogi woh usey dekh lega, Bukhari-o-Muslim ki shafa'at ke zikr wali mutawwal hadith mein hai ke phir Allah farmaye ga laut kar jao aur jis ke dil mein rai ke danay barabar iman dekho usey Jahannam se nikal lao. Pas bohat si makhlooq Jahannam se azad hogi Hazrat Abu Saeed R.A yeh hadith bayan farma kar farmate hain agar tum chaho to ayat-e-Qurani ke is jumlay ko parh lo (Innallaha la yazlimu misqala zarratin, wa in taku hasanatan yuda'ifha wa yu'ti mil ladunhu ajran azima) (4. An-Nisa: 40). Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood R.A ka farman marwi hai ke Qayamat ke din kisi Allah ke banday ya bandi ko laya jayega aur ek pukarne wala sab ahl-e-mahshar ko ba-awaz-e-buland suna kar kahega yeh fulan ka beta ya beti hai is ka naam yeh hai jis kisi ka koi haq is ke zimma baqi ho ya aaye aur le jaye us waqt yeh halat hogi ke aurat chahegi ke is ka koi haq is ke baap par ya maa par ya bhai par ya shohar par ho to dor kar aaye aur le rishtay naatay kat jayenge koi kisi ka pursan-e-haal na hoga Allah Ta'ala apna jo haq chahe maaf farma dega lekin logon ke huqooq mein se koi haq maaf na farmaye ga isi tarah jab koi haqdar aayega to fareeq-e-sani se kaha jayega ke in ke haq ada kar yeh kahega duniya to khatam ho chuki aaj mere hath mein kya hai jo main doon?

Pas is ke nek a'maal liye jayenge aur haq-daron ko diye jayenge aur har ek ka haq isi tarah ada kiya jayega. Ab yeh shakhs agar Allah ka dost hai to us ke paas ek rai ke daane barabar neki bach rahegi jise barha charha kar sirf isi ki bina par Allah Ta'ala use jannat mein le jayega. Phir aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat ki aur agar woh banda Allah ka dost nahin hai balkeh badbakht aur sarkash hai to yeh haal hoga keh farishta kahega keh Bari Ta'ala is ki sab nekiyan khatam ho gayin aur abhi haq-dar baqi reh gaye. Hukm hoga keh un ki buraiyan le kar is par laad do phir ise jahannam wasil karo, a'azana Allahu minha. Is mauqoof asar ke ba'az shawahid marfoo ahadees mein bhi maujood hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Ibn-e-Umar R.A ka farman hai keh (aayat "Man ja'a bil-hasanati falahu ashru amsaliha") a'raab ke bare mein utri hai. Is par un se sawal hua keh phir muhajireen ke bare mein kya hai? Aap ne farmaya is se bahut hi achi (Innal-laha la yazlimu misqala zarratin, wa in taku hasanatan yuda'ifha wa yu'ti mil-ladunhu ajran azeema) (Surah An-Nisa: 40). Hazrat Sa'eed bin Jubair R.H farmate hain mushrik ke bhi azabon mein is ke ba'is kami kar di jati hai, haan jahannam se nikle ga to nahin. Chunancha sahih hadees mein hai keh Hazrat Abbas R.A ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se poocha, Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ! Aap ke chacha Abu Talib aap ki pusht-panah bane hue the, aap ko logon ki ezaon se bachate rehte the, aap ki taraf se un se larte the, to kya unhein kuch nafa bhi pahunche ga? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya haan, woh bahut thori si aag mein hai aur agar mera yeh ta'alluq na hota to jahannam ke neeche ke tabqe mein hota. Lekin yeh bahut mumkin hai keh yeh faida sirf Abu Talib ke liye hi ho, ya'ni aur kuffar is hukm mein na hon, is liye keh Musnad-e-Tayalisi ki hadees mein hai Allah Ta'ala momin ki kisi neki par zulm nahin karta, duniya mein rozi waghera ki soorat mein. Us ke paas koi neki na hogi, ajr-e-azeem se murad is aayat mein jannat hai. Allah Ta'ala apne fazl-o-karam, lutf-o-rahm se apni razamandi ata farmaye aur jannat naseeb kare. Ameen. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek ghareeb hadees mein hai Hazrat Abu Usman R.H farmate hain mujhe khabar mili keh Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A ne farmaya hai Allah Ta'ala apne momin bande ko ek neki ke badle ek laakh neki ka sawab dega. Mujhe bara ta'ajjub hua aur main ne kaha Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A se mil kar un se khud pooch aaun. Chunancha main ne saman-e-safar durust kiya aur is riwayat ki chhan-been ke liye rawana hua, maloom hua keh woh to hajj ko gaye hain to main bhi hajj ki niyat se wahan pahuncha. Mulaqat hui to main ne kaha Abu Hurairah R.A! Main ne suna aap ne aisi hadees bayan ki hai? Kya yeh sach hai? Aap ne farmaya kya tumhein ta'ajjub maloom hota hai? Tum ne Quran mein nahin parha?

Keh Allah Ta'ala farmata hai jo shakhs Allah ko achha qarz de Allah usey bahut bahut barha kar inayat farmata hai aur dusri aayat mein sari duniya ko kam kaha gaya hai. Allah Ta'ala ki qasam main ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai keh ek neki ko barha kar us ke badle do lakh milengi. Yeh hadith aur tariqon se bhi marwi hai, phir Qayamat ke din ki sakhti aur holnaki bayan farma raha hai keh us din Anbiya (A.S) ko bator-e-gawah ke pesh kiya jayega jaise aur aayat mein hai (Wa ashraqatil-ardu bi-noori rabbiha wa wudi'al-kitabu wa jee'a bin-nabiyyina wash-shuhada'i wa qudiya bainahum bil-haqqi wa hum la yuzlamun) (Surah Az-Zumar: 69). Zameen apne Rab ke noor se chamakne lagegi, nama-e-aamal diye jayenge aur nabiyon aur gawahon ko la khara karenge. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai keh Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud (R.A) se farmaya mujhe kuch Quran parh kar sunao. Hazrat Abdullah ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main aap ko parh kar sunaunga? Aap par to utra hi hai. Farmaya haan lekin mera jee chahta hai keh dusre se sunun. Pas main ne Surah Nisa ki tilawat shuru ki, parhte parhte jab main ne is aayat "Fa-kaifa" ki tilawat ki to aap ne farmaya bas karo. Main ne dekha keh aap ki aankhon se aansu jaari thay. Hazrat Muhammad bin Fudala Ansari (R.A) farmate hain keh qabila Bani Zafar ke paas Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aaye aur us chattan par baith gaye jo ab tak unke mohalle mein hai. Aap ke sath Ibn Mas'ud (R.A), Mu'adh bin Jabal (R.A) aur deegar Sahaba (R.A) bhi thay. Aap ne ek qari se farmaya Quran parho. Parhte parhte jab is aayat "Fa-kaifa" tak pahuncha to aap is qadar roye keh dono rukhsar aur darhi tar ho gayi aur arz karne lage Ya Rab! Jo maujood hain un par to khair meri gawahi hogi lekin jin logon ko main ne dekha hi nahin un ki babat kaise? (Ibn Abi Hatim). Ibn Jarir mein hai keh aap ne farmaya main un par gawah hoon jab tak keh un mein hoon, pas jab tu mujhe faut karega tab to tu hi un par nigahban hai. Abu Abdullah Qurtubi (R.H) ne apni kitab Tazkirah mein baab bandha hai keh Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki apni ummat par shahadat ke bare mein kya aaya hai? Is mein Hazrat Sa'eed bin Musayyib (R.H) ka yeh qaul laye hain keh har din subh-o-sham Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par aap ki ummat ke aamal pesh kiye jate hain ma' naamon ke, pas aap Qayamat ke din un sab par gawahi denge, phir yahi aayat tilawat farmayi. Lekin awwalan to yeh Hazrat Sa'eed ka khud ka qaul hai, dusre yeh keh is ki sanad mein inqita hai, is mein ek rawi mubham hai jis ka naam hi nahin, teesre yeh keh yeh hadith marfu' ke bayan hi nahin karte. Haan Imam Qurtubi (R.H) ise qabool karte hain, woh is ke lane ke baad farmate hain keh pehle guzar chuka hai keh Allah Ta'ala ke samne har cheez aur har Jumerat ko aamal pesh kiye jate hain, pas woh Anbiya par aur maa-baap par har Jum'a ko pesh kiye jate hain aur is mein koi ta'aruz nahin, mumkin hai keh hamare Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par har Jum'a ko bhi pesh hote hon aur har din bhi. (Theek yahi hai keh yeh baat sehat ke sath sabit nahin, Wallahu A'lam).

Mutarjim) Phir farmata hai ke us din kafir kahega kaash main kisi zameen mein sama jaaun phir zameen barabar ho jaye gi. Kafir na-qabil-e-bardasht holnakiyon, ruswaiyon aur daant-dapat se ghabra uthe ga, jaise aur aayat mein hai (Yawma yanzurul mar'u ma qaddamat yaduhoo wa yaqoolul kafiru ya laytani kuntu turaba) (Surah An-Naba: 40) jis din insaan apne aage bheje hue aamal apni aankhon dekh le ga aur kafir kahega kaash ke main mitti ho gaya hota. Phir farmaya yeh un tamam bad-afaliyon ka us din iqrar karenge jo unhon ne ki thin aur ek cheez bhi posheeda na rakhenge. Ek shakhs ne Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se kaha Hazrat ek jagah to Quran mein hai ke mushrikeen qayamat ke din kahenge (Wallahi Rabbina ma kunna mushrikeen) (Surah Al-An'am: 23) ki qasam Rab ki qasam hum ne shirk nahin kiya aur dusri jagah hai ke (Wa la yaktumoonallaha hadeetha) (Surah An-Nisa: 42) Allah se baat bhi na chhupayenge phir in dono aayaton ka kya matlab hai? Aap ne farmaya is ka aur waqt hai is ka waqt aur hai aur jab muwahidon ko jannat mein jaate hue dekhenge to kahenge aao tum bhi apne shirk ka inkar karo kya ajab kaam chal jaye. Phir un ke munh par mohrein lag jayengi aur haath paanv bolne lagenge ab Allah Ta'ala se ek baat bhi na chhupayenge (Ibn-e-Jareer). Musnad-e-Abdur Razzaq mein hai ke us shakhs ne aa kar kaha tha bahut si cheezein mujh par Quran mein mukhtalif nazar aa rahi hain, Aap ne farmaya kya matlab tujhe kya Quran mein shak hai? Us ne kaha shak to nahin haan meri samajh mein ikhtilaf nazar aa raha hai, Aap ne farmaya jahan jahan ikhtilaf tujhe nazar aaya ho un maqamat ko pesh kar to us ne yeh do aayatein ki tatbeeq samjha di. Ek aur riwayat mein sail ka naam bhi aaya hai ke woh Hazrat Nafi bin Azraq thay yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne un se yeh bhi farmaya ke shayad tum kisi aisi majlis se aa rahe ho jahan in ka tazkira ho raha hoga ya tum ne kiya hoga ke main jaata hoon aur Ibn-e-Abbas se daryaft karta hoon agar mera yeh guman sahi hai to tumhein lazim hai ke jawab sun kar unhein bhi ja kar sunado phir yahi jawab diya.

Bemisaal kharidar? Al-Anbiya: 47) hum adl ki tarazu rakhenge. Luqman: 16) ae betay agar koi cheez rai ke danay barabar ho go woh kisi patthar mein ya asmanon mein ho ya zameen ke andar ho Allah usey la hazir karega, beshak Allah Ta'ala bareek been kharidar hai. Az-Zalzalah: 6) us din log apne mukhtalif ahwal par lautenge taake unhein un ke a'mal dikhaye jayen pas jis ne zarra barabar neki ki hogi woh usey dekh lega aur jis ne zarra barabar burai ki hogi woh usey dekh lega, Bukhari-o-Muslim ki shafa'at ke zikr wali mutawwal hadith mein hai ke phir Allah farmaye ga laut kar jao aur jis ke dil mein rai ke danay barabar iman dekho usey Jahannam se nikal lao. Pas bohat si makhlooq Jahannam se azad hogi Hazrat Abu Saeed R.A yeh hadith bayan farma kar farmate hain agar tum chaho to ayat-e-Qurani ke is jumlay ko parh lo (Innallaha la yazlimu misqala zarratin, wa in taku hasanatan yuda'ifha wa yu'ti mil ladunhu ajran azima) (4. An-Nisa: 40). Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood R.A ka farman marwi hai ke Qayamat ke din kisi Allah ke banday ya bandi ko laya jayega aur ek pukarne wala sab ahl-e-mahshar ko ba-awaz-e-buland suna kar kahega yeh fulan ka beta ya beti hai is ka naam yeh hai jis kisi ka koi haq is ke zimma baqi ho ya aaye aur le jaye us waqt yeh halat hogi ke aurat chahegi ke is ka koi haq is ke baap par ya maa par ya bhai par ya shohar par ho to dor kar aaye aur le rishtay naatay kat jayenge koi kisi ka pursan-e-haal na hoga Allah Ta'ala apna jo haq chahe maaf farma dega lekin logon ke huqooq mein se koi haq maaf na farmaye ga isi tarah jab koi haqdar aayega to fareeq-e-sani se kaha jayega ke in ke haq ada kar yeh kahega duniya to khatam ho chuki aaj mere hath mein kya hai jo main doon?

Ab yeh shakhs agar Allah ka dost hai to us ke paas ek rai ke daane barabar neki bach rahegi jise barha charha kar sirf isi ki bina par Allah Ta'ala use jannat mein le jayega. Phir aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat ki aur agar woh banda Allah ka dost nahin hai balkeh badbakht aur sarkash hai to yeh haal hoga keh farishta kahega keh Bari Ta'ala is ki sab nekiyan khatam ho gayin aur abhi haq-dar baqi reh gaye. Hukm hoga keh un ki buraiyan le kar is par laad do phir ise jahannam wasil karo, a'azana Allahu minha. Is mauqoof asar ke ba'az shawahid marfoo ahadees mein bhi maujood hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Ibn-e-Umar R.A ka farman hai keh (aayat "Man ja'a bil-hasanati falahu ashru amsaliha") a'raab ke bare mein utri hai. Is par un se sawal hua keh phir muhajireen ke bare mein kya hai? Aap ne farmaya is se bahut hi achi (Innal-laha la yazlimu misqala zarratin, wa in taku hasanatan yuda'ifha wa yu'ti mil-ladunhu ajran azeema) (Surah An-Nisa: 40). Hazrat Sa'eed bin Jubair R.H farmate hain mushrik ke bhi azabon mein is ke ba'is kami kar di jati hai, haan jahannam se nikle ga to nahin. Chunancha sahih hadees mein hai keh Hazrat Abbas R.A ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se poocha, Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ! Aap ke chacha Abu Talib aap ki pusht-panah bane hue the, aap ko logon ki ezaon se bachate rehte the, aap ki taraf se un se larte the, to kya unhein kuch nafa bhi pahunche ga? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya haan, woh bahut thori si aag mein hai aur agar mera yeh ta'alluq na hota to jahannam ke neeche ke tabqe mein hota. Lekin yeh bahut mumkin hai keh yeh faida sirf Abu Talib ke liye hi ho, ya'ni aur kuffar is hukm mein na hon, is liye keh Musnad-e-Tayalisi ki hadees mein hai Allah Ta'ala momin ki kisi neki par zulm nahin karta, duniya mein rozi waghera ki soorat mein. Us ke paas koi neki na hogi, ajr-e-azeem se murad is aayat mein jannat hai. Allah Ta'ala apne fazl-o-karam, lutf-o-rahm se apni razamandi ata farmaye aur jannat naseeb kare. Ameen. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek ghareeb hadees mein hai Hazrat Abu Usman R.H farmate hain mujhe khabar mili keh Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A ne farmaya hai Allah Ta'ala apne momin bande ko ek neki ke badle ek laakh neki ka sawab dega. Mujhe bara ta'ajjub hua aur main ne kaha Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A se mil kar un se khud pooch aaun. Chunancha main ne saman-e-safar durust kiya aur is riwayat ki chhan-been ke liye rawana hua, maloom hua keh woh to hajj ko gaye hain to main bhi hajj ki niyat se wahan pahuncha. Mulaqat hui to main ne kaha Abu Hurairah R.A! Main ne suna aap ne aisi hadees bayan ki hai? Kya yeh sach hai? Aap ne farmaya kya tumhein ta'ajjub maloom hota hai? Tum ne Quran mein nahin parha?

Keh Allah Ta'ala farmata hai jo shakhs Allah ko achha qarz de Allah usey bahut bahut barha kar inayat farmata hai aur dusri aayat mein sari duniya ko kam kaha gaya hai. Allah Ta'ala ki qasam main ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai keh ek neki ko barha kar us ke badle do lakh milengi. Zameen apne Rab ke noor se chamakne lagegi, nama-e-aamal diye jayenge aur nabiyon aur gawahon ko la khara karenge. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai keh Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud (R.A) se farmaya mujhe kuch Quran parh kar sunao. Hazrat Abdullah ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main aap ko parh kar sunaunga? Aap par to utra hi hai. Farmaya haan lekin mera jee chahta hai keh dusre se sunun. Pas main ne Surah Nisa ki tilawat shuru ki, parhte parhte jab main ne is aayat "Fa-kaifa" ki tilawat ki to aap ne farmaya bas karo. Main ne dekha keh aap ki aankhon se aansu jaari thay. Hazrat Muhammad bin Fudala Ansari (R.A) farmate hain keh qabila Bani Zafar ke paas Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aaye aur us chattan par baith gaye jo ab tak unke mohalle mein hai. Aap ke sath Ibn Mas'ud (R.A), Mu'adh bin Jabal (R.A) aur deegar Sahaba (R.A) bhi thay. Aap ne ek qari se farmaya Quran parho. (Theek yahi hai keh yeh baat sehat ke sath sabit nahin, Wallahu A'lam).

Phir farmaya yeh un tamam bad-afaliyon ka us din iqrar karenge jo unhon ne ki thin aur ek cheez bhi posheeda na rakhenge. Ek shakhs ne Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se kaha Hazrat ek jagah to Quran mein hai ke mushrikeen qayamat ke din kahenge (Wallahi Rabbina ma kunna mushrikeen) (Surah Al-An'am: 23) ki qasam Rab ki qasam hum ne shirk nahin kiya aur dusri jagah hai ke (Wa la yaktumoonallaha hadeetha) (Surah An-Nisa: 42) Allah se baat bhi na chhupayenge phir in dono aayaton ka kya matlab hai? Aap ne farmaya is ka aur waqt hai is ka waqt aur hai aur jab muwahidon ko jannat mein jaate hue dekhenge to kahenge aao tum bhi apne shirk ka inkar karo kya ajab kaam chal jaye. Phir un ke munh par mohrein lag jayengi aur haath paanv bolne lagenge ab Allah Ta'ala se ek baat bhi na chhupayenge (Ibn-e-Jareer). Musnad-e-Abdur Razzaq mein hai ke us shakhs ne aa kar kaha tha bahut si cheezein mujh par Quran mein mukhtalif nazar aa rahi hain, Aap ne farmaya kya matlab tujhe kya Quran mein shak hai? Us ne kaha shak to nahin haan meri samajh mein ikhtilaf nazar aa raha hai, Aap ne farmaya jahan jahan ikhtilaf tujhe nazar aaya ho un maqamat ko pesh kar to us ne yeh do aayatein ki tatbeeq samjha di. Ek aur riwayat mein sail ka naam bhi aaya hai ke woh Hazrat Nafi bin Azraq thay yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne un se yeh bhi farmaya ke shayad tum kisi aisi majlis se aa rahe ho jahan in ka tazkira ho raha hoga ya tum ne kiya hoga ke main jaata hoon aur Ibn-e-Abbas se daryaft karta hoon agar mera yeh guman sahi hai to tumhein lazim hai ke jawab sun kar unhein bhi ja kar sunado phir yahi jawab diya.

Batadreej hurmat-e-sharab aur pas-e-manzar: Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala apne imandar bandon ko nashe ki halat mein namaz parhne se rok raha hai kyunke us waqt namazi ko maloom hi nahin hota ke woh kya keh raha hai aur sath hi mahal-e-namaz yani masjid mein aane se roka ja raha hai aur sath junubi shakhs jise nahane ki haajat ho, use mahal-e-namaz yani masjid mein aane se roka ja raha hai. Haan, aisa shakhs kisi kaam ki wajah se masjid ke ek darwaze se dakhil ho kar dusre darwaze se nikal jaye to jaiz hai. Nashe ki halat mein namaz ke qareeb na jaane ka hukum sharab ki hurmat se pehle tha jaise is hadith se zahir hai jo humne Surah Al-Baqarah ki (YAS-ALUNAKA 'ANIL-KHAMRI WAL-MAISIRI QUL FIHIMA ITHMUN KABEERUN WA MANAFI'U LIN-NASI WA ITHMUHUMA AKBARU MIN NAW'IHIMA WA YAS-ALUNAKA MADHA YUNFIQUNA QULIL-'AFWA KADHALIKA YUBAYYINULLAHU LAKUMUL-AYATI LA'ALLAKUM TATAFAKKARUN) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 219) ki tafsir mein bayan ki hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jab woh ayat Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke samne tilawat ki to aap ne dua mangi ke Aye Allah! Sharab ke bare mein aur saaf saaf bayan nazil farma. Phir nashe ki halat mein namaz ke qareeb na jaane ki yeh ayat utri, is par namazon ke waqt is ka peena logon ne chhor diya. Ise sun kar bhi Janab-e-Farooq (R.A) ne yahi dua mangi to (YA AYYUHAL-LADHINA AMANU INNAMAL-KHAMRU WAL-MAISIRU WAL-ANSABU WAL-AZLAMU RIJSUN MIN 'AMALISH-SHAYTANI FAJ-TANIBUHU LA'ALLAKUM TUFLIHUN. INNAMA YUREEDUSH-SHAYTANU AN YUQI'A BAINAKUMUL-'ADAWATA WAL-BAGHDA'A FIL-KHAMRI WAL-MAISIRI WA YASUDDAKUM 'AN DHIKRIL-LAHI WA 'ANIS-SALATI FAHAL ANTUM MUNTAHUN) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 90-91) tak nazil hui jis mein sharab se bachne ka hukum saaf majood hai. Ise sun kar Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ne farmaya: Hum baaz aaye.

Isi riwayat ki ek sanad mein hai ke jab Surah Nisa ki yeh aayat nazil hui aur nashe ke waqt namaz parhne ki mumanat hui us waqt yeh dastoor tha ke jab namaz khari hoti to ek shakhs aawaz lagata ke koi nasha wala namaz ke qareeb na aaye, Ibn-e-Majah Sharif mein hai Hazrat Sa'ad (R.A) farmate hain mere bare mein chaar aayatein nazil hui hain, ek Ansari ne bahut se logon ki dawat ki hum sab ne khoob khaya piya phir sharabein peen aur makhmur ho gaye phir aapas mein fakhr jatane lage ek shakhs ne oont ke jabre ki haddi utha kar Hazrat Sa'ad ko maari jis se naak par zakhm aaya aur us ka nishan baqi reh gaya us waqt tak sharab ko Islam ne haram nahin kiya tha pas yeh aayat nazil hui yeh hadith Sahih Muslim Sharif mein bhi poori marwi hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki riwayat mein hai ke Abdur-Rahman bin Auf (R.A) ne dawat ki sab ne khana khaya phir sharab pi aur mast ho gaye itne mein namaz ka waqt aa gaya ek shakhs ko imam banaya us ne namaz mein Surah (Aayat: Qul ya ayyuhal kafirun) mein is tarah parha (Aayat: Ma a'budu ma ta'buduna wa nahnu na'budu ma ta'budun) is par yeh aayat utri aur nashe ki halat mein namaz ka parhna mana kiya gaya. Yeh hadith Tirmidhi mein bhi hai aur Hasan hai. Ibn-e-Jarir ki riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Ali (R.A), Hazrat Abdur-Rahman aur teesre ek aur sahib ne sharab pi aur Hazrat Abdur-Rahman namaz mein imam banaye gaye aur Quran ki qirat khalt-malt kar di is par yeh aayat utri.

Abu Dawood aur Nasai mein bhi yeh riwayat hai. Ibn-e-Jarir ki ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne imamat ki aur jis tarah parhna chahiye tha na parh sake, is par yeh aayat nazil hui. Aur ek riwayat mein marwi hai ke Hazrat Abdur-Rahman bin Auf (R.A) ne imamat karayi aur is tarah parha (Aayat: "Qul ayyuhal-kafirun, a'budu ma ta'budun, wa antum 'abiduna ma a'bud, wa ana 'abidum ma 'abadtum, wa antum 'abiduna ma a'bud, lakum dinukum wa liya din"). Pas yeh aayat nazil hui aur is halat mein namaz parhna haram kar diya gaya. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke sharab ki hurmat se pehle log nasha ki halat mein namaz ke liye khare hote the, pas is aayat se unhein aisa karne se rok diya gaya (Ibn-e-Jarir). Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) farmate hain is ke nazil hone ke baad log is se ruk gaye, phir sharab ki mutlaq hurmat nazil hone ke baad log is se bilkul taib ho gaye, phir sharab ki mutlaq hurmat nazil hui. Hazrat Zahhak (R.H) farmate hain is se sharab ka nasha murad nahin balkay neend ka khumar murad hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) farmate hain theek yahi hai ke murad is se sharab ka nasha hai aur yahan khitab un se kiya gaya hai jo nasha mein hain lekin itne nasha mein bhi nahin ke ahkam-e-shar' un par jari hi na ho sakein, kyunke nashe ki aisi halat wala shakhs majnoon ke hukm mein hai. Bohat se usooli hazrat ka qaul hai ke khitab un logon se hai jo kalam ko samajh sakein, aise nasha walon ki taraf nahin jo samajhte hi nahin ke un se kya kaha ja raha hai, is liye ke khitab ka takleef ki samajhna shart hai. Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke go alfaaz yeh hain ke nasha ki halat mein namaz na parho, lekin murad yeh hai ke nashe ki cheez khao piyo bhi nahin, is liye ke din raat mein paanch waqt namaz farz hai to kaise mumkin hai ke ek sharabi in paanchon waqt namazein theek waqt par ada kar sake halankeh sharab barabar pee raha hai, Wallahu A'lam. Pas yeh hukm bhi isi tarah hoga jis tarah yeh hukm hai ke "Aiman walo Allah se darte raho jitna us se darne ka haq hai aur na marna tum magar is halat mein ke tum musalman ho". To is se murad yeh hai ke aisi tayyari har waqt rakho aur aise pakeeza a'maal har waqt karte raho ke jab tumhein maut aaye to Islam par dam nikle. Yeh jo is aayat mein irshad hua hai ke "yahan tak ke tum maloom kar sako jo tum keh rahe ho", yeh nashe ki had se yani nasha ki halat mein is shakhs ko samjha jaye ga, na hi use aajizi aur khushoo-o-khuzoo hasil ho sakta hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain: "Jab tum mein se agar koi namaz mein oonghne lage to use chahiye ke woh namaz chor kar so jaye jab tak ke woh janne lage ke woh kya keh raha hai". Bukhari aur Nasai mein bhi yeh hadith hai aur is ke ba'z turuq mein yeh alfaaz bhi hain ke mumkin hai ke woh apne liye istighfar kare lekin us ki zaban se us ke khilaf nikle.

Aadab-e-Masjid aur Masail-e-Tayammum. Phir farman hai ke junubi namaz ke qareeb na jaye jab tak ghusl na karle, han bator-e-guzar jaane ke masjid mein guzarna jaiz hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain aisi napaki ki halat mein masjid mein jana najayaz hai, han masjid ke ek taraf se nikal jaane mein koi haraj nahin, masjid mein baithein nahin. Aur bhi bahut se Sahaba aur Tabi'een ka yahi qaul hai. Hazrat Yazeed bin Abu Habeeb farmate hain ba'az Ansar jo masjid ke gird rehte the aur junubi hote the, ghar mein pani nahin hota tha aur ghar ke darwaze masjid se mutasil the, unhein ijazat mil gayi ke masjid se isi halat mein guzar sakte hain. Bukhari Sharif ki ek hadith se bhi yeh baat saaf taur par sabit hoti hai ke logon ke gharon ke darwaze masjid mein the, chunancha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne aakhri marz-ul-maut mein farmaya tha ke masjid mein jin jin logon ke darwaze padte hain sab ko band kardo, Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) ka darwaza rehne do. Is se yeh bhi maloom hua ke Aap (ﷺ) ke baad Aap ke janasheen Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) honge, toh unhein har waqt aur bakasrat masjid mein aane jaane ki zaroorat rahegi taake musalmanon ke ahem umoor ka faisla kar sakein, is liye Aap (ﷺ) ne sab ke darwaze band karne aur Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) ka darwaza khula rakhne ki hidayat farmayi. Ba'az sunan ki is hadith mein bajaye Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) ke Hazrat Ali (R.A) ka naam hai, woh bilkul ghalat hai, sahih yahi hai jo Sahih (Bukhari) mein hai. Is ayat se aksar aimma ne daleel pakdi hai ke junubi shakhs ko masjid mein thehrana haram hai, han guzar jana jaiz hai. Isi tarah haiz-o-nifas wali auraton ko bhi ba'az kehte hain in dono ka guzarna bhi jaiz nahin, mumkin hai masjid mein aaloodgi ho, aur ba'az kehte hain agar is baat ka khauf na ho unka guzarna bhi jaiz hai. Sahih Muslim Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) se farmaya ke masjid se mujhe boriya utha do, toh Umm-ul-Momineen ne arz kiya Huzoor (ﷺ), main haiz se hoon, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya tera haiz tere haath mein nahin. Is se sabit hota hai ke haiza masjid mein aa sakti hai aur nifas wali ke liye bhi yahi hukm hai. Yeh dono bator-e-rasta chalne ke ja aa sakti hain. Abu Dawood mein farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ) hai ke main haiz aur junubi ke liye masjid ko halal nahin karta. Imam Abu Muslim Khattabi (R.H) farmate hain is hadith ko ek jamaat ne za'eef kaha hai kyunke "Aflit" is ka rawi majhool hai. Lekin Ibn-e-Majah mein yeh riwayat hai, is mein Aflit ki wajah Ma'doom Zahli hain. Pehli hadith barwayat-e-Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) aur dusri barwayat-e-Hazrat Umm-e-Salma (R.A) hai, lekin theek naam Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ka hi hai. Ek aur hadith Tirmidhi mein hai jis mein hai ke "Ae Ali! Is masjid mein junubi hona mere aur tere siwa kisi ko halal nahin", yeh hadith bilkul za'eef hai, Wallahu A'lam. Is ayat ki tafseer mein Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke junubi shakhs baghair ghusl kiye namaz nahin padh sakta, lekin agar woh musafir ho aur pani na mile toh pani ke milne tak padh sakta hai.

Ibn-e-Abbas, Saeed bin Jubair aur Zahhak se bhi yahi marvi hai, Hazrat Mujahid, Hasan, Hakam, Zaid aur Abdur-Rahman se bhi is ke misl marvi hai. Abdullah bin Kathir (R.H) farmate hain hum suna karte the ke yeh aayat safar ke hukm mein hai, is hadith se bhi masla ki shahadat ho sakti hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) behtar hai (Sunan aur Ahmad). Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) farmate hain in dono qaulon mein aula qaul un hi logon ka hai jo kehte hain is se murad sirf guzar jana hai kyunke jis musafir ko junub ki halat mein pani na mile us ka hukm to aage saaf bayan hua hai, pas agar yahi matlab yahan bhi liya jaye to phir dusre jumla mein ise lautane ki zaroorat baqi nahin rehti. Pas ma'ani aayat ke ab yeh hue ke iman walo namaz ke liye masjid mein na jao jab ke tum nashe mein ho jab tak tum apni baat ko aap na samajhne lago, isi tarah junub ki halat mein bhi masjid mein na jao jab tak naha na lo, han sirf guzar jana jaiz hai. Aabir ke ma'ani aane jaane yani guzar jaane wale hain, is ka masdar 'abran aur 'ubooran aata hai, jab koi nehar se guzre to Arab kehte hain 'abara fulanun-nahr, fulan shakhs ne nehar se uboor kar liya, isi tarah qawi oontni ko jo safar kaatti ho 'abral-asfar kehte hain. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir jis qaul ki ta'eed karte hain yahi qaul jumhoor ka hai aur aayat se zahir bhi yahi hai, yani Allah Ta'ala is naqis halat-e-namaz se mana farma raha hai jo maqsood-e-namaz ke khilaf hai, isi tarah namaz ki jagah mein bhi aisi halat mein aane ko rokta hai jo us jagah ki azmat aur pakeezgi ke khilaf hai, Wallahu A'lam. Phir jo farmaya ke yahan tak ke tum ghusl kar lo, Imam Abu Hanifa, Imam Malik aur Shafi'i isi daleel ki roshni mein kehte hain ke junubi ko masjid mein theharna haram hai jab tak ghusl na kar le ya agar pani na mile ya pani ho lekin us ke istemaal ki qudrat na ho to tayammum kar le. Hazrat Imam Ahmad (R.H) farmate hain jab junubi ne wuzu kar liya to use masjid mein theharna jaiz hai, chunancha Musnad-e-Ahmad aur Sunan-e-Saeed bin Mansoor mein marvi hai. Hazrat Ata bin Yasar (R.H) farmate hain ke main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sahaba ko dekha ke woh junubi hote aur wuzu kar ke masjid mein baithe rehte, Wallahu A'lam. Phir tayammum ki ijazat ka fatwa diya hai kyunke aayat mein umoom hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain ek Ansari bimar the, na to khade ho kar wuzu kar sakte the na un ka koi khadim tha jo unhein pani de, unhon ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is ka zikr kiya is par yeh hukm utra, yeh riwayat mursal hai. Dusri halat mein tayammum ke jawaz ki wajah safar hai khwah lamba safar aur khwah chota. Gha'it narm zameen ko yahan se kinaya kiya gaya hai pakhana peshab se. Laamastum ki dusri qira'at lamastum hai, is ki tafseer mein do qaul hain, ek yeh ke murad jima hai jaise aur aayat mein hai (Thumma tallaqtumuhunna min qabli an tamassuhunna fama lakum 'alaihinna min 'iddatin ta'taddunaha, famatti'uhunna wa sarrihuhunna sarahan jamila) (33:49).

Al-Ahzab: 49) Ya'ni agar tum apni biwiyon ko, jo iman wali auraton mein se hon, nikah karo phir mujamat se pehle unhein talaq de do to un ke zimme iddat nahin. Yahan bhi lafz (Aayat: min qabli an tamussuhunna) hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke awwalan mastumun-nisa se murad mujamat hai. Hazrat Ali (R.A), Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A), Hazrat Mujahid (R.A), Hazrat Ta'oos (R.A), Hazrat Hasan (R.A), Hazrat Ubaid bin Umair, Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.A), Hazrat Sha'bi (R.H), Hazrat Qatadah (R.H), Hazrat Muqatil bin Hayyan (R.H) se bhi yahi marwi hai. Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) farmate hain ek martaba is lafz par muzakara hua to chand mawali ne kaha yeh jima nahin aur chand Arab ne kaha jima hai. Main ne Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se is ka zikr kiya, aap ne pucha tum kin ke sath thay? Main ne kaha mawali ke. Farmaya mawali maghloob ho gaye, lams aur mass aur mubashirat ka ma'ni jima hai, Allah Ta'ala ne yahan kinaya kiya hai. Ba'az aur hazrat ne is se murad mutlaq chuna liya hai, khwah jism ke kisi hisse ko aurat ke kisi hisse se milaya jaye to wuzu karna parega. Lams se murad chuna hai aur is se bhi wuzu karna parega. Farmate hain mubashirat se, hath lagane se, bosa lene se wuzu karna parega. Lams se murad chuna hai. Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) bhi aurat ka bosa lene se wuzu karne ke qail thay aur ise lams mein dakhil jante thay. Ubaidah, Abu Usman, Sabit, Ibrahim, Zaid bhi kehte hain ke lams se murad jima ke alawa hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) farmate hain ke insan ka apni biwi ka bosa lena aur use hath lagana malamast hai, is se wuzu karna parega (Muwatta Imam Malik). Dar-e-Qutni mein khud Umar (R.A) se bhi isi tarah marwi hai lekin dusri riwayat aap se is ke khilaf bhi payi jati hai, aap bawuzu thay, aap ne apni biwi ka bosa liya phir wuzu na kiya aur namaz ada ki. Pas dono riwayaton ko sahi manne ke baad yeh faisla karna parega ke aap wuzu ko mustahab jante thay, Wallahu A'lam. Mutlaq chune se wuzu ke qail Imam Shafi'i (R.H) aur un ke sathi Imam Malik (R.H) hain aur mashhoor Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal (R.H) se bhi yahi riwayat hai. Is qaul ke qail kehte hain ke yahan do qiratein hain: la mastum aur lamastum, aur lams ka itlaq hath lagane par bhi Quran-e-Karim mein aaya hai. Chunancha irshad hai: (Wa lau nazzalna alaika kitaban fi qirtasin falamasuhu bi-aydihim laqalallazina kafaroo in haza illa sihrun mubeen) (Surah Al-An'am: 7). Zahir hai ke yahan hath lagana hi murad hai. Isi tarah Hazrat Ma'iz bin Malik (R.A) ko Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ka yeh farmana ke shayad tum ne bosa liya hoga, hath lagaya hoga, wahan bhi lafz lamasta hai. Aur sirf hath lagane ke ma'ni mein hi aur hadith mein hai: (Hadith: Wal-yadu zinaha al-lams) hath ka "zina" chuna aur hath lagana hai. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) farmati hain bahut kam din aise guzarte thay ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) hamare paas aa kar bosa na lete hon ya hath na lagate hon.

Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bai-e-malamat se mana farmaya, yeh bhi hath lagane ki bai hai. Pas yeh lafz jis tarah jima par bola jata hai, hath se chune par bhi bola jata hai. Shair kehta hai: "Wa lamastu kaffi kaffahu atlubul ghina" (Mera hath uske hath se mila, main tungari chahta tha). Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke ek shakhs Sarkar-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mein hazir ho kar arz karta hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us shakhs ke bare mein kya faisla hai jo ek ajnabiya aurat ke sath tamam woh kaam karta hai jo miyan-biwi mein hote hain siwaye jima ke, toh (وَاَقِمِ الصَّلٰوةَ طَرَفَيِ النَّهَارِ وَزُلَفًا مِّنَ الَّيْلِ) (Surah Hud: 114) nazil hoti hai aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain wuzu kar ke namaz ada kar le. Is par Hazrat Mu'az (R.A) puchte hain kya yeh isi ke liye khas hai ya sab musalmanon ke liye kaam hai? Aap jawab dete hain tamam iman walon ke liye hai. Imam Tirmizi (R.H) ise Zaida ki hadith se yeh kehte hain ke ise wuzu ka hukum isi liye diya ke usne aurat ko chhua tha, jima nahin kiya tha. Iska jawab yeh diya jata hai ke awwalan toh yeh munqata hai, Ibn-e-Abi Laila aur Mu'az ke darmiyan mulaqat ka suboot nahin. Dusre yeh ke ho sakta hai use wuzu ka hukum farz namaz ki adaigi ke liye diya ho, jaise ke Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) wali hadith hai ke jo banda koi gunah kare phir wuzu kar ke do rakat namaz ada kare toh Allah Ta'ala uske gunah maaf farma deta hai. Yeh puri hadith Surah Al-Imran mein (ذَكَرُوا اللّٰهَ فَاسْتَغْفَرُوْا لِذُنُوْبِھِمْ ۠ وَ مَنْ يَّغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ) (Surah Al-Imran: 135) ki tafsir mein guzar chuki hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) farmate hain in dono qaulon mein se awla qaul unka hai jo kehte hain ke murad is se jima hai na ke aur, kyunke sahih marfoo hadith mein aa chuka hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apni kisi biwi sahiba ka bosa liya aur baghair wuzu kiye namaz padhi. Hazrat Mai Aisha Siddiqa (R.A) farmati hain An-Hazrat Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) wuzu karte, bosa lete, phir baghair wuzu kiye namaz padhte. Hazrat Habib (R.H) farmate hain Mai Aisha (R.A) ne farmaya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni kisi biwi ka bosa lete namaz ko jate, maine kaha woh aap hi hongi toh aap muskura dein. Iski sanad mein kalam hai lekin dusri sanadon se baghair wuzu kiye sabit hai ke upar ke rawi yani Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) se sunne wale Hazrat Urwa bin Zubair (R.H) hain aur riwayat mein hai ke wuzu ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mera bosa liya aur phir wuzu kiye baghair namaz ada ki. Hazrat Umm-ul-Momineen Umm-e-Salma (R.A) farmati hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bosa lete halanke aap rozay se hote, phir na toh roza jata na naya wuzu karte (Ibn-e-Jarir). Hazrat Zainab bint Khuzaima farmati hain Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bosa lene ke baad wuzu na karte aur namaz padhte. Allah Ta'ala farmate hain agar pani na pao toh pak mitti se tayammum kar lo, is se aksar fuqaha ne istidlal kiya hai ke pani na paane wale ke liye tayammum ki ijazat pani ki talash ke baad hai.

Kutub-e-Furoo mein talash ki kaifiyat bhi likhi hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek shakhs ko dekha ke alag thalag hai aur logon ke sath usne namaz jamaat ke sath nahin padhi, toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne us se poocha, "Tu ne logon ke sath namaz kyun na padhi? Kya tu Musalman nahin?" Usne kaha, "Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam), hoon toh Musalman lekin junubi ho gaya aur pani na mila." Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Phir is surat mein tujhe mitti kafi thi." Tayammum ke lafzi ma'ani qasd karne ke hain. Arab kehte hain, "Tayammaka Allah bi-hifzihi" ya'ni Allah apni hifazat ke sath tera qasd kare. Imra-ul-Qais ke sher mein bhi yeh lafz isi ma'ani mein aaya hai. Sa'eed ke ma'ani mein kaha gaya hai ke har woh cheez jo zameen mein se oopar ko chadhe, pas is mein mitti, ret, darakht, patthar, ghaas bhi dakhil ho jayenge. Imam Malik (R.H) ka qaul yahi hai aur kaha gaya hai ke jo cheez mitti ki jins se ho jaise ret, hartal aur choona, yeh mazhab Abu Hanifa (R.H) ka hai aur yeh bhi kaha gaya ke sirf mitti hai, magar yeh qaul hai Hazrat Imam Shafi'i aur Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal (R.H) aur un ke tamam sathiyon ka hai. Is ki daleel ek toh Quran-e-Kareem ke yeh alfaaz hain: (Fatusbiha sa'eedan zalaqan) (Surah Al-Kahf: 40), ya'ni ho jaye woh mitti phisalti. Dusri daleel Sahih Muslim Sharif ki yeh hadith hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Hamein tamam logon par teen fazilatein di gayi hain: hamari safein misl farishton ki safon ke tarteeb di gayin, hamare liye tamam zameen masjid banayi gayi aur zameen ki mitti hamare liye paak aur paak karne wali banayi gayi jabke hum pani na payein." Aur ek sanad se bajaye turbat ke turabat ka lafz marwi hai. Pas is hadith mein ehsan ke jatate waqt mitti ki takhsees ki gayi, agar koi aur cheez bhi wuzu ke qaim-maqam kaam aane wali hoti toh is ka zikr bhi sath hi kar dete. Yahan yeh lafz 'tayyib' isi ke ma'ani mein aaya hai. Murad halal hai aur kaha gaya hai ke murad paak hai, jaise hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain, "Paak mitti Musalmanon ka wuzu hai go das saal tak pani na paye, phir jab pani mile toh use apne jism se bahaye, yeh is ke liye behtar hai." Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) ise Hasan Sahih kehte hain, Hafiz Abu-ul-Hassan Qattan (R.H) bhi ise Sahih kehte hain. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain, "Sab se zyada paak mitti khet ki zameen ki mitti hai," balkeh Tafsir Ibn Marduyah mein toh ise marfoo'an warid kiya hai. Phir farman hai ke use apne chehre par aur hath par malna kafi hai aur is par ijma hai, lekin kaifiyat-e-tayammum mein aimma ka ikhtilaf hai. Jadeed mazhab-e-Shafi'i yeh hai ke do dafa kar ke munh aur dono hathon ka kohniyon tak masah karna wajib hai, is liye ke yadein ka itlaq baghlon tak aur kohniyon tak hota hai jaise ayat-e-wuzu mein aur isi lafz ka itlaq hota hai aur murad sirf hatheliyan hi hoti hain, jaise ke chor ki had ke bare mein farmaya: (Wassariqu wassariqatu faqta'oo aidiyahuma jaza'am bima kasaba nakalam minallahi wallahu Azizun Hakim) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 38).

Al-Ma'idah: 38) Kehte hain yahan tayammum ke hukm mein haath ka zikr mutlaq hai aur wuzu ke hukm se mashroot hai is liye is mutlaq ko is mashroot par mahmool kiya jaye ga kyunke tahooriyat-e-jami' majood hai aur ba'az log is ki daleel mein Dar-e-Qutni wali riwayat pesh karte hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tayammum ki do zarbein hain, ek martaba haath maar kar munh par malna aur ek martaba haath maar kar dono kohniyon tak malna, lekin yeh hadith sahih nahin is liye ke is ki asnaad mein za'f hai, hadith sabit nahin. Abu Dawood ki ek hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne haath ek deewar par maare aur munh par male phir dobara haath maar kar apni dono bazuon par male. Lekin is ki asnaad mein Muhammad bin Sabit Abdi za'eef hain, unhein ba'az hafizan-e-hadith ne za'eef kaha hai, aur yahi hadith ba'az siqa raawiyon ne bhi riwayat ki hai lekin woh marfoo' nahin karte balkay Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ka fe'l batate hain. Imam Bukhari (Rahimahullah / R.H), Imam Shafi'i (Rahimahullah / R.H) ki daleel yeh hadith bhi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) peshab kar rahe hain, main ne Aap ko salam kiya lekin Aap ne jawab na diya, farigh ho kar Aap ek deewar ke paas gaye aur apne dono haath us par maar kar munh par male phir mere salam ka jawab diya (Ibn-e-Jareer). Yeh to tha Imam Shafi'i (Rahimahullah / R.H) ka jadeed mazhab. Aap ka khayal yeh hai ke zarbein to tayammum mein do hain lekin dusri zarb mein hathon ko pahunchon tak malna chahiye. Teesra qaul yeh hai ke sirf ek hi zarb yani ek hi martaba dono hathon ka mitti par maar lena kaafi hai, un gard-aalood hathon ko munh par pher le aur dono par pahunchon tak. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek shakhs Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar Farooq (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ke paas aaya ke main junubi ho gaya aur mujhe paani na mila to mujhe kya karna chahiye? Aap ne farmaya namaz na parhni chahiye. Darbar mein Hazrat Ammar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) bhi majood thay, farmane lage Ameer-ul-Momineen kya aap ko yaad nahin ke main aur aap ek lashkar mein thay aur hum junubi ho gaye thay aur hamein paani na mila to aap ne to namaz na parhi aur main ne mitti mein lot-pot kar namaz ada kar li. Jab hum wapas palte aur An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein pahunche to main ne is waqiye ka bayan Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kiya to Aap ne farmaya mujhe itna kaafi tha, phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne haath zameen par maare aur un mein phoonk maar di aur apne munh ko mala aur hatheliyon ko mala.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya tayammum mein ek hi martaba haath maarna jo chehre ke liye dono hathon ki hatheliyon ke liye hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Shaqiq R.H farmate hain ke main Hazrat Abdullah R.A aur Hazrat Abu Musa R.A ke paas baitha hua tha, Hazrat Abu Laila R.H ne Hazrat Abdullah R.A se kaha ke agar koi shakhs paani na paaye to namaz na padhe, is par Hazrat Abdullah R.A ne farmaya kya tumhein yaad nahin jabke mujhe aur aap ko Rasool Allah ﷺ ne oonton ke baare mein bheja tha wahan main junubi ho gaya aur mitti mein lot-pot liya, wapas aa kar Huzoor ﷺ se yeh waqia bayan kiya to aap hans diye aur farmaya apne chehre par ek baar haath pher liye aur zarb ek hi rahi, to Hazrat Abdullah R.A ne farmaya lekin Hazrat Umar R.A ne is par qana'at nahin ki, yeh sun kar Hazrat Abu Musa R.A ne farmaya phir tum is aayat ka kya karoge jo Surah Nisa mein hai ke paani na paao to paak mitti ka qasd karo, is ka jawab Hazrat Abdullah R.A na de sake aur farmane lage suno hum ne logon ko tayammum ki rukhsat de di to bahut mumkin hai ke paani jab unhein thanda maloom hoga to woh tayammum karne lagenge. Surah Ma'idah mein farman hai (فَامْسَحُوْا بِوُجُوْهِكُمْ وَاَيْدِيْكُمْ مِّنْهُ) (5. Al-Ma'idah: 6) ise apne chehre aur haath par malo. Is se Hazrat Imam Shafi'i R.H ne daleel pakdi hai ke tayammum ka paak mitti se hona aur us ka bhi ghubar-aalood hona jis se hathon par ghubar lage aur woh munh aur haath par mila jaaye zaroori hai jaise ke Hazrat Abu Jahm R.A wali hadith mein guzra hai, ke unhon ne Huzoor ﷺ ko istinja karte hue dekha aur salam kiya, is mein yeh bhi hai ke farigh ho kar ek deewar ke paas gaye aur apni lakdi se khurch kar phir haath maar kar tayammum kiya. Phir farman hai ke Allah Ta'ala tum par tumhare deen mein tangi aur sakhti karna nahin chahta balki woh tumhein paak saaf karna chahta hai, isi liye paani na paane ke waqt mitti ke saath tayammum kar lene ko mubah qarar de kar tum par apni ne'mat ka itmam farmaya taake tum shukr karo. Pas yeh ummat is ne'mat ke saath makhsoos hai jaise ke Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain mujhe paanch cheezein aisi di gayi hain jo mujh se pehle kisi ko nahin di gayin, mahine bhar ki raah tak meri madad ra'ab se ki gayi hai, mere liye saari zameen masjid aur paak karne wali banayi gayi hai mere jis ummati ko jahan namaz ka waqt aa jaaye woh wahin padh le us ki masjid aur us ka wuzu wahin us ke paas maujood hai, mere liye ghaneemat ke maal halal kiye gaye jo mujh se pehle kisi ke liye halal na the, mujhe shafa'at di gayi, tamam ambiya sirf apni qoum ki taraf bheje jaate rahe lekin main tamam duniya ki taraf bheja gaya aur Sahih Muslim ke hawaley se woh hadith bhi pehle guzar chuki hai ke tamam logon par hamein teen fazilatein inayat ki gayin, hamari safein farishton ki safon ki tarah banayi gayin, hamare liye zameen masjid banayi gayi aur apne haath par masah kar.

Pani na milne ke waqt Allah maaf karne wala aur bakhshne wala hai. Uski afw-o-darguzar shaan hai ke usne tumhare liye pani na milne ke waqt tayammum ko mashroo kar ke namaz ada karne ki ijazat marhamat farmayi. Agar yeh rukhsat na hoti toh tum ek goona mushkil mein pad jate, kyunke is Ayat-e-Karima mein namaz ko naqis halat mein ada karna mana kiya gaya hai. Maslan nashe ki halat mein ho ya janabat ki halat mein ho ya be-wazu ho, toh jab tak apni baatein khud samajhne jitna hosh aur baqaida ghusl aur shar'i tariq par wazu na ho namaz nahin padh sakte. Lekin bimari ki halat mein aur pani na milne ki surat mein ghusl aur wazu ke qaim-maqam tayammum kar diya. Pas Allah Ta'ala is ehsan par hum uske shukr-guzar hain, Alhamdulillah.

Tayammum ki rukhsat nazil hone ka waqia bhi sun lijiye. Hum is waqia ko Surah Nisa ki is Ayat ki tafsir mein isi liye bayan karte hain ke Surah Ma'idah mein jo tayammum ki Ayat hai woh nazil hui, yeh uske baad ki hai. Iski daleel yeh hai ke yeh wazeh hai ke yeh Ayat sharab ki hurmat se pehle nazil hui thi aur sharab jang-e-Uhud ke kuch arsa ke baad Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Banu Nazeer ke yahudiyon ka muhasra kiye hue the, haram hui. Aur Surah Ma'idah Quran mein nazil hone wali aakhri suraton mein se hai, bilkhusoos is surat ka ibtidai hissa. Lehaza munasib yahi hai ke tayammum ka shaan-e-nuzool yahin bayan kiya jaye. Allah nek taufiq de, usi ka bharosa hai.

Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai ke Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ne Hazrat Asma (R.A) se ek haar mil gaya lekin namaz ka waqt uski talash mein faut ho gaya aur unke sath pani na tha. Unhone be-wazu namaz ada ki aur An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas pahunch kar iski shikayat ki, is par tayammum ka hukum nazil hua. Hazrat Usaid bin Huzair (R.A) kehne lage, "Ae Umm-ul-Momineen Ayesha (R.A), aap ko jazaye khair de, Allah ki qasam jo takleef aap ko pahunchti hai uska anjam hum musalmanon ke liye khair hi khair hota hai."

Bukhari mein hai Hazrat Siddiqa R.A farmati hain hum apne kisi safar mein thay, Baida mein ya Zaat-ul-Jaish mein, mera haar toot kar kahin gir para jis ke dhoondne ke liye Huzoor ﷺ ma'a qafila thehar gaye. Ab na toh hamare paas pani tha na wahan maidan mein kahin pani tha. Log mere walid Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.A ke paas meri shikayatein karne lage ke dekho hum in ki wajah se kaisi museebat mein par gaye. Chunancha mere walid sahab mere paas aaye, us waqt Rasool Allah ﷺ meri raan par apna sar-e-mubarak rakh kar so gaye thay. Aate hi mujhe kehne lage tu ne Huzoor ﷺ ko aur logon ko rok diya, ab na toh un ke paas pani hai na yahan aur kahin pani nazar aata hai. Al-garz mujhe khoob danta-dapta aur Allah jaane kya kya kaha aur mere pehlu mein apne haath se kachoke bhi maarte rahe lekin main ne zara si bhi junbish na ki ke aisa na ho ke Huzoor ﷺ ke aaram mein khalal waqay ho. Sari raat guzar gayi, subah ko log jaage lekin pani na tha. Allah ne Tayammum ki aayat nazil farmayi aur sab ne tayammum kiya. Hazrat Usaid bin Huzair R.A kehne lage ae Abu Bakr R.A ke gharane walo! Yeh kuch tumhari pehli hi barkat nahin. Ab jab hum ne us oont ko uthaya jis par yeh sawar thi toh us ke neeche se hi haar mil gaya. Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ apni ahliya Hazrat Aisha R.A ke hamrah Zaat-ul-Jaish se guzre. Umm-ul-Momineen R.A ka Yamani khar-moharon ka haar toot kar kahin gir para tha aur gum ho gaya tha, us ki talash mein yahan thehar gaye. Sari raat aap ke ham-safar musalmanon ne aur aap ne yahin guzari. Subah uthay toh pani bilkul nahin tha, pas Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi par paak mitti se tayammum kar ke paaki hasil karne ki rukhsat ki aayat utari aur musalmanon ne Huzoor ﷺ ke saath kharay ho kar zameen par apne haath maaray aur jo mitti un se lat-pat hui usay jharay baghair apne chehray par aur apne hathon par mondhon tak aur hathon ke neeche se baghal tak mal li. Ibn-e-Jareer ki riwayat mein hai ke is se pehle Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.A Hazrat Aisha R.A par sakht gussa ho kar gaye thay lekin tayammum ki rukhsat ke hukum ko sun kar khushi khushi apni sahibzadi sahiba R.A ke paas aaye aur kehne lage tum bari mubarak ho, musalmanon ko itni bari rukhsat mili. Phir musalmanon ne zameen par ek zarb se chehray malay aur dusri zarb se kohniyon aur baghlon tak haath le gaye. Ibn-e-Marduyah mein riwayat hai Hazrat Asla' bin Shareek R.A farmate hain main Rasool Allah ﷺ ki oontni ko chala raha tha jis par Huzoor ﷺ sawar thay. Jaron ka mausam tha, raat ka waqt tha, sakht sardi par rahi thi aur main junbi ho gaya. Idhar Huzoor ﷺ ne kooch ka irada kiya toh main ne apni is halat mein Huzoor ﷺ ki oontni ko chalana pasand na kiya, saath hi yeh bhi khayal aaya ke agar sard pani se nahaunga toh mar jaunga ya bimar par jaunga, toh main ne chupke se ek Ansari ko kaha ke aap oontni ki nakeel thaam lijiye. Chunancha woh chalate rahay aur main ne aag sulga kar pani garam kar ke ghusal kiya, phir dor-bhaag kar qafila mein pahunch gaya. Aap ﷺ ne mujhe farmaya Asla'! Kya baat hai? Oontni ki chaal kaise bigri hui hai?

Main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) main ise nahin chala raha tha balkay falan Ansari sahab chala rahe thay, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya yeh kyun? To main ne sara waqia keh sunaya, is par Allah Azza wa Jall ne (Yaa Ayyuhallazeena Aamanu Laa Taqrabus Salaata Wa Antum Sukaraa Hatta Ta'lamu Maa Taquluna Wa Laa Junuban Illa Aabiri Sabilin Hatta Taghtasilu Wa In Kuntum Mardaa Aw 'Alaa Safarin Aw Jaa'a Ahadum Minkum Minal Ghaa'iti Aw Laamastumun Nisaa'a Falam Tajidu Maa'an Fatayammamu Sa'idan Tayyiban Famsahu Biwujuhikum Wa Aydikum Innallaha Kaana Afuwwan Ghafoora) (Surah An-Nisa: 43) tak nazil farmayi. Yeh riwayat dusri sanad se bhi marwi hai.

Yahudiyon ki ek mazmoom khaslat Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ke Yahudiyon ki ek mazmoom khaslat yeh bhi hai ke woh gumrahi ko hidayat par tarjeeh dete hain, Nabi-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par jo Kitab nazil hui us se bhi rogardani karte hain aur Allah ka diya hua jo ilm un ke paas hai use bhi pas-e-pusht daal dete hain. Khud apni kitabon mein Nabi-e-Mau'ood ki basharatein padhte hain lekin apne mureedon se chadhawa lene ke lalach mein zahir nahin karte, balkeh sath hi yeh chahte hain ke khud Musalman bhi rah-e-rast se bhatak jayen, Allah ki Kitab ke mukhalif ho jayen, hidayat ko aur sachay ilm ko chhod dein. Allah Ta'ala tumhare dushmanon se khoob bakhabar hai, woh tumhein un se mutalla kar raha hai ke kahin tum un ke dhoke mein na aa jao. Allah ki himayat kaafi hai, tum yaqeen rakho ke woh apni taraf jhukne walon ki zaroor himayat karta hai, woh us ka madadgar ban jata hai.

Teesri aayat mein lafz 'min' se shuru hui hai, is mein 'min' bayan-e-jins ke liye hai jaise (فَاجْتَنِبُوا الرِّجْسَ مِنَ الْاَوْثَانِ وَاجْتَنِبُوْا قَوْلَ الزُّوْرِ) (Surah Al-Hajj: 30) mein. Phir Yahudiyon ke is firqe ki jis tehreef ka zikr hai us se murad yeh hai ke woh Kalam-e-Ilahi ke matlab ko badal dete hain aur khilaf-e-mansha-e-Ilahi tafseer karte hain aur un ka yeh fe'l jaan boojh kar hota hai, qasdan iftira pardazi ke murtakib hote hain. Phir kehte hain ke ae Paighambar! Jo aap ne kaha hum ne suna lekin hum manne ke nahin. Khayal kijiye un ke kufr-o-ilhaad ko dekhiye ke jaan kar, sun kar, samajh kar khule lafzon mein apne napak khayal ka izhar karte hain aur kehte hain "aap suniye, Allah kare aap na sunein." Ya yeh matlab ke "aap suniye, aap ki na suni jaye" lekin pehla matlab zyada achha hai. Yeh kehna un ka bator-e-tamsukhur aur mazaq ke tha aur Allah unhein laanat kare.

Alawa azeen 'Ra'ina' kehte jis se bazahir yeh samajha jata hai ke yeh log kehte hain "hamari taraf kaan lagaye" lekin woh is lafz se murad yeh lete the ke "tum badi ra'unat wale ho." Is ka poora matlab (يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَقُوْلُوْا رَاعِنَا وَقُوْلُوا انْظُرْنَا وَاسْمَعُوْا ۭ وَلِلْكٰفِرِيْنَ عَذَابٌ اَلِــيْمٌ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 104) ki tafseer mein guzar chuka hai. Maqsad yeh hai ke jo zahir karte the us ke khilaf apni zabanon ko mod kar ta'an-amez lehje mein kehte aur haqeeqi mafhoom mein apne dil mein makhfi rakhte the. Darasal yeh log Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki be-adabi aur gustakhi karte the. Pas unhein hidayat ki gayi hai ke woh in do ma'ani wale alfaz ka istemaal chhod dein aur saaf saaf kahein ke "hum ne suna, mana, aap hamari arz suniye! Aap hamari taraf dekhiye!" Yeh kehna hi un ke liye behtar hai aur yahi saaf, seedhi, sachi aur munasib baat hai. Lekin un ke dil bhalai se door daal diye gaye hain, imaan kaamil taur se un ke dilon mein jagah hi nahin pata, is jumle ki tafseer bhi pehle guzar chuki hai, matlab yeh hai ke nafa dene wala imaan un mein nahin.

Yahudiyon ki ek mazmoom khaslat Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ke Yahudiyon ki ek mazmoom khaslat yeh bhi hai ke woh gumrahi ko hidayat par tarjeeh dete hain, Nabi-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par jo Kitab nazil hui us se bhi rogardani karte hain aur Allah ka diya hua jo ilm un ke paas hai use bhi pas-e-pusht daal dete hain. Khud apni kitabon mein Nabi-e-Mau'ood ki basharatein padhte hain lekin apne mureedon se chadhawa lene ke lalach mein zahir nahin karte, balkeh sath hi yeh chahte hain ke khud Musalman bhi rah-e-rast se bhatak jayen, Allah ki Kitab ke mukhalif ho jayen, hidayat ko aur sachay ilm ko chhod dein. Allah Ta'ala tumhare dushmanon se khoob bakhabar hai, woh tumhein un se mutalla kar raha hai ke kahin tum un ke dhoke mein na aa jao. Allah ki himayat kaafi hai, tum yaqeen rakho ke woh apni taraf jhukne walon ki zaroor himayat karta hai, woh us ka madadgar ban jata hai.

Teesri aayat mein lafz 'min' se shuru hui hai, is mein 'min' bayan-e-jins ke liye hai jaise (فَاجْتَنِبُوا الرِّجْسَ مِنَ الْاَوْثَانِ وَاجْتَنِبُوْا قَوْلَ الزُّوْرِ) (Surah Al-Hajj: 30) mein. Phir Yahudiyon ke is firqe ki jis tehreef ka zikr hai us se murad yeh hai ke woh Kalam-e-Ilahi ke matlab ko badal dete hain aur khilaf-e-mansha-e-Ilahi tafseer karte hain aur un ka yeh fe'l jaan boojh kar hota hai, qasdan iftira pardazi ke murtakib hote hain. Phir kehte hain ke ae Paighambar! Jo aap ne kaha hum ne suna lekin hum manne ke nahin. Khayal kijiye un ke kufr-o-ilhaad ko dekhiye ke jaan kar, sun kar, samajh kar khule lafzon mein apne napak khayal ka izhar karte hain aur kehte hain "aap suniye, Allah kare aap na sunein." Ya yeh matlab ke "aap suniye, aap ki na suni jaye" lekin pehla matlab zyada achha hai. Yeh kehna un ka bator-e-tamsukhur aur mazaq ke tha aur Allah unhein laanat kare.

Alawa azeen 'Ra'ina' kehte jis se bazahir yeh samajha jata hai ke yeh log kehte hain "hamari taraf kaan lagaye" lekin woh is lafz se murad yeh lete the ke "tum badi ra'unat wale ho." Is ka poora matlab (يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَقُوْلُوْا رَاعِنَا وَقُوْلُوا انْظُرْنَا وَاسْمَعُوْا ۭ وَلِلْكٰفِرِيْنَ عَذَابٌ اَلِــيْمٌ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 104) ki tafseer mein guzar chuka hai. Maqsad yeh hai ke jo zahir karte the us ke khilaf apni zabanon ko mod kar ta'an-amez lehje mein kehte aur haqeeqi mafhoom mein apne dil mein makhfi rakhte the. Darasal yeh log Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki be-adabi aur gustakhi karte the. Pas unhein hidayat ki gayi hai ke woh in do ma'ani wale alfaz ka istemaal chhod dein aur saaf saaf kahein ke "hum ne suna, mana, aap hamari arz suniye! Aap hamari taraf dekhiye!" Yeh kehna hi un ke liye behtar hai aur yahi saaf, seedhi, sachi aur munasib baat hai. Lekin un ke dil bhalai se door daal diye gaye hain, imaan kaamil taur se un ke dilon mein jagah hi nahin pata, is jumle ki tafseer bhi pehle guzar chuki hai, matlab yeh hai ke nafa dene wala imaan un mein nahin.

Yahudiyon ki ek mazmoom khaslat Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ke Yahudiyon ki ek mazmoom khaslat yeh bhi hai ke woh gumrahi ko hidayat par tarjeeh dete hain, Nabi-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par jo Kitab nazil hui us se bhi rogardani karte hain aur Allah ka diya hua jo ilm un ke paas hai use bhi pas-e-pusht daal dete hain. Khud apni kitabon mein Nabi-e-Mau'ood ki basharatein padhte hain lekin apne mureedon se chadhawa lene ke lalach mein zahir nahin karte, balkeh sath hi yeh chahte hain ke khud Musalman bhi rah-e-rast se bhatak jayen, Allah ki Kitab ke mukhalif ho jayen, hidayat ko aur sachay ilm ko chhod dein. Allah Ta'ala tumhare dushmanon se khoob bakhabar hai, woh tumhein un se mutalla kar raha hai ke kahin tum un ke dhoke mein na aa jao. Allah ki himayat kaafi hai, tum yaqeen rakho ke woh apni taraf jhukne walon ki zaroor himayat karta hai, woh us ka madadgar ban jata hai.

Teesri aayat mein lafz 'min' se shuru hui hai, is mein 'min' bayan-e-jins ke liye hai jaise (فَاجْتَنِبُوا الرِّجْسَ مِنَ الْاَوْثَانِ وَاجْتَنِبُوْا قَوْلَ الزُّوْرِ) (Surah Al-Hajj: 30) mein. Phir Yahudiyon ke is firqe ki jis tehreef ka zikr hai us se murad yeh hai ke woh Kalam-e-Ilahi ke matlab ko badal dete hain aur khilaf-e-mansha-e-Ilahi tafseer karte hain aur un ka yeh fe'l jaan boojh kar hota hai, qasdan iftira pardazi ke murtakib hote hain. Ya yeh matlab ke "aap suniye, aap ki na suni jaye" lekin pehla matlab zyada achha hai. Yeh kehna un ka bator-e-tamsukhur aur mazaq ke tha aur Allah unhein laanat kare.

Is ka poora matlab (يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَقُوْلُوْا رَاعِنَا وَقُوْلُوا انْظُرْنَا وَاسْمَعُوْا ۭ وَلِلْكٰفِرِيْنَ عَذَابٌ اَلِــيْمٌ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 104) ki tafseer mein guzar chuka hai.
