Darasal yeh log Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki be-adabi aur gustakhi karte the. Pas unhein hidayat ki gayi hai ke woh in do ma'ani wale alfaz ka istemaal chhod dein aur saaf saaf kahein ke "hum ne suna, mana, aap hamari arz suniye! Aap hamari taraf dekhiye!" Yeh kehna hi un ke liye behtar hai aur yahi saaf, seedhi, sachi aur munasib baat hai. Lekin un ke dil bhalai se door daal diye gaye hain, imaan kaamil taur se un ke dilon mein jagah hi nahin pata, is jumle ki tafseer bhi pehle guzar chuki hai, matlab yeh hai ke nafa dene wala imaan un mein nahin.

Qur'an-e-Hakim ka Aijaz-e-Taseer. Allah Azzawajal Yahood-o-Nasara ko hukum deta hai ke main ne apni zabardast kitab apne behtareen Nabi (ﷺ) ke sath nazil farmayi hai jis mein khud tumhari apni kitab ki tasdeeq bhi hai, is par iman lao is se pehle ke hum tumhari suratein maskh kar dein yani munh bigad kar dein, aankhein bajaye idhar ke udhar ho jayen, ya yeh matlab ke tumhare chehre mita dein, aankhein, kaan, naak sab mit jayen phir yeh maskh chehra bhi ulta ho jaye. Yeh azab un ke bad-a'maal ka badla hai, yahi wajah hai ke yeh haq se hat kar batil ki taraf, hidayat se phir kar zalalat ki janib badhe chale ja rahe hain. Ba-in-hama Allah Ta'ala unhein ehsas dila rahe hain ke ab bhi baaz aa jao aur apne se pehle aisi harkat karne walon ki suraton ke maskh hone ko yaad karo, kahin aisa na ho ke un ki tarah tumhara munh ulat doon ga taake tumhein pichle pairon chalna pade, tumhari aankhein gaddi ki taraf kar doon aur isi jaisi tafsir baaz ne (Inna ja'alna fi a'naqihim aghlalan fahiya ilal-azqani fahum muqmahoon) (Surah Ya-Sin: 8) ki ayat mein bhi ki hai. Garz yeh un ki gumrahi aur hidayat se door pad jane ki buri misaal bayan hui hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) se marvi hai ke matlab yeh hai ke hum tumhein sach-much haq ke raste se hata dein aur gumrahi ki taraf mutawajja kar dein, hum tumhein kafir bana dein aur tumhare chehre bandaron jaise kar dein. Abu Zaid (R.H) farmate hain ke lota dena yeh tha ke arz-e-Hijaz se bilad-e-Sham mein pahuncha diya. Yeh bhi mazkoor hai ke isi ayat ko sun kar Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar (R.A) musharraf ba-Islam huye thay. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim (R.H) ke samne Hazrat Ka'ab (R.A) ke Islam ka tazkira hua to aap ne farmaya Hazrat Ka'ab (R.A) Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke zamane mein musalman huye, yeh Bait-ul-Muqaddas jate huye Madina mein aaye, Hazrat Umar (R.A) un ke paas gaye aur farmaya ae Ka'ab (R.A) musalman ho jao, unhon ne jawab diya tum to Qur'an mein padh chuke ho ke jinhein Taurat ka hamil banaya gaya unhon ne use kama-haqqahu qabool na kiya, un ki misaal us gadhe ki si hai jo bojh lade huye ho aur yeh bhi tum jante ho ke main bhi un logon mein se hoon jo Taurat uthwaye gaye, is par Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne use chhod diya. Yeh yahan se chal kar Homs pahunche, wahan suna ke ek shakhs jo un ke gharane mein se tha is ayat ki tilawat kar raha hai, jab us ne ayat khatam ki unhein darr lagne laga ke kahin sach-much is ayat ki wa'eed mujh par sadiq na aa jaye aur mera munh maskh kar palat na jaye, yeh jhat se kehne lage "Ya Rabb Aslamtu" mere Allah main iman laya. Phir Homs se hi wapas apne watan Yaman mein aaye aur yahan se apne tamam ghar walon ko le kar sare kunbe samet musalman ho gaye. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Ka'ab (R.A) ke Islam ka waqea is tarah marvi hai ke un ke ustad Abu Muslim Jalili un ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein hazir hone mein der lagane ki wajah se har waqt unhein malamat karte rehte thay, phir unhein bheja ke dekhein ke aap wahi paighambar hain jin ki khushkhabri aur ausaf Taurat mein hain?

Yeh aaye toh farmate hain jab main Madina Sharif pahuncha toh ek shakhs Quran-e-Karim ki is aayat ki tilawat kar raha tha ke "Aye Ahl-e-Kitab! Hamari nazil karda kitab tumhare paas maujood kitab ki tasdeeq karti hai, behtar hai ke is par is se pehle imaan lao ke hum tumhare munh bigad dein aur unhein ulta kar dein." Main chaunk utha aur jaldi jaldi ghusl karne baith gaya aur apne chehre par haath pherta jata tha ke kahin mujhe imaan lane mein der na lag jaye aur mera chehra ulta na ho jaye. Phir main bahut jald aa kar musalman ho gaya. Is ke baad Allah Ta'ala farmate hain ya hum un par la'nat karein jaise ke hafta walon par hum ne la'nat nazil ki, yani jin logon ne hafta wale din heele ke liye shikar khela halanke unhein is kaam se mana kiya gaya tha, jis ka natija yeh hua ke woh bandar aur suar bana diye gaye, un ka mufassal waqia Surah Al-A'raf mein aayega Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Irshad hota hai Ilahi kaam poore ho kar hi rehte hain, woh jab koi hukum kar de toh koi nahin jo us ki mukhalifat ya mumanat kar sake. Phir khabar deta hai ke Allah Ta'ala apne sath shirk kiye jane ke gunah ko nahin bakhshta, yani jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala se is haal mein mulaqat kare ke woh mushrik ho, us par bakhshish. Bahut si ahadees hain hum yahan ba-qadr-e-aasani zikr karte hain. Gunahon ke teen diwan: Pehli hadith ba-hawala Musnad-e-Ahmad: Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek gunahon ke teen diwan hain, ek toh woh jis ki Allah Ta'ala kuch parwah nahin karta, dusra woh jis mein Allah Ta'ala kuch nahin chhodta, teesra woh jise Allah Ta'ala hargiz nahin bakhshta. Pas jise woh bakhshta nahin woh shirk hai, Allah Azza-wa-Jal khud farmata hai ke Allah Ta'ala apne sath shareek kiye jane ko maaf nahin farmata aur jagah irshad hai jo shakhs Allah ke sath shareek kar le, Allah us par jannat ko haram kar deta hai. Aur jis diwan mein Allah ke han koi waqat nahin woh bande ka apni jaan par zulm karna hai aur jis ka talluq is se aur Allah ki zaat se hai maslan kisi din ka roza jise us ne chhod diya ya namaz chhod di toh Allah Ta'ala use bakhsh de ga aur jis diwan (aamal-nama) mein se maujood kisi fard ko Allah nahin chhodta woh bandon ke aapas mein mazalim hain jin ka badla aur qisas zaroori hai. Dusri hadith ba-hawala Musnad-e-Bazzar: Alfaaz ke her-pher ke sath matlab wahi hai. Teesri hadith ba-hawala Musnad-e-Ahmad: Mumkin hai Allah Ta'ala har gunah ko bakhsh de magar woh shakhs jo kufr ki halat mein mara, dusra woh jis ne imandar ko jaan boojh kar qatl kiya. Chauthi hadith ba-hawala Musnad-e-Ahmad: Allah Ta'ala farmata hai aye mere bande! Tu jab tak meri ibadat karta rahega aur mujh se nek umeed rakhega main bhi teri jitni khatayen hain unhein maaf farmata rahunga, mere bande agar tu sari zameen bhar ki khatayen bhi le kar mere paas aayega toh main bhi zameen ki wus'aton jitni maghfirat ke sath tujh se milunga basharte ke tu ne mere sath kisi ko shareek na kiya ho. Panchwin hadith ba-hawala Musnad-e-Ahmad.

Jo banda La ilaha illallah kahe phir isi par us ka inteqal ho woh zaroor jannat mein jayega, yeh sun kar Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) ne daryaft kiya ke agar us ne zina aur chori bhi kiya ho? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya go us ne zinakari aur chori bhi ki ho, teen martaba yahi sawal jawab hua. Chauthe sawal par Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya chahe Abu Zar ki naak khaak-aalood ho. Pas Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) wahan se apni chadar ghaseet-te hue yeh farmate hue nikle ke chahe Abu Zar ki naak khaak-aalood ho aur is ke baad jab kabhi aap yeh hadith bayan farmate yeh jumla zaroori kehte. Yeh hadith dusri sanad se qadre ziyadati ke sath bhi marwi hai, is mein hai Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) farmate hain main Nabi (ﷺ) ke sath Madina ke maidan mein chala ja raha tha, Uhad ki taraf hamari nigahain thin ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya ae Abu Zar! Main ne kaha Labbaik Ya Rasool Allah! Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya suno mere paas Uhad pahar ke barabar sona ho to main na chahunga ke teesri sham ko is mein se kuch bhi baqi reh jaye bajuz us dinar ke jise main qarza chukane ke liye rakh loon, baqi tamam maal main is tarah rah-e-Lillah is ke bandon ko de daloon aur Aap (ﷺ) ne dayen bayen aur samne lapain phenkin.

Phir kuch der hum chalte rahe phir Huzoor ﷺ ne mujhe pukara aur farmaya jin ke paas yahan ziyadati hai wohi wahan kami wale honge magar jo is tarah aur is tarah kare yani aap ne apne daen samne aur baen lapain (hatheliyan) bhar kar dete hue is amal ki wazahat ki, phir kuch der chalne ke baad farmaya Abu Zar main abhi aata hoon tum yahin thehro aap tashreef le gaye aur meri nigahon se ojhal ho gaye aur mujhe aawazein sunai dene lagin dil bechain ho gaya ke kahin tanhai mein koi dushman aa gaya ho main ne qasd kiya ke wahan pahunchun lekin sath hi Huzoor ﷺ ka yeh farman yaad aa gaya ke main jab tak na aaun tum yahin thehre rehna chunancha main thehra raha yahan tak ke aap tashreef le aaye to main ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ yeh aawazein kaisi aa rahi thin aap ne farmaya mere paas Hazrat Jibraeel A.S aaye the aur farma rahe the ke aap ki ummat mein se wafat paane wala Allah Ta'ala ke sath kisi ko shareek na kare to woh jannat mein jayega main ne kaha go zina aur chori bhi us se sarzad hui ho to farmaya haan go zina aur chori bhi hui ho, yeh hadith Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai ke Hazrat Abu Zar R.A farmate hain raat ke waqt nikla dekha ke Rasool Allah ﷺ tanha tashreef le ja rahe hain to mujhe khayal hua ke shayad is waqt aap kisi ko sath le jana nahin chahte to main chand ki chandni mein Huzoor ﷺ ke peeche ho liya aap ne jab mud kar mujhe dekha to poocha kaun hai main ne kaha Abu Zar Allah mujhe aap par se qurban kar de to aap ne farmaya aao mere sath chalo thodi der hum chalte rahe phir aap ne farmaya ziyadati wale hi Qayamat ke din kami wale honge magar woh jinhein Allah Ta'ala ne maal diya phir woh daen baen aage peeche nek kamon mein kharch karte rahe phir kuch der chalne ke baad aap ne mujhe ek jagah bitha kar jis ke gird-o-pesh patthar the farmaya meri wapsi tak yahin baithe raho phir aap aage nikal gaye yahan tak ke meri nazar se posheeda ho gaye aap ko zyada der lag gayi phir main ne dekha ke aap tashreef la rahe hain aur zaban-e-mubarak se farmate aa rahe hain go zina kiya ho ya chori ki ho jab mere paas pahunche to main ruk na saka poocha ke ae Nabi-e-Allah ﷺ Allah mujhe aap par qurban kare is maidan ke kinare aap kis se baatein kar rahe the main ne suna koi aap ko jawab bhi de raha tha aap ne farmaya woh Jibraeel A.S the yahan mere paas aaye aur farmaya apni ummat ko khushkhabri suna do ke jo mere aur Allah ke sath us ne kisi ko shareek na kiya woh jannati hoga main ne kaha ae Jibraeel A.S go us ne chori ki ho aur zina kiya ho farmaya haan main ne phir yahi sawal kiya jawab diya haan main ne phir yahi farmaya haan aur agarche us ne sharab pi ho. Chathi hadith bahawala Musnad Abd bin Humaid ek shakhs Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaya, aur kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ jannat wajib kar dene wali cheezein kya hain?

Aap ne farmaya jo shakhs baghair shirk kiye mara us ke liye jannat wajib hai aur jo shirk karte hue mara us ke liye jahannam wajib hai, yahi hadith aur tariq se marvi hai jis mein hai ke jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala ke sath shirk na karta hua mara us ke liye bakhshish halal hai agar Allah chahe use azab kare agar chahe bakhsh de, Allah ke sath kisi ko sharik karne wale ko nahin bakhshta us ke siwa jise chahe bakhsh de (Ibn Abi Hatim). Aur sanad se marvi hai ke Aap ne farmaya bande par maghfirat hamesha rehti hai jab tak ke parde na pad jayen, daryaft kiya gaya ke Huzoor (ﷺ) parde pad jana kya hai? Farmaya shirk, jo shakhs shirk na karta ho aur Allah Ta'ala se mulaqat kare us ke liye bakhshish-e-Ilahi halal ho gayi agar chahiye azab kare agar chahe bakhsh de, phir Aap ne (Aayat: Inna Allaha la yaghfiru an yushraka bihi wa yaghfiru ma duna dhalika liman yasha'u) tilawat farmayi (Musnad Abu Ya'la). Satvin hadith ba-hawala Musnad Ahmad, jo shakhs mare Allah ke sath sharik na karta ho woh jannat mein dakhil hoga. Athvin hadith ba-hawala Musnad Ahmad, Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ek martaba Sahaba (R.A) ke paas aaye aur farmaya tumhare Rabb-e-Azz-o-Jal ne mujhe ikhtiyar diya ke meri ummat mein se sattar hazar ka be-hisab jannat mein jana pasand karun ya Allah Ta'ala ke paas jo cheez mere liye meri ummat ki babat poshida mehfooz hai use qabool kar lun, toh ba'az Sahaba ne kaha kya Allah Ta'ala Aap ke liye yeh mehfooz cheez bacha kar bhi rakhega? Aap yeh sun kar andar tashreef le gaye phir takbeer padhte hue bahar aaye aur farmane lage mere Rabb ne mujhe har hazar ke sath sattar hazar ko jannat ata karna mazeed ata farmaya aur woh poshida hissa bhi. Hazrat Abu Ayyub Ansari (R.A) jab yeh hadith bayan farma chuke toh Hazrat Abu Rahm ne sawal kiya ke woh poshida mehfooz kya hai? Is par logon ne unhein kuch kuch kehna shuru kar diya ke kahan tum aur kahan Huzoor (ﷺ) ke liye ikhtiyar karda cheez? Hazrat Ayyub (R.A) ne farmaya suno jahan tak hamara guman hai jo guman yaqeen ke qareeb hai yeh hai ke woh cheez jannat mein jana hai har us shakhs ka jo sache dil se gawahi de ke Allah ek hai us ke siwa koi mabood nahin aur Muhammad (ﷺ) us ke bande aur Rasool hain. Navin hadith ba-hawala Ibn Abi Hatim, ek shakhs Huzoor (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein hazir hua aur kaha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) mera bhatija haram se baaz nahin aata, Aap ne farmaya us ki deendari kaisi hai, kaha namazi hai aur tauheed wala hai, Aap ne farmaya jao aur us se us ka deen bator-e-subah ke talab karo agar inkar kare toh us se khareed lo, us ne ja kar us se talab kiya toh us ne inkar kar diya, us ne aa kar Huzoor (ﷺ) ko khabar di toh Aap ne farmaya main ne use apne deen par chimta hua paya, is par (Aayat: Inna Allaha la yaghfiru an yushraka bihi...) nazil hui. Dasvin hadith ba-hawala Hafiz Ya'la, ek shakhs Rasool (ﷺ) ke paas aaya aur kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) main ne koi hajat ya hajat wala nahin choda yani zindagi mein sab kuch kar chuka, Aap ne farmaya kya tu yeh gawahi nahin deta ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahin aur Muhammad (ﷺ) Allah ke Rasool hain, teen martaba us ne kaha han, Aap ne farmaya yeh in sab par ghalib aa jayega.

Gyarahvin hadith bahawala Musnad-e-Ahmad. Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ne Zakhm bin Josh Yamami (R.H) se kaha ke ae Yamami! Kisi shakhs se hargiz yeh na kehna ke Allah Ta'ala tujhe nahin bakhshe ga ya tujhe jannat mein dakhil na kare ga. Yamami (R.H) ne kaha, Hazrat! Yeh baat toh hum log apne bhaiyon aur doston se bhi gusse gusse mein keh jate hain. Aap (R.A) ne farmaya, khabardar! Hargiz na kehna. Suno, main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai, aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Bani Israel mein do shakhs thay, ek toh ibadat mein bahut chust chalak aur dusra apni jaan par ziyadati karne wala, aur dono mein dostana aur bhai chara tha. Aabid basa auqat is dusre ko kisi na kisi gunah mein dekhta rehta tha, (aur kehta) ae shakhs! Baaz reh. Jawab deta, tu mujhe mere Rab par chhor de, kya tu mujh par nigahban bana kar bheja gaya hai? Ek martaba aabid ne dekha ke woh phir kisi gunah ke kaam ko kar raha hai jo gunah use bahut bada maloom hua, toh kaha, afsos tujh par! Baaz aa. Us ne wahi jawab diya, toh aabid ne kaha, Allah ki qasam! Allah tujhe hargiz na bakhshe ga ya jannat na de ga. Allah Ta'ala ne un ke paas farishta bheja jis ne un ki roohein qabz kar lin. Jab dono Allah Ta'ala ke haan jama hue toh Allah Ta'ala ne is gunehgar se farmaya, ja aur meri rahmat ki bina par jannat mein dakhil ho ja. Aur is aabid se farmaya, kya tujhe haqiqi ilm tha? Kya tu meri cheez par qadir tha? Ise jahannam ki taraf le jao. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne yeh bayan farmaya, us ki qasam jis ke haath mein Abu Al-Qasim ki jaan hai, us ne ek kalma zaban se aisa nikal diya jis ne us ki duniya aur aakhirat barbad kar di.

Barahvin hadith bahawala Tabrani: Jis ne is baat ka yaqeen kar liya ke main gunahon ki bakhshish par qadir hoon toh main use bakhsh hi deta hoon aur koi parwah nahin karta jab tak ke woh mere saath kisi ko shareek na thehraye.

Terahvin hadith bahawala Bazzar, Abu Ya'la: Jis amal par Allah Ta'ala ne sawab ka wada kiya hai use toh Malik zaroor pura farmaye ga aur jis par saza ka farmaya hai woh us ke ikhtiyar mein hai, chahe bakhsh de ya saza de. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) farmate hain, hum Sahaba (R.A) qatil ke bare mein aur yateem ka maal kha jane wale ke bare mein aur pak daman aurton par tohmat lagane wale ke bare mein aur jhooti gawahi dene wale ke bare mein koi shak-o-shuba hi nahin karte thay, yahan tak ke (Aayat: Inna Allaha Yaghfiru... Al-Ayah) utri aur Ashab-e-Rasool gumrahi se ruk gaye (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Ibn-e-Jareer ki yeh riwayat is tarah par hai ke jin gunahon par jahannam ka zikr Kitabullah mein hai use karne wale ke jahannami hone mein hamein koi shak hi nahin tha, yahan tak ke hum par yeh aayat utri, jab hum ne ise suna toh hum shahadat ke liye ruk gaye aur tamam umoor Allah Ta'ala ki taraf sonp diye.

Bazzar mein aap hi ki ek riwayat hai ke kabira gunah karne walon ke liye istighfar karne se hum ruke hue thay yahan tak ke hum ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yeh aayat suni aur aap ne yeh bhi farmaya ke main ne apni shafa'at ko apni ummat mein se kabira gunah karne walon ke liye mu'akhar kar rakha hai. Abu Ja'far Razi ki riwayat mein aap ka yeh farman hai ke jab (يٰعِبَادِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اَسْرَفُوْا عَلٰٓي اَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوْا مِنْ رَّحْمَةِ اللّٰهِ) (Surah Az-Zumar: 53) nazil hui yani ae mere woh bando jinhon ne apni janon par zulm kiya hai tum meri rahmat se mayus na ho jao, to ek shakhs ne khade ho kar pucha Huzoor shirk karne wala bhi? Aap ko is ka yeh sawal na-pasand aaya phir aap ne unhein (Aayat-e-Allah la yaghfiru al-shirka...) padh kar sunayi. Surah Tanzeel ki yeh aayat mashroot hai tauba ke sath, pas jo shakhs jis gunah se tauba kare Allah us ki taraf ruju' karta hai go baar baar kare, pas mayus na hone ki aayat mein tauba ki shart zaroor hai. Warna is mein shirk bhi aa jayega aur phir matlab sahih na hoga kyunke is aayat mein wazahat ke sath yahan maujood hai ke Allah ke sath shirk karne wale ki bakhshish nahin hai, haan is ke siwa jise chahe yani agar us ne tauba bhi na ki ho, is matlab ke sath is aayat mein jo umeed dilane wali hai aur zyada umeed ki aas paida ho jati hai, Wallahu A'lam. Phir farmata hai Allah ke sath jo shirk kare us ne bade gunah ka iftira bandha, jaise aur aayat mein hai shirk bahut bada zulm hai. Bukhari Muslim mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se riwayat hai ke sab se bada gunah kya hai? Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain tumhein sab se bada kabira gunah batata hoon woh Allah Ta'ala ke sath shareek karna hai, phir aap ne isi aayat ka yeh aakhri hissa tilawat farmaya, phir maa baap ki nafarmani karna, phir aap ne yeh aayat tilawat farmayi ke (اَنِ اشْكُرْ لِيْ وَلِوَالِدَيْكَ ۭ اِلَيَّ الْمَصِيْرُ) (Surah Luqman: 14) mera shukr kar aur apne maa baap ka shukriya kar, meri taraf lautna hai.

Qur'an-e-Hakim ka Aijaz-e-Taseer. Allah Azzawajal Yahood-o-Nasara ko hukum deta hai ke main ne apni zabardast kitab apne behtareen Nabi (ﷺ) ke sath nazil farmayi hai jis mein khud tumhari apni kitab ki tasdeeq bhi hai, is par iman lao is se pehle ke hum tumhari suratein maskh kar dein yani munh bigad kar dein, aankhein bajaye idhar ke udhar ho jayen, ya yeh matlab ke tumhare chehre mita dein, aankhein, kaan, naak sab mit jayen phir yeh maskh chehra bhi ulta ho jaye. Yeh azab un ke bad-a'maal ka badla hai, yahi wajah hai ke yeh haq se hat kar batil ki taraf, hidayat se phir kar zalalat ki janib badhe chale ja rahe hain. Ba-in-hama Allah Ta'ala unhein ehsas dila rahe hain ke ab bhi baaz aa jao aur apne se pehle aisi harkat karne walon ki suraton ke maskh hone ko yaad karo, kahin aisa na ho ke un ki tarah tumhara munh ulat doon ga taake tumhein pichle pairon chalna pade, tumhari aankhein gaddi ki taraf kar doon aur isi jaisi tafsir baaz ne (Inna ja'alna fi a'naqihim aghlalan fahiya ilal-azqani fahum muqmahoon) (Surah Ya-Sin: 8) ki ayat mein bhi ki hai. Garz yeh un ki gumrahi aur hidayat se door pad jane ki buri misaal bayan hui hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) se marvi hai ke matlab yeh hai ke hum tumhein sach-much haq ke raste se hata dein aur gumrahi ki taraf mutawajja kar dein, hum tumhein kafir bana dein aur tumhare chehre bandaron jaise kar dein. Abu Zaid (R.H) farmate hain ke lota dena yeh tha ke arz-e-Hijaz se bilad-e-Sham mein pahuncha diya. Yeh bhi mazkoor hai ke isi ayat ko sun kar Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar (R.A) musharraf ba-Islam huye thay. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim (R.H) ke samne Hazrat Ka'ab (R.A) ke Islam ka tazkira hua to aap ne farmaya Hazrat Ka'ab (R.A) Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke zamane mein musalman huye, yeh Bait-ul-Muqaddas jate huye Madina mein aaye, Hazrat Umar (R.A) un ke paas gaye aur farmaya ae Ka'ab (R.A) musalman ho jao, unhon ne jawab diya tum to Qur'an mein padh chuke ho ke jinhein Taurat ka hamil banaya gaya unhon ne use kama-haqqahu qabool na kiya, un ki misaal us gadhe ki si hai jo bojh lade huye ho aur yeh bhi tum jante ho ke main bhi un logon mein se hoon jo Taurat uthwaye gaye, is par Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne use chhod diya. Yeh yahan se chal kar Homs pahunche, wahan suna ke ek shakhs jo un ke gharane mein se tha is ayat ki tilawat kar raha hai, jab us ne ayat khatam ki unhein darr lagne laga ke kahin sach-much is ayat ki wa'eed mujh par sadiq na aa jaye aur mera munh maskh kar palat na jaye, yeh jhat se kehne lage "Ya Rabb Aslamtu" mere Allah main iman laya. Phir Homs se hi wapas apne watan Yaman mein aaye aur yahan se apne tamam ghar walon ko le kar sare kunbe samet musalman ho gaye. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Ka'ab (R.A) ke Islam ka waqea is tarah marvi hai ke un ke ustad Abu Muslim Jalili un ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein hazir hone mein der lagane ki wajah se har waqt unhein malamat karte rehte thay, phir unhein bheja ke dekhein ke aap wahi paighambar hain jin ki khushkhabri aur ausaf Taurat mein hain?

Yeh aaye toh farmate hain jab main Madina Sharif pahuncha toh ek shakhs Quran-e-Karim ki is aayat ki tilawat kar raha tha ke "Aye Ahl-e-Kitab! Hamari nazil karda kitab tumhare paas maujood kitab ki tasdeeq karti hai, behtar hai ke is par is se pehle imaan lao ke hum tumhare munh bigad dein aur unhein ulta kar dein." Main chaunk utha aur jaldi jaldi ghusl karne baith gaya aur apne chehre par haath pherta jata tha ke kahin mujhe imaan lane mein der na lag jaye aur mera chehra ulta na ho jaye. Phir main bahut jald aa kar musalman ho gaya. Is ke baad Allah Ta'ala farmate hain ya hum un par la'nat karein jaise ke hafta walon par hum ne la'nat nazil ki, yani jin logon ne hafta wale din heele ke liye shikar khela halanke unhein is kaam se mana kiya gaya tha, jis ka natija yeh hua ke woh bandar aur suar bana diye gaye, un ka mufassal waqia Surah Al-A'raf mein aayega Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Irshad hota hai Ilahi kaam poore ho kar hi rehte hain, woh jab koi hukum kar de toh koi nahin jo us ki mukhalifat ya mumanat kar sake. Phir khabar deta hai ke Allah Ta'ala apne sath shirk kiye jane ke gunah ko nahin bakhshta, yani jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala se is haal mein mulaqat kare ke woh mushrik ho, us par bakhshish. Bahut si ahadees hain hum yahan ba-qadr-e-aasani zikr karte hain. Gunahon ke teen diwan: Pehli hadith ba-hawala Musnad-e-Ahmad: Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek gunahon ke teen diwan hain, ek toh woh jis ki Allah Ta'ala kuch parwah nahin karta, dusra woh jis mein Allah Ta'ala kuch nahin chhodta, teesra woh jise Allah Ta'ala hargiz nahin bakhshta. Pas jise woh bakhshta nahin woh shirk hai, Allah Azza-wa-Jal khud farmata hai ke Allah Ta'ala apne sath shareek kiye jane ko maaf nahin farmata aur jagah irshad hai jo shakhs Allah ke sath shareek kar le, Allah us par jannat ko haram kar deta hai. Aur jis diwan mein Allah ke han koi waqat nahin woh bande ka apni jaan par zulm karna hai aur jis ka talluq is se aur Allah ki zaat se hai maslan kisi din ka roza jise us ne chhod diya ya namaz chhod di toh Allah Ta'ala use bakhsh de ga aur jis diwan (aamal-nama) mein se maujood kisi fard ko Allah nahin chhodta woh bandon ke aapas mein mazalim hain jin ka badla aur qisas zaroori hai. Dusri hadith ba-hawala Musnad-e-Bazzar: Alfaaz ke her-pher ke sath matlab wahi hai. Teesri hadith ba-hawala Musnad-e-Ahmad: Mumkin hai Allah Ta'ala har gunah ko bakhsh de magar woh shakhs jo kufr ki halat mein mara, dusra woh jis ne imandar ko jaan boojh kar qatl kiya. Chauthi hadith ba-hawala Musnad-e-Ahmad: Allah Ta'ala farmata hai aye mere bande! Tu jab tak meri ibadat karta rahega aur mujh se nek umeed rakhega main bhi teri jitni khatayen hain unhein maaf farmata rahunga, mere bande agar tu sari zameen bhar ki khatayen bhi le kar mere paas aayega toh main bhi zameen ki wus'aton jitni maghfirat ke sath tujh se milunga basharte ke tu ne mere sath kisi ko shareek na kiya ho. Panchwin hadith ba-hawala Musnad-e-Ahmad.

Jo banda La ilaha illallah kahe phir isi par us ka inteqal ho woh zaroor jannat mein jayega, yeh sun kar Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) ne daryaft kiya ke agar us ne zina aur chori bhi kiya ho? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya go us ne zinakari aur chori bhi ki ho, teen martaba yahi sawal jawab hua. Chauthe sawal par Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya chahe Abu Zar ki naak khaak-aalood ho. Pas Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) wahan se apni chadar ghaseet-te hue yeh farmate hue nikle ke chahe Abu Zar ki naak khaak-aalood ho aur is ke baad jab kabhi aap yeh hadith bayan farmate yeh jumla zaroori kehte. Yeh hadith dusri sanad se qadre ziyadati ke sath bhi marwi hai, is mein hai Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) farmate hain main Nabi (ﷺ) ke sath Madina ke maidan mein chala ja raha tha, Uhad ki taraf hamari nigahain thin ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya ae Abu Zar! Main ne kaha Labbaik Ya Rasool Allah! Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya suno mere paas Uhad pahar ke barabar sona ho to main na chahunga ke teesri sham ko is mein se kuch bhi baqi reh jaye bajuz us dinar ke jise main qarza chukane ke liye rakh loon, baqi tamam maal main is tarah rah-e-Lillah is ke bandon ko de daloon aur Aap (ﷺ) ne dayen bayen aur samne lapain phenkin.

Phir kuch der hum chalte rahe phir Huzoor ﷺ ne mujhe pukara aur farmaya jin ke paas yahan ziyadati hai wohi wahan kami wale honge magar jo is tarah aur is tarah kare yani aap ne apne daen samne aur baen lapain (hatheliyan) bhar kar dete hue is amal ki wazahat ki, phir kuch der chalne ke baad farmaya Abu Zar main abhi aata hoon tum yahin thehro aap tashreef le gaye aur meri nigahon se ojhal ho gaye aur mujhe aawazein sunai dene lagin dil bechain ho gaya ke kahin tanhai mein koi dushman aa gaya ho main ne qasd kiya ke wahan pahunchun lekin sath hi Huzoor ﷺ ka yeh farman yaad aa gaya ke main jab tak na aaun tum yahin thehre rehna chunancha main thehra raha yahan tak ke aap tashreef le aaye to main ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ yeh aawazein kaisi aa rahi thin aap ne farmaya mere paas Hazrat Jibraeel A.S aaye the aur farma rahe the ke aap ki ummat mein se wafat paane wala Allah Ta'ala ke sath kisi ko shareek na kare to woh jannat mein jayega main ne kaha go zina aur chori bhi us se sarzad hui ho to farmaya haan go zina aur chori bhi hui ho, yeh hadith Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai ke Hazrat Abu Zar R.A farmate hain raat ke waqt nikla dekha ke Rasool Allah ﷺ tanha tashreef le ja rahe hain to mujhe khayal hua ke shayad is waqt aap kisi ko sath le jana nahin chahte to main chand ki chandni mein Huzoor ﷺ ke peeche ho liya aap ne jab mud kar mujhe dekha to poocha kaun hai main ne kaha Abu Zar Allah mujhe aap par se qurban kar de to aap ne farmaya aao mere sath chalo thodi der hum chalte rahe phir aap ne farmaya ziyadati wale hi Qayamat ke din kami wale honge magar woh jinhein Allah Ta'ala ne maal diya phir woh daen baen aage peeche nek kamon mein kharch karte rahe phir kuch der chalne ke baad aap ne mujhe ek jagah bitha kar jis ke gird-o-pesh patthar the farmaya meri wapsi tak yahin baithe raho phir aap aage nikal gaye yahan tak ke meri nazar se posheeda ho gaye aap ko zyada der lag gayi phir main ne dekha ke aap tashreef la rahe hain aur zaban-e-mubarak se farmate aa rahe hain go zina kiya ho ya chori ki ho jab mere paas pahunche to main ruk na saka poocha ke ae Nabi-e-Allah ﷺ Allah mujhe aap par qurban kare is maidan ke kinare aap kis se baatein kar rahe the main ne suna koi aap ko jawab bhi de raha tha aap ne farmaya woh Jibraeel A.S the yahan mere paas aaye aur farmaya apni ummat ko khushkhabri suna do ke jo mere aur Allah ke sath us ne kisi ko shareek na kiya woh jannati hoga main ne kaha ae Jibraeel A.S go us ne chori ki ho aur zina kiya ho farmaya haan main ne phir yahi sawal kiya jawab diya haan main ne phir yahi farmaya haan aur agarche us ne sharab pi ho. Chathi hadith bahawala Musnad Abd bin Humaid ek shakhs Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaya, aur kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ jannat wajib kar dene wali cheezein kya hain?

Aap ne farmaya jo shakhs baghair shirk kiye mara us ke liye jannat wajib hai aur jo shirk karte hue mara us ke liye jahannam wajib hai, yahi hadith aur tariq se marvi hai jis mein hai ke jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala ke sath shirk na karta hua mara us ke liye bakhshish halal hai agar Allah chahe use azab kare agar chahe bakhsh de, Allah ke sath kisi ko sharik karne wale ko nahin bakhshta us ke siwa jise chahe bakhsh de (Ibn Abi Hatim). Aur sanad se marvi hai ke Aap ne farmaya bande par maghfirat hamesha rehti hai jab tak ke parde na pad jayen, daryaft kiya gaya ke Huzoor (ﷺ) parde pad jana kya hai? Farmaya shirk, jo shakhs shirk na karta ho aur Allah Ta'ala se mulaqat kare us ke liye bakhshish-e-Ilahi halal ho gayi agar chahiye azab kare agar chahe bakhsh de, phir Aap ne (Aayat: Inna Allaha la yaghfiru an yushraka bihi wa yaghfiru ma duna dhalika liman yasha'u) tilawat farmayi (Musnad Abu Ya'la). Satvin hadith ba-hawala Musnad Ahmad, jo shakhs mare Allah ke sath sharik na karta ho woh jannat mein dakhil hoga. Athvin hadith ba-hawala Musnad Ahmad, Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ek martaba Sahaba (R.A) ke paas aaye aur farmaya tumhare Rabb-e-Azz-o-Jal ne mujhe ikhtiyar diya ke meri ummat mein se sattar hazar ka be-hisab jannat mein jana pasand karun ya Allah Ta'ala ke paas jo cheez mere liye meri ummat ki babat poshida mehfooz hai use qabool kar lun, toh ba'az Sahaba ne kaha kya Allah Ta'ala Aap ke liye yeh mehfooz cheez bacha kar bhi rakhega? Aap yeh sun kar andar tashreef le gaye phir takbeer padhte hue bahar aaye aur farmane lage mere Rabb ne mujhe har hazar ke sath sattar hazar ko jannat ata karna mazeed ata farmaya aur woh poshida hissa bhi. Hazrat Abu Ayyub Ansari (R.A) jab yeh hadith bayan farma chuke toh Hazrat Abu Rahm ne sawal kiya ke woh poshida mehfooz kya hai? Is par logon ne unhein kuch kuch kehna shuru kar diya ke kahan tum aur kahan Huzoor (ﷺ) ke liye ikhtiyar karda cheez? Hazrat Ayyub (R.A) ne farmaya suno jahan tak hamara guman hai jo guman yaqeen ke qareeb hai yeh hai ke woh cheez jannat mein jana hai har us shakhs ka jo sache dil se gawahi de ke Allah ek hai us ke siwa koi mabood nahin aur Muhammad (ﷺ) us ke bande aur Rasool hain. Navin hadith ba-hawala Ibn Abi Hatim, ek shakhs Huzoor (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein hazir hua aur kaha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) mera bhatija haram se baaz nahin aata, Aap ne farmaya us ki deendari kaisi hai, kaha namazi hai aur tauheed wala hai, Aap ne farmaya jao aur us se us ka deen bator-e-subah ke talab karo agar inkar kare toh us se khareed lo, us ne ja kar us se talab kiya toh us ne inkar kar diya, us ne aa kar Huzoor (ﷺ) ko khabar di toh Aap ne farmaya main ne use apne deen par chimta hua paya, is par (Aayat: Inna Allaha la yaghfiru an yushraka bihi...) nazil hui. Dasvin hadith ba-hawala Hafiz Ya'la, ek shakhs Rasool (ﷺ) ke paas aaya aur kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) main ne koi hajat ya hajat wala nahin choda yani zindagi mein sab kuch kar chuka, Aap ne farmaya kya tu yeh gawahi nahin deta ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahin aur Muhammad (ﷺ) Allah ke Rasool hain, teen martaba us ne kaha han, Aap ne farmaya yeh in sab par ghalib aa jayega.

Gyarahvin hadith bahawala Musnad-e-Ahmad. Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ne Zakhm bin Josh Yamami (R.H) se kaha ke ae Yamami! Kisi shakhs se hargiz yeh na kehna ke Allah Ta'ala tujhe nahin bakhshe ga ya tujhe jannat mein dakhil na kare ga. Yamami (R.H) ne kaha, Hazrat! Yeh baat toh hum log apne bhaiyon aur doston se bhi gusse gusse mein keh jate hain. Aap (R.A) ne farmaya, khabardar! Hargiz na kehna. Suno, main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai, aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Bani Israel mein do shakhs thay, ek toh ibadat mein bahut chust chalak aur dusra apni jaan par ziyadati karne wala, aur dono mein dostana aur bhai chara tha. Aabid basa auqat is dusre ko kisi na kisi gunah mein dekhta rehta tha, (aur kehta) ae shakhs! Baaz reh. Jawab deta, tu mujhe mere Rab par chhor de, kya tu mujh par nigahban bana kar bheja gaya hai? Ek martaba aabid ne dekha ke woh phir kisi gunah ke kaam ko kar raha hai jo gunah use bahut bada maloom hua, toh kaha, afsos tujh par! Baaz aa. Us ne wahi jawab diya, toh aabid ne kaha, Allah ki qasam! Allah tujhe hargiz na bakhshe ga ya jannat na de ga. Allah Ta'ala ne un ke paas farishta bheja jis ne un ki roohein qabz kar lin. Jab dono Allah Ta'ala ke haan jama hue toh Allah Ta'ala ne is gunehgar se farmaya, ja aur meri rahmat ki bina par jannat mein dakhil ho ja. Aur is aabid se farmaya, kya tujhe haqiqi ilm tha? Kya tu meri cheez par qadir tha? Ise jahannam ki taraf le jao. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne yeh bayan farmaya, us ki qasam jis ke haath mein Abu Al-Qasim ki jaan hai, us ne ek kalma zaban se aisa nikal diya jis ne us ki duniya aur aakhirat barbad kar di.

Barahvin hadith bahawala Tabrani: Jis ne is baat ka yaqeen kar liya ke main gunahon ki bakhshish par qadir hoon toh main use bakhsh hi deta hoon aur koi parwah nahin karta jab tak ke woh mere saath kisi ko shareek na thehraye.

Terahvin hadith bahawala Bazzar, Abu Ya'la: Jis amal par Allah Ta'ala ne sawab ka wada kiya hai use toh Malik zaroor pura farmaye ga aur jis par saza ka farmaya hai woh us ke ikhtiyar mein hai, chahe bakhsh de ya saza de. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) farmate hain, hum Sahaba (R.A) qatil ke bare mein aur yateem ka maal kha jane wale ke bare mein aur pak daman aurton par tohmat lagane wale ke bare mein aur jhooti gawahi dene wale ke bare mein koi shak-o-shuba hi nahin karte thay, yahan tak ke (Aayat: Inna Allaha Yaghfiru... Al-Ayah) utri aur Ashab-e-Rasool gumrahi se ruk gaye (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Ibn-e-Jareer ki yeh riwayat is tarah par hai ke jin gunahon par jahannam ka zikr Kitabullah mein hai use karne wale ke jahannami hone mein hamein koi shak hi nahin tha, yahan tak ke hum par yeh aayat utri, jab hum ne ise suna toh hum shahadat ke liye ruk gaye aur tamam umoor Allah Ta'ala ki taraf sonp diye.

Bazzar mein aap hi ki ek riwayat hai ke kabira gunah karne walon ke liye istighfar karne se hum ruke hue thay yahan tak ke hum ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yeh aayat suni aur aap ne yeh bhi farmaya ke main ne apni shafa'at ko apni ummat mein se kabira gunah karne walon ke liye mu'akhar kar rakha hai. Abu Ja'far Razi ki riwayat mein aap ka yeh farman hai ke jab (يٰعِبَادِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اَسْرَفُوْا عَلٰٓي اَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوْا مِنْ رَّحْمَةِ اللّٰهِ) (Surah Az-Zumar: 53) nazil hui yani ae mere woh bando jinhon ne apni janon par zulm kiya hai tum meri rahmat se mayus na ho jao, to ek shakhs ne khade ho kar pucha Huzoor shirk karne wala bhi? Aap ko is ka yeh sawal na-pasand aaya phir aap ne unhein (Aayat-e-Allah la yaghfiru al-shirka...) padh kar sunayi. Surah Tanzeel ki yeh aayat mashroot hai tauba ke sath, pas jo shakhs jis gunah se tauba kare Allah us ki taraf ruju' karta hai go baar baar kare, pas mayus na hone ki aayat mein tauba ki shart zaroor hai. Warna is mein shirk bhi aa jayega aur phir matlab sahih na hoga kyunke is aayat mein wazahat ke sath yahan maujood hai ke Allah ke sath shirk karne wale ki bakhshish nahin hai, haan is ke siwa jise chahe yani agar us ne tauba bhi na ki ho, is matlab ke sath is aayat mein jo umeed dilane wali hai aur zyada umeed ki aas paida ho jati hai, Wallahu A'lam. Phir farmata hai Allah ke sath jo shirk kare us ne bade gunah ka iftira bandha, jaise aur aayat mein hai shirk bahut bada zulm hai. Bukhari Muslim mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se riwayat hai ke sab se bada gunah kya hai? Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain tumhein sab se bada kabira gunah batata hoon woh Allah Ta'ala ke sath shareek karna hai, phir aap ne isi aayat ka yeh aakhri hissa tilawat farmaya, phir maa baap ki nafarmani karna, phir aap ne yeh aayat tilawat farmayi ke (اَنِ اشْكُرْ لِيْ وَلِوَالِدَيْكَ ۭ اِلَيَّ الْمَصِيْرُ) (Surah Luqman: 14) mera shukr kar aur apne maa baap ka shukriya kar, meri taraf lautna hai.

Qur'an-e-Hakim ka Aijaz-e-Taseer. Allah Azzawajal Yahood-o-Nasara ko hukum deta hai ke main ne apni zabardast kitab apne behtareen Nabi (ﷺ) ke sath nazil farmayi hai jis mein khud tumhari apni kitab ki tasdeeq bhi hai, is par iman lao is se pehle ke hum tumhari suratein maskh kar dein yani munh bigad kar dein, aankhein bajaye idhar ke udhar ho jayen, ya yeh matlab ke tumhare chehre mita dein, aankhein, kaan, naak sab mit jayen phir yeh maskh chehra bhi ulta ho jaye. Yeh azab un ke bad-a'maal ka badla hai, yahi wajah hai ke yeh haq se hat kar batil ki taraf, hidayat se phir kar zalalat ki janib badhe chale ja rahe hain. Ba-in-hama Allah Ta'ala unhein ehsas dila rahe hain ke ab bhi baaz aa jao aur apne se pehle aisi harkat karne walon ki suraton ke maskh hone ko yaad karo, kahin aisa na ho ke un ki tarah tumhara munh ulat doon ga taake tumhein pichle pairon chalna pade, tumhari aankhein gaddi ki taraf kar doon aur isi jaisi tafsir baaz ne (Inna ja'alna fi a'naqihim aghlalan fahiya ilal-azqani fahum muqmahoon) (Surah Ya-Sin: 8) ki ayat mein bhi ki hai. Garz yeh un ki gumrahi aur hidayat se door pad jane ki buri misaal bayan hui hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) se marvi hai ke matlab yeh hai ke hum tumhein sach-much haq ke raste se hata dein aur gumrahi ki taraf mutawajja kar dein, hum tumhein kafir bana dein aur tumhare chehre bandaron jaise kar dein. Abu Zaid (R.H) farmate hain ke lota dena yeh tha ke arz-e-Hijaz se bilad-e-Sham mein pahuncha diya. Yeh bhi mazkoor hai ke isi ayat ko sun kar Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar (R.A) musharraf ba-Islam huye thay. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim (R.H) ke samne Hazrat Ka'ab (R.A) ke Islam ka tazkira hua to aap ne farmaya Hazrat Ka'ab (R.A) Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke zamane mein musalman huye, yeh Bait-ul-Muqaddas jate huye Madina mein aaye, Hazrat Umar (R.A) un ke paas gaye aur farmaya ae Ka'ab (R.A) musalman ho jao, unhon ne jawab diya tum to Qur'an mein padh chuke ho ke jinhein Taurat ka hamil banaya gaya unhon ne use kama-haqqahu qabool na kiya, un ki misaal us gadhe ki si hai jo bojh lade huye ho aur yeh bhi tum jante ho ke main bhi un logon mein se hoon jo Taurat uthwaye gaye, is par Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne use chhod diya. Yeh yahan se chal kar Homs pahunche, wahan suna ke ek shakhs jo un ke gharane mein se tha is ayat ki tilawat kar raha hai, jab us ne ayat khatam ki unhein darr lagne laga ke kahin sach-much is ayat ki wa'eed mujh par sadiq na aa jaye aur mera munh maskh kar palat na jaye, yeh jhat se kehne lage "Ya Rabb Aslamtu" mere Allah main iman laya. Phir Homs se hi wapas apne watan Yaman mein aaye aur yahan se apne tamam ghar walon ko le kar sare kunbe samet musalman ho gaye. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Ka'ab (R.A) ke Islam ka waqea is tarah marvi hai ke un ke ustad Abu Muslim Jalili un ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein hazir hone mein der lagane ki wajah se har waqt unhein malamat karte rehte thay, phir unhein bheja ke dekhein ke aap wahi paighambar hain jin ki khushkhabri aur ausaf Taurat mein hain?

Yeh aaye toh farmate hain jab main Madina Sharif pahuncha toh ek shakhs Quran-e-Karim ki is aayat ki tilawat kar raha tha ke "Aye Ahl-e-Kitab! Hamari nazil karda kitab tumhare paas maujood kitab ki tasdeeq karti hai, behtar hai ke is par is se pehle imaan lao ke hum tumhare munh bigad dein aur unhein ulta kar dein." Main chaunk utha aur jaldi jaldi ghusl karne baith gaya aur apne chehre par haath pherta jata tha ke kahin mujhe imaan lane mein der na lag jaye aur mera chehra ulta na ho jaye. Phir main bahut jald aa kar musalman ho gaya. Is ke baad Allah Ta'ala farmate hain ya hum un par la'nat karein jaise ke hafta walon par hum ne la'nat nazil ki, yani jin logon ne hafta wale din heele ke liye shikar khela halanke unhein is kaam se mana kiya gaya tha, jis ka natija yeh hua ke woh bandar aur suar bana diye gaye, un ka mufassal waqia Surah Al-A'raf mein aayega Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Irshad hota hai Ilahi kaam poore ho kar hi rehte hain, woh jab koi hukum kar de toh koi nahin jo us ki mukhalifat ya mumanat kar sake. Phir khabar deta hai ke Allah Ta'ala apne sath shirk kiye jane ke gunah ko nahin bakhshta, yani jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala se is haal mein mulaqat kare ke woh mushrik ho, us par bakhshish. Bahut si ahadees hain hum yahan ba-qadr-e-aasani zikr karte hain. Gunahon ke teen diwan: Pehli hadith ba-hawala Musnad-e-Ahmad: Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek gunahon ke teen diwan hain, ek toh woh jis ki Allah Ta'ala kuch parwah nahin karta, dusra woh jis mein Allah Ta'ala kuch nahin chhodta, teesra woh jise Allah Ta'ala hargiz nahin bakhshta. Pas jise woh bakhshta nahin woh shirk hai, Allah Azza-wa-Jal khud farmata hai ke Allah Ta'ala apne sath shareek kiye jane ko maaf nahin farmata aur jagah irshad hai jo shakhs Allah ke sath shareek kar le, Allah us par jannat ko haram kar deta hai. Aur jis diwan mein Allah ke han koi waqat nahin woh bande ka apni jaan par zulm karna hai aur jis ka talluq is se aur Allah ki zaat se hai maslan kisi din ka roza jise us ne chhod diya ya namaz chhod di toh Allah Ta'ala use bakhsh de ga aur jis diwan (aamal-nama) mein se maujood kisi fard ko Allah nahin chhodta woh bandon ke aapas mein mazalim hain jin ka badla aur qisas zaroori hai. Dusri hadith ba-hawala Musnad-e-Bazzar: Alfaaz ke her-pher ke sath matlab wahi hai. Teesri hadith ba-hawala Musnad-e-Ahmad: Mumkin hai Allah Ta'ala har gunah ko bakhsh de magar woh shakhs jo kufr ki halat mein mara, dusra woh jis ne imandar ko jaan boojh kar qatl kiya. Chauthi hadith ba-hawala Musnad-e-Ahmad: Allah Ta'ala farmata hai aye mere bande! Tu jab tak meri ibadat karta rahega aur mujh se nek umeed rakhega main bhi teri jitni khatayen hain unhein maaf farmata rahunga, mere bande agar tu sari zameen bhar ki khatayen bhi le kar mere paas aayega toh main bhi zameen ki wus'aton jitni maghfirat ke sath tujh se milunga basharte ke tu ne mere sath kisi ko shareek na kiya ho. Panchwin hadith ba-hawala Musnad-e-Ahmad.

Jo banda La ilaha illallah kahe phir isi par us ka inteqal ho woh zaroor jannat mein jayega, yeh sun kar Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) ne daryaft kiya ke agar us ne zina aur chori bhi kiya ho? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya go us ne zinakari aur chori bhi ki ho, teen martaba yahi sawal jawab hua. Chauthe sawal par Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya chahe Abu Zar ki naak khaak-aalood ho. Pas Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) wahan se apni chadar ghaseet-te hue yeh farmate hue nikle ke chahe Abu Zar ki naak khaak-aalood ho aur is ke baad jab kabhi aap yeh hadith bayan farmate yeh jumla zaroori kehte. Yeh hadith dusri sanad se qadre ziyadati ke sath bhi marwi hai, is mein hai Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) farmate hain main Nabi (ﷺ) ke sath Madina ke maidan mein chala ja raha tha, Uhad ki taraf hamari nigahain thin ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya ae Abu Zar! Main ne kaha Labbaik Ya Rasool Allah! Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya suno mere paas Uhad pahar ke barabar sona ho to main na chahunga ke teesri sham ko is mein se kuch bhi baqi reh jaye bajuz us dinar ke jise main qarza chukane ke liye rakh loon, baqi tamam maal main is tarah rah-e-Lillah is ke bandon ko de daloon aur Aap (ﷺ) ne dayen bayen aur samne lapain phenkin.

Phir kuch der hum chalte rahe phir Huzoor ﷺ ne mujhe pukara aur farmaya jin ke paas yahan ziyadati hai wohi wahan kami wale honge magar jo is tarah aur is tarah kare yani aap ne apne daen samne aur baen lapain (hatheliyan) bhar kar dete hue is amal ki wazahat ki, phir kuch der chalne ke baad farmaya Abu Zar main abhi aata hoon tum yahin thehro aap tashreef le gaye aur meri nigahon se ojhal ho gaye aur mujhe aawazein sunai dene lagin dil bechain ho gaya ke kahin tanhai mein koi dushman aa gaya ho main ne qasd kiya ke wahan pahunchun lekin sath hi Huzoor ﷺ ka yeh farman yaad aa gaya ke main jab tak na aaun tum yahin thehre rehna chunancha main thehra raha yahan tak ke aap tashreef le aaye to main ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ yeh aawazein kaisi aa rahi thin aap ne farmaya mere paas Hazrat Jibraeel A.S aaye the aur farma rahe the ke aap ki ummat mein se wafat paane wala Allah Ta'ala ke sath kisi ko shareek na kare to woh jannat mein jayega main ne kaha go zina aur chori bhi us se sarzad hui ho to farmaya haan go zina aur chori bhi hui ho, yeh hadith Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai ke Hazrat Abu Zar R.A farmate hain raat ke waqt nikla dekha ke Rasool Allah ﷺ tanha tashreef le ja rahe hain to mujhe khayal hua ke shayad is waqt aap kisi ko sath le jana nahin chahte to main chand ki chandni mein Huzoor ﷺ ke peeche ho liya aap ne jab mud kar mujhe dekha to poocha kaun hai main ne kaha Abu Zar Allah mujhe aap par se qurban kar de to aap ne farmaya aao mere sath chalo thodi der hum chalte rahe phir aap ne farmaya ziyadati wale hi Qayamat ke din kami wale honge magar woh jinhein Allah Ta'ala ne maal diya phir woh daen baen aage peeche nek kamon mein kharch karte rahe phir kuch der chalne ke baad aap ne mujhe ek jagah bitha kar jis ke gird-o-pesh patthar the farmaya meri wapsi tak yahin baithe raho phir aap aage nikal gaye yahan tak ke meri nazar se posheeda ho gaye aap ko zyada der lag gayi phir main ne dekha ke aap tashreef la rahe hain aur zaban-e-mubarak se farmate aa rahe hain go zina kiya ho ya chori ki ho jab mere paas pahunche to main ruk na saka poocha ke ae Nabi-e-Allah ﷺ Allah mujhe aap par qurban kare is maidan ke kinare aap kis se baatein kar rahe the main ne suna koi aap ko jawab bhi de raha tha aap ne farmaya woh Jibraeel A.S the yahan mere paas aaye aur farmaya apni ummat ko khushkhabri suna do ke jo mere aur Allah ke sath us ne kisi ko shareek na kiya woh jannati hoga main ne kaha ae Jibraeel A.S go us ne chori ki ho aur zina kiya ho farmaya haan main ne phir yahi sawal kiya jawab diya haan main ne phir yahi farmaya haan aur agarche us ne sharab pi ho. Chathi hadith bahawala Musnad Abd bin Humaid ek shakhs Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaya, aur kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ jannat wajib kar dene wali cheezein kya hain?

Aap ne farmaya jo shakhs baghair shirk kiye mara us ke liye jannat wajib hai aur jo shirk karte hue mara us ke liye jahannam wajib hai, yahi hadith aur tariq se marvi hai jis mein hai ke jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala ke sath shirk na karta hua mara us ke liye bakhshish halal hai agar Allah chahe use azab kare agar chahe bakhsh de, Allah ke sath kisi ko sharik karne wale ko nahin bakhshta us ke siwa jise chahe bakhsh de (Ibn Abi Hatim). Aur sanad se marvi hai ke Aap ne farmaya bande par maghfirat hamesha rehti hai jab tak ke parde na pad jayen, daryaft kiya gaya ke Huzoor (ﷺ) parde pad jana kya hai? Farmaya shirk, jo shakhs shirk na karta ho aur Allah Ta'ala se mulaqat kare us ke liye bakhshish-e-Ilahi halal ho gayi agar chahiye azab kare agar chahe bakhsh de, phir Aap ne (Aayat: Inna Allaha la yaghfiru an yushraka bihi wa yaghfiru ma duna dhalika liman yasha'u) tilawat farmayi (Musnad Abu Ya'la). Satvin hadith ba-hawala Musnad Ahmad, jo shakhs mare Allah ke sath sharik na karta ho woh jannat mein dakhil hoga. Athvin hadith ba-hawala Musnad Ahmad, Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ek martaba Sahaba (R.A) ke paas aaye aur farmaya tumhare Rabb-e-Azz-o-Jal ne mujhe ikhtiyar diya ke meri ummat mein se sattar hazar ka be-hisab jannat mein jana pasand karun ya Allah Ta'ala ke paas jo cheez mere liye meri ummat ki babat poshida mehfooz hai use qabool kar lun, toh ba'az Sahaba ne kaha kya Allah Ta'ala Aap ke liye yeh mehfooz cheez bacha kar bhi rakhega? Aap yeh sun kar andar tashreef le gaye phir takbeer padhte hue bahar aaye aur farmane lage mere Rabb ne mujhe har hazar ke sath sattar hazar ko jannat ata karna mazeed ata farmaya aur woh poshida hissa bhi. Hazrat Abu Ayyub Ansari (R.A) jab yeh hadith bayan farma chuke toh Hazrat Abu Rahm ne sawal kiya ke woh poshida mehfooz kya hai? Is par logon ne unhein kuch kuch kehna shuru kar diya ke kahan tum aur kahan Huzoor (ﷺ) ke liye ikhtiyar karda cheez? Hazrat Ayyub (R.A) ne farmaya suno jahan tak hamara guman hai jo guman yaqeen ke qareeb hai yeh hai ke woh cheez jannat mein jana hai har us shakhs ka jo sache dil se gawahi de ke Allah ek hai us ke siwa koi mabood nahin aur Muhammad (ﷺ) us ke bande aur Rasool hain. Navin hadith ba-hawala Ibn Abi Hatim, ek shakhs Huzoor (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein hazir hua aur kaha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) mera bhatija haram se baaz nahin aata, Aap ne farmaya us ki deendari kaisi hai, kaha namazi hai aur tauheed wala hai, Aap ne farmaya jao aur us se us ka deen bator-e-subah ke talab karo agar inkar kare toh us se khareed lo, us ne ja kar us se talab kiya toh us ne inkar kar diya, us ne aa kar Huzoor (ﷺ) ko khabar di toh Aap ne farmaya main ne use apne deen par chimta hua paya, is par (Aayat: Inna Allaha la yaghfiru an yushraka bihi...) nazil hui. Dasvin hadith ba-hawala Hafiz Ya'la, ek shakhs Rasool (ﷺ) ke paas aaya aur kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) main ne koi hajat ya hajat wala nahin choda yani zindagi mein sab kuch kar chuka, Aap ne farmaya kya tu yeh gawahi nahin deta ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahin aur Muhammad (ﷺ) Allah ke Rasool hain, teen martaba us ne kaha han, Aap ne farmaya yeh in sab par ghalib aa jayega.

Gyarahvin hadith bahawala Musnad-e-Ahmad. Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ne Zakhm bin Josh Yamami (R.H) se kaha ke ae Yamami! Kisi shakhs se hargiz yeh na kehna ke Allah Ta'ala tujhe nahin bakhshe ga ya tujhe jannat mein dakhil na kare ga. Yamami (R.H) ne kaha, Hazrat! Yeh baat toh hum log apne bhaiyon aur doston se bhi gusse gusse mein keh jate hain. Aap (R.A) ne farmaya, khabardar! Hargiz na kehna. Suno, main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai, aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Bani Israel mein do shakhs thay, ek toh ibadat mein bahut chust chalak aur dusra apni jaan par ziyadati karne wala, aur dono mein dostana aur bhai chara tha. Aabid basa auqat is dusre ko kisi na kisi gunah mein dekhta rehta tha, (aur kehta) ae shakhs! Baaz reh. Jawab deta, tu mujhe mere Rab par chhor de, kya tu mujh par nigahban bana kar bheja gaya hai? Ek martaba aabid ne dekha ke woh phir kisi gunah ke kaam ko kar raha hai jo gunah use bahut bada maloom hua, toh kaha, afsos tujh par! Baaz aa. Us ne wahi jawab diya, toh aabid ne kaha, Allah ki qasam! Allah tujhe hargiz na bakhshe ga ya jannat na de ga. Allah Ta'ala ne un ke paas farishta bheja jis ne un ki roohein qabz kar lin. Jab dono Allah Ta'ala ke haan jama hue toh Allah Ta'ala ne is gunehgar se farmaya, ja aur meri rahmat ki bina par jannat mein dakhil ho ja. Aur is aabid se farmaya, kya tujhe haqiqi ilm tha? Kya tu meri cheez par qadir tha? Ise jahannam ki taraf le jao. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne yeh bayan farmaya, us ki qasam jis ke haath mein Abu Al-Qasim ki jaan hai, us ne ek kalma zaban se aisa nikal diya jis ne us ki duniya aur aakhirat barbad kar di.

Barahvin hadith bahawala Tabrani: Jis ne is baat ka yaqeen kar liya ke main gunahon ki bakhshish par qadir hoon toh main use bakhsh hi deta hoon aur koi parwah nahin karta jab tak ke woh mere saath kisi ko shareek na thehraye.

Terahvin hadith bahawala Bazzar, Abu Ya'la: Jis amal par Allah Ta'ala ne sawab ka wada kiya hai use toh Malik zaroor pura farmaye ga aur jis par saza ka farmaya hai woh us ke ikhtiyar mein hai, chahe bakhsh de ya saza de. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) farmate hain, hum Sahaba (R.A) qatil ke bare mein aur yateem ka maal kha jane wale ke bare mein aur pak daman aurton par tohmat lagane wale ke bare mein aur jhooti gawahi dene wale ke bare mein koi shak-o-shuba hi nahin karte thay, yahan tak ke (Aayat: Inna Allaha Yaghfiru... Al-Ayah) utri aur Ashab-e-Rasool gumrahi se ruk gaye (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Ibn-e-Jareer ki yeh riwayat is tarah par hai ke jin gunahon par jahannam ka zikr Kitabullah mein hai use karne wale ke jahannami hone mein hamein koi shak hi nahin tha, yahan tak ke hum par yeh aayat utri, jab hum ne ise suna toh hum shahadat ke liye ruk gaye aur tamam umoor Allah Ta'ala ki taraf sonp diye.

Bazzar mein aap hi ki ek riwayat hai ke kabira gunah karne walon ke liye istighfar karne se hum ruke hue thay yahan tak ke hum ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yeh aayat suni aur aap ne yeh bhi farmaya ke main ne apni shafa'at ko apni ummat mein se kabira gunah karne walon ke liye mu'akhar kar rakha hai. Abu Ja'far Razi ki riwayat mein aap ka yeh farman hai ke jab (يٰعِبَادِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اَسْرَفُوْا عَلٰٓي اَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوْا مِنْ رَّحْمَةِ اللّٰهِ) (Surah Az-Zumar: 53) nazil hui yani ae mere woh bando jinhon ne apni janon par zulm kiya hai tum meri rahmat se mayus na ho jao, to ek shakhs ne khade ho kar pucha Huzoor shirk karne wala bhi? Aap ko is ka yeh sawal na-pasand aaya phir aap ne unhein (Aayat-e-Allah la yaghfiru al-shirka...) padh kar sunayi. Surah Tanzeel ki yeh aayat mashroot hai tauba ke sath, pas jo shakhs jis gunah se tauba kare Allah us ki taraf ruju' karta hai go baar baar kare, pas mayus na hone ki aayat mein tauba ki shart zaroor hai. Warna is mein shirk bhi aa jayega aur phir matlab sahih na hoga kyunke is aayat mein wazahat ke sath yahan maujood hai ke Allah ke sath shirk karne wale ki bakhshish nahin hai, haan is ke siwa jise chahe yani agar us ne tauba bhi na ki ho, is matlab ke sath is aayat mein jo umeed dilane wali hai aur zyada umeed ki aas paida ho jati hai, Wallahu A'lam. Phir farmata hai Allah ke sath jo shirk kare us ne bade gunah ka iftira bandha, jaise aur aayat mein hai shirk bahut bada zulm hai. Bukhari Muslim mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se riwayat hai ke sab se bada gunah kya hai? Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain tumhein sab se bada kabira gunah batata hoon woh Allah Ta'ala ke sath shareek karna hai, phir aap ne isi aayat ka yeh aakhri hissa tilawat farmaya, phir maa baap ki nafarmani karna, phir aap ne yeh aayat tilawat farmayi ke (اَنِ اشْكُرْ لِيْ وَلِوَالِدَيْكَ ۭ اِلَيَّ الْمَصِيْرُ) (Surah Luqman: 14) mera shukr kar aur apne maa baap ka shukriya kar, meri taraf lautna hai.

Qur'an-e-Hakim ka Aijaz-e-Taseer. Allah Azzawajal Yahood-o-Nasara ko hukum deta hai ke main ne apni zabardast kitab apne behtareen Nabi (ﷺ) ke sath nazil farmayi hai jis mein khud tumhari apni kitab ki tasdeeq bhi hai, is par iman lao is se pehle ke hum tumhari suratein maskh kar dein yani munh bigad kar dein, aankhein bajaye idhar ke udhar ho jayen, ya yeh matlab ke tumhare chehre mita dein, aankhein, kaan, naak sab mit jayen phir yeh maskh chehra bhi ulta ho jaye. Yeh azab un ke bad-a'maal ka badla hai, yahi wajah hai ke yeh haq se hat kar batil ki taraf, hidayat se phir kar zalalat ki janib badhe chale ja rahe hain. Ba-in-hama Allah Ta'ala unhein ehsas dila rahe hain ke ab bhi baaz aa jao aur apne se pehle aisi harkat karne walon ki suraton ke maskh hone ko yaad karo, kahin aisa na ho ke un ki tarah tumhara munh ulat doon ga taake tumhein pichle pairon chalna pade, tumhari aankhein gaddi ki taraf kar doon aur isi jaisi tafsir baaz ne (Inna ja'alna fi a'naqihim aghlalan fahiya ilal-azqani fahum muqmahoon) (Surah Ya-Sin: 8) ki ayat mein bhi ki hai. Garz yeh un ki gumrahi aur hidayat se door pad jane ki buri misaal bayan hui hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) se marvi hai ke matlab yeh hai ke hum tumhein sach-much haq ke raste se hata dein aur gumrahi ki taraf mutawajja kar dein, hum tumhein kafir bana dein aur tumhare chehre bandaron jaise kar dein. Abu Zaid (R.H) farmate hain ke lota dena yeh tha ke arz-e-Hijaz se bilad-e-Sham mein pahuncha diya. Yeh bhi mazkoor hai ke isi ayat ko sun kar Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar (R.A) musharraf ba-Islam huye thay. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim (R.H) ke samne Hazrat Ka'ab (R.A) ke Islam ka tazkira hua to aap ne farmaya Hazrat Ka'ab (R.A) Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke zamane mein musalman huye, yeh Bait-ul-Muqaddas jate huye Madina mein aaye, Hazrat Umar (R.A) un ke paas gaye aur farmaya ae Ka'ab (R.A) musalman ho jao, unhon ne jawab diya tum to Qur'an mein padh chuke ho ke jinhein Taurat ka hamil banaya gaya unhon ne use kama-haqqahu qabool na kiya, un ki misaal us gadhe ki si hai jo bojh lade huye ho aur yeh bhi tum jante ho ke main bhi un logon mein se hoon jo Taurat uthwaye gaye, is par Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne use chhod diya. Yeh yahan se chal kar Homs pahunche, wahan suna ke ek shakhs jo un ke gharane mein se tha is ayat ki tilawat kar raha hai, jab us ne ayat khatam ki unhein darr lagne laga ke kahin sach-much is ayat ki wa'eed mujh par sadiq na aa jaye aur mera munh maskh kar palat na jaye, yeh jhat se kehne lage "Ya Rabb Aslamtu" mere Allah main iman laya. Phir Homs se hi wapas apne watan Yaman mein aaye aur yahan se apne tamam ghar walon ko le kar sare kunbe samet musalman ho gaye. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Ka'ab (R.A) ke Islam ka waqea is tarah marvi hai ke un ke ustad Abu Muslim Jalili un ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein hazir hone mein der lagane ki wajah se har waqt unhein malamat karte rehte thay, phir unhein bheja ke dekhein ke aap wahi paighambar hain jin ki khushkhabri aur ausaf Taurat mein hain?

Yeh aaye toh farmate hain jab main Madina Sharif pahuncha toh ek shakhs Quran-e-Karim ki is aayat ki tilawat kar raha tha ke "Aye Ahl-e-Kitab! Hamari nazil karda kitab tumhare paas maujood kitab ki tasdeeq karti hai, behtar hai ke is par is se pehle imaan lao ke hum tumhare munh bigad dein aur unhein ulta kar dein." Main chaunk utha aur jaldi jaldi ghusl karne baith gaya aur apne chehre par haath pherta jata tha ke kahin mujhe imaan lane mein der na lag jaye aur mera chehra ulta na ho jaye. Phir main bahut jald aa kar musalman ho gaya. Is ke baad Allah Ta'ala farmate hain ya hum un par la'nat karein jaise ke hafta walon par hum ne la'nat nazil ki, yani jin logon ne hafta wale din heele ke liye shikar khela halanke unhein is kaam se mana kiya gaya tha, jis ka natija yeh hua ke woh bandar aur suar bana diye gaye, un ka mufassal waqia Surah Al-A'raf mein aayega Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Irshad hota hai Ilahi kaam poore ho kar hi rehte hain, woh jab koi hukum kar de toh koi nahin jo us ki mukhalifat ya mumanat kar sake. Phir khabar deta hai ke Allah Ta'ala apne sath shirk kiye jane ke gunah ko nahin bakhshta, yani jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala se is haal mein mulaqat kare ke woh mushrik ho, us par bakhshish. Bahut si ahadees hain hum yahan ba-qadr-e-aasani zikr karte hain. Gunahon ke teen diwan: Pehli hadith ba-hawala Musnad-e-Ahmad: Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek gunahon ke teen diwan hain, ek toh woh jis ki Allah Ta'ala kuch parwah nahin karta, dusra woh jis mein Allah Ta'ala kuch nahin chhodta, teesra woh jise Allah Ta'ala hargiz nahin bakhshta. Pas jise woh bakhshta nahin woh shirk hai, Allah Azza-wa-Jal khud farmata hai ke Allah Ta'ala apne sath shareek kiye jane ko maaf nahin farmata aur jagah irshad hai jo shakhs Allah ke sath shareek kar le, Allah us par jannat ko haram kar deta hai. Aur jis diwan mein Allah ke han koi waqat nahin woh bande ka apni jaan par zulm karna hai aur jis ka talluq is se aur Allah ki zaat se hai maslan kisi din ka roza jise us ne chhod diya ya namaz chhod di toh Allah Ta'ala use bakhsh de ga aur jis diwan (aamal-nama) mein se maujood kisi fard ko Allah nahin chhodta woh bandon ke aapas mein mazalim hain jin ka badla aur qisas zaroori hai. Dusri hadith ba-hawala Musnad-e-Bazzar: Alfaaz ke her-pher ke sath matlab wahi hai. Teesri hadith ba-hawala Musnad-e-Ahmad: Mumkin hai Allah Ta'ala har gunah ko bakhsh de magar woh shakhs jo kufr ki halat mein mara, dusra woh jis ne imandar ko jaan boojh kar qatl kiya. Chauthi hadith ba-hawala Musnad-e-Ahmad: Allah Ta'ala farmata hai aye mere bande! Tu jab tak meri ibadat karta rahega aur mujh se nek umeed rakhega main bhi teri jitni khatayen hain unhein maaf farmata rahunga, mere bande agar tu sari zameen bhar ki khatayen bhi le kar mere paas aayega toh main bhi zameen ki wus'aton jitni maghfirat ke sath tujh se milunga basharte ke tu ne mere sath kisi ko shareek na kiya ho. Panchwin hadith ba-hawala Musnad-e-Ahmad.

Jo banda La ilaha illallah kahe phir isi par us ka inteqal ho woh zaroor jannat mein jayega, yeh sun kar Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) ne daryaft kiya ke agar us ne zina aur chori bhi kiya ho? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya go us ne zinakari aur chori bhi ki ho, teen martaba yahi sawal jawab hua. Chauthe sawal par Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya chahe Abu Zar ki naak khaak-aalood ho. Pas Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) wahan se apni chadar ghaseet-te hue yeh farmate hue nikle ke chahe Abu Zar ki naak khaak-aalood ho aur is ke baad jab kabhi aap yeh hadith bayan farmate yeh jumla zaroori kehte. Yeh hadith dusri sanad se qadre ziyadati ke sath bhi marwi hai, is mein hai Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) farmate hain main Nabi (ﷺ) ke sath Madina ke maidan mein chala ja raha tha, Uhad ki taraf hamari nigahain thin ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya ae Abu Zar! Main ne kaha Labbaik Ya Rasool Allah! Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya suno mere paas Uhad pahar ke barabar sona ho to main na chahunga ke teesri sham ko is mein se kuch bhi baqi reh jaye bajuz us dinar ke jise main qarza chukane ke liye rakh loon, baqi tamam maal main is tarah rah-e-Lillah is ke bandon ko de daloon aur Aap (ﷺ) ne dayen bayen aur samne lapain phenkin.

Phir kuch der hum chalte rahe phir Huzoor ﷺ ne mujhe pukara aur farmaya jin ke paas yahan ziyadati hai wohi wahan kami wale honge magar jo is tarah aur is tarah kare yani aap ne apne daen samne aur baen lapain (hatheliyan) bhar kar dete hue is amal ki wazahat ki, phir kuch der chalne ke baad farmaya Abu Zar main abhi aata hoon tum yahin thehro aap tashreef le gaye aur meri nigahon se ojhal ho gaye aur mujhe aawazein sunai dene lagin dil bechain ho gaya ke kahin tanhai mein koi dushman aa gaya ho main ne qasd kiya ke wahan pahunchun lekin sath hi Huzoor ﷺ ka yeh farman yaad aa gaya ke main jab tak na aaun tum yahin thehre rehna chunancha main thehra raha yahan tak ke aap tashreef le aaye to main ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ yeh aawazein kaisi aa rahi thin aap ne farmaya mere paas Hazrat Jibraeel A.S aaye the aur farma rahe the ke aap ki ummat mein se wafat paane wala Allah Ta'ala ke sath kisi ko shareek na kare to woh jannat mein jayega main ne kaha go zina aur chori bhi us se sarzad hui ho to farmaya haan go zina aur chori bhi hui ho, yeh hadith Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai ke Hazrat Abu Zar R.A farmate hain raat ke waqt nikla dekha ke Rasool Allah ﷺ tanha tashreef le ja rahe hain to mujhe khayal hua ke shayad is waqt aap kisi ko sath le jana nahin chahte to main chand ki chandni mein Huzoor ﷺ ke peeche ho liya aap ne jab mud kar mujhe dekha to poocha kaun hai main ne kaha Abu Zar Allah mujhe aap par se qurban kar de to aap ne farmaya aao mere sath chalo thodi der hum chalte rahe phir aap ne farmaya ziyadati wale hi Qayamat ke din kami wale honge magar woh jinhein Allah Ta'ala ne maal diya phir woh daen baen aage peeche nek kamon mein kharch karte rahe phir kuch der chalne ke baad aap ne mujhe ek jagah bitha kar jis ke gird-o-pesh patthar the farmaya meri wapsi tak yahin baithe raho phir aap aage nikal gaye yahan tak ke meri nazar se posheeda ho gaye aap ko zyada der lag gayi phir main ne dekha ke aap tashreef la rahe hain aur zaban-e-mubarak se farmate aa rahe hain go zina kiya ho ya chori ki ho jab mere paas pahunche to main ruk na saka poocha ke ae Nabi-e-Allah ﷺ Allah mujhe aap par qurban kare is maidan ke kinare aap kis se baatein kar rahe the main ne suna koi aap ko jawab bhi de raha tha aap ne farmaya woh Jibraeel A.S the yahan mere paas aaye aur farmaya apni ummat ko khushkhabri suna do ke jo mere aur Allah ke sath us ne kisi ko shareek na kiya woh jannati hoga main ne kaha ae Jibraeel A.S go us ne chori ki ho aur zina kiya ho farmaya haan main ne phir yahi sawal kiya jawab diya haan main ne phir yahi farmaya haan aur agarche us ne sharab pi ho. Chathi hadith bahawala Musnad Abd bin Humaid ek shakhs Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaya, aur kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ jannat wajib kar dene wali cheezein kya hain?

Aap ne farmaya jo shakhs baghair shirk kiye mara us ke liye jannat wajib hai aur jo shirk karte hue mara us ke liye jahannam wajib hai, yahi hadith aur tariq se marvi hai jis mein hai ke jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala ke sath shirk na karta hua mara us ke liye bakhshish halal hai agar Allah chahe use azab kare agar chahe bakhsh de, Allah ke sath kisi ko sharik karne wale ko nahin bakhshta us ke siwa jise chahe bakhsh de (Ibn Abi Hatim). Aur sanad se marvi hai ke Aap ne farmaya bande par maghfirat hamesha rehti hai jab tak ke parde na pad jayen, daryaft kiya gaya ke Huzoor (ﷺ) parde pad jana kya hai? Farmaya shirk, jo shakhs shirk na karta ho aur Allah Ta'ala se mulaqat kare us ke liye bakhshish-e-Ilahi halal ho gayi agar chahiye azab kare agar chahe bakhsh de, phir Aap ne (Aayat: Inna Allaha la yaghfiru an yushraka bihi wa yaghfiru ma duna dhalika liman yasha'u) tilawat farmayi (Musnad Abu Ya'la). Satvin hadith ba-hawala Musnad Ahmad, jo shakhs mare Allah ke sath sharik na karta ho woh jannat mein dakhil hoga. Athvin hadith ba-hawala Musnad Ahmad, Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ek martaba Sahaba (R.A) ke paas aaye aur farmaya tumhare Rabb-e-Azz-o-Jal ne mujhe ikhtiyar diya ke meri ummat mein se sattar hazar ka be-hisab jannat mein jana pasand karun ya Allah Ta'ala ke paas jo cheez mere liye meri ummat ki babat poshida mehfooz hai use qabool kar lun, toh ba'az Sahaba ne kaha kya Allah Ta'ala Aap ke liye yeh mehfooz cheez bacha kar bhi rakhega? Aap yeh sun kar andar tashreef le gaye phir takbeer padhte hue bahar aaye aur farmane lage mere Rabb ne mujhe har hazar ke sath sattar hazar ko jannat ata karna mazeed ata farmaya aur woh poshida hissa bhi. Hazrat Abu Ayyub Ansari (R.A) jab yeh hadith bayan farma chuke toh Hazrat Abu Rahm ne sawal kiya ke woh poshida mehfooz kya hai? Is par logon ne unhein kuch kuch kehna shuru kar diya ke kahan tum aur kahan Huzoor (ﷺ) ke liye ikhtiyar karda cheez? Hazrat Ayyub (R.A) ne farmaya suno jahan tak hamara guman hai jo guman yaqeen ke qareeb hai yeh hai ke woh cheez jannat mein jana hai har us shakhs ka jo sache dil se gawahi de ke Allah ek hai us ke siwa koi mabood nahin aur Muhammad (ﷺ) us ke bande aur Rasool hain. Navin hadith ba-hawala Ibn Abi Hatim, ek shakhs Huzoor (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein hazir hua aur kaha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) mera bhatija haram se baaz nahin aata, Aap ne farmaya us ki deendari kaisi hai, kaha namazi hai aur tauheed wala hai, Aap ne farmaya jao aur us se us ka deen bator-e-subah ke talab karo agar inkar kare toh us se khareed lo, us ne ja kar us se talab kiya toh us ne inkar kar diya, us ne aa kar Huzoor (ﷺ) ko khabar di toh Aap ne farmaya main ne use apne deen par chimta hua paya, is par (Aayat: Inna Allaha la yaghfiru an yushraka bihi...) nazil hui. Dasvin hadith ba-hawala Hafiz Ya'la, ek shakhs Rasool (ﷺ) ke paas aaya aur kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) main ne koi hajat ya hajat wala nahin choda yani zindagi mein sab kuch kar chuka, Aap ne farmaya kya tu yeh gawahi nahin deta ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahin aur Muhammad (ﷺ) Allah ke Rasool hain, teen martaba us ne kaha han, Aap ne farmaya yeh in sab par ghalib aa jayega.

Gyarahvin hadith bahawala Musnad-e-Ahmad. Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ne Zakhm bin Josh Yamami (R.H) se kaha ke ae Yamami! Kisi shakhs se hargiz yeh na kehna ke Allah Ta'ala tujhe nahin bakhshe ga ya tujhe jannat mein dakhil na kare ga. Yamami (R.H) ne kaha, Hazrat! Yeh baat toh hum log apne bhaiyon aur doston se bhi gusse gusse mein keh jate hain. Aap (R.A) ne farmaya, khabardar! Hargiz na kehna. Suno, main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai, aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Bani Israel mein do shakhs thay, ek toh ibadat mein bahut chust chalak aur dusra apni jaan par ziyadati karne wala, aur dono mein dostana aur bhai chara tha. Aabid basa auqat is dusre ko kisi na kisi gunah mein dekhta rehta tha, (aur kehta) ae shakhs! Baaz reh. Jawab deta, tu mujhe mere Rab par chhor de, kya tu mujh par nigahban bana kar bheja gaya hai? Ek martaba aabid ne dekha ke woh phir kisi gunah ke kaam ko kar raha hai jo gunah use bahut bada maloom hua, toh kaha, afsos tujh par! Baaz aa. Us ne wahi jawab diya, toh aabid ne kaha, Allah ki qasam! Allah tujhe hargiz na bakhshe ga ya jannat na de ga. Allah Ta'ala ne un ke paas farishta bheja jis ne un ki roohein qabz kar lin. Jab dono Allah Ta'ala ke haan jama hue toh Allah Ta'ala ne is gunehgar se farmaya, ja aur meri rahmat ki bina par jannat mein dakhil ho ja. Aur is aabid se farmaya, kya tujhe haqiqi ilm tha? Kya tu meri cheez par qadir tha? Ise jahannam ki taraf le jao. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne yeh bayan farmaya, us ki qasam jis ke haath mein Abu Al-Qasim ki jaan hai, us ne ek kalma zaban se aisa nikal diya jis ne us ki duniya aur aakhirat barbad kar di.

Barahvin hadith bahawala Tabrani: Jis ne is baat ka yaqeen kar liya ke main gunahon ki bakhshish par qadir hoon toh main use bakhsh hi deta hoon aur koi parwah nahin karta jab tak ke woh mere saath kisi ko shareek na thehraye.

Terahvin hadith bahawala Bazzar, Abu Ya'la: Jis amal par Allah Ta'ala ne sawab ka wada kiya hai use toh Malik zaroor pura farmaye ga aur jis par saza ka farmaya hai woh us ke ikhtiyar mein hai, chahe bakhsh de ya saza de. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) farmate hain, hum Sahaba (R.A) qatil ke bare mein aur yateem ka maal kha jane wale ke bare mein aur pak daman aurton par tohmat lagane wale ke bare mein aur jhooti gawahi dene wale ke bare mein koi shak-o-shuba hi nahin karte thay, yahan tak ke (Aayat: Inna Allaha Yaghfiru... Al-Ayah) utri aur Ashab-e-Rasool gumrahi se ruk gaye (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Ibn-e-Jareer ki yeh riwayat is tarah par hai ke jin gunahon par jahannam ka zikr Kitabullah mein hai use karne wale ke jahannami hone mein hamein koi shak hi nahin tha, yahan tak ke hum par yeh aayat utri, jab hum ne ise suna toh hum shahadat ke liye ruk gaye aur tamam umoor Allah Ta'ala ki taraf sonp diye.

Bazzar mein aap hi ki ek riwayat hai ke kabira gunah karne walon ke liye istighfar karne se hum ruke hue thay yahan tak ke hum ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yeh aayat suni aur aap ne yeh bhi farmaya ke main ne apni shafa'at ko apni ummat mein se kabira gunah karne walon ke liye mu'akhar kar rakha hai. Abu Ja'far Razi ki riwayat mein aap ka yeh farman hai ke jab (يٰعِبَادِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اَسْرَفُوْا عَلٰٓي اَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوْا مِنْ رَّحْمَةِ اللّٰهِ) (Surah Az-Zumar: 53) nazil hui yani ae mere woh bando jinhon ne apni janon par zulm kiya hai tum meri rahmat se mayus na ho jao, to ek shakhs ne khade ho kar pucha Huzoor shirk karne wala bhi? Aap ko is ka yeh sawal na-pasand aaya phir aap ne unhein (Aayat-e-Allah la yaghfiru al-shirka...) padh kar sunayi. Surah Tanzeel ki yeh aayat mashroot hai tauba ke sath, pas jo shakhs jis gunah se tauba kare Allah us ki taraf ruju' karta hai go baar baar kare, pas mayus na hone ki aayat mein tauba ki shart zaroor hai. Warna is mein shirk bhi aa jayega aur phir matlab sahih na hoga kyunke is aayat mein wazahat ke sath yahan maujood hai ke Allah ke sath shirk karne wale ki bakhshish nahin hai, haan is ke siwa jise chahe yani agar us ne tauba bhi na ki ho, is matlab ke sath is aayat mein jo umeed dilane wali hai aur zyada umeed ki aas paida ho jati hai, Wallahu A'lam. Phir farmata hai Allah ke sath jo shirk kare us ne bade gunah ka iftira bandha, jaise aur aayat mein hai shirk bahut bada zulm hai. Bukhari Muslim mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se riwayat hai ke sab se bada gunah kya hai? Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain tumhein sab se bada kabira gunah batata hoon woh Allah Ta'ala ke sath shareek karna hai, phir aap ne isi aayat ka yeh aakhri hissa tilawat farmaya, phir maa baap ki nafarmani karna, phir aap ne yeh aayat tilawat farmayi ke (اَنِ اشْكُرْ لِيْ وَلِوَالِدَيْكَ ۭ اِلَيَّ الْمَصِيْرُ) (Surah Luqman: 14) mera shukr kar aur apne maa baap ka shukriya kar, meri taraf lautna hai.

Munh par tareef-o-tauseef ki muman'at. Yahood-o-Nasara ka qaul tha ke hum Allah Ta'ala ki aulad aur us ke chehite hain aur kehte thay ke jannat mein sirf Yahood jayenge ya Nasrani. Un ke is qaul ki tardeed mein yeh (Aayat Alam Tara Al-Kh) nazil hui aur yeh qaul Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) ke khayal ke mutabiq is aayat ka shaan-e-nuzool hi hai ke yeh log apne bachon ko imam banate thay aur kehte thay ke yeh beganah hai, yeh bhi marwi hai ke un ka khayal tha ke hamare jo bache faut ho gaye hain woh hamare liye qurbat-e-Ilahi ka zariya hain, hamare sifarishi hain aur hamein woh bacha lenge, pas yeh aayat utri. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) Yahudiyon ka apne bachon ko aage karne ka waqia bayan kar ke farmate hain woh jhoote hain, Allah Ta'ala kisi gunahgar ko beganah ki wajah se chhor nahin deta. Yeh kehte thay ke jaise hamare bache be-khata hain aise hi hum bhi beganah hain aur kaha gaya hai ke yeh aayat dusron ki barhi charhi madh-o-sana bayan karne ke radd mein utri hai. Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai ke hamein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hukum diya ke hum madh karne walon ke munh mitti se bhar dein. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek martaba ek shakhs ko dusre ki madh-o-sataish karte hue sun kar farmaya afsos! Tu ne apne sathi ki gardan tor di, phir farmaya agar tum mein se kisi ko aisi hi zaroorat ki wajah se kisi ki tareef karni bhi ho to yun kahe ke falan shakhs ke bare mein meri raye yeh hai, Allah ke nazdeek pasandida amal yahi hai ke kisi ki munh par tareef na ki jaye. Musnad-e-Ahmed mein Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ka qaul hai ke jo kahe main momin hoon woh kafir hai aur jo kahe ke main aalim hoon woh jahil hai aur jo kahe main jannati hoon woh jahannami hai. Ibn Marduyah mein aap ke farman mein yeh bhi marwi hai ke mujhe tum par sab se zyada khauf is baat ka hai ke koi shakhs khud-pasandi karne lage aur apni samajh par aap fakhr karne baith jaye. Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai ke Hazrat Muawiyah (R.A) bahut hi kam hadith bayan farmate aur bahut kam jum'e aise honge jin mein aap ne yeh chand hadithein na sunayi hon ke jis ke sath Allah ka irada bhalayi ka hota hai use apne deen ki samajh ata farmata hai aur yeh maal meetha aur sabz rang hai, jo ise is ke haq ke sath lega use is mein barkat di jayegi, tum log aapas mein ek dusre ki madh-o-sataish se parhez karo is liye ke yeh dusre par chhuri pherna hai, yeh pichhla jumla un se Ibn Majah mein bhi marwi hai. Hazrat Ibn Masood (R.A) farmate hain ke insan ke paas ek subah ko apne deen mein se kuch bhi nahin hota (is ki wajah yeh hoti hai) ke woh subah kisi se apna kaam nikalne ke liye mila, us ki tareef shuru kar di aur us ki madh-sarayi shuru ki aur qasmein kha kar kehne laga aap aise hain aur aise hain halankeh na woh us ke nuqsan ka malik hai na nafa aur basa mumkin hai ke un tareefi kalmaat aur us ka tafseeli bayan (FALA TUZAKKU ANFUSAKUM) 53.

An-Najm: 32 ki tafsir mein aayega Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Pas yahan irshad hota hai ke Allah Ta'ala hi hai woh jise chahe pak kar de kyunke tamam cheezon ki haqeeqat aur asliyat ka aalim wahi hai, phir farmaya ke Allah ek dhage ke wazan ke barabar bhi kisi ki neki na chhorega, fateel ke ma'ani hain khajoor ki guthli ke darmiyan ka dhaga aur marwi hai ke woh dhaga jise koi apni ungliyon se bat le, phir farmata hai un ki iftira pardazi to dekho ke kis tarah Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki aulad aur us ke mehboob banne ke da'wedar hain? Aur kaisi baatein kar rahe hain ke hamein to sirf chand din aag mein rehna hoga, kis tarah apne baron ke nek a'amal par e'temad kiye baithe hain? Halan-ke ek ka amal dusre ko kuch nafa nahin de sakta jaise irshad hai (Tilka ummatun qad khalat, laha ma kasabat wa lakum ma kasabtum, wa la tus'aluna amma kanu ya'malun) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 134) yeh ek giroh hai jo guzar chuka un ke a'amal un ke sath aur tumhare a'amal tumhare sath. Phir farmata hai un ka yeh khula kazb-o-iftira hi un ke liye kafi hai. "Jibt" ke ma'ani Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam R.A waghera se jadu aur taghut ke ma'ani shaitan ke marwi hain, yeh bhi kaha jata hai ke jibt habash ka lafz hai is ke ma'ani shaitan ke hain, shirk, but aur kahin ke ma'ani bhi bataye gaye hain, ba'az kehte hain ke is se murad Huyay bin Akhtab hai, ba'az kehte hain Ka'ab bin Ashraf hai, ek hadith mein hai faal aur parindon ko daantna yani un ke naam ya un ke udne ya bolne ya un ke naam se shagun lena aur zameen par lakeerein khench kar mamla tay karna aur jibt hai, Hasan kehte hain jibt shaitan ki ghanghanahat hai, Taghut ki nisbat sawal kiya gaya to farmaya ke yeh kahin log hain jin ke paas shaitan aate thay, Mujahid farmate hain insani surat ke yeh shaitan hain jin ke paas log apne jhagde le kar aate hain aur unhein hakim maante hain, Hazrat Imam Malik farmate hain is se murad har cheez hai jis ki ibadat Allah ke siwa ki jaye. Phir farmaya ke un ki jahalat, bedini aur khud apni kitab ke sath kufr ki naubat yahan tak pahunch gayi hai ke kafiron ko musalmanon par tarjeeh aur afzaliyat dete hain, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Huyay bin Akhtab aur Ka'ab bin Ashraf Makkah walon ke paas aaye to Ahl-e-Makkah ne un se kaha tum Ahl-e-Kitab aur sahib-e-ilm ho bhala batao to tum behtar hain ya Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)? Unhon ne kaha tum kya ho? Aur woh kya hain? To Ahl-e-Makkah ne kaha hum sila-rehmi karte hain, tayyar untniyan zibah kar ke dusron ko khilate hain, lassi pilate hain, ghulamon ko azad karte hain, hajiyon ko pani pilate hain aur Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) to samboor hain hamare rishte naate tudwa diye. Un ka sath hajiyon ke choron ne diya jo qabila Ghifar mein se hain, ab batao hum achhe ya woh?

Toh un dono ne kaha tum behtar ho aur tum zyada seedhay raastay par ho, is par yeh aayat utri. Dusri riwayat mein hai ke inhi ke baray mein (Aayat: Inna shani-aka huwal abtar) utri hai. Banu Wa'il aur Banu Nazeer ke chand sardar jab Arab mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke khilaf aag laga rahay thay aur jang-e-azeem ki tayari mein thay, us waqt jab yeh Quraish ke paas aaye toh Quraishiyon ne inhe aalim-o-darwesh jaan kar un se poocha ke batao hamara deen achha hai ya Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka? Toh un logon ne kaha tum achhay deen walay aur un se zyada sahih raastay par ho. Is par yeh aayat utri aur khabar di gayi ke yeh la'nati giroh hai aur in ka madad-o-muawin duniya aur aakhirat mein koi nahin, is liye ke sirf kuffar ko apne saath milanay ke liye bator-e-chaplusi aur khushamad ke yeh kalmaat apni maloomat ke khilaf keh rahay hain lekin yaad rakh lein ke yeh kamyab nahin ho saktay. Chunancha yahi hua, zabardast lashkar le kar saray Arab ko apne saath mila kar tamam-tar quwwat-o-taqat ikatthi kar ke in logon ne Madina Sharif par charhai ki, yahan tak ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Madina ke ird-gird khandaq khodni padi, lekin bil-aakhir duniya ne dekh liya in ki sari sazishein nakam huin, yeh khaib-o-khasir rahay, namurad-o-nakam paltay, daman-e-murad khali raha, balkay namuradi, mayusi aur nuqsan-e-azeem ke saath lautna pada. Allah Ta'ala ne mominon ki madad ki aur apni quwwat-o-izzat se (kafiron ko) oundhay munh gira diya, Falhamdulillahil Kabirul Muta'al.

Munh par tareef-o-tauseef ki muman'at. Yahood-o-Nasara ka qaul tha ke hum Allah Ta'ala ki aulad aur us ke chehite hain aur kehte thay ke jannat mein sirf Yahood jayenge ya Nasrani. Un ke is qaul ki tardeed mein yeh (Aayat Alam Tara Al-Kh) nazil hui aur yeh qaul Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) ke khayal ke mutabiq is aayat ka shaan-e-nuzool hi hai ke yeh log apne bachon ko imam banate thay aur kehte thay ke yeh beganah hai, yeh bhi marwi hai ke un ka khayal tha ke hamare jo bache faut ho gaye hain woh hamare liye qurbat-e-Ilahi ka zariya hain, hamare sifarishi hain aur hamein woh bacha lenge, pas yeh aayat utri. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) Yahudiyon ka apne bachon ko aage karne ka waqia bayan kar ke farmate hain woh jhoote hain, Allah Ta'ala kisi gunahgar ko beganah ki wajah se chhor nahin deta. Yeh kehte thay ke jaise hamare bache be-khata hain aise hi hum bhi beganah hain aur kaha gaya hai ke yeh aayat dusron ki barhi charhi madh-o-sana bayan karne ke radd mein utri hai.
