Yahudiyon ki dushmani ki inteha aur us ki saza yahan bator-e-inkaar ke sawal hota hai ke kya woh mulk ke kisi hissa ke maalik hain? Ya'ni nahin hain, phir un ki bakhili bayan ki jaati hai ke agar aisa hota to yeh kisi ko zara sa bhi nafa pahunchane ke dawa-daar na hote, khususan Allah ke is aakhri paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko itna bhi na dete jitna khajoor ki guthli ke darmiyan ka parda hota hai, jaise aur aayat mein hai (Qul lau antum tamlikuna khaza'ina rahmati rabbi izal la-amsaktum khashyatal infaq, wa kanal insanu qatura) (17. Al-Isra: 100) ya'ni agar tum mere Rab ki rehmaton ke khazanon ke maalik hote to tum to kharch ho jaane ke khauf se bilkul hi rok lete, go zahir hai ke woh kam nahin ho sakte the lekin tumhari kanjusi tumhein dara deti, isi liye farma diya ke insaan bada hi bakhil hai. Un ke in bakhilana mizaj ke baad un ka hasad wazeh kiya ja raha hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Allah Ta'ala farmata hai hum ne Aal-e-Ibrahim ko jo Bani Israel se nahin, is liye un se hasad ki aag mein jal rahe hain aur logon ko aap ki tasdeeq se rok rahe hain. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yahan 'An-Naas' se murad hum hain koi aur nahin. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai hum ne Aal-e-Ibrahim ko jo Bani Israel ke qabail mein aulad-e-Ibrahim se hain, nabuwwat di, kitab nazil farmayi, jeene marne ke aadaab sikhaye, badshahat bhi di, is ke bawajood un mein se ba'az to momin huye, is in'am-o-ikram ko maana lekin ba'az ne khud bhi kufr kiya aur dusre logon ko bhi is se roka, halankeh woh bhi Bani Israel hi the, to jabkeh yeh apne walon se bhi munkir ho chuke hain to phir ae Nabi-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman aap ka inkaar un se kya door hai? Jabkeh aap un mein se bhi nahin. Yeh bhi matlab ho sakta hai ke ba'az is par ya'ni Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par imaan laye aur ba'az na laye, pas yeh kaafir apne kufr mein bahut sakht aur nihayat pakke hain aur hidayat-o-haq se bahut hi door hain. Phir unhein un ki saza sunayi ja rahi hai ke Jahannam ka jalna unhein bas hai, un ke kufr-o-inaad ki, un ki takzeeb aur sarkashi ki yeh saza kaafi hai.

Azab ki tafseel aur nek logon ka anjam bil-khair. Allah ki aayaton ke na manne aur rasoolon se logon ko bargashta karne walon ki saza aur un ke bad-anjam ka zikr hua. Unhein is aag mein dhakela jayega jo unhein charon taraf se gher legi aur un ke rom-rom ko sulga degi aur yehi nahin balkay ye azab daimi aisa hoga, ek chamra jal gaya to dusra badal diya jayega jo safed kagaz ki misal hoga. Ek-ek kafir ki sau-sau khalein hongi, har-har khal par qisam-qisam ke alaihda-alaihda azab honge, ek-ek din mein sattar hazar martaba khal ulat-palat hogi. Ya'ni keh diya jayega ke jald laut aaye, woh phir laut aayegi. Hazrat Umar R.A ke samne jab is aayat ki tilawat hui to aap parhne wale se dobara sunane ki farmaish karte, woh dobara parhta to Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal R.A farmate hain main aap ko is ki tafseer sunaoon, ek-ek sa'at mein sau-sau baar badli jayegi. Is par Hazrat Umar R.A ne farmaya main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se yehi suna hai (Ibn Marduyah waghera). Dusri riwayat mein hai ke us waqt Ka'ab R.A ne kaha tha ke mujhe is aayat ki tafseer yaad hai, main ne ise Islam lane se pehle parha tha. Aap ne farmaya achha bayan karo, agar woh wohi hui jo main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se suni hai to hum ise qabool karenge warna hum ise qabil-e-iltifat na samjhenge. To aap ne farmaya ek sa'at mein ek sau bees martaba, is par Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A ne farmaya main ne isi tarah Huzoor ﷺ se suna hai. Hazrat Rabi' bin Anas R.A farmate hain pehli kitab mein likha hua hai ke un ki khalein chalees haath ya chhattar haath hongi aur un ke pet itne bade honge ke agar un mein pahar rakha jaye to sama jaye. Jab un khalon ko aag kha legi to aur khalein aa jayengi. Ek hadith mein is se bhi zyada Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, jahannami jahannam mein is qadar bade-bade bana diye jayenge ke un ke kaan ki nok se kandha saat sau saal ki raah par hoga aur un ki khal ki motai sattar zira' hogi aur kuchli misl-e-Uhud pahar ke hongi. Aur ye bhi kaha gaya hai ke murad khal se libas hai lekin ye za'eef hai aur zahir-e-lafz ke khilaf hai. Is ke muqablon mein nek logon ke anjam ko bayan kiya jata hai ke woh Jannat-e-Adan mein honge jis ke chappe-chappe par nahrein jaari hongi, jahan chahein unhein le jayen, apne mehalat mein, baghat mein, raston mein, garz jahan un ke jee chahein wahin woh pak nahrein behne lengi. Phir sab se a'ala lutf ye hai ke ye tamam ne'matein abadi aur hamesha rehne wali hongi, na khatam hongi. Phir un ke liye wahan haiz-o-nifas se, gandagi aur paleedi se, mail-kuchail aur boo-baas se, razeel sifatton aur behuda akhlaq se pak biwiyan hongi aur ghane lambe chaure saye honge jo bohat farhat-bakhsh, bohat hi suroor-angez, rahat-afza, dil-khush-kun honge. Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain jannat mein ek darakht hai jis ke saye tale ek sau saal tak bhi ek sawar chala jaye to us ka saya khatam na ho, ye Shajarat-ul-Khuld hai (Ibn Jareer).

Amanat aur Adl-o-Insaf. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain jo tere sath amanat dari ka bartao kare to us ki amanat ada kar aur jo tere sath khayanat kare to us se khayanat mat kar (Musnad-e-Ahmad wa Sunan). Ayat ke alfaaz wasee-ul-ma'ani hain. In mein Allah Ta'ala Azza-wa-Jal ke huqooq ki adaigi bhi shamil hai jaise roza, namaz, zakat, kaffara, nazr waghera, aur bandon ke aapas ke kul huqooq bhi shamil hain jaise amanat dar ka haq use dilwaya jaye ga yahan tak ke be-seeng wali bakri ko agar seengon wali bakri ne mara hai to us ka badla bhi use dilwaya jaye ga. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain ke shahadat ki wajah se tamam gunah mit jate hain magar amanat nahin mitne lagi. Koi shakhs Allah ki rah mein shaheed bhi hua to use bhi Qayamat ke din laya jaye ga aur kaha jaye ga ke apni amanat ada kar. Woh jawab de ga ke duniya to ab hai nahin main kahan se use ada karoon? Farmate hain phir woh cheez use Jahannam ki teh mein nazar aaye gi aur kaha jaye ga ke ja use le aa. Woh use apne kandhe par laad kar le chale ga lekin woh gir pade gi, woh phir use lene jaye ga, bas isi azab mein woh mubtala rahe ga. Hazrat Zazan is riwayat ko sun kar Hazrat Bara (R.A) ke paas aa kar bayan karte hain, woh kehte hain mere bhai ne sach kaha, phir Quran ki is ayat ko padhte hain. Ibn Abbas (R.A) waghera farmate hain har nek-o-bad ke liye par yahi hukum hai. Abu Al-Aliyah farmate hain jis cheez ka hukum diya gaya aur jis cheez se mana kiya gaya woh sab amanat hai. Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) farmate hain aurat apni sharmgah ki amanat dar hai. Rabee bin Anas (R.A) farmate hain jo jo muamlaat tere aur dusre logon ke darmiyan hon woh sab isi mein shamil hain. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain is mein yeh bhi dakhil hai ke Sultan Eid wale din aurton ko khutba sunaye. Is ayat ki shaan-e-nuzool mein marwi hai ke jab Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne Makkah fatah kiya aur itminan ke sath Baitullah Shareef mein aaye to apni oontni par sawar ho kar tawaf kiya. Hajar-e-Aswad ko apni lakdi se chhoote the. Is ke baad Usman bin Talha (R.A) ko jo Ka'aba ki kunji bardar the bulaya, un se kunji talab ki, unhon ne dena chahi itne mein Hazrat Abbas (R.A) ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ab yeh mujhe sonpiye taake mere gharane mein Zamzam ka pani pilana aur Ka'aba ki kunji rakhna dono hi baatein rahen. Yeh sunte hi Hazrat Usman bin Talha (R.A) ne apna hath rok liya. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne dobara talab ki phir wahi waqia hua, aap ne seh-bara talab ki, Hazrat Usman ne yeh keh kar de di ke Allah ki amanat aap ko deta hoon. Huzoor (ﷺ) Ka'aba ka darwaza khol andar gaye, wahan jitne but aur tasweerein thin sab tod kar phenk din. Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ka but bhi tha jis ke hath mein faal ke teer the, aap ne farmaya Allah in mushrikeen ko gharat kare, bhala Khaleelullah ko in teeron se kya sarokar?

Phir un tamam cheezon ko barbad kar ke un ki jagah pani daal kar un ke naam-o-nishan mita kar aap bahar aaye, Ka'aba ke darwaze par khade ho kar aap ne kaha: Koi mabood nahin bajuz Allah ke, woh akela hai jis ka koi shareek nahin, us ne apne wade ko sacha kiya, apne bande ki madad ki aur tamam lashkaron ko isi akele ne shikast di. Phir aap ne ek lamba khutba diya jis mein yeh bhi farmaya ke jahiliyat ke tamam jhagde ab mere paon tale kuchal diye gaye, khwah maali hon khwah jaani hon. Baitullah ki chaukidari ka aur hajiyon ko pani pilane ka mansab joon ka toon baqi rahega. Is khutbe ko pura kar ke aap baithe hi the ke Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne aage badh kar kaha: Huzoor! Chabi mujhe inayat farmayi jaye taake Baitullah ki chaukidari ka aur hajiyon ko Zamzam pilane ka mansab dono yakja ho jayen, lekin aap ne unhein na di. Maqam-e-Ibrahim ko Ka'aba ke andar se nikal kar aap ne Ka'aba ki deewar se mila kar rakh diya aur auron se keh diya ke tumhara qibla yahi hai. Phir aap tawaf mein mashghool ho gaye, abhi woh chand phere hi phire the ke Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) nazil huye aur aap ne apni zaban-e-mubarak se is ayat ki tilawat shuru ki. Is par Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya: Mere maa-baap Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par fida hon, main ne to is se pehle aap ko is ayat ki tilawat karte nahin suna. Ab aap ne Hazrat Usman bin Talha (R.A) ko bulaya aur unhein kunji sonp di aur farmaya: Aaj ka din wafa ka, neki aur sulook ka din hai. Yeh wahi Usman bin Talha (R.A) hain, jin ki nasl mein aaj tak Ka'abatullah ki kunji chali aati hai. Yeh sulh-e-Hudaibiya aur Fatah-e-Makkah ke darmiyan Islam laye, jab hi Khalid bin Waleed aur Amr bin Aas bhi musalman huye the. Un ka chacha Usman bin Talha Uhud ki ladai mein mushrikon ke sath tha, balkay un ka jhanda bardar tha aur wahin bahalat-e-kufr mara gaya tha.

Al-gharz mashhoor toh yahi hai ke yeh aayat isi baare mein utri hai ab khwah is baare mein nazil hui ho ya na hui ho baharsurat is ka hukm aam hai jaise Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) aur Hazrat Muhammad bin Hanafiyah ka qaul hai ke har shakhs ko dusre ki amanat ki adaigi ka hukm hai phir irshad hai ke faisle adl ke sath karo hakimon ko Ahkam-ul-Hakimin ka hukm ho raha hai ke kisi halat mein adl ka daman na chhodo, hadith mein hai Allah hakim ke sath hota hai jab tak ke woh zulm na kare jab zulm karta hai toh use usi ki taraf sonp deta hai, ek asar mein hai ek din ka adl chalis saal ki ibadat ke barabar hai, phir farmata hai yeh adaigi-e-amanat ka aur adl-o-insaf ka hukm aur isi tarah shariat ke tamam ahkam aur tamam mamnooaat tumhare liye behtareen aur nafe cheezein hain jin ka amr-e-parwardigar ne tumhe diya hai (Ibn Abi Hatim) aur riwayat mein hai Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ne is aayat ke aakhri alfaaz padhte hue apna angootha apne kaan mein rakha aur shahadat ki ungli apni aankh par rakhi (yani ishare se sunna dekhna kaan aur aankh par ungli rakh kar bata kar) farmaya main ne isi tarah padhte aur karte Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko dekha hai, rawi-e-hadith Hazrat Abu Zakariya (R.H) farmate hain hamare ustad Mudhari (R.H) ne bhi isi tarah padh kar ishara kar ke hamein bataya apne dahne hath ka angootha apni dayin aankh par rakha aur us ke paas ki ungli apne dahne kaan par rakhi (Ibn Abi Hatim) yeh hadith isi tarah Imam Abu Dawood ne bhi riwayat ki hai aur Imam Ibn Hibban ne bhi apni Sahih mein ise naqal kiya hai. Aur Hakim ne Mustadrak mein aur Ibn Marduyah ne apni tafsir mein bhi ise warid kiya hai, is ki sanad mein jo Abu Yunus hain woh Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ke maula hain aur un ka naam Saleem bin Jubair (R.H) hai.

Mashroot Itaat-e-Ameer

Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein barwayat-e-Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne ek chote se lashkar mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Huzafah bin Qais ko bheja tha, unke bare mein yeh aayat utri hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne ek lashkar bheja jis ki sardari ek Ansari (R.A) ko di. Ek martaba woh logon par sakht gussa ho gaye aur farmane lage, "Kya tumhein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne meri farmanbardari ka hukum nahin diya?" Sab ne kaha, "Haan, beshak diya hai." Farmane lage, "Achha, lakriyan jama karo." Phir aag mangwa kar lakriyan jalayin, phir hukum diya ke tum is aag mein kood paro. Ek naujawan ne kaha, "Logon! Suno, aag se bachne ke liye hi toh hum ne daman-e-Rasool (ﷺ) mein panah li hai, tum jaldi na karo jab tak ke Huzoor (ﷺ) se mulaqat na ho jaye, phir agar aap bhi yahi farmayen toh be-jhijhak is aag mein kood parna." Chunancha yeh log wapas Huzoor (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein hazir hue aur sara waqia keh sunaya. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, "Agar tum is aag mein kood parte toh hamesha aag hi mein jalte rehte. Suno! Farmanbardari sirf maroof mein hai."

Abu Dawood mein hai ke musalman par sunna aur manna farz hai, jee chahe ya tabiyat roke, lekin us waqt tak ke (Allah Ta'ala aur Rasool ki) nafarmani ka hukum na diya jaye. Jab nafarmani ka hukum mile toh na sune na mane. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai, Hazrat Ubada bin Samit (R.A) farmate hain hum se Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne bai'at li ke kaam ke ahl se us kaam ko na chheinein. Lekin jab tum unka khula kufr dekho jis ke bare mein tumhare paas koi wazeh Ilahi daleel bhi ho. Bukhari Sharif mein hai, "Suno aur itaat karo agarche tum par Habshi ghulam ameer banaya gaya ho chahe ke us ka sar kishmish jaisa ho." Muslim Sharif mein hai, Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) farmate hain mujhe mere Khaleel (yani Risalat Ma'ab ﷺ) ne sunne ki wasiyat ki agarche naqis hath paon wala Habshi ghulam hi ho. Muslim ki hi aur hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne Hujjat-ul-Wida ke khutba mein farmaya, "Chahe tum par ghulam aamil banaya jaye jo tumhein Kitabullah ke mutabiq tumhara sath chahe toh tum us ki suno aur mano." Ek riwayat mein 'ghulam Habshi aaza kata' ke alfaaz hain.

Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai, nekon aur badon se bad tum har ek is amr mein jo mutabiq ho un ki suno aur mano ke mere baad nek se nek aur bad se bad tum ko milenge. Tum par ek imame jo haq par ho us ka sunna aur manna tum par hai aur un ke peeche namazein parhte raho. Agar woh neki karenge toh un ke liye nafa hai aur tumhare liye bhi, aur agar woh badi karenge toh tumhare liye achhai hai aur un par gunahon ka bojh hai. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) farmate hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya, "Bani Israel mein musalsal lagatar Rasool aaya karte the, ek ke baad ek, aur mere baad koi Nabi nahin magar khulafa bakasrat honge." Logon ne poocha, "Phir Huzoor (ﷺ) hamein kya hukum dete hain?" Farmaya, "Pehle ki bai'at poori karo, phir us ke baad aane wale ki, un ka haq unhein de do, Allah Ta'ala un se un ki ra'iyat ke bare mein sawal karne wala hai."

Aap farmate hain jo shakhs apne ameer ka koi napasandida kaam dekhe use sabr karna chahiye jo shakhs jamaat se balisht bhar juda hogaya phir woh jahiliyat ki maut marega (Bukhari o Muslim). Irshad hai jo shakhs itaat se haath khench le woh Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala se hujjat o daleel baghair mulaqat karega aur jo is halat mein mare ke uski gardan mein bai'at na ho woh jahiliyat ki maut marega (Muslim). Hazrat Abdur Rahman (R.H) farmate hain main Baitullah Sharif mein gaya dekha to Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr bin Aas (R.A) Ka'aba ke saya mein tashreef farma hain aur logon ka ek majma jama hai main bhi is majlis mein ek taraf baith gaya us waqt Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ne yeh hadith bayan ki farmaya ek safar mein hum Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath thay ek manzil mein utre koi apna khaima theek karne laga koi apne neze sambhalne laga koi kisi aur kaam mein mashghool hogaya, achanak hum ne suna ke Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farma rahe hain har Nabi par Allah ki taraf se farz hota hai ke apni ummat ko tamam nekiyan jo woh jaanta hai unki tarbiyat unhein de aur tamam buraiyon se jo uski nigah mein hain unhein aagah kar de. Suno meri ummat ki aafiyat ka zamana awwal ka zamana hai aakhir zamane mein badi badi balayein aayengi aur aise aise umoor nazil honge jinhein musalman napasand karenge aur ek har ek fitna barpa hoga ek aisa waqt aayega ke momin samajh lega isi mein meri halakat hai phir woh hatega. To dusra is se bhi bada aayega jis mein use apni halakat ka kamil yaqeen hoga bas yunhi lagatar fitne aur zabardast aazmaishein aur kul takleefein aati rahengi pas jo shakhs is baat ko pasand kare ke Jahannam se bach jaye aur Jannat ka mustahiq ho use chahiye ke marte dam tak Allah Ta'ala par aur Qayamat ke din par imaan rakhe aur logon se woh bartao kare jo khud apne liye pasand karta hai suno jis ne Imam se bai'at karli us ne apna haath uske qabza mein aur dil ki tamannayein use de dein. Aur apne dil ka phal de diya ab use chahiye ke uski itaat kare agar koi dusra is se khilaf cheenna chahe to uski gardan uda do, Abdur Rahman farmate hain main yeh sun kar qareeb gaya aur kaha aap ko main Allah Ta'ala ki qasam deta hoon kya khud aap ne ise Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani suna hai?

Toh aap ne apne dono haath apne kaan aur dil ki taraf barha kar farmaya main ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se apne in do kaanon se suna aur main ne ise apne is dil mein mehfooz rakha hai magar aap ke chacha zaad bhai Hazrat Muawiyah (R.A) hamein hamare apne maal batareeq-e-baatil se khane aur aapas mein ek dusre se jang karne ka hukum dete hain halankeh Allah Ta'ala ne in dono kaamon se muman'at farmayi hai, irshad hai (Aayat "Ya ayyuhallazina amanu la ta'kulu amwalakum..." [Surah An-Nisa: 29]), ise sun kar Hazrat Abdullah zara si der khamosh rahe phir farmaya Allah ki ita'at mein un ki ita'at karo aur agar Allah ki nafarmani ka hukum dein toh ise na maano is baare mein hadeesein aur bhi bohat si hain, isi aayat ki tafseer mein Hazrat Suddi (R.H) se marwi hai ke Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek lashkar bheja jis ka ameer Hazrat Khalid bin Waleed (R.A) ko banaya is lashkar mein Hazrat Ammar bin Yasir (R.A) bhi thay yeh lashkar jis qoum ki taraf jana chahta tha chala raat ke waqt us ki basti ke paas pohanch kar parao kiya un logon ko apne jasooson se pata chal gaya aur chup chup kar sab raaton raat bhaag kharay huay. Sirf ek shakhs reh gaya us ne un ke saath jaane se inkaar kar diya unhon ne us ka sab asbaab jala diya yeh shakhs raat ke andhere mein Khalid (R.A) ke lashkar mein aaya aur Hazrat Ammar (R.A) se mila aur un se kaha ke ae Abu Al-Yaqzan main Islam qabool kar chuka hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahin aur yeh ke Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us ke banday aur us ke Rasool hain meri saari qoum tumhara aana sun kar bhaag gayi hai sirf main baqi reh gaya hoon toh kya kal mera yeh Islam mujhe nafa de ga? Agar nafa na de toh main bhi bhaag jaoon Hazrat Ammar (R.A) ne farmaya yaqeenan yeh Islam tumhein nafa de ga tum na bhaago balkeh thehray raho subh ke waqt jab Hazrat Khalid (R.A) ne lashkar kashi ki toh siwaye us shakhs ke wahan kisi ko na paya use us ke maal samet giraftar kar liya gaya jab Hazrat Ammar (R.A) ko maloom hua toh aap Hazrat Khalid (R.A) ke paas aaye aur kaha ise chor dijiye yeh Islam la chuka hai aur meri panah mein hai Hazrat Khalid (R.A) ne farmaya tum kaun ho jo kisi ko panah de sako? Is par dono buzurgon mein kuch tez kalami ho gayi aur qissa barha yahan tak ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein sara waqea bayan kiya gaya. Aap ne Hazrat Ammar (R.A) ki panah ko jaiz qarar diya aur farmaya aayinda ameer ki taraf se panah na dena phir dono mein kuch tez kalami hone lagi is par Hazrat Khalid (R.A) ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha is naak katay ghulam ko aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kuch nahin kehte? Dekhiye toh yeh mujhe bura bhala keh raha hai? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Khalid (R.A) Ammar (R.A) ko bura na kaho.

Ammar R.A ko gaaliyan dene wale ko Allah gaaliyan dega, Ammar R.A se dushmani karne wale se Allah dushmani rakhega, Ammar R.A par jo laanat bheje ga us par Allah ki laanat naazil hogi. Ab toh Hazrat Khalid R.A ko lene ke dene parh gaye, Hazrat Ammar R.A gussa mein chilla rahe thay, aap daur kar un ke paas gaye, daaman thaam liya, maazrat ki aur apni taqseer maaf karayi, tab tak peecha na chhora jab tak ke Hazrat Ammar R.A raazi na ho gaye. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayat naazil farmayi (Amr-e-imarat-o-khilafat ke mutaliq sharait waghera ka bayaan aayat "Wa iz qaala rabbuka lil-malaaikati inni jaa'ilun fil-ardi khalifah" ki tafseer mein guzar chuka hai, haan mulahiza ho. Mutarjim). Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se bhi yeh riwayat marwi hai (Ibn-e-Jareer aur Ibn-e-Marduyah). Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A waghera farmate hain, "Ulil-Amr" se muraad samajh boojh aur deen wale hain yani ulama. Zahir baat toh yeh maloom hoti hai, aage haqeeqi ilm Allah ko hai ke yeh lafz aam hain, umara aur ulama dono is se muraad hain, jaise ke pehle guzra. Quran farmata hai (Aayat: Lawla yanhaahumur-rabbaniyyuna...), yani un ke ulama ne unhein jhoot bolne aur haraam khane se kyun na roka? Aur jagah hai (Aayat: Fas'alu ahlaz-zikri...), hadees ke janne walon se pooch liya karo ke agar tumhein ilm na ho. Sahih hadees mein hai, "Meri itaat karne wala Allah ki itaat karne wala hai aur jis ne meri nafarmani ki us ne Allah ki nafarmani ki hai." Pas yeh hain ahkaam, ulama aur umara ki itaat karo yani us ki sunnaton par amal karo aur hukm walon ki itaat karo yani us cheez mein jo Allah ki itaat ho. Allah ke farmaan ke khilaf agar un ka koi hukm ho toh itaat na karni chahiye, aise waqt ulama ya umara ki maanna haraam hai, jaise ke pehli hadees guzar chuki ke itaat sirf maroof mein hai, yani farmaan-e-Ilahi aur farmaan-e-Rasool (ﷺ) ke daayre mein. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, is se bhi zyada saaf hadees hai jis mein hai kisi ki itaat Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan ke khilaf jaaiz nahin.

Aage chal kar farmaya ke agar tum mein kisi baare mein jhagda pade toh use Allah aur Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf lautao yani Kitabullah aur Sunnat-e-Rasool ki taraf jaise ke Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) ki tafsir hai. Pas yahan sarih aur saaf lafzon mein Allah Azza-wa-Jal ka hukum ho raha hai ke log jis masle mein ikhtilaf karein khwah woh masla usool-e-deen se mutaliq ho khwah furoo-e-deen se mutaliq, uske tasfiya ki sirf yahi surat hai ke Kitab-o-Sunnat ko hukum maan liya jaye, jo is mein ho woh qabool kiya jaye. Jaise aur aayat-e-Qurani mein hai (Aayat: Wa ma ikhtalaftum fihi min shai'in fahukmuhu ilallah) yani agar kisi cheez mein tumhara ikhtilaf ho jaye uska faisla Allah ki taraf hai. Pas Kitab-o-Sunnat jo hukum de aur jis masle ki sehat ki shahadat de wahi haq hai, baqi sab batil hai. Quran farmata hai ke haq ke baad jo hai zalalat-o-gumrahi hai. Isi liye yahan bhi is hukum ke sath hi irshad hota hai agar tum Allah Ta'ala par aur Qayamat par iman rakhte ho, yani agar tum iman ke dawe mein sache ho toh jis masle ka tumhein ilm na ho yani jis masle mein ikhtilaf ho, jis amr mein juda juda aara hon un sab ka faisla Kitabullah aur Hadith-e-Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kiya karo, jo in dono mein ho maan liya karo. Pas sabit hua ke jo shakhs ikhtilafi masail ka tasfiya Kitab-o-Sunnat ki taraf se na le jaye woh Allah par aur Qayamat par iman nahin rakhta. Phir irshad hota hai ke jhagdon mein aur ikhtilafat mein Kitabullah-o-Sunnat-e-Rasool ki taraf faisla lana aur unki taraf ruju karna hi behtar hai, aur yahi nek anjam khush-aaind hai aur yahi ache badle dilane wala kaam hai, bahut achi jaza isi ka samar hai.

Hasan sulook aur doghlay log. Upar ki aayat mein Allah Ta'ala ne un logon ke da'way ko jhutlaya hai jo zabani toh iqrar karte hain ke Allah Ta'ala ki tamam agli kitabon par aur is Quran-o-Hadith ki taraf ruju nahin karte balkay kisi aur taraf le jate hain, chunancha yeh aayat un do shakhson ke bare mein nazil hui jin mein kuch ikhtilaf tha, ek toh Yahudi tha dusra Ansari, Yahudi toh kehta tha ke chal Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se faisla karalein aur Ansari kehta tha Ka'ab bin Ashraf ke paas chalo. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh aayat un munafiqon ke bare mein utri hai jo bazahir musalman kehlate hain, un munafiqon ke bare mein utri hai jo bhi musalman hone ka da'wa karte thay lekin darparda ahkam-e-jahiliyat ki taraf jhukna chahte thay, is ke siwa aur aqwal bhi hain. Aayat apne hukum aur alfaz ke aitbar se aam hai, un tamam waqiyat par mushtamil hai, har us shakhs ki muzammat aur burai ka izhar karti hai jo Kitab-o-Sunnat se hat kar kisi aur batil ki taraf apna faisla le jaye aur yahi murad yahan Taghoot se hai (yani Quran-o-Hadith ke siwa ki cheez ya shakhs). Sudoor se murad takabbur se munh mod lena hai, jaise aur aayat mein hai: (Wa iza qeela lahumut-tabi'u ma anzalallahu qalu bal nattabi'u ma alfaina alaihi aaba'ana) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 170), yani jab un se kaha jaye ke Allah ki utari hui wahi ki farmanbardari karo toh jawab dete hain ke hum toh apne baap dada ki pairwi par hi aray rahenge. Iman walon ka jawab yeh nahin hota balkay un ka jawab dusri aayat mein is tarah mazkoor hai: (Innama kana qaulul-mu'mineena iza du'u ilallahi wa rasulihi liyahkuma bainahum an yaqulu sami'na wa ata'na, wa ula'ika humul-muflihun) (Surah An-Nur: 51), yani iman walon ko jab Allah Rasool ke faislay aur hukum ki taraf bulaya jaye toh un ka jawab yahi hota hai ke hum ne suna aur hum ne teh-e-dil se qubool kiya. Phir munafiqon ki muzammat mein bayan ho raha hai ke un ke gunahon ke ba'is jab takleefein pahunchti hain aur teri zaroorat mehsoos hoti hai toh doray bhagay aate hain aur tumhein khush karne ke liye uzr-e-ma'zarat karne baith jate hain aur qasmein kha kar apni neki aur salahiyat ka yaqeen dilana chahte hain aur kehte hain ke aap ke siwa dusron ki taraf un muqadmaat ke le jane se hamara maqsood sirf yahi tha ke zara dusron ka dil rakha jaye, aapas mein mel-jol nibh jaye warna dil se kuch hum un ki achhai ke mu'taqid nahin, jaise aur aayat mein: (Fatara-llazina fi qulubihim maradun yusari'una fihim yaquluna nakhsha an tusibana da'iratun, fa'asallahu an ya'tiya bil-fathi au amrin min indihi fayusbihu 'ala ma asarru fi anfusihim nadimeen) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 52).

(Al-Ma'idah: 52) tak bayan hua hai, yani tu dekhega ke bimar dil yani munafiq Yahud-o-Nasara ki baham dosti ki tamam tar koshishein karte phirte hain aur kehte hain ke hamein un se ikhtilaf ki wajah se aafat mein phans jaane ka khatra hai. Bahut mumkin hai un se dosti ke baad Allah Ta'ala fatah dein ya apna koi hukum nazil farmayein aur yeh log un iradon par pasheman hone lagein jo un ke dilon mein posheeda hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Abu Burzah Aslami ek kahan shakhs tha, Yahud apne ba'az faisle us se karate the. Ek waqiye mein mushrikeen bhi us ki taraf daure, is mein yeh ayatein (Aayat: Alam tara se tarfiqa) tak nazil huin. Allah Ta'ala farmate hain ke is qisam ke log yani munafiqeen ke dilon mein jo kuch hai? Us ka ilm Allah Ta'ala ko kamil hai, us par koi chhoti se chhoti cheez bhi makhfi nahin, woh un ke zahir-o-batin ka use ilm hai. To un se chashm-poshi kar, un ke batini iradon par daant-dapat na kar, haan unhein nifaq aur dusron se shar-o-fasad wabasta rehne se baaz rehne ki nasihat kar aur dil mein utarne wali baatein un se keh, balkeh un ke liye dua bhi kar.

Allah Ta'ala farmate hain ke is qisam ke log yani munafiqeen ke dilon mein jo kuch hai? Us ka ilm Allah Ta'ala ko kamil hai, us par koi chhoti se chhoti cheez bhi makhfi nahin, woh un ke zahir-o-batin ka use ilm hai. To un se chashm-poshi kar, un ke batini iradon par daant-dapat na kar, haan unhein nifaq aur dusron se shar-o-fasad wabasta rehne se baaz rehne ki nasihat kar aur dil mein utarne wali baatein un se keh, balkeh un ke liye dua bhi kar.

Ita'at-e-Rasool (ﷺ) hi zamin-e-najat hai. Matlab yeh hai ke har zamana ke Rasool ki tabedari us ki ummat par Allah ki taraf se farz hoti hai. Mansab-e-Risalat yahi hai ke us ke sabhi ahkamat ko Allah ke ahkam samjha jaye. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain "bi-iznillah" se yeh murad hai ke us ki taufiq Allah Ta'ala ke hath hai, us ki qudrat-o-mashiyat par mauqoof hai, jaise aur ayat mein hai: (Walaqad sadaqakumullahu wa'dahu iz tahussunahum bi-iznihi hatta iza fashiltum wa tanaza'tum fil-amri wa 'asaytum mim ba'di ma arakum ma tuhibbun) (Surah Al-Imran: 152). Yahan bhi izn se murad amr, qudrat aur mashiyat hai, yani us ne tumhein un par ghalba diya. Phir Allah Ta'ala 'asi aur khatakaron ko irshad farmata hai ke unhein Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ke paas aa kar Allah Ta'ala se istighfar karna chahiye aur khud Rasool se bhi arz karna chahiye ke aap hamare liye duayein kijiye. Jab woh aisa karenge to yaqeenan Allah un ki taraf ruju' karega, unhein bakhsh dega aur un par raham farmayega. Abu Mansoor Sabbagh ne apni kitab mein jis mein mashhoor qisse likhe hain, likha hai ke 'Utbi ka bayan hai: Main Huzoor (ﷺ) ki turbat ke paas baitha hua tha jabke ek a'rabi aaya aur us ne kaha: "Assalamu Alaikum Ya Rasoolullah (ﷺ), main ne Quran-e-Kareem ki is ayat ko suna aur aap ke paas aaya hoon taake aap ke samne apne gunahon ka istighfar karoon aur aap ki shafa'at talab karoon." Phir us ne yeh ashaar parhe: "Ya khaira man dafanat bil-qa'i a'zamuhu, fataba min teebihinnal-qa'u wal-akamu. Nafsi al-fida'u li-qabrin anta sakinuhu, feehi al-'afafu wa feehi al-joodu wal-karamu." (Jin jin ki haddiyan maidanon mein dafan ki gayi hain aur un ki khushbu se woh maidan-o-teele mehak uthe hain. Aye un tamam mein se behtareen hasti, meri jaan is qabr par se sadqe ho jis ka sakin tu hai, jis mein parsai, sakhawat aur karam hai). Phir a'rabi to laut gaya aur mujhe neend aa gayi. Khwab mein kya dekhta hoon Huzoor (ﷺ) mujh se farma rahe hain: "Ja is a'rabi ko khushkhabri suna, Allah ne us ke gunah maaf farma diye." (Yeh khayal rahe ke na to yeh kisi hadith ki kitab ka waqia hai na is ki koi sahih sanad hai, balkeh ayat ka yeh hukm Huzoor (ﷺ) ki zindagi mein hi tha, wisal ke baad nahin, jaise ke "ja'ooka" ka lafz batla raha hai aur Muslim Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke har insaan ka har amal us ki maut ke sath munqata ho jata hai, Wallahu A'lam. Mutarjim). Phir Allah Ta'ala apni buzurg aur muqaddas zaat ki qasam kha kar farmata hai ke koi shakhs imaan ki hudood mein nahin aa sakta jab tak ke tamam umoor mein Allah ke is aakhir-uz-zaman afzal-tar Rasool ko apna sacha hakim na maan le aur aap ke har hukm, har faisle, har sunnat aur har hadith ko qabil-e-qubool aur haq-e-sareeh tasleem na karne lage, dil ko aur jism ko yaksar tabe'-e-Rasool (ﷺ) na bana de. Gharz jo bhi zahir-o-batin, chhote bare kul umoor mein hadith-e-Rasool (ﷺ) ko asal-e-usool samjhe wahi momin hai.

Pas farman hai ke tere ahkam ko yeh kushada dili se tasleem kar liya karein, apne dil mein pasandidagi na layein, tasleem-e-kulli tamam ahadees ke sath rahe, na toh ahadees ke manne se rukein, na unhein be-asar karne ke asbab dhoondein, na un ke martaba ki kisi aur cheez ko samjhein, na un ki tardeed karein, na un ka muqabla karein, na un ke tasleem karne mein jhagrein. Jaise farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai: Uss ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, tum mein se koi sahib-e-iman nahin ho sakta jab tak ke woh apni khwahish ko uss cheez ka tabe na bana de jise main laya hoon. Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke Hazrat Zubair (R.A) ka kisi shakhs se naliyon se bagh mein pani lene ke bare mein jhagda ho pada, toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Zubair (R.A) tum pani pila lo, uss ke baad pani ko ansari ke bagh mein jaane do. Iss par ansari ne kaha: Haan ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam), yeh toh aap ke phuphi ke ladke hain. Yeh sun kar aap ka chehra mutaghayyar ho gaya aur farmaya: Zubair (R.A) tum pani pila lo, phir pani ko roke rakho yahan tak ke bagh ki deewaron tak pahunch jaye, phir apne padosi ki taraf chhod do. Pehle toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek aisi surat nikali thi ke jis mein Hazrat Zubair (R.A) ko takleef na ho aur ansari ko kushadgi ho jaye, lekin jab ansari ne ise apne haq mein behtar na samjha toh aap ne Hazrat Zubair (R.A) ko un ka pura haq dilwaya. Hazrat Zubair (R.A) farmate hain jahan tak mera khayal hai yeh (فَلَا وَرَبِّكَ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ حَتّٰي يُحَكِّمُوْكَ فِيْمَا شَجَــرَ بَيْنَھُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُوْا فِيْٓ اَنْفُسِهِمْ حَرَجًا مِّمَّا قَضَيْتَ وَيُسَلِّمُوْا تَسْلِــيْمًا) (Surah An-Nisa: 65) issi bare mein nazil hui hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek mursal hadees mein hai ke yeh ansari (R.A) badri the aur riwayat mein hai dono mein jhagda yeh tha ke pani ki nehar se pehle Hazrat Zubair (R.A) ka khajooron ka bagh padta tha phir uss ansari ka. Ansari kehte the ke pani dono baghon mein ek sath aaye. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke yeh dono da'wedar Hazrat Zubair (R.A) aur Hazrat Hatib bin Abu Balta (R.A) the, aap ka faisla un mein yeh hua ke pehle unche wala pani pila le phir neeche wala. Dusri ek zyada ghareeb riwayat mein shaan-e-nuzool yeh marwi hai ke do shakhs apna jhagda le kar darbar-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mein aaye, aap ne faisla kar diya lekin jis ke khilaf faisla tha uss ne kaha: Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap hamein Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke paas bhej dijiye. Aap ne farmaya: Bohat achha, un ke paas chale jao. Jab yahan aaye toh jis ke muwafiq faisla hua tha uss ne sara hi waqea keh sunaya, Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne uss dusre se pucha: Kya yeh sach hai?

Us ne iqrar kiya, aap ne farmaya achha tum dono yahan thehro main aata hoon aur faisla kar deta hoon. Thodi der mein talwar taane aa gaye aur us shakhs ki jis ne kaha tha ke Hazrat hamein Umar (R.A) ke paas bhej dijiye, gardan uda di. Dusra shakhs yeh dekhte hi dauda bhaga Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas pahuncha aur kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mera saathi toh maar dala gaya aur agar main bhi jaan bacha kar bhaag kar na aata toh meri bhi khair na thi. Aap ne farmaya main Umar ko aisa nahin jaanta tha ke woh is jurrat ke saath ek momin ka khoon baha de ga. Is par yeh aayat utri aur us ka khoon barbad gaya aur Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko bari kar diya, lekin yeh tareeqa logon mein is ke baad bhi jaari na ho jaye is liye is ke baad hi yeh aayat utri (Wa lau anna katabna alaihim aniqtulu anfusakum awikhruju min diyarikum ma fa'alu hu illa qalilun minhum) (Surah An-Nisa: 66) jo aage aati hai (Ibn Abi Hatim). Ibn Marduyah mein bhi yeh riwayat hai jo ghareeb aur mursal hai aur Ibn Lahi'ah rawi za'eef hai, Wallahu A'lam. Dusri sanad se marwi hai do shakhs Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas apna jhagda laye, aap ne haq wale ke haq mein decree de di lekin jis ke khilaf hua tha us ne kaha main raazi nahin hoon. Aap ne poocha toh kya chahta hai? Kaha yeh ke Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) ke paas chalein. Dono wahan pahunche, jab yeh waqea Janab-e-Siddiq (R.A) ne suna toh farmaya tumhara faisla wahi hai jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kiya. Woh ab bhi khush na hua aur kaha Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke paas chalo, wahan gaye phir woh hua jo aap ne oopar padha (Tafsir-e-Hafiz Abu Ishaq).

Aadat jab fitrat-e-saniya ban jaye aur sahib-e-iman ko basharat-e-rafaqat-e-Allah khabar deta hai ke aksar log aise hain ke agar unhein in mana karda kamon ka bhi hukum diya jata jinhein woh is waqt kar rahe hain to woh in kamon ko bhi na karte is liye ke un ki zaleel tabiyatein hukum-e-Ilahi ki mukhalifat par hi ustawar hui hain, pas Allah Ta'ala ne is haqeeqat ki khabar di hai jo zahir nahin hui lekin hoti to kis tarah hoti? Is ayat ko sun kar ek buzurg ne farmaya tha ke agar Allah Ta'ala hamein yeh hukum deta to yaqeenan hum kar guzarte lekin is ka shukar hai ke us ne hamein is se bacha liya. Jab An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh baat pahunchi to aap ne farmaya beshak meri ummat mein aise aise log bhi hain jin ke dilon mein iman paharon se bhi zyada mazboot aur sabit hai. (Ibn Abi Hatim) Is riwayat ki dusri sanad mein hai ke kisi ek sahaba (Razi Allahu Anhum / R.A) ne yeh farmaya tha. Suddi ka qaul hai ke ek yahudi ne Hazrat Thabit bin Qais bin Shammas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se fakhriya kaha ke Allah Ta'ala ne hum par khud hamara qatl bhi farz kiya to bhi hum kar guzrein ge, is par Hazrat Thabit (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne farmaya wallah agar hum par yeh farz hota to hum bhi kar guzarte, is par yeh ayat utri aur riwayat mein hai ke jab yeh ayat utri to An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar yeh hukum hota to is ke baja lane walon mein ek Ibn-e-Umm-e-Abd (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) bhi hote hain. (Ibn Abi Hatim) Dusri riwayat mein hai ke aap ne is ayat ko parh kar Hazrat Abdullah bin Rawaha (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ki taraf hath se ishara kar ke farmaya ke yeh bhi is par amal karne walon mein se ek hain. Irshad-e-Ilahi hai ke agar yeh log hamare ahkam baja late aur hamari mana karda cheezon aur kamon se ruk jate to yeh un ke haq mein is se behtar hota ke aur duniya aur akhirat ki behtar rah ki rehnumai karte, phir farmata hai aur jo shakhs Allah aur Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ahkam par amal kare aur mana karda kamon se baz rahe use Allah Ta'ala izzat ke ghar mein le jaye ga, nabiyon ka rafeeq banaye ga aur siddiqon ko jo martabe mein nabiyon ke baad hain un ka musahib banaye ga, shaheedon, mominon aur saleheen jin ka zahir batin aarasta hai un ka ham-jins banaye ga, khayal to karo yeh kaise pakeeza aur behtareen rafeeq hain. Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai Hazrat Ayesha (Razi Allahu Anha / R.A) farmati hain main ne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna tha ke har nabi ko us ke marz ke zamane mein duniya mein rehne aur akhirat mein jane ka ikhtiyar diya jata hai, jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bimar hue to shiddat-e-naqahat se uth nahin sakte the, awaz baith gayi thi lekin main ne suna ke aap farma rahe hain un ka sath jin par Allah ne in'am kiya jo nabi hain, siddiq hain, shaheed hain, aur nekokar hain, yeh sun kar mujhe maloom ho gaya ke ab aap ko ikhtiyar diya gaya hai. Yehi matlab hai jo dusri hadith mein aap ke yeh alfaz warid hue hain ke Aye Allah main buland-o-bala rafeeq ki rafaqat ka talib hoon, yeh kalma aap ne teen martaba apni zaban-e-mubarak se nikala phir faut ho gaye Alaihi Afdalus Salati wat Tasleem.

Is aayat ke shaan-e-nuzool ka bayan Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke ek Ansari Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye, aap ne dekha ke sakht maghmoom hain, sabab daryaft kiya to jawab mila ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yahan to subh-o-sham hum log aap ki khidmat mein aa baithte hain, deedar bhi ho jata hai aur do ghari sohbat bhi mayassar ho jati hai, lekin kal Roz-e-Qayamat ke din to aap Nabiyon ki aala majlis mein honge, hum to aap tak pahunch bhi na sakenge. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kuch jawab na diya, is par Huzoor Jibraeel (A.S) yeh aayat laye, Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aadmi bhej kar unhein yeh khushkhabri suna di. Yehi asar mursal sanad bhi marwi hai jo sanad bahut hi achi hai. Hazrat Rabee (R.H) farmate hain Sahaba-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kaha ke yeh zahir hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka darja aap par imaan lane walon se yaqeenan bahut hi bada hai, pas jab ke Jannat mein yeh sab jama honge to aapas mein ek dusre ko kaise dekhenge aur kaise milenge? Pas yeh aayat utri aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya upar ke darje wale neeche walon ke paas utar aayenge aur pur-bahar baghon mein sab jama honge aur Allah ke ehsanat ka zikr aur us ki tareefein karenge aur jo chahenge payenge, naaz-o-nayam se har waqt rahenge. Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai ek shakhs Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye aur kehne lage Ya Rasool Allah! Main aap ko apni jaan se, apne ahl-e-ayal se aur apne bachon se bhi zyada mehboob rakhta hoon. Main ghar mein hota hoon lekin shauq-e-ziyarat mujhe be-qarar kar deta hai, sabr nahin ho sakta, daurta bhagta aata hoon aur deedar kar ke chala jata hoon, lekin jab mujhe aap ki aur apni maut yaad aati hai aur is ka yaqeen hai ke aap Jannat mein Nabiyon ke sab se bade unche darje mein honge to darr lagta hai ke phir main Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke deedar se mehroom ho jaunga, aap ne to koi jawab nahin diya lekin yeh aayat nazil hui. Is riwayat ke aur bhi tareeqe hain. Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai Rabee'ah bin Ka'ab Aslami (R.A) farmate hain main raat ko Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein rehta aur pani waghera la diya karta tha, ek baar aap ne mujh se farmaya kuch maang le, main ne kaha Jannat mein main aap ki rafaqat ka talib hoon, farmaya is ke siwa aur kuch? Main ne kaha woh bhi yehi, farmaya meri rafaqat ke liye meri madad kar, ba-kasrat sajde kiya kar. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ek shakhs ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha main Allah ke la-shareek hone ki aur aap ke Rasool hone ki gawahi deta hoon aur Ramzan ke rozey rakhta hoon, to aap ne farmaya jo marte dam tak isi par rahega woh Qayamat ke din Nabiyon, Siddiqon aur Shaheedon ke sath is tarah hoga, phir aap ne apni do ungliyan utha kar ishara kar ke bataya.

Lekin yeh shart hai ke maa baap ka nafarman na ho. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai jis ne Allah ki raah mein ek hazaar aayatein parhin woh Insha'Allah Qayamat ke din nabiyon, siddiqon, shaheedon aur salehon ke saath likha jayega. Tirmidhi mein hai saccha amaanat-daar tajir nabiyon, siddiqon aur shaheedon ke saath hoga. In sab se zyada zabardast basharat is hadith mein hai jo Sahah aur Masaneed waghera mein Sahaba-e-Kiram Razi Allahu Anhum Ajma'een ki ek zabardast jamaat se batwatar marwi hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se us shakhs ke baare mein daryaft kiya gaya jo ek qoum se mohabbat rakhta hai lekin us se mila nahin, toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: (Al-Mar'u ma'a man ahabba) har insaan us ke saath hoga jis se woh mohabbat rakhta tha. Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain Wallah meri mohabbat toh Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se hai, Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) se hai aur Hazrat Umar (R.A) se hai toh mujhe umeed hai ke Allah mujhe bhi inhi ke saath uthayega go mere aamaal in jaise nahin. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Jannati log apne se buland darja wale jannatiyon ko un ke bala-khanon mein is tarah dekhenge jaise tum chamakte sitare ko mashriq ya maghrib mein dekhte ho, un mein bahut kuch faasla hoga. Sahaba (R.A) ne kaha yeh manzilein toh Anbiya-e-Kiram ke liye hi makhsoos hongi? Kyun aur wahan tak kaise pahunch sakta hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya kyun nahin, us ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai, in manzilon tak woh bhi pahunchenge jo Allah par imaan laye, Rasoolon ko saccha jaana aur maana (Bukhari, Muslim). Ek Habshi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hota hai, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo puchna ho pucho aur samjho. Woh kehta hai Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap ko surat mein, rang mein, nabuwwat mein Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne hum par fazeelat de rakhi hai, agar main bhi us cheez par imaan laoon jis par aap imaan laye hain aur un ahkaam ko baja laoon jinhein aap baja la rahe hain toh kya Jannat mein aap ka saath milega? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan, us Allah Ta'ala ki qasam jis ke haath jagmagata hua nazar aayega. La ilaha illallah kehne wale se Allah ka waada hai aur SubhanAllah-e-wa-bihamdihi kehne wale ke liye ek laakh chaubees hazaar nekiyan likhi jaati hain. Is par ek aur sahib ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab yeh haqaiq hain toh phir hum kaise halak ho sakte hain? Yehi matlab hai jo dusri hadith mein aap ke yeh alfaz warid hue hain ke Aye Allah main buland-o-bala rafeeq ki rafaqat ka talib hoon, yeh kalma aap ne teen martaba apni zaban-e-mubarak se nikala phir faut ho gaye Alaihi Afdalus Salati wat Tasleem.

Aadat jab fitrat-e-saniya ban jaye aur sahib-e-iman ko basharat-e-rafaqat-e-Allah khabar deta hai ke aksar log aise hain ke agar unhein in mana karda kamon ka bhi hukum diya jata jinhein woh is waqt kar rahe hain to woh in kamon ko bhi na karte is liye ke un ki zaleel tabiyatein hukum-e-Ilahi ki mukhalifat par hi ustawar hui hain, pas Allah Ta'ala ne is haqeeqat ki khabar di hai jo zahir nahin hui lekin hoti to kis tarah hoti? Is ayat ko sun kar ek buzurg ne farmaya tha ke agar Allah Ta'ala hamein yeh hukum deta to yaqeenan hum kar guzarte lekin is ka shukar hai ke us ne hamein is se bacha liya. Jab An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh baat pahunchi to aap ne farmaya beshak meri ummat mein aise aise log bhi hain jin ke dilon mein iman paharon se bhi zyada mazboot aur sabit hai. (Ibn Abi Hatim) Is riwayat ki dusri sanad mein hai ke kisi ek sahaba (Razi Allahu Anhum / R.A) ne yeh farmaya tha. Suddi ka qaul hai ke ek yahudi ne Hazrat Thabit bin Qais bin Shammas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se fakhriya kaha ke Allah Ta'ala ne hum par khud hamara qatl bhi farz kiya to bhi hum kar guzrein ge, is par Hazrat Thabit (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne farmaya wallah agar hum par yeh farz hota to hum bhi kar guzarte, is par yeh ayat utri aur riwayat mein hai ke jab yeh ayat utri to An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar yeh hukum hota to is ke baja lane walon mein ek Ibn-e-Umm-e-Abd (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) bhi hote hain. (Ibn Abi Hatim) Dusri riwayat mein hai ke aap ne is ayat ko parh kar Hazrat Abdullah bin Rawaha (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ki taraf hath se ishara kar ke farmaya ke yeh bhi is par amal karne walon mein se ek hain. Irshad-e-Ilahi hai ke agar yeh log hamare ahkam baja late aur hamari mana karda cheezon aur kamon se ruk jate to yeh un ke haq mein is se behtar hota ke aur duniya aur akhirat ki behtar rah ki rehnumai karte, phir farmata hai aur jo shakhs Allah aur Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ahkam par amal kare aur mana karda kamon se baz rahe use Allah Ta'ala izzat ke ghar mein le jaye ga, nabiyon ka rafeeq banaye ga aur siddiqon ko jo martabe mein nabiyon ke baad hain un ka musahib banaye ga, shaheedon, mominon aur saleheen jin ka zahir batin aarasta hai un ka ham-jins banaye ga, khayal to karo yeh kaise pakeeza aur behtareen rafeeq hain. Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai Hazrat Ayesha (Razi Allahu Anha / R.A) farmati hain main ne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna tha ke har nabi ko us ke marz ke zamane mein duniya mein rehne aur akhirat mein jane ka ikhtiyar diya jata hai, jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bimar hue to shiddat-e-naqahat se uth nahin sakte the, awaz baith gayi thi lekin main ne suna ke aap farma rahe hain un ka sath jin par Allah ne in'am kiya jo nabi hain, siddiq hain, shaheed hain, aur nekokar hain, yeh sun kar mujhe maloom ho gaya ke ab aap ko ikhtiyar diya gaya hai. Yehi matlab hai jo dusri hadith mein aap ke yeh alfaz warid hue hain ke Aye Allah main buland-o-bala rafeeq ki rafaqat ka talib hoon, yeh kalma aap ne teen martaba apni zaban-e-mubarak se nikala phir faut ho gaye Alaihi Afdalus Salati wat Tasleem.

Is aayat ke shaan-e-nuzool ka bayan Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke ek Ansari Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye, aap ne dekha ke sakht maghmoom hain, sabab daryaft kiya to jawab mila ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yahan to subh-o-sham hum log aap ki khidmat mein aa baithte hain, deedar bhi ho jata hai aur do ghari sohbat bhi mayassar ho jati hai, lekin kal Roz-e-Qayamat ke din to aap Nabiyon ki aala majlis mein honge, hum to aap tak pahunch bhi na sakenge. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kuch jawab na diya, is par Huzoor Jibraeel (A.S) yeh aayat laye, Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aadmi bhej kar unhein yeh khushkhabri suna di. Yehi asar mursal sanad bhi marwi hai jo sanad bahut hi achi hai. Hazrat Rabee (R.H) farmate hain Sahaba-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kaha ke yeh zahir hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka darja aap par imaan lane walon se yaqeenan bahut hi bada hai, pas jab ke Jannat mein yeh sab jama honge to aapas mein ek dusre ko kaise dekhenge aur kaise milenge? Pas yeh aayat utri aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya upar ke darje wale neeche walon ke paas utar aayenge aur pur-bahar baghon mein sab jama honge aur Allah ke ehsanat ka zikr aur us ki tareefein karenge aur jo chahenge payenge, naaz-o-nayam se har waqt rahenge. Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai ek shakhs Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye aur kehne lage Ya Rasool Allah! Main aap ko apni jaan se, apne ahl-e-ayal se aur apne bachon se bhi zyada mehboob rakhta hoon. Main ghar mein hota hoon lekin shauq-e-ziyarat mujhe be-qarar kar deta hai, sabr nahin ho sakta, daurta bhagta aata hoon aur deedar kar ke chala jata hoon, lekin jab mujhe aap ki aur apni maut yaad aati hai aur is ka yaqeen hai ke aap Jannat mein Nabiyon ke sab se bade unche darje mein honge to darr lagta hai ke phir main Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke deedar se mehroom ho jaunga, aap ne to koi jawab nahin diya lekin yeh aayat nazil hui. Is riwayat ke aur bhi tareeqe hain. Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai Rabee'ah bin Ka'ab Aslami (R.A) farmate hain main raat ko Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein rehta aur pani waghera la diya karta tha, ek baar aap ne mujh se farmaya kuch maang le, main ne kaha Jannat mein main aap ki rafaqat ka talib hoon, farmaya is ke siwa aur kuch? Main ne kaha woh bhi yehi, farmaya meri rafaqat ke liye meri madad kar, ba-kasrat sajde kiya kar. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ek shakhs ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha main Allah ke la-shareek hone ki aur aap ke Rasool hone ki gawahi deta hoon aur Ramzan ke rozey rakhta hoon, to aap ne farmaya jo marte dam tak isi par rahega woh Qayamat ke din Nabiyon, Siddiqon aur Shaheedon ke sath is tarah hoga, phir aap ne apni do ungliyan utha kar ishara kar ke bataya.

Lekin yeh shart hai ke maa baap ka nafarman na ho. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai jis ne Allah ki raah mein ek hazaar aayatein parhin woh Insha'Allah Qayamat ke din nabiyon, siddiqon, shaheedon aur salehon ke saath likha jayega. Tirmidhi mein hai saccha amaanat-daar tajir nabiyon, siddiqon aur shaheedon ke saath hoga. In sab se zyada zabardast basharat is hadith mein hai jo Sahah aur Masaneed waghera mein Sahaba-e-Kiram Razi Allahu Anhum Ajma'een ki ek zabardast jamaat se batwatar marwi hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se us shakhs ke baare mein daryaft kiya gaya jo ek qoum se mohabbat rakhta hai lekin us se mila nahin, toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: (Al-Mar'u ma'a man ahabba) har insaan us ke saath hoga jis se woh mohabbat rakhta tha. Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain musalman jis qadar is hadith se khush hue utna kisi aur cheez se khush nahin hue. Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain Wallah meri mohabbat toh Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se hai, Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) se hai aur Hazrat Umar (R.A) se hai toh mujhe umeed hai ke Allah mujhe bhi inhi ke saath uthayega go mere aamaal in jaise nahin. (Ya Allah tu hamare dilon ko bhi apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur un ke chahne walon ki mohabbat se bhar de aur hamara hashr bhi inhi ke saath kar de, Ameen). Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Jannati log apne se buland darja wale jannatiyon ko un ke bala-khanon mein is tarah dekhenge jaise tum chamakte sitare ko mashriq ya maghrib mein dekhte ho, un mein bahut kuch faasla hoga. Sahaba (R.A) ne kaha yeh manzilein toh Anbiya-e-Kiram ke liye hi makhsoos hongi? Kyun aur wahan tak kaise pahunch sakta hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya kyun nahin, us ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai, in manzilon tak woh bhi pahunchenge jo Allah par imaan laye, Rasoolon ko saccha jaana aur maana (Bukhari, Muslim). Ek Habshi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hota hai, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo puchna ho pucho aur samjho. Woh kehta hai Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap ko surat mein, rang mein, nabuwwat mein Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne hum par fazeelat de rakhi hai, agar main bhi us cheez par imaan laoon jis par aap imaan laye hain aur un ahkaam ko baja laoon jinhein aap baja la rahe hain toh kya Jannat mein aap ka saath milega? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan, us Allah Ta'ala ki qasam jis ke haath jagmagata hua nazar aayega. La ilaha illallah kehne wale se Allah ka waada hai aur SubhanAllah-e-wa-bihamdihi kehne wale ke liye ek laakh chaubees hazaar nekiyan likhi jaati hain. Is par ek aur sahib ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab yeh haqaiq hain toh phir hum kaise halak ho sakte hain? Toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ek insaan Qayamat ke din is qadar aamaal le kar aayega agar kisi pahad par rakhe jayen toh woh bhi bojh-hal hon lekin ek hi ne'mat jo...

ke muqabil khari hogi jo sirf us ki nematon ka shukriya ada karne ka natija hogi us ke samne mazkoora aamal kam nazar aayenge, mehez us ka shukriya mein hi yeh aamal kam nazar aayenge. Haan yeh aur baat hai ke Allah Ta'ala apni Rahmat-e-Kamilah se use dhank le aur Jannat de de aur yeh aayatein utrin (Hal ata alal insani heenun minad dahri lam yakun shai'an mazkoora se Wa iza ra'aita samma ra'aita na'eeman wa mulkan kabeera) (Surah Ad-Dahr: 1 ta 20) tak. To Habshi Sahabi (R.A) kehne lage ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) kya Jannat mein jin jin cheezon ko aap ki aankhein dekhengi meri aankhein bhi dekh sakengi? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya haan, is par woh Habshi fart-e-shauq mein roye aur is qadar roye ke isi halat mein faut ho gaye (R.A) wa arzah. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) farmate hain main ne dekha ke un ki na'ash-e-mubarak ko khud Rasool Allah (ﷺ) qabr mein utaar rahe thay. Yeh riwayat ghareeb hai aur is mein usooli khamiyan bhi hain, is ki sanad bhi za'eef hai. Irshad-e-Ilahi hai yeh khaas Allah ki inayat aur us ka fazl hai, us ki rahmat se hi yeh us ke qabil hue na ke apne aamal se, Allah khoob janne wala hai, isay bakhubi maloom hai ke mustahiq-e-hidayat-o-taufeeq kaun hai?

Taqatwar aur muttahid ho kar zinda raho. Allah Rabbul Izzat Musalmanon ko hukum deta hai ke woh har waqt apne bachao ke asbab tayyar rakhein, har waqt hathiyar band rahein taake dushman un par ba-asani kamyab na ho jaye. Zaroorat ke hathiyar tayyar rakhein, apni tadaad barhate rahein, quwwat mazboot karte rahein, munazzam mardana-war jihad ke liye ek awaz uth khade hon, chote chote lashkaron mein bat kar ya muttahid fauj ki surat mein jaisa mauqa ho, awaz sunte hi hoshiyar rahein. Ke munafiqeen ki khaslat hai ke khud bhi Allah Ta'ala ki rah se ji churayein aur dusron ko bhi buzdil banayein, jaise Abdullah bin Ubay bin Salool sardar-e-munafiqeen ka fe'l tha, Allah Ta'ala use ruswa kare. Uska kirdar yeh tha ke agar hikmat-e-Ilahiya se Musalmanon ko dushmanon ke muqable mein kamyabi na hoti, dushman un par chha jata, unhein nuqsan pahunchata, unke aadmi shaheed hote to yeh ghar baitha khushiyan manata aur apni danai par akarta aur apna is jihad mein shareek na hona apne haq mein Allah Ta'ala ka inaam qarar deta. Lekin be-khabar yeh nahin samajhta ke jo ajr-o-sawab un mujahideen ko mila us sab se yeh bad-naseeb yak-lakht mehroom raha. Agar yeh bhi un mein shamil hota to ya to ghazi ka darja pata, apne sabr ke sawab samet-ta ya shahadat ke buland martabe tak pahunch jata. Aur agar Musalman mujahideen ka Allah ka fazl muawin hota, yani yeh dushmanon par ghalib aa jate, unki fatah hoti, dushmanon ko unhon ne pamal kiya aur maal-e-ghaneemat, laundi, ghulam le kar khair-o-aafiyat, zafar aur nusrat ke sath laut-te to yeh angaron par lot-ta aur aise lambe lambe saans le kar haye-waye karta hai aur is tarah pachhtata hai aur aise kalmaat zaban se nikalta hai goya yeh deen tumhara nahin balkay iska deen hai aur kehta afsos main unke sath na hua warna mujhe bhi hissa milta aur main bhi laundi, ghulam, maal, mata' wala ban jata. Al-gharaz duniya par reejha hua aur isi par mita hua hai. Pas Allah ki rah mein nikal khade hone wale mominon ko chahiye ke un se jihad karein jo apne deen ko duniya ke badle farokht kar rahe hain, apne kufr aur adam-e-imaan ke ba'is apni aakhirat ko barbad kar ke duniya banate hain. Suno! Allah ki rah ka mujahid kabhi nuqsan nahin uthata, uske dono hathon mein laddu hain; qatl kiya gaya to ajr majood, ghalib raha to sawab hazir. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Allah ki rah ke mujahid ka zamin khud Allah Azzawajal hai, ya to isay faut kar ke jannat mein pahunchaye ga, jis jagah se woh chala hai wahin ajr-o-ghaneemat ke sath sahih salim wapas laye ga, falhamdulillah.

Agar yeh bhi un mein shamil hota to ya to ghazi ka darja pata, apne sabr ke sawab samet-ta ya shahadat ke buland martabe tak pahunch jata. Aur agar Musalman mujahideen ka Allah ka fazl muawin hota, yani yeh dushmanon par ghalib aa jate, unki fatah hoti, dushmanon ko unhon ne pamal kiya aur maal-e-ghaneemat, laundi, ghulam le kar khair-o-aafiyat, zafar aur nusrat ke sath laut-te to yeh angaron par lot-ta aur aise lambe lambe saans le kar haye-waye karta hai aur is tarah pachhtata hai aur aise kalmaat zaban se nikalta hai goya yeh deen tumhara nahin balkay iska deen hai aur kehta afsos main unke sath na hua warna mujhe bhi hissa milta aur main bhi laundi, ghulam, maal, mata' wala ban jata. Al-gharaz duniya par reejha hua aur isi par mita hua hai. Pas Allah ki rah mein nikal khade hone wale mominon ko chahiye ke un se jihad karein jo apne deen ko duniya ke badle farokht kar rahe hain, apne kufr aur adam-e-imaan ke ba'is apni aakhirat ko barbad kar ke duniya banate hain. Suno! Allah ki rah ka mujahid kabhi nuqsan nahin uthata, uske dono hathon mein laddu hain; qatl kiya gaya to ajr majood, ghalib raha to sawab hazir. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Allah ki rah ke mujahid ka zamin khud Allah Azzawajal hai, ya to isay faut kar ke jannat mein pahunchaye ga, jis jagah se woh chala hai wahin ajr-o-ghaneemat ke sath sahih salim wapas laye ga, falhamdulillah.

Shaitan ke doston se jang lazim hai. Allah Ta'ala mominon ko apni rah ke jihad ki raghbat dilata hai aur farmata hai ke woh kamzor bebas logon jo Makkah mein hain jin mein auratein aur bachay bhi hain jo wahan ke qayam se ukta gaye hain jin par kuffar nit nayi musibatein tor rahe hain. Jo mehez be-bal-o-par hain unhein azad karao, jo bekas duayein mang rahe hain ke isi basti yani Makkah se hamara nikalna mumkin ho, Makkah Sharif ko is ayat mein bhi qarya kaha gaya hai (Wa-ka-ayyin min qaryatin hiya ashaddu quwwatan min qaryatikal-lati akhrajatka ahlaknahum fala nasira lahum) (Surah Muhammad: 13). Bohat si bastiyan is basti se zyada taqatwar thin jis basti se (yani wahan ke rehne walon ne) tumhein nikala. Isi Makkah ke rehne wale musalman kafiron ke zulm ki shikayat bhi kar rahe hain aur sath hi apni duayon mein keh rahe hain ke aye Rab kisi ko apni taraf se hamara wali aur madadgar bana kar hamari imdad ko bhej. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A inhi kamzaron mein thay aur riwayat mein hai ke aap ne (Illal-mustad'afina minar-rijali wannisa-i wal-wildani la yastati'una hilatan wala yahtaduna sabila) (Surah An-Nisa: 98) parh kar farmaya main aur meri walida sahiba bhi inhi logon mein se hain jinhein Allah Ta'ala ne mazoor rakha. Irshad hai imandar Allah Ta'ala ki farmanbardari aur uski raza joi ke liye jihad karte hain aur kuffar ita'at-e-Shaitan mein larte hain to musalmanon ko chahiye ke Shaitan ke doston se jo Allah ke dushman hain dil khol kar jang karein aur yaqeen manein ke Shaitan ke hathkanday aur uske makr-o-fareb sab naqsh-bar-ab hain.

Isi Makkah ke rehne wale musalman kafiron ke zulm ki shikayat bhi kar rahe hain aur sath hi apni duayon mein keh rahe hain ke aye Rab kisi ko apni taraf se hamara wali aur madadgar bana kar hamari imdad ko bhej.
