Awwaleen dars-e-sabr-o-zabt ka waqia bayan ho raha hai ke ibtida-e-Islam mein jab Makkah Sharif mein thay, kamzor thay, hurmat walay shehar mein thay, kuffar ka ghalba tha, yeh unhi ke shehar mein thay, woh bakasrat thay, jangi asbab mein har tarah fauqiyat rakhtay thay, is liye us waqt Allah Ta'ala ne musalmanon ko jihad-o-qital ka hukum nahin diya tha, balkay un se farmaya tha ke kafiron ki izayein sehtay chalay jayen, un ki mukhalifat bardasht karein, un ke zulm-o-sitam bardasht karein, jo ahkam-e-Allah nazil ho chukay hain un par amil rahein, namaz ada kartay rahein, zakat detay raha karein, go un mein umooman maal ki ziyadati bhi na thi lekin taham maskeenon aur mohtajon ke kaam aanay ka aur un ki hamdardi karnay ka unhein hukum diya gaya tha. Maslahat-e-Ilahi ka taqaza yeh tha ke sardast yeh kuffar se na ladein balkay sabr-o-zabt se kaam lein. Udhar kuffar bari daleri se un par sitam ke pahar tor rahe thay, har chotay baray ko sakht se sakht sazayein de rahe thay, musalmanon ka naak mein dam kar rakha tha, is liye un ke dil mein reh reh kar josh uthta tha aur zaban se alfaz nikal jatay thay ke is roz-marra ki museebaton se toh yahi behtar hai ke ek martaba dil ki bharas nikal jaye, do do haath maidan mein ho lein, kaash ke Allah Ta'ala hamein jihad ka hukum de de, lekin ab tak hukum nahin mila tha. Jab unhein hijrat ki ijazat mili aur musalman apni zameen, zar, rishta, kunbay, Allah Azza-wa-Jal ke naam par qurban kar ke apna deen le kar Makkah se hijrat kar ke Madine pohanchay, yahan unhein Allah Ta'ala ne har tarah ki sahulat di, aman ki jagah di, imdad ke liye Ansar-e-Madina diye, tadaad mein kasrat ho gayi, quwwat-o-taqat qadray barh gayi toh ab Allah Hakim-e-Mutlaq ki taraf se ijazat mili ke apne larnay walon se laro. Jihad ka hukum utartay hi baaz log sat-pataye, khauf-zada huye, jihad ka tasawwur kar ke maidan mein qatl kiye janay ka tasawwur, aurton ke randapay ka khayal, bachon ki yateemi ka manzar aankhon ke samnay aa gaya, ghabrahat mein keh uthay ke aye Allah abhi se jihad kyun farz kar diya, kuch toh mohlat di hoti. Isi mazmoon ko dusri aayaton mein is tarah bayan kiya gaya hai: (Wa yaqoolul-lazeena aamano lau la nuzzilat sooratun, fa iza unzilat sooratun muhkamatun wa zukira feehal qital) (Surah Muhammad: 20). Mukhtasar matlab yeh hai ke imandar kehtay hain koi soorat kyun nazil nahin ki jati, jab koi soorat utari jati hai aur us mein jihad ka zikr hota hai toh beemar dil log cheekh uthtay hain, terhay tewaron se tujhay ghoortay hain aur maut ki ghashi walon ki tarah apni aankhein band kar letay hain, in par afsos hai. Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Auf (R.A) aur aap ke sathi Makkah Sharif mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aatay hain aur kehtay hain, aye Nabi-e-Allah! Hum kufr ki halat mein (musalmanon ko) mana kartay hain jin se kuffar ki jurrat barh gayi hai aur woh hamein zaleel karnay lagay hain, toh aap hamein muqabla ki ijazat kyun nahin detay? Lekin aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jawab diya, mujhe Allah ka hukum yahi hai ke hum darguzar karein, kafiron se jang na karein.

Phir jab Madina ki taraf hijrat hui aur Jihad ke ahkaam nazil hue toh log hichkichane lage, is par yeh aayat utri (Nasa'i, Hakim, Ibn Marduyah). Suddi R.H farmate hain, sirf Salat-o-Zakat ka hukum hi tha toh tamannayein karte the ke Jihad farz ho, jab fareeza-e-Jihad nazil hua toh kamzor dil log insaanon se darne lage jaise Allah se darna chahiye balkeh us se bhi zyada, kehne lage, "Aye Rab! Tu ne hum par Jihad kyun farz kiya? Kyun hamein apni maut ke sahi waqt tak faida na uthane diya?" Inhein jawab milta hai ke dunyawi nafa bilkul na-paidaar aur bahut hi kam hai, haan muttaqiyon ke liye aakhirat duniya se behtar aur pakeeza-tar hai. Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain yeh aayat Yahudiyon ke bare mein utri hai, jawaban kaha gaya ke parhezgaron ka anjaam aaghaz se bahut hi achha hai. Tumhein tumhare aamaal poore poore diye jayenge, kaamil ajar milega, ek bhi nek amal gharat na kiya jayega, namumkin hai ke ek baal barabar zulm Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se kisi par kiya jaye. Is jumle mein inhein duniya se be-raghbati dilayi ja rahi hai, aakhirat ki taraf tawajjah dilayi ja rahi hai, Jihad ki raghbat di ja rahi hai. Hazrat Hasan R.H farmate hain, Allah us bande par raham kare jo duniya ke sath aisa hi rahe, saari duniya awwal se aakhirat tak is tarah hai jaise koi soya hua shakhs apne khwab mein apni pasandeeda cheez ko dekhe lekin aankh khulte hi maloom ho jata hai ke kuch na tha. Hazrat Abu Mushir R.H ka yeh kalaam kitna pyara hai: "Wala khairun fid-dunya liman lam yakun lahu minallahi fi daril muqami naseeb, fa'in ta'jabud-dunya rijalan fa'innaha mata'un qaleelun waz-zawalu qareeb." Ya'ni us shakhs ke liye duniya bhalai se yaksar khaali hai jise kal aakhirat ka koi hissa milne wala nahin. Go duniya ko dekh dekh kar baaz log reejh rahe hain lekin darasal yeh yunhi sa faida hai aur woh bhi jald fana ho jane wala. Phir irshad-e-Bari hai ke aakhirash maut ka maza har ek ko chakhna hi hai, koi zariya kisi ko is se bacha nahin sakta, jaise farman hai: (Kullu man 'alaiha faan) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 26), jitne yahan hain sab faani hain. Aur jagah irshad hai: (Kullu nafsin za'iqatul maut) (Surah Al-Imran: 185), har har jaandaar marne wala hai. Farmata hai: (Wa ma ja'alna libasharim min qablikal khuld) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 34), tujh se agle logon mein se bhi kisi ke liye hum ne hamesha ki zindagi muqarrar nahin ki. Maqsad yeh hai ke khwah Jihad kar le ya na kare, Zaat-e-Allah ke siwa maut ka maza toh ek na ek roz har kisi ko chakhna hi padega.

Har ek ka ek waqt muqarrar hai aur har ek ki maut ki jagah muayyan hai, Hazrat Khalid bin Waleed R.A is waqt jabke aap bistar-e-marg par hain farmate hain Allah ki qasam falan jagah falan jagah gharz beesiyon ladaiyon mein saikdon maarkon mein gaya sabit qadmi pamardi ke sath dalirana jihad kiye aao dekh lo mere jism ka koi uzw aisa na paoge jahan koi na koi nishan neze ya barche ya teer ya bhale ka talwar aur hathiyar ka na ho lekin chunke maidan-e-jang mein maut na likhi thi ab dekho apne bistare par apni maut ke panje se buland-o-bala mazboot aur mazboot qile aur mahal bhi bacha nahin sakte. Baaz ne kaha murad is se aasman ke burj hain, lekin yeh qaul zaeef hai sahih yahi hai ke murad mehfooz maqamat hain yani kitni hi hifazat maut se ki jaye. Lekin woh apne waqt se aage peeche nahin ho sakti. Zuhair ka sher hai ke maut se bhagne wala go zeena laga kar asbab-e-aasmani bhi jama karle to bhi use koi nafa nahin pahunch sakta, ek qaul hai mushayyada ba tashdeed musheeda baghair tashdeed ek hi maani mein hain aur baaz in dono mein farq ke qail hain kehte hain ke awwal ka maani mutawwal dusre ka maani muzayyan yani chune se. Ibn-e-Jareer aur Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein is mauqa par ek mutawwal qissa bazuban-e-Hazrat Mujahid marwi hai ke agle zamane mein ek aurat hamila thi jab use dard hone lage aur bachi tawallud hui to usne apne mulazim se kaha ke jao kahin se aag le aao woh bahar nikla to dekha ke darwaze par ek shakhs khada hai puchta hai ke kya hua ladki ya ladka? Usne kaha ladki hui hai kaha sun yeh ladki ek sau aadmiyon se zina karayegi phir uske han ab jo shakhs mulazim hai usi se iska nikah hoga aur ek makdi iski maut ka baais banegi. Yeh shakhs yahin se palat aaya aur aate hi ek tez chhuri le kar us ladki ke pet ko cheer dala aur use murda samajh kar wahan se bhag nikla uski maa ne yeh haal dekh kar apni bachi ke pet ko tanke diye aur ilaj-e-moalaja shuru kiya jis se uska zakhm bhar gaya ab ek zamana guzar gaya idhar yeh ladki bulughat ko pahunch gayi aur thi bhi achi shakal-o-surat ki bad-chalni mein pad gayi idhar mulazim samundar ke raste kahin chala gaya kaam kaaj shuru kiya aur bahut raqam paida ki kul maal sameet kar bahut muddat baad yeh phir isi apne gaon mein aa gaya ek budhiya aurat ko bula kar kaha ke main nikah karna chahta hoon gaon mein jo bahut khubsurat aurat ho us se mera nikah kara do, yeh aurat gayi aur chunke shehar bhar mein is ladki se zyada khush-shakal koi aurat na thi yahin paigham bheja, manzoor ho gaya, nikah bhi ho gaya aur wida ho kar yeh uske han aa bhi gayi dono miyan biwi mein bahut mohabbat ho gayi, ek din zikr-azkar mein is aurat ne us se pucha aap kaun hain kahan se aaye hain yahan kaise aa gaye?

Waghaira usne apna tamam majra bayan kardiya ke main yahan ek aurat ke han mulazim tha aur wahan se uski ladki ke sath yeh harkat karke bhag gaya tha ab itne barson ke baad yahan aaya hun to us ladki ne kaha jis ka pet cheer kar tum bhage thay main wahi hun yeh keh kar apne us zakhm ka nishan bhi use dikhaya tab to use yaqeen hogaya aur kehne laga jab tu wahi hai to ek baat teri nisbat mujhe aur bhi maloom hai woh yeh ke tu ek sau admiyon se mujh se pehle mil chuki hai usne kaha theek hai yeh kaam to mujh se hua hai lekin ginti yaad nahin. Usne kaha ke mujhe teri nisbat ek aur baat bhi maloom hai woh yeh ke teri maut ka sabab ek makdi banegi, khair chunke mujhe tujh se bahut zyada mohabbat hai main tere liye ek buland-o-bala pukhta aur aala mahal tameer kara deta hun isi mein tu reh taake wahan tak aise keede makode pahunch hi na sakein chunancha aisa hi mahal tayar hua aur yeh wahan rehne lagi, ek muddat ke baad ek roz dono miyan biwi baithe hue thay ke achanak chhat par ek makdi dikhayi di use dekhte hain us shakhs ne kaha dekho aaj yahan makdi dikhayi di aurat boli achha yeh meri jaan lewa hai? To main is ki jaan lungi ghulamon ko hukum diya ke ise zinda pakad kar mere samne lao naukar pakad kar le aaye usne zameen par rakh kar apne pair ke angoothe se ise mal dala uski jaan nikal gayi lekin is mein se peep ka ek aadh qatra uske angoothe ke nakhun aur gosht ke darmiyan ud kar chipak gaya is ka zehar chadha pair siyah padgaya aur isi mein aakhir mar gayi, Hazrat Usman R.A par jab baghi chadh daude to aap ne Ummat-e-Muhammad ﷺ ki khair khwahi aur unke ittefaq ki dua ke baad do sher padhe jin ka matlab bhi yahi hai ke maut ko taalne wali koi cheez aur koi heela koi quwwat aur koi chalaki nahin, Hazar ke badshah Satroon ko Kasra-e-Shapur Zul-Aknaf ne jis tarah qatl kiya woh waqea bhi hum yahan likhte hain, Ibn-e-Hisham mein hai jab Shapur Iraq mein tha to uske ilaqe par Satroon ne chadhayi ki thi uske badle mein jab usne chadhayi ki to yeh qila band hogaya do saal tak muhasra raha lekin qila fath na hosaka ek roz Satroon ki beti Nadheera apne baap ke qile ka gasht laga rahi thi achanak uski nazar Shapur par padh gayi yeh us waqt shahana pur-takalluf reshmi libas mein taj-e-shahi sar par rakhe hue tha Nadheera ke dil mein aaya ke is se meri shadi hojaye to kya hi achha ho?

Chunancha usne khufiya paigham bhejne shuru kiye aur wada hogaya ke agar yeh ladki is qila par Shahpur ka qabza kara de toh Shahpur is se nikah kar lega. Iska baap Satroon bada sharabi tha, uski sari raat nasha mein kat-ti thi. Uski ladki ne mauqa pa kar raat ko apne baap ko nasha mein madhosh dekh kar uske sarhane se qila ke darwaze ki kunjiyan chupke se nikal lein aur apne ek ba-aitamad ghulam ke hath Satroon tak pahuncha dein, jis se usne darwaza khol liya aur shehar mein qatl-e-aam karaya aur qabiz hogaya. Yeh bhi kaha gaya ke is qila mein ek jadoo tha, jab tak is tilism ko toda na jaye qila ka fath hona namumkin tha. Is ladki ne iske todne ka gur use bata diya ke ek chit-kabra kabootar le kar uske paon kisi bakira ke pehle haiz ke khoon se rang lo, phir us kabootar ko chhodo, woh ja kar qila ki deewar par baithe toh foran woh tilism toot jayega aur qila ka phatak khul jayega. Chunancha Shahpur ne yahi kiya aur qila fath kar ke Satroon ko qatl kar dala, tamam logon ko tegh kiya aur tamam shehar ko ujaad diya aur is ladki ko apne hamrah le gaya aur is se nikah kar liya. Ek raat jabke ladki Nadira apne bistare par leti hui thi, use neend na aa rahi thi, bilbila rahi thi aur be-chaini se karwatein badal rahi thi toh Shahpur ne poocha kya baat hai? Usne kaha mere bistar mein kuch hai jis se mujhe neend nahin aa rahi. Shama jalayi gayi, bistar tatola gaya toh gul-e-aas ki ek batti nikli. Shahpur is nazakat par hairan reh gaya ke ek itni chhoti si batti bistar mein hone par use neend nahin aayi? Poocha tere walid ke yahan tere liye kya hota tha? Usne kaha narm resham ka bistara tha, sirf bareek narm reshmi libas tha, sirf naliyon ka guda khaya karti thi aur sirf angoori khalis sharab piyti thi. Yeh intezam mere baap ne mere liye kar rakha tha. Yeh thi bhi aisi ke uski pindli ka guda tak bahar se nazar aata tha. In baton se Shahpur par ek aur rang chadh gaya aur usne kaha jis baap ne tujhe is tarah pala posa uske sath tune yeh sulook kiya ke mere hathon use qatl karaya, uske mulk ko takht-o-taraj karaya, phir mujhe tujh se kya umeed rakhni chahiye? Allah jaane mere sath tu kya kare? Usi waqt hukum diya ke iske sar ke baal ghode se bandh diye jayen aur ghode ko be-lagam chhod diya jaye. Chunancha yahi hua, ghoda badak kar bhaga, uchalne koodne laga aur uski tapon se zameen par pachadein khate hue uske jism ka choora choora hogaya.

Chunancha is waqia ko Arab shu'ara ne nazm bhi kiya hai. Is ke baad Allah Ta'ala farmate hain ke agar unhein khush-hali, phalwari, aulad-o-kheti hath lage to kehte hain yeh Allah ki taraf se hai aur agar qahat-sali pade, tang-rozi ho, maut hone ka yeh phal hai sahib-e-iman banne ka. Firauni bhi isi tarah buraiyon ko Hazrat Musa A.S aur musalmanon se mansoob bad-shuguni liya karte the, jaise ke Quran ne is ka zikr kiya hai. Ek ayat mein hai (Wa minan-nasi may-ya'budullaha 'ala harfin, fa-in asabahu khayrunit-ma'anna bihi, wa in asabathu fitnatun-inqalaba 'ala wajhihi, khasirad-dunya wal-akhirah, zalika huwal-khusranul-mubin) (Surah Al-Hajj: 11). Ya'ni ba'z log aise bhi hain jo ek kinare khade reh kar Allah ki ibadat karte hain, ya'ni agar bhalai mili to bachhein khul jati hain aur agar burai pahunche to ulte pairon palat jate hain. Yeh hain jo dono jahan mein barbad honge. Pas yahan bhi un munafiqon ki jo bazahir musalman hain aur dil ke khote hain, burai bayan ho rahi hai. Ke jahan kuch nuqsan hua aur behak gaye ke Islam lane ki wajah se hamein nuqsan hua. Suddi R.H farmate hain ke 'hasana' se murad yahan barishon ka hona, janwaron mein ziyadati hona, baal-bachay ba-kasrat hona, khush-hali mayassar aana waghera hai. Agar yeh hua to kehte ke yeh sab min janib-e-Allah hai aur agar is ke khilaf ho to is be-barkati ka ba'is Rasoolullah ﷺ ko batate aur kehte yeh sab teri wajah se hai, ya'ni hum ne apne badon ki rah chhod di aur is Nabi ﷺ ki tabedari ikhtiyar ki is liye is musibat mein phans gaye aur is bala mein giraftar hue. Pas Parwardigar un ke napak qaul aur is paleed aqeeday ki tardeed karte hue farmata hai ke sab kuch Allah ki taraf se hai, us ki qaza-o-qadar har bhale bure, fasiq-fajir, nek-bad, momin-kafir par jari hai, bhalai-burai sab us ki taraf se hai. Phir un ke is qaul ki jo mehez shak-o-shuba, kam-ilmi, be-waqoofi, jahalat aur zulm ki bina par hai, tardeed karte hue farmata hai ke unhein kya ho gaya hai? Baat samajhne ki qabiliyat bhi un se jati rahi. "Ek gharib hadith jo (Ayat: Kullun min 'indillah) ke mutaliq hai use bhi suniye". Bazzar mein hai hum Rasoolullah ﷺ ke sath baithe the ke kuch logon ke hamrah Hazrat Abu Bakr R.A aaye, un dono ki aawazein buland ho rahi thin aur Huzoor ﷺ ke qareeb aa kar dono sahib baith gaye to Huzoor ﷺ ne daryaft kiya ke buland aawaz guftagu kya ho rahi thi? Ek shakhs ne kaha Ya Rasoolullah ﷺ! Hazrat Abu Bakr R.A to keh rahe the? Hazrat Umar R.A ne kaha main keh raha tha ke dono batein Allah Jalla Shanuhu ki taraf se hain. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya yahi behas awwal-awwal Hazrat Jibraeel A.S aur Hazrat Mikaeel A.S wahi kehte the jo Abu Bakr R.A aur Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A tum keh rahe ho.

Pas aasman walon mein jab ikhtilaf hua toh zameen walon mein toh hona lazmi tha, aakhir Hazrat Israfil ki taraf faisla gaya aur unhon ne faisla kiya ke hasanat aur sayyat dono Allah mukhtar-e-kul ki taraf se hain, phir aap ne dono ki taraf mutawajja ho kar farmaya mera faisla suno aur yaad rakho agar Allah Ta'ala apni nafarmani ke amal ko na chahta toh Iblees ko paida hi na karta, lekin Sheikh-ul-Islam Imam Taqi-ud-Din Abu-ul-Abbas Hazrat Ibn-e-Taimiyah (R.H) farmate hain yeh hadith mauzoo hai aur tamam un muhaddiseen ka jo hadith ki parakh rakhte hain ittefaq hai ke yeh riwayat ghari hui hai. Phir Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se khitab farmate hain jis se murad umoom hai yani sab se hi khitab hai ke tumhein jo bhalai pahunchti hai woh Allah ka fazl, lutf, rahmat aur jo burai pahunchti hai woh khud tumhari taraf se tumhare aamal ka natija hai, jaise aur aayat mein hai (وَمَآ اَصَابَكُمْ مِّنْ مُّصِيْبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ اَيْدِيْكُمْ وَيَعْفُوْا عَنْ كَثِيْرٍ) (42-Ash-Shura: 30) yani jo museebat tumhein pahunchti hai, woh tumhare baaz aamal ki wajah se aur bhi toh Allah Ta'ala bahut si bad-aamaliyon se dar-guzar farmata rehta hai (مَآ اَصَابَكَ مِنْ حَسَنَةٍ فَمِنَ اللّٰهِ ۡ وَمَآ اَصَابَكَ مِنْ سَيِّئَةٍ فَمِنْ نَّفْسِكَ ۭوَاَرْسَلْنٰكَ للنَّاسِ رَسُوْلًا ۭ وَكَفٰى باللّٰهِ شَهِيْدًا) (4-An-Nisa: 79) mein Famin-nafsika se murad basabab-e-gunah hai yani shamat-e-aamal. An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se manqool hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jis shakhs ka zara sa jism kisi lakri se jal jaye ya uska qadam phisal jaye ya use zara si mehnat karni pare jis se paseena aa jaye toh woh bhi kisi na kisi gunah par hota hai aur abhi tak toh Allah Ta'ala jin gunahon se chashm-poshi farmata hai jinhein maaf kar deta hai woh bahut sare hain, is mursal hadith ka mazmoon ek muttasil hadith mein bhi hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain us ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai ke imandar ko ranj ya jo bhi takleef-o-mashaqqat pahunchti hai yahan tak ke jo kanta bhi lagta hai use Allah Ta'ala us ki khataon ka kaffara bana deta hai, Abu Saleh farmate hain matlab is aayat ka yeh hai ke jo burai tujhe pahunchti hai us ka ba'is tera gunah hai han use muqaddar karne wala Allah Ta'ala aap hai, Hazrat Mutarrif bin Abdullah farmate hain tum taqdeer ke bare mein kya jante ho?

Kya tumhein Surah Nisa ki yeh aayat kaafi nahin, phir is aayat ko parh kar farmate hain Allah Subhanahu ki qasam log Allah Subhanahu ki taraf sonp nahin diye gaye, unhein hukum diye gaye hain aur usi ki taraf woh laut-te hain. Yeh qaul bahut qawi aur mazboot hai, Qadriya aur Jabriya ki poori tardeed karta hai. Tafsir is behas ka mauzoo nahin. Phir farmata hai ke tera kaam ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) shariat ki tableegh karna hai, uski razamandi aur narazgi ke kaam ko, uske ahkaam aur uski muman'at ko logon tak pahuncha dena hai. Allah ki gawahi kaafi hai ke usne tujhe Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bana kar bheja hai, isi tarah ki gawahi is amr-e-ilahi par bhi kaafi hai ke tune tableegh kar di. Tere unke darmiyan jo ho raha hai, use bhi woh mushahida kar raha hai; yeh jis tarah kuffar-e-anaad aur takabbur tere saath baratte hain, use bhi woh dekh raha hai.

Awwaleen dars-e-sabr-o-zabt ka waqia bayan ho raha hai ke ibtida-e-Islam mein jab Makkah Sharif mein thay, kamzor thay, hurmat walay shehar mein thay, kuffar ka ghalba tha, yeh unhi ke shehar mein thay, woh bakasrat thay, jangi asbab mein har tarah fauqiyat rakhtay thay, is liye us waqt Allah Ta'ala ne musalmanon ko jihad-o-qital ka hukum nahin diya tha, balkay un se farmaya tha ke kafiron ki izayein sehtay chalay jayen, un ki mukhalifat bardasht karein, un ke zulm-o-sitam bardasht karein, jo ahkam-e-Allah nazil ho chukay hain un par amil rahein, namaz ada kartay rahein, zakat detay raha karein, go un mein umooman maal ki ziyadati bhi na thi lekin taham maskeenon aur mohtajon ke kaam aanay ka aur un ki hamdardi karnay ka unhein hukum diya gaya tha. Maslahat-e-Ilahi ka taqaza yeh tha ke sardast yeh kuffar se na ladein balkay sabr-o-zabt se kaam lein. Udhar kuffar bari daleri se un par sitam ke pahar tor rahe thay, har chotay baray ko sakht se sakht sazayein de rahe thay, musalmanon ka naak mein dam kar rakha tha, is liye un ke dil mein reh reh kar josh uthta tha aur zaban se alfaz nikal jatay thay ke is roz-marra ki museebaton se toh yahi behtar hai ke ek martaba dil ki bharas nikal jaye, do do haath maidan mein ho lein, kaash ke Allah Ta'ala hamein jihad ka hukum de de, lekin ab tak hukum nahin mila tha. Jab unhein hijrat ki ijazat mili aur musalman apni zameen, zar, rishta, kunbay, Allah Azza-wa-Jal ke naam par qurban kar ke apna deen le kar Makkah se hijrat kar ke Madine pohanchay, yahan unhein Allah Ta'ala ne har tarah ki sahulat di, aman ki jagah di, imdad ke liye Ansar-e-Madina diye, tadaad mein kasrat ho gayi, quwwat-o-taqat qadray barh gayi toh ab Allah Hakim-e-Mutlaq ki taraf se ijazat mili ke apne larnay walon se laro. Jihad ka hukum utartay hi baaz log sat-pataye, khauf-zada huye, jihad ka tasawwur kar ke maidan mein qatl kiye janay ka tasawwur, aurton ke randapay ka khayal, bachon ki yateemi ka manzar aankhon ke samnay aa gaya, ghabrahat mein keh uthay ke aye Allah abhi se jihad kyun farz kar diya, kuch toh mohlat di hoti. Isi mazmoon ko dusri aayaton mein is tarah bayan kiya gaya hai: (Wa yaqoolul-lazeena aamano lau la nuzzilat sooratun, fa iza unzilat sooratun muhkamatun wa zukira feehal qital) (Surah Muhammad: 20). Mukhtasar matlab yeh hai ke imandar kehtay hain koi soorat kyun nazil nahin ki jati, jab koi soorat utari jati hai aur us mein jihad ka zikr hota hai toh beemar dil log cheekh uthtay hain, terhay tewaron se tujhay ghoortay hain aur maut ki ghashi walon ki tarah apni aankhein band kar letay hain, in par afsos hai. Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Auf (R.A) aur aap ke sathi Makkah Sharif mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aatay hain aur kehtay hain, aye Nabi-e-Allah! Hum kufr ki halat mein (musalmanon ko) mana kartay hain jin se kuffar ki jurrat barh gayi hai aur woh hamein zaleel karnay lagay hain, toh aap hamein muqabla ki ijazat kyun nahin detay? Lekin aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jawab diya, mujhe Allah ka hukum yahi hai ke hum darguzar karein, kafiron se jang na karein.

Phir jab Madina ki taraf hijrat hui aur Jihad ke ahkaam nazil hue toh log hichkichane lage, is par yeh aayat utri (Nasa'i, Hakim, Ibn Marduyah). Suddi R.H farmate hain, sirf Salat-o-Zakat ka hukum hi tha toh tamannayein karte the ke Jihad farz ho, jab fareeza-e-Jihad nazil hua toh kamzor dil log insaanon se darne lage jaise Allah se darna chahiye balkeh us se bhi zyada, kehne lage, "Aye Rab! Tu ne hum par Jihad kyun farz kiya? Kyun hamein apni maut ke sahi waqt tak faida na uthane diya?" Inhein jawab milta hai ke dunyawi nafa bilkul na-paidaar aur bahut hi kam hai, haan muttaqiyon ke liye aakhirat duniya se behtar aur pakeeza-tar hai. Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain yeh aayat Yahudiyon ke bare mein utri hai, jawaban kaha gaya ke parhezgaron ka anjaam aaghaz se bahut hi achha hai. Tumhein tumhare aamaal poore poore diye jayenge, kaamil ajar milega, ek bhi nek amal gharat na kiya jayega, namumkin hai ke ek baal barabar zulm Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se kisi par kiya jaye. Is jumle mein inhein duniya se be-raghbati dilayi ja rahi hai, aakhirat ki taraf tawajjah dilayi ja rahi hai, Jihad ki raghbat di ja rahi hai. Hazrat Hasan R.H farmate hain, Allah us bande par raham kare jo duniya ke sath aisa hi rahe, saari duniya awwal se aakhirat tak is tarah hai jaise koi soya hua shakhs apne khwab mein apni pasandeeda cheez ko dekhe lekin aankh khulte hi maloom ho jata hai ke kuch na tha. Hazrat Abu Mushir R.H ka yeh kalaam kitna pyara hai: "Wala khairun fid-dunya liman lam yakun lahu minallahi fi daril muqami naseeb, fa'in ta'jabud-dunya rijalan fa'innaha mata'un qaleelun waz-zawalu qareeb." Ya'ni us shakhs ke liye duniya bhalai se yaksar khaali hai jise kal aakhirat ka koi hissa milne wala nahin. Go duniya ko dekh dekh kar baaz log reejh rahe hain lekin darasal yeh yunhi sa faida hai aur woh bhi jald fana ho jane wala. Phir irshad-e-Bari hai ke aakhirash maut ka maza har ek ko chakhna hi hai, koi zariya kisi ko is se bacha nahin sakta, jaise farman hai: (Kullu man 'alaiha faan) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 26), jitne yahan hain sab faani hain. Aur jagah irshad hai: (Kullu nafsin za'iqatul maut) (Surah Al-Imran: 185), har har jaandaar marne wala hai. Farmata hai: (Wa ma ja'alna libasharim min qablikal khuld) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 34), tujh se agle logon mein se bhi kisi ke liye hum ne hamesha ki zindagi muqarrar nahin ki. Maqsad yeh hai ke khwah Jihad kar le ya na kare, Zaat-e-Allah ke siwa maut ka maza toh ek na ek roz har kisi ko chakhna hi padega.

Har ek ka ek waqt muqarrar hai aur har ek ki maut ki jagah muayyan hai, Hazrat Khalid bin Waleed R.A is waqt jabke aap bistar-e-marg par hain farmate hain Allah ki qasam falan jagah falan jagah gharz beesiyon ladaiyon mein saikdon maarkon mein gaya sabit qadmi pamardi ke sath dalirana jihad kiye aao dekh lo mere jism ka koi uzw aisa na paoge jahan koi na koi nishan neze ya barche ya teer ya bhale ka talwar aur hathiyar ka na ho lekin chunke maidan-e-jang mein maut na likhi thi ab dekho apne bistare par apni maut ke panje se buland-o-bala mazboot aur mazboot qile aur mahal bhi bacha nahin sakte. Baaz ne kaha murad is se aasman ke burj hain, lekin yeh qaul zaeef hai sahih yahi hai ke murad mehfooz maqamat hain yani kitni hi hifazat maut se ki jaye. Lekin woh apne waqt se aage peeche nahin ho sakti. Zuhair ka sher hai ke maut se bhagne wala go zeena laga kar asbab-e-aasmani bhi jama karle to bhi use koi nafa nahin pahunch sakta, ek qaul hai mushayyada ba tashdeed musheeda baghair tashdeed ek hi maani mein hain aur baaz in dono mein farq ke qail hain kehte hain ke awwal ka maani mutawwal dusre ka maani muzayyan yani chune se. Ibn-e-Jareer aur Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein is mauqa par ek mutawwal qissa bazuban-e-Hazrat Mujahid marwi hai ke agle zamane mein ek aurat hamila thi jab use dard hone lage aur bachi tawallud hui to usne apne mulazim se kaha ke jao kahin se aag le aao woh bahar nikla to dekha ke darwaze par ek shakhs khada hai puchta hai ke kya hua ladki ya ladka? Usne kaha ladki hui hai kaha sun yeh ladki ek sau aadmiyon se zina karayegi phir uske han ab jo shakhs mulazim hai usi se iska nikah hoga aur ek makdi iski maut ka baais banegi. Yeh shakhs yahin se palat aaya aur aate hi ek tez chhuri le kar us ladki ke pet ko cheer dala aur use murda samajh kar wahan se bhag nikla uski maa ne yeh haal dekh kar apni bachi ke pet ko tanke diye aur ilaj-e-moalaja shuru kiya jis se uska zakhm bhar gaya ab ek zamana guzar gaya idhar yeh ladki bulughat ko pahunch gayi aur thi bhi achi shakal-o-surat ki bad-chalni mein pad gayi idhar mulazim samundar ke raste kahin chala gaya kaam kaaj shuru kiya aur bahut raqam paida ki kul maal sameet kar bahut muddat baad yeh phir isi apne gaon mein aa gaya ek budhiya aurat ko bula kar kaha ke main nikah karna chahta hoon gaon mein jo bahut khubsurat aurat ho us se mera nikah kara do, yeh aurat gayi aur chunke shehar bhar mein is ladki se zyada khush-shakal koi aurat na thi yahin paigham bheja, manzoor ho gaya, nikah bhi ho gaya aur wida ho kar yeh uske han aa bhi gayi dono miyan biwi mein bahut mohabbat ho gayi, ek din zikr-azkar mein is aurat ne us se pucha aap kaun hain kahan se aaye hain yahan kaise aa gaye?

Waghaira usne apna tamam majra bayan kardiya ke main yahan ek aurat ke han mulazim tha aur wahan se uski ladki ke sath yeh harkat karke bhag gaya tha ab itne barson ke baad yahan aaya hun to us ladki ne kaha jis ka pet cheer kar tum bhage thay main wahi hun yeh keh kar apne us zakhm ka nishan bhi use dikhaya tab to use yaqeen hogaya aur kehne laga jab tu wahi hai to ek baat teri nisbat mujhe aur bhi maloom hai woh yeh ke tu ek sau admiyon se mujh se pehle mil chuki hai usne kaha theek hai yeh kaam to mujh se hua hai lekin ginti yaad nahin. Usne kaha ke mujhe teri nisbat ek aur baat bhi maloom hai woh yeh ke teri maut ka sabab ek makdi banegi, khair chunke mujhe tujh se bahut zyada mohabbat hai main tere liye ek buland-o-bala pukhta aur aala mahal tameer kara deta hun isi mein tu reh taake wahan tak aise keede makode pahunch hi na sakein chunancha aisa hi mahal tayar hua aur yeh wahan rehne lagi, ek muddat ke baad ek roz dono miyan biwi baithe hue thay ke achanak chhat par ek makdi dikhayi di use dekhte hain us shakhs ne kaha dekho aaj yahan makdi dikhayi di aurat boli achha yeh meri jaan lewa hai? To main is ki jaan lungi ghulamon ko hukum diya ke ise zinda pakad kar mere samne lao naukar pakad kar le aaye usne zameen par rakh kar apne pair ke angoothe se ise mal dala uski jaan nikal gayi lekin is mein se peep ka ek aadh qatra uske angoothe ke nakhun aur gosht ke darmiyan ud kar chipak gaya is ka zehar chadha pair siyah padgaya aur isi mein aakhir mar gayi, Hazrat Usman R.A par jab baghi chadh daude to aap ne Ummat-e-Muhammad ﷺ ki khair khwahi aur unke ittefaq ki dua ke baad do sher padhe jin ka matlab bhi yahi hai ke maut ko taalne wali koi cheez aur koi heela koi quwwat aur koi chalaki nahin, Hazar ke badshah Satroon ko Kasra-e-Shapur Zul-Aknaf ne jis tarah qatl kiya woh waqea bhi hum yahan likhte hain, Ibn-e-Hisham mein hai jab Shapur Iraq mein tha to uske ilaqe par Satroon ne chadhayi ki thi uske badle mein jab usne chadhayi ki to yeh qila band hogaya do saal tak muhasra raha lekin qila fath na hosaka ek roz Satroon ki beti Nadheera apne baap ke qile ka gasht laga rahi thi achanak uski nazar Shapur par padh gayi yeh us waqt shahana pur-takalluf reshmi libas mein taj-e-shahi sar par rakhe hue tha Nadheera ke dil mein aaya ke is se meri shadi hojaye to kya hi achha ho?

Chunancha usne khufiya paigham bhejne shuru kiye aur wada hogaya ke agar yeh ladki is qila par Shahpur ka qabza kara de toh Shahpur is se nikah kar lega. Iska baap Satroon bada sharabi tha, uski sari raat nasha mein kat-ti thi. Uski ladki ne mauqa pa kar raat ko apne baap ko nasha mein madhosh dekh kar uske sarhane se qila ke darwaze ki kunjiyan chupke se nikal lein aur apne ek ba-aitamad ghulam ke hath Satroon tak pahuncha dein, jis se usne darwaza khol liya aur shehar mein qatl-e-aam karaya aur qabiz hogaya. Yeh bhi kaha gaya ke is qila mein ek jadoo tha, jab tak is tilism ko toda na jaye qila ka fath hona namumkin tha. Is ladki ne iske todne ka gur use bata diya ke ek chit-kabra kabootar le kar uske paon kisi bakira ke pehle haiz ke khoon se rang lo, phir us kabootar ko chhodo, woh ja kar qila ki deewar par baithe toh foran woh tilism toot jayega aur qila ka phatak khul jayega. Chunancha Shahpur ne yahi kiya aur qila fath kar ke Satroon ko qatl kar dala, tamam logon ko tegh kiya aur tamam shehar ko ujaad diya aur is ladki ko apne hamrah le gaya aur is se nikah kar liya. Ek raat jabke ladki Nadira apne bistare par leti hui thi, use neend na aa rahi thi, bilbila rahi thi aur be-chaini se karwatein badal rahi thi toh Shahpur ne poocha kya baat hai? Usne kaha mere bistar mein kuch hai jis se mujhe neend nahin aa rahi. Shama jalayi gayi, bistar tatola gaya toh gul-e-aas ki ek batti nikli. Shahpur is nazakat par hairan reh gaya ke ek itni chhoti si batti bistar mein hone par use neend nahin aayi? Poocha tere walid ke yahan tere liye kya hota tha? Usne kaha narm resham ka bistara tha, sirf bareek narm reshmi libas tha, sirf naliyon ka guda khaya karti thi aur sirf angoori khalis sharab piyti thi. Yeh intezam mere baap ne mere liye kar rakha tha. Yeh thi bhi aisi ke uski pindli ka guda tak bahar se nazar aata tha. In baton se Shahpur par ek aur rang chadh gaya aur usne kaha jis baap ne tujhe is tarah pala posa uske sath tune yeh sulook kiya ke mere hathon use qatl karaya, uske mulk ko takht-o-taraj karaya, phir mujhe tujh se kya umeed rakhni chahiye? Allah jaane mere sath tu kya kare? Usi waqt hukum diya ke iske sar ke baal ghode se bandh diye jayen aur ghode ko be-lagam chhod diya jaye. Chunancha yahi hua, ghoda badak kar bhaga, uchalne koodne laga aur uski tapon se zameen par pachadein khate hue uske jism ka choora choora hogaya.

Chunancha is waqia ko Arab shu'ara ne nazm bhi kiya hai. Is ke baad Allah Ta'ala farmate hain ke agar unhein khush-hali, phalwari, aulad-o-kheti hath lage to kehte hain yeh Allah ki taraf se hai aur agar qahat-sali pade, tang-rozi ho, maut hone ka yeh phal hai sahib-e-iman banne ka. Firauni bhi isi tarah buraiyon ko Hazrat Musa A.S aur musalmanon se mansoob bad-shuguni liya karte the, jaise ke Quran ne is ka zikr kiya hai. Ek ayat mein hai (Wa minan-nasi may-ya'budullaha 'ala harfin, fa-in asabahu khayrunit-ma'anna bihi, wa in asabathu fitnatun-inqalaba 'ala wajhihi, khasirad-dunya wal-akhirah, zalika huwal-khusranul-mubin) (Surah Al-Hajj: 11). Ya'ni ba'z log aise bhi hain jo ek kinare khade reh kar Allah ki ibadat karte hain, ya'ni agar bhalai mili to bachhein khul jati hain aur agar burai pahunche to ulte pairon palat jate hain. Yeh hain jo dono jahan mein barbad honge. Pas yahan bhi un munafiqon ki jo bazahir musalman hain aur dil ke khote hain, burai bayan ho rahi hai. Ke jahan kuch nuqsan hua aur behak gaye ke Islam lane ki wajah se hamein nuqsan hua. Suddi R.H farmate hain ke 'hasana' se murad yahan barishon ka hona, janwaron mein ziyadati hona, baal-bachay ba-kasrat hona, khush-hali mayassar aana waghera hai. Agar yeh hua to kehte ke yeh sab min janib-e-Allah hai aur agar is ke khilaf ho to is be-barkati ka ba'is Rasoolullah ﷺ ko batate aur kehte yeh sab teri wajah se hai, ya'ni hum ne apne badon ki rah chhod di aur is Nabi ﷺ ki tabedari ikhtiyar ki is liye is musibat mein phans gaye aur is bala mein giraftar hue. Pas Parwardigar un ke napak qaul aur is paleed aqeeday ki tardeed karte hue farmata hai ke sab kuch Allah ki taraf se hai, us ki qaza-o-qadar har bhale bure, fasiq-fajir, nek-bad, momin-kafir par jari hai, bhalai-burai sab us ki taraf se hai. Phir un ke is qaul ki jo mehez shak-o-shuba, kam-ilmi, be-waqoofi, jahalat aur zulm ki bina par hai, tardeed karte hue farmata hai ke unhein kya ho gaya hai? Baat samajhne ki qabiliyat bhi un se jati rahi. "Ek gharib hadith jo (Ayat: Kullun min 'indillah) ke mutaliq hai use bhi suniye". Bazzar mein hai hum Rasoolullah ﷺ ke sath baithe the ke kuch logon ke hamrah Hazrat Abu Bakr R.A aaye, un dono ki aawazein buland ho rahi thin aur Huzoor ﷺ ke qareeb aa kar dono sahib baith gaye to Huzoor ﷺ ne daryaft kiya ke buland aawaz guftagu kya ho rahi thi? Ek shakhs ne kaha Ya Rasoolullah ﷺ! Hazrat Abu Bakr R.A to keh rahe the? Hazrat Umar R.A ne kaha main keh raha tha ke dono batein Allah Jalla Shanuhu ki taraf se hain. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya yahi behas awwal-awwal Hazrat Jibraeel A.S aur Hazrat Mikaeel A.S wahi kehte the jo Abu Bakr R.A aur Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A tum keh rahe ho.

Pas aasman walon mein jab ikhtilaf hua toh zameen walon mein toh hona lazmi tha, aakhir Hazrat Israfil ki taraf faisla gaya aur unhon ne faisla kiya ke hasanat aur sayyat dono Allah mukhtar-e-kul ki taraf se hain, phir aap ne dono ki taraf mutawajja ho kar farmaya mera faisla suno aur yaad rakho agar Allah Ta'ala apni nafarmani ke amal ko na chahta toh Iblees ko paida hi na karta, lekin Sheikh-ul-Islam Imam Taqi-ud-Din Abu-ul-Abbas Hazrat Ibn-e-Taimiyah (R.H) farmate hain yeh hadith mauzoo hai aur tamam un muhaddiseen ka jo hadith ki parakh rakhte hain ittefaq hai ke yeh riwayat ghari hui hai. Phir Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se khitab farmate hain jis se murad umoom hai yani sab se hi khitab hai ke tumhein jo bhalai pahunchti hai woh Allah ka fazl, lutf, rahmat aur jo burai pahunchti hai woh khud tumhari taraf se tumhare aamal ka natija hai, jaise aur aayat mein hai (وَمَآ اَصَابَكُمْ مِّنْ مُّصِيْبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ اَيْدِيْكُمْ وَيَعْفُوْا عَنْ كَثِيْرٍ) (42-Ash-Shura: 30) yani jo museebat tumhein pahunchti hai, woh tumhare baaz aamal ki wajah se aur bhi toh Allah Ta'ala bahut si bad-aamaliyon se dar-guzar farmata rehta hai (مَآ اَصَابَكَ مِنْ حَسَنَةٍ فَمِنَ اللّٰهِ ۡ وَمَآ اَصَابَكَ مِنْ سَيِّئَةٍ فَمِنْ نَّفْسِكَ ۭوَاَرْسَلْنٰكَ للنَّاسِ رَسُوْلًا ۭ وَكَفٰى باللّٰهِ شَهِيْدًا) (4-An-Nisa: 79) mein Famin-nafsika se murad basabab-e-gunah hai yani shamat-e-aamal. An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se manqool hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jis shakhs ka zara sa jism kisi lakri se jal jaye ya uska qadam phisal jaye ya use zara si mehnat karni pare jis se paseena aa jaye toh woh bhi kisi na kisi gunah par hota hai aur abhi tak toh Allah Ta'ala jin gunahon se chashm-poshi farmata hai jinhein maaf kar deta hai woh bahut sare hain, is mursal hadith ka mazmoon ek muttasil hadith mein bhi hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain us ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai ke imandar ko ranj ya jo bhi takleef-o-mashaqqat pahunchti hai yahan tak ke jo kanta bhi lagta hai use Allah Ta'ala us ki khataon ka kaffara bana deta hai, Abu Saleh farmate hain matlab is aayat ka yeh hai ke jo burai tujhe pahunchti hai us ka ba'is tera gunah hai han use muqaddar karne wala Allah Ta'ala aap hai, Hazrat Mutarrif bin Abdullah farmate hain tum taqdeer ke bare mein kya jante ho?

Kya tumhein Surah Nisa ki yeh aayat kaafi nahin, phir is aayat ko parh kar farmate hain Allah Subhanahu ki qasam log Allah Subhanahu ki taraf sonp nahin diye gaye, unhein hukum diye gaye hain aur usi ki taraf woh laut-te hain. Yeh qaul bahut qawi aur mazboot hai, Qadriya aur Jabriya ki poori tardeed karta hai. Tafsir is behas ka mauzoo nahin. Phir farmata hai ke tera kaam ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) shariat ki tableegh karna hai, uski razamandi aur narazgi ke kaam ko, uske ahkaam aur uski muman'at ko logon tak pahuncha dena hai. Allah ki gawahi kaafi hai ke usne tujhe Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bana kar bheja hai, isi tarah ki gawahi is amr-e-ilahi par bhi kaafi hai ke tune tableegh kar di. Tere unke darmiyan jo ho raha hai, use bhi woh mushahida kar raha hai; yeh jis tarah kuffar-e-anaad aur takabbur tere saath baratte hain, use bhi woh dekh raha hai.

Awwaleen dars-e-sabr-o-zabt ka waqia bayan ho raha hai ke ibtida-e-Islam mein jab Makkah Sharif mein thay, kamzor thay, hurmat walay shehar mein thay, kuffar ka ghalba tha, yeh unhi ke shehar mein thay, woh bakasrat thay, jangi asbab mein har tarah fauqiyat rakhtay thay, is liye us waqt Allah Ta'ala ne musalmanon ko jihad-o-qital ka hukum nahin diya tha, balkay un se farmaya tha ke kafiron ki izayein sehtay chalay jayen, un ki mukhalifat bardasht karein, un ke zulm-o-sitam bardasht karein, jo ahkam-e-Allah nazil ho chukay hain un par amil rahein, namaz ada kartay rahein, zakat detay raha karein, go un mein umooman maal ki ziyadati bhi na thi lekin taham maskeenon aur mohtajon ke kaam aanay ka aur un ki hamdardi karnay ka unhein hukum diya gaya tha. Maslahat-e-Ilahi ka taqaza yeh tha ke sardast yeh kuffar se na ladein balkay sabr-o-zabt se kaam lein. Udhar kuffar bari daleri se un par sitam ke pahar tor rahe thay, har chotay baray ko sakht se sakht sazayein de rahe thay, musalmanon ka naak mein dam kar rakha tha, is liye un ke dil mein reh reh kar josh uthta tha aur zaban se alfaz nikal jatay thay ke is roz-marra ki museebaton se toh yahi behtar hai ke ek martaba dil ki bharas nikal jaye, do do haath maidan mein ho lein, kaash ke Allah Ta'ala hamein jihad ka hukum de de, lekin ab tak hukum nahin mila tha. Jab unhein hijrat ki ijazat mili aur musalman apni zameen, zar, rishta, kunbay, Allah Azza-wa-Jal ke naam par qurban kar ke apna deen le kar Makkah se hijrat kar ke Madine pohanchay, yahan unhein Allah Ta'ala ne har tarah ki sahulat di, aman ki jagah di, imdad ke liye Ansar-e-Madina diye, tadaad mein kasrat ho gayi, quwwat-o-taqat qadray barh gayi toh ab Allah Hakim-e-Mutlaq ki taraf se ijazat mili ke apne larnay walon se laro. Jihad ka hukum utartay hi baaz log sat-pataye, khauf-zada huye, jihad ka tasawwur kar ke maidan mein qatl kiye janay ka tasawwur, aurton ke randapay ka khayal, bachon ki yateemi ka manzar aankhon ke samnay aa gaya, ghabrahat mein keh uthay ke aye Allah abhi se jihad kyun farz kar diya, kuch toh mohlat di hoti. Isi mazmoon ko dusri aayaton mein is tarah bayan kiya gaya hai: (Wa yaqoolul-lazeena aamano lau la nuzzilat sooratun, fa iza unzilat sooratun muhkamatun wa zukira feehal qital) (Surah Muhammad: 20). Mukhtasar matlab yeh hai ke imandar kehtay hain koi soorat kyun nazil nahin ki jati, jab koi soorat utari jati hai aur us mein jihad ka zikr hota hai toh beemar dil log cheekh uthtay hain, terhay tewaron se tujhay ghoortay hain aur maut ki ghashi walon ki tarah apni aankhein band kar letay hain, in par afsos hai. Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Auf (R.A) aur aap ke sathi Makkah Sharif mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aatay hain aur kehtay hain, aye Nabi-e-Allah! Hum kufr ki halat mein (musalmanon ko) mana kartay hain jin se kuffar ki jurrat barh gayi hai aur woh hamein zaleel karnay lagay hain, toh aap hamein muqabla ki ijazat kyun nahin detay? Lekin aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jawab diya, mujhe Allah ka hukum yahi hai ke hum darguzar karein, kafiron se jang na karein.

Phir jab Madina ki taraf hijrat hui aur Jihad ke ahkaam nazil hue toh log hichkichane lage, is par yeh aayat utri (Nasa'i, Hakim, Ibn Marduyah). Suddi R.H farmate hain, sirf Salat-o-Zakat ka hukum hi tha toh tamannayein karte the ke Jihad farz ho, jab fareeza-e-Jihad nazil hua toh kamzor dil log insaanon se darne lage jaise Allah se darna chahiye balkeh us se bhi zyada, kehne lage, "Aye Rab! Tu ne hum par Jihad kyun farz kiya? Kyun hamein apni maut ke sahi waqt tak faida na uthane diya?" Inhein jawab milta hai ke dunyawi nafa bilkul na-paidaar aur bahut hi kam hai, haan muttaqiyon ke liye aakhirat duniya se behtar aur pakeeza-tar hai. Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain yeh aayat Yahudiyon ke bare mein utri hai, jawaban kaha gaya ke parhezgaron ka anjaam aaghaz se bahut hi achha hai. Tumhein tumhare aamaal poore poore diye jayenge, kaamil ajar milega, ek bhi nek amal gharat na kiya jayega, namumkin hai ke ek baal barabar zulm Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se kisi par kiya jaye. Is jumle mein inhein duniya se be-raghbati dilayi ja rahi hai, aakhirat ki taraf tawajjah dilayi ja rahi hai, Jihad ki raghbat di ja rahi hai. Hazrat Hasan R.H farmate hain, Allah us bande par raham kare jo duniya ke sath aisa hi rahe, saari duniya awwal se aakhirat tak is tarah hai jaise koi soya hua shakhs apne khwab mein apni pasandeeda cheez ko dekhe lekin aankh khulte hi maloom ho jata hai ke kuch na tha. Hazrat Abu Mushir R.H ka yeh kalaam kitna pyara hai: "Wala khairun fid-dunya liman lam yakun lahu minallahi fi daril muqami naseeb, fa'in ta'jabud-dunya rijalan fa'innaha mata'un qaleelun waz-zawalu qareeb." Ya'ni us shakhs ke liye duniya bhalai se yaksar khaali hai jise kal aakhirat ka koi hissa milne wala nahin. Go duniya ko dekh dekh kar baaz log reejh rahe hain lekin darasal yeh yunhi sa faida hai aur woh bhi jald fana ho jane wala. Phir irshad-e-Bari hai ke aakhirash maut ka maza har ek ko chakhna hi hai, koi zariya kisi ko is se bacha nahin sakta, jaise farman hai: (Kullu man 'alaiha faan) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 26), jitne yahan hain sab faani hain. Aur jagah irshad hai: (Kullu nafsin za'iqatul maut) (Surah Al-Imran: 185), har har jaandaar marne wala hai. Farmata hai: (Wa ma ja'alna libasharim min qablikal khuld) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 34), tujh se agle logon mein se bhi kisi ke liye hum ne hamesha ki zindagi muqarrar nahin ki. Maqsad yeh hai ke khwah Jihad kar le ya na kare, Zaat-e-Allah ke siwa maut ka maza toh ek na ek roz har kisi ko chakhna hi padega.

Har ek ka ek waqt muqarrar hai aur har ek ki maut ki jagah muayyan hai, Hazrat Khalid bin Waleed R.A is waqt jabke aap bistar-e-marg par hain farmate hain Allah ki qasam falan jagah falan jagah gharz beesiyon ladaiyon mein saikdon maarkon mein gaya sabit qadmi pamardi ke sath dalirana jihad kiye aao dekh lo mere jism ka koi uzw aisa na paoge jahan koi na koi nishan neze ya barche ya teer ya bhale ka talwar aur hathiyar ka na ho lekin chunke maidan-e-jang mein maut na likhi thi ab dekho apne bistare par apni maut ke panje se buland-o-bala mazboot aur mazboot qile aur mahal bhi bacha nahin sakte. Baaz ne kaha murad is se aasman ke burj hain, lekin yeh qaul zaeef hai sahih yahi hai ke murad mehfooz maqamat hain yani kitni hi hifazat maut se ki jaye. Lekin woh apne waqt se aage peeche nahin ho sakti. Zuhair ka sher hai ke maut se bhagne wala go zeena laga kar asbab-e-aasmani bhi jama karle to bhi use koi nafa nahin pahunch sakta, ek qaul hai mushayyada ba tashdeed musheeda baghair tashdeed ek hi maani mein hain aur baaz in dono mein farq ke qail hain kehte hain ke awwal ka maani mutawwal dusre ka maani muzayyan yani chune se. Ibn-e-Jareer aur Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein is mauqa par ek mutawwal qissa bazuban-e-Hazrat Mujahid marwi hai ke agle zamane mein ek aurat hamila thi jab use dard hone lage aur bachi tawallud hui to usne apne mulazim se kaha ke jao kahin se aag le aao woh bahar nikla to dekha ke darwaze par ek shakhs khada hai puchta hai ke kya hua ladki ya ladka? Usne kaha ladki hui hai kaha sun yeh ladki ek sau aadmiyon se zina karayegi phir uske han ab jo shakhs mulazim hai usi se iska nikah hoga aur ek makdi iski maut ka baais banegi. Yeh shakhs yahin se palat aaya aur aate hi ek tez chhuri le kar us ladki ke pet ko cheer dala aur use murda samajh kar wahan se bhag nikla uski maa ne yeh haal dekh kar apni bachi ke pet ko tanke diye aur ilaj-e-moalaja shuru kiya jis se uska zakhm bhar gaya ab ek zamana guzar gaya idhar yeh ladki bulughat ko pahunch gayi aur thi bhi achi shakal-o-surat ki bad-chalni mein pad gayi idhar mulazim samundar ke raste kahin chala gaya kaam kaaj shuru kiya aur bahut raqam paida ki kul maal sameet kar bahut muddat baad yeh phir isi apne gaon mein aa gaya ek budhiya aurat ko bula kar kaha ke main nikah karna chahta hoon gaon mein jo bahut khubsurat aurat ho us se mera nikah kara do, yeh aurat gayi aur chunke shehar bhar mein is ladki se zyada khush-shakal koi aurat na thi yahin paigham bheja, manzoor ho gaya, nikah bhi ho gaya aur wida ho kar yeh uske han aa bhi gayi dono miyan biwi mein bahut mohabbat ho gayi, ek din zikr-azkar mein is aurat ne us se pucha aap kaun hain kahan se aaye hain yahan kaise aa gaye?

Waghaira usne apna tamam majra bayan kardiya ke main yahan ek aurat ke han mulazim tha aur wahan se uski ladki ke sath yeh harkat karke bhag gaya tha ab itne barson ke baad yahan aaya hun to us ladki ne kaha jis ka pet cheer kar tum bhage thay main wahi hun yeh keh kar apne us zakhm ka nishan bhi use dikhaya tab to use yaqeen hogaya aur kehne laga jab tu wahi hai to ek baat teri nisbat mujhe aur bhi maloom hai woh yeh ke tu ek sau admiyon se mujh se pehle mil chuki hai usne kaha theek hai yeh kaam to mujh se hua hai lekin ginti yaad nahin. Usne kaha ke mujhe teri nisbat ek aur baat bhi maloom hai woh yeh ke teri maut ka sabab ek makdi banegi, khair chunke mujhe tujh se bahut zyada mohabbat hai main tere liye ek buland-o-bala pukhta aur aala mahal tameer kara deta hun isi mein tu reh taake wahan tak aise keede makode pahunch hi na sakein chunancha aisa hi mahal tayar hua aur yeh wahan rehne lagi, ek muddat ke baad ek roz dono miyan biwi baithe hue thay ke achanak chhat par ek makdi dikhayi di use dekhte hain us shakhs ne kaha dekho aaj yahan makdi dikhayi di aurat boli achha yeh meri jaan lewa hai? To main is ki jaan lungi ghulamon ko hukum diya ke ise zinda pakad kar mere samne lao naukar pakad kar le aaye usne zameen par rakh kar apne pair ke angoothe se ise mal dala uski jaan nikal gayi lekin is mein se peep ka ek aadh qatra uske angoothe ke nakhun aur gosht ke darmiyan ud kar chipak gaya is ka zehar chadha pair siyah padgaya aur isi mein aakhir mar gayi, Hazrat Usman R.A par jab baghi chadh daude to aap ne Ummat-e-Muhammad ﷺ ki khair khwahi aur unke ittefaq ki dua ke baad do sher padhe jin ka matlab bhi yahi hai ke maut ko taalne wali koi cheez aur koi heela koi quwwat aur koi chalaki nahin, Hazar ke badshah Satroon ko Kasra-e-Shapur Zul-Aknaf ne jis tarah qatl kiya woh waqea bhi hum yahan likhte hain, Ibn-e-Hisham mein hai jab Shapur Iraq mein tha to uske ilaqe par Satroon ne chadhayi ki thi uske badle mein jab usne chadhayi ki to yeh qila band hogaya do saal tak muhasra raha lekin qila fath na hosaka ek roz Satroon ki beti Nadheera apne baap ke qile ka gasht laga rahi thi achanak uski nazar Shapur par padh gayi yeh us waqt shahana pur-takalluf reshmi libas mein taj-e-shahi sar par rakhe hue tha Nadheera ke dil mein aaya ke is se meri shadi hojaye to kya hi achha ho?

Chunancha usne khufiya paigham bhejne shuru kiye aur wada hogaya ke agar yeh ladki is qila par Shahpur ka qabza kara de toh Shahpur is se nikah kar lega. Iska baap Satroon bada sharabi tha, uski sari raat nasha mein kat-ti thi. Uski ladki ne mauqa pa kar raat ko apne baap ko nasha mein madhosh dekh kar uske sarhane se qila ke darwaze ki kunjiyan chupke se nikal lein aur apne ek ba-aitamad ghulam ke hath Satroon tak pahuncha dein, jis se usne darwaza khol liya aur shehar mein qatl-e-aam karaya aur qabiz hogaya. Yeh bhi kaha gaya ke is qila mein ek jadoo tha, jab tak is tilism ko toda na jaye qila ka fath hona namumkin tha. Is ladki ne iske todne ka gur use bata diya ke ek chit-kabra kabootar le kar uske paon kisi bakira ke pehle haiz ke khoon se rang lo, phir us kabootar ko chhodo, woh ja kar qila ki deewar par baithe toh foran woh tilism toot jayega aur qila ka phatak khul jayega. Chunancha Shahpur ne yahi kiya aur qila fath kar ke Satroon ko qatl kar dala, tamam logon ko tegh kiya aur tamam shehar ko ujaad diya aur is ladki ko apne hamrah le gaya aur is se nikah kar liya. Ek raat jabke ladki Nadira apne bistare par leti hui thi, use neend na aa rahi thi, bilbila rahi thi aur be-chaini se karwatein badal rahi thi toh Shahpur ne poocha kya baat hai? Usne kaha mere bistar mein kuch hai jis se mujhe neend nahin aa rahi. Shama jalayi gayi, bistar tatola gaya toh gul-e-aas ki ek batti nikli. Shahpur is nazakat par hairan reh gaya ke ek itni chhoti si batti bistar mein hone par use neend nahin aayi? Poocha tere walid ke yahan tere liye kya hota tha? Usne kaha narm resham ka bistara tha, sirf bareek narm reshmi libas tha, sirf naliyon ka guda khaya karti thi aur sirf angoori khalis sharab piyti thi. Yeh intezam mere baap ne mere liye kar rakha tha. Yeh thi bhi aisi ke uski pindli ka guda tak bahar se nazar aata tha. In baton se Shahpur par ek aur rang chadh gaya aur usne kaha jis baap ne tujhe is tarah pala posa uske sath tune yeh sulook kiya ke mere hathon use qatl karaya, uske mulk ko takht-o-taraj karaya, phir mujhe tujh se kya umeed rakhni chahiye? Allah jaane mere sath tu kya kare? Usi waqt hukum diya ke iske sar ke baal ghode se bandh diye jayen aur ghode ko be-lagam chhod diya jaye. Chunancha yahi hua, ghoda badak kar bhaga, uchalne koodne laga aur uski tapon se zameen par pachadein khate hue uske jism ka choora choora hogaya.

Chunancha is waqia ko Arab shu'ara ne nazm bhi kiya hai. Is ke baad Allah Ta'ala farmate hain ke agar unhein khush-hali, phalwari, aulad-o-kheti hath lage to kehte hain yeh Allah ki taraf se hai aur agar qahat-sali pade, tang-rozi ho, maut hone ka yeh phal hai sahib-e-iman banne ka. Firauni bhi isi tarah buraiyon ko Hazrat Musa A.S aur musalmanon se mansoob bad-shuguni liya karte the, jaise ke Quran ne is ka zikr kiya hai. Ek ayat mein hai (Wa minan-nasi may-ya'budullaha 'ala harfin, fa-in asabahu khayrunit-ma'anna bihi, wa in asabathu fitnatun-inqalaba 'ala wajhihi, khasirad-dunya wal-akhirah, zalika huwal-khusranul-mubin) (Surah Al-Hajj: 11). Ya'ni ba'z log aise bhi hain jo ek kinare khade reh kar Allah ki ibadat karte hain, ya'ni agar bhalai mili to bachhein khul jati hain aur agar burai pahunche to ulte pairon palat jate hain. Yeh hain jo dono jahan mein barbad honge. Pas yahan bhi un munafiqon ki jo bazahir musalman hain aur dil ke khote hain, burai bayan ho rahi hai. Ke jahan kuch nuqsan hua aur behak gaye ke Islam lane ki wajah se hamein nuqsan hua. Suddi R.H farmate hain ke 'hasana' se murad yahan barishon ka hona, janwaron mein ziyadati hona, baal-bachay ba-kasrat hona, khush-hali mayassar aana waghera hai. Agar yeh hua to kehte ke yeh sab min janib-e-Allah hai aur agar is ke khilaf ho to is be-barkati ka ba'is Rasoolullah ﷺ ko batate aur kehte yeh sab teri wajah se hai, ya'ni hum ne apne badon ki rah chhod di aur is Nabi ﷺ ki tabedari ikhtiyar ki is liye is musibat mein phans gaye aur is bala mein giraftar hue. Pas Parwardigar un ke napak qaul aur is paleed aqeeday ki tardeed karte hue farmata hai ke sab kuch Allah ki taraf se hai, us ki qaza-o-qadar har bhale bure, fasiq-fajir, nek-bad, momin-kafir par jari hai, bhalai-burai sab us ki taraf se hai. Phir un ke is qaul ki jo mehez shak-o-shuba, kam-ilmi, be-waqoofi, jahalat aur zulm ki bina par hai, tardeed karte hue farmata hai ke unhein kya ho gaya hai? Baat samajhne ki qabiliyat bhi un se jati rahi. "Ek gharib hadith jo (Ayat: Kullun min 'indillah) ke mutaliq hai use bhi suniye". Bazzar mein hai hum Rasoolullah ﷺ ke sath baithe the ke kuch logon ke hamrah Hazrat Abu Bakr R.A aaye, un dono ki aawazein buland ho rahi thin aur Huzoor ﷺ ke qareeb aa kar dono sahib baith gaye to Huzoor ﷺ ne daryaft kiya ke buland aawaz guftagu kya ho rahi thi? Ek shakhs ne kaha Ya Rasoolullah ﷺ! Hazrat Abu Bakr R.A to keh rahe the? Hazrat Umar R.A ne kaha main keh raha tha ke dono batein Allah Jalla Shanuhu ki taraf se hain. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya yahi behas awwal-awwal Hazrat Jibraeel A.S aur Hazrat Mikaeel A.S wahi kehte the jo Abu Bakr R.A aur Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A tum keh rahe ho.

Pas aasman walon mein jab ikhtilaf hua toh zameen walon mein toh hona lazmi tha, aakhir Hazrat Israfil ki taraf faisla gaya aur unhon ne faisla kiya ke hasanat aur sayyat dono Allah mukhtar-e-kul ki taraf se hain, phir aap ne dono ki taraf mutawajja ho kar farmaya mera faisla suno aur yaad rakho agar Allah Ta'ala apni nafarmani ke amal ko na chahta toh Iblees ko paida hi na karta, lekin Sheikh-ul-Islam Imam Taqi-ud-Din Abu-ul-Abbas Hazrat Ibn-e-Taimiyah (R.H) farmate hain yeh hadith mauzoo hai aur tamam un muhaddiseen ka jo hadith ki parakh rakhte hain ittefaq hai ke yeh riwayat ghari hui hai. Phir Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se khitab farmate hain jis se murad umoom hai yani sab se hi khitab hai ke tumhein jo bhalai pahunchti hai woh Allah ka fazl, lutf, rahmat aur jo burai pahunchti hai woh khud tumhari taraf se tumhare aamal ka natija hai, jaise aur aayat mein hai (وَمَآ اَصَابَكُمْ مِّنْ مُّصِيْبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ اَيْدِيْكُمْ وَيَعْفُوْا عَنْ كَثِيْرٍ) (42-Ash-Shura: 30) yani jo museebat tumhein pahunchti hai, woh tumhare baaz aamal ki wajah se aur bhi toh Allah Ta'ala bahut si bad-aamaliyon se dar-guzar farmata rehta hai (مَآ اَصَابَكَ مِنْ حَسَنَةٍ فَمِنَ اللّٰهِ ۡ وَمَآ اَصَابَكَ مِنْ سَيِّئَةٍ فَمِنْ نَّفْسِكَ ۭوَاَرْسَلْنٰكَ للنَّاسِ رَسُوْلًا ۭ وَكَفٰى باللّٰهِ شَهِيْدًا) (4-An-Nisa: 79) mein Famin-nafsika se murad basabab-e-gunah hai yani shamat-e-aamal. An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se manqool hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jis shakhs ka zara sa jism kisi lakri se jal jaye ya uska qadam phisal jaye ya use zara si mehnat karni pare jis se paseena aa jaye toh woh bhi kisi na kisi gunah par hota hai aur abhi tak toh Allah Ta'ala jin gunahon se chashm-poshi farmata hai jinhein maaf kar deta hai woh bahut sare hain, is mursal hadith ka mazmoon ek muttasil hadith mein bhi hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain us ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai ke imandar ko ranj ya jo bhi takleef-o-mashaqqat pahunchti hai yahan tak ke jo kanta bhi lagta hai use Allah Ta'ala us ki khataon ka kaffara bana deta hai, Abu Saleh farmate hain matlab is aayat ka yeh hai ke jo burai tujhe pahunchti hai us ka ba'is tera gunah hai han use muqaddar karne wala Allah Ta'ala aap hai, Hazrat Mutarrif bin Abdullah farmate hain tum taqdeer ke bare mein kya jante ho?

Kya tumhein Surah Nisa ki yeh aayat kaafi nahin, phir is aayat ko parh kar farmate hain Allah Subhanahu ki qasam log Allah Subhanahu ki taraf sonp nahin diye gaye, unhein hukum diye gaye hain aur usi ki taraf woh laut-te hain. Yeh qaul bahut qawi aur mazboot hai, Qadriya aur Jabriya ki poori tardeed karta hai. Tafsir is behas ka mauzoo nahin. Phir farmata hai ke tera kaam ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) shariat ki tableegh karna hai, uski razamandi aur narazgi ke kaam ko, uske ahkaam aur uski muman'at ko logon tak pahuncha dena hai. Allah ki gawahi kaafi hai ke usne tujhe Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bana kar bheja hai, isi tarah ki gawahi is amr-e-ilahi par bhi kaafi hai ke tune tableegh kar di. Tere unke darmiyan jo ho raha hai, use bhi woh mushahida kar raha hai; yeh jis tarah kuffar-e-anaad aur takabbur tere saath baratte hain, use bhi woh dekh raha hai.

Zahir-o-batin Nabi-e-Akram (ﷺ) ka muti bana lo. Allah Ta'ala ka irshad hai ke mere bande aur Rasool Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ) ka tabe-dar sahi mayne mein mera hi itaat-guzar hai, aap ka nafarman mera nafarman hai, is liye ke aap apni taraf se kuch nahin kehte, jo farmate hain woh wahi hota hai jo meri taraf se wahi kiya jata hai. Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain ke meri manne wala Allah Ta'ala ki manne wala hai aur jis ne meri nafarmani ki us ne Allah ki baat na mani, jis ne amir ki itaat ki aur jis ne amir ki nafarmani ki us ne meri nafarmani ki, yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim mein sabit hai. Phir farmata hai jo bhi munh mod kar baith jaye to us ka gunah ae Nabi (ﷺ) aap par nahin, aap ka zimma to sirf pahuncha dena hai, jo nek naseeb honge maan lenge, nijat aur ajar hasil kar lenge, haan un ki nekiyon ka sawab aap ko bhi hoga kyunke darasal is rah ka rahbar, is neki ke muallim aap hi hain. Aur jo na mane na amal kare to nuqsan uthayega, badnaseeb hoga, apne bojh se aap marega, us ka gunah aap par nahin is liye ke aap ne samjhane bujhane aur rah-e-haq dikhane mein koi kasar utha nahin rakhi. Hadith mein hai Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ) ki itaat karne wala rushd-o-hidayat wala hai aur Allah aur Rasool (ﷺ) ka nafarman apne hi nafs ko zaroor nuqsan pahunchane wala hai. Phir munafiqon ka haal bayan ho raha hai ke zahiri taur par itaat ka iqrar karte hain, muwafiqat ka izhar karte hain lekin jahan nazron se door hue, apni jagah par pahunche to aise ho gaye goya in tilon mein tel hi na tha, jo kuch yahan kaha tha us ke bilkul bar-aks raton ko chup chup kar sazishain karne baith gaye, halankeh Allah Ta'ala in ki in posheeda chalakiyon aur chalon ko bakhoobi janta hai, us ke muqarrar karda zameen ke farishtay in ki sab kartooton aur in ki tamam baton ko us ke hukm se in ke nama-e-aamal mein likh rahe hain. Pas unhein danta ja raha hai ke yeh kya behooda harkat hai? Jis ne tumhein paida kiya hai us se tumhari koi baat chup sakti hai? Tum kyun zahir-o-batin yaksan nahin rakhte, zahir-o-batin ka janne wala tumhein tumhari is behooda harkat par saza dega. Ek aur aayat mein bhi munafiqon ki is khaslat ka bayan in alfaaz mein farmaya hai: (Wa yaqooloona amanna billahi wa bir-rasooli wa ata'na thumma yatawalla fareequm-minhum mim-ba'di zalika wa ma ula'ika bil-mu'mineen) (Surah An-Noor: 47). Phir apne Nabi (ﷺ) ko hukm deta hai ke aap in se darguzar kijiye, bardbari baratiye, in ki khata maaf kijiye, in ka haal in ke naam se dusron se na kahiye, in se bilkul be-khauf rahiye, Allah par bharosa kijiye, jo is par bharosa kare, jo is ki taraf ruju kare use wahi kafi hai.

Kitabullah mein ikhtilaf nahin hamare dimagh mein futoor hai. Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ko hukum deta hai ke woh Quran ko gaur-o-fikr, tamul-o-tadabbur se parhein, is se taghaful na bartein, be-parwahi na karein. Is ke mustahkam mazameen, is ke hikmat bhare ahkaam, is ke faseeh-o-baleeg alfaz par gaur karein. Saath hi yeh khabar deta hai ke yeh pak kitab ikhtilaf, iztirab, ta'aruz aur tazad se pak hai, is liye ke Hakeem-o-Hameed Allah ka kalam hai. Woh khud haq hai aur isi tarah is ka kalam bhi sarasar haq hai. Chunancha aur jagah farmaya: (Afala yatadabbarunal Qur'ana am 'ala quloobin aqfaluha) (Surah Muhammad: 24). Yeh log kyun Quran mein gaur-o-khauz nahin karte? Kya in ke dilon par sangeen qufl lag gaye hain? Phir farmata hai agar yeh Quran Allah ki taraf se nazil shuda na hota, jaise ke mushrikeen aur munafiqeen ka za'am hai, yeh agar yeh fil-haqeeqat kisi ka apni taraf se waza kiya hua hota ya koi aur is ka kehne wala hota to zaroori baat thi ke is mein insani tabai' ke mutabiq ikhtilaf milta. Ya'ni namumkin hai ke insani iztirab-o-tazad se mubarra ho, lazman yeh hota ke kahin kuch kaha jata aur kahin kuch aur, yahan ek baat kahi to aage ja kar is ke khilaf bhi keh gaye. Chunancha aalimon ka qaul bayan kiya gaya hai ke woh kehte hain hum is par iman laye, yeh sab hamare Rab ki taraf se hain, ya'ni muhkam aur mutashabeh ko muhkam ki taraf lota dete hain aur hidayat pa lete hain aur jin ke dilon mein kaji hai, badniyati hai, woh muhkam ko mutashabeh ki taraf mor tor kar ke gumrah ho jate hain. Yehi wajah hai jo Allah Ta'ala ne pehle sahih mizaj walon ki tareef ki aur dusri qisam ke logon ki burai bayan farmayi. Amr bin Shuaib se marwi hai, 'An abeehi an jaddihi' wali hadith mein hai ke main aur mere bhai ek aisi majlis mein shamil hue ke is ke muqable mein surkh oonton ka mil jana bhi is ke pasang barabar bhi qeemat nahin rakhta. Hum dono ne dekha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke darwaze par chand buzurg sahaba khare hue hain, hum adab ke sath ek taraf baith gaye. Un mein Quran-e-Kareem ki kisi ayat ki babat muzakira ho raha tha jis mein ikhtilafi masail bhi the, aakhir baat barh gayi aur zor zor se aapas mein baat-cheet hone lagi. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ise sun kar sakht ghazabnak ho kar bahar tashreef laye, chehra mubarak surkh ho raha tha, un par mitti dalte hue farmane lage: Khamosh raho! Tum se agli ummatein isi ba'is tabah-o-barbad ho gayin ke unhon ne apne ambiya se ikhtilaf kiya aur Kitabullah ki ek ayat ko dusri ayat ke khilaf samjha. Yaad rakho Quran ki koi ayat dusri ayat ke khilaf use jhutlane wali nahin, balki Quran ki ek-ek ayat ek dusre ki tasdeeq karti hai. Tum jise jaan lo amal karo, jise na maloom kar sako is ke janne wale ke liye chor do. Dusri ayat mein hai ke sahaba taqdeer ke bare mein mubahisa kar rahe the, rawi kehte hain ke kaash ke main is majlis mein na baithta.

Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) farmate hain ke main dopahar ke waqt hazir-e-huzoor hua toh baitha hi tha ke ek aayat ke bare mein do shakhson ke darmiyan ikhtilaf hua, unki aawazein unchi huin toh Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya tum se pehli ummaton ki halakat ka baais sirf unka Kitabullah ka ikhtilaf karna hi tha (Musnad-e-Ahmed). Phir in jald-baaz logon ko roka ja raha hai jo kisi amn ya khauf ki khabar paate hi be-tahqeeq baat idhar se udhar tak pahuncha dete hain halanke mumkin hai woh bilkul hi ghalat ho, Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai jo shakhs koi baat bayan kare aur woh guman karta ho ke yeh ghalat hai woh bhi jhooton mein ka ek jhoota hai, yahan par hum Hazrat Umar (R.A) wali riwayat ka zikr karna bhi munasib samajhte hain ke jab unhein yeh khabar pahunchi ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apni biwiyon ko talaq de di toh aap apne ghar se chale masjid mein aaye yahan bhi logon ko yahi kehte suna toh ba-zat-e-khud Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ) ke paas pahunche aur khud aap se daryaft kiya ke kya yeh sach hai? Ke aap ne apni azwaj-e-mutahharat ko talaq de di? Aap ne farmaya ghalat hai, chunancha Farooq-e-Azam ne Allah ki badai bayan ki. Sahih Muslim mein hai ke phir masjid ke darwaze par khade ho kar ba-aawaz-e-buland farmaya logo Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ) ne apni biwiyon ko talaq nahin di. Isi par yeh aayat nazil hui. Pas Hazrat Umar (R.A) woh hain jinhon ne is mamle ki tahqeeq ki. Ilmi istilah mein istinbat kehte hain kisi cheez ko uske manba aur makhzan se nikalna, maslan jab koi shakhs kisi kaan ko khod kar uske neeche se koi cheez nikale toh Arab kehte hain "Istambat-ar-rajul". Phir farmata hai agar Allah Ta'ala ka fazl-o-rahm tum par na hota toh tum sab ke sab siwaye chand kamil iman walon ke shaitan ke tabe-dar ban jaate, aise mauqon par muhawratan maani hote hain ke tum kul ke kul shamil ho chunancha Arab ke aise sher bhi hain.

Hukm-e-Jihad imtehan-e-iman hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ko hukm ho raha hai ke aap tanha apni zaat se Allah Ta'ala ki rah mein jihad karein, chahiye koi bhi aap ka sath na de. Abu Ishaq, Hazrat Bara bin Azib (R.A) se daryaft farmate hain ke ek musalman akela tanha ho aur dushman ek sau hon to kya woh un se jihad kare? Aap ne farmaya haan. To kaha phir Quran ki is ayat se to muman'at-e-takeed hoti hai ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai apne hathon aap halakat mein na paro. To Hazrat Bara ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala isi ayat mein apne Nabi (ﷺ) se farmata hai Allah ki rah mein lar, tujhe fakat tere nafs ki takleef di jati hai aur hukm diya jata hai ke mominon ko bhi. Is se murad Allah ki rah mein kharch karne se rukne wala hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke jab yeh ayat-e-halakat utri to aap ne Sahaba (R.A) se farmaya mujhe mere Rab ne jihad ka hukm diya hai, pas tum bhi jihad karo. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai.

Phir farmata hai mominon ko daleri dila aur unhein jihad ki raghbat dila. aaye unhon ne kaha Assalamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullah wa Barakatuhu, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tees nekiyan milin, Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Ghareeb batate hain, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) is aayat ko aam lete hain aur farmate hain ke Khalq-e-Allah mein se jo koi salam karega use jawab do go woh Majusi ho, Hazrat Qatada farmate hain salam ka is se behtar jawab dena to musalmanon musalman salam ke sabhi alfaz keh de to phir jawab dene wala unhi ko lota de, Zimmi logon ko khud karein to jawab mein utne hi alfaz keh de, Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai jab koi Yahudi tumhein salam kare muztar kar, Imam Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain salam nafl hai aur jawab-e-salam farz hai aur ulama-e-kiram ka farman bhi yahi hai, pas agar jawab na dega to gunahgar hoga is liye ke jawab-e-salam ka Allah ka hukum hai, is ke baad Allah Ta'ala apni tauheed bayan farmata hai aur uluhiyat aur apna yakta hona zahir karta hai aur is mein zimni mazameen bhi hain isi liye dusre jumle ko laam se shuru kiya jo qasam ke jawab mein aata hai, to agla jumla khabar hai aur qasam bhi hai ke woh anqareeb tamam muqaddam-o-muakhar ko maidan-e-mahshar mein jama karega aur wahan har ek ko us ke amal ka badla dega, us Allah Sami-o-Baseer se zyada sachi baat wala aur koi nahin, us ki khabar us ka wada us ki wa'eed sab sach hai, wahi mabood-e-barhaq hai, us ke siwa koi murabbi nahin.

Hukm-e-Jihad imtehan-e-iman hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ko hukm ho raha hai ke aap tanha apni zaat se Allah Ta'ala ki rah mein jihad karein, chahiye koi bhi aap ka sath na de. Abu Ishaq, Hazrat Bara bin Azib (R.A) se daryaft farmate hain ke ek musalman akela tanha ho aur dushman ek sau hon to kya woh un se jihad kare? Aap ne farmaya haan. To kaha phir Quran ki is ayat se to muman'at-e-takeed hoti hai ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai apne hathon aap halakat mein na paro. To Hazrat Bara ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala isi ayat mein apne Nabi (ﷺ) se farmata hai Allah ki rah mein lar, tujhe fakat tere nafs ki takleef di jati hai aur hukm diya jata hai ke mominon ko bhi. Is se murad Allah ki rah mein kharch karne se rukne wala hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke jab yeh ayat-e-halakat utri to aap ne Sahaba (R.A) se farmaya mujhe mere Rab ne jihad ka hukm diya hai, pas tum bhi jihad karo. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai.

Phir farmata hai mominon ko daleri dila aur unhein jihad ki raghbat dila. Chunancha Badr wale din maidan-e-jihad mein musalmanon ki safein durust karte hue Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya utho aur barho us jannat ki taraf jis ki chorai asman-o-zameen hai. Jihad ki targheeb ki bahut si hadithein hain. Bukhari mein hai jo Allah par aur us ke Rasool par iman laye, salat qaim kare, zakat deta rahe, Ramzan ke rozay rakhe, Allah par us ka haq hai ke woh use jannat mein dakhil kare, Allah ki rah mein hijrat ki ho, jahan paida hua hai wahin thehra raha ho. Logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) kya logon ko is ki khushkhabri hum na de dein? Aap ne farmaya suno jannat mein sau darjay hain jin mein se ek darjay mein is qadar bulandi hai jitni zameen-o-asman mein aur yeh darjay Allah ne un ke liye tayyar kiye hain jo us ki rah mein jihad karein. Pas jab tum Allah se jannat mango to Jannat-ul-Firdous talab karo, woh behtareen jannat hai aur sab se aala hai, us ke upar Rahman ka Arsh hai aur isi se jannat ki sab nahrein jari hoti hain.

Muslim ki hadith mein hai jo shakhs Rab hone par, Islam ke deen hone par, Muhammad (ﷺ) ke Rasool-o-Nabi hone par razi ho jaye us ke liye jannat wajib hai. Hazrat Abu Saeed ise sun kar khush ho kar kehne lage Huzoor (ﷺ) dobara irshad ho. Aap ne dobara isi ko bayan farma kar kaha ek aur amal hai jis ke ba'is Allah Ta'ala apne banday ke sau darjay buland karta hai, ek darjay se dusre darjay tak itni bulandi hai jitni asman-o-zameen ke darmiyan hai. Pucha woh amal kya hai? Farmaya Allah ki rah mein jihad.

Irshad hai jab aap jihad ke liye tayyar ho jayenge, musalman aap ki taleem se jihad par amada ho jayenge to phir Allah ki madad shamil-e-haal hogi. Allah Ta'ala kufr ki kamar tor de ga, kuffar ki himmat past kar de ga, un ke hoslay toot jayenge. Phir kya majal ke duniya mein bhi unhein maghloob kare aur yahin unhein azab bhi de, isi tarah akhirat mein bhi isi ko qudrat hasil hai, jaise aur ayat mein hai: (Wa lau yasha'ullahu lantasara minhum wa lakin liyabluwa ba'dakum bi ba'din) (47:4).

Muhammad: 4) Agar Allah chahe in se az-khud badla le le, lekin woh in ko aur tumhein aazma raha hai. Jo shakhs kisi Amr-e-Khair mein koshish kare to use bhi us khair bhala'i ka sawab milega, aur jo us ke khilaf koshish kare aur bad natija bar-amad kare us ki koshish aur niyat ka us par bhi waisa hi bojh hoga, Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain sifarish karo ajar paoge aur Allah apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zaban par woh jaari karega jo chahe, yeh aayat ek dusre ki sifarish karne ke bare mein nazil hui hai, is meharbani ko dekhiye farmaya mahaz shafa'at par hi ajar mil jayega khwah us se kaam bane ya na bane, Allah har cheez ka hafiz hai, har cheez par hazir hai, har cheez ka hisab lene wala hai, har cheez par qadir hai, har cheez ko dawam bakhshne wala hai, har ek ko rozi dene wala hai, har insaan ke a'maal ka andaza karne wala hai. Salam kehne wale ko us se behtar jawab do: Musalmano! Jab tumhein koi musalman salam kare to us ke salam ke alfaaz se behtar alfaaz se us ka jawab do, ya kam se kam unhi alfaaz ko dohra do pas ziyadati mustahab hai aur barabari farz hai, Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ek shakhs Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hua aur kaha Assalamu Alaikum Ya Rasool Allah aap ne farmaya Wa Alaikumussalam wa Rahmatullah wa Barakatuhu phir ek sahib aaye unhon ne Assalamu Alaika wa Rahmatullah wa Barakatuhu aap ne jawab mein farmaya Wa Alaika to us ne kaha ae Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) fulan aur fulan ne aap ko salam kiya to aap ne jawab diya kuch zyada du'aiya alfaaz ke sath diya jo mujhe nahin diya aap ne farmaya tum ne hamare liye kuch baqi hi na choda Allah ka farman hai jab tum par salam kiya jaye to tum us se achha jawab do ya usi ko lota do is liye hum ne wahi alfaaz lota diye yeh riwayat Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein bhi isi tarah marwi hai, ise Abu Bakr Marduyah ne bhi riwayat kiya magar main ne ise Musnad mein nahin dekha Wallahu A'lam is hadith se yeh bhi maloom hua ki salam ke kalmaat mein se ziyadati nahin, agar hoti to Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us aakhri sahabi ke jawab mein woh lafz keh dete.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek shakhs Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye aur Assalamu Alaikum Ya Rasool Allah keh kar baith gaye, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jawab diya aur farmaya das nekiyan milin, dusre aaye aur Assalamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullah Ya Rasool Allah keh kar baith gaye, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya bees nekiyan milin, phir teesre sahab aaye unhon ne kaha Assalamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullah wa Barakatuhu, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tees nekiyan milin, Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Ghareeb batate hain, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) is aayat ko aam lete hain aur farmate hain ke Khalq-e-Allah mein se jo koi salam karega use jawab do go woh Majusi ho, Hazrat Qatada farmate hain salam ka is se behtar jawab dena to musalmanon ke liye hai aur isi ko lota dena Ahl-e-Zimma ke liye hai, lekin is tafsir mein zara ikhtilaf hai jaise ke upar ki hadith mein guzar chuka hai murad yeh hai ke us ke salam se achha jawab dein aur agar musalman salam ke sabhi alfaz keh de to phir jawab dene wala unhi ko lota de, Zimmi logon ko khud karein to jawab mein utne hi alfaz keh de, Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai jab koi Yahudi tumhein salam kare to khayal rakho yeh keh dete hain As-Samu Alaikum to tum keh do Wa Alaikum, Sahih Muslim mein hai Yahud-o-Nasara ko tum pehle salam na karo aur jab raste mein mud-bhed ho jaye to unhein tangi ki taraf
