Allah ka hukum hai, is ke baad Allah Ta'ala apni tauheed bayan farmata hai aur uluhiyat aur apna yakta hona zahir karta hai aur is mein zimni mazameen bhi hain isi liye dusre jumle ko laam se shuru kiya jo qasam ke jawab mein aata hai, to agla jumla khabar hai aur qasam bhi hai ke woh anqareeb tamam muqaddam-o-muakhar ko maidan-e-mahshar mein jama karega aur wahan har ek ko us ke amal ka badla dega, us Allah Sami-o-Baseer se zyada sachi baat wala aur koi nahin, us ki khabar us ka wada us ki wa'eed sab sach hai, wahi mabood-e-barhaq hai, us ke siwa koi murabbi nahin.

Munafiqon se hoshiyar raho is mein ikhtilaf hai ke munafiqon ke kis mamla mein musalmanon ke darmiyan do qisam ke khayalat dakhil hue thay, Hazrat Zaid bin Sabit (R.A) farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) jab maidan-e-Uhud mein tashreef le gaye tab aap ke sath munafiq bhi thay jo jang se pehle hi laut aaye thay un ke bare mein baaz musalman toh kehte thay ke inhe qatl kar dena chahiye aur baaz kehte thay nahin yeh bhi imandar hain, is par yeh aayat utri toh Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya yeh shehar-e-Taiba hai jo khud ba khud mail kuchail ko is tarah door kar de ga jis tarah bhatti lohay ke mail kuchail ko chhant deti hai. (Bukhari o Muslim) Ibn Ishaq mein hai ke kul lashkar-e-jang-e-Uhud mein ek hazar ka tha, Abdullah bin Ubayy Salool teen sau aadmiyon ko apne hamrah le kar wapas laut aaya tha aur Huzoor (ﷺ) ke sath phir saat sau hi reh gaye thay, Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Makkah se nikle, inhe yaqeen tha ke ashab-e-Rasool se un ki koi rok tok nahin hogi kyunke bazahir kalma ke qail thay udhar jab madani musalmanon ko is ka ilm hua toh un mein se baaz kehne lage in namuradon se pehle jihad karo yeh hamare dushmanon ke taraf-dar hain aur baaz ne kaha SubhanAllah jo log tum jaisa kalma padhte hain tum un se lado ge? Sirf is wajah se ke unhon ne hijrat nahin ki aur apne ghar nahin chhore, hum kis tarah un ke khoon aur un ke maal apne oopar halal kar sakte hain? Un ka yeh ikhtilaf Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke samne hua aap khamosh thay jo yeh aayat nazil hui (Ibn Abi Hatim) Hazrat Saeed bin Mu'az ke ladke farmate hain Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) par jab tohmat lagayi gayi aur Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne mimbar par khade ho kar farmaya koi hai jo mujhe Abdullah bin Ubayy ki eza se bachaye is par Aus o Khazraj ke darmiyan jo ikhtilaf hua us ki babat yeh aayat nazil hui hai, un ki hidayat ki koi raah nahin. Yeh toh chahte hain ke sachay musalman bhi un jaise gumrah ho jayen un ke dilon mein is qadar adawat hai, toh tumhein mumanat ki jati hai ke jab tak yeh hijrat na karein inhe apna na samjho, yeh khayal na karo ke yeh tumhare dost aur madadgar hain, balkay yeh khud is laiq hain ke un se baqaida jihad kiya jaye. Phir un mein se un hazrat ka istisna kiya jata hai jo kisi aisi qoum ki panah mein chale jayen jis se musalmanon ka ahd-o-paiman sulh-o-sulook ho toh un ka hukum bhi wahi hoga jo mu'ahida wali qoum ka hai, Suraqa bin Malik Mudlaji farmate hain jab jang-e-Badr aur jang-e-Uhud mein musalman ghalib aaye aur aas paas ke logon mein Islam ki bakhoobi isha'at ho gayi toh mujhe maloom hua ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ka irada hai ke Khalid bin Waleed ko ek lashkar de kar meri qoum Banu Mudlaj ki goshmali ke liye rawana farmayen toh main aap ki khidmat mein hazir hua aur kaha main aap ko ehsan yaad dilata hoon logon ne mujh se kaha khamosh reh lekin Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya ise kehne do, kaho kya kehna chahte ho?

Main ne kaha mujhe maloom hua hai ke aap meri qoum ki taraf lashkar bhejne wale hain, main chahta hoon ke aap un se sulah kar lein is baat par ke agar Quraish Islam layein to yeh bhi musalman ho jayenge aur agar woh Islam na layein to un par bhi aap charhai na karein. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Khalid bin Waleed (R.A) ka haath apne haath mein le kar farmaya: In ke sath jao aur un ke kehne ke mutabiq un ki qoum se sulah kar aao. Pas is baat par sulah ho gayi ke woh dushmanan-e-deen ki kisi qisam ki madad na karein aur agar Quraish Islam layein to yeh bhi musalman ho jayein. Pas Allah ne yeh aayat utari ke yeh chahte hain ke tum bhi kufr karo jaise woh kufr karte hain phir tum aur woh barabar ho jayein, pas in mein se kisi ko dost na jano. Yehi riwayat Ibn Marduyah mein hai aur in mein hi aayat (اِلَّا الَّذِيْنَ يَصِلُوْنَ اِلٰى قَوْمٍۢ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَھُمْ مِّيْثَاقٌ اَوْ جَاۗءُوْكُمْ حَصِرَتْ صُدُوْرُھُمْ اَنْ يُّقَاتِلُوْكُمْ اَوْ يُقَاتِلُوْا قَوْمَھُمْ) (Surah An-Nisa: 90) nazil hui. Pas jo bhi un se mil jata woh inhi ki tarah pur-amn rehta, kalam ke alfaaz se zyada munasibat isi ko hai. Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein sulah Hudaibiyah ke qissay mein hai ke phir jo chahta hai ke kuffar ki jamaat mein dakhil ho jata hai aur amn pa leta hai, jo chahta hai Madani musalmanon se milta aur ahd-nama ki wajah se mamoon ho jata hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ka qaul hai ke is hukm ko phir is aayat ne mansookh kar diya ke (فَاِذَا انْسَلَخَ الْاَشْهُرُ الْحُرُمُ فَاقْتُلُوا الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ حَيْثُ وَجَدْتُّمُــوْهُمْ وَخُذُوْهُمْ وَاحْصُرُوْهُمْ وَاقْعُدُوْا لَهُمْ كُلَّ مَرْصَدٍ ۚ فَاِنْ تَابُوْا وَاَقَامُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَاٰتَوُا الزَّكٰوةَ فَخَــلُّوْا سَـبِيْلَهُمْ ۭاِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ) (Surah At-Tawbah: 5) yani jab hurmat wale mahine guzar jayein to mushrikeen se jihad karo jahan kahin unhein pao. Ek dusri jamaat ka zikr ho raha hai jise mustasna kiya hai jo maidan mein laye jate hain lekin yeh bechare bebasi hote hain, woh na to tum se larna chahte hain na tumhare sath mil kar apni qoum se larna pasand karte hain balkeh woh aise beech ke log hain jo na tumhare dushman kahe ja sakte hain na dost. Yeh bhi Allah ka fazl hai ke us ne in logon ko tum par musallat nahin kiya, agar woh chahta to unhein zor-o-taqat deta aur un ke dil mein daal deta ke woh tum se larein. Pas agar yeh tumhari larai se baaz rahein aur sulah-o-safai se yaksu ho jayein to tumhein bhi un se larne ki ijazat nahin. Isi qisam ke log thay jo Badr wale din Banu Hashim ke qabeelay mein se mushrikeen ke sath aaye thay jo dil se ise na-pasand rakhte thay jaise Hazrat Abbas (R.A) waghera, yehi wajah thi ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Abbas (R.A) ke qatl ko mana farma diya tha aur hukm diya tha ke unhein zinda giraftar kar liya jaye.

Phir ek aur giroh ka zikr kiya jata hai jo bazahir toh upar walon jaisa hai lekin darasal niyat mein bahut khot hai. Yeh log munafiq hain. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aakar Islam zahir kar ke apne jaan-o-maal musalmanon se mehfooz kara lete hain. Udhar kuffar mein mil kar un ke maboodan-e-batil ki parastish kar ke un mein se hona zahir kar ke un se faida uthate rehte hain taake un ke hathon se bhi aman mein rahein. Darasal yeh log kafir hain, jaise aur jagah hai apne shayateen ke paas tanhai mein ja kar kehte hain hum tumhare saath hain. Yahan bhi farmata hai ke jab kabhi fitna-angezi ki taraf lautaye jate hain toh jee khol kar poori sargarmi se is mein hissa lete hain jaise koi oondhe munh gira hua ho. "Fitna" se murad yahan shirk hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain ke yeh log bhi Makkah wale thay, yahan aa kar bator-e-riya-kari ke Islam qabool karte thay, wahan ja kar un ke but poojte thay. Toh musalmanon ko farmaya jata hai ke agar yeh apni doghli raush se baaz na aayein, eeza-rasani se hath na rokein, sulah na karein toh inhe aman-o-aman na do, un se bhi jihad karo, inhe bhi qaidi banao aur jahan pao qatl kar do, beshak un par hum ne tumhein zahir ghalba aur khuli hujjat ata farmayi hai.

Phir ek aur giroh ka zikr kiya jata hai jo bazahir toh upar walon jaisa hai lekin darasal niyat mein bahut khot hai. Yeh log munafiq hain. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aakar Islam zahir kar ke apne jaan-o-maal musalmanon se mehfooz kara lete hain. Udhar kuffar mein mil kar un ke maboodan-e-batil ki parastish kar ke un mein se hona zahir kar ke un se faida uthate rehte hain taake un ke hathon se bhi aman mein rahein. Darasal yeh log kafir hain, jaise aur jagah hai apne shayateen ke paas tanhai mein ja kar kehte hain hum tumhare saath hain. Yahan bhi farmata hai ke jab kabhi fitna-angezi ki taraf lautaye jate hain toh jee khol kar poori sargarmi se is mein hissa lete hain jaise koi oondhe munh gira hua ho. "Fitna" se murad yahan shirk hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain ke yeh log bhi Makkah wale thay, yahan aa kar bator-e-riya-kari ke Islam qabool karte thay, wahan ja kar un ke but poojte thay. Toh musalmanon ko farmaya jata hai ke agar yeh apni doghli raush se baaz na aayein, eeza-rasani se hath na rokein, sulah na karein toh inhe aman-o-aman na do, un se bhi jihad karo, inhe bhi qaidi banao aur jahan pao qatl kar do, beshak un par hum ne tumhein zahir ghalba aur khuli hujjat ata farmayi hai.

Munafiqon se hoshiyar raho is mein ikhtilaf hai ke munafiqon ke kis mamla mein musalmanon ke darmiyan do qisam ke khayalat dakhil hue thay, Hazrat Zaid bin Sabit (R.A) farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) jab maidan-e-Uhud mein tashreef le gaye tab aap ke sath munafiq bhi thay jo jang se pehle hi laut aaye thay un ke bare mein baaz musalman toh kehte thay ke inhe qatl kar dena chahiye aur baaz kehte thay nahin yeh bhi imandar hain, is par yeh aayat utri toh Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya yeh shehar-e-Taiba hai jo khud ba khud mail kuchail ko is tarah door kar de ga jis tarah bhatti lohay ke mail kuchail ko chhant deti hai. Sirf is wajah se ke unhon ne hijrat nahin ki aur apne ghar nahin chhore, hum kis tarah un ke khoon aur un ke maal apne oopar halal kar sakte hain? Phir un mein se un hazrat ka istisna kiya jata hai jo kisi aisi qoum ki panah mein chale jayen jis se musalmanon ka ahd-o-paiman sulh-o-sulook ho toh un ka hukum bhi wahi hoga jo mu'ahida wali qoum ka hai, Suraqa bin Malik Mudlaji farmate hain jab jang-e-Badr aur jang-e-Uhud mein musalman ghalib aaye aur aas paas ke logon mein Islam ki bakhoobi isha'at ho gayi toh mujhe maloom hua ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ka irada hai ke Khalid bin Waleed ko ek lashkar de kar meri qoum Banu Mudlaj ki goshmali ke liye rawana farmayen toh main aap ki khidmat mein hazir hua aur kaha main aap ko ehsan yaad dilata hoon logon ne mujh se kaha khamosh reh lekin Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya ise kehne do, kaho kya kehna chahte ho?

"Fitna" se murad yahan shirk hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain ke yeh log bhi Makkah wale thay, yahan aa kar bator-e-riya-kari ke Islam qabool karte thay, wahan ja kar un ke but poojte thay. Qatl-e-Muslim, Qisas-o-Diyat ke masail aur Qatl-e-Khata. Irshad hota hai ke kisi Musalman ko laiq nahin ke kisi haal mein apne Musalman bhai ka khoon-e-na-haq kare. Sahih mein hai Rasoolullah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Kisi Musalman ka jo Allah ki ek hone ki aur mere Rasool hone ki shahadat deta ho, khoon bahana halal nahin magar teen halaton mein: Ek toh yeh ke usne kisi ko qatl kar diya ho, dusre shadi shuda ho kar zina kiya ho, teesre deen-e-Islam ko chhod dene wala, jamaat se alaihida hone wala. Phir yeh bhi yaad rahe ke jab in teenon kamon mein se koi kaam kisi se waqay ho jaye toh riyaya mein se kisi ko uske qatl ka ikhtiyar nahin, albatta Imam ya naib-e-Imam ko ba-ohda-e-qaza ka haq hai. Iske baad istisna-e-munqata hai, Arab shairon ke kalam mein bhi is qisam ke istisna bahut se milte hain. Is ayat ki shaan-e-nuzool mein ek qaul toh yeh marwi hai ke Ayyash bin Abi Rabia jo Abu Jahl ka maa ki taraf se bhai tha, jis maa ka naam Asma bint Makhrama tha, uske bare mein utri hai. Usne ek shakhs ko qatl kar dala tha jise woh Islam lane ki wajah se sazayein de raha tha yahan tak ke uski jaan le li, unka naam Harith bin Zaid Aamiri tha. Hazrat Ayyash (R.A) ke dilon mein yeh kanta reh gaya aur unhone thaan li ke mauqa pa kar ise qatl kar dunga. Allah Ta'ala ne kuch dinon baad qatil ko bhi Islam ki hidayat di, woh Musalman ho gaye aur hijrat bhi kar li lekin Hazrat Ayyash (R.A) ko yeh maloom na tha. Fatah-e-Makkah wale din yeh unki nazar pade, yeh jaan kar ke yeh ab tak kufr par hain, un par achanak hamla kar diya aur qatl kar diya, is par yeh ayat utri. Dusra qaul yeh hai ke yeh ayat Hazrat Abu Darda (R.A) ke bare mein nazil hui hai jabke unhone ek shakhs kafir par hamla kiya, talwar sonthi hi thi toh usne kalma padh liya lekin unki talwar chal gayi aur use qatl kar dala. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ) se yeh waqaya bayan hua toh Hazrat Abu Darda (R.A) ne apna yeh uzr bayan kiya ke usne sirf jaan bachane ki gharz se yeh kalma padha tha, Aap (ﷺ) naraz ho kar farmane lage: Kya tumne uska dil cheer kar dekha tha? Yeh waqaya sahih hadith mein bhi hai lekin wahan naam dusre sahabi ka hai. Phir qatl-e-khata ka zikr ho raha hai ke is mein do cheezein wajib hain: Ek toh ghulam azad karna, dusre diyat dena. Is ghulam ke liye bhi shart hai ke woh imandar ho, kafir ko azad karna kafi na hoga, chhota nabaligh bacha bhi kafi na hoga jab tak ke woh apne irade se iman ka qasd karne wala aur itni umar ka na ho. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ka mukhtar qaul yeh hai ke agar uske maa baap dono Musalman hon toh jaiz hai warna nahin. Jamhoor ka mazhab yeh hai ke Musalman hona shart hai, chhote bade ki koi qaid nahin. Ek Ansari siyah-faam londi ko le kar hazir Huzoor (ﷺ) hote hain aur kehte hain ke mere zimme ek Musalman gardan ka azad karna hai, agar yeh Musalman ho toh main ise azad kar doon. Aap (ﷺ) ne us londi se pucha: Kya tu gawahi deti hai ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahin?

Us ne kaha haan, Aap ne farmaya is baat ki bhi gawahi deti hai ke main Allah ka Rasool hoon? Us ne kaha haan, farmaya kya marne ke baad jee uthne ki bhi toh qail hai? Us ne kaha haan, Aap ne farmaya ise azaad kar do. Is ki asnaad sahih hai aur sahabi kaun thay? Is ka makhfi rehna sanad mein muzir nahin, yeh riwayat hadith ki aur bahut si kitabon mein is tarah hai ke Aap ne us se poocha Allah kahan hai? Us ne kaha aasmanon mein, daryaft kiya main kaun hoon? Jawab diya Aap Rasool Allah (ﷺ) hain, Aap ne farmaya ise azaad kar do. Yeh imandar hai. Pas ek toh gardan azaad karna wajib hai, dusre khoon-baha dena jo maqtool ke ghar walon ko saunp diya jaye ga, yeh un ke maqtool ka ewaz hai. Yeh diyat sau oont hai paanch sau qismon ke, bees toh dusre saal ki umar ki oontniyan aur bees isi umar ke oont aur bees teesre saal mein lagi hui oontniyan aur bees paanchwein saal mein lagi hui aur bees chauthe saal mein lagi hui. Yehi faisla qatl-e-khata ke khoon-baha ka Rasool (ﷺ) ne kiya hai, mulahiza ho Sunan-o-Musnad-e-Ahmad. Yeh hadith barwayat Hazrat Abdullah mauqoof bhi marwi hai, Hazrat Ali (R.A) aur ek jamaat se bhi yehi manqool hai aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke diyat chaar chauthaiyon mein banti hui hai. Yeh khoon-baha qatil ke aaqila aur us ke asba yani warison ke baad ke qareebi rishtedaron par hai, us ke apne maal par nahin. Imam Shafi (R.H) farmate hain mere khayal mein is amr mein koi bhi mukhalif nahin ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne diyat ka faisla inhi logon par kiya hai aur yeh hadith khasa mein kasrat se mazkoor hai. Imam sahab jin ahadith ki taraf ishara karte hain woh bahut si hain, Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) se marwi hai ke Huzail qabeela ki do auratein aapas mein ladeen, ek ne dusre ko patthar mara woh hamila thi, bacha bhi zaya ho gaya aur woh bhi mar gayi. Qissa An-Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ) ke paas aaya toh Aap ne yeh faisla kiya ke woh is bacha ke ewaz toh ek londi ya ghulam de aur aurat maqtoolah ke badle diyat qatilah aurat ke haqeeqi warison ke baad ke rishtedaron ke zimme hai. Is se yeh bhi maloom hua ke jo qatl-e-amd khata se ho woh bhi hukm mein khata-e-mehaz ke hai.

Ya'ni diyat ke aitbar se haan is mein taqseem-e-suls par hogi teen hissay honge kyunke is mein shabahat-e-amd ya'ni bil-qasd bhi hai, Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Banu Jazima ki jang ke liye Hazrat Khalid bin Walid (R.A) ko Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek lashkar par sardar bana kar bheja unhon ne ja kar unhein dawat-e-Islam di unhon ne dawat to qabool kar li lekin ba-wajah la-ilmi bajaye aslamna ya'ni hum musalman huye ke "sabana" kaha ya'ni hum be-deen huye, Hazrat Khalid bin Walid (R.A) ne unhein qatl karna shuru kar diya jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh khabar pahunchi to Aap ne haath utha kar janab-e-bari mein arz ki ya Allah Khalid ke is fe'l mein apni bezari aur barat tere samne zahir karta hoon, phir Hazrat Ali (R.A) ko bula kar unhein bheja ke jao un ke maqtoolon ki diyat chukao aur jo un ka maali nuqsan hua ho usay bhi kori kori chukao, is se sabit hua ke Imam ya naib-e-Imam ki khata ka bojh Bait-ul-Maal par hoga. Phir farmaya hai ke khoon-baha jo wajib hai agar auliya-e-maqtool az-khud is se dast-bardar ho jayen to unhein ikhtiyar hai woh bator-e-sadqa ke usay maaf kar sakte hain. Phir farman hai ke agar maqtool musalman ho lekin us ke auliya harbi kafir hon to qatil par diyat nahin, qatil par is soorat mein sirf azadgi-e-gardan hai aur agar us ke wali waris us qoum mein se hon jin se tumhari sulh aur ahd-o-paiman hai to diyat deni paregi agar maqtool momin tha to kamil khoon-baha aur agar maqtool kafir tha to ba'z ke nazdeek to poori diyat hai ba'z ke nazdeek adhi ba'z ke nazdeek tihai, tafseel kutub-e-ahkam mein mulahiza ho aur qatil par momin banday ko azad karna bhi lazim hai agar kisi ko is ki taqat ba-wajah muflisi ke na ho to us ke zimme do mahine ke rozay hain jo lagatar pay-dar-pay rakhne honge agar kisi shar'i uzr maslan bimari ya haiz ya nifas ke baghair koi roza beech mein se chhor diya to phir naye siray se rozay shuru karne parenge, safar ke bare mein do qaul hain ek to yeh ke yeh bhi shar'i uzr hai dusre yeh ke yeh uzr nahin. Phir farmata hai qatl-e-khata ki tauba ki yeh soorat hai ke ghulam azad nahin kar sakta to rozay rakh le aur jisay rozon ki bhi taqat na ho woh maskeenon ko khila sakta hai ya nahin? To ek qaul to yeh hai ke sath maskeenon ko khila de jaise ke zihar ke kaffaray mein hai, wahan saaf bayan farma diya yahan is liye bayan nahin kiya gaya ke yeh daranay aur khauf dilanay ka maqam hai asani ki soorat agar bayan kar di jati to haibat-o-azmat itni baqi na rehti, dusra qaul yeh hai ke rozay ke neeche kuch nahin agar hota to bayan ke sath hi bayan kar diya jata, haajib ke waqt se bayan ko mu'akhar karna theek nahin (yeh bazahir qaul-e-sani hi sahih maloom hota hai wallahu a'lam. Mutarjim) Allah Aleem-o-Hakeem hai, is ki tafseer kayi martaba guzar chuki hai.

Qatl-e-Amadan aur Qatl-e-Muslim. Qatl-e-Khata ke baad ab Qatl-e-Amadan ka bayan ho raha hai, is ki sakhti, burai aur intehai takeed wali darauni wa'eed farmayi ja rahi hai. Yeh woh gunah hai jise Allah Ta'ala ne shirk ke sath mila diya hai. Farmata hai: (Wa-alladhina la yad'una ma'allahi ilahan akhara wala yaqtulunan-nafsa allati harramallahu illabil-haqqi wala yaznun. Wa-may-yaf'al dhalika yalqa athama) (Surah Al-Furqan: 68). Ya'ni musalman bande woh hain jo Allah ke sath kisi aur ko mabood thahra kar nahin pukarte aur na woh kisi shakhs ko nahaq qatl karte hain. Dusri jagah farman hai: (Qul ta'alau atlu ma harrama rabbukum 'alaikum alla tushriku bihi shay'an wabil-walidayni ihsana. Wala taqtulu auladakum min imlaq) (Surah Al-An'am: 151). Yahan bhi Allah ke haram kiye huye kamon ka zikr karte hain, shirk ka aur qatl ka zikr farmaya hai aur bhi is mazmoon ki ayatein bahut si hain aur hadith bhi is baab mein bahut si manqool hui hain. Bukhari Muslim mein hai ke sab se pehle khoon ka faisla Qayamat ke din hoga. Abu Dawood mein hai imandar nekiyon aur bhalaiyon mein barhta rehta hai jab tak ke khoon-e-nahaq na kare, agar aisa kar liya to tabah ho jata hai. Dusri hadith mein hai sari duniya ka zawal Allah ke nazdeek ek musalman ke qatl se kam darje ka hai. Aur hadith mein hai agar tamam ruye zameen ke aur aasman ke log kisi ek musalman ke qatl mein shareek hon to Allah sab ko oundhe munh jahannam mein daal de. Aur hadith mein hai jis shakhs ne kisi musalman ke qatl mein aadhe kalme se bhi iaanat ki, woh Qayamat ke din Allah ke samne is halat mein aayega, us ki peshani mein likha hoga ke yeh shakhs Allah ki rahmat se mehroom hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka to qaul hai ke jis ne momin ko qasdan qatl kiya us ki tauba qabool hi nahin. Ahl-e-Kufa jab is masle mein ikhtilaf karte hain to Ibn-e-Jubair Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ke paas aakar daryaft karte hain, aap farmate hain yeh aakhri aayat hai jise kisi aayat ne mansookh nahin kiya, aur aap farmate hain ke dusri (Wa-alladhina la yad'una ma'allahi ilahan akhara wala yaqtulunan-nafsa allati harramallahu illabil-haqqi wala yaznun. Wa-may-yaf'al dhalika yalqa athama) (Surah Al-Furqan: 68).

(Al-Furqan: 68) jis mein toh yeh zikr hai ke woh ahl-e-shirk ke baare mein nazil hui hai, pas jabke kisi shakhs ne Islam ki halat mein kisi musalman ko ghair-e-shar'i wajah se qatl kiya uski saza Jahannam hai aur uski tauba qabool nahin hogi, Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) se jab yeh qaul-e-Abbas bayan hua toh farmane lage magar jo nadim ho, Salim bin Abu al-Ja'd farmate hain, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) jab nabina ho gaye the ek martaba hum unke paas baithe hue the jo ek shakhs aaya aur aap ko aawaz de kar poocha ke uske baare mein aap kya farmate hain jisne kisi momin ko jaan boojh kar maar dala? Aap ne farmaya uski saza Jahannam hai jis mein woh hamesha rahega, Allah ka us par ghazab hai, us par Allah ki la'nat hai aur uske liye azab-e-azim taiyar hai, usne phir poocha agar woh tauba kare, nek amal kare aur hidayat par jam jaye toh? Farmane lage uski maa use roye, use tauba aur hidayat kahan? Uski qasam jiske hath mein mera nafs hai, maine tumhare Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai, uski maa use roye, jisne momin ko jaan boojh kar maar dala hai woh Qayamat ke din use dayen ya bayen hath se thame hue Rahman ke Arsh ke samne aayega, uski ragon se khoon beh raha hoga aur Allah se kahega ke aye Allah is se pooch ke isne mujhe kyun qatl kiya? Us Allah-e-Azim ki qasam jiske hath mein Abdullah ki jaan hai ke is aayat ke nazil hone ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki wafat tak ise mansookh karne wali koi aayat nahin utri, aur riwayat mein itna aur bhi hai ke na Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke baad koi wahi utregi. Hazrat Zaid bin Thabit (R.A), Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A), Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A), Hazrat Abu Salamah bin Abdur-Rahman (R.H), Ubaid bin Umair (R.H), Hasan (R.H), Qatadah (R.H), Zahhak (R.H) bhi Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ke khayal ke sath hain. Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai ke maqtool apne qatil ko pakar kar Qayamat ke din Allah ke samne layega, dusre hath se apna sar uthaye hue hoga aur kahega mere Rabb is se pooch ke isne mujhe kyun qatl kiya? Qatil kahega Parwardigar isliye ke teri izzat ho, Allah farmayega pas yeh meri rah mein hai. Dusra maqtool bhi apne qatil ko pakre hue layega aur yahi kahega, qatil jawaban kahega isliye ke falan ki izzat ho, Allah farmayega qatil ka gunah usne apne sar le liya, phir use aag mein jhonk diya jayega jis garhay mein sattar saal tak toh neeche chala jayega. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai mumkin hai Allah Ta'ala tamam gunah bakhsh de, lekin ek toh woh shakhs jo kufr ki halat mein mara, dusra woh jo kisi momin ka qasdan qatil bana. Ibn-e-Marduyah mein bhi aisi hi hadith hai aur woh bilkul ghareeb hai, mehfooz woh hadith hai jo bahawala-e-Musnad bayan hui. Ibn-e-Marduyah mein aur hadith hai ke jaan boojh kar imandar ko maar dalne wala kafir hai. Yeh hadith munkar hai aur iski asnad mein bahut kalam hai.

Humaid kehte hain mere paas Abul Aliyah aaye, mere dost bhi us waqt mere paas the. Hum se kehne lage tum dono kam umr aur zyada yaaddasht wale ho, aao mere saath Bishr bin Aasim ke paas chalo. Jab wahan pahunche toh Bishr se farmaya inhe bhi woh hadith suna do. Unhone sunani shuru ki ke Utbah bin Malik Laithi ne kaha Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek chhota sa lashkar bheja tha, usne ek qoum par chapa mara, woh log bhaag khade hue. Unke saath ek shakhs bhaga ja raha tha, uske peeche ek lashkari bhaga, jab uske qareeb nangi talwar liye hue pahunch gaya toh usne kaha main toh musalman hoon. Usne kuch khayal na kiya, talwar chala di. Is waqiye ki khabar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hui toh aap bahut naraz hue aur sakht sust kaha. Yeh khabar us shakhs ko bhi pahunchi. Ek roz Rasool-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khutba padh rahe the ke us qatil ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Allah ki qasam usne toh yeh baat mehez qatl se bachne ke liye kahi thi. Aap ne uski taraf se nigah pher li aur khutba sunate rahe. Usne dobara kaha, aap ne phir munh mod liya, usse sabr na ho saka, teesri bari kaha toh aap ne uski taraf tawajjah ki aur narazgi aap ke chehre se tapak rahi thi, farmane lage momin ke qatil ki koi bhi ma'zarat qabool karne se Allah Ta'ala inkar karte hain, teen baar yahi farmaya. Yeh riwayat Nasai mein bhi hai. Pas ek mazhab toh yeh hua ke qatil-e-momin ki tauba nahin, dusra mazhab yeh hai ke tauba uske aur Allah ke darmiyan hai. Jamhoor-e-Salaf-o-Khalaf ka yahi mazhab hai ke agar usne tauba ki, Allah ki taraf ruju kiya, khushoo-o-khuzoo mein laga raha, nek aamal karne lag gaya toh Allah uski tauba qabool kar lega aur maqtool ko apne paas se ewaz de kar use raazi kar lega. Allah farmata hai (اِلَّا مَنْ تَابَ وَاٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًـا فَاُولٰۗىِٕكَ يَدْخُلُوْنَ الْجَــنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُوْنَ شَـيْــــــًٔا) (Surah Maryam: 60). Yeh khabar aur khabar mein naskh ka ehtemal nahin aur is aayat ko mushrikon ke bare mein aur is aayat ko mominon ke bare mein khaas karna bazahir khilaf-e-qiyas hai aur kisi saaf daleel ka mohtaj hai, Wallahu A'lam. Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai (قُلْ يٰعِبَادِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اَسْرَفُوْا عَلٰٓي اَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوْا مِنْ رَّحْمَةِ اللّٰهِ ۭ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ جَمِيْعًا ۭ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ) (Surah Az-Zumar: 53). Aye mere woh bando jinhone apni janon par ziyadati ki hai tum meri rahmat se mayoos na ho. Yeh aayat apne umoom ke aitbar se har gunah par muheet hai, khwah kufr-o-shirk ho, khwah shak-o-nifaq ho, khwah qatl-o-fisq ho, khwah kuch hi ho, jo Allah ki taraf ruju kare Allah uski taraf mail hoga, jo tauba kare Allah use maaf farmaye ga. Farmata hai (اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ جَمِيْعًا ۭ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ) (Surah Az-Zumar: 53). Allah Ta'ala shirk ko bakhshta nahin, uske siwa ke tamam gunah jise chahe bakhsh de.

Allah Ta'ala ki karimi ke sadqe jaiye ke us ne isi Surah mein is aayat se pehle bhi jis ki tafsir ab hum kar rahe hain apni aam bakhshish ki aayat bayan farmayi aur phir is aayat ke baad hi ise dohra diya isi tarah apni aam bakhshish ka elaan phir kiya taake bandon ko us ki kaamil fitrat se kaamil umeed bandh jaye. Wallahu A'lam. Bukhari Muslim ki woh hadith bhi is mauqa par yaad rakhne ke qabil hai jis mein hai ke ek Bani Israeli ne ek sau qatl kiye thay. Phir ek aalim se poochta hai ke kya meri tauba qabool ho sakti hai? Woh jawab deta hai ke tujh mein aur teri tauba mein kaun hai jo haail hai? Jao is bad-basti ko chhor kar nekon ke shehar mein baso. Chunancha us ne hijrat ki magar raaste mein hi faut ho gaya aur Rahmat ke farishte use le gaye. Yeh hadith poori poori kayi martaba ho chuki hai jabke Bani Israel mein yeh hai to is Ummat-e-Marhooma ke liye qatil ki tauba ke liye darwaze band kyun hon? Hum par to pehle bahut zyada pabandiyan thin jin sab se Allah ne hamein azaad kar diya aur Rahmatul-lil-Aalameen jaise sardar-e-ambiya ko bhej kar woh deen hamein diya jo aasaniyon aur rahaton wala seedha saaf aur wazeh hai, lekin yahan jo saza qatil ki bayan farmayi hai is se murad yeh hai ke is ki saza yeh hai ke use saza zaroor di jaye. Chunancha Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) aur salaf ki ek jamaat bhi yahi farmati hai, balkeh is ma'ani ki ek hadith bhi Ibn Marduyah mein hai lekin sanadan woh sahih nahin aur isi tarah har wa'eed ka matlab yahi hai ke agar koi amal-e-saleh waghera is ke muqabil mein nahin to is badi ka badla woh hai jo wa'eed mein wazeh bayan hua hai aur yahi tariqa wa'eed ke bare mein hamare nazdeek nihayat durust aur ehtiyat wala hai. Wallahu A'lam bis-sawab, aur qatil ka muqaddar Jahannam ban gaya. Chahe is ki wajah tauba ki adam-e-qabooliyat kaha jaye ya is ke mutabadil kisi nek amal ka mafqood hona khwah ba-qaul-e-jumhoor dusra nek amal najaat-dehanda na hone ki wajah se ho. Woh hamesha Jahannam mein na rahega balkeh yahan khulood se murad bahut der tak rehna hai jaisa ke mutawatir ahadith se sabit hai ke Jahannam mein se woh bhi nikal aayenge jin ke dilon mein raayi ke chhote se chhote daane ke barabar bhi imaan hoga. Upar jo ek hadith bayan hui hai ke mumkin hai Allah Ta'ala tamam gunahon ko bajuz kufr aur qatl-e-momin ke maaf farma de. Is mein "Asa" tarajji ka masla hai in dono suraton mein tarajji yani umeed go uth jaye phir bhi waqoo-pazeer hota yani aisa hona in dono mein se ek bhi mumkin nahin aur woh qatl hai, kyunke shirk-o-kufr ka maaf na hona to alfaaz-e-Quran se sabit ho chuka aur jo ahadith guzrin jin mein qatil ko maqtool le kar aayega woh bilkul theek hain chunke is mein insani haq hai woh tauba se tal nahin jata. Balkeh insani haq to tauba hone ki surat mein bhi haq-daar ko pahunchana zaroori hai is mein jis tarah qatl hai isi tarah chori hai, ghasb hai, tohmat hai aur dusre huqooq-e-insan hain jin ka tauba se maaf na hona ijma'an sabit hai balkeh tauba ke liye sehat ki shart hai ke in huqooq ko ada kare.

Aur jab adaigi muhaal hai toh Qayamat ke roz is ka mutalba zaroori hai. Lekin mutalba se saza ka waqay hona zaroori nahin. Mumkin hai ke qatil ke aur sab aamaal-e-saliha maqtool ko de diye jayen ya ba'az de diye jayen aur us ke paas phir bhi kuch reh jayen aur yeh bakhash diya jaye aur yeh bhi mumkin hai ke qatil ka mutalba Allah Ta'ala apne fazl-o-karam se apne paas se aur apni taraf se hoor-o-qasoor aur buland darajat-e-jannat de kar poora kar de aur is ke ewaz woh apne qatil se dargarzar karne par khush ho jaye aur qatil ko Allah Ta'ala bakhash de waghera. Wallahu A'lam. Jaan boojh kar maar daalne wale ke liye kuch toh dunyawi ahkaam hain aur kuch ukhrawi. Duniya mein toh Allah ne maqtool ke waliyon ko is par ghalba diya hai farmata hai (Aayat: Wa man qutila mazlooman faqad ja'alna liwaliyhi sultana, Al-Isra: 33), jo zulm se qatl kiya jaye hum ne is ke peeche walon ko ghalba diya hai ke unhein ikhtiyar hai ke ya toh woh badla lein yani qatil ko bhi qatl karayen ya maaf kar dein ya diyat yani khoon-e-baha yani jurmana wasool kar lein aur is ke jurmana mein sakhti hai jo teen qismon par mushtamil hai. Tees toh chauthe saal ki umar mein lage hue oont, tees paanchvein saal mein lage hue, chalees hamila oontniyan jaise ke kutub-e-ahkaam mein sabit hain, is mein aimma ne ikhtilaf kiya hai ke is par ghulam ka azaad karna ya do maah ke pay-dar-pay rozay rakhna ya khana khilana hai ya nahin? Pas Imam Shafi R.H aur un ke as-haab aur ulama ki ek jamaat toh is ki qail hai ke jab khata mein yeh hukm hai toh amdan mein bator-e-adna yahi hukm hona chahiye aur un par jawaban jhooti ghair-shar'i qasam ke kaffaray ko pesh kiya gaya hai aur unhon ne is ka uzr amdan chhod di hui namaz ko qaza qarar diya hai jaise ke is par ijma hai khata mein, Imam Ahmad R.H ke as-haab aur dusre kehte hain qatl-e-amdan na-qabil-e-kaffara hai. Is liye is yani kaffara nahin aur isi tarah jhooti qasam aur un ke liye in dono suraton mein aur amdan chhuti hui namaz mein farq karne ki koi raah nahin, is liye ke yeh log Hazrat Wasila bin Asqa R.A ke paas aaye aur kaha koi aisi hadith bhi hai jo Musnad-e-Ahmad mein marwi hai ke log Hazrat Wasila bin Asqa R.A ke paas aaye aur kaha koi aisi hadith sunao jis mein kami ziyadati na ho toh woh bohat naraz hue aur farmane lage kya tum Quran le kar padhte ho toh is mein kami ziyadati bhi karte ho? Unhon ne kaha Hazrat hamara matlab yeh hai ke khud Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se aap ne jo suni ho kaha hum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas apnon mein se ek aadmi ki babat hazir hue jis ne ba-wajah-e-qatl ke apne tayein jahannami bana liya tha. Toh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya is ki taraf se ek ghulam azaad karo is ke ek ek uzw ke badla is ka ek ek uzw Allah Ta'ala jahannam se azaad kar de ga.

Qatl-e-Muslim, Qisas-o-Diyat ke masail aur Qatl-e-Khata. Irshad hota hai ke kisi Musalman ko laiq nahin ke kisi haal mein apne Musalman bhai ka khoon-e-na-haq kare. Sahih mein hai Rasoolullah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Kisi Musalman ka jo Allah ki ek hone ki aur mere Rasool hone ki shahadat deta ho, khoon bahana halal nahin magar teen halaton mein: Ek toh yeh ke usne kisi ko qatl kar diya ho, dusre shadi shuda ho kar zina kiya ho, teesre deen-e-Islam ko chhod dene wala, jamaat se alaihida hone wala. Phir yeh bhi yaad rahe ke jab in teenon kamon mein se koi kaam kisi se waqay ho jaye toh riyaya mein se kisi ko uske qatl ka ikhtiyar nahin, albatta Imam ya naib-e-Imam ko ba-ohda-e-qaza ka haq hai. Iske baad istisna-e-munqata hai, Arab shairon ke kalam mein bhi is qisam ke istisna bahut se milte hain. Is ayat ki shaan-e-nuzool mein ek qaul toh yeh marwi hai ke Ayyash bin Abi Rabia jo Abu Jahl ka maa ki taraf se bhai tha, jis maa ka naam Asma bint Makhrama tha, uske bare mein utri hai. Usne ek shakhs ko qatl kar dala tha jise woh Islam lane ki wajah se sazayein de raha tha yahan tak ke uski jaan le li, unka naam Harith bin Zaid Aamiri tha. Hazrat Ayyash (R.A) ke dilon mein yeh kanta reh gaya aur unhone thaan li ke mauqa pa kar ise qatl kar dunga. Allah Ta'ala ne kuch dinon baad qatil ko bhi Islam ki hidayat di, woh Musalman ho gaye aur hijrat bhi kar li lekin Hazrat Ayyash (R.A) ko yeh maloom na tha. Fatah-e-Makkah wale din yeh unki nazar pade, yeh jaan kar ke yeh ab tak kufr par hain, un par achanak hamla kar diya aur qatl kar diya, is par yeh ayat utri. Dusra qaul yeh hai ke yeh ayat Hazrat Abu Darda (R.A) ke bare mein nazil hui hai jabke unhone ek shakhs kafir par hamla kiya, talwar sonthi hi thi toh usne kalma padh liya lekin unki talwar chal gayi aur use qatl kar dala. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ) se yeh waqaya bayan hua toh Hazrat Abu Darda (R.A) ne apna yeh uzr bayan kiya ke usne sirf jaan bachane ki gharz se yeh kalma padha tha, Aap (ﷺ) naraz ho kar farmane lage: Kya tumne uska dil cheer kar dekha tha? Yeh waqaya sahih hadith mein bhi hai lekin wahan naam dusre sahabi ka hai. Phir qatl-e-khata ka zikr ho raha hai ke is mein do cheezein wajib hain: Ek toh ghulam azad karna, dusre diyat dena. Is ghulam ke liye bhi shart hai ke woh imandar ho, kafir ko azad karna kafi na hoga, chhota nabaligh bacha bhi kafi na hoga jab tak ke woh apne irade se iman ka qasd karne wala aur itni umar ka na ho. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ka mukhtar qaul yeh hai ke agar uske maa baap dono Musalman hon toh jaiz hai warna nahin. Jamhoor ka mazhab yeh hai ke Musalman hona shart hai, chhote bade ki koi qaid nahin. Ek Ansari siyah-faam londi ko le kar hazir Huzoor (ﷺ) hote hain aur kehte hain ke mere zimme ek Musalman gardan ka azad karna hai, agar yeh Musalman ho toh main ise azad kar doon. Aap (ﷺ) ne us londi se pucha: Kya tu gawahi deti hai ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahin?

Us ne kaha haan, Aap ne farmaya is baat ki bhi gawahi deti hai ke main Allah ka Rasool hoon? Us ne kaha haan, farmaya kya marne ke baad jee uthne ki bhi toh qail hai? Us ne kaha haan, Aap ne farmaya ise azaad kar do. Is ki asnaad sahih hai aur sahabi kaun thay? Is ka makhfi rehna sanad mein muzir nahin, yeh riwayat hadith ki aur bahut si kitabon mein is tarah hai ke Aap ne us se poocha Allah kahan hai? Us ne kaha aasmanon mein, daryaft kiya main kaun hoon? Jawab diya Aap Rasool Allah (ﷺ) hain, Aap ne farmaya ise azaad kar do. Yeh imandar hai. Pas ek toh gardan azaad karna wajib hai, dusre khoon-baha dena jo maqtool ke ghar walon ko saunp diya jaye ga, yeh un ke maqtool ka ewaz hai. Yeh diyat sau oont hai paanch sau qismon ke, bees toh dusre saal ki umar ki oontniyan aur bees isi umar ke oont aur bees teesre saal mein lagi hui oontniyan aur bees paanchwein saal mein lagi hui aur bees chauthe saal mein lagi hui. Yehi faisla qatl-e-khata ke khoon-baha ka Rasool (ﷺ) ne kiya hai, mulahiza ho Sunan-o-Musnad-e-Ahmad. Yeh hadith barwayat Hazrat Abdullah mauqoof bhi marwi hai, Hazrat Ali (R.A) aur ek jamaat se bhi yehi manqool hai aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke diyat chaar chauthaiyon mein banti hui hai. Yeh khoon-baha qatil ke aaqila aur us ke asba yani warison ke baad ke qareebi rishtedaron par hai, us ke apne maal par nahin. Imam Shafi (R.H) farmate hain mere khayal mein is amr mein koi bhi mukhalif nahin ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne diyat ka faisla inhi logon par kiya hai aur yeh hadith khasa mein kasrat se mazkoor hai. Imam sahab jin ahadith ki taraf ishara karte hain woh bahut si hain, Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) se marwi hai ke Huzail qabeela ki do auratein aapas mein ladeen, ek ne dusre ko patthar mara woh hamila thi, bacha bhi zaya ho gaya aur woh bhi mar gayi. Qissa An-Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ) ke paas aaya toh Aap ne yeh faisla kiya ke woh is bacha ke ewaz toh ek londi ya ghulam de aur aurat maqtoolah ke badle diyat qatilah aurat ke haqeeqi warison ke baad ke rishtedaron ke zimme hai. Is se yeh bhi maloom hua ke jo qatl-e-amd khata se ho woh bhi hukm mein khata-e-mehaz ke hai.

Ya'ni diyat ke aitbar se haan is mein taqseem-e-suls par hogi teen hissay honge kyunke is mein shabahat-e-amd ya'ni bil-qasd bhi hai, Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Banu Jazima ki jang ke liye Hazrat Khalid bin Walid (R.A) ko Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek lashkar par sardar bana kar bheja unhon ne ja kar unhein dawat-e-Islam di unhon ne dawat to qabool kar li lekin ba-wajah la-ilmi bajaye aslamna ya'ni hum musalman huye ke "sabana" kaha ya'ni hum be-deen huye, Hazrat Khalid bin Walid (R.A) ne unhein qatl karna shuru kar diya jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh khabar pahunchi to Aap ne haath utha kar janab-e-bari mein arz ki ya Allah Khalid ke is fe'l mein apni bezari aur barat tere samne zahir karta hoon, phir Hazrat Ali (R.A) ko bula kar unhein bheja ke jao un ke maqtoolon ki diyat chukao aur jo un ka maali nuqsan hua ho usay bhi kori kori chukao, is se sabit hua ke Imam ya naib-e-Imam ki khata ka bojh Bait-ul-Maal par hoga. Phir farmaya hai ke khoon-baha jo wajib hai agar auliya-e-maqtool az-khud is se dast-bardar ho jayen to unhein ikhtiyar hai woh bator-e-sadqa ke usay maaf kar sakte hain. Phir farman hai ke agar maqtool musalman ho lekin us ke auliya harbi kafir hon to qatil par diyat nahin, qatil par is soorat mein sirf azadgi-e-gardan hai aur agar us ke wali waris us qoum mein se hon jin se tumhari sulh aur ahd-o-paiman hai to diyat deni paregi agar maqtool momin tha to kamil khoon-baha aur agar maqtool kafir tha to ba'z ke nazdeek to poori diyat hai ba'z ke nazdeek adhi ba'z ke nazdeek tihai, tafseel kutub-e-ahkam mein mulahiza ho aur qatil par momin banday ko azad karna bhi lazim hai agar kisi ko is ki taqat ba-wajah muflisi ke na ho to us ke zimme do mahine ke rozay hain jo lagatar pay-dar-pay rakhne honge agar kisi shar'i uzr maslan bimari ya haiz ya nifas ke baghair koi roza beech mein se chhor diya to phir naye siray se rozay shuru karne parenge, safar ke bare mein do qaul hain ek to yeh ke yeh bhi shar'i uzr hai dusre yeh ke yeh uzr nahin. Phir farmata hai qatl-e-khata ki tauba ki yeh soorat hai ke ghulam azad nahin kar sakta to rozay rakh le aur jisay rozon ki bhi taqat na ho woh maskeenon ko khila sakta hai ya nahin? To ek qaul to yeh hai ke sath maskeenon ko khila de jaise ke zihar ke kaffaray mein hai, wahan saaf bayan farma diya yahan is liye bayan nahin kiya gaya ke yeh daranay aur khauf dilanay ka maqam hai asani ki soorat agar bayan kar di jati to haibat-o-azmat itni baqi na rehti, dusra qaul yeh hai ke rozay ke neeche kuch nahin agar hota to bayan ke sath hi bayan kar diya jata, haajib ke waqt se bayan ko mu'akhar karna theek nahin (yeh bazahir qaul-e-sani hi sahih maloom hota hai wallahu a'lam. Mutarjim) Allah Aleem-o-Hakeem hai, is ki tafseer kayi martaba guzar chuki hai.

Qatl-e-Amadan aur Qatl-e-Muslim. Qatl-e-Khata ke baad ab Qatl-e-Amadan ka bayan ho raha hai, is ki sakhti, burai aur intehai takeed wali darauni wa'eed farmayi ja rahi hai. Yeh woh gunah hai jise Allah Ta'ala ne shirk ke sath mila diya hai. Farmata hai: (Wa-alladhina la yad'una ma'allahi ilahan akhara wala yaqtulunan-nafsa allati harramallahu illabil-haqqi wala yaznun. Wa-may-yaf'al dhalika yalqa athama) (Surah Al-Furqan: 68). Ya'ni musalman bande woh hain jo Allah ke sath kisi aur ko mabood thahra kar nahin pukarte aur na woh kisi shakhs ko nahaq qatl karte hain. Dusri jagah farman hai: (Qul ta'alau atlu ma harrama rabbukum 'alaikum alla tushriku bihi shay'an wabil-walidayni ihsana. Wala taqtulu auladakum min imlaq) (Surah Al-An'am: 151). Yahan bhi Allah ke haram kiye huye kamon ka zikr karte hain, shirk ka aur qatl ka zikr farmaya hai aur bhi is mazmoon ki ayatein bahut si hain aur hadith bhi is baab mein bahut si manqool hui hain. Bukhari Muslim mein hai ke sab se pehle khoon ka faisla Qayamat ke din hoga. Abu Dawood mein hai imandar nekiyon aur bhalaiyon mein barhta rehta hai jab tak ke khoon-e-nahaq na kare, agar aisa kar liya to tabah ho jata hai. Dusri hadith mein hai sari duniya ka zawal Allah ke nazdeek ek musalman ke qatl se kam darje ka hai. Aur hadith mein hai agar tamam ruye zameen ke aur aasman ke log kisi ek musalman ke qatl mein shareek hon to Allah sab ko oundhe munh jahannam mein daal de. Aur hadith mein hai jis shakhs ne kisi musalman ke qatl mein aadhe kalme se bhi iaanat ki, woh Qayamat ke din Allah ke samne is halat mein aayega, us ki peshani mein likha hoga ke yeh shakhs Allah ki rahmat se mehroom hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka to qaul hai ke jis ne momin ko qasdan qatl kiya us ki tauba qabool hi nahin. Ahl-e-Kufa jab is masle mein ikhtilaf karte hain to Ibn-e-Jubair Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ke paas aakar daryaft karte hain, aap farmate hain yeh aakhri aayat hai jise kisi aayat ne mansookh nahin kiya, aur aap farmate hain ke dusri (Wa-alladhina la yad'una ma'allahi ilahan akhara wala yaqtulunan-nafsa allati harramallahu illabil-haqqi wala yaznun. Wa-may-yaf'al dhalika yalqa athama) (Surah Al-Furqan: 68).

(Al-Furqan: 68) jis mein toh yeh zikr hai ke woh ahl-e-shirk ke baare mein nazil hui hai, pas jabke kisi shakhs ne Islam ki halat mein kisi musalman ko ghair-e-shar'i wajah se qatl kiya uski saza Jahannam hai aur uski tauba qabool nahin hogi, Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) se jab yeh qaul-e-Abbas bayan hua toh farmane lage magar jo nadim ho, Salim bin Abu al-Ja'd farmate hain, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) jab nabina ho gaye the ek martaba hum unke paas baithe hue the jo ek shakhs aaya aur aap ko aawaz de kar poocha ke uske baare mein aap kya farmate hain jisne kisi momin ko jaan boojh kar maar dala? Aap ne farmaya uski saza Jahannam hai jis mein woh hamesha rahega, Allah ka us par ghazab hai, us par Allah ki la'nat hai aur uske liye azab-e-azim taiyar hai, usne phir poocha agar woh tauba kare, nek amal kare aur hidayat par jam jaye toh? Farmane lage uski maa use roye, use tauba aur hidayat kahan? Uski qasam jiske hath mein mera nafs hai, maine tumhare Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai, uski maa use roye, jisne momin ko jaan boojh kar maar dala hai woh Qayamat ke din use dayen ya bayen hath se thame hue Rahman ke Arsh ke samne aayega, uski ragon se khoon beh raha hoga aur Allah se kahega ke aye Allah is se pooch ke isne mujhe kyun qatl kiya? Us Allah-e-Azim ki qasam jiske hath mein Abdullah ki jaan hai ke is aayat ke nazil hone ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki wafat tak ise mansookh karne wali koi aayat nahin utri, aur riwayat mein itna aur bhi hai ke na Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke baad koi wahi utregi. Hazrat Zaid bin Thabit (R.A), Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A), Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A), Hazrat Abu Salamah bin Abdur-Rahman (R.H), Ubaid bin Umair (R.H), Hasan (R.H), Qatadah (R.H), Zahhak (R.H) bhi Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ke khayal ke sath hain. Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai ke maqtool apne qatil ko pakar kar Qayamat ke din Allah ke samne layega, dusre hath se apna sar uthaye hue hoga aur kahega mere Rabb is se pooch ke isne mujhe kyun qatl kiya? Qatil kahega Parwardigar isliye ke teri izzat ho, Allah farmayega pas yeh meri rah mein hai. Dusra maqtool bhi apne qatil ko pakre hue layega aur yahi kahega, qatil jawaban kahega isliye ke falan ki izzat ho, Allah farmayega qatil ka gunah usne apne sar le liya, phir use aag mein jhonk diya jayega jis garhay mein sattar saal tak toh neeche chala jayega. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai mumkin hai Allah Ta'ala tamam gunah bakhsh de, lekin ek toh woh shakhs jo kufr ki halat mein mara, dusra woh jo kisi momin ka qasdan qatil bana. Ibn-e-Marduyah mein bhi aisi hi hadith hai aur woh bilkul ghareeb hai, mehfooz woh hadith hai jo bahawala-e-Musnad bayan hui. Ibn-e-Marduyah mein aur hadith hai ke jaan boojh kar imandar ko maar dalne wala kafir hai. Yeh hadith munkar hai aur iski asnad mein bahut kalam hai.

Humaid kehte hain mere paas Abul Aliyah aaye, mere dost bhi us waqt mere paas the. Hum se kehne lage tum dono kam umr aur zyada yaaddasht wale ho, aao mere saath Bishr bin Aasim ke paas chalo. Jab wahan pahunche toh Bishr se farmaya inhe bhi woh hadith suna do. Unhone sunani shuru ki ke Utbah bin Malik Laithi ne kaha Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek chhota sa lashkar bheja tha, usne ek qoum par chapa mara, woh log bhaag khade hue. Unke saath ek shakhs bhaga ja raha tha, uske peeche ek lashkari bhaga, jab uske qareeb nangi talwar liye hue pahunch gaya toh usne kaha main toh musalman hoon. Usne kuch khayal na kiya, talwar chala di. Is waqiye ki khabar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hui toh aap bahut naraz hue aur sakht sust kaha. Yeh khabar us shakhs ko bhi pahunchi. Ek roz Rasool-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khutba padh rahe the ke us qatil ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Allah ki qasam usne toh yeh baat mehez qatl se bachne ke liye kahi thi. Aap ne uski taraf se nigah pher li aur khutba sunate rahe. Usne dobara kaha, aap ne phir munh mod liya, usse sabr na ho saka, teesri bari kaha toh aap ne uski taraf tawajjah ki aur narazgi aap ke chehre se tapak rahi thi, farmane lage momin ke qatil ki koi bhi ma'zarat qabool karne se Allah Ta'ala inkar karte hain, teen baar yahi farmaya. Yeh riwayat Nasai mein bhi hai. Pas ek mazhab toh yeh hua ke qatil-e-momin ki tauba nahin, dusra mazhab yeh hai ke tauba uske aur Allah ke darmiyan hai. Jamhoor-e-Salaf-o-Khalaf ka yahi mazhab hai ke agar usne tauba ki, Allah ki taraf ruju kiya, khushoo-o-khuzoo mein laga raha, nek aamal karne lag gaya toh Allah uski tauba qabool kar lega aur maqtool ko apne paas se ewaz de kar use raazi kar lega. Allah farmata hai (اِلَّا مَنْ تَابَ وَاٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًـا فَاُولٰۗىِٕكَ يَدْخُلُوْنَ الْجَــنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُوْنَ شَـيْــــــًٔا) (Surah Maryam: 60). Yeh khabar aur khabar mein naskh ka ehtemal nahin aur is aayat ko mushrikon ke bare mein aur is aayat ko mominon ke bare mein khaas karna bazahir khilaf-e-qiyas hai aur kisi saaf daleel ka mohtaj hai, Wallahu A'lam. Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai (قُلْ يٰعِبَادِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اَسْرَفُوْا عَلٰٓي اَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوْا مِنْ رَّحْمَةِ اللّٰهِ ۭ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ جَمِيْعًا ۭ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ) (Surah Az-Zumar: 53). Aye mere woh bando jinhone apni janon par ziyadati ki hai tum meri rahmat se mayoos na ho. Yeh aayat apne umoom ke aitbar se har gunah par muheet hai, khwah kufr-o-shirk ho, khwah shak-o-nifaq ho, khwah qatl-o-fisq ho, khwah kuch hi ho, jo Allah ki taraf ruju kare Allah uski taraf mail hoga, jo tauba kare Allah use maaf farmaye ga. Farmata hai (اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ جَمِيْعًا ۭ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ) (Surah Az-Zumar: 53). Allah Ta'ala shirk ko bakhshta nahin, uske siwa ke tamam gunah jise chahe bakhsh de.

Allah Ta'ala ki karimi ke sadqe jaiye ke us ne isi Surah mein is aayat se pehle bhi jis ki tafsir ab hum kar rahe hain apni aam bakhshish ki aayat bayan farmayi aur phir is aayat ke baad hi ise dohra diya isi tarah apni aam bakhshish ka elaan phir kiya taake bandon ko us ki kaamil fitrat se kaamil umeed bandh jaye. Wallahu A'lam. Bukhari Muslim ki woh hadith bhi is mauqa par yaad rakhne ke qabil hai jis mein hai ke ek Bani Israeli ne ek sau qatl kiye thay. Phir ek aalim se poochta hai ke kya meri tauba qabool ho sakti hai? Woh jawab deta hai ke tujh mein aur teri tauba mein kaun hai jo haail hai? Jao is bad-basti ko chhor kar nekon ke shehar mein baso. Chunancha us ne hijrat ki magar raaste mein hi faut ho gaya aur Rahmat ke farishte use le gaye. Yeh hadith poori poori kayi martaba ho chuki hai jabke Bani Israel mein yeh hai to is Ummat-e-Marhooma ke liye qatil ki tauba ke liye darwaze band kyun hon? Hum par to pehle bahut zyada pabandiyan thin jin sab se Allah ne hamein azaad kar diya aur Rahmatul-lil-Aalameen jaise sardar-e-ambiya ko bhej kar woh deen hamein diya jo aasaniyon aur rahaton wala seedha saaf aur wazeh hai, lekin yahan jo saza qatil ki bayan farmayi hai is se murad yeh hai ke is ki saza yeh hai ke use saza zaroor di jaye. Chunancha Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) aur salaf ki ek jamaat bhi yahi farmati hai, balkeh is ma'ani ki ek hadith bhi Ibn Marduyah mein hai lekin sanadan woh sahih nahin aur isi tarah har wa'eed ka matlab yahi hai ke agar koi amal-e-saleh waghera is ke muqabil mein nahin to is badi ka badla woh hai jo wa'eed mein wazeh bayan hua hai aur yahi tariqa wa'eed ke bare mein hamare nazdeek nihayat durust aur ehtiyat wala hai. Wallahu A'lam bis-sawab, aur qatil ka muqaddar Jahannam ban gaya. Chahe is ki wajah tauba ki adam-e-qabooliyat kaha jaye ya is ke mutabadil kisi nek amal ka mafqood hona khwah ba-qaul-e-jumhoor dusra nek amal najaat-dehanda na hone ki wajah se ho. Woh hamesha Jahannam mein na rahega balkeh yahan khulood se murad bahut der tak rehna hai jaisa ke mutawatir ahadith se sabit hai ke Jahannam mein se woh bhi nikal aayenge jin ke dilon mein raayi ke chhote se chhote daane ke barabar bhi imaan hoga. Upar jo ek hadith bayan hui hai ke mumkin hai Allah Ta'ala tamam gunahon ko bajuz kufr aur qatl-e-momin ke maaf farma de. Is mein "Asa" tarajji ka masla hai in dono suraton mein tarajji yani umeed go uth jaye phir bhi waqoo-pazeer hota yani aisa hona in dono mein se ek bhi mumkin nahin aur woh qatl hai, kyunke shirk-o-kufr ka maaf na hona to alfaaz-e-Quran se sabit ho chuka aur jo ahadith guzrin jin mein qatil ko maqtool le kar aayega woh bilkul theek hain chunke is mein insani haq hai woh tauba se tal nahin jata. Balkeh insani haq to tauba hone ki surat mein bhi haq-daar ko pahunchana zaroori hai is mein jis tarah qatl hai isi tarah chori hai, ghasb hai, tohmat hai aur dusre huqooq-e-insan hain jin ka tauba se maaf na hona ijma'an sabit hai balkeh tauba ke liye sehat ki shart hai ke in huqooq ko ada kare.

Aur jab adaigi muhaal hai toh Qayamat ke roz is ka mutalba zaroori hai. Lekin mutalba se saza ka waqay hona zaroori nahin. Mumkin hai ke qatil ke aur sab aamaal-e-saliha maqtool ko de diye jayen ya ba'az de diye jayen aur us ke paas phir bhi kuch reh jayen aur yeh bakhash diya jaye aur yeh bhi mumkin hai ke qatil ka mutalba Allah Ta'ala apne fazl-o-karam se apne paas se aur apni taraf se hoor-o-qasoor aur buland darajat-e-jannat de kar poora kar de aur is ke ewaz woh apne qatil se dargarzar karne par khush ho jaye aur qatil ko Allah Ta'ala bakhash de waghera. Wallahu A'lam. Jaan boojh kar maar daalne wale ke liye kuch toh dunyawi ahkaam hain aur kuch ukhrawi. Duniya mein toh Allah ne maqtool ke waliyon ko is par ghalba diya hai farmata hai (Aayat: Wa man qutila mazlooman faqad ja'alna liwaliyhi sultana, Al-Isra: 33), jo zulm se qatl kiya jaye hum ne is ke peeche walon ko ghalba diya hai ke unhein ikhtiyar hai ke ya toh woh badla lein yani qatil ko bhi qatl karayen ya maaf kar dein ya diyat yani khoon-e-baha yani jurmana wasool kar lein aur is ke jurmana mein sakhti hai jo teen qismon par mushtamil hai. Tees toh chauthe saal ki umar mein lage hue oont, tees paanchvein saal mein lage hue, chalees hamila oontniyan jaise ke kutub-e-ahkaam mein sabit hain, is mein aimma ne ikhtilaf kiya hai ke is par ghulam ka azaad karna ya do maah ke pay-dar-pay rozay rakhna ya khana khilana hai ya nahin? Pas Imam Shafi R.H aur un ke as-haab aur ulama ki ek jamaat toh is ki qail hai ke jab khata mein yeh hukm hai toh amdan mein bator-e-adna yahi hukm hona chahiye aur un par jawaban jhooti ghair-shar'i qasam ke kaffaray ko pesh kiya gaya hai aur unhon ne is ka uzr amdan chhod di hui namaz ko qaza qarar diya hai jaise ke is par ijma hai khata mein, Imam Ahmad R.H ke as-haab aur dusre kehte hain qatl-e-amdan na-qabil-e-kaffara hai. Is liye is yani kaffara nahin aur isi tarah jhooti qasam aur un ke liye in dono suraton mein aur amdan chhuti hui namaz mein farq karne ki koi raah nahin, is liye ke yeh log Hazrat Wasila bin Asqa R.A ke paas aaye aur kaha koi aisi hadith bhi hai jo Musnad-e-Ahmad mein marwi hai ke log Hazrat Wasila bin Asqa R.A ke paas aaye aur kaha koi aisi hadith sunao jis mein kami ziyadati na ho toh woh bohat naraz hue aur farmane lage kya tum Quran le kar padhte ho toh is mein kami ziyadati bhi karte ho? Unhon ne kaha Hazrat hamara matlab yeh hai ke khud Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se aap ne jo suni ho kaha hum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas apnon mein se ek aadmi ki babat hazir hue jis ne ba-wajah-e-qatl ke apne tayein jahannami bana liya tha. Toh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya is ki taraf se ek ghulam azaad karo is ke ek ek uzw ke badla is ka ek ek uzw Allah Ta'ala jahannam se azaad kar de ga.

Musalman ke hathon musalman ka qatl na-qabil-e-muafi jurm hai. Tirmidhi waghera ki ek hadith mein hai ke Banu Sulaim ka ek shakhs bakriyan charata hua Sahaba ki ek jamaat ke paas se guzra aur salam kiya, toh Sahaba aapas mein kehne lage yeh musalman toh hai nahin, sirf apni jaan bachane ke liye salam karta hai. Chunancha use qatl kar diya aur bakriyan le kar chale aaye, is par yeh aayat utri. Yeh hadith toh sahih hai lekin baaz ne is mein illatein nikali hain ke Simak rawi ke siwaye is tariqe ka aur koi makhraj hi is ka nahin, aur yeh ke Ikrimah se is ke riwayat karne ke bhi qail hain, aur yeh ke is aayat ke shaan-e-nuzool mein aur waqiat bhi marwi hain. Baaz kehte hain Muhallim bin Jathama ke bare mein utri hai, baaz kehte hain Usama bin Zaid ke bare mein nazil hui hai aur is ke ilawa bhi aqwal hain, lekin mere khayal mein yeh sab na-qabil-e-tasleem hai. Simak se ise bahut se aimma-e-kibar ne riwayat kiya hai, Ikrimah se sahih daleel li gayi hai, yahi riwayat dusre tariq se Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas se Sahih Bukhari mein marwi hai, Saeed bin Mansoor mein yahi marwi hai. Ibn-e-Jarir aur Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke ek shakhs ko us ke walid aur us ki qoum ne apne islam ki khabar pahunchane ke liye Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein bheja, raste mein use Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke bheje hue ek lashkar se raat ke waqt mulaqat hui, us ne un se kaha ke main musalman hoon lekin unhein yaqeen na aaya aur use dushman samajh kar qatl kar dala. Un ke walid ko jab yeh ilm hua toh yeh khud Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hue aur waqia bayan kiya, chunancha aap ne unhein ek hazar dinar diye aur diyat di aur unhein izzat ke sath rukhsat kiya, is par yeh aayat utri. Muhallim bin Jathama ka waqia yeh hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apna ek chota sa lashkar Akhsam ki taraf bheja, jab yeh lashkar Batn-e-Akhsam mein pahuncha toh Aamir bin Adbat Ashja'i apni sawari par sawar ma' asbab ke aa rahe the, paas pahunch kar salam kiya, sab toh ruk gaye lekin Muhallim bin Jathama ne aapas ki purani adawat ki bina par is par jhapat kar hamla kar diya, unhein qatl kar dala aur un ka asbab qabze mein kar liya, phir hum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas pahunche aur aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne yeh waqia bayan kiya, is par yeh aayat utri. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Aamir ne islami tariqe ke mutabiq salam kiya tha lekin jahiliyat ki pehli adawat ke ba'is Muhallim ne use teer maar kar maar dala. Yeh khabar pa kar Aamir ke logon se Muhallim bin Jathama ne musalehana guftagu ki lekin Uyaina ne kaha nahin nahin Allah ki qasam jab tak is ki aurton par bhi wahi musibat na aaye jo meri aurton par aayi. Chunancha Muhallim apni dono chadrein odhe hue aaye aur Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne baith gaye is umeed par ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) un ke liye istighfar karein, lekin aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah tujhe maaf na kare. Yeh yahan se sakht nadim sharmsar rote hue uthe, apni chadron se apne aansu ponchte jate the, saat roz bhi na guzarne paye the ke inteqal kar gaye.

Logon ne unhein dafan kiya lekin zameen ne unki na'ash ugal di, Huzoor ﷺ se jab yeh zikr hua toh Aap ﷺ ne farmaya tumhare is saathi se nihayat badtar logon ko zameen sambhal leti hai lekin Allah Ta'ala ka irada hai ke woh tumhein Musalman ki hurmat dikhaye chunancha unke lashay ko pahar par daal diya gaya aur upar se patthar rakh diye gaye aur yeh aayat nazil hui (Ibn-e-Jarir). Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein ta'aliqan marwi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Miqdad (R.A) se farmaya jabke unhon ne qoum-e-kuffar ke saath jo Musalman makhfi imaan wala tha use qatl kar diya tha bawajood-e-ke usne apne salam ka izhar kar diya tha ke tum bhi Makkah mein isi tarah imaan chupaye hue thay. Bazzar mein yeh waqia poora is tarah marwi hai ke Rasool ﷺ ne ek chota sa lashkar bheja tha jismein Hazrat Miqdad (R.A) bhi thay jab dushmanon ke paas pohanche toh dekha ke sab toh idhar udhar ho gaye hain ek shakhs maldar wahan reh gaya hai usne unhein dekhte hi Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah kaha. Taham unhon ne hamla kar diya aur use qatl kar dala, ek shakhs jisne yeh waqia dekha tha woh sakht barham hua aur kehne laga Miqdad (R.A) ne use qatl kar dala jisne kalma parha tha? Main iska zikr Huzoor ﷺ se karunga, jab yeh lashkar wapas pohancha toh us shakhs ne yeh waqia Huzoor ﷺ se arz kiya Aap ﷺ ne Hazrat Miqdad (R.A) ko bulwaya aur farmaya tumne yeh kya kiya? Kal Qayamat ke din tum La ilaha illallah ke samne kya jawab doge? Pas Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayat utari aur Aap ﷺ ne farmaya ke ae Miqdad (R.A) woh shakhs Musalman tha jis tarah tu Makkah mein apne imaan ko makhfi rakhta tha phir tune uske Islam zahir karne ke bawajood use mara? Iske baad Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke jis ghanimat ke lalach mein tum ghaflat baratte ho aur salam karne walon ke imaan mein shak-o-shuba karke unhein qatl kar daalte ho yaad rakho woh ghanimat Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se hai uske paas bahut si ghanimatein hain jo woh tumhein halal zaraye se dega aur woh tumhare liye is maal se bahut behtar hongi. Tum bhi apna woh waqt yaad karo ke tum bhi aise hi lachar thay apne zu'f aur apni kamzori ki wajah se imaan zahir karne ki jurrat nahin kar sakte thay qoum mein chhupe lage phirte thay aaj Allah Khaliq-e-Kul ne tum par ehsan kiya tumhein quwwat di aur tum khule bandon apne Islam ka izhar kar rahe ho, toh jo be-asbab ab tak dushmanon ke panje mein phanse hue hain aur imaan ka elaan khule taur par nahin kar sake jab woh apna imaan zahir karein tumhein tasleem kar lena chahiye aur aayat mein hai (Wazkuru iz antum qalilum mustad'afuna fil-ardi takhafuna ay yatakhattafakumun-nasu fa-awakum wa ayyadakum binasrihi wa razaqakum minat-tayyibati la'allakum tashkurun) (Surah Al-Anfal: 26) yaad karo jabke tum kam thay kamzor thay.

Al-gharz irshad hota hai ke jis tarah yeh bakri ka charwaha apna iman chupaye hue tha isi tarah is se pehle jabke besaro-samani aur qillat ki halat mein tum mushrikon ke darmiyan the iman chupaye phirte the, yeh matlab bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke tum bhi pehle Islam wale na the Allah ne tum par ehsan kiya aur tumhein Islam naseeb farmaya, Hazrat Usama (R.A) ne qasam khayi thi ke is ke baad bhi kisi La ilaha illallah kehne wale ko qatl na karunga kyunke unhein bhi is bare mein poori sarzanish hui thi. Phir takeedan dobara farmaya ke bakhoobi tehqeeq kar liya karo, phir dhamki di jati hai ke Allah Jalla Shanuhu ko apne aamal se ghafil na samjho, jo tum kar rahe, woh sab ki poori tarah khabar rakhta hai.

Mujahid aur awam mein farq: Sahih Bukhari mein hai ke jab is ayat ke ibtidai alfaz utre ke gharon mein baith rehne wale jihad karne wale momin barabar nahin, toh Aap (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Zaid (R.A) ko bulwa kar likhwa rahe the us waqt Hazrat Ibn-e-Um-e-Maktum (R.A) nabina aaye aur kehne lage Huzoor (ﷺ) main toh nabina hoon mazoor hoon, is par alfaz "Ghair-e-Ulid-Darar" nazil hue yani woh baith rehne wale jo be-uzr hon unka zikr hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Zaid (R.A) apne sath qalam, dawat aur shana le kar aaye the aur hadith mein hai ke Ibn-e-Um-e-Maktum (R.A) ne farmaya tha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) agar mujh mein taqat hoti toh main zaroor jihad mein shamil hota, is par woh ayat utri, us waqt Huzoor (ﷺ) ki ran Hazrat Zaid (R.A) ki ran par thi, un par is qadar bojh pada qareeb tha ke ran toot jaye. Woh hadith mein hai ke jis waqt in ayaton ki wahi utri aur uske baad tamaniyat Aap (ﷺ) par nazil hui main Aap (ﷺ) ke pehlu mein tha, Allah ki qasam mujh par Rasool (ﷺ) ki ran ka aisa bojh pada ke main ne is se zyada bojhal cheez zindagi bhar koi nahin uthai, phir wahi hat jane ke baad Aap (ﷺ) ne "Azima" tak ayat likhwai aur main ne ise shane ki haddi par likh liya aur hadith mein yeh alfaz bhi hain ke abhi toh Ibn-e-Um-e-Maktum (R.A) ke alfaz khatam bhi na hue the jo Aap (ﷺ) par wahi nazil hona shuru hui, Hazrat Zaid (R.A) farmate hain woh manzar ab tak meri nigahon ke samne hai goya main dekh raha hoon ke baad mein utre hue alfaz ko main ne unki jagah par apni tahrir mein baad mein badhaya hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain murad Badr ki ladai mein jane wale aur us mein hazir na hone wale hain, Ghazwa-e-Badr ke mauqa par Hazrat Abdullah bin Jahsh (R.A) aur Hazrat Abdullah bin Um-e-Maktum (R.A) aa kar Huzoor (ﷺ) se kehne lage hum dono nabina hain kya hamein rukhsat hai? Toh unhein ayat-e-Qurani mein rukhsat di gayi, pas mujahideen ko jis qisam ke baith rehne walon par fazilat di gayi hai woh woh hain jo sehat-o-tandurusti wale hon, pas pehle toh mujahideen ko baith rehne walon par mutlaqan fazilat thi lekin isi wahi mein jo alfaz utre us ne un logon ko jinhein mubah uzr hon aam baith rehne walon se mustasna kar diya jaise andhe, langde, loole aur bimar, yeh mujahideen ke darje mein hain.

Phir Mujahideen ki jo fazilat bayan hui hai woh un logon par bhi hai jo be-wajah Jihad mein shamil na hue hon, jaise ke Ibn-e-Abbas ki tafsir guzri aur yeh hona bhi chahiye. Bukhari mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Madina mein aise log bhi hain ke tum jis Jihad ke liye safar karo aur jis jungle mein kuch karo woh tumhare sath ajar mein yaksan hain, Sahaba ne kaha bawajood-e-ke woh Madine mein muqeem hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya is liye ke unhein uzr ne rok rakha hai aur riwayat mein hai ke tum jo kharch karte ho us ka sawab bhi jo tumhein milta hai unhein bhi milta hai. Isi matlab ko ek shayar ne in alfaaz mein yara halain ilal baitil ateeq laqad sartum jasman wa sarna nahnu arwahan inna aqamna ala uzrin wa man qadara wa man aqama ala uzrin faqad raha. Yani ae Allah ke ghar ke Hajj ko jaane walo! Agar tum apne jismon samet is taraf chal rahe ho lekin hum bhi apni roohani raush se isi taraf lapke ja rahe hain, suno hamari jismani kamzori aur uzr ne humein rok rakha hai aur zahir hai ke uzr se ruk jaane wala kuch jaane wale se kam nahin. Phir farmaya hai har ek se Allah Ta'ala ka wada Jannat ka aur bahut bade ajar ka hai, is se yeh bhi maloom hua ke Jihad farz-e-ain nahin balkay farz-e-kifaya hai. Phir irshad hai, Mujahideen ko ghair Mujahideen par badi fazilat hai. Phir un ke buland darajat un ke gunahon ki maafi aur un par jo barkat-o-rahmat hai us ka bayan farmaya aur apni aam bakhshish aur aam raham ki khabar di. Bukhari Muslim mein hai Jannat mein sau darje hain jinhein Allah Ta'ala ne rah-e-Jihad ke Mujahideen ke liye tayyar kiya hai har do darjon mein is qadar fasla hai jitna aasman-o-zameen mein, aur hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs Allah ki rah mein teer chalaye usay Jannat ka darja milta hai ek shakhs ne poocha darja kya hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya woh tumhare yahan ke gharon ke bala khanon jitna nahin balkay do darjon mein sau saal ka fasla hai.

Mujahid aur awam mein farq: Sahih Bukhari mein hai ke jab is ayat ke ibtidai alfaz utre ke gharon mein baith rehne wale jihad karne wale momin barabar nahin, toh Aap (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Zaid (R.A) ko bulwa kar likhwa rahe the us waqt Hazrat Ibn-e-Um-e-Maktum (R.A) nabina aaye aur kehne lage Huzoor (ﷺ) main toh nabina hoon mazoor hoon, is par alfaz "Ghair-e-Ulid-Darar" nazil hue yani woh baith rehne wale jo be-uzr hon unka zikr hai. Woh hadith mein hai ke jis waqt in ayaton ki wahi utri aur uske baad tamaniyat Aap (ﷺ) par nazil hui main Aap (ﷺ) ke pehlu mein tha, Allah ki qasam mujh par Rasool (ﷺ) ki ran ka aisa bojh pada ke main ne is se zyada bojhal cheez zindagi bhar koi nahin uthai, phir wahi hat jane ke baad Aap (ﷺ) ne "Azima" tak ayat likhwai aur main ne ise shane ki haddi par likh liya aur hadith mein yeh alfaz bhi hain ke abhi toh Ibn-e-Um-e-Maktum (R.A) ke alfaz khatam bhi na hue the jo Aap (ﷺ) par wahi nazil hona shuru hui, Hazrat Zaid (R.A) farmate hain woh manzar ab tak meri nigahon ke samne hai goya main dekh raha hoon ke baad mein utre hue alfaz ko main ne unki jagah par apni tahrir mein baad mein badhaya hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain murad Badr ki ladai mein jane wale aur us mein hazir na hone wale hain, Ghazwa-e-Badr ke mauqa par Hazrat Abdullah bin Jahsh (R.A) aur Hazrat Abdullah bin Um-e-Maktum (R.A) aa kar Huzoor (ﷺ) se kehne lage hum dono nabina hain kya hamein rukhsat hai? Toh unhein ayat-e-Qurani mein rukhsat di gayi, pas mujahideen ko jis qisam ke baith rehne walon par fazilat di gayi hai woh woh hain jo sehat-o-tandurusti wale hon, pas pehle toh mujahideen ko baith rehne walon par mutlaqan fazilat thi lekin isi wahi mein jo alfaz utre us ne un logon ko jinhein mubah uzr hon aam baith rehne walon se mustasna kar diya jaise andhe, langde, loole aur bimar, yeh mujahideen ke darje mein hain.

Phir Mujahideen ki jo fazilat bayan hui hai woh un logon par bhi hai jo be-wajah Jihad mein shamil na hue hon, jaise ke Ibn-e-Abbas ki tafsir guzri aur yeh hona bhi chahiye. Bukhari mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Madina mein aise log bhi hain ke tum jis Jihad ke liye safar karo aur jis jungle mein kuch karo woh tumhare sath ajar mein yaksan hain, Sahaba ne kaha bawajood-e-ke woh Madine mein muqeem hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya is liye ke unhein uzr ne rok rakha hai aur riwayat mein hai ke tum jo kharch karte ho us ka sawab bhi jo tumhein milta hai unhein bhi milta hai. Isi matlab ko ek shayar ne in alfaaz mein yara halain ilal baitil ateeq laqad sartum jasman wa sarna nahnu arwahan inna aqamna ala uzrin wa man qadara wa man aqama ala uzrin faqad raha. Yani ae Allah ke ghar ke Hajj ko jaane walo! Agar tum apne jismon samet is taraf chal rahe ho lekin hum bhi apni roohani raush se isi taraf lapke ja rahe hain, suno hamari jismani kamzori aur uzr ne humein rok rakha hai aur zahir hai ke uzr se ruk jaane wala kuch jaane wale se kam nahin. Phir farmaya hai har ek se Allah Ta'ala ka wada Jannat ka aur bahut bade ajar ka hai, is se yeh bhi maloom hua ke Jihad farz-e-ain nahin balkay farz-e-kifaya hai. Phir irshad hai, Mujahideen ko ghair Mujahideen par badi fazilat hai. Phir un ke buland darajat un ke gunahon ki maafi aur un par jo barkat-o-rahmat hai us ka bayan farmaya aur apni aam bakhshish aur aam raham ki khabar di. Bukhari Muslim mein hai Jannat mein sau darje hain jinhein Allah Ta'ala ne rah-e-Jihad ke Mujahideen ke liye tayyar kiya hai har do darjon mein is qadar fasla hai jitna aasman-o-zameen mein, aur hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs Allah ki rah mein teer chalaye usay Jannat ka darja milta hai ek shakhs ne poocha darja kya hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya woh tumhare yahan ke gharon ke bala khanon jitna nahin balkay do darjon mein sau saal ka fasla hai.

Be-mani uzr mustarad honge, hijrat aur niyat. Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman Abu Al-Aswad farmate hain, Ahl-e-Madina se jang karne ke liye jo lashkar tayyar kiya gaya us mein mera naam bhi tha. Main Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ke maula Hazrat Ikrimah R.H se mila aur is baat ka zikr kiya to unhon ne mujhe is mein shamooliyat karne se bahut sakhti se roka. Aur kaha suno, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se main ne suna hai ke baaz musalman log jo Huzoor ﷺ ke zamane mein mushrikon ke sath the aur un ki tadaad badhate the, basa auqaat aisa bhi hota ke un mein se koi teer se halak kar diya jata ya musalmanon ki talwaron se qatl kar diya jata, inhi ke bare mein yeh aayat utri hai, yani maut ke waqt un ka apni be-taqati ka heela Allah Ta'ala ke han qabool nahin hota. Aur riwayat mein hai ke aise log jo apne imaan ko makhfi rakhte the jab woh Badr ki ladai mein kafiron ke sath aa gaye to musalmanon ke hathon un mein se bhi baaz mare gaye jis par musalman ghamgeen hue ke afsos yeh to hamare hi bhai the aur hamare hi hathon mare gaye, un ke liye istighfar karne lage, is par yeh aayat utri. Pas baqi manda musalmanon ki taraf yeh aayat likhi ke un ka koi uzr na tha, kaha yeh nikle aur un se mushrikeen mile aur unhon ne taqiyah kiya, pas yeh aayat utri (وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَّقُوْلُ اٰمَنَّا باللّٰهِ وَبِالْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ وَمَا ھُمْ بِمُؤْمِنِيْنَ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 8). Hazrat Ikrimah R.H farmate hain yeh aayat un logon ke bare mein utri hai jo Islam ka kalma padhte the aur the Makkah mein hi, in mein Ali bin Umayyah bin Khalaf aur Abu Qais bin Waleed bin Mughirah aur Abu Mansoor bin Hajjaj aur Haris bin Zam'ah the. Zahhak kehte hain yeh un munafiqon ke bare mein utri hai jo Rasool Allah ﷺ ki hijrat ke baad Makkah mein reh gaye, phir Badr ki ladai mein mushrikon ke sath aaye, in mein se baaz maidan-e-jang mein kaam bhi aa gaye. Maqsad yeh hai ke aayat ka hukm aam hai, har us shakhs ka jo hijrat par qadir ho phir bhi mushrikon mein pada rahe aur deen par mazboot na rahe, woh Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek zalim hai aur is aayat ki ro se aur musalmanon ke ijma se woh haram kaam ka murtakib hai. Is aayat mein hijrat se gurez karne ko zulm kaha gaya hai, aise logon se un ke naz'a ke aalam mein farishtay kehte hain ke tum yahan kyun thehre rahe? Kyun hijrat na ki? Yeh jawab dete hain ke hum apne shehar se dusre shehar kahin nahin ja sakte the, jis ke jawab mein farishtay kehte hain kya Allah Ta'ala ki zameen mein kushadgi na thi? Abu Dawood mein hai jo shakhs mushrikeen mein mila jula rahe, inhi ke sath rahe sahe, woh bhi inhi jaisa hai. Suddi farmate hain jabke Hazrat Abbas R.A, Aqeel R.A aur Naufal R.A giraftar kiye gaye to Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ne farmaya Abbas! Tum apna fidiya bhi do aur apne bhatije ka bhi. Hazrat Abbas R.A ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ! Kya hum aap ke qiblay ki taraf namazein nahin padhte the? Kya hum kalma-e-shahadat ada nahin karte the?

Aap ne farmaya Abbas tum ne behas toh chhedi lekin is mein tum haar jaoge suno Allah Jalla Shanuhu farmata hai phir aap ne yahi tilawat farmayi yani tum ne hijrat kyun na ki? Phir jin logon ko hijrat ke chhod dene par malamat na hogi un ka zikr farmata hai ke jo log mushrikeen ke hathon se na chhoot sakein aur agar kabhi chhoot bhi jayein toh raaste ka ilm unhein nahin un se Allah Ta'ala darguzar farmayega, "Asa" kalma Allah ke kalam mein wujub aur yaqeen ke liye hota hai. Allah darguzar karne wala aur bahut hi maafi dene wala hai. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ka bayan hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Isha ki namaz mein Sami Allahu liman hamidah kehne ke baad sajde mein jaane se pehle yeh dua mangi: Aye Allah Ayyash bin Abu Rabia ko, Salama bin Hisham ko, Waleed bin Waleed ko aur tamam bebas nataqat musalmanon ko kuffar ke panje se rihayi de, aye Allah apna sakht azab qabeela Mudar par daal, aye Allah un par aisi qahat sali nazil farma jaisi Hazrat Yusuf A.S ke zamane mein aayi thi. Ibn Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne salam pherne ke baad qiblay ki taraf munh kiye hue hath utha kar dua mangi: Aye Allah Waleed bin Waleed ko, Ayyash bin Abu Rabia ko, Salama bin Hisham ko aur tamam natwan betaqat musalmanon ko aur jo behilay ki taqat rakhte hain na raah paane ki kafiron ke hathon se nijat de. Ibn Jareer mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Zohar ki namaz ke baad yeh dua manga karte the. Is hadith ke shawahid Sahih mein bhi is sanad ke siwa aur sanadon mein bhi hain ke jaise ke pehle guzra. Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain main aur meri walida un zaeef aurton aur bachon mein the jin ka zikr is aayat mein hai. Hamein Allah ne mazoor rakha. Hijrat ki targheeb dete hue aur mushrikon se alag hone ki hadayat karte hue farmata hai ke Allah ki raah mein hijrat karne wala harasan na ho woh jahan jayega Allah Ta'ala us ke liye asbab-e-panah tayyar kar dega aur woh ba-aram wahan iqamat karsakega. Maragham ke ek maani ek jagah se dusri jagah jaane ke bhi hain, Mujahid R.H farmate hain woh apne dukh se bachao ki bahut si suratein paalega, aman ke bahut se asbab use mil jayenge, dushmanon ke shar se bach jayega aur woh rozi bhi payega gumrahi ki jagah hidayat use milegi us ki faqiri tungari se badal jayegi. Irshad hota hai jo shakhs ba-niyat-e-hijrat apne ghar se nikla phir hijrat-gah pahunchne se pehle hi raaste mein use maut aagayi use bhi hijrat ka kamil sawab mil gaya. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke har amal ka daromadar niyat par hai aur har shakhs ke liye woh hai jo us ne niyat ki, pas jis ki hijrat Allah ki taraf aur us ke Rasool ki taraf ho us ki hijrat Allah ki razamandi aur Rasool ki khushnudi ka ba'is hogi aur jis ki hijrat duniya hasil karne ke liye ho ya kisi aurat se nikah karne ke liye ho toh use asal hijrat ka sawab na milega balkay us ki hijrat us ke baare mein hai jis ne ninnanway qatl kiye the phir ek aabid ko qatl karke sau poore kiye phir ek aalim se pucha ke kya us ki tauba qabool hosakti hai?

Us ne kaha teri tauba ke aur tere darmiyan koi cheez hail nahin, tu apni basti se hijrat karke falan shehar chala ja jahan Allah ke aabid bande rehte hain. Chunancha yeh hijrat karke us taraf chala, raste mein hi tha jo maut aa gayi. Rahmat aur azab ke farishton mein us ke bare mein ikhtilaf hua, behas yeh thi ke yeh shakhs tauba karke hijrat karke magar chala to sahi, yeh wahan pahuncha to nahin. Phir unhein hukm kiya gaya ke woh is taraf ki aur is taraf ki zameen naapein, jis basti se yeh shakhs qareeb ho us ke rehne walon mein ise mila diya jaye. Phir zameen ko Allah Ta'ala ne hukm diya ke buri basti ki janib se door ho ja aur nek basti walon ki taraf qareeb ho ja. Jab zameen napi gayi to tauheed walon ki basti se ek balisht barabar qareeb nikli aur ise rahmat ke farishte le gaye. Ek riwayat mein hai ke maut ke waqt yeh apne seene ke bal nek logon ki basti ki taraf ghaseetta hua gaya. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai jo shakhs apne ghar se Allah ki rah mein hijrat ki niyat se nikla, phir Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apni teenon ungliyon yani kalma ki ungli, beech ki ungli aur angoothe ko mila kar kaha. Phir farmaya kahan hain mujahid? Phir woh apni sawari par se gir pada ya use kisi janwar ne kaat liya ya apni maut mar gaya to us ka hijrat ka sawab Allah ke zimme sabit ho gaya (rawi kehte hain apni maut marne ke liye jo kalma Huzoor ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam ne istemal kiya) wallah main ne is kalma ko Aap se pehle kisi arabi ki zabani nahin suna aur jo shakhs ghazab ki halat mein qatl kiya gaya woh jagah ka mustahiq ho gaya. Hazrat Khalid bin Khuram hijrat karke Habsha ki taraf chale lekin rah mein hi unhein ek saanp ne das liya aur isi mein un ki rooh qabz ho gayi, un ke bare mein yeh aayat utri. Hazrat Zubair farmate hain main chunke hijrat karke Habsha pahunch gaya aur mujhe un ki khabar mil gayi thi ke yeh bhi hijrat karke aa rahe hain aur main janta tha ke qabila Banu Asad se un ke siwa aur koi hijrat karke aane ka nahin aur kam-o-besh jitne muhajir the un ke sath rishte kunbe ke log the lekin mere sath koi na tha, main un ka yani Hazrat Khalid ka be-chaini se intezar kar raha tha jo mujhe un ki is tarah ki achanak shahadat ki khabar mili to mujhe bahut hi ranj hua. Yeh asar bahut hi ghareeb hai, yeh bhi wajah hai ke yeh qissa Makkah ka hai aur aayat Madine mein utri hai. Lekin bahut mumkin hai ke rawi ka maqsood yeh ho ke aayat ka hukm aam hai go shaan-e-nuzool yeh na ho wallah aalam. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Samurah bin Jundab hijrat karke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf chale lekin Aap ke paas pahunchne se pehle hi raste mein inteqal kar gaye, un ke bare mein yeh aayat-e-sharifa nazil hui aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Saad bin Abi Samurah jin ko aankhon se dikhayi na deta tha jab woh (Illal mustad'afeena minar rijali wannisa-i wal wildani la yastate'oona heelatan wala yahtadoona sabeela) 4.

(An-Nisa: 98) Sunte hain toh kehte hain main maaldar hoon aur chara-e-kaar bhi rakhta hoon mujhe hijrat karni chahiye, chunancha saaman-e-safar tayyar kar liya aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf chal khade hue lekin abhi Taneem mein hi thay jo maut aa gayi, un ke baare mein yeh aayat nazil hui. Tabrani mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala farmata hai jo shakhs meri raah mein ghazwa karne ke liye nikla sirf mere wadon ko sacha jaan kar aur mere Rasoolon par imaan rakh kar, bas woh Allah ki zamanat mein hai, ya toh woh lashkar ke saath faut ho kar jannat mein pahunche ga ya Allah ki zamanat mein wapas laute ga ajr-o-ghaneemat aur fazl-e-Rabb le kar. Agar woh apni maut mar jaye ya maar dala jaye ya ghode se gir jaye ya oont par se gir pade ya koi zehreela janwar kaat le ya apne bistar par kisi tarah faut ho jaye woh shaheed hai. Abu Dawood mein itni ziyadati bhi hai ke woh jitni hai baaz alfaaz Abu Dawood mein nahin hain. Abu Ya'la mein hai jo shakhs hajj ke liye nikla phir mar gaya Qayamat tak us ke liye hajj ka sawab likha jata hai, jo umre ke liye nikla aur raaste mein faut ho gaya us ke liye Qayamat tak umre ka ajr likha jata hai. Jo jihad ke liye nikla aur faut ho gaya us ke liye Qayamat tak ka sawab likha jata hai. Yeh hadith bhi ghareeb hai.
