Irshad hota hai jo shakhs ba-niyat-e-hijrat apne ghar se nikla phir hijrat-gah pahunchne se pehle hi raaste mein use maut aagayi use bhi hijrat ka kamil sawab mil gaya. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke har amal ka daromadar niyat par hai aur har shakhs ke liye woh hai jo us ne niyat ki, pas jis ki hijrat Allah ki taraf aur us ke Rasool ki taraf ho us ki hijrat Allah ki razamandi aur Rasool ki khushnudi ka ba'is hogi aur jis ki hijrat duniya hasil karne ke liye ho ya kisi aurat se nikah karne ke liye ho toh use asal hijrat ka sawab na milega balkay us ki hijrat us ke baare mein hai jis ne ninnanway qatl kiye the phir ek aabid ko qatl karke sau poore kiye phir ek aalim se pucha ke kya us ki tauba qabool hosakti hai?

Us ne kaha teri tauba ke aur tere darmiyan koi cheez hail nahin, tu apni basti se hijrat karke falan shehar chala ja jahan Allah ke aabid bande rehte hain. Chunancha yeh hijrat karke us taraf chala, raste mein hi tha jo maut aa gayi. Rahmat aur azab ke farishton mein us ke bare mein ikhtilaf hua, behas yeh thi ke yeh shakhs tauba karke hijrat karke magar chala to sahi, yeh wahan pahuncha to nahin. Phir unhein hukm kiya gaya ke woh is taraf ki aur is taraf ki zameen naapein, jis basti se yeh shakhs qareeb ho us ke rehne walon mein ise mila diya jaye. Phir zameen ko Allah Ta'ala ne hukm diya ke buri basti ki janib se door ho ja aur nek basti walon ki taraf qareeb ho ja. Jab zameen napi gayi to tauheed walon ki basti se ek balisht barabar qareeb nikli aur ise rahmat ke farishte le gaye. Ek riwayat mein hai ke maut ke waqt yeh apne seene ke bal nek logon ki basti ki taraf ghaseetta hua gaya. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai jo shakhs apne ghar se Allah ki rah mein hijrat ki niyat se nikla, phir Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apni teenon ungliyon yani kalma ki ungli, beech ki ungli aur angoothe ko mila kar kaha. Phir farmaya kahan hain mujahid? Phir woh apni sawari par se gir pada ya use kisi janwar ne kaat liya ya apni maut mar gaya to us ka hijrat ka sawab Allah ke zimme sabit ho gaya (rawi kehte hain apni maut marne ke liye jo kalma Huzoor ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam ne istemal kiya) wallah main ne is kalma ko Aap se pehle kisi arabi ki zabani nahin suna aur jo shakhs ghazab ki halat mein qatl kiya gaya woh jagah ka mustahiq ho gaya. Hazrat Khalid bin Khuram hijrat karke Habsha ki taraf chale lekin rah mein hi unhein ek saanp ne das liya aur isi mein un ki rooh qabz ho gayi, un ke bare mein yeh aayat utri. Hazrat Zubair farmate hain main chunke hijrat karke Habsha pahunch gaya aur mujhe un ki khabar mil gayi thi ke yeh bhi hijrat karke aa rahe hain aur main janta tha ke qabila Banu Asad se un ke siwa aur koi hijrat karke aane ka nahin aur kam-o-besh jitne muhajir the un ke sath rishte kunbe ke log the lekin mere sath koi na tha, main un ka yani Hazrat Khalid ka be-chaini se intezar kar raha tha jo mujhe un ki is tarah ki achanak shahadat ki khabar mili to mujhe bahut hi ranj hua. Yeh asar bahut hi ghareeb hai, yeh bhi wajah hai ke yeh qissa Makkah ka hai aur aayat Madine mein utri hai. Lekin bahut mumkin hai ke rawi ka maqsood yeh ho ke aayat ka hukm aam hai go shaan-e-nuzool yeh na ho wallah aalam. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Samurah bin Jundab hijrat karke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf chale lekin Aap ke paas pahunchne se pehle hi raste mein inteqal kar gaye, un ke bare mein yeh aayat-e-sharifa nazil hui aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Saad bin Abi Samurah jin ko aankhon se dikhayi na deta tha jab woh (Illal mustad'afeena minar rijali wannisa-i wal wildani la yastate'oona heelatan wala yahtadoona sabeela) 4.

(An-Nisa: 98) Sunte hain toh kehte hain main maaldar hoon aur chara-e-kaar bhi rakhta hoon mujhe hijrat karni chahiye, chunancha saaman-e-safar tayyar kar liya aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf chal khade hue lekin abhi Taneem mein hi thay jo maut aa gayi, un ke baare mein yeh aayat nazil hui. Tabrani mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala farmata hai jo shakhs meri raah mein ghazwa karne ke liye nikla sirf mere wadon ko sacha jaan kar aur mere Rasoolon par imaan rakh kar, bas woh Allah ki zamanat mein hai, ya toh woh lashkar ke saath faut ho kar jannat mein pahunche ga ya Allah ki zamanat mein wapas laute ga ajr-o-ghaneemat aur fazl-e-Rabb le kar. Agar woh apni maut mar jaye ya maar dala jaye ya ghode se gir jaye ya oont par se gir pade ya koi zehreela janwar kaat le ya apne bistar par kisi tarah faut ho jaye woh shaheed hai. Abu Dawood mein itni ziyadati bhi hai ke woh jitni hai baaz alfaaz Abu Dawood mein nahin hain. Abu Ya'la mein hai jo shakhs hajj ke liye nikla phir mar gaya Qayamat tak us ke liye hajj ka sawab likha jata hai, jo umre ke liye nikla aur raaste mein faut ho gaya us ke liye Qayamat tak umre ka ajr likha jata hai. Jo jihad ke liye nikla aur faut ho gaya us ke liye Qayamat tak ka sawab likha jata hai. Yeh hadith bhi ghareeb hai.

Salat-e-Qasr? Farman-e-Ilahi hai ke tum kahin safar mein ja rahe ho. Yehi alfaaz safar ke liye Surah Muzammil mein bhi aaye hain. Toh tum par namaz ki takhfeef karne mein koi gunah nahin, yeh kami ya toh kammiyat mein yani bajaye chaar rakat ke do rakat hai jaise ke jamhoor ne is aayat se samjha hai go phir in mein baaz masail mein ikhtilaf hua hai. Baaz toh kehte hain yeh shart hai ke safar itaat ka ho maslan jihad ke liye ya Hajj-o-Umrah ke liye ya talab-o-ziyarat ke liye waghera. Ibn-e-Umar, Atta, Yahya aur ek riwayat ki ro se Imam Malik ka yehi qaul hai, kyunke is se aage farman hai agar tumhein kuffar ki eza-rasani ka khauf ho. Baaz kehte hain is qaid ki koi zaroorat nahin ke safar qurbat-e-Ilahiya ka ho balkeh namaz ki kami har mubah safar ke liye hai jaise iztirar aur bebasi ki soorat mein murdar khane ki ijazat hai, haan yeh shart hai ke safar masiyat ka na ho, Imam Shafi waghera aimma ka yehi qaul hai. Ek shakhs ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya ke main tijarat ke silsile mein daryai safar karta hoon toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne use do rakatein padhne ka hukum diya, yeh hadith mursal hai. Baaz logon ka mazhab hai ke har safar mein namaz ko qasr karna jaiz hai safar khwah mubah ho khwah mamnoo ho yahan tak ke agar koi daka dalne ke liye aur musafiron ko satane ke liye nikla hua hai use bhi namaz qasr karne ki ijazat hai, Abu Hanifa, Thauri aur Dawood ka yehi qaul hai ke aayat aam hai, lekin yeh qaul jamhoor ke qaul ke khilaf hai. Kuffar se darr ki jo shart lagayi hai yeh ba-aitbar-e-aksariyat ke hai, aayat ke nazil hone ke waqt chunke umooman yehi haal tha is liye aayat mein bhi ise bayan kar diya gaya. Hijrat ke baad safar musalmanon ke sab ke sab khauf wale hi hote the, qadam qadam par dushman ka khatra rehta tha balkeh musalman safar ke liye nikal hi na sakte the bajuz is ke ke ya toh jihad ko jayen ya kisi khas lashkar ke sath jayen aur yeh qaida hai ke jab mantooq ba-aitbar-e-ghalib ke aaye toh is ka mafhoom motabar nahin hota. Jaise aur aayat mein hai apni londiyon ko badkari ke liye majboor na karo agar woh pakdamni karna chahein aur jaise farmaya un ki betiyan jo tumhari parwarish mein hain jin aurton se tum ne mohabbat ki hai. Pas jaise ke in dono aayaton mein qaid ka bayan hai lekin is ke hone par hi hukum ka daromadar nahin balkeh baghair is ke bhi hukum wohi hai yani londiyon ko badkari ke liye majboor karna haram hai chahe woh pakdamni mein ho ya na ho, halankeh dono jagah Quran mein yeh qaid majood hai. Pas jis tarah in dono mauqon mein baghair in quyood ke bhi hukum yehi hai isi tarah yahan bhi go khauf na ho toh bhi mehez safar ki wajah se namaz ko qasr karna jaiz hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Ya'la bin Umayyah ne Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) se poocha ke namaz ki takhfeef ka hukum toh khauf ki halat mein hai aur ab toh aman hai? Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne jawab diya ke yehi khayal mujhe hua tha aur yehi sawal main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kiya tha toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yeh Allah Ta'ala ka sadqa hai jo us ne tumhein diya hai tum us ke sadqe ko qabool karo.

Muslim aur Sunan waghera mein bhi yeh hadith hai bilkul sahi riwayat hai. Abu Hanzala Haza ne Hazrat Umar R.A se safar ki namaz ka poocha toh aap ne farmaya do rakat hain, unhon ne kaha Quran mein toh khauf ke waqt do rakat hain aur is waqt toh poori tarah amn-o-aman hai toh aap ne farmaya yahi sunnat hai Rasool Allah ﷺ ki (Ibn Abi Shaiba). Ek aur shakhs ke sawal par Hazrat Umar R.A ne farmaya tha aasman se toh yeh rukhsat utar chuki hai ab agar tum chaho toh ise lauta do, Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain Makkah aur Madina ke darmiyan hum ne bawajood amn ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ke sath do rakat parhin (Nasai waghera) aur hadith mein hai ke Nabi ﷺ Madina se Makkah ki taraf chale toh Allah ke siwa kisi se khauf na tha aur aap barabar do rakat hi ada farmate rahe. Bukhari ki hadith mein hai ke wapsi mein bhi yahi do rakat aap parhte rahe aur Makkah mein is safar mein aap ne das roz qayam kiya tha. Musnad Ahmad mein Hazrat Harisa R.A se riwayat hai ke main ne Nabi ﷺ ke sath Mina mein Zohar ki aur Asr ki namaz do do rakat parhi hain halankeh is waqt hum bakasrat thay aur nihayat hi pur-amn thay, Sahih Bukhari mein hai Hazrat Abdullah R.A ke sath (safar mein) do rakat parhi hain, lekin Hazrat Usman R.A ki char rakaat ka zikr aaya toh aap ne Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji'un parh kar farmaya main ne toh Huzoor ﷺ ke sath bhi Mina mein do rakat parhi hain aur Siddiq-e-Akbar R.A ke sath bhi aur Umar Farooq R.A ke sath bhi, kaash ke bajaye in char rakaat ke mere hissay mein do hi maqbool rakaat aayen, pas yeh hadeesain khulam khula daleel hain is baat ki ke safar ki do rakaat ke liye khauf ka hona shart nahin balkeh nihayat amn-o-itminan ke safar mein bhi do-gana ada kar sakta hai, isi liye ulama-e-kiram ne farmaya hai ke yahan kaifiyat mein yani qirat, qayam, ruku, sujud waghera mein qasr aur kami murad hai na ke kamiyat mein yani tadaad-e-rakaat mein takhfeef karna, Zahhak, Mujahid aur Suddi ka yahi qaul hai jaise ke aa raha hai, is ki ek daleel Imam Malik R.H ki riwayat karda yeh hadith bhi hai ke Hazrat Aisha R.A farmati hain namaz do do rakatain hi safar-o-hazar mein farz ki gayi thi phir safar mein toh wahi do rakatain rahin aur iqamat ki halat mein do aur barha di gayin, pas ulama ki yeh jamaat kehti hai ke asal namaz do rakatain thi toh phir is aayat mein qasr se murad kamiyat yani rakaton ki tadaad mein kami kaise ho sakti hai? Is qaul ki bahut bari tayeed sarahatan is hadith se bhi hoti hai jo Musnad Ahmad mein Hazrat Umar R.A ki riwayat se hai ke ba-zaban-e-Nabi ﷺ safar ki do rakatain hain aur Zuha ki namaz bhi do rakat hai aur Eid-ul-Fitr ki namaz bhi do rakat hai aur Jumma ki namaz bhi do rakat hai, yeh yahi poori namaz hai qasr wali nahin, yeh hadith Nasai, Ibn Majah aur Sahih Ibn Hibban mein bhi hai is ki sanad bashart-e-Muslim hai. Is ke rawi Ibn Abi Laila ka Hazrat Umar R.A se sunna sabit hai jaise ke Imam Muslim R.H ne apni Sahih ke muqaddama mein likha hai aur khud is riwayat aur is ke alawa bhi sarahatan majood hai aur yahi theek bhi hai Insha'Allah.

Go ba'az muhaddiseen sunne par faisla dene ke qail nahin, lekin ise maante hue bhi is sanad mein kami waqay nahin hoti kyunke ba'az turuq mein Ibn-e-Abi Laila ka ek siqa se aur un ka Hazrat Umar se sunna marwi hai, aur Ibn-e-Majah mein un ka Ka'ab bin Ujra se riwayat karna aur un ka Hazrat Umar se riwayat karna bhi marwi hai, Fallahu A'alam. Muslim waghera mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas se marwi hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare Nabi Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani namaz ko iqamat ki halat mein chaar rakat farz ki hai aur safar mein do rakat aur khauf mein ek rakat. Pas jaise ke qayam mein is se pehle aur is ke peeche namaz parhte the ya parhi jati thi isi tarah safar mein bhi aur is riwayat mein aur Hazrat Ayesha wali riwayat mein jo oopar guzri ke hazar mein Allah Ta'ala ne do rakatein hi farz ki thin goya musafat se mashroot hain is liye ke asal do hi thin baad mein do aur barha di gayin phir hazar ki chaar rakat ho gayin to ab keh sakte hain ke iqamat ki halat mein farz chaar rakatein hain. Jaise ke Ibn-e-Abbas ki is riwayat mein hai, Wallahu A'alam. Al-gharaz yeh dono riwayatein ise sabit karti hain ke safar mein do rakat namaz hi poori namaz hai kam nahin aur yahi Hazrat Umar ki riwayat se bhi sabit ho chuka hai. Murad is mein qasr-e-kamiyat hai jaise ke salat-e-khauf mein hai isi liye farmaya hai agar tum daro is baat se ke kafir tumhein fitne mein daal denge aur is ke baad farmaya jab waqt un mein ho aur namaz parho to bhi. Phir qasr ka maqsood sifat aur kaifiyat bhi bayan farma di Imam-ul-Muhaddiseen Hazrat Bukhari ne Kitab-us-Salat-ul-Khauf ko isi (وَاِذَا ضَرَبْتُمْ فِي الْاَرْضِ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ اَنْ تَقْصُرُوْا مِنَ الصَّلٰوةِ ڰ اِنْ خِفْتُمْ اَنْ يَّفْتِنَكُمُ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا ۭ اِنَّ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ كَانُوْا لَكُمْ عَدُوًّا مُّبِيْنًا) (Surah An-Nisa: 101) tak likh kar shuru kiya hai, Zahhak is ki tafseer mein farmate hain ke yeh larai ke waqt hai insaan apni sawari par namaz do takbeerein parh le is ka munh jis taraf bhi ho isi taraf sahih hai. Suddi farmate hain ke safar mein jab tu ne do rakat parhein to woh qasr ki poori miqdar hai haan jab kafiron ki fitna angezi ka khauf ho to ek hi rakat qasr hai albatta yeh kisi saneen-e-khauf ke baghair jaiz nahin. Mujahid farmate hain is ayat se murad woh din hai jabke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne tamam sahaba ke sath hasb-e-mamool chaar rakatein poori ada keen phir mushrikeen ne saman-o-asbab ko loot lene ka irada kiya, Ibn-e-Jareer ise Mujahid aur Suddi aur Jabir aur Ibn-e-Umar se riwayat karte hain aur isi ko ikhtiyar karte hain aur isi ko kehte hain ke yahi theek hai. Hazrat Khalid bin Usaid Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar se kehte hain salat-e-khauf ke qasr ka hukum to hum Kitabullah mein paate hain lekin salat-e-musafir ke qasr ka hukum Kitabullah mein nahin milta to Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar jawab dete hain hum ne apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko safar mein namaz ko qasr karte hue paya aur hum ne bhi is par amal kiya.

Khayal farmaiye ke is mein qasr ka itlaq salat-e-khauf par kiya aur ayat se murad bhi salat-e-khauf li aur salat-e-musafir ko is mein shamil nahin kiya aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) ne bhi is ka iqrar kiya. Is ayat se musafirat ki namaz ka qasr bayan nahin farmaya balkay is ke liye fe'l-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko sanad bataya. Is se zyada sarahat wali riwayat Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ki hai ke Hazrat Simak aap se salat poochte hain aap farmate hain safar ki namaz do rakat hai aur yahi do rakat safar ki poori namaz hai qasr nahin, qasr to salat-e-khauf mein hai ke imam ek jamaat ko ek rakat parhata hai dusri jamaat dushman ke samne hai phir yeh chale gaye woh aa gaye ek rakat imam ne unhein parhai to imam ki do rakat huin aur un dono jamaaton ki ek ek rakat hui.

Salat-e-Khauf ke masail: Namaz-e-Khauf ki kayi qismein, mukhtalif suratein aur halatein hain. Kabhi toh aisa hota hai ke dushman Qibla ki taraf, kabhi dushman dusri janib hota hai. Namaz bhi kabhi chaar rakat hoti hai, kabhi teen rakat jaise Maghrib aur Fajr ki do salat-e-safar. Kabhi jamaat se ada karni mumkin hoti hai, kabhi lashkar is tarah baham guthe hue hote hain ke namaz-e-ba-jamaat mumkin hi nahin hoti, balkay alag alag Qibla ki taraf aur ghair Qibla ki taraf paidal aur sawar jis tarah mumkin ho padhi jati hai. Balkay aisa bhi hota hai jo jaiz bhi hai ke dushmanon ke hamlon se bachte bhi jayen, un par barabar hamle bhi karte jayen aur namaz bhi ada karte jayen. Aisi halat mein sirf ek rakat hi namaz padhi jati hai, jis ke jawaz mein ulama ka fatwa hai aur daleel Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) ki hadith hai jo is se agli ayat ki tafsir mein bayan ho chuki hai. Ata, Jabir, Hasan, Mujahid, Hakam, Qatada, Hammad, Taus, Zahhak, Muhammad bin Nasr, Marwazi, Ibn Hazm ajma'een ka yahi fatwa hai. Subah ki namaz mein ek hi rakat is halat mein reh jati hai. Ishaq Rahwiya (R.H) farmate hain aisi daud dhoop ke waqt ek hi rakat kafi hai. Irshad hai ada kar le, agar is qadar par bhi qadir na ho toh sajda kar le, yeh bhi zikr-e-Allah hai. Aur log kehte hain sirf ek takbeer hi kafi hai, lekin yeh ho sakta hai ke ek sajda aur ek takbeer se murad bhi ek rakat ho. Jaise ke Hazrat Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal (R.H) aur un ke as-hab ka fatwa hai aur yahi qaul hai Jabir bin Abdullah, Abdullah bin Umar, Ka'ab waghera sahaba ka (R.A) ajma'een. Suddi bhi farmate hain, lekin jin logon ka qaul sirf ek takbeer ka hi bayan hua hai, us ka bayan karne wale use puri rakat par mahmool nahin karte balkay sirf takbeer hi jo zahir hai murad lete hain, jaise ke Ishaq bin Rahwiya ka mazhab hai. Ameer Abdul Wahab bin Bakht Makki bhi isi taraf gaye hain, woh yahan tak kehte hain ke agar is par bhi qudrat na ho toh use apne nafs mein bhi na chhore yani niyat hi kar le, Wallahu A'lam. (Lekin sirf niyat ke kar lene ya sirf Allahu Akbar keh lene par iktifa karne ya sirf ek hi sajda kar lene ki koi daleel Quran-o-Hadith se nazar se nahin guzri. Wallahu A'lam mutarjim). Ba'az ulama ne aise khaas auqat mein namaz ko takheer kar ke padhne ki rukhsat bhi di hai. Un ki daleel yeh hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Jang-e-Khandaq mein suraj doob jane ke baad Zuhr-o-Asr ki namaz padhi thi, phir Maghrib-o-Isha. Phir is ke baad Banu Quraiza ki jang ke din un ki taraf jinhein bheja tha unhein takeed kar di thi ke tum mein se koi bhi Banu Quraiza tak pahunchne se pehle Asr ki namaz na padhe. Yeh jamaat abhi raste mein hi thi toh Asr ka waqt aa gaya. Ba'az ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka maqsad is farman se sirf yahi tha ke hum jaldi Banu Quraiza pahunch kar namaz padhein, jabke suraj ghuroob ho chuka tha.

Jab is baat ka zikr Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se hua toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne dono jamaaton mein se kisi ek ko bhi daant dupt nahin ki. Hum ne is par tafseeli behas apni kitab As-Seerah mein ki hai aur ise sabit kiya hai ke sahih baat ke qareeb woh jamaat thi jinhon ne waqt par namaz ada kar li, go dusri jamaat bhi mazoor thi. Maqsood yeh hai ke is jamaat ne jihad ke mauqa par dushmanon par takht karte hue un ke qil'e ki taraf yurish jaari rakhte hue namaz ko mu'akhar kar diya. Dushmanon ka yeh giroh mal'oon yahudiyon ka tha jinhon ne ahd tod diya tha aur sulh ke khilaf kiya tha. Lekin jamhoor kehte hain Salat-e-Khauf ke nazil hone se yeh sab mansookh ho gaya. Yeh waqiyat is aayat ke nazil hone se pehle ke hain. Salat-e-Khauf ke hukm ke baad ab jihad ke waqt namaz ko waqt se taalna jaiz nahin raha. Abu Saeed ki riwayat se bhi yahi zahir hai jise Shafi'i ne marwi ki hai. Lekin Sahih Bukhari ke (Baab As-Salat inda munahazatil husoon al-kh) mein hai ke Auza'i farmate hain agar fath ki tayyari ho aur namaz ba-jamaat ka imkan na ho toh har shakhs alag alag apni apni namaz ishare se ada kar le. Agar yeh bhi na ho sakta ho toh namaz mein takheer kar lein yahan tak ke jang khatam ho ya aman ho jaye, us waqt do rak'atein padh lein aur agar aman na mile toh ek rak'at ada kar lein, sirf takbeer ka keh lena kaafi nahin.

Aisa ho toh namaz ko der karke padhein jabke itminan naseeb ho jaye. Hazrat Makhool R.H ka farman bhi yahi hai. Hazrat Anas bin Malik R.A farmate hain ke Tustar ke qila ke muhasre mein main majood tha, subh-e-sadiq ke waqt dast-ba-dast jang shuru hui aur sakht ghumsan ka ran pada, hum log namaz na padh sake aur barabar jihad mein mashghool rahe. Jab Allah Ta'ala ne hamein qila par qabiz kardiya us waqt hum ne din chadhe namaz padhi. Is jang mein hamare imam Hazrat Abu Musa R.A the. Hazrat Anas R.A farmate hain is namaz ke mutabadil sari duniya ki tamam cheezein bhi mujhe khush nahin karsakti. Imam Bukhari R.H is ke baad jang-e-khandaq mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka namazon ko takheer karne ka zikr karte hain, phir Banu Quraiza wala waqiya aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman ke tum Banu Quraiza pahunchne se pehle asr ki namaz na padhna warid karte hain. Goya Imam-e-Humam Hazrat Imam Bukhari R.H isi se ittefaq karte hain ke aisi ashad ladai aur poore khatre aur qurb-e-fatah ke mauqe par agar namaz mu'akhar ho jaye toh koi harj nahin. Hazrat Abu Musa R.A ne is par aitraz kiya ho aur yeh log yeh bhi kehte hain ke khandaq ke mauqe par bhi salat-e-khauf ki ayatein majood thin, is liye ke yeh ayatein Ghazwa-e-Zat-ur-Riqa mein nazil hui hain aur yeh ghazwa Ghazwa-e-Khandaq se pehle ka hai aur is par jamhoor ulama-e-siyar-o-maghazi ka ittefaq hai. Muhammad bin Ishaq, Musa bin Uqba, Waqidi, Muhammad bin Saad, Katib-e-Waqidi aur Khalifa bin Khayyat waghera bhi isi ke qail hain. Haan Imam Bukhari R.H waghera ka qaul hai ke Ghazwa-e-Zat-ur-Riqa Khandaq ke baad hua tha ba-sabab bahawala hadith Abu Musa R.A ke aur yeh khud Khaibar mein hi aaye the, Wallahu A'lam. Lekin sab se zyada ta'ajjub toh is amr par hai ke Qazi Abu Yusuf, Muzani, Ibrahim bin Ismail bin Ulayya kehte hain ke salat-e-khauf mansookh hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke Ghazwa-e-Khandaq mein der karke namaz padhne se. Yeh qaul bilkul hi ghareeb hai is liye ke Ghazwa-e-Khandaq ke baad ki salat-e-khauf ki hadeesein sabit hain. Is din ki namaz ki takheer ko Makhool aur Auza'i ke qaul par hi mahmool karna zyada qawi aur zyada durust hai, yani un ka woh qaul jo bahawala Bukhari bayan hua ke qurb-e-fatah aur adam-e-imkan-e-salat-e-khauf ke bawajood takheer jaiz hai, Wallahu A'lam. Ayat mein hukum hota hai ke jab tu unhein ba-jamaat namaz padhaye. Yeh halat pehli ke siwa hai, us waqt yani intehai khauf ke waqt toh ek hi rakat jaiz hai aur woh bhi alag alag, paidal, sawar, qibla ki taraf munh karke ya na karke, jis tarah mumkin ho, jaise ke hadith guzar chuki hai. Yeh imamat aur jamaat ka haal bayan ho raha hai, jamaat ke wajib hone par yeh ayat behtareen aur mazboot daleel hai ke jamaat ki wajah se bahut kami kardi gayi. Agar jamaat wajib na hoti toh sirf ek rakat jaiz na ki jati.

Baaz ne is se ek aur istidlal bhi kiya hai woh kehte hain ke is mein chunke yeh lafz hain ke jab tu in mein ho aur yeh khitab Nabi-e-Kareem Alaihi Afdalus Salati Wat Tasleem se hai toh maloom hua ke Salat-e-Khauf ka hukum Aap (ﷺ) ke baad mansookh hai, yeh istidlal bilkul zaeef hai, yeh istidlal toh aisa hi hai jaisa istidlal un logon ka tha jo Zakat ko Khulafa-e-Rashideen se rok baithe the aur kehte the ke Quran mein hai (Aayat: Khuz min amwalihim sadaqatan...), yani tu un ke maalon se Zakat le jis se tu unhein paak saaf kar aur tu un ke liye rahmat ki dua kar teri dua un ke liye baais-e-taskeen hai. Toh hum Aap (ﷺ) ke baad kisi ko Zakat na denge balkeh hum Aap apne haath se khud jise chahein denge aur sirf usi ko denge jis ki dua hamare liye sabab-e-sukoon bane. Lekin yeh istidlal un ka be-mani tha isi liye ke Sahaba ne ise rad kar diya aur unhein majboor kiya ke yeh Zakat ada karein balkeh un mein se jin logon ne ise rok liya tha un se jang ki. Aaiye hum aayat ki sifat bayan karne se pehle is ka shaan-e-nuzool bayan kar dein. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke Banu Najjar ki ek qoum ne Huzoor (ﷺ) se sawal kiya ke hum barabar idhar udhar aamad-o-raft kiya karte hain, hum namaz kis tarah padhein toh Allah Azzawajal ne apna yeh qaul nazil farmaya (Aayat: Wa iza darabtum fil ardi falaisa alaikum junahun an taqsuru minas salati). Is ke baad saal bhar tak koi hukum na aaya phir jabkeh Aap (ﷺ) ek ghazwe mein Zohar ki namaz ke liye khade hue toh mushrikeen kehne lage afsos kya hi achha mauqa haath se jata raha kaash ke namaz ki halat mein hum yak-bargi un par hamla kar dete, is par baaz mushrikeen ne kaha yeh mauqa toh tumhein phir bhi milega is ke thodi der baad hi yeh dusri namaz (yani namaz-e-Asr) ke liye khade honge, lekin Allah Ta'ala ne Asr ki namaz se pehle aur Zohar ki namaz ke baad (Aayat: In khiftum) wali puri do aayaton tak nazil farma dein aur kafir nakam rahe khud Allah Ta'ala-o-Quddus ne Salat-e-Khauf ki taleem di. Goya siyaq nihayat hi ghareeb hai lekin ise mazboot karne wali aur riwayatein bhi hain, Hazrat Abu Ayyash Zurqi farmate hain Usfan mein hum Nabi-e-Kareem (ﷺ) ke saath the Khalid bin Waleed us waqt Islam nahin laye the aur mushrikeen ke lashkar ke sardar the yeh log hamare samne padao dale the tab hum ne qibla rukh, Zohar ki namaz jab hum ne ada ki toh mushrikon ke munh mein pani bhar aaya aur woh kehne lage afsos hum ne mauqa haath se kho diya waqt tha ke yeh namaz mein mashghool the idhar hum un par dafatan dhawa bol dete phir un mein ke baaz janne walon ne kaha khair koi baat nahin is ke baad in ki ek aur namaz ka waqt aa raha hai aur woh namaz toh unhein apne baal bachon se balkeh apni jaanon se bhi zyada azeez hai us waqt sahi.

Pas Zuhr-o-Asr ke darmiyan Allah Azzawajal ne Hazrat Jibraeel A.S ko nazil farmaya aur (Aayat: Iza kunta feehim) utari. Chunancha Asr ki namaz ke waqt hamein Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hukum diya, hum ne hathiyar saja liye aur apni do safon mein se pehli saf Aap (ﷺ) ke sath sajde mein gayi aur dusri saf khari ki khari unki nigahbani karti rahi. Jab sajdon se farigh ho kar yeh log khare hogaye to ab dusri saf wale sajde mein gaye. Jab yeh dono sajde kar chuke to ab pehli saf wale dusri saf ki jagah chale gaye aur dusri saf wale pehli saf walon ki jagah aagaye, phir qayam, ruku aur qauma sab ne Huzoor (ﷺ) ke sath hi sath ada kiya aur jab Aap (ﷺ) sajde mein gaye to saf-e-awwal Aap (ﷺ) ke sath sajde mein gayi aur dusri saf wale khare hue pehra dete rahe. Jab yeh sajdon se farigh hogaye aur attahiyat mein baithe tab dusri saf ke logon ne sajde kiye aur attahiyat mein sab ke sab sath mil gaye aur salam bhi Huzoor (ﷺ) ke sath sab ne ek sath phera. Salat-e-Khauf ek baar to Aap (ﷺ) ne yahan Usfan mein parhi aur dusri martaba Banu Saleem ki zameen mein. Yeh hadith Musnad-e-Ahmad, Abu Dawood aur Nasai mein bhi hai, iski asnad sahih hai aur shahid bhi bakasrat hain. Bukhari mein bhi yeh riwayat ikhtisar ke sath hai aur is mein hai bawajood-e-ke sab log namaz mein thay lekin ek dusre ki chaukidari kar rahe thay. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke Sulaiman bin Qais Yashkari ne Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) se pucha namaz ke qasr karne ka hukum kab nazil hua? To Aap (R.A) ne farmaya Quraishiyon ka ek qafila Sham se aaraha tha hum uski taraf chale. Wadi-e-Nakhl mein pohanche to ek shakhs Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke paas pohanch gaya aur kehne laga kya Aap mujh se darte nahin? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya nahin. Usne kaha Aap ko mujh se is waqt kaun bacha sakta hai? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya Allah mujhe tujh se bacha lega. Phir talwar khench li aur daraya dhamkaya, phir kooch ki munadi hui aur Aap (ﷺ) hathiyar saja kar chale. Phir azan hui aur Sahaba do hisson mein taqseem hogaye, ek hissa Aap (ﷺ) ke sath namaz ada kar raha tha aur dusra hissa pehra de raha tha. Jo Aap (ﷺ) ke mutasil thay woh do rakat Aap (ﷺ) ke sath parh kar peeche walon ki jagah chale gaye aur peeche wale ab aage barh aaye aur in aglon ki jagah khare hogaye, inhe bhi Huzoor (ﷺ) ne do rakat parhayin phir salam pher diya. Pas Huzoor (ﷺ) ki char rakat huin aur sab ki do do huin aur Allah Ta'ala ne namaz ki kami ka aur hathiyar liye rehne ka hukum nazil farmaya. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke jo shakhs talwar taane Rasool (ﷺ) par hamla-awar hua tha yeh dushman ke qabile mein se tha, uska naam Ghauras bin Haris tha. Jab Aap (ﷺ) ne Allah ka naam liya to uske hath se talwar chhoot gayi, Aap (ﷺ) ne talwar apne hath mein le li aur us se kaha ab tu bata ke tujhe kaun bachayega? To woh maafi mangne laga ke mujh par Aap raham kijiye. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya kya tu Allah ke ek hone ki aur mere Rasool hone ki shahadat deta hai?

Us ne kaha yeh toh nahin, haan main iqrar karta hoon ke aap se ladunga nahin aur un logon ka saath na dunga jo aap se barsar-e-paikar hon, aap ne use maafi di. Jab yeh apne qabeelay walon mein aaya toh kehne laga roo-e-zameen par Huzoor (ﷺ) se behtar koi shakhs nahin. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Yazeed Faqeer ne Hazrat Jabir (R.A) se poocha ke safar mein jo do rakat hain kya yeh qasr kehlati hain? Aap ne farmaya yeh poori namaz hai, qasr toh ba-waqt-e-jihad ek rakat hai. Phir salat-e-khauf ka isi tarah zikr kiya, is mein yeh bhi hai ke aap ke salam ke saath aap ke peeche walon ne aur un logon ne salam phera aur is mein dono hissa-e-fauj ke saath ek ek rakat padhne ka bayan hai, pas sab ki ek ek rakat hui aur Huzoor (ﷺ) ki do rakatein. Aur riwayat mein hai ke ek jamaat aap ke peeche saf-basta namaz mein thi aur ek jamaat dushman ke muqabil thi, phir ek rakat ke baad aap ke peeche walay aglon ki jagah aa gaye aur woh peeche aa gaye. Yeh hadith bahut si kitabon mein bahut si sanadon ke saath Hazrat Jabir (R.A) se marwi hai. Ek aur hadith jo ba-riwayat-e-Salim an abeehi marwi hai, is mein yeh bhi hai ke phir kharay ho kar sahaba ne ek ek rakat apni apni ada kar li. Is hadith ki bhi bahut si sanadein aur bahut se alfaaz hain, Hafiz Abu Bakr bin Marduyah ne un sab ko jama kar diya, aur isi tarah Ibn-e-Jareer ne bhi, hum ise Kitab-e-Ahkam-e-Kabeer mein likhna chahte hain, Insha'Allah. Khauf ki namaz mein hathiyar liye rehne ka hukum baaz ke nazdeek toh bator-e-wajoob ke hai kyunke aayat ke zahiri alfaaz hain, Imam Shafi (R.H) ka bhi yahi qaul hai aur isi ki ta'eed is aayat ke pichle fiqray se bhi hoti hai ke barish ya bimari ki wajah se hathiyar utaar rakhne mein tum par gunah nahin, apna bachao saath liye raho, yani aisay tayyar raho ke waqt aatay hi be-takalluf-o-be-takleef hathiyar se aarasta ho jao. Allah ne kafiron ke liye ihanat wala azaab tayyar kar rakha hai.

Salat-e-Khauf ke baad kasrat-e-zikr. Janab-e-Bari Azza Ismuhu is aayat mein hukum deta hai ke namaz-e-khauf ke baad Allah ka zikr bakasrat kiya karo, go zikr-e-Allah ka hukum aur uski targheeb-o-ta'eed aur namazon ke baad balkeh har waqt hi hai, lekin yahan khusoosiyat se is liye bayan farmaya ke yahan bahut badi rukhsat inayat farmayi hai, namaz mein takhfeef kar di, phir halat-e-namaz mein idhar udhar hatna jana aur aana maslahat ke mutabiq jaiz rakha, jaise hurmat wale mahinon ke mutaliq farmaya in mein apni janon par zulm na karo, jabke aur auqat mein bhi zulm mamnoo hai lekin un mahinon mein is se bachao ki mazeed ta'eed ki, toh farman hota hai ke apni har halat mein Allah Azzawajal ka zikr karte raho, aur jab itminan hasil ho jaye dar-o-khauf na rahe toh baqaida khushoo-o-khuzoo se arkan-e-namaz ko pabandi ke mutabiq shar'an baja lao, namaz padhna waqt-e-muqarrara par minjanib-e-Allah farz-e-ain hai, jis tarah hajj ka waqt mu'ayyan hai isi tarah namaz ka waqt bhi muqarrar hai, ek waqt ke baad doosra phir doosre ke baad teesra. Phir farmata hai dushmanon ki talash mein kam-himti na karo chusti aur chalaki se ghaat ki jagah baith kar unki khabar lo, agar qatl-o-zakhm-o-nuqsan tumhein pahunchta hai toh kya unhein nahin pahunchta? Isi mazmoon ko in alfaaz mein bhi ada kiya gaya hai (In yamsaskum qarhun faqad massal qawma qarhum misluhu) (Surah Al-Imran: 140). Pas museebat aur takleef ke pahunchne mein tum aur woh barabar hain, lekin bahut bada farq yeh hai ke tumhein Zaat-e-Azza Ismuhu se woh umeedein aur woh aasre hain jo unhein nahin, tumhein ajr-o-sawab bhi milega tumhari nusrat-o-ta'eed bhi hogi, jaise ke khud Bari Ta'ala ne khabar di hai aur wada kiya, na uski khabar jhooti na uske wade talne wale, pas tumhein ba-nisbat unke bahut tag-o-dau chahiye tumhare dilon mein jihad ka walwala hona chahiye, tumhein uski raghbat-e-kamil honi chahiye, tumhare dilon mein Allah ke kalme ko mustahkam karne, tawana karne, phailane aur buland karne ki tadap har waqt majood rehni chahiye. Allah Ta'ala jo kuch muqarrar karta hai jo faisla karta hai jo jaari karta hai jo shar'an muqarrar karta hai jo kaam karta hai sab mein poori khabar ka maalik sahih aur sache ilm wala saath hi hikmat wala bhi hai, har haal mein har waqt sazawaar-e-tareef-o-hamd wahi hai.

Haqeeqat chup nahin sakti. Allah Ta'ala Nabi-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se farmata hai ke yeh Quran-e-Kareem jo Aap (ﷺ) par Allah ne utara hai woh mukammal taur par aur ibtida ta intiha haq hai, is ki khabrein bhi haq, is ke farmaan bhi bar-haq. Phir farmata hai taake tum logon ke darmiyan woh insaaf karo jo Allah Ta'ala tumhein samjhaye. Ba'az ulama-e-usool ne is se istidlal kiya hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ko ijtihad se hukm karne ka ikhtiyar diya gaya tha, is ki daleel Bukhari Muslim ki hadith bhi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apne darwaze par do jhagadne walon ki aawaz suni to Aap (ﷺ) bahar aaye aur farmane lage main ek insaan hoon jo sunta hoon us ke mutabiq faisla karta hoon, bahut mumkin hai ke yeh ek shakhs zyada hujjat-baaz aur charb-zaban ho aur main us ki baton ko sahih jaan kar us ke haq mein faisla de doon aur jis ke haq mein faisla kar doon fil-waqia woh haqdar na ho to woh samajh le ke woh us ke liye jahannam ka tukda hai, ab use ikhtiyar hai ke le le ya chhod de. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke do Ansari ek virse ke bare mein Huzoor (ﷺ) ke paas apna qaziya laye, waqia ko zamana guzar chuka tha, dono ke paas gawah koi na tha to us waqt Aap (ﷺ) ne wahi hadith bayan farmayi aur farmaya ke mere faisle ki bina par apne bhai ka haq na le le, agar aisa karega to Qayamat ke din apni gardan mein jahannam ki aag latka kar aayega. Ab to woh dono buzurg rone lage aur har ek kehne laga main apna haq bhi apne bhai ko de raha hoon. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya ab tum jao apne taur par jahan tak tum se ho sake theek theek hisse taqseem karo, phir qura daal kar hissa le lo aur har ek dusre ko apna raha saha ghalti ka haq maaf kar do.

Abu Dawood mein bhi yeh hadith hai aur is mein yeh alfaaz hain ke main tumhare darmiyan apni samajh se un umoor mein faisla karta hoon jin mein koi wahi mujh par nazil shuda nahin hoti, Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke Ansar ka ek giroh ek jihad mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath tha wahan ek shakhs ki ek chadar kisi ne chura li aur is chori ka guman Tu'ma bin Ubairiq ki taraf tha. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein yeh qissa pesh hua. Chor ne is chadar ko ek shakhs ke ghar mein us ki be-khabari mein daal diya aur apne kunba qabeelay walon se kaha main ne chadar falan ke ghar mein daal di hai tum raat ko Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas jao aur aap se zikr karo ke hamara sathi to chor nahin chor falan hai aur hum ne pata laga liya hai ke chadar bhi us ke ghar mein majood hai. Is tarah aap hamare sathi ki tamam logon ke rubaru bari'at kar dijiye aur us ki himayat kijiye warna dar hai ke kahin woh halak na ho jaye. Aap ne aisa hi kiya is par yeh aayatein utrin aur jo log apne jhoot ko posheeda karke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye thay un ke bare mein (Aayat Yastakhfoona) se do aayatein nazil huin, phir Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne farmaya jo burai aur badi ka kaam kare is se murad bhi yahi log hain aur chor ke aur us ke himayatiyon ke bare mein utra ke jo gunah aur khata kare aur na-karda gunah ke zimme ilzaam lagaye woh bohtan baaz aur khula gunahgar hai, lekin yeh siyaq ghareeb hai baaz buzurgon se marwi hai ke yeh aayat Banu Ubairiq ke chor ke bare mein nazil hui hai, yeh qissa matool Tirmidhi Kitab-ut-Tafsir mein bazubani Hazrat Qatadah (R.A) is tarah marwi hai ke hamare gharane ke Banu Ubairiq qabeelay ka ek ghar tha jis mein Bashir, Basheer aur Mubashir thay, Basheer ek munafiq shakhs tha ashaar ko kisi aur ki taraf mansoob karke khoob mazay le le kar parha karta tha, Ashab-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jantay thay ke yahi khabeeth in ashaar ka kehne wala hai, yeh log jahiliyat ke zamane se hi faqa mast chale aa rahay thay Madine ke logon ka aksar khana jau aur khajoorein thin, haan tungar log Sham ke aaye hue qafilay walon se maida khareed letay jisay woh khud apne liye makhsoos kar letay, baqi ghar walay umooman jau aur khajoorein hi khatay, mere chacha Rifa'ah bin Yazeed ne bhi Sham ke aaye hue qafilay se ek bora maiday ka khareeda aur apne bala khanay mein usay mehfooz kar diya jahan hathiyar zarhein talwarein waghera bhi rakhi hui thin. Raat ko choron ne neeche se naqab laga kar anaaj bhi nikal liya aur hathiyar bhi chura le gaye, subah mere paas aaye aur sara waqea bayan kiya, ab hum tajassus karne lagay to pata chala ke aaj raat ko Banu Ubairiq ke ghar mein aag jal rahi thi aur kuch kha paka rahe thay ghaliban woh tumhare haan se chori kar gaye hain, is se pehle jab apne gharane walon se pooch guch kar rahe thay to is qabeelay ke logon ne hum se kaha tha ke tumhara chor Labeed bin Sahl hai, hum jantay thay ke Labeed ka yeh kaam nahin woh ek diyanatdar saccha Musalman shakhs tha.

Hazrat Labeed ko jab yeh khabar mili toh woh aape se bahar hogaye, talwar taane Banu Abairaq ke paas aaye aur kehne lage ya toh tum meri chori sabit karo warna main tumhein qatl kar dunga. Un logon ne unki barat ki aur maafi chah li, woh chale gaye. Hum sab ke sab poori tahqiqat ke baad is natije par pahunche ke chori Banu Abairaq ne ki hai. Mere chacha ne mujhe kaha ke tum ja kar Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko khabar toh do, main ne ja kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sara waqia bayan kiya aur yeh bhi kaha ke aap hamein hamare hathiyar dilwa dijiye, ghalla ki wapsi ki zaroorat nahin. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujhe itminan dilaya ke achha main is ki tahqiq karunga. Yeh khabar jab Banu Abairaq ko hui toh unhon ne apna ek aadmi aap ke paas bheja jin ka naam Usaid bin Urwah tha, unhon ne aa kar kaha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh toh zulm ho raha hai, Banu Abairaq toh salahiyat aur Islam wale log hain, inhe Qatada bin Numan aur un ke chacha chor kehte hain aur baghair kisi suboot aur daleel ke chor ka badanuma ilzaam un par rakhte hain waghera. Phir jab main khidmat-e-Nabwi mein pahuncha toh aap ne mujh se farmaya yeh toh tum bahut bura karte ho ke deendar aur bhale logon ke zimme chori chipkate ho jab ke tumhare paas is ka koi suboot nahin. Main chup chap wapas chala aaya aur dil mein sakht pasheman aur pareshan tha, khayal aata tha ke kaash ke main is maal se chup chap dast-bardar ho jata aur aap se is ka zikr hi na karta toh achha tha. Itne mein mere chacha aaye aur mujh se poocha tum ne kya kiya?

Main ne sara waqia un se bayan kiya jisay sun kar unhon ne kaha Allahul Musta'an, Allah hi se hum madad chahte hain. Un ka jana tha jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par wahi mein yeh aayatein utrin. Pas khayineen se murad Banu Ubairiq hain, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko istighfar ka hukum hua, yeh yahi Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Qatada (R.A) ko farmaya tha. Phir sath hi farma diya gaya ke agar yeh log istighfar karein to Allah unhein bakhash de ga. Phir farmaya nakarda gunah ke zimme gunah thopna badtareen jurm hai, Ajran Azeema tak. Yani unhon ne jo Hazrat Labeed (R.A) ki nisbat kaha ke chor yeh hain, jab yeh aayatein utrin to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Banu Ubairiq se hamaray hathiyar dilwaye. Main unhein le kar apne chacha ke paas aaya, yeh bechare boorhay thay, aankhon se bhi kam nazar aata tha. Mujh se farmanay lage beta jao yeh sab hathiyar Allah ke naam khairat kar do. Main aaj tak apne chacha ki nisbat qadray badguman tha ke yeh dil se Islam mein pooray tor par dakhil nahin huye lekin is waqiye ne badgumani mere dil se door kar di aur main un ke sachay Islam ka qail ho gaya. Basheer yeh sun kar mushrikeen mein ja mila aur Sulafa bint Sa'ad bin Sumayya ke haan ja kar apna qayam kiya. Yeh riwayat bohat si kitabon mein bohat si sanadon se mutawwal aur mukhtasar marwi hai. In munafiqon ki kam-aqli ka bayan ho raha hai ke woh jo apni siyah kariyon ko logon se chupatay hain bhala un se kya natija? Allah Ta'ala se to posheeda nahin rakh saktay. Phir farmata hai mana ke dunyawi hakimon ke haan jo zahir dari par faislay kartay hain tum ne ghalba hasil kar liya, lekin Qayamat ke din Allah ke samnay jo zahir-o-batin ka aalim hai tum kya kar sako ge? Wahan kisay wakeel bana kar pesh karo ge jo tumharay jhootay da'way ki ta'eed karay, matlab yeh hai ke us din tumhari kuch nahin chalay gi.

Raat ko choron ne neeche se naqab laga kar anaaj bhi nikal liya aur hathiyar bhi chura le gaye, subah mere paas aaye aur sara waqea bayan kiya, ab hum tajassus karne lagay to pata chala ke aaj raat ko Banu Ubairiq ke ghar mein aag jal rahi thi aur kuch kha paka rahe thay ghaliban woh tumhare haan se chori kar gaye hain, is se pehle jab apne gharane walon se pooch guch kar rahe thay to is qabeelay ke logon ne hum se kaha tha ke tumhara chor Labeed bin Sahl hai, hum jantay thay ke Labeed ka yeh kaam nahin woh ek diyanatdar saccha Musalman shakhs tha.

Hazrat Labeed ko jab yeh khabar mili toh woh aape se bahar hogaye, talwar taane Banu Abairaq ke paas aaye aur kehne lage ya toh tum meri chori sabit karo warna main tumhein qatl kar dunga. Un logon ne unki barat ki aur maafi chah li, woh chale gaye. Hum sab ke sab poori tahqiqat ke baad is natije par pahunche ke chori Banu Abairaq ne ki hai. Mere chacha ne mujhe kaha ke tum ja kar Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko khabar toh do, main ne ja kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sara waqia bayan kiya aur yeh bhi kaha ke aap hamein hamare hathiyar dilwa dijiye, ghalla ki wapsi ki zaroorat nahin. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujhe itminan dilaya ke achha main is ki tahqiq karunga. Yeh khabar jab Banu Abairaq ko hui toh unhon ne apna ek aadmi aap ke paas bheja jin ka naam Usaid bin Urwah tha, unhon ne aa kar kaha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh toh zulm ho raha hai, Banu Abairaq toh salahiyat aur Islam wale log hain, inhe Qatada bin Numan aur un ke chacha chor kehte hain aur baghair kisi suboot aur daleel ke chor ka badanuma ilzaam un par rakhte hain waghera. Phir jab main khidmat-e-Nabwi mein pahuncha toh aap ne mujh se farmaya yeh toh tum bahut bura karte ho ke deendar aur bhale logon ke zimme chori chipkate ho jab ke tumhare paas is ka koi suboot nahin. Main chup chap wapas chala aaya aur dil mein sakht pasheman aur pareshan tha, khayal aata tha ke kaash ke main is maal se chup chap dast-bardar ho jata aur aap se is ka zikr hi na karta toh achha tha. Itne mein mere chacha aaye aur mujh se poocha tum ne kya kiya?

Main ne sara waqia un se bayan kiya jisay sun kar unhon ne kaha Allahul Musta'an, Allah hi se hum madad chahte hain. Basheer yeh sun kar mushrikeen mein ja mila aur Sulafa bint Sa'ad bin Sumayya ke haan ja kar apna qayam kiya. Wahan kisay wakeel bana kar pesh karo ge jo tumharay jhootay da'way ki ta'eed karay, matlab yeh hai ke us din tumhari kuch nahin chalay gi.

Aap ne aisa hi kiya is par yeh aayatein utrin aur jo log apne jhoot ko posheeda karke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye thay un ke bare mein (Aayat Yastakhfoona) se do aayatein nazil huin, phir Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne farmaya jo burai aur badi ka kaam kare is se murad bhi yahi log hain aur chor ke aur us ke himayatiyon ke bare mein utra ke jo gunah aur khata kare aur na-karda gunah ke zimme ilzaam lagaye woh bohtan baaz aur khula gunahgar hai, lekin yeh siyaq ghareeb hai baaz buzurgon se marwi hai ke yeh aayat Banu Ubairiq ke chor ke bare mein nazil hui hai, yeh qissa matool Tirmidhi Kitab-ut-Tafsir mein bazubani Hazrat Qatadah (R.A) is tarah marwi hai ke hamare gharane ke Banu Ubairiq qabeelay ka ek ghar tha jis mein Bashir, Basheer aur Mubashir thay, Basheer ek munafiq shakhs tha ashaar ko kisi aur ki taraf mansoob karke khoob mazay le le kar parha karta tha, Ashab-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jantay thay ke yahi khabeeth in ashaar ka kehne wala hai, yeh log jahiliyat ke zamane se hi faqa mast chale aa rahay thay Madine ke logon ka aksar khana jau aur khajoorein thin, haan tungar log Sham ke aaye hue qafilay walon se maida khareed letay jisay woh khud apne liye makhsoos kar letay, baqi ghar walay umooman jau aur khajoorein hi khatay, mere chacha Rifa'ah bin Yazeed ne bhi Sham ke aaye hue qafilay se ek bora maiday ka khareeda aur apne bala khanay mein usay mehfooz kar diya jahan hathiyar zarhein talwarein waghera bhi rakhi hui thin. Raat ko choron ne neeche se naqab laga kar anaaj bhi nikal liya aur hathiyar bhi chura le gaye, subah mere paas aaye aur sara waqea bayan kiya, ab hum tajassus karne lagay to pata chala ke aaj raat ko Banu Ubairiq ke ghar mein aag jal rahi thi aur kuch kha paka rahe thay ghaliban woh tumhare haan se chori kar gaye hain, is se pehle jab apne gharane walon se pooch guch kar rahe thay to is qabeelay ke logon ne hum se kaha tha ke tumhara chor Labeed bin Sahl hai, hum jantay thay ke Labeed ka yeh kaam nahin woh ek diyanatdar saccha Musalman shakhs tha.

Hazrat Labeed ko jab yeh khabar mili toh woh aape se bahar hogaye, talwar taane Banu Abairaq ke paas aaye aur kehne lage ya toh tum meri chori sabit karo warna main tumhein qatl kar dunga. Un logon ne unki barat ki aur maafi chah li, woh chale gaye. Hum sab ke sab poori tahqiqat ke baad is natije par pahunche ke chori Banu Abairaq ne ki hai. Mere chacha ne mujhe kaha ke tum ja kar Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko khabar toh do, main ne ja kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sara waqia bayan kiya aur yeh bhi kaha ke aap hamein hamare hathiyar dilwa dijiye, ghalla ki wapsi ki zaroorat nahin. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujhe itminan dilaya ke achha main is ki tahqiq karunga. Yeh khabar jab Banu Abairaq ko hui toh unhon ne apna ek aadmi aap ke paas bheja jin ka naam Usaid bin Urwah tha, unhon ne aa kar kaha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh toh zulm ho raha hai, Banu Abairaq toh salahiyat aur Islam wale log hain, inhe Qatada bin Numan aur un ke chacha chor kehte hain aur baghair kisi suboot aur daleel ke chor ka badanuma ilzaam un par rakhte hain waghera. Phir jab main khidmat-e-Nabwi mein pahuncha toh aap ne mujh se farmaya yeh toh tum bahut bura karte ho ke deendar aur bhale logon ke zimme chori chipkate ho jab ke tumhare paas is ka koi suboot nahin. Main chup chap wapas chala aaya aur dil mein sakht pasheman aur pareshan tha, khayal aata tha ke kaash ke main is maal se chup chap dast-bardar ho jata aur aap se is ka zikr hi na karta toh achha tha. Itne mein mere chacha aaye aur mujh se poocha tum ne kya kiya?

Main ne sara waqia un se bayan kiya jisay sun kar unhon ne kaha Allahul Musta'an, Allah hi se hum madad chahte hain. Un ka jana tha jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par wahi mein yeh aayatein utrin. Pas khayineen se murad Banu Ubairiq hain, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko istighfar ka hukum hua, yeh yahi Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Qatada (R.A) ko farmaya tha. Phir sath hi farma diya gaya ke agar yeh log istighfar karein to Allah unhein bakhash de ga. Phir farmaya nakarda gunah ke zimme gunah thopna badtareen jurm hai, Ajran Azeema tak. Yani unhon ne jo Hazrat Labeed (R.A) ki nisbat kaha ke chor yeh hain, jab yeh aayatein utrin to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Banu Ubairiq se hamaray hathiyar dilwaye. Main unhein le kar apne chacha ke paas aaya, yeh bechare boorhay thay, aankhon se bhi kam nazar aata tha. Mujh se farmanay lage beta jao yeh sab hathiyar Allah ke naam khairat kar do. Main aaj tak apne chacha ki nisbat qadray badguman tha ke yeh dil se Islam mein pooray tor par dakhil nahin huye lekin is waqiye ne badgumani mere dil se door kar di aur main un ke sachay Islam ka qail ho gaya. Basheer yeh sun kar mushrikeen mein ja mila aur Sulafa bint Sa'ad bin Sumayya ke haan ja kar apna qayam kiya. Is ke baray mein is ke baad ki (وَمَنْ يُّشَاقِقِ الرَّسُوْلَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُ الْهُدٰى وَيَتَّبِعْ غَيْرَ سَبِيْلِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ نُوَلِّهٖ مَا تَوَلّٰى وَنُصْلِهٖ جَهَنَّمَ ۭ وَسَاۗءَتْ مَصِيْرًا 115 اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَغْفِرُ اَنْ يُّشْرَكَ بِهٖ وَيَغْفِرُ مَا دُوْنَ ذٰلِكَ لِمَنْ يَّشَاۗءُ ۭوَمَنْ يُّشْرِكْ باللّٰهِ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ ضَلٰلًۢا بَعِيْدًا 116) (Surah An-Nisa: 115-116) tak nazil huin aur Hazrat Hassan (R.A) ne is ke is fe'l ki muzammat aur is ki hajo apne sher'on mein ki. In ashaar ko sun kar us ki aurat ko bari ghairat aayi aur Basheer ka sab asbab apne sar par rakh kar Abtah maidan mein phenk aayi aur kaha tu koi bhalai le kar mere paas nahin aaya balkay Hassan ki hajo ke ashaar le kar aaya hai, main tujhe apne haan nahin thehraungi. Yeh riwayat bohat si kitabon mein bohat si sanadon se mutawwal aur mukhtasar marwi hai. In munafiqon ki kam-aqli ka bayan ho raha hai ke woh jo apni siyah kariyon ko logon se chupatay hain bhala un se kya natija? Allah Ta'ala se to posheeda nahin rakh saktay. Phir unhein khabardar kiya ja raha hai ke tumharay posheeda raaz bhi Allah se chup nahin saktay. Phir farmata hai mana ke dunyawi hakimon ke haan jo zahir dari par faislay kartay hain tum ne ghalba hasil kar liya, lekin Qayamat ke din Allah ke samnay jo zahir-o-batin ka aalim hai tum kya kar sako ge? Wahan kisay wakeel bana kar pesh karo ge jo tumharay jhootay da'way ki ta'eed karay, matlab yeh hai ke us din tumhari kuch nahin chalay gi.

Sachi tauba kabhi mustarad nahin hoti. Allah Ta'ala apna karam aur apni meharbani ko bayan farmata hai ke jis gunah se jo koi tauba kare Allah us ki taraf meharbani se ruju karta hai, har woh shakhs jo Rab ki taraf jhuke Rab apni meharbani se aur apni wus'at-e-rahmat se use dhanp leta hai aur us ke saghira kabira gunah ko bakhsh deta hai, chahe woh gunah aasman-o-zameen aur paharon se bhi bade hon. Bani Israel mein jab koi gunah karta to us ke darwaze par qudrati huroof mein kaffara likha hua nazar aa jata jo use ada karna padta aur unhein yeh bhi hukum tha ke un ke kapde par agar peshab lag jaye to utna kapda katwa dalein. Allah ne is ummat par aasani kar di, pani se dho lena hi kapde ki paki rakhi aur tauba kar lena hi gunah ki maafi. Ek aurat ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Mufaddal se sawal kiya ke aurat ne badkari ki phir jab bacha hua to use maar dala. Aap ne farmaya is ki saza jahannam hai. Woh roti hui wapas chali to aap ne use bulaya aur (Wamay ya'mal su'an aw yazlim nafsahu thumma yastaghfirillaha yajidillaha Ghafooran Rahima) (Surah An-Nisa: 110) padh kar sunayi to us ne apne aansu ponch dale aur wapas laut gayi. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jis musalman se koi gunah sarzad ho jaye phir woh wuzu karke do rakat namaz ada karke Allah se istighfar kare to Allah us ke is gunah ko bakhsh deta hai, phir aap ne yeh aayat aur (Walladhina idha fa'alu fahishatan aw zalamu anfusahum dhakarullaha fastaghfiru lidhunubihim wamay yaghfirudh-dhunuba illallahu walam yusirru 'ala ma fa'alu wahum ya'lamun) (Surah Al-Imran: 135) ki tilawat ki. Is hadith ka poora bayan hum ne Musnad-e-Abu Bakr mein kar diya hai aur kuch bayan Surah Al-Imran ki tafsir mein bhi guzra hai. Hazrat Abu Darda (R.A) farmate hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aadat-e-mubarak thi ke majlis mein se uth kar apne kisi kaam ke liye kabhi jate aur wapas tashreef lane ka irada bhi hota jooti ya kapda kuch na kuch chhod jate. Ek martaba aap apni jooti chhore hue uthe, dolchi pani ki sath le chale, main bhi aap ke peeche ho liya. Aap kuch door ja kar baghair haajat poori kiye wapas aaye aur farmane lage: Mere paas mere Rab ki taraf se ek aane wala aaya aur mujhe yeh paigham de gaya, phir aap ne (Wamay ya'mal su'an aw yazlim nafsahu thumma yastaghfirillaha yajidillaha Ghafooran Rahima) (Surah An-Nisa: 110) padhi aur farmaya main apne sahaba ko yeh khushkhabri sunane ke liye raste mein hi laut aaya hoon. Is se pehle chunke (Wamay ya'mal su'an aw yazlim nafsahu thumma yastaghfirillaha yajidillaha Ghafooran Rahima) (Surah An-Nisa: 110) yani har burai karne wale ko us ki burai ka badla milega utar chuki thi is liye sahaba bahut pareshan the. Main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kisi ne zina kiya ho? Chori ki ho?

Phir woh istighfar kare toh use bhi Allah bakhsh dega? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya haan, main ne dobara poocha aap ne kaha haan, main ne seh-bara daryaft kiya toh aap ne farmaya haan go Abu Darda ki naak khaak-aalood ho, pas Hazrat Abu Darda (R.A) jab yeh hadith bayan karte apni naak par maar kar batate. Is ki asnaad za'eef hai aur yeh hadith ghareeb hai. Phir farmaya gunah karne wala apna hi bura karta hai jaise aur jagah hai koi dusre ka bojh nahin uthaye ga, ek dusre ko nafa na pahuncha sake ga, har shakhs apne kartoot ka zimmedar hai, koi bojh batayi na hoga, Allah ka ilm, Allah ki hikmat aur Ilahi adl-o-rahmat ke khilaf hai ke ek gunah kare aur dusra pakda jaye. Phir farmata hai jo khud bura kaam kar ke kisi be-gunah ke sar thop de jaise Banu Abairaq ne Labeed ka naam le diya jo waqia tafseel-war is se agli aayat ki tafseer mein bayan ho chuka hai, ya murad Zaid bin Sameen Yahudi hai jaise ba'az aur mufassireen ka khayal hai ke is chori ki tohmat is qabeele ne is be-gunah shakhs ke zimme lagayi thi aur khud hi khayin aur zalim thay, aayat shaan-e-nuzool ke aitbaar se khaas hai lekin hukm ke aitbaar se aam hai jo bhi aisa kare woh Allah ki saza ka mustahiq hai. Is ke baad ki (aayat Walawla-ilakh,) ka talluq bhi isi waqia se hai yani Labeed bin Urwa aur un ke sathiyon ne Banu Abairaq ke choron ki Huzoor (ﷺ) ke samne bara'at aur un ki pakdamni ka izhaar kar ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ko asliyat se door rakhne ka sara kaam poora kar liya tha, lekin Allah Ta'ala ne jo aap ki ismat ka haqeeqi nigehban hai aap ko is khatarnak mauqa par khayino ki taraf-dari se bacha liya aur asli waqia saaf kar diya. Kitab se murad Quran aur Hukm se murad Sunnat hai. Nuzool-e-Wahi se pehle aap jo na jante thay un ka ilm parwardigar ne aap ko bazariya wahi kar diya jaise aur aayat mein hai "Wa kazalika auhaina ilaika roohan min amrina" se poori soorat tak aur aayat mein hai (Wama kunta tarju an yulqa ilaika al-kitabu illa rahmatan min rabbika fala takoonanna zaheeran lil-kafireen) (28. Al-Qasas: 86) isi liye yahan bhi farmaya. Yeh sab baatein Allah ka fazl hain jo aap ke shamil-e-haal hai.

Is ki asnaad za'eef hai aur yeh hadith ghareeb hai. Phir farmaya gunah karne wala apna hi bura karta hai jaise aur jagah hai koi dusre ka bojh nahin uthaye ga, ek dusre ko nafa na pahuncha sake ga, har shakhs apne kartoot ka zimmedar hai, koi bojh batayi na hoga, Allah ka ilm, Allah ki hikmat aur Ilahi adl-o-rahmat ke khilaf hai ke ek gunah kare aur dusra pakda jaye. Phir farmata hai jo khud bura kaam kar ke kisi be-gunah ke sar thop de jaise Banu Abairaq ne Labeed ka naam le diya jo waqia tafseel-war is se agli aayat ki tafseer mein bayan ho chuka hai, ya murad Zaid bin Sameen Yahudi hai jaise ba'az aur mufassireen ka khayal hai ke is chori ki tohmat is qabeele ne is be-gunah shakhs ke zimme lagayi thi aur khud hi khayin aur zalim thay, aayat shaan-e-nuzool ke aitbaar se khaas hai lekin hukm ke aitbaar se aam hai jo bhi aisa kare woh Allah ki saza ka mustahiq hai. Is ke baad ki (aayat Walawla-ilakh,) ka talluq bhi isi waqia se hai yani Labeed bin Urwa aur un ke sathiyon ne Banu Abairaq ke choron ki Huzoor (ﷺ) ke samne bara'at aur un ki pakdamni ka izhaar kar ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ko asliyat se door rakhne ka sara kaam poora kar liya tha, lekin Allah Ta'ala ne jo aap ki ismat ka haqeeqi nigehban hai aap ko is khatarnak mauqa par khayino ki taraf-dari se bacha liya aur asli waqia saaf kar diya. Kitab se murad Quran aur Hukm se murad Sunnat hai. Nuzool-e-Wahi se pehle aap jo na jante thay un ka ilm parwardigar ne aap ko bazariya wahi kar diya jaise aur aayat mein hai "Wa kazalika auhaina ilaika roohan min amrina" se poori soorat tak aur aayat mein hai (Wama kunta tarju an yulqa ilaika al-kitabu illa rahmatan min rabbika fala takoonanna zaheeran lil-kafireen) (28. Al-Qasas: 86) isi liye yahan bhi farmaya. Yeh sab baatein Allah ka fazl hain jo aap ke shamil-e-haal hai.

Sachi tauba kabhi mustarad nahin hoti. Allah Ta'ala apna karam aur apni meharbani ko bayan farmata hai ke jis gunah se jo koi tauba kare Allah us ki taraf meharbani se ruju karta hai, har woh shakhs jo Rab ki taraf jhuke Rab apni meharbani se aur apni wus'at-e-rahmat se use dhanp leta hai aur us ke saghira kabira gunah ko bakhsh deta hai, chahe woh gunah aasman-o-zameen aur paharon se bhi bade hon. Bani Israel mein jab koi gunah karta to us ke darwaze par qudrati huroof mein kaffara likha hua nazar aa jata jo use ada karna padta aur unhein yeh bhi hukum tha ke un ke kapde par agar peshab lag jaye to utna kapda katwa dalein. Allah ne is ummat par aasani kar di, pani se dho lena hi kapde ki paki rakhi aur tauba kar lena hi gunah ki maafi. Ek aurat ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Mufaddal se sawal kiya ke aurat ne badkari ki phir jab bacha hua to use maar dala. Aap ne farmaya is ki saza jahannam hai. Woh roti hui wapas chali to aap ne use bulaya aur (Wamay ya'mal su'an aw yazlim nafsahu thumma yastaghfirillaha yajidillaha Ghafooran Rahima) (Surah An-Nisa: 110) padh kar sunayi to us ne apne aansu ponch dale aur wapas laut gayi. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jis musalman se koi gunah sarzad ho jaye phir woh wuzu karke do rakat namaz ada karke Allah se istighfar kare to Allah us ke is gunah ko bakhsh deta hai, phir aap ne yeh aayat aur (Walladhina idha fa'alu fahishatan aw zalamu anfusahum dhakarullaha fastaghfiru lidhunubihim wamay yaghfirudh-dhunuba illallahu walam yusirru 'ala ma fa'alu wahum ya'lamun) (Surah Al-Imran: 135) ki tilawat ki. Is hadith ka poora bayan hum ne Musnad-e-Abu Bakr mein kar diya hai aur kuch bayan Surah Al-Imran ki tafsir mein bhi guzra hai. Hazrat Abu Darda (R.A) farmate hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aadat-e-mubarak thi ke majlis mein se uth kar apne kisi kaam ke liye kabhi jate aur wapas tashreef lane ka irada bhi hota jooti ya kapda kuch na kuch chhod jate. Ek martaba aap apni jooti chhore hue uthe, dolchi pani ki sath le chale, main bhi aap ke peeche ho liya. Aap kuch door ja kar baghair haajat poori kiye wapas aaye aur farmane lage: Mere paas mere Rab ki taraf se ek aane wala aaya aur mujhe yeh paigham de gaya, phir aap ne (Wamay ya'mal su'an aw yazlim nafsahu thumma yastaghfirillaha yajidillaha Ghafooran Rahima) (Surah An-Nisa: 110) padhi aur farmaya main apne sahaba ko yeh khushkhabri sunane ke liye raste mein hi laut aaya hoon. Is se pehle chunke (Wamay ya'mal su'an aw yazlim nafsahu thumma yastaghfirillaha yajidillaha Ghafooran Rahima) (Surah An-Nisa: 110) yani har burai karne wale ko us ki burai ka badla milega utar chuki thi is liye sahaba bahut pareshan the. Main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kisi ne zina kiya ho? Chori ki ho?

Phir woh istighfar kare toh use bhi Allah bakhsh dega? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya haan, main ne dobara poocha aap ne kaha haan, main ne seh-bara daryaft kiya toh aap ne farmaya haan go Abu Darda ki naak khaak-aalood ho, pas Hazrat Abu Darda (R.A) jab yeh hadith bayan karte apni naak par maar kar batate. Al-Qasas: 86) isi liye yahan bhi farmaya. Yeh sab baatein Allah ka fazl hain jo aap ke shamil-e-haal hai.

Achhay kamon ki dawat aur buray kamon se rokne ke ilawa tamam baatein qabil-e-muwakhiza hain. Logon ke aksar kalam be-mani hotay hain siwaye un ke jin ki baton ka maqsad dusron ki bhalai aur logon mein mel milap karana ho. Hazrat Sufyan Thauri (R.H) ki ayadat ke liye log jatay hain un mein Saeed bin Hassan bhi hain to aap farmatay hain Saeed tum ne Umm-e-Saleh ki riwayat se jo hadith bayan ki thi aaj usay phir sunao, aap sanad bayan karke farmatay hain Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya insan ki tamam baatein qabil-e-muwakhiza hain bajuz Allah ke zikr aur achhay kamon ke batane aur buray kamon se rokne ke. Hazrat Sufyan (R.H) ne kaha yahi mazmoon is ayat mein hai, yahi mazmoon ayat (YAWMA YAQUMUR-RUHU WAL-MALA'IKATU SAFFAN LAA YATAKALLAMUNA ILLA MAN AZINA LAHUR-RAHMANU WA QALA SAWABAN) (Surah An-Naba: 38) mein hai, yahi mazmoon Surah Al-Asr mein hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai ke logon ki aapas mein mohabbat barhane aur sulah safai ke liye jo bhi baat kahe idhar udhar se kahe ya qasam uthaye woh jhooton mein dakhil nahin. Hazrat Umm-e-Kulthum bint-e-Uqbah (R.A) farmati hain main ne aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko idhar ki baat udhar kehne ki teen suraton mein ijazat detay hue suna hai: "Jihad ki targheeb mein, logon mein sulah karane aur miyan biwi ko milane ki surat mein" yeh hijrat karne waliyon aur bai'at karne waliyon mein se hain. Ek aur hadith mein hai kya main tumhein ek aisa amal bataun? Jo roza, namaz aur sadqa se bhi afzal hai, logon ne khwahish ki to aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya woh aapas mein islah karana hai, farmatay hain aur aapas ka fasad nekiyon ko khatam kar deta hai (Abu Dawood waghera). Bazzar mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Abu Ayyub (R.A) se farmaya aa main tujhe ek tijarat bataun, log jab lar jhagad rahe hon to un mein musalahat kara de, jab ek dusre se ranjeeda hon to unhein mila de. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke aisi bhali baatein Rab ki razamandi, khuloos aur nek niyati se jo kare woh ajar-e-azeem payega. Jo shakhs ghair-e-shar'i tariq par chale yani shar'a ek taraf ho aur us ki rah ek taraf ho. Farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kuch ho aur us ka maqsad-e-amal aur ho. Halankeh us par haq wazeh ho chuka ho, daleel dekh chuka ho phir bhi Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki mukhalifat karke musalmanon ki saaf rah se hat jaye to hum bhi usay terhi aur buri rah par hi laga detay hain, usay wahi ghalat rah achi aur bhali maloom hone lagti hai yahan tak ke beechon beech jahannam mein ja pahunchta hai. Mominon ki rah ke ilawa rah ikhtiyar karna darasal Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki mukhalifat aur dushmani ke mutaradif hai jo kabhi to Shari' (A.S) ki saaf baat ke khilaf aur kabhi us cheez ke khilaf hota hai jis par sari Ummat-e-Muhammadiya muttafiq hai jis mein unhein Allah ne ba-wajah un ki sharafat-o-karamat ke mehfooz kar rakha hai.

Is baare mein bahut si hadeesein bhi hain aur hum ne bhi ahadees-e-usool mein un ka bada hissa bayan kar diya hai, baaz ulama toh is ke tawatur-e-ma'ani ke qail hain, Hazrat Imam Shafi'i (R.H) ghaur-o-fikr ke baad is aayat se ummat ke ittefaq ki daleel hone par istidlal kiya hai haqeeqatan yahi mauqif behtareen aur qawi-tar hai, baaz deegar aimma ne is dalalat ko mushkil aur door az aayat bhi bataya hai, gharz aisa karne wale ki rassi Allah Miyan bhi dheeli chhod dete hain. Jaise farman hai (Aayat: Sanastadrijuhum aur Falamma zaghu aur Nazaruhum) yani hum un ki be-khabri mein aahista aahista mohlat badhate rehte hain, un ke behakte hi hum bhi un ke dilon ko tedha kar dete hain, hum unhein un ki sarkashi mein gum chhod dete hain, bil-aakhir un ki jaye-bazgasht jahannam ban jati hai jaise farman hai zalimon ko un ke sathiyon ke sath qabron se uthayenge, aur jaise farmaya zalim aag ko dekh kar jaan le ga ke is mein koodna padega lekin koi surat chhutkare ki na payega.

Mushrik ki pehchan aur un ka anjam. Is surat ke shuru mein pehli ayat ke mutaliq hum puri tafsir kar chuke hain aur wahin is ayat se talluq rakhne wali hadeesain bhi bayan kar di hain, Hazrat Ali R.A farmaya karte thay Quran ki koi ayat mujhe is ayat se zyada mehboob nahin (Tirmidhi). Mushrikeen se duniya aur akhirat ki bhalai door ho jati hai aur woh rah-e-haq se door ho jate hain, woh apne aap ko aur apne dono jahano ko barbad kar lete hain. Yeh mushrikeen aurton ke parastar hain, Hazrat Ka'ab R.H farmate hain har sanam ke sath ek janbiya aurat hai, Hazrat Aisha R.A farmati hain 'Inasan' se murad but hain, yeh qaul aur bhi mufassireen ka hai. Zahhak ka qaul hai ke mushrik farishton ko poojte thay aur unhein Allah ki ladkiyan mante thay aur kehte thay ke in ki ibadat se hamari asal gharz Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki nazdiki hasil karna hai aur in ki tasweerein aurton ki shakal par banate thay phir hukum karte thay aur taqleed karte thay aur kehte thay ke yeh suratein farishton ki hain jo Allah ki ladkiyan hain. Yeh tafsir (Afara'aitumul-Lata wal-Uzza) (Surah An-Najm: 19-20) ke mazmoon se khoob milti hai jahan in ke buton ke naam le kar Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya hai ke yeh khoob insaf hai ke ladke to tumhare aur ladkiyan meri? Aur ayat mein hai (Wa ja'alul-mala'ikatalladhina hum 'ibadur-Rahmani inasan, ashahidu khalqahum, satuktabu shahadatuhum wa yus'alun) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 19). In logon ne Allah Ta'ala aur jinnat mein nasab nikale hain, Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain murad murde hain, Hasan R.H farmate hain har be-rooh cheez inas hai khwah khushk lakdi ho khwah patthar ho, lekin yeh qaul ghareeb hai. Phir irshad hai ke darasal yeh shaitani pooja ke phande mein thay, Shaitan ko Rabb ne apni rahmat se door kar diya aur apni bargah se nikal bahar kiya hai, us ne bhi beeda utha rakha hai ke Allah ke bandon ko maqool tadaad mein behkaye, Qatada R.H farmate hain yani har hazar mein se nau sau ninnanve (999) ko jahannam mein apne sath le jaye ga, ek bach rahe ga jo jannat ka mustahiq hoga. Shaitan ne kaha hai ke main inhein haq se behkaunga aur inhein umeed dilata rahunga, yeh tauba tark kar baithenge, khwahishon ke peeche pad jayenge, maut ko bhool baithenge, nafs parwari aur akhirat se ghafil ho jayenge, janwaron ke kaan kaat kar ya surakh-dar kar ke Allah ke siwa dusron ke naam karne ki inhein talqeen karunga, Allah ki banayi hui suraton ko bigadna sikhaunga jaise janwaron ko khasi karna.

Ek hadith mein is se bhi muman'at aayi hai (shayad murad is se nasl munqata karne ki gharz se aisa karna hai). Ek ma'ani yeh bhi kiye gaye hain ke chehre par godna gudwana, jo Sahih Muslim ki hadith mein mamnoo hai aur jis ke karne wale par Allah ki la'nat warid hui hai. Ibn-e-Mas'ood (R.A) se sahih sanad se marwi hai ke godne waliyon aur gudwane waliyon, peshani ke baal nochne waliyon aur nochwane waliyon aur danton mein kushadgi karne waliyon par jo husn-o-khoobsurti ke liye Allah ki banawat ko bigadti hain Allah ki la'nat hai. Main un par la'nat kyun na bhejoon? Jin par Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne la'nat ki hai aur jo Kitabullah mein maujood hai. Phir aap ne (Wama atakumur-rasulu fakhuzuho wama nahakum anhu fantahu, wattaqullaha innallaha shadidul-iqab) (Surah Al-Hashr: 7) padhi. Ba'z aur mufassireen-e-kiram se marwi hai ke murad Allah ke deen ko badal dena hai jaise aur aayat mein hai (Faqim wajhaka liddini hanifa, fitratallahi allati fataran-nasa alaiha, la tabdila likhalqillahi, zalikad-dinul-qayyimu walakinn-a aksaran-nasi la ya'lamun) (Surah Ar-Rum: 30). Ya'ni apna chehra qaim rakh kar Allah ke yak-tarfa deen ka rukh ikhtiyar karna. Yeh Allah ki woh fitrat hai jis par tamam insanon ko us ne paida kiya hai. Allah ki khalq mein koi tabdili nahin. Is se pichle (aakhri) jumle ko agar amr ke ma'ani mein liya jaye to yeh tafsir theek ho jati hai ya'ni Allah ki fitrat ko na badlo, logon ko main ne jis fitrat par paida kiya hai usi par rehne do. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai har bacha fitrat par paida hota hai lekin us ke maa-baap phir use yahudi ya nasrani ya majoosi bana lete hain, jaise bakri ka sahih salim bacha be-aib hota hai lekin phir log us ke kaan waghera kaat dete hain aur use aib-dar kar dete hain. Sahih Muslim mein hai Allah Azza-wa-Jal farmata hai main ne apne bandon ko yaksooi wale deen par paida kiya lekin shaitan ne aa kar unhein behka diya, phir main ne apne halal ko un par haram kar diya. Shaitan ko dost banane wala apna nuqsan karne wala hai jis nuqsan ki kabhi talafi na ho sake. Kyunke shaitan unhein sabz bagh dikhata rehta hai, ghalat rahon mein un ki falah-o-behbood ka yaqin dilata hai, darasal woh bada fareb aur saaf dhoka hota hai. Chunancha shaitan Qayamat ke din saaf kahega Allah ke wade sache thay aur main to wada khilaf hoon hi, mera koi zor tum par tha hi nahin, meri pukar ko sunte hi kyun tum mast-o-be-aql ban gaye? Ab mujhe kyun koste ho? Apne aap ko bura kaho. Zahhak ka qaul hai ke mushrik farishton ko poojte thay aur unhein Allah ki ladkiyan mante thay aur kehte thay ke in ki ibadat se hamari asal gharz Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki nazdiki hasil karna hai aur in ki tasweerein aurton ki shakal par banate thay phir hukum karte thay aur taqleed karte thay aur kehte thay ke yeh suratein farishton ki hain jo Allah ki ladkiyan hain. Yeh tafsir (Afara'aitumul-Lata wal-Uzza) (Surah An-Najm: 19-20) ke mazmoon se khoob milti hai jahan in ke buton ke naam le kar Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya hai ke yeh khoob insaf hai ke ladke to tumhare aur ladkiyan meri? Aur ayat mein hai (Wa ja'alul-mala'ikatalladhina hum 'ibadur-Rahmani inasan, ashahidu khalqahum, satuktabu shahadatuhum wa yus'alun) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 19). In logon ne Allah Ta'ala aur jinnat mein nasab nikale hain, Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain murad murde hain, Hasan R.H farmate hain har be-rooh cheez inas hai khwah khushk lakdi ho khwah patthar ho, lekin yeh qaul ghareeb hai. Phir irshad hai ke darasal yeh shaitani pooja ke phande mein thay, Shaitan ko Rabb ne apni rahmat se door kar diya aur apni bargah se nikal bahar kiya hai, us ne bhi beeda utha rakha hai ke Allah ke bandon ko maqool tadaad mein behkaye, Qatada R.H farmate hain yani har hazar mein se nau sau ninnanve (999) ko jahannam mein apne sath le jaye ga, ek bach rahe ga jo jannat ka mustahiq hoga. Shaitan ne kaha hai ke main inhein haq se behkaunga aur inhein umeed dilata rahunga, yeh tauba tark kar baithenge, khwahishon ke peeche pad jayenge, maut ko bhool baithenge, nafs parwari aur akhirat se ghafil ho jayenge, janwaron ke kaan kaat kar ya surakh-dar kar ke Allah ke siwa dusron ke naam karne ki inhein talqeen karunga, Allah ki banayi hui suraton ko bigadna sikhaunga jaise janwaron ko khasi karna.

Ek hadith mein is se bhi muman'at aayi hai (shayad murad is se nasl munqata karne ki gharz se aisa karna hai). Ek ma'ani yeh bhi kiye gaye hain ke chehre par godna gudwana, jo Sahih Muslim ki hadith mein mamnoo hai aur jis ke karne wale par Allah ki la'nat warid hui hai. Ibn-e-Mas'ood (R.A) se sahih sanad se marwi hai ke godne waliyon aur gudwane waliyon, peshani ke baal nochne waliyon aur nochwane waliyon aur danton mein kushadgi karne waliyon par jo husn-o-khoobsurti ke liye Allah ki banawat ko bigadti hain Allah ki la'nat hai. Main un par la'nat kyun na bhejoon? Jin par Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne la'nat ki hai aur jo Kitabullah mein maujood hai. Phir aap ne (Wama atakumur-rasulu fakhuzuho wama nahakum anhu fantahu, wattaqullaha innallaha shadidul-iqab) (Surah Al-Hashr: 7) padhi. Ba'z aur mufassireen-e-kiram se marwi hai ke murad Allah ke deen ko badal dena hai jaise aur aayat mein hai (Faqim wajhaka liddini hanifa, fitratallahi allati fataran-nasa alaiha, la tabdila likhalqillahi, zalikad-dinul-qayyimu walakinn-a aksaran-nasi la ya'lamun) (Surah Ar-Rum: 30). Ya'ni apna chehra qaim rakh kar Allah ke yak-tarfa deen ka rukh ikhtiyar karna. Yeh Allah ki woh fitrat hai jis par tamam insanon ko us ne paida kiya hai. Allah ki khalq mein koi tabdili nahin. Is se pichle (aakhri) jumle ko agar amr ke ma'ani mein liya jaye to yeh tafsir theek ho jati hai ya'ni Allah ki fitrat ko na badlo, logon ko main ne jis fitrat par paida kiya hai usi par rehne do. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai har bacha fitrat par paida hota hai lekin us ke maa-baap phir use yahudi ya nasrani ya majoosi bana lete hain, jaise bakri ka sahih salim bacha be-aib hota hai lekin phir log us ke kaan waghera kaat dete hain aur use aib-dar kar dete hain. Sahih Muslim mein hai Allah Azza-wa-Jal farmata hai main ne apne bandon ko yaksooi wale deen par paida kiya lekin shaitan ne aa kar unhein behka diya, phir main ne apne halal ko un par haram kar diya. Shaitan ko dost banane wala apna nuqsan karne wala hai jis nuqsan ki kabhi talafi na ho sake. Kyunke shaitan unhein sabz bagh dikhata rehta hai, ghalat rahon mein un ki falah-o-behbood ka yaqin dilata hai, darasal woh bada fareb aur saaf dhoka hota hai. Chunancha shaitan Qayamat ke din saaf kahega Allah ke wade sache thay aur main to wada khilaf hoon hi, mera koi zor tum par tha hi nahin, meri pukar ko sunte hi kyun tum mast-o-be-aql ban gaye? Ab mujhe kyun koste ho? Apne aap ko bura kaho. Shaitani wadon ko sahih janne wale, us ki dilayi hui ummidon ko poori hone wali samajhne wale aakhirash Jahannam wasil honge jahan se chutkara mahal hoga.

In badbakhton ke zikr ke baad ab nek logon ka haal bayan ho raha hai ke jo dil se mere manne wale hain aur jism se meri tabedari karne wale hain, mere ahkaam par amal karte hain, meri mana karda cheezon se baaz rehte hain, main unhein apni ne'matein doonga, unhein jannaton mein le jaunga jin ki nahrein jahan yeh chahein khud-ba-khud behne lagen, jin mein zawaal, kami ya nuqsan bhi nahin hai. Allah ka yeh wada asal aur bilkul sacha hai aur yaqeenan hone wala hai. Allah se zyada sachi baat aur kis ki hogi? Is ke siwa koi mabood-e-barhaq nahin, na hi koi is ke siwa murabbi hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne khutbe mein farmaya karte the: Sab se zyada sachi baat Allah ka kalam hai aur sab se behtar hidayat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki hidayat hai aur tamam kamon mein sab se bura kaam deen mein nayi baat nikalna hai aur har aisi nayi baat ka naam bid'at hai aur har bid'at gumrahi hai aur har gumrahi jahannam mein hai.
