Masaib Gunahon Ka Kaffara. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain hum se zikr kiya gaya ke Ahl-e-Kitab aur Musalman mein charcha hone laga. Ahl-e-Kitab toh yeh keh kar apni fazilat jata rahe thay ke hamare Nabi tumhare Nabi se pehle ke hain aur hamari kitab bhi tumhari kitab se pehle ki hai aur Musalman keh rahe thay ke hamare Nabi Khatam-ul-Anbiya hain aur hamari kitab tamam agli kitabon ki tasdeeq karne wali hai. Is par yeh ayatein utrin aur Musalmanon ki sabqa deen walon par fazilat bayan hui. Mujahid (R.H) se marvi hai ke Arab ne kaha na toh hum marne ke baad jiyenge na hamein azab hoga. Yahudiyon ne kaha sirf hum hi Jannati hain, yahi qaul Nasraniyon ka bhi tha aur kehte thay aag hamein sirf chand din satayegi. Ayat ka mazmoon yeh hai ke sirf izhar karne aur dawa karne se sadaqat-o-haqqaniyat sabit nahin hoti balkay imandar woh hai jiska dil saaf ho aur amal shahid hon aur Allah Ta'ala ki daleel uske hathon mein ho. Tumhari khwahishein aur zabani dawe koi waqat nahin rakhte, na Ahl-e-Kitab ki tamannayein aur buland baatein, nijat ka madar hain balkay waqar-o-nijat Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala ki farman-bardari aur Rasoolon ki tabedari mein hai. Burai karne wale kisi nisbat ki wajah se is burai ke khamyaze se chhoot jayen namumkin hai balkay ratti ratti bhalai aur burai Qayamat ke din apni ankhon se apne samne dekh lenge. Yeh ayat Sahaba (R.A) par bohat garan guzri thi aur Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ne kaha tha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ab nijat kaise hogi? Jabke ek ek amal ka badla zaroori hai toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala tujhe bakhshe Abu Bakr! Yeh saza wahi hai jo kabhi teri bimari ki surat mein hoti hai, kabhi takleef ki surat mein, kabhi sadme aur gham-o-ranj ki surat mein aur kabhi bala-o-museebat ki shakal mein (Musnad Ahmad). Aur riwayat mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya har burai karne wala duniya mein badla pa lega.

Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar R.A ne apne ghulam se farmaya dekho jis jagah Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair R.A ko sooli di gayi hai wahan tum na chalna, ghulam bhool gaya, ab Hazrat Abdullah ki nazar Ibn-e-Zubair par padi toh farmane lage Wallah jahan tak meri maloomat hain meri gawahi hai ke tu rozay-dar aur namazi aur rishtay-naatay joray wala tha mujhe Allah se umeed hai ke jo laghzishein tujh se ho gayin un ka badla duniya mein hi mukammal ho ab tujhe Allah koi azab nahin de ga phir Hazrat Mujahid R.H ki taraf dekh kar farmane lage main ne Hazrat Abu Bakr R.A se suna hai woh farmate thay Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se main ne suna jo shakhs burai karta hai us ka badla duniya mein hi pa leta hai, dusri riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar R.A ne Hazrat Ibn-e-Zubair R.A ko sooli par dekh kar farmaya ae Abu Habib Allah tujh par raham kare main ne tere walid ki zaban se yeh hadith suni hai, Ibn-e-Marduyah gham-naak ho gaye unhein yeh maloom hone laga ke goya har har amal ka badla hi milna jab thehra toh nijat mushkil ho jaye gi aap ne farmaya suno Siddiq tum aur tumhare saathi yani momin toh duniya mein hi badla de diye jao ge aur in museebaton ke baais tumhare gunah maaf ho jayenge qayamat ke din paak saaf utho ge haan aur log ki buraiyan jama hoti jati hain aur qayamat ke din unhein saza di jaye gi, yeh hadith Tirmidhi ne bhi riwayat ki hai aur kaha hai ke is ka rawi Musa bin Ubaidah zaeef hai aur dusra rawi Maula bin Suba' majhool hai aur bhi bohat se tareeq se is riwayat ka mahasil marwi hai.

Ek aur hadith mein hai, Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) yeh aayat sab se zyada hum par bhari padti hai to Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya momin ka yeh badla wahi hai jo mukhtalif qisam ki pareshaniyon aur takleefon ki surat mein use duniya mein hi mil jata hai aur hadith mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya yahan tak ke momin apni naqdi jaib mein rakh le phir zaroorat ke waqt talash kare thodi der na mile phir jaib mein hath dalne se nikal aaye to itni der mein jo use sadma hua us se bhi us ke gunah maaf hote hain aur yeh bhi us ki buraiyon ka badla hojata hai yunhi masaib-e-duniya use kundan bana dete hain ke Qayamat ka koi bojh us par nahin rehta jis tarah sona bhatti mein tapa kar nikal liya jaye is tarah duniya mein pak saaf ho kar Allah ke paas jata hai, Ibn Marduyah mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se is aayat ke bare mein sawal kiya gaya to Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya momin ko har cheez mein ajar diya jata hai yahan tak ke maut ki sakhti ka bhi, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai jab bande ke gunah zyada hojate hain aur unhein door karne wale bakasrat nek aamal hote hain to Allah us par koi gham daal deta hai jis se us ke gunah maaf hojate hain, Saeed bin Mansoor laye hain ke jab Sahaba (R.A) par is aayat ka mazmoon garan guzra to Huzoor (ﷺ) ne un se farmaya theek thak raho aur mile jule raho musalman ki har takleef us ke gunah ka kaffara hai yahan tak ke kante ka lagna bhi is se kam takleef bhi riwayat mein hai ke jab Sahaba (R.A) ro rahe the aur ranj mein the us waqt Huzoor (ﷺ) ne un se yeh farmaya, ek shakhs ne Huzoor (ﷺ) se poocha ke hamari in bimariyon mein hamein kya milta hai? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya yeh tumhare gunahon ka kaffara hoti hain, ise sun kar Hazrat Ka'ab bin Ujra (R.A) ne dua mangi ke Ya Allah marte dam tak mujh se bukhar juda na ho lekin Hajj-o-Umrah, Jihad aur namaz-e-ba-jamaat se mehroom na hoon un ki yeh dua qabool hui jab un ke jism par hath lagaya jata to bukhar chadha rehta, (Musnad) Huzoor (ﷺ) se ek martaba kaha gaya ke kya har burai ka badla diya jaye ga? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya han, isi jaisa aur isi jitna lekin har bhalai ka badla das guna kar ke diya jaye ga pas is par afsos hai jis ki ikaiyan dahaiyon se badh jayen, (Ibn Marduyah) Hazrat Hasan (R.H) farmate hain is se murad kafir hain jaise aur aayat mein hai (Wa hal nujazi illa al-kafoor) (Surah Saba: 17). Ibn Abbas (R.A) aur Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) farmate hain yahan burai se murad shirk hai. Yeh shakhs Allah ke siwa apna koi wali aur madadgar na paye ga, han yeh aur baat hai ke tauba kar le, Imam Ibn Jareer (R.H) farmate hain theek baat yahi hai ke har burai ko yeh aayat shamil hai jaise ke ahadees guzar chukin Wallahu A'alam.

Bad-amliyon ki saza ka zikr karke ab nek aamal ki jaza ka bayan farma raha hai. Badi ki saza ya toh duniya mein hi ho jati hai aur bande ke liye yahi achha ya aakhirat mein hoti hai, Allah is se mehfooz rakhe. Hum Allah Ta'ala se sawal karte hain ki woh hamein dono jahan ki aafiyat ata farmaye aur meherbani aur darguzar kare aur apni pakad aur narazgi se bacha le. Aamal-e-Saliha ko Allah Ta'ala pasand farmata hai aur apne ehsan-o-karam-o-rahm se unhein qabool karta hai. Kisi mard-o-aurat ke kisi nek amal ko woh zaya nahin karta, haan yeh shart hai ki woh imandar ho. In nek logon ko woh apni jannat mein dakhil karega aur un ki hasanat mein koi kami nahin aane dega. Fateel kehte hain us guthli ke darmiyan jo halka sa chhilka hota hai us ko, magar yeh dono toh khajoor ke beej mein hote hain aur Qatmeer kehte hain us beej ke oopar ke lifafe ko aur yeh teeno lafz is mauqa par Quran mein aaye hain. Phir farmaya is se achhe deen wala kaun hai? Jo nek niyati ke sath us ke farman ke mutabiq us ke ahkaam baja laye aur ho bhi woh Mohsin yani shariat ka paband, deen-e-haq aur hidayat par chalne wala, Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki hadith par amal karne wala. Har nek amal ki qabooliyat ke liye yeh dono baatein shart hain yani khuloos aur wahi ke mutabiq hona. Khuloos se yeh matlab ki faqat Allah ki razamandi matloob ho aur theek hona yeh hai ki shariat ki mat-huti mein ho. Pas zahir toh Quran-o-Hadith ke muwafiq hone se theek ho jata hai aur batin nek niyati se sanwar jata hai. Agar in do baaton mein se ek bhi na ho toh woh amal fasid hota hai. Ikhlas na hone se munafiqat aa jati hai, logon ki raza joi aur unhein dikhana maqsood ho jata hai aur amal qabil-e-qabool nahin rehta. Sunnat ke muwafiq na hone se zalalat-o-jahalat ka majmooa ho jata hai aur is se bhi amal paya-e-qabooliyat se gir jata hai aur chunke momin ka amal riyakari aur shariat ki mukhalifat se bacha hua hota hai is liye us ka amal sab se achha amal ho jata hai jo Allah ko pasand aata hai aur us ki jaza ka balkeh aur gunahon ki bakhshish ka sabab ban jata hai. Aizaz-e-Khalil kyun aur kaise mila? Isi liye us ke baad hi farmaya Millat-e-Ibrahim Hanif ki pairwi karo yani Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aur aap ke qadam-ba-qadam chalne walon ki bhi qayamat tak hon, jaise aur aayat mein hai (Aayat: Inna awlan-nasi bi-Ibrahima...), yani Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se qareeb-tar woh log hain jo un ke har hukm ki tameel karte rahe aur Nabi hue. Dusri aayat mein farmaya (Thumma awhayna ilayka anittabi' millata Ibrahima hanifa, wa ma kana minal mushrikin) (Surah An-Nahl: 123). Phir hum ne teri taraf wahi ki ki Ibrahim Hanif ki millat ki pairwi kar jo mushrik na the. Hanif kehte hain qasdan shirk se bezar aur poori tarah haq ki taraf mutawajja hone wala jise koi rokne wala rok na sake aur koi hatane wala hata na sake.

Phir Hazrat Khalilullah ki itteba ki takeed aur targheeb ke liye unka wasf bayan kiya ke woh Allah ke dost hain, yani banda taraqqi karke jis aala se aala darjay tak pahunch sakta hai us tak woh pahunch gaye. Khillat ke darjay se koi bada darja nahin, mohabbat ka yeh aala-tar maqam hai aur yahan tak Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) urooj kar gaye hain. Iski wajah unki kamil itaat hai, jaise farman hai (Wa Ibrahimal-lazi waffa) (Surah An-Najm: 37), yani Ibrahim (A.S) ko jo hukum mila woh usay bakhushi baja laye, kabhi Allah ki marzi se munh na moda, kabhi ibadat se na uktaye, koi cheez unhein ibadat-e-Ilahiya se mani na hui. Aur aayat mein hai (Wa izibtala Ibrahima Rabbuhu bi-kalimatin fa-atammahunna, qala inni ja'iluka lin-nasi imama, qala wa min zurriyati, qala la yanalu 'ahdiz-zalimin) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 124). Jab jab jis jis tarah Allah Azza-Ismuhu ne unki aazmaish li woh pooray utray, jo jo Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya unhon ne kar dikhaya. Farman hai ke Ibrahim (A.S) mukammal yaksooi se tauheed ke rang mein shirk se bachta hua hamara tabe-e-farman bana raha. Hazrat Mu'az (R.A) ne Yaman mein subah ki namaz mein jab yeh aayat padhi to ek shakhs ne kaha: "Laqad qarrat 'ainu ummi Ibrahim" (Ibrahim ki maa ki aankhein thandi huin). Ba'az log kehte hain ke Khalilullah laqab ki yeh wajah hui ke ek martaba qahat-sali ke mauqay par aap apne ek dost ke paas Misr mein ya Mawsil mein gaye taake wahan se kuch anaaj ghalla le aayen, yahan kuch na mila, khali haath lautay. Jab apni basti ke qareeb pahunchay to khayal aaya aao is rait ke today mein se apni boriyan bhar kar le chalo taake ghar walon ko qadray taskeen ho jaye, chunancha bhar lein aur janwaron par laad ke le chalay. Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat se woh rait sach-much aata ban gayi. Aap to ghar pahunch kar lait rahe, thakay haaray to thay hi, aankh lag gayi. Ghar walon ne boriyan kholin aur unhein behtareen aatay se bhara hua paya. Aata goondha, rotiyan pakayin. Jab yeh jaagay aur ghar mein sab ko khush-khush paya aur rotiyan bhi tayyar dekhein to ta'ajjub se poochne lagay: "Aata kahan se aaya?"

Jo tum ne rotiyan pakayin unhon ne kaha aap hi toh apne dost ke haan se laye hain, ab aap samajh gaye aur farmaya haan yeh main apne dost Allah Azzawajal se laya hoon, pas Allah ne bhi aap ko apna dost bana liya aur Khalilullah naam rakh diya, lekin is ki sehat aur is waqiye mein zara ta'ammul hai, zyada se zyada yeh hai ke yeh Bani Israel ki riwayat ho jise hum sacha nahin keh sakte go jhutla bhi nahin sakte. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke aap ko yeh laqab is liye mila ke aap ke dil mein Allah Ta'ala ki mohabbat hadd-e-darja ki thi, kamil ita'at sha'ari aur farmanbardari thi, apni ibadaton se Allah Ta'ala ko khush kar liya tha. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bhi apne aakhri khutba mein farmaya tha, "Logon agar main zameen walon mein se kisi ko Khalil aur wali dost banane wala hota toh Abu Bakr bin Abu Quhafa ko banata, balkay tumhare sathi Allah Ta'ala ke Khalil hain," (Bukhari, Muslim). Aur riwayat mein hai, "Allah A'ala-o-Akram ne jis tarah Ibrahim ko Khalil bana liya tha isi tarah mujhe bhi apna Khalil kar liya hai."

Ek martaba as-hab-e-Rasool aap ke intezar mein baithe hue aapas mein zikr-o-tazkire kar rahe the, ek keh raha tha ta'ajjub hai ke Allah ne apni makhlooq mein se Hazrat Ibrahim ko apna Khalil banaya, dusre ne kaha is se bhi badh kar meherbani yeh ke Hazrat Musa se khud baatein keen aur unhein Kaleem banaya, ek ne kaha aur Isa toh Roohullah aur Kalimatullah hain, ek ne kaha Adam Safiullah aur Allah Ta'ala ke pasandida hain. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab bahar tashreef laye, salam kiya aur yeh baatein sunin toh farmaya, "Beshak tumhara qaul sahi hai, Ibrahim Khalilullah hain aur Musa Kaleemullah hain aur Isa Roohullah aur Kalimatullah hain aur Adam Safiullah hain aur isi tarah Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain, magar main haqeeqat bayan karta hoon, kuch fakhr ke taur par nahin kehta ke main Habibullah hoon, main sab se pehla shafa'at karne wala hoon aur sab se pehle shafa'at qabool kiya jane wala hoon aur sab se pehle jannat ke darwaze par dastak dene wala hoon, Allah mere liye jannat ko khol de ga aur mujhe is mein dakhil kare ga aur mere sath momin fuqra honge, Qayamat ke din tamam aglon pichlon se zyada ikram-o-izzat wala hoon, yeh bator-e-fakhr ke nahin balkay bator-e-sachai ko maloom karane ke liye main tum se keh raha hoon." Yeh hadith is sanad se toh ghareeb hai lekin is ke ba'az ke shahid majood hain.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain, "Kya tum is se ta'ajjub karte ho ke khullat sirf Hazrat Ibrahim ke liye thi aur kalam Hazrat Musa ke liye tha aur deedar Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke liye." Salawatullahi wa salamuhu alaihim ajma'een (Mustadrak Hakim). Isi tarah ki riwayat Hazrat Anas bin Malik aur bohat se sahaba, tabieen aur salaf-o-khalaf se marwi hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai, Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki aadat thi ke mehmanon ke sath khayein. Ek din aap mehman ki justuju mein nikle lekin koi na mila, wapas aaye, ghar mein dakhil hue toh dekha ke ek shakhs khada hua hai, pucha, "Ae Allah ke bande tujhe mere ghar mein aane ki ijazat kis ne di?" Us ne kaha, "Is makan ke haqeeqi malik ne." Pucha, "Tum kaun ho?"

Kaha main Malik-ul-Maut hoon mujhe Allah Ta'ala ne apne ek bande ke paas is liye bheja hai ke main use yeh basharat suna doon ke Allah Ta'ala ne use apna Khalil bana liya hai, yeh sun kar Hazrat ne kaha phir to mujhe zaroor bataiye ke woh buzurg kaun hain? Allah Azzawajal ki qasam agar woh zameen ke kisi door ke goshe mein bhi honge main zaroor ja kar un se mulaqat karunga phir apni baqi zindagi un ke qadmon mein hi guzaroonga yeh sun kar Hazrat Malik-ul-Maut ne kaha woh shakhs khud aap hain. Aap ne phir daryaft farmaya kya sach-much main hi hoon? Farishtay ne kaha haan aap hi hain. Aap ne phir daryaft farmaya ke aap mujhe yeh bhi batayenge ke kis bina par kin kamon par Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe apna Khalil banaya? Farishtay ne farmaya is liye ke tum har ek ko dete rehte ho aur khud kisi se kuch talab nahin karte aur riwayat mein hai. Jab Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ko Khalilullah ke mumtaz aur mubarak laqab se Allah ne mullaqab kiya tab se to un ke dil mein is qadar khauf-e-Rabb aur haibat-e-Rabb sama gayi ke un ke dil ka uchhalna door se is tarah suna jata tha jis tarah faza mein parind ke parwaz ki aawaz. Sahih hadith mein Janab-e-Rasool-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ) ki nisbat bhi warid hai ke jis waqt Allah Ta'ala ka khauf aap par ghalib aa jata tha to aap ke rone ki aawaz jise aap zabt karte jate the is tarah door-o-nazdeek walon ko sunai deti thi jaise kisi handiya ke kholne ki aawaz ho. Phir farmaya ke zameen-o-aasman mein jo kuch hai sab Allah ki malkiyat mein aur us ki ghulami mein aur usi ka paida kiya hua hai. Jis tarah jab jo tasarruf un mein woh karna chahta hai baghair kisi rok-tok ke bila-mashwara-e-ghaire aur baghair kisi ki sharakat aur madad ke kar guzarta hai koi nahin jo us ke iraday se use baaz rakh sake koi nahin jo us ke hukm mein hail ho sake koi nahin jo us ki marzi ko badal sake woh azmaton aur qudraton wala woh adl-o-hikmat wala woh lutf-o-rahm wala Wahid-o-Samad Allah hai. Us ka ilm har chhoti badi cheez ko ghere hue hai, makhfi se makhfi aur chhoti se chhoti aur door se door wali cheez bhi us par posheeda nahin, hamari nigahon se jo posheeda hain us ke ilm mein sab zahir hain.

Masaib Gunahon Ka Kaffara. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain hum se zikr kiya gaya ke Ahl-e-Kitab aur Musalman mein charcha hone laga. Ahl-e-Kitab toh yeh keh kar apni fazilat jata rahe thay ke hamare Nabi tumhare Nabi se pehle ke hain aur hamari kitab bhi tumhari kitab se pehle ki hai aur Musalman keh rahe thay ke hamare Nabi Khatam-ul-Anbiya hain aur hamari kitab tamam agli kitabon ki tasdeeq karne wali hai. Is par yeh ayatein utrin aur Musalmanon ki sabqa deen walon par fazilat bayan hui. Mujahid (R.H) se marvi hai ke Arab ne kaha na toh hum marne ke baad jiyenge na hamein azab hoga. Yahudiyon ne kaha sirf hum hi Jannati hain, yahi qaul Nasraniyon ka bhi tha aur kehte thay aag hamein sirf chand din satayegi. Ayat ka mazmoon yeh hai ke sirf izhar karne aur dawa karne se sadaqat-o-haqqaniyat sabit nahin hoti balkay imandar woh hai jiska dil saaf ho aur amal shahid hon aur Allah Ta'ala ki daleel uske hathon mein ho. Tumhari khwahishein aur zabani dawe koi waqat nahin rakhte, na Ahl-e-Kitab ki tamannayein aur buland baatein, nijat ka madar hain balkay waqar-o-nijat Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala ki farman-bardari aur Rasoolon ki tabedari mein hai. Burai karne wale kisi nisbat ki wajah se is burai ke khamyaze se chhoot jayen namumkin hai balkay ratti ratti bhalai aur burai Qayamat ke din apni ankhon se apne samne dekh lenge. Yeh ayat Sahaba (R.A) par bohat garan guzri thi aur Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ne kaha tha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ab nijat kaise hogi? Jabke ek ek amal ka badla zaroori hai toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala tujhe bakhshe Abu Bakr! Yeh saza wahi hai jo kabhi teri bimari ki surat mein hoti hai, kabhi takleef ki surat mein, kabhi sadme aur gham-o-ranj ki surat mein aur kabhi bala-o-museebat ki shakal mein (Musnad Ahmad). Aur riwayat mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya har burai karne wala duniya mein badla pa lega.

Ek aur hadith mein hai, Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) yeh aayat sab se zyada hum par bhari padti hai to Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya momin ka yeh badla wahi hai jo mukhtalif qisam ki pareshaniyon aur takleefon ki surat mein use duniya mein hi mil jata hai aur hadith mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya yahan tak ke momin apni naqdi jaib mein rakh le phir zaroorat ke waqt talash kare thodi der na mile phir jaib mein hath dalne se nikal aaye to itni der mein jo use sadma hua us se bhi us ke gunah maaf hote hain aur yeh bhi us ki buraiyon ka badla hojata hai yunhi masaib-e-duniya use kundan bana dete hain ke Qayamat ka koi bojh us par nahin rehta jis tarah sona bhatti mein tapa kar nikal liya jaye is tarah duniya mein pak saaf ho kar Allah ke paas jata hai, Ibn Marduyah mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se is aayat ke bare mein sawal kiya gaya to Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya momin ko har cheez mein ajar diya jata hai yahan tak ke maut ki sakhti ka bhi, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai jab bande ke gunah zyada hojate hain aur unhein door karne wale bakasrat nek aamal hote hain to Allah us par koi gham daal deta hai jis se us ke gunah maaf hojate hain, Saeed bin Mansoor laye hain ke jab Sahaba (R.A) par is aayat ka mazmoon garan guzra to Huzoor (ﷺ) ne un se farmaya theek thak raho aur mile jule raho musalman ki har takleef us ke gunah ka kaffara hai yahan tak ke kante ka lagna bhi is se kam takleef bhi riwayat mein hai ke jab Sahaba (R.A) ro rahe the aur ranj mein the us waqt Huzoor (ﷺ) ne un se yeh farmaya, ek shakhs ne Huzoor (ﷺ) se poocha ke hamari in bimariyon mein hamein kya milta hai? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya yeh tumhare gunahon ka kaffara hoti hain, ise sun kar Hazrat Ka'ab bin Ujra (R.A) ne dua mangi ke Ya Allah marte dam tak mujh se bukhar juda na ho lekin Hajj-o-Umrah, Jihad aur namaz-e-ba-jamaat se mehroom na hoon un ki yeh dua qabool hui jab un ke jism par hath lagaya jata to bukhar chadha rehta, (Musnad) Huzoor (ﷺ) se ek martaba kaha gaya ke kya har burai ka badla diya jaye ga? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya han, isi jaisa aur isi jitna lekin har bhalai ka badla das guna kar ke diya jaye ga pas is par afsos hai jis ki ikaiyan dahaiyon se badh jayen, (Ibn Marduyah) Hazrat Hasan (R.H) farmate hain is se murad kafir hain jaise aur aayat mein hai (Wa hal nujazi illa al-kafoor) (Surah Saba: 17). Ibn Abbas (R.A) aur Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) farmate hain yahan burai se murad shirk hai. Yeh shakhs Allah ke siwa apna koi wali aur madadgar na paye ga, han yeh aur baat hai ke tauba kar le, Imam Ibn Jareer (R.H) farmate hain theek baat yahi hai ke har burai ko yeh aayat shamil hai jaise ke ahadees guzar chukin Wallahu A'alam.

Bad-amliyon ki saza ka zikr karke ab nek aamal ki jaza ka bayan farma raha hai. Badi ki saza ya toh duniya mein hi ho jati hai aur bande ke liye yahi achha ya aakhirat mein hoti hai, Allah is se mehfooz rakhe. Hum Allah Ta'ala se sawal karte hain ki woh hamein dono jahan ki aafiyat ata farmaye aur meherbani aur darguzar kare aur apni pakad aur narazgi se bacha le. Aamal-e-Saliha ko Allah Ta'ala pasand farmata hai aur apne ehsan-o-karam-o-rahm se unhein qabool karta hai. Kisi mard-o-aurat ke kisi nek amal ko woh zaya nahin karta, haan yeh shart hai ki woh imandar ho. In nek logon ko woh apni jannat mein dakhil karega aur un ki hasanat mein koi kami nahin aane dega. Fateel kehte hain us guthli ke darmiyan jo halka sa chhilka hota hai us ko, magar yeh dono toh khajoor ke beej mein hote hain aur Qatmeer kehte hain us beej ke oopar ke lifafe ko aur yeh teeno lafz is mauqa par Quran mein aaye hain. Phir farmaya is se achhe deen wala kaun hai? Jo nek niyati ke sath us ke farman ke mutabiq us ke ahkaam baja laye aur ho bhi woh Mohsin yani shariat ka paband, deen-e-haq aur hidayat par chalne wala, Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki hadith par amal karne wala. Har nek amal ki qabooliyat ke liye yeh dono baatein shart hain yani khuloos aur wahi ke mutabiq hona. Khuloos se yeh matlab ki faqat Allah ki razamandi matloob ho aur theek hona yeh hai ki shariat ki mat-huti mein ho. Pas zahir toh Quran-o-Hadith ke muwafiq hone se theek ho jata hai aur batin nek niyati se sanwar jata hai. Agar in do baaton mein se ek bhi na ho toh woh amal fasid hota hai. Ikhlas na hone se munafiqat aa jati hai, logon ki raza joi aur unhein dikhana maqsood ho jata hai aur amal qabil-e-qabool nahin rehta. Sunnat ke muwafiq na hone se zalalat-o-jahalat ka majmooa ho jata hai aur is se bhi amal paya-e-qabooliyat se gir jata hai aur chunke momin ka amal riyakari aur shariat ki mukhalifat se bacha hua hota hai is liye us ka amal sab se achha amal ho jata hai jo Allah ko pasand aata hai aur us ki jaza ka balkeh aur gunahon ki bakhshish ka sabab ban jata hai. Aizaz-e-Khalil kyun aur kaise mila? Isi liye us ke baad hi farmaya Millat-e-Ibrahim Hanif ki pairwi karo yani Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aur aap ke qadam-ba-qadam chalne walon ki bhi qayamat tak hon, jaise aur aayat mein hai (Aayat: Inna awlan-nasi bi-Ibrahima...), yani Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se qareeb-tar woh log hain jo un ke har hukm ki tameel karte rahe aur Nabi hue. Dusri aayat mein farmaya (Thumma awhayna ilayka anittabi' millata Ibrahima hanifa, wa ma kana minal mushrikin) (Surah An-Nahl: 123). Phir hum ne teri taraf wahi ki ki Ibrahim Hanif ki millat ki pairwi kar jo mushrik na the. Hanif kehte hain qasdan shirk se bezar aur poori tarah haq ki taraf mutawajja hone wala jise koi rokne wala rok na sake aur koi hatane wala hata na sake.

Phir Hazrat Khalilullah ki itteba ki takeed aur targheeb ke liye unka wasf bayan kiya ke woh Allah ke dost hain, yani banda taraqqi karke jis aala se aala darjay tak pahunch sakta hai us tak woh pahunch gaye. Khillat ke darjay se koi bada darja nahin, mohabbat ka yeh aala-tar maqam hai aur yahan tak Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) urooj kar gaye hain. Iski wajah unki kamil itaat hai, jaise farman hai (Wa Ibrahimal-lazi waffa) (Surah An-Najm: 37), yani Ibrahim (A.S) ko jo hukum mila woh usay bakhushi baja laye, kabhi Allah ki marzi se munh na moda, kabhi ibadat se na uktaye, koi cheez unhein ibadat-e-Ilahiya se mani na hui. Aur aayat mein hai (Wa izibtala Ibrahima Rabbuhu bi-kalimatin fa-atammahunna, qala inni ja'iluka lin-nasi imama, qala wa min zurriyati, qala la yanalu 'ahdiz-zalimin) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 124). Jab jab jis jis tarah Allah Azza-Ismuhu ne unki aazmaish li woh pooray utray, jo jo Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya unhon ne kar dikhaya. Farman hai ke Ibrahim (A.S) mukammal yaksooi se tauheed ke rang mein shirk se bachta hua hamara tabe-e-farman bana raha. Hazrat Mu'az (R.A) ne Yaman mein subah ki namaz mein jab yeh aayat padhi to ek shakhs ne kaha: "Laqad qarrat 'ainu ummi Ibrahim" (Ibrahim ki maa ki aankhein thandi huin). Ba'az log kehte hain ke Khalilullah laqab ki yeh wajah hui ke ek martaba qahat-sali ke mauqay par aap apne ek dost ke paas Misr mein ya Mawsil mein gaye taake wahan se kuch anaaj ghalla le aayen, yahan kuch na mila, khali haath lautay. Jab apni basti ke qareeb pahunchay to khayal aaya aao is rait ke today mein se apni boriyan bhar kar le chalo taake ghar walon ko qadray taskeen ho jaye, chunancha bhar lein aur janwaron par laad ke le chalay. Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat se woh rait sach-much aata ban gayi. Aap to ghar pahunch kar lait rahe, thakay haaray to thay hi, aankh lag gayi. Ghar walon ne boriyan kholin aur unhein behtareen aatay se bhara hua paya. Aata goondha, rotiyan pakayin. Jab yeh jaagay aur ghar mein sab ko khush-khush paya aur rotiyan bhi tayyar dekhein to ta'ajjub se poochne lagay: "Aata kahan se aaya?"

Jo tum ne rotiyan pakayin unhon ne kaha aap hi toh apne dost ke haan se laye hain, ab aap samajh gaye aur farmaya haan yeh main apne dost Allah Azzawajal se laya hoon, pas Allah ne bhi aap ko apna dost bana liya aur Khalilullah naam rakh diya, lekin is ki sehat aur is waqiye mein zara ta'ammul hai, zyada se zyada yeh hai ke yeh Bani Israel ki riwayat ho jise hum sacha nahin keh sakte go jhutla bhi nahin sakte. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke aap ko yeh laqab is liye mila ke aap ke dil mein Allah Ta'ala ki mohabbat hadd-e-darja ki thi, kamil ita'at sha'ari aur farmanbardari thi, apni ibadaton se Allah Ta'ala ko khush kar liya tha. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bhi apne aakhri khutba mein farmaya tha, "Logon agar main zameen walon mein se kisi ko Khalil aur wali dost banane wala hota toh Abu Bakr bin Abu Quhafa ko banata, balkay tumhare sathi Allah Ta'ala ke Khalil hain," (Bukhari, Muslim). Aur riwayat mein hai, "Allah A'ala-o-Akram ne jis tarah Ibrahim ko Khalil bana liya tha isi tarah mujhe bhi apna Khalil kar liya hai."

Ek martaba as-hab-e-Rasool aap ke intezar mein baithe hue aapas mein zikr-o-tazkire kar rahe the, ek keh raha tha ta'ajjub hai ke Allah ne apni makhlooq mein se Hazrat Ibrahim ko apna Khalil banaya, dusre ne kaha is se bhi badh kar meherbani yeh ke Hazrat Musa se khud baatein keen aur unhein Kaleem banaya, ek ne kaha aur Isa toh Roohullah aur Kalimatullah hain, ek ne kaha Adam Safiullah aur Allah Ta'ala ke pasandida hain. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab bahar tashreef laye, salam kiya aur yeh baatein sunin toh farmaya, "Beshak tumhara qaul sahi hai, Ibrahim Khalilullah hain aur Musa Kaleemullah hain aur Isa Roohullah aur Kalimatullah hain aur Adam Safiullah hain aur isi tarah Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain, magar main haqeeqat bayan karta hoon, kuch fakhr ke taur par nahin kehta ke main Habibullah hoon, main sab se pehla shafa'at karne wala hoon aur sab se pehle shafa'at qabool kiya jane wala hoon aur sab se pehle jannat ke darwaze par dastak dene wala hoon, Allah mere liye jannat ko khol de ga aur mujhe is mein dakhil kare ga aur mere sath momin fuqra honge, Qayamat ke din tamam aglon pichlon se zyada ikram-o-izzat wala hoon, yeh bator-e-fakhr ke nahin balkay bator-e-sachai ko maloom karane ke liye main tum se keh raha hoon." Yeh hadith is sanad se toh ghareeb hai lekin is ke ba'az ke shahid majood hain.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain, "Kya tum is se ta'ajjub karte ho ke khullat sirf Hazrat Ibrahim ke liye thi aur kalam Hazrat Musa ke liye tha aur deedar Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke liye." Salawatullahi wa salamuhu alaihim ajma'een (Mustadrak Hakim). Isi tarah ki riwayat Hazrat Anas bin Malik aur bohat se sahaba, tabieen aur salaf-o-khalaf se marwi hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai, Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki aadat thi ke mehmanon ke sath khayein. Ek din aap mehman ki justuju mein nikle lekin koi na mila, wapas aaye, ghar mein dakhil hue toh dekha ke ek shakhs khada hua hai, pucha, "Ae Allah ke bande tujhe mere ghar mein aane ki ijazat kis ne di?" Us ne kaha, "Is makan ke haqeeqi malik ne." Pucha, "Tum kaun ho?"

Kaha main Malik-ul-Maut hoon mujhe Allah Ta'ala ne apne ek bande ke paas is liye bheja hai ke main use yeh basharat suna doon ke Allah Ta'ala ne use apna Khalil bana liya hai, yeh sun kar Hazrat ne kaha phir to mujhe zaroor bataiye ke woh buzurg kaun hain? Allah Azzawajal ki qasam agar woh zameen ke kisi door ke goshe mein bhi honge main zaroor ja kar un se mulaqat karunga phir apni baqi zindagi un ke qadmon mein hi guzaroonga yeh sun kar Hazrat Malik-ul-Maut ne kaha woh shakhs khud aap hain. Aap ne phir daryaft farmaya kya sach-much main hi hoon? Farishtay ne kaha haan aap hi hain. Aap ne phir daryaft farmaya ke aap mujhe yeh bhi batayenge ke kis bina par kin kamon par Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe apna Khalil banaya? Farishtay ne farmaya is liye ke tum har ek ko dete rehte ho aur khud kisi se kuch talab nahin karte aur riwayat mein hai. Jab Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ko Khalilullah ke mumtaz aur mubarak laqab se Allah ne mullaqab kiya tab se to un ke dil mein is qadar khauf-e-Rabb aur haibat-e-Rabb sama gayi ke un ke dil ka uchhalna door se is tarah suna jata tha jis tarah faza mein parind ke parwaz ki aawaz. Sahih hadith mein Janab-e-Rasool-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ) ki nisbat bhi warid hai ke jis waqt Allah Ta'ala ka khauf aap par ghalib aa jata tha to aap ke rone ki aawaz jise aap zabt karte jate the is tarah door-o-nazdeek walon ko sunai deti thi jaise kisi handiya ke kholne ki aawaz ho. Phir farmaya ke zameen-o-aasman mein jo kuch hai sab Allah ki malkiyat mein aur us ki ghulami mein aur usi ka paida kiya hua hai. Jis tarah jab jo tasarruf un mein woh karna chahta hai baghair kisi rok-tok ke bila-mashwara-e-ghaire aur baghair kisi ki sharakat aur madad ke kar guzarta hai koi nahin jo us ke iraday se use baaz rakh sake koi nahin jo us ke hukm mein hail ho sake koi nahin jo us ki marzi ko badal sake woh azmaton aur qudraton wala woh adl-o-hikmat wala woh lutf-o-rahm wala Wahid-o-Samad Allah hai. Us ka ilm har chhoti badi cheez ko ghere hue hai, makhfi se makhfi aur chhoti se chhoti aur door se door wali cheez bhi us par posheeda nahin, hamari nigahon se jo posheeda hain us ke ilm mein sab zahir hain.

Masaib Gunahon Ka Kaffara. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain hum se zikr kiya gaya ke Ahl-e-Kitab aur Musalman mein charcha hone laga. Ahl-e-Kitab toh yeh keh kar apni fazilat jata rahe thay ke hamare Nabi tumhare Nabi se pehle ke hain aur hamari kitab bhi tumhari kitab se pehle ki hai aur Musalman keh rahe thay ke hamare Nabi Khatam-ul-Anbiya hain aur hamari kitab tamam agli kitabon ki tasdeeq karne wali hai. Is par yeh ayatein utrin aur Musalmanon ki sabqa deen walon par fazilat bayan hui. Mujahid (R.H) se marvi hai ke Arab ne kaha na toh hum marne ke baad jiyenge na hamein azab hoga. Yahudiyon ne kaha sirf hum hi Jannati hain, yahi qaul Nasraniyon ka bhi tha aur kehte thay aag hamein sirf chand din satayegi. Ayat ka mazmoon yeh hai ke sirf izhar karne aur dawa karne se sadaqat-o-haqqaniyat sabit nahin hoti balkay imandar woh hai jiska dil saaf ho aur amal shahid hon aur Allah Ta'ala ki daleel uske hathon mein ho. Tumhari khwahishein aur zabani dawe koi waqat nahin rakhte, na Ahl-e-Kitab ki tamannayein aur buland baatein, nijat ka madar hain balkay waqar-o-nijat Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala ki farman-bardari aur Rasoolon ki tabedari mein hai. Burai karne wale kisi nisbat ki wajah se is burai ke khamyaze se chhoot jayen namumkin hai balkay ratti ratti bhalai aur burai Qayamat ke din apni ankhon se apne samne dekh lenge. Yeh ayat Sahaba (R.A) par bohat garan guzri thi aur Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ne kaha tha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ab nijat kaise hogi? Jabke ek ek amal ka badla zaroori hai toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala tujhe bakhshe Abu Bakr! Yeh saza wahi hai jo kabhi teri bimari ki surat mein hoti hai, kabhi takleef ki surat mein, kabhi sadme aur gham-o-ranj ki surat mein aur kabhi bala-o-museebat ki shakal mein (Musnad Ahmad). Aur riwayat mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya har burai karne wala duniya mein badla pa lega.

Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar R.A ne apne ghulam se farmaya dekho jis jagah Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair R.A ko sooli di gayi hai wahan tum na chalna, ghulam bhool gaya, ab Hazrat Abdullah ki nazar Ibn-e-Zubair par padi toh farmane lage Wallah jahan tak meri maloomat hain meri gawahi hai ke tu rozay-dar aur namazi aur rishtay-naatay joray wala tha mujhe Allah se umeed hai ke jo laghzishein tujh se ho gayin un ka badla duniya mein hi mukammal ho ab tujhe Allah koi azab nahin de ga phir Hazrat Mujahid R.H ki taraf dekh kar farmane lage main ne Hazrat Abu Bakr R.A se suna hai woh farmate thay Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se main ne suna jo shakhs burai karta hai us ka badla duniya mein hi pa leta hai, dusri riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar R.A ne Hazrat Ibn-e-Zubair R.A ko sooli par dekh kar farmaya ae Abu Habib Allah tujh par raham kare main ne tere walid ki zaban se yeh hadith suni hai, Ibn-e-Marduyah gham-naak ho gaye unhein yeh maloom hone laga ke goya har har amal ka badla hi milna jab thehra toh nijat mushkil ho jaye gi aap ne farmaya suno Siddiq tum aur tumhare saathi yani momin toh duniya mein hi badla de diye jao ge aur in museebaton ke baais tumhare gunah maaf ho jayenge qayamat ke din paak saaf utho ge haan aur log ki buraiyan jama hoti jati hain aur qayamat ke din unhein saza di jaye gi, yeh hadith Tirmidhi ne bhi riwayat ki hai aur kaha hai ke is ka rawi Musa bin Ubaidah zaeef hai aur dusra rawi Maula bin Suba' majhool hai aur bhi bohat se tareeq se is riwayat ka mahasil marwi hai.

Phir farmaya is se achhe deen wala kaun hai? Jo nek niyati ke sath us ke farman ke mutabiq us ke ahkaam baja laye aur ho bhi woh Mohsin yani shariat ka paband, deen-e-haq aur hidayat par chalne wala, Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki hadith par amal karne wala. Har nek amal ki qabooliyat ke liye yeh dono baatein shart hain yani khuloos aur wahi ke mutabiq hona. Khuloos se yeh matlab ki faqat Allah ki razamandi matloob ho aur theek hona yeh hai ki shariat ki mat-huti mein ho. Pas zahir toh Quran-o-Hadith ke muwafiq hone se theek ho jata hai aur batin nek niyati se sanwar jata hai. Agar in do baaton mein se ek bhi na ho toh woh amal fasid hota hai. Ikhlas na hone se munafiqat aa jati hai, logon ki raza joi aur unhein dikhana maqsood ho jata hai aur amal qabil-e-qabool nahin rehta. Sunnat ke muwafiq na hone se zalalat-o-jahalat ka majmooa ho jata hai aur is se bhi amal paya-e-qabooliyat se gir jata hai aur chunke momin ka amal riyakari aur shariat ki mukhalifat se bacha hua hota hai is liye us ka amal sab se achha amal ho jata hai jo Allah ko pasand aata hai aur us ki jaza ka balkeh aur gunahon ki bakhshish ka sabab ban jata hai. Aizaz-e-Khalil kyun aur kaise mila? Isi liye us ke baad hi farmaya Millat-e-Ibrahim Hanif ki pairwi karo yani Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aur aap ke qadam-ba-qadam chalne walon ki bhi qayamat tak hon, jaise aur aayat mein hai (Aayat: Inna awlan-nasi bi-Ibrahima...), yani Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se qareeb-tar woh log hain jo un ke har hukm ki tameel karte rahe aur Nabi hue. Dusri aayat mein farmaya (Thumma awhayna ilayka anittabi' millata Ibrahima hanifa, wa ma kana minal mushrikin) (Surah An-Nahl: 123). Phir hum ne teri taraf wahi ki ki Ibrahim Hanif ki millat ki pairwi kar jo mushrik na the. Hanif kehte hain qasdan shirk se bezar aur poori tarah haq ki taraf mutawajja hone wala jise koi rokne wala rok na sake aur koi hatane wala hata na sake.

Phir Hazrat Khalilullah ki itteba ki takeed aur targheeb ke liye unka wasf bayan kiya ke woh Allah ke dost hain, yani banda taraqqi karke jis aala se aala darjay tak pahunch sakta hai us tak woh pahunch gaye. Khillat ke darjay se koi bada darja nahin, mohabbat ka yeh aala-tar maqam hai aur yahan tak Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) urooj kar gaye hain. Iski wajah unki kamil itaat hai, jaise farman hai (Wa Ibrahimal-lazi waffa) (Surah An-Najm: 37), yani Ibrahim (A.S) ko jo hukum mila woh usay bakhushi baja laye, kabhi Allah ki marzi se munh na moda, kabhi ibadat se na uktaye, koi cheez unhein ibadat-e-Ilahiya se mani na hui. Aur aayat mein hai (Wa izibtala Ibrahima Rabbuhu bi-kalimatin fa-atammahunna, qala inni ja'iluka lin-nasi imama, qala wa min zurriyati, qala la yanalu 'ahdiz-zalimin) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 124). Jab jab jis jis tarah Allah Azza-Ismuhu ne unki aazmaish li woh pooray utray, jo jo Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya unhon ne kar dikhaya. Farman hai ke Ibrahim (A.S) mukammal yaksooi se tauheed ke rang mein shirk se bachta hua hamara tabe-e-farman bana raha. Hazrat Mu'az (R.A) ne Yaman mein subah ki namaz mein jab yeh aayat padhi to ek shakhs ne kaha: "Laqad qarrat 'ainu ummi Ibrahim" (Ibrahim ki maa ki aankhein thandi huin). Ba'az log kehte hain ke Khalilullah laqab ki yeh wajah hui ke ek martaba qahat-sali ke mauqay par aap apne ek dost ke paas Misr mein ya Mawsil mein gaye taake wahan se kuch anaaj ghalla le aayen, yahan kuch na mila, khali haath lautay. Jab apni basti ke qareeb pahunchay to khayal aaya aao is rait ke today mein se apni boriyan bhar kar le chalo taake ghar walon ko qadray taskeen ho jaye, chunancha bhar lein aur janwaron par laad ke le chalay. Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat se woh rait sach-much aata ban gayi. Aap to ghar pahunch kar lait rahe, thakay haaray to thay hi, aankh lag gayi. Ghar walon ne boriyan kholin aur unhein behtareen aatay se bhara hua paya. Aata goondha, rotiyan pakayin. Jab yeh jaagay aur ghar mein sab ko khush-khush paya aur rotiyan bhi tayyar dekhein to ta'ajjub se poochne lagay: "Aata kahan se aaya?"

Jo tum ne rotiyan pakayin unhon ne kaha aap hi toh apne dost ke haan se laye hain, ab aap samajh gaye aur farmaya haan yeh main apne dost Allah Azzawajal se laya hoon, pas Allah ne bhi aap ko apna dost bana liya aur Khalilullah naam rakh diya, lekin is ki sehat aur is waqiye mein zara ta'ammul hai, zyada se zyada yeh hai ke yeh Bani Israel ki riwayat ho jise hum sacha nahin keh sakte go jhutla bhi nahin sakte. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke aap ko yeh laqab is liye mila ke aap ke dil mein Allah Ta'ala ki mohabbat hadd-e-darja ki thi, kamil ita'at sha'ari aur farmanbardari thi, apni ibadaton se Allah Ta'ala ko khush kar liya tha. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bhi apne aakhri khutba mein farmaya tha, "Logon agar main zameen walon mein se kisi ko Khalil aur wali dost banane wala hota toh Abu Bakr bin Abu Quhafa ko banata, balkay tumhare sathi Allah Ta'ala ke Khalil hain," (Bukhari, Muslim). Aur riwayat mein hai, "Allah A'ala-o-Akram ne jis tarah Ibrahim ko Khalil bana liya tha isi tarah mujhe bhi apna Khalil kar liya hai."

Ek martaba as-hab-e-Rasool aap ke intezar mein baithe hue aapas mein zikr-o-tazkire kar rahe the, ek keh raha tha ta'ajjub hai ke Allah ne apni makhlooq mein se Hazrat Ibrahim ko apna Khalil banaya, dusre ne kaha is se bhi badh kar meherbani yeh ke Hazrat Musa se khud baatein keen aur unhein Kaleem banaya, ek ne kaha aur Isa toh Roohullah aur Kalimatullah hain, ek ne kaha Adam Safiullah aur Allah Ta'ala ke pasandida hain. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab bahar tashreef laye, salam kiya aur yeh baatein sunin toh farmaya, "Beshak tumhara qaul sahi hai, Ibrahim Khalilullah hain aur Musa Kaleemullah hain aur Isa Roohullah aur Kalimatullah hain aur Adam Safiullah hain aur isi tarah Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain, magar main haqeeqat bayan karta hoon, kuch fakhr ke taur par nahin kehta ke main Habibullah hoon, main sab se pehla shafa'at karne wala hoon aur sab se pehle shafa'at qabool kiya jane wala hoon aur sab se pehle jannat ke darwaze par dastak dene wala hoon, Allah mere liye jannat ko khol de ga aur mujhe is mein dakhil kare ga aur mere sath momin fuqra honge, Qayamat ke din tamam aglon pichlon se zyada ikram-o-izzat wala hoon, yeh bator-e-fakhr ke nahin balkay bator-e-sachai ko maloom karane ke liye main tum se keh raha hoon." Yeh hadith is sanad se toh ghareeb hai lekin is ke ba'az ke shahid majood hain.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain, "Kya tum is se ta'ajjub karte ho ke khullat sirf Hazrat Ibrahim ke liye thi aur kalam Hazrat Musa ke liye tha aur deedar Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke liye." Salawatullahi wa salamuhu alaihim ajma'een (Mustadrak Hakim). Isi tarah ki riwayat Hazrat Anas bin Malik aur bohat se sahaba, tabieen aur salaf-o-khalaf se marwi hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai, Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki aadat thi ke mehmanon ke sath khayein. Ek din aap mehman ki justuju mein nikle lekin koi na mila, wapas aaye, ghar mein dakhil hue toh dekha ke ek shakhs khada hua hai, pucha, "Ae Allah ke bande tujhe mere ghar mein aane ki ijazat kis ne di?" Us ne kaha, "Is makan ke haqeeqi malik ne." Pucha, "Tum kaun ho?"

Kaha main Malik-ul-Maut hoon mujhe Allah Ta'ala ne apne ek bande ke paas is liye bheja hai ke main use yeh basharat suna doon ke Allah Ta'ala ne use apna Khalil bana liya hai, yeh sun kar Hazrat ne kaha phir to mujhe zaroor bataiye ke woh buzurg kaun hain? Allah Azzawajal ki qasam agar woh zameen ke kisi door ke goshe mein bhi honge main zaroor ja kar un se mulaqat karunga phir apni baqi zindagi un ke qadmon mein hi guzaroonga yeh sun kar Hazrat Malik-ul-Maut ne kaha woh shakhs khud aap hain. Aap ne phir daryaft farmaya kya sach-much main hi hoon? Farishtay ne kaha haan aap hi hain. Aap ne phir daryaft farmaya ke aap mujhe yeh bhi batayenge ke kis bina par kin kamon par Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe apna Khalil banaya? Farishtay ne farmaya is liye ke tum har ek ko dete rehte ho aur khud kisi se kuch talab nahin karte aur riwayat mein hai. Jab Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ko Khalilullah ke mumtaz aur mubarak laqab se Allah ne mullaqab kiya tab se to un ke dil mein is qadar khauf-e-Rabb aur haibat-e-Rabb sama gayi ke un ke dil ka uchhalna door se is tarah suna jata tha jis tarah faza mein parind ke parwaz ki aawaz. Sahih hadith mein Janab-e-Rasool-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ) ki nisbat bhi warid hai ke jis waqt Allah Ta'ala ka khauf aap par ghalib aa jata tha to aap ke rone ki aawaz jise aap zabt karte jate the is tarah door-o-nazdeek walon ko sunai deti thi jaise kisi handiya ke kholne ki aawaz ho. Phir farmaya ke zameen-o-aasman mein jo kuch hai sab Allah ki malkiyat mein aur us ki ghulami mein aur usi ka paida kiya hua hai. Jis tarah jab jo tasarruf un mein woh karna chahta hai baghair kisi rok-tok ke bila-mashwara-e-ghaire aur baghair kisi ki sharakat aur madad ke kar guzarta hai koi nahin jo us ke iraday se use baaz rakh sake koi nahin jo us ke hukm mein hail ho sake koi nahin jo us ki marzi ko badal sake woh azmaton aur qudraton wala woh adl-o-hikmat wala woh lutf-o-rahm wala Wahid-o-Samad Allah hai. Us ka ilm har chhoti badi cheez ko ghere hue hai, makhfi se makhfi aur chhoti se chhoti aur door se door wali cheez bhi us par posheeda nahin, hamari nigahon se jo posheeda hain us ke ilm mein sab zahir hain.

Masaib Gunahon Ka Kaffara. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain hum se zikr kiya gaya ke Ahl-e-Kitab aur Musalman mein charcha hone laga. Ahl-e-Kitab toh yeh keh kar apni fazilat jata rahe thay ke hamare Nabi tumhare Nabi se pehle ke hain aur hamari kitab bhi tumhari kitab se pehle ki hai aur Musalman keh rahe thay ke hamare Nabi Khatam-ul-Anbiya hain aur hamari kitab tamam agli kitabon ki tasdeeq karne wali hai. Is par yeh ayatein utrin aur Musalmanon ki sabqa deen walon par fazilat bayan hui. Mujahid (R.H) se marvi hai ke Arab ne kaha na toh hum marne ke baad jiyenge na hamein azab hoga. Yahudiyon ne kaha sirf hum hi Jannati hain, yahi qaul Nasraniyon ka bhi tha aur kehte thay aag hamein sirf chand din satayegi. Ayat ka mazmoon yeh hai ke sirf izhar karne aur dawa karne se sadaqat-o-haqqaniyat sabit nahin hoti balkay imandar woh hai jiska dil saaf ho aur amal shahid hon aur Allah Ta'ala ki daleel uske hathon mein ho. Tumhari khwahishein aur zabani dawe koi waqat nahin rakhte, na Ahl-e-Kitab ki tamannayein aur buland baatein, nijat ka madar hain balkay waqar-o-nijat Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala ki farman-bardari aur Rasoolon ki tabedari mein hai. Burai karne wale kisi nisbat ki wajah se is burai ke khamyaze se chhoot jayen namumkin hai balkay ratti ratti bhalai aur burai Qayamat ke din apni ankhon se apne samne dekh lenge. Yeh ayat Sahaba (R.A) par bohat garan guzri thi aur Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ne kaha tha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ab nijat kaise hogi? Jabke ek ek amal ka badla zaroori hai toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala tujhe bakhshe Abu Bakr! Yeh saza wahi hai jo kabhi teri bimari ki surat mein hoti hai, kabhi takleef ki surat mein, kabhi sadme aur gham-o-ranj ki surat mein aur kabhi bala-o-museebat ki shakal mein (Musnad Ahmad). Aur riwayat mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya har burai karne wala duniya mein badla pa lega.

Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar R.A ne apne ghulam se farmaya dekho jis jagah Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair R.A ko sooli di gayi hai wahan tum na chalna, ghulam bhool gaya, ab Hazrat Abdullah ki nazar Ibn-e-Zubair par padi toh farmane lage Wallah jahan tak meri maloomat hain meri gawahi hai ke tu rozay-dar aur namazi aur rishtay-naatay joray wala tha mujhe Allah se umeed hai ke jo laghzishein tujh se ho gayin un ka badla duniya mein hi mukammal ho ab tujhe Allah koi azab nahin de ga phir Hazrat Mujahid R.H ki taraf dekh kar farmane lage main ne Hazrat Abu Bakr R.A se suna hai woh farmate thay Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se main ne suna jo shakhs burai karta hai us ka badla duniya mein hi pa leta hai, dusri riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar R.A ne Hazrat Ibn-e-Zubair R.A ko sooli par dekh kar farmaya ae Abu Habib Allah tujh par raham kare main ne tere walid ki zaban se yeh hadith suni hai, Ibn-e-Marduyah gham-naak ho gaye unhein yeh maloom hone laga ke goya har har amal ka badla hi milna jab thehra toh nijat mushkil ho jaye gi aap ne farmaya suno Siddiq tum aur tumhare saathi yani momin toh duniya mein hi badla de diye jao ge aur in museebaton ke baais tumhare gunah maaf ho jayenge qayamat ke din paak saaf utho ge haan aur log ki buraiyan jama hoti jati hain aur qayamat ke din unhein saza di jaye gi, yeh hadith Tirmidhi ne bhi riwayat ki hai aur kaha hai ke is ka rawi Musa bin Ubaidah zaeef hai aur dusra rawi Maula bin Suba' majhool hai aur bhi bohat se tareeq se is riwayat ka mahasil marwi hai.

Ek aur hadith mein hai, Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) yeh aayat sab se zyada hum par bhari padti hai to Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya momin ka yeh badla wahi hai jo mukhtalif qisam ki pareshaniyon aur takleefon ki surat mein use duniya mein hi mil jata hai aur hadith mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya yahan tak ke momin apni naqdi jaib mein rakh le phir zaroorat ke waqt talash kare thodi der na mile phir jaib mein hath dalne se nikal aaye to itni der mein jo use sadma hua us se bhi us ke gunah maaf hote hain aur yeh bhi us ki buraiyon ka badla hojata hai yunhi masaib-e-duniya use kundan bana dete hain ke Qayamat ka koi bojh us par nahin rehta jis tarah sona bhatti mein tapa kar nikal liya jaye is tarah duniya mein pak saaf ho kar Allah ke paas jata hai, Ibn Marduyah mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se is aayat ke bare mein sawal kiya gaya to Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya momin ko har cheez mein ajar diya jata hai yahan tak ke maut ki sakhti ka bhi, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai jab bande ke gunah zyada hojate hain aur unhein door karne wale bakasrat nek aamal hote hain to Allah us par koi gham daal deta hai jis se us ke gunah maaf hojate hain, Saeed bin Mansoor laye hain ke jab Sahaba (R.A) par is aayat ka mazmoon garan guzra to Huzoor (ﷺ) ne un se farmaya theek thak raho aur mile jule raho musalman ki har takleef us ke gunah ka kaffara hai yahan tak ke kante ka lagna bhi is se kam takleef bhi riwayat mein hai ke jab Sahaba (R.A) ro rahe the aur ranj mein the us waqt Huzoor (ﷺ) ne un se yeh farmaya, ek shakhs ne Huzoor (ﷺ) se poocha ke hamari in bimariyon mein hamein kya milta hai? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya yeh tumhare gunahon ka kaffara hoti hain, ise sun kar Hazrat Ka'ab bin Ujra (R.A) ne dua mangi ke Ya Allah marte dam tak mujh se bukhar juda na ho lekin Hajj-o-Umrah, Jihad aur namaz-e-ba-jamaat se mehroom na hoon un ki yeh dua qabool hui jab un ke jism par hath lagaya jata to bukhar chadha rehta, (Musnad) Huzoor (ﷺ) se ek martaba kaha gaya ke kya har burai ka badla diya jaye ga? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya han, isi jaisa aur isi jitna lekin har bhalai ka badla das guna kar ke diya jaye ga pas is par afsos hai jis ki ikaiyan dahaiyon se badh jayen, (Ibn Marduyah) Hazrat Hasan (R.H) farmate hain is se murad kafir hain jaise aur aayat mein hai (Wa hal nujazi illa al-kafoor) (Surah Saba: 17). Ibn Abbas (R.A) aur Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) farmate hain yahan burai se murad shirk hai. Yeh shakhs Allah ke siwa apna koi wali aur madadgar na paye ga, han yeh aur baat hai ke tauba kar le, Imam Ibn Jareer (R.H) farmate hain theek baat yahi hai ke har burai ko yeh aayat shamil hai jaise ke ahadees guzar chukin Wallahu A'alam.

Bad-amliyon ki saza ka zikr karke ab nek aamal ki jaza ka bayan farma raha hai. Badi ki saza ya toh duniya mein hi ho jati hai aur bande ke liye yahi achha ya aakhirat mein hoti hai, Allah is se mehfooz rakhe. Hum Allah Ta'ala se sawal karte hain ki woh hamein dono jahan ki aafiyat ata farmaye aur meherbani aur darguzar kare aur apni pakad aur narazgi se bacha le. Aamal-e-Saliha ko Allah Ta'ala pasand farmata hai aur apne ehsan-o-karam-o-rahm se unhein qabool karta hai. Kisi mard-o-aurat ke kisi nek amal ko woh zaya nahin karta, haan yeh shart hai ki woh imandar ho. In nek logon ko woh apni jannat mein dakhil karega aur un ki hasanat mein koi kami nahin aane dega. Fateel kehte hain us guthli ke darmiyan jo halka sa chhilka hota hai us ko, magar yeh dono toh khajoor ke beej mein hote hain aur Qatmeer kehte hain us beej ke oopar ke lifafe ko aur yeh teeno lafz is mauqa par Quran mein aaye hain. Jab apni basti ke qareeb pahunchay to khayal aaya aao is rait ke today mein se apni boriyan bhar kar le chalo taake ghar walon ko qadray taskeen ho jaye, chunancha bhar lein aur janwaron par laad ke le chalay. Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat se woh rait sach-much aata ban gayi. Aap to ghar pahunch kar lait rahe, thakay haaray to thay hi, aankh lag gayi. Ghar walon ne boriyan kholin aur unhein behtareen aatay se bhara hua paya. Aata goondha, rotiyan pakayin. Jab yeh jaagay aur ghar mein sab ko khush-khush paya aur rotiyan bhi tayyar dekhein to ta'ajjub se poochne lagay: "Aata kahan se aaya?"

Jo tum ne rotiyan pakayin unhon ne kaha aap hi toh apne dost ke haan se laye hain, ab aap samajh gaye aur farmaya haan yeh main apne dost Allah Azzawajal se laya hoon, pas Allah ne bhi aap ko apna dost bana liya aur Khalilullah naam rakh diya, lekin is ki sehat aur is waqiye mein zara ta'ammul hai, zyada se zyada yeh hai ke yeh Bani Israel ki riwayat ho jise hum sacha nahin keh sakte go jhutla bhi nahin sakte. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke aap ko yeh laqab is liye mila ke aap ke dil mein Allah Ta'ala ki mohabbat hadd-e-darja ki thi, kamil ita'at sha'ari aur farmanbardari thi, apni ibadaton se Allah Ta'ala ko khush kar liya tha. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bhi apne aakhri khutba mein farmaya tha, "Logon agar main zameen walon mein se kisi ko Khalil aur wali dost banane wala hota toh Abu Bakr bin Abu Quhafa ko banata, balkay tumhare sathi Allah Ta'ala ke Khalil hain," (Bukhari, Muslim). Aur riwayat mein hai, "Allah A'ala-o-Akram ne jis tarah Ibrahim ko Khalil bana liya tha isi tarah mujhe bhi apna Khalil kar liya hai."

Ek martaba as-hab-e-Rasool aap ke intezar mein baithe hue aapas mein zikr-o-tazkire kar rahe the, ek keh raha tha ta'ajjub hai ke Allah ne apni makhlooq mein se Hazrat Ibrahim ko apna Khalil banaya, dusre ne kaha is se bhi badh kar meherbani yeh ke Hazrat Musa se khud baatein keen aur unhein Kaleem banaya, ek ne kaha aur Isa toh Roohullah aur Kalimatullah hain, ek ne kaha Adam Safiullah aur Allah Ta'ala ke pasandida hain. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab bahar tashreef laye, salam kiya aur yeh baatein sunin toh farmaya, "Beshak tumhara qaul sahi hai, Ibrahim Khalilullah hain aur Musa Kaleemullah hain aur Isa Roohullah aur Kalimatullah hain aur Adam Safiullah hain aur isi tarah Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain, magar main haqeeqat bayan karta hoon, kuch fakhr ke taur par nahin kehta ke main Habibullah hoon, main sab se pehla shafa'at karne wala hoon aur sab se pehle shafa'at qabool kiya jane wala hoon aur sab se pehle jannat ke darwaze par dastak dene wala hoon, Allah mere liye jannat ko khol de ga aur mujhe is mein dakhil kare ga aur mere sath momin fuqra honge, Qayamat ke din tamam aglon pichlon se zyada ikram-o-izzat wala hoon, yeh bator-e-fakhr ke nahin balkay bator-e-sachai ko maloom karane ke liye main tum se keh raha hoon." Yeh hadith is sanad se toh ghareeb hai lekin is ke ba'az ke shahid majood hain.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain, "Kya tum is se ta'ajjub karte ho ke khullat sirf Hazrat Ibrahim ke liye thi aur kalam Hazrat Musa ke liye tha aur deedar Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke liye." Salawatullahi wa salamuhu alaihim ajma'een (Mustadrak Hakim). Isi tarah ki riwayat Hazrat Anas bin Malik aur bohat se sahaba, tabieen aur salaf-o-khalaf se marwi hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai, Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki aadat thi ke mehmanon ke sath khayein. Ek din aap mehman ki justuju mein nikle lekin koi na mila, wapas aaye, ghar mein dakhil hue toh dekha ke ek shakhs khada hua hai, pucha, "Ae Allah ke bande tujhe mere ghar mein aane ki ijazat kis ne di?" Us ne kaha, "Is makan ke haqeeqi malik ne." Pucha, "Tum kaun ho?"

Kaha main Malik-ul-Maut hoon mujhe Allah Ta'ala ne apne ek bande ke paas is liye bheja hai ke main use yeh basharat suna doon ke Allah Ta'ala ne use apna Khalil bana liya hai, yeh sun kar Hazrat ne kaha phir to mujhe zaroor bataiye ke woh buzurg kaun hain? Allah Azzawajal ki qasam agar woh zameen ke kisi door ke goshe mein bhi honge main zaroor ja kar un se mulaqat karunga phir apni baqi zindagi un ke qadmon mein hi guzaroonga yeh sun kar Hazrat Malik-ul-Maut ne kaha woh shakhs khud aap hain. Aap ne phir daryaft farmaya kya sach-much main hi hoon? Farishtay ne kaha haan aap hi hain. Aap ne phir daryaft farmaya ke aap mujhe yeh bhi batayenge ke kis bina par kin kamon par Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe apna Khalil banaya? Farishtay ne farmaya is liye ke tum har ek ko dete rehte ho aur khud kisi se kuch talab nahin karte aur riwayat mein hai. Jab Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ko Khalilullah ke mumtaz aur mubarak laqab se Allah ne mullaqab kiya tab se to un ke dil mein is qadar khauf-e-Rabb aur haibat-e-Rabb sama gayi ke un ke dil ka uchhalna door se is tarah suna jata tha jis tarah faza mein parind ke parwaz ki aawaz. Sahih hadith mein Janab-e-Rasool-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ) ki nisbat bhi warid hai ke jis waqt Allah Ta'ala ka khauf aap par ghalib aa jata tha to aap ke rone ki aawaz jise aap zabt karte jate the is tarah door-o-nazdeek walon ko sunai deti thi jaise kisi handiya ke kholne ki aawaz ho. Phir farmaya ke zameen-o-aasman mein jo kuch hai sab Allah ki malkiyat mein aur us ki ghulami mein aur usi ka paida kiya hua hai. Jis tarah jab jo tasarruf un mein woh karna chahta hai baghair kisi rok-tok ke bila-mashwara-e-ghaire aur baghair kisi ki sharakat aur madad ke kar guzarta hai koi nahin jo us ke iraday se use baaz rakh sake koi nahin jo us ke hukm mein hail ho sake koi nahin jo us ki marzi ko badal sake woh azmaton aur qudraton wala woh adl-o-hikmat wala woh lutf-o-rahm wala Wahid-o-Samad Allah hai. Us ka ilm har chhoti badi cheez ko ghere hue hai, makhfi se makhfi aur chhoti se chhoti aur door se door wali cheez bhi us par posheeda nahin, hamari nigahon se jo posheeda hain us ke ilm mein sab zahir hain.

Yateemon ke murabbiyon ki goshmali aur munsifana ahkaam. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai, Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) farmati hain is se murad woh shakhs hai jis ki parwarish mein koi yateem bachi ho jis ka wali waris bhi wohi maal mein shareek ho gaya ho, ab chahta yeh ho ke is yateem se main nikah kar loon, is bina par aur jagah is ki shadi rokta ho, aise shakhs ke bare mein yeh aayat utri hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke is aayat ke utarne ke baad jab phir logon ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se in yateem ladkiyon ke bare mein sawal kiya to Allah Ta'ala ne (يَسْتَـفْتُوْنَكَ ۭ قُلِ اللّٰهُ يُفْتِيْكُمْ فِي الْكَلٰلَةِ) (Surah An-Nisa: 176) nazil farmayi. Farmati hain ke is aayat mein jo yeh farmaya gaya hai (ۙ وَمَا يُتْلٰي عَلَيْكُمْ فِي الْكِتٰبِ فِيْ يَتٰمَي النِّسَاۗءِ الّٰتِيْ لَا تُؤْتُوْنَھُنَّ مَا كُتِبَ لَھُنَّ وَتَرْغَبُوْنَ اَنْ تَنْكِحُوْھُنَّ وَالْمُسْتَضْعَفِيْنَ مِنَ الْوِلْدَانِ) (Surah An-Nisa: 127) is se murad pehli (وَاِنْ خِفْتُمْ اَلَّا تُقْسِطُوْا فِي الْيَتٰمٰى فَانْكِحُوْا مَا طَابَ لَكُمْ مِّنَ النِّسَاۗءِ مَثْنٰى وَثُلٰثَ وَرُبٰعَ ۚ فَاِنْ خِفْتُمْ اَلَّا تَعْدِلُوْا فَوَاحِدَةً اَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَانُكُمْ ۭ ذٰلِكَ اَدْنٰٓى اَلَّا تَعُوْلُوْا) (Surah An-Nisa: 3) hai. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se bhi manqool hai ke yateem ladkiyon ke wali waris jab un ke paas maal kam paate ya woh haseen na hotin to un se nikah karne se baaz rehte aur agar maaldar aur sahib-e-jamal paate to nikah ki raghbat karte, lekin is haal mein bhi chunke in ladkiyon ka aur koi muhafiz nahin hota tha un ke mehar aur haqooq mein kami karte the to Allah Ta'ala ne unhein rok diya ke baghair poora mehar aur pooray haqooq dene ke nikah kar lene ki ijazat nahin. Maqsad yeh hai ke aisi yateem bachi jis se us ke wali ko nikah halal ho to woh is se nikah kar sakta hai bashart-e-ke jo mehar is jaisi us ke kunbay qabeelay ki aur ladkiyon ko mila hai usay bhi utna hi de aur agar aisa na kare to usay chahiye is se nikah bhi na kare. Is surat ke shuru ki is mazmoon ki pehli aayat ka bhi yahi matlab hai aur kabhi aisa bhi hota hai ke is yateem bachi se khud us ka aisa wali jisay us se nikah karna halal hai usay apne nikah mein lana nahin chahta khwah kisi wajah se ho lekin yeh jaan kar ke jab yeh dusre ke nikah mein chali jayegi to jo maal mere us ladki ke darmiyan sharakat mein hai woh bhi mere qabzay se jata rahega. To aise nawajibi fe'l se is aayat mein rok diya gaya. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke jahiliyat mein dastoor tha ke yateem ladki ka wali jab ladki ko apni wilayat mein leta to us par ek kapra daal deta, ab kisi ki majaal na thi ke us se khud aap nikah kar leta aur maal bhi hazam kar jata aur agar woh surat shakal mein achi na hoti aur maaldar hoti to usay dusri jagah nikah karne se rok deta, woh bechari yunhi mar jati aur yeh us ka maal qabzay mein kar leta. Is se Allah Ta'ala is aayat mein mana farma raha hai.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se is ke sath hi yeh bhi marwi hai ke jahiliyat wale chote ladkon ko waris nahin samajhte the, is rasm ko bhi Quran ne khatam kar diya aur har ek ko hissa dilwaya aur farmaya ke ladki aur ladke ko khwah chote hon khwah bade, hissa zaroor do. Albata ladki ko aadha aur ladke ko poora yani do ladkiyon ke barabar aur yateem ladkiyon ke bare mein insaf ka hukum diya ke jab jamal-o-maal wali se khud tum apna nikah kar lete ho to phir un se bhi kar liya karo jo maal-o-jamal mein kam hon. Phir farmaya yaqeen mano ke tumhare tamam aamal se Allah Ta'ala ba-khabar hai. Tumhein chahiye ke khair ke kaam karo, farman-bardari karo aur nek jaza hasil karo.

Miyan biwi mein sulh-o-khair ka usool. Allah Ta'ala miyan biwi ke halaat aur un ke ahkaam bayan farma raha hai. Kabhi mard us se na-khush ho jata hai, kabhi chahne lagta hai aur kabhi alag kar deta hai. Pas pehli halat mein jabke aurat ko apne shohar ki narazgi ka khayal hai aur use khush karne ke liye apne tamam huqooq se ya kisi khaas haq se woh dast-bardari karna chahe to kar sakti hai. Maslan apna khana kapra chhor de ya shab-bashi ka haq maaf kar de to dono ke liye jaiz hai. Phir isi ki raghbat dilata hai ke sulh hi behtar hai. Hazrat Sauda bint-e-Zama jab bahut bari umar ki ho jati hain aur unhein maloom hota hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein qabool farma liya. Abu Dawood mein hai ke isi par yeh aayat utri. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain miyan biwi jis baat par razamand ho jayen woh jaiz hai. Aap farmate hain Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke wisal ke waqt aap ki nau biwiyan thin jin mein se aap ne aath ko bariyaan taqseem kar rakhi thin. Bukhari Muslim mein hai ke Hazrat Sauda ka din bhi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ko dete the. Hazrat Urwa ka qaul hai ke Hazrat Sauda ko bari umar mein jab yeh maloom hua ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) unhein chhor dena chahte hain to khayal kiya ke aap ko Siddiqa (R.A) se poori mohabbat hai agar main apni bari unhein de doon to kya ajab ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) raazi ho jayen aur main aap ki biwiyon mein hi aakhir dam tak reh jaon. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ka bayan hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) raat guzarnay mein apni tamam biwiyon ko barabar ke darjay par rakha karte the, umooman har roz sab biwiyon ke haan aate, baithte, bolte chalte magar haath na barhate, phir aakhir mein jin biwi sahiba ki bari hoti un ke haan jate aur raat wahin guzarte. Phir Hazrat Sauda ka waqia bayan farmate jo oopar guzar (Abu Dawood). Mu'jam Abu Al-Abbas ki aik mursal hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Sauda ko talaq ki khabar bhijwayi, yeh Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke haan ja baithin, jab aap tashreef laye to kehne lagin: Aap ko us Allah Ta'ala ki qasam hai jis ne aap par apna kalam nazil farmaya aur apni makhlooq mein se aap ko barguzida aur apna pasandida banaya, aap mujh se ruju kar lijiye, meri umar bari ho gayi hai, mujhe mard ki khaas khwahish nahin rahi lekin yeh chahat hai ke Qayamat ke din aap ki biwiyon mein uthayi jaon. Chunancha aap ne yeh manzoor farma liya aur ruju kar liya. Phir yeh kehne lagin: Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main apni bari ka din aur raat aap ki mehboob Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ko hiba karti hoon. Bukhari Sharif mein aata hai ke is aayat se murad yeh hai ke aik burhiya aurat jo apne khawand ko dekhti hai ke woh us se mohabbat nahin kar sakta balkay use alag karna chahta hai to woh kehti hai ke main apne haq chhorti hoon to mujhe juda na kar, to aayat dono ki rukhsat deti hai. Yehi soorat us waqt bhi hai ke jab kisi ko do biwiyan hon aur aik se us ki ba-wajah us ke burhapay ya bad-soorati ke mohabbat na ho aur woh use juda karna chahta ho aur yeh ba-wajah apne lagao ya ba'az aur masaleh ke alag hona pasand na karti ho to use haq hai ke apne ba'az ya sab huqooq se alag ho jaye aur khawand us ki baat ko manzoor kar ke use juda na kare.

Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Hazrat Umar (R.A) se ek sawal (jise uski behoodgi ki wajah se) aap ne na-pasand farmaya aur use kora maar diya, phir ek aur ne isi aayat ki babat sawal kiya to aap ne farmaya ke haan yeh baatein poochne ki hain. Is se aisi surat murad hai ke maslan ek shakhs ki biwi hai lekin woh burhiya ho gayi hai, aulad nahin hoti, us ne aulad ki khatir kisi jawan aurat se aur nikah kiya, phir yeh dono jis cheez par aapas mein ittefaq kar lein jaiz hai. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se jab is aayat ki nisbat poocha gaya to aap ne farmaya ke is se murad woh aurat hai jo ba-wajah apne budhape ke ya bad-surati ke ya bad-khulqi ke ya gandagi ke apne khawand ki nazron mein gir jaye aur uski chahat yeh ho ke khawand mujhe na chhore to yeh apna poora ya adhoora mehar maaf kar de ya apni baari maaf kar de waghera, to is tarah sulah kar sakte hain. Salaf aur aimma se barabari is ki yahi tafsir marwi hai, balkay taqreeban is par ittefaq hai, mere khayal se to is ka koi mukhalif nahin, Wallahu A'lam.

Muhammad bin Muslim ki sahibzadi Hazrat Rafe bin Khadij (R.A) ke ghar mein thin, ba-wajah budhape ke ya kisi aur amr ke yeh unhein chahte na thay yahan tak ke talaq dene ka irada kar liya. Is par unhon ne kaha aap mujhe talaq to na dijiye aur jo aap chahein faisla karein mujhe manzoor hai. Is par yeh aayat utri. In dono aayaton mein zikr hai us aurat ka jis se us ka khawand bigra hua ho, use chahiye ke apni biwi se keh de ke agar woh chahe to use talaq de de aur agar woh chahe to is baat ko pasand kar ke us ke ghar mein rahe ke woh maal ki taqseem mein aur baari ki taqseem mein us par doosri biwi ko tarjeeh de ga. Ab use ikhtiyar hai, agar yeh doosri shaq ko manzoor kar le to shar'an khawand ko jaiz hai ke use baari na de aur jo mehar waghera us ne chhora hai use apni malkiyat samjhe.

Hazrat Rafe bin Khadij Ansari (R.A) ki biwi sahiba jab sin-raseeda ho gayin to unhon ne ek naujawan ladki se nikah kiya aur phir use zyada chahne lage aur use pehli biwi par muqaddam rakhne lage. Aakhir is se tang aa kar talaq talab ki, aap ne de di, phir iddat khatam hone ke qareeb lota li, lekin phir wahi haal hua ke jawan biwi ko zyada chahne lage aur us ki taraf jhuk gaye. Us ne phir talaq mangi, aap ne dobara talaq de di, phir lota liya lekin phir wahi naqsha pesh aaya. Phir us ne qasam di ke mujhe talaq de do to aap ne farmaya dekho ab yeh teesri aakhri talaq hai, agar tum chaho to main de doon aur agar chaho to isi tarah rehna manzoor karo. Us ne soch kar jawab diya ke achha mujhe isi tarah manzoor hai, chunancha woh apne haqooq se dast-bardar ho gayin aur isi tarah rehne sehne lagin.

Is jumle ka ke "Sulah khair hai" ek ma'ni to yeh bayan kiya gaya hai ke khawand ka apni biwi ko yeh ikhtiyar dena ke agar tu chahe to isi tarah reh kar doosri biwi ke barabar tere haqooq na hon aur agar tu chahe to talaq le le, yeh behtar hai is se ke yunhi doosri ko is par tarjeeh diye hue rahe.

Lekin is se achha matlab yeh hai ke biwi apna kuch chhor de aur khawand use talaq na de aur aapas mein mil kar rahein, yeh talaq dene aur lene se behtar hai, jaise ke khud Nabi Allah Alaihis Salawatu Wassalam ne Hazrat Sauda bint-e-Zama'a (R.A) ko apni zaujiyat mein rakha aur unhon ne apna din Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ko hiba kar diya. Aap (ﷺ) ke is fe'l mein bhi aap ki ummat ke liye behtareen namuna hai ke namuwafiqat ki surat mein bhi talaq ki naubat na aaye. Chunki Allah A'ala-o-Akbar ke nazdeek sulh iftiraq se behtar hai is liye yahan farma diya ke sulh khair hai. Balkeh Ibn-e-Majah waghera ki hadith mein hai tamam halal cheezon mein se sab se zyada napasand cheez Allah ke nazdeek talaq hai. Phir farmaya tumhara ehsan aur taqwa karna yani aurat ki taraf ki narazgi se darguzar karna aur use bawajood napasandidagi ke uska pura haq dena, bari mein len-den mein barabari karna yeh behtareen fe'l hai jise Allah bakhoobi janta hai aur jis par woh bahut achha badla ata farmaye ga. Phir irshad hota hai ke go tum chaho ke apni kayi ek biwiyon ke darmiyan har tarah bilkul pura adl-o-insaf aur barabari karo to bhi tum kar nahin sakte. Is liye ke go ek-ek raat ki bari bandh lo lekin mohabbat, chahat, shahwat, jama' waghera mein barabari kaise kar sakte ho? Ibn-e-Mulayka farmate hain yeh baat Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke bare mein nazil hui hai, Huzoor (ﷺ) unhein bahut chahte the, isi liye ek hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) aurton ke darmiyan sahih taur par musawat rakhte the lekin phir bhi Allah Ta'ala se dua karte hue farmate the: "Ilahi yeh woh taqseem hai jo mere bas mein thi, ab jo cheez mere qabze se bahar hai yani dili talluq is mein to mujhe malamat na karna" (Abu Dawood). Is ki asnad sahih hai lekin Imam Tirmidhi farmate hain dusri sanad se yeh mursalan marwi hai aur woh zyada sahih hai. Phir farmaya bilkul hi ek janib jhuk na jao ke dusri ko latka do, woh na be-khawand ki rahe na khawand wali, woh tumhari zaujiyat mein ho aur tum us se be-rukhi barto, na to use talaq hi do ke apna dusra nikah kar le na us ke woh huqooq ada karo jo har biwi ke liye us ke miyan par hain. Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain jis ki do biwiyan hon phir woh bilkul hi ek ki taraf jhuk jaye to Qayamat ke din Allah ke samne is tarah aaye ga ke us ka aadha jism saqit hoga (Ahmad waghera). Imam Tirmidhi farmate hain yeh hadith marfoo' tareeq se siwaye Hammam ki hadith ke pehchani nahin jati. Phir farmata hai agar tum apne kamon ki islah kar lo aur jahan tak tumhare ikhtiyar mein ho aurton ke darmiyan adl-o-insaf aur musawat barto, har haal mein Allah se darte raha karo, is ke bawajood agar tum kisi waqt kisi ek ki taraf kuch mail ho gaye ho use Allah Ta'ala maaf farma de ga. Phir teesri halat bayan farmata hai ke agar koi surat bhi nibah ki na ho aur dono alag ho jayen to Allah ek ko dusre se be-niyaz kar de ga, use is se achha shohar aur use is se achhi biwi de de ga.

Allah Ta'ala ka fazl bahut wasee hai, woh bade ehsano wala hai aur saath hi woh Hakeem hai, tamam af'aal, sari taqdeerein aur poori shariat hikmat se sarasar bharpoor hai.

Miyan biwi mein sulh-o-khair ka usool. Allah Ta'ala miyan biwi ke halaat aur un ke ahkaam bayan farma raha hai. Kabhi mard us se na-khush ho jata hai, kabhi chahne lagta hai aur kabhi alag kar deta hai. Pas pehli halat mein jabke aurat ko apne shohar ki narazgi ka khayal hai aur use khush karne ke liye apne tamam huqooq se ya kisi khaas haq se woh dast-bardari karna chahe to kar sakti hai. Maslan apna khana kapra chhor de ya shab-bashi ka haq maaf kar de to dono ke liye jaiz hai. Phir isi ki raghbat dilata hai ke sulh hi behtar hai. Hazrat Sauda bint-e-Zama jab bahut bari umar ki ho jati hain aur unhein maloom hota hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein qabool farma liya. Abu Dawood mein hai ke isi par yeh aayat utri. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain miyan biwi jis baat par razamand ho jayen woh jaiz hai. Aap farmate hain Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke wisal ke waqt aap ki nau biwiyan thin jin mein se aap ne aath ko bariyaan taqseem kar rakhi thin. Bukhari Muslim mein hai ke Hazrat Sauda ka din bhi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ko dete the. Hazrat Urwa ka qaul hai ke Hazrat Sauda ko bari umar mein jab yeh maloom hua ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) unhein chhor dena chahte hain to khayal kiya ke aap ko Siddiqa (R.A) se poori mohabbat hai agar main apni bari unhein de doon to kya ajab ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) raazi ho jayen aur main aap ki biwiyon mein hi aakhir dam tak reh jaon. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ka bayan hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) raat guzarnay mein apni tamam biwiyon ko barabar ke darjay par rakha karte the, umooman har roz sab biwiyon ke haan aate, baithte, bolte chalte magar haath na barhate, phir aakhir mein jin biwi sahiba ki bari hoti un ke haan jate aur raat wahin guzarte. Phir Hazrat Sauda ka waqia bayan farmate jo oopar guzar (Abu Dawood). Mu'jam Abu Al-Abbas ki aik mursal hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Sauda ko talaq ki khabar bhijwayi, yeh Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke haan ja baithin, jab aap tashreef laye to kehne lagin: Aap ko us Allah Ta'ala ki qasam hai jis ne aap par apna kalam nazil farmaya aur apni makhlooq mein se aap ko barguzida aur apna pasandida banaya, aap mujh se ruju kar lijiye, meri umar bari ho gayi hai, mujhe mard ki khaas khwahish nahin rahi lekin yeh chahat hai ke Qayamat ke din aap ki biwiyon mein uthayi jaon. Chunancha aap ne yeh manzoor farma liya aur ruju kar liya. Phir yeh kehne lagin: Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main apni bari ka din aur raat aap ki mehboob Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ko hiba karti hoon. Bukhari Sharif mein aata hai ke is aayat se murad yeh hai ke aik burhiya aurat jo apne khawand ko dekhti hai ke woh us se mohabbat nahin kar sakta balkay use alag karna chahta hai to woh kehti hai ke main apne haq chhorti hoon to mujhe juda na kar, to aayat dono ki rukhsat deti hai. Yehi soorat us waqt bhi hai ke jab kisi ko do biwiyan hon aur aik se us ki ba-wajah us ke burhapay ya bad-soorati ke mohabbat na ho aur woh use juda karna chahta ho aur yeh ba-wajah apne lagao ya ba'az aur masaleh ke alag hona pasand na karti ho to use haq hai ke apne ba'az ya sab huqooq se alag ho jaye aur khawand us ki baat ko manzoor kar ke use juda na kare.

Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Hazrat Umar (R.A) se ek sawal (jise uski behoodgi ki wajah se) aap ne na-pasand farmaya aur use kora maar diya, phir ek aur ne isi aayat ki babat sawal kiya to aap ne farmaya ke haan yeh baatein poochne ki hain. Is se aisi surat murad hai ke maslan ek shakhs ki biwi hai lekin woh burhiya ho gayi hai, aulad nahin hoti, us ne aulad ki khatir kisi jawan aurat se aur nikah kiya, phir yeh dono jis cheez par aapas mein ittefaq kar lein jaiz hai. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se jab is aayat ki nisbat poocha gaya to aap ne farmaya ke is se murad woh aurat hai jo ba-wajah apne budhape ke ya bad-surati ke ya bad-khulqi ke ya gandagi ke apne khawand ki nazron mein gir jaye aur uski chahat yeh ho ke khawand mujhe na chhore to yeh apna poora ya adhoora mehar maaf kar de ya apni baari maaf kar de waghera, to is tarah sulah kar sakte hain. Salaf aur aimma se barabari is ki yahi tafsir marwi hai, balkay taqreeban is par ittefaq hai, mere khayal se to is ka koi mukhalif nahin, Wallahu A'lam.

Muhammad bin Muslim ki sahibzadi Hazrat Rafe bin Khadij (R.A) ke ghar mein thin, ba-wajah budhape ke ya kisi aur amr ke yeh unhein chahte na thay yahan tak ke talaq dene ka irada kar liya. Is par unhon ne kaha aap mujhe talaq to na dijiye aur jo aap chahein faisla karein mujhe manzoor hai. Is par yeh aayat utri. In dono aayaton mein zikr hai us aurat ka jis se us ka khawand bigra hua ho, use chahiye ke apni biwi se keh de ke agar woh chahe to use talaq de de aur agar woh chahe to is baat ko pasand kar ke us ke ghar mein rahe ke woh maal ki taqseem mein aur baari ki taqseem mein us par doosri biwi ko tarjeeh de ga. Ab use ikhtiyar hai, agar yeh doosri shaq ko manzoor kar le to shar'an khawand ko jaiz hai ke use baari na de aur jo mehar waghera us ne chhora hai use apni malkiyat samjhe.

Hazrat Rafe bin Khadij Ansari (R.A) ki biwi sahiba jab sin-raseeda ho gayin to unhon ne ek naujawan ladki se nikah kiya aur phir use zyada chahne lage aur use pehli biwi par muqaddam rakhne lage. Aakhir is se tang aa kar talaq talab ki, aap ne de di, phir iddat khatam hone ke qareeb lota li, lekin phir wahi haal hua ke jawan biwi ko zyada chahne lage aur us ki taraf jhuk gaye. Us ne phir talaq mangi, aap ne dobara talaq de di, phir lota liya lekin phir wahi naqsha pesh aaya. Phir us ne qasam di ke mujhe talaq de do to aap ne farmaya dekho ab yeh teesri aakhri talaq hai, agar tum chaho to main de doon aur agar chaho to isi tarah rehna manzoor karo. Us ne soch kar jawab diya ke achha mujhe isi tarah manzoor hai, chunancha woh apne haqooq se dast-bardar ho gayin aur isi tarah rehne sehne lagin.

Is jumle ka ke "Sulah khair hai" ek ma'ni to yeh bayan kiya gaya hai ke khawand ka apni biwi ko yeh ikhtiyar dena ke agar tu chahe to isi tarah reh kar doosri biwi ke barabar tere haqooq na hon aur agar tu chahe to talaq le le, yeh behtar hai is se ke yunhi doosri ko is par tarjeeh diye hue rahe.

Lekin is se achha matlab yeh hai ke biwi apna kuch chhor de aur khawand use talaq na de aur aapas mein mil kar rahein, yeh talaq dene aur lene se behtar hai, jaise ke khud Nabi Allah Alaihis Salawatu Wassalam ne Hazrat Sauda bint-e-Zama'a (R.A) ko apni zaujiyat mein rakha aur unhon ne apna din Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ko hiba kar diya. Aap (ﷺ) ke is fe'l mein bhi aap ki ummat ke liye behtareen namuna hai ke namuwafiqat ki surat mein bhi talaq ki naubat na aaye. Chunki Allah A'ala-o-Akbar ke nazdeek sulh iftiraq se behtar hai is liye yahan farma diya ke sulh khair hai. Balkeh Ibn-e-Majah waghera ki hadith mein hai tamam halal cheezon mein se sab se zyada napasand cheez Allah ke nazdeek talaq hai. Phir farmaya tumhara ehsan aur taqwa karna yani aurat ki taraf ki narazgi se darguzar karna aur use bawajood napasandidagi ke uska pura haq dena, bari mein len-den mein barabari karna yeh behtareen fe'l hai jise Allah bakhoobi janta hai aur jis par woh bahut achha badla ata farmaye ga. Phir irshad hota hai ke go tum chaho ke apni kayi ek biwiyon ke darmiyan har tarah bilkul pura adl-o-insaf aur barabari karo to bhi tum kar nahin sakte. Is liye ke go ek-ek raat ki bari bandh lo lekin mohabbat, chahat, shahwat, jama' waghera mein barabari kaise kar sakte ho? Ibn-e-Mulayka farmate hain yeh baat Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke bare mein nazil hui hai, Huzoor (ﷺ) unhein bahut chahte the, isi liye ek hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) aurton ke darmiyan sahih taur par musawat rakhte the lekin phir bhi Allah Ta'ala se dua karte hue farmate the: "Ilahi yeh woh taqseem hai jo mere bas mein thi, ab jo cheez mere qabze se bahar hai yani dili talluq is mein to mujhe malamat na karna" (Abu Dawood). Is ki asnad sahih hai lekin Imam Tirmidhi farmate hain dusri sanad se yeh mursalan marwi hai aur woh zyada sahih hai. Phir farmaya bilkul hi ek janib jhuk na jao ke dusri ko latka do, woh na be-khawand ki rahe na khawand wali, woh tumhari zaujiyat mein ho aur tum us se be-rukhi barto, na to use talaq hi do ke apna dusra nikah kar le na us ke woh huqooq ada karo jo har biwi ke liye us ke miyan par hain. Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain jis ki do biwiyan hon phir woh bilkul hi ek ki taraf jhuk jaye to Qayamat ke din Allah ke samne is tarah aaye ga ke us ka aadha jism saqit hoga (Ahmad waghera). Imam Tirmidhi farmate hain yeh hadith marfoo' tareeq se siwaye Hammam ki hadith ke pehchani nahin jati. Phir farmata hai agar tum apne kamon ki islah kar lo aur jahan tak tumhare ikhtiyar mein ho aurton ke darmiyan adl-o-insaf aur musawat barto, har haal mein Allah se darte raha karo, is ke bawajood agar tum kisi waqt kisi ek ki taraf kuch mail ho gaye ho use Allah Ta'ala maaf farma de ga. Phir teesri halat bayan farmata hai ke agar koi surat bhi nibah ki na ho aur dono alag ho jayen to Allah ek ko dusre se be-niyaz kar de ga, use is se achha shohar aur use is se achhi biwi de de ga.

Allah Ta'ala ka fazl bahut wasee hai, woh bade ehsano wala hai aur saath hi woh Hakeem hai, tamam af'aal, sari taqdeerein aur poori shariat hikmat se sarasar bharpoor hai.
