Mango toh sirf Allah Aala-o-Akbar se mango. Allah Ta'ala muttala karta hai ke zameen-o-aasman ka maalik aur haakim wahi hai. Farmata hai jo ahkaam tumhein diye jaate hain ke Allah se daro, uski wahdaniyat ko maano, uski ibadat karo aur kisi aur ki ibadat na karo. Yehi ahkaam tum se pehle ke Ahl-e-Kitab ko bhi diye gaye thay. Aur agar tum kufr karo (toh Allah ka kya bigaaroge?) Woh toh zameen-aasman ka tanha maalik hai, jaise ke Hazrat Musa A.S ne apni qoum se farmaya tha ke agar tum aur tamam roo-e-zameen ke insaan kufr karne lago toh bhi Allah Ta'ala be-parwah aur laiq-e-sataish hai. Aur jagah farmaya (Fakafaru wa tawallau wastaghnallahu wallahu ghaniyyun hameed) (Surah At-Taghabun: 6). Unhon ne kufr kiya aur munh mod liya, Allah ne un se be-niyazi ki aur Allah bahut hi be-niyaz aur tareef kiya gaya hai. Apne tamam bandon se ghani aur apne tamam kaamon mein hamd kiya gaya hai. Aasman-o-zameen ki har cheez ka woh maalik hai aur har shakhs ke tamam af'aal par woh gawah hai aur har cheez ka woh aalim aur shahid hai. Woh qadir hai ke agar tum uski nafarmaniyan karo toh woh tumhein barbaad kar de aur ghairon ko aabaad kar de, jaisa ke dusri aayat mein hai (Wa in tatawallau yastabdil qawman ghairakum thumma la yakunu amthalakum) (Surah Muhammad: 38). Agar tum munh modoge toh Allah Ta'ala tumhein badal kar tumhare siwa aur qoum ko layega jo tum jaise na honge. Ba'az salaf se manqool hai ke is aayat par gaur karo aur socho ke gunahgar bande Allah Akbar-o-Aala ke nazdeek kis qadar zaleel aur faromaya hain? Insaf aur sachi gawahi taqwe ki rooh hai. Allah Ta'ala imandari ko hukum deta hai ke woh adl-o-insaf par mazbooti se jame rahein, is se ek inch idhar udhar na sarkein. Aisa na ho ke dar ki wajah se ya kisi lalach ki bina par ya kisi khushamad mein ya kisi par reham kha kar ya kisi sifarish se adl-o-insaf chhod baithein. Sab mil kar adl ko qaim-o-jari karein, ek dusre ki is mamle mein madad karein aur Allah ki makhlooq mein adalat ke sikke jama dein. Allah ke liye gawah ban jayein jaise aur jagah hai (Wa aqimush shahadata lillah) (65. At-Talaq: 2), yani gawahiyaan Allah ki raza joi ke liye do jo bilkul sahi, saaf, sachi aur belag hon. Inhein badlo nahin, chupao nahin, chaba kar na bolo, saaf saaf sachi shahadat do chahe woh tumhare apne hi khilaf ho. Tum haq goi se na ruko aur yaqeen rakho ke Allah Ta'ala apne farman-bardar ghulamon ki mukhlisi ki suratein bahut si nikal deta hai, kuch isi par mauqoof nahin ke jhooti shahadat se hi is ka chhutkara ho. Go sachi shahadat maa baap ke khilaf hoti ho, go is shahadat se rishtedaron ka nuqsan pahunchta ho, lekin tum sach haath se na jane do, gawahi sachi do. Is liye ke haq har ek par ghalib hai. Gawahi ke waqt na tungar ka lihaz karo na ghareeb par reham karo, in ki maslahaton ko Allah A'ala-o-Akbar tum se bahut behtar janta hai. Tum har surat aur har halat mein sachi shahadat ada karo. Dekho kisi ke behkawe mein aa kar khud apna bura na kar lo, kisi ki dushmani mein asabiyat aur qaumiyat mein fana ho kar adl-o-insaf haath se na jane do, balkeh har haal har aan adl-o-insaf ka mujasma bane raho. Jaise aur jagah farman-e-Bari hai: (Wala yajrimannakum shana'anu qawmin 'ala alla ta'dilu, i'dilu, huwa aqrabu lit-taqwa) (5. Al-Ma'idah: 8). Kisi qaum ki adawat tumhein khilaf-e-adl karne par amada na kar de, adl karte raho, yahi taqwa ki shaan ke qareeb-tar hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Rawaha (R.A) ko jab Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Khaibar walon ki khetiyon aur baghon ka andaza karne ko bheja to unhon ne aap ko rishwat dena chahi ke aap miqdar kam batayein, to aap ne farmaya: Suno! Allah ki qasam, Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe tamam makhlooq se zyada aziz hain aur tum mere nazdeek kutton aur khanzeeron se badtar ho, lekin bawajood is ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki mohabbat mein aa kar ya tumhari adawat ko samne rakh kar namumkin hai ke main insaf se hat jaun aur tum mein adl na karoon. Yeh sun kar woh kehne lage: Bas isi se to zameen-o-aasman qaim hain. Yeh poori hadith Surah Ma'idah ki tafsir mein aayegi Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Phir farmata hai agar tum ne shahadat mein tehrif ki, yani badal di, ghalat goi se kaam liya, waqiye ke khilaf gawahi di, dabi zaban se pecheeda alfaz kahe, waqiyat ghalat pesh kar diye ya kuch chhupa liya kuch bayan kiya, to yaad rakho Allah jaise ba-khabar hakim ke samne yeh chaal chal nahin sakti, wahan ja kar is ka badla paoge aur saza bhugtoge. Huzoor Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka irshad hai: Behtareen gawah woh hain jo daryaft karne se pehle hi sachi gawahi de dein.

Iman ki takmeel mukammal ita'at mein muzmar hai. Iman walon ko hukum diya ja raha hai ke iman mein pooray pooray dakhil ho jayen, tamam ahkaam ko, kul shariat ko, iman ki tamam juz'iyaat ko maan lein. Yeh khayal na ho ke is mein tehseel-e-hasil hai, nahin balkay takmeel-e-kamil hai. Iman laye ho toh ab isi par qaim raho, Allah Jalla Shanuhu ko mana hai toh jis tarah woh manwaye mantay chalay jao. Yehi matlab har musalman ki is dua ka hai ke hamein Sirat-e-Mustaqeem ki hidayat kar, yani hamari hidayat ko sabit rakh, mudam rakh, is mein hamein mazboot kar aur din ba din barhata reh. Isi tarah yahan bhi mominon ko apni zaat par aur apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par iman lane ko farmaya hai aur aayat mein imandaron se khitab kar ke farmaya: Allah se daro aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par iman lao. Pehli kitab se murad Quran hai aur us se pehle ki kitab se murad tamam nabiyon par jo jo kitabein nazil huin sab hain. Quran ke liye lafz "Nazzala" bola gaya aur deegar kitabon ke liye "Anzala", is liye ke Quran batadreej, waqtan fawaqtan, thora thora kar ke utra aur baqi kitabein poori poori ek sath nazil huin. Phir farmaya jo shakhs Allah Jalla Shanuhu ke sath, us ke farishton ke sath, us ki kitabon ke sath, us ke rasoolon ke sath, aakhirat ke din ke sath kufr kare woh rah-e-hidayat se behak gaya aur bohat door ghalat rah par gaya, gumrahi mein rah-e-haq se hat kar rah-e-batil pe chala gaya.

Sohbat-e-bad se bacho. Irshad ho raha hai ke jo iman la kar phir murtad ho jaye, phir woh momin ho kar kafir ban jaye, phir apne kufr par jam jaye aur isi halat mein mar jaye to na uski tauba qabool, na uski bakhshish ka imkan, na uska chhutkara, na falah, na Allah use bakhshe, na rah-e-rast par laye. Hazrat Ali (R.A) is ayat ki tilawat farma kar farmate thay murtad se teen baar kaha jaye ke tauba kar le. Phir farmaya yeh munafiqon ka haal hai ke aakhirash unke dilon par mohar lag jati hai, phir woh mominon ko chhor kafiron se dostiyan ganthte hain, idhar bazahir mominon se mile jule rehte hain aur kafiron mein baith kar un mominon ka mazaq udate hain aur kehte hain hum to inhe bewaqoof bana rahe hain, darasal hum to tumhare sath hain. Pas Allah Ta'ala unke maqsood-e-asli ko unke samne pesh kar ke is mein unki nakami ko bayan farmata hai ke tum chahte ho unke paas tumhari izzat ho magar yeh tumhe dhoka hua hai aur tum ghalti kar rahe ho. Bagosh-e-hosh suno izzaton ka malik to Allah Ta'ala wahdahu la sharika lahu hai. Woh jise chahe izzat deta hai aur ayat mein hai (Man kana yureedul izzata falillahil izzatu jamee'a) (35. Fatir: 10) yani izzat Allah ke liye hai aur uske Rasool aur mominon ka haq hai, lekin munafiq be-samajh log hain. Maqsood yeh hai ke agar haqiqi izzat chahte ho to Allah ke nek bandon ke a'maal ikhtiyar karo, uski ibadat ki taraf jhuk jao aur us janab-e-bari se izzat ke khwahan bano, duniya aur aakhirat mein woh tumhe waqar bana de ga. Musnad-e-Ahmad bin Hanbal ki yeh hadith is jagah yaad rakhne ke qabil hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs fakhr-o-ghuroor ke taur par apni izzat zahir karne ke liye apna nasab apne kuffar baap dada se jore aur nau tak pahunch jaye woh bhi unke sath daswan jahannami hoga. Phir farman hai jab main tumhe mana kar chuka ke jis majlis mein Allah ki ayaton se inkar kiya ja raha ho aur unka mazaq uraya ja raha ho us mein na baitho, phir bhi agar tum aisi majlison mein shareek hote rahoge to yaad rakho mere han tum bhi unke shareek-e-kaar samjhe jaoge. Unke gunah mein tum bhi unhi jaise ho jaoge jaise ek hadith mein hai ke jis dastarkhwan par sharab noshi ho rahi hai us par kisi aise shakhs ko na baithna chahiye jo Allah par aur Qayamat par iman rakhta ho. Is ayat mein jis muman'at ka hawala diya gaya hai woh Surah An'am ki jo Makkiyah hai yeh (Wa iza ra'aitallazina yakhoodoona fee ayatina fa-a'rid anhum hatta yakhoodoo fee hadeesin ghairihi) (6. Al-An'am: 68) jab tu inhe dekhe jo meri ayaton mein ghote lagane baith jate hain to tu un se munh mor le. Hazrat Muqatil bin Hayyan farmate hain is ayat ka yeh hukm (Innakum izan misluhum innallaha jami'ul munafiqeena wal kafireena fee jahannama jamee'a) (4. An-Nisa: 140).

Amal mein safar, da'we mein asli musalman. Munafiqon ki bad-batini ka zikr hai ke musalmanon ki barbadi aur uski pasti ki talash mein lage rehte hain, toh lete rehte hain. Agar kisi jihad mein musalman kamyab-o-kamran ho gaye, Allah ki madad se yeh ghalib aa gaye, toh unke pet mein ghusne ke liye aa aa kar kehte hain kyun ji hum bhi toh tumhare sathi hain? Aur agar kisi waqt musalmanon ki aazmaish ke liye Allah Jalla Shanuhu ne kafiron ko ghalba de diya, jaise Uhad mein hua tha (go anjam-e-kar haq hi ghalib raha), toh yeh unki taraf lapakte hain aur kehte hain dekho posheeda taur par toh hum tumhari ta'eed hi karte rahe aur unhein nuqsan pahunchate rahe, yeh hamari hi chalaki thi jis ki badaulat aaj tum ne un par fatah pa li. Yeh hain unke kartoot ke do kashtiyon mein paon rakh chhodte hain, "Dhobi ka kutta ghar ka na ghat ka". Go yeh apni is makkari ko apne liye ba'is-e-fakhr jante hon lekin darasal yeh sara unki be-imani aur kam-yaqeeni ki daleel hai. Bhala kacha rang kab tak rehta hai? Gajar ki pungi kab tak bajegi? Kagaz ki nao kab tak chalegi? Waqt aa raha hai ke apne kiye par nadim honge, apni bewaqoofi par hath malenge, apne sharmnak kartoot par tuswe bahayenge, Allah ka sacha faisla sun lenge aur tamam bhalaiyon se na-umeed ho jayenge. Bharm khul jayega, har raaz fash ho jayega, andar ka bahar aa jayega. Yeh policy aur hikmat-e-amli, yeh maslahat-e-waqt aur muqtaza-e-mauqa nihayat darauni surat se samne aa jayega aur Aalim-ul-Ghaib ke be-panah azabon ka shikar ban jayenge. Namumkin hai ke kafiron ko Allah Ta'ala mominon par ghalib kar de. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se ek shakhs ne iska matlab pucha toh aap ne awwal jumle ke sath mila kar padh diya. Matlab yeh tha ke Qayamat ke din aisa na hoga. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke sabeel se murad hujjat hai, lekin taham iske zahiri ma'ani murad lene mein bhi koi mani nahin, ya'ni yeh namumkin hai ke Allah Ta'ala ab se le kar Qayamat tak koi aisa waqt laye ke kafir is qadar ghalba hasil kar lein ke musalmanon ka naam mita dein. Yeh aur baat hai ke kisi jagah kisi waqt dunyawi taur par unhein ghalba mil jaye lekin anjam-e-kar musalmanon ke haq mein hi mufeed hoga, dunya mein bhi aur Aakhirat mein bhi. Farman-e-Ilahi hai: (Inna lanansuru rusulana wallazina aamanu fil-hayatid-dunya wa yauma yaqumul-ashhad) (40).

Ghafir: 51) Hum apne Rasoolon aur imandar bandon ko madad duniya mein bhi zaroor denge aur yeh ma'ani lene mein ek latafat yeh bhi hai ke munafiqon ke dilon mein musalmanon ko zillat aur barbadi ka shikar dekhne ka jo intezar tha mayus kardiya gaya ke kuffar ko musalmanon par Allah Ta'ala is tarah ghalib nahin karega ke tum phule na samao aur kuch log jis dar se musalmanon ka sath khule taur par na dete the unke dar ko bhi zail kardiya ke tum yeh na samjho ke kisi waqt bhi musalman mit jayenge isi matlab ki wazahat (فَتَرَى الَّذِيْنَ فِيْ قُلُوْبِهِمْ مَّرَضٌ يُّسَارِعُوْنَ فِيْهِمْ يَقُوْلُوْنَ نَخْشٰٓى اَنْ تُصِيْبَنَا دَاۗىِٕرَةٌ) 5. Al-Ma'idah: 52) mein kardi hai. Is ayat-e-karima se hazrat ulama-e-kiram ne is amr par bhi istidlal kiya hai ke musalman ghulam ko kafir ke hath bechna jaiz nahin, kyunke is surat mein ek kafir ko ek musalman par ghalib kardena hai aur is mein musalman ki zillat hai jin ba'az zi-ilm hazrat ne is saude ko jaiz rakha hai unka faisla hai ke woh apni mulk se is ko usi waqt azad karde.

Do riwar ke darmiyan ki bakri. Surah Baqarah ke shuru mein bhi (يُخٰدِعُوْنَ اللّٰهَ وَالَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا ۚ وَمَا يَخْدَعُوْنَ اِلَّآ اَنْفُسَھُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُوْنَ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 9) isi mazmoon ki guzar chuki hai, yahan bhi yahi bayan ho raha hai ke yeh kam-samajh munafiq us Allah Ta'ala ke samne chalein chalte hain jo seenon mein chupi hui baton aur dilon ke posheeda raazon se aagah hai. Kam-fehmi se yeh khayal kiye baithe hain ke jis tarah in ki munafiqat is duniya mein chal gayi aur musalmanon mein mile-jule rahe isi tarah Allah Ta'ala ke paas bhi yeh makkari chal jayegi. Chunancha Quran mein hai ke Qayamat ke din bhi yeh log Allah Khabeer-o-Aleem ke samne apni yak-rangi ki qasmein khayenge jaise yahan khate hain lekin us Aalim-ul-Ghaib ke samne yeh nakara qasmein hargiz kar-amad nahin ho saktin. Allah bhi unhein dhoke mein rakh raha hai, woh dheel deta hai, hosla-afzai karta hai, yeh phule nahin samate, khush hote hain aur apne liye ise achhai samajhte hain. Qayamat mein bhi un ka yahi haal hoga, musalmanon ke noor ke sahare mein honge, woh aage nikal jayenge, yeh aawazein denge ke thehro hum bhi tumhari roshni mein chalein, jawab milega ke peeche mud jao aur roshni talash kar lao, yeh mudenge udhar hijab hail ho jayega. Musalmanon ki janib rahmat aur un ke liye zahmat. Hadith-e-Shareef mein hai jo sunayega Allah bhi use sunayega aur jo riya-kari karega Allah bhi use waisa hi dikhayega. Ek aur hadith mein hai in munafiqon mein woh bhi honge ke logon ke samne Allah Ta'ala un ki nisbat farmayega ke inhein Jannat mein le jao, farishte le ja kar Dozakh mein daal denge, Allah apni panah mein rakhe. Phir in munafiqon ki bad-zauqi ka haal bayan ho raha hai ke unhein namaz jaisi behtareen ibadat mein bhi yak-sui aur khushoo-o-khuzoo naseeb nahin hota kyunke nek-niyati, husn-e-amal, haqeeqi iman, sacha yaqeen, un mein hai hi nahin. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) thake mande badan se kasma kar namaz padhna makrooh jante the aur farmate the namazi ko chahiye ke zauq-o-shauq se raazi khushi, poori raghbat aur intehai tawajjuh ke sath namaz mein khada ho aur yaqeen mane ke us ki aawaz par Allah Ta'ala ke kaan hain, us ki talab poori karne ko Allah Ta'ala tayyar hai. Yeh to hui in munafiqon ki zahiri halat ke thake haare tang-dili ke sath bator-e-beegar taalne ke namaz ke liye aaye, phir androoni halat yeh hai ke ikhlas se koson door hain, Rabb se koi talluq nahin rakhte, namazi mashhoor hone ke liye, logon mein apne iman ko zahir karne ke liye namaz padh rahe hain, bhala in sanam-ashna dil walon ko namaz mein kya milega?

Yahi wajah hai ke in namazon mein jin mein log ek dusre ko kam dekh sakein yeh ghair hazir rehte hain maslan Isha ki namaz aur Fajr ki namaz, Bukhari Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain sab se zyada bojhal namaz munafiqon par Isha aur Fajr ki hai, agar darasal yeh in namazon ke fazail ke dil se qail hote to ghutnon ke bal bhi chal kar aana padta yeh zaroor aa jate, main irada kar raha hoon ke takbeer kehlwa kar kisi ko apni imamat ki jagah khada kar ke namaz shuru kara kar kuch logon se lakdiyan uthwa kar un ke gharon mein jaaun jo jamaat mein shamil nahin hote aur lakdiyan un ke gharon ke ird-gird laga kar hukum doon ke aag laga do aur un ke gharon ko jala do, ek riwayat mein hai Allah Ta'ala ki qasam agar inhe ek charb haddi ya do achhe khur milne ki umeed ho to daude chale aayen lekin aakhirat ki aur Allah ke sawabon ki inhe itni bhi qadr nahin. Agar baal bachon aur aurton ka jo gharon mein rehti hain mujhe khayal na hota to qatan main un ke ghar jala deta, Abu Ya'la mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain jo shakhs logon ki maujudgi mein namaz ko sanwar kar thehar thehar kar ada kare lekin jab koi na ho to buri tarah namaz padh le yeh woh hai jis ne apne Rab ki ihanat ki. Phir farmaya yeh log zikr-e-Allah bhi bahut hi kam karte hain yani namaz mein un ka dil nahin lagta, yeh apni kahi hui baat samajhte bhi nahin, balkeh ghafil dil aur be-parwah nafs se namaz padh lete hain, Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) farmate hain yeh namaz munafiq ki hai yeh namaz munafiq ki hai ke baitha hua suraj ki taraf dekh raha hai yahan tak ke jab woh doobne laga aur shaitan ne apne dono seeng us ke ird-gird laga diye to yeh khada hua aur jaldi jaldi char rakat padh lein jin mein Allah ka zikr baraye naam hi kiya (Muslim waghera). Yeh munafiq mutahayyir aur shashdar-o-pareshan haal hain iman aur kufr ke darmiyan un ka dil danwa-dol ho raha hai na to saaf taur se musalmanon ke sathi hain na bilkul kuffar ke sath kabhi noor-e-iman chamak utha to Islam ki sadaqat karne lage kabhi kufr ki andheriyan ghalib aa gayin to iman se alag thalag ho gaye. Na to Huzoor (ﷺ) ke sahaba ki taraf hain na Yahudiyon ki janib. Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ) ka irshad hai ke munafiq ki misal aisi hai jaisi do rewad ke darmiyan ki bakri ke kabhi to woh mein mein karti us rewad ki taraf daudti hai kabhi is taraf us ke nazdeek abhi tay nahin hua ke in mein jaye ya us ke peeche lage.

Ek riwayat mein hai ke is ma'ani ki hadith Hazrat Ubaid bin Umair ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar ki maujoodgi mein kuch alfaaz ke her-pher se bayan ki to Hazrat Abdullah ne apne sunay huay alfaaz dohra kar kaha yun nahin balkay darasal hadith yun hai jis par Hazrat Ubaid naraz huay (mumkin hai ek buzurg ne ek tarah ke alfaaz sunay hon dusray ne dusri qisam ke). Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai momin, kafir aur munafiq ki misaal un teen shakhson jaisi hai jo ek darya par gaye, ek to kinaray hi khara reh gaya, dusra paar ho kar manzil-e-maqsood ko pahunch gaya, teesra utar chala magar jab beechon-beech pahuncha to udhar walay ne pukarna shuru kiya ke kahan halak honay ja raha hai idhar aa wapas chala aa, idhar walay ne aawaz di jao nijat ke sath manzil-e-maqsood par meri taraf pahunch jao aadha rasta tay kar chukay ho, ab yeh hairan ho kar kabhi udhar dekhta hai kabhi idhar nazar dalta hai, tazabzub hai ke kidhar jaon kidhar na jaon? Itnay mein ek zabardast mauj aayi aur baha kar le gayi aur woh ghotay kha kha kar mar gaya, pas paar janay wala musalman hai, kinaray khara bulanay wala kafir hai aur mauj mein doob marnay wala munafiq hai, aur hadith mein hai munafiq ki misaal us bakri jaisi hai jo haray bharay teelay par bakriyon ko dekh kar aayi aur soongh kar chal di, phir dusray teelay par charhi aur soongh kar aa gayi. Phir farmaya jisay Allah Ta'ala hi rah-e-haq se pher day us ka wali-o-murshid kaun hai? Is ke gumrah kardah ko kaun rah dikha sakay? Allah Ta'ala ne munafiqon ko un ki badtareen bad-amli ke ba'is rasti se dhakel diya hai ab na koi unhein rah-e-rast par la sakay na chhutkara dila sakay, Allah Ta'ala ki marzi ke khilaf kaun kar sakta hai woh sab par hakim hai isi par kisi ki hukumat nahin.

Kafir se dosti aag se dosti ke mutaradif hai. Kafiron se dostiyan karne se, un se dili mohabbat rakhne se, un ke sath har waqt uthne baithne se, musalmanon ke bhed un ko dene se aur posheeda talluqat un se qaim rakhne se Allah Ta'ala imandaron ko rok raha hai. Jaise aur aayat mein hai (La yattakhizil-mu'minunal-kafirina awliya'a min dunil-mu'minin, wa man yaf'al zalika falaisa minallahi fi shai'in illa an tattaqu minhum tuqatan, wa yuhazzirukumullahu nafsahu, wa ilallahil-masir) (Surah Al-Imran: 28). Mominon ko chahiye ke bajuz mominon ke kuffar se dosti na karein, aisa karne wala Allah ke han kisi bhalai ka mustahiq nahin. Haan agar sirf bachao ke taur par zahirdari ho to aur baat hai. Allah Ta'ala tumhein apne aap se dara raha hai, yani agar tum us ki nafarmaniyan karoge to tumhein us ke azabon ko yaad rakhna chahiye. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) ka farman marwi hai ke aap ne farmaya Quran mein jahan kahin aisi ibaraton mein sultan ka lafz hai wahan us se murad hujjat hai, yani tum ne agar mominon ko chhod kar kuffar se dili dosti ke talluqat paida kiye to tumhara yeh fe'l kafi suboot hoga aur poori daleel hogi jis ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala tumhein saza de. Kai ek salaf mufassireen (Rahimahumullah) ne is aayat ki yahi tafseer ki hai. Phir munafiqon ka anjam bayan farmata hai ke yeh apne is sakht kufr ki wajah se jahannam ke sab se nichle tabqe mein dakhil kiye jayenge. Darak darja ke muqabil ka mazhar hai, behisht mein darje hain ek se ek buland aur dozakh mein darak hain ek se ek past. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) farmate hain inhe aag ke sandookon mein band kar ke jahannam mein dala jayega aur yeh jalte bhunte rahenge. Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain yeh sandook lohe ke honge jo aag lagte hi aag ke ho jayenge aur charon taraf se bilkul band honge aur koi na hoga jo in ki kisi tarah ki madad kare, jahannam se nikal sake ya azabon mein hi kuch kam karwa sake. Haan in mein se jo tauba kar lein, nadim ho jayen aur sache dil se munafiqat chhod dein aur Rabb se apne is gunah ki maafi chahein. Phir apne a'maal mein ikhlas paida karein, sirf khushnoodi-e-Allah aur marzi-e-Maula ke liye nek a'maal par kamar kas lein, riyakari ko ikhlas se badal dein, Allah Ta'ala ke deen ko mazbooti se tham lein to beshak Allah in ki tauba qabool farmayega aur inhe sache mominon mein dakhil kar dega aur bade sawab aur a'la ajr inayat farmayega. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain apne deen ko khalis kar lo to thoda a'mal bhi tumhein kafi ho jayega. Phir irshad hota hai ke Allah Ghani hai, be-niyaz hai, bandon ko saza karni woh nahin chahta, haan jab gunahon par daleer ho jayen to gosh-mali zaroori hai. Pas farmaya agar tum apne a'maal ko sanwar lo aur Allah Ta'ala par aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par sache dil se imaan le aao to koi wajah nahin jo Allah tumhein azab de.

Woh toh chhoti chhoti nekiyon ki bhi qadr-dani karne wala hai, jo iska shukr kare woh iski izzat-afzai karta hai, woh pooray aur sahih ilm wala hai. Jaanta hai ke kiska amal ikhlas wala aur qabooliyat aur qadr ke laiq hai. Isay maloom hai ke kis dil mein qawi iman hai aur kaunsa dil iman se khali hai, jo ikhlas aur iman wale hain unhein bharpoor aur kamil badlay Allah Ta'ala inayat farmaye ga (Allah hamein iman-o-ikhlas ki daulat se mala-maal kare aur phir ajr-o-sawab se nihal kare, Ameen). Alhamdulillah! Tafsir-e-Muhammadi Ibn-e-Kathir ka panchwan para khatam hua. Allah Ta'ala qabool farmaye aur hamein apne kalam ke samajhne samjhane ki aur is par aalim ban jaane ki taufiq ata farmaye. Ameen! Ilahi tu is pak tafsir ko mere hathon khatam kara aur poori kitab chapi hui mujhe dikha. Mere nama-e-aamal se gunahon ko mita kar nekiyan tahreer farma aur apne nek bandon mein shumar kar, Ameen!!

Ameen! Ilahi tu is pak tafsir ko mere hathon khatam kara aur poori kitab chapi hui mujhe dikha. Mazloom ko faryad ka haq hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) is aayat ki tafsir mein farmate hain ke kisi musalman ko dusre ko bad-dua dena jaiz nahin, haan jis par zulm kiya gaya ho use apne zalim ko bad-dua dena jaiz hai aur woh bhi agar sabr-o-zabt karle to afzal yahi hai. Abu Dawood mein hai "Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ki koi cheez chor chura le gaye to aap un par bad-dua karne lagin. Huzoor-e-Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ) ne yeh sun kar farmaya! Kyun is ka bojh halka kar rahi ho?" Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain is par bad-dua na karni chahiye balkeh yeh dua karni chahiye: (Allahumma a'inni alaihi wastakhrij haqqi minhu) Ya Allah is chor par tu meri madad kar aur is se mera haq dilwa de. Aap se ek aur riwayat mein marwi hai ke agarche mazloom ke zalim ko kosne ki rukhsat hai magar yeh khayal rahe ke had se na barh jaye. Abdul Karim bin Malik Jazri (R.H) is aayat ki tafsir mein farmate hain "Gali dene wale ko yani bura kehne wale ko bura to keh sakte hain lekin bohtan bandhne wale par bohtan nahin bandh sakte." Ek aur aayat mein hai (Walamani-ntasara ba'da zulmihi fa-ula-ika ma alaihim min sabil) (42-Ash-Shura: 41) Jo mazloom apne zalim se us ke zulm ka inteqam le, us par koi muakhiza nahin. Abu Dawood mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain "Do galiyan dene walon ka wabaal us par hai, jis ne galiyan dena shuru kiya. Haan agar mazloom had se barh jaye to aur baat hai." Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain jo shakhs kisi ke yahan mehman ban kar jaye aur mezban us ka haq-e-mehmani ada na kare to use jaiz hai ke logon ke samne apne mezban ki shikayat kare, jab tak ke woh haq-e-ziyafat ada na kare. Abu Dawood, Ibn-e-Majah waghera mein hai "Sahaba ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se shikayat ki ke aap hamein idhar udhar bhejte hain. Ba'z martaba aisa bhi hota hai ke wahan ke log hamari mehmandari nahin karte." Aap ne farmaya "Agar woh mehmandari karein to durust, warna tum un se lawazimat-e-mehmandari khud le liya karo." Musnad-e-Ahmad ki riwayat mein farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ) hai ke "Jo musalman kisi ahl-e-qibla ke yahan mehman ban kar jaye aur sari raat guzar jaye lekin woh log us ki mehmandari na karein to har musalman par us mehman ki nusrat zaroori hai taake mezban ke maal se us ki kheti se ba-qadr-e-mehmani dilwayein." Musnad ki aur hadith mein hai "Ziyafat ki raat har musalman par wajib hai, agar koi musafir subh tak mehroom reh jaye to yeh us mezban ke zimma qarz hai, khwah ada kare khwah baqi rakhe." In ahadith ki wajah se Imam Ahmad (R.H) waghera ka mazhab hai ke ziyafat wajib hai. Abu Dawood Sharif waghera mein hai "Ek shakhs Sarkar-e-Risalat Ma'ab (ﷺ) mein hazir ho kar arz karta hai ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) mujhe mera parosi bahut eza pahunchata hai, aap ne farmaya ek kaam karo, apna kul maal asbab ghar se nikal kar bahar rakh do. Us ne aisa hi kiya raste par asbab daal kar wahin baith gaya, ab jo guzarta woh puchta kya baat hai?"

Yeh kehta mera parosi mujhe satata hai main tang aa gaya hoon, rah-guzar use bura bhala kehta, koi kehta Rabb ki maar is parosi par. Koi kehta Allah gharat kare is parosi ko, jab parosi ko apni is tarah ki ruswai ka haal maloom hua toh us ke paas aaya, minnatein kar ke kaha "Apne ghar chalo Allah ki qasam ab marte dam tak tum ko kisi tarah na sataunga." Phir irshad hai ke ae logo tum kisi neki ko zahir karo ya posheeda rakho tum par kisi ne zulm kiya ho aur tum us se darguzar karo toh Allah ke paas tumhare liye bada sawab, poora ajar aur aala darje hain. Khud woh bhi maaf karne wala hai aur bandon ki bhi yeh aadat use pasand hai, woh inteqam ki qudrat ke bawajood maaf farmata rehta hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke "Arsh ko uthane wale farishte Allah ki tasbeeh karte rehte hain." Baaz toh kehte hain "Dua (Subhanaka ala hilmika ba'da ilmika) ya Allah teri zaat paak hai ke tu bawajood janne ke phir bhi bard-bari aur chashm-poshi karta hai." Baaz kehte hain dua (Subhanaka ala afwika ba'da qudratika) ae qudrat ke bawajood darguzar karne wale Allah tamam pakiyan teri zaat ke liye mukhtas hain. Sahih hadith shareef mein hai sadqe aur khairat se kisi ka maal ghat-ta nahin, afw-o-darguzar karne aur maaf kar dene se Allah Ta'ala aur izzat badhata hai aur jo shakhs Allah ke hukum se tawazo, farotani aur aajizi ikhtiyar kare Allah us ka martaba aur tauqeer mazeed badha deta hai.

Kisi ek bhi Nabi ko na manna kufr hai! Is aayat mein bayan ho raha hai ke jo ek Nabi ko bhi na maane kafir hai, Yahudi siwaye Hazrat Isa aur Hazrat Muhammad (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke aur tamam Nabiyon ko maante thay, Nasrani Afzal-ur-Rusul Khatam-ul-Anbiya Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ) ke siwa tamam Anbiya par imaan rakhte thay, Samri Yusha (A.S) ke baad kisi ki nabuwat ke qail na thay, Hazrat Yusha Hazrat Musa bin Imran (A.S) ke khalifa thay, Majusiyon ki nisbat mashhoor hai ke woh apna Nabi Zardasht ko maante thay lekin jab yeh bhi unki shariat ke munkir ho gaye to Allah Ta'ala ne woh shariat hi un se utha li. Wallahu A'lam. Pas yeh log hain jinhon ne Allah aur uske Rasoolon mein tafreeq ki yani kisi Nabi ko mana, kisi se inkar kar diya. Kisi rabbani daleel ki bina par nahin balkay mehez apni nafsani khwahish, josh-e-ta'assub aur taqleed-e-aabai ki wajah se, is se yeh bhi maloom hua ke ek Nabi ko na manne wala Allah ke nazdeek tamam Nabiyon ka munkir hai, is liye ke agar aur Anbiya ko ba-wajah-e-Nabi hone ke maanta to us Nabi ko manna bhi isi wajah se us par zaroori tha, jab woh ek ko nahin maanta to maloom hua ke jinhein woh maanta hai unhein bhi kisi dunyawi gharz aur hawaon ki wajah se maanta hai, unka shariat manna ya na manna donon be-ma'ni hai, aise log hatman aur yaqeenan kafir hain, kisi Nabi par unka shar'i imaan nahin balkay taqleedi aur ta'assubi imaan hai jo qabil-e-qabool nahin, pas in kuffar ko ihanat aur ruswai aamez azab diye jayenge. Kyunke jin par yeh imaan na la kar unki tauheen karte thay uska badla yahi hai ke unki tauheen ho aur unhein zillat wale azab mein dala jaye ga, unke imaan na lane ki wajah khwah gaur-o-fikr ke baghair nabuwat ki tasdeeq na karna ho, khwah haq wazeh ho chukne ke baad dunyawi wajah se munh mod kar nabuwat se inkar karna ho, jaise aksar Yahudi ulama ka shewa Huzoor (ﷺ) ke bare mein tha ke mehez hasad ki wajah se aap ki azeem-ush-shan nabuwat ke munkir thay aur aap ki mukhalifat aur adawat mein aa kar muqablay par tul gaye, pas Allah ne un par dunya ki zillat bhi musallat kar di aur aakhirat ki zillat ki maar bhi unke liye tayyar kar rakhi. Phir Ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ) ki tareef ho rahi hai ke yeh Allah par imaan rakh kar tamam Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) ko aur tamam aasmani kitabon ko bhi ilhami kitabein tasleem karte hain. Jaise ek aur aayat mein hai (Kullun aamana billahi). Phir unke liye jo ajr-e-jameel aur sawab-e-azeem usne tayyar kar rakha hai use bhi bayan farma diya ke unke imaan-e-kamil ke ba'is unhein ajr-o-sawab ata honge. Agar un se koi gunah bhi sar-zad ho gaya to Allah maaf farma de ga aur un par apni rehmat ki barish barsayenge.

Mahsoos mojiza ki maang aur Bani Israel ki hujjat baziyan. Yahudiyon ne Janab-e-Risalat Ma'ab (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke jis tarah Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) Allah ki taraf se Taurat ek saath likhi hui hamare paas laye, aap bhi koi aasmani kitab puri likhi likhayi le aayiye. Yeh bhi marvi hai ke unhon ne kaha tha ke hamare naam Allah Ta'ala khat bheje ke hum aap ki nabuwat ko maan lein. Yeh sawal bhi un ka badniyati se bator mazaaq aur kufr tha. Jaisa ke Ahl-e-Makkah ne bhi isi tarah ka ek sawal kiya tha, jis tarah Surah Subhan mein mazkoor hai ke "Jab tak Arab ki sar-zameen mein daryao'n ki rail-pel aur taro-tazgi ka daur-daura na ho jaye hum aap par iman nahin layenge." Pas bator-e-tasalli ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se Allah Ta'ala farmata hai in ki is sarkashi aur beja sawal par aap kabida-khatir na hon in ki yeh bad-adat purani hai, unhon ne Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se is se bhi zyada behuda sawal kiya tha ke hamein Allah Ta'ala khud ko dikhaye. Is takabbur aur sarkashi aur fazool sawalon ki padash bhi yeh bhugat chuke hain yani un par aasmani bijli giri thi. Jaise Surah Baqarah mein tafseel-war bayan guzar chuka. Mulahiza ho ayat (Wa iz qultum ya Musa lan nu'mina laka hatta narallaha jahratan fa-akhazatkumus sa'iqatu wa antum tanzurun) (2. Al-Baqarah: 55) yani "Jab tum ne kaha tha ke ae Musa hum tujh par hargiz iman na layenge jab tak ke Allah Ta'ala ko hum saaf taur par apni aankhon se na dekh lein pas tumhein bijli ke karake ne pakad liya aur ek dusre ke samne sab halak ho gaye, phir bhi hum ne tumhari maut ke baad dobara tumhein zinda kar diya taake tum shukr karo." Phir farmata hai ke "Badi badi nishaniyan dekh chukne ke baad bhi in logon ne bachhde ko poojna shuru kar diya." Misr mein apne dushman Firaun ka Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke muqable mein halak hona us ke tamam lashkaron ka namuradi ki maut marna, un ka darya se bach kar paar nikal aana, abhi abhi un ki nigahon ke samne hua tha lekin wahan se chal kar kuch door ja kar hi but-paraston ko but-parasti karte hue dekh kar apne paighambar se kehte hain "Hamara bhi ek aisa hi ma'bud bana do." Jis ka pura bayan Surah A'raf mein hai aur Surah Taha mein bhi. Phir Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) Allah Ta'ala se munajat karte hain, un ki tauba ki qubuliyat ki yeh surat thaharti hai ke jinhon ne gausala-parasti nahin ki woh gausala-paraston ko qatl karein. Jab qatl shuru ho jata hai, Allah un ki tauba qubul farmata hai aur mare huon ko bhi dobara zinda kar deta hai. Pas yahan farmata hai hum ne is se bhi darguzar kiya aur yeh jurm-e-azeem bhi baksh diya aur Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko zahir hujjat aur khula ghalba inayat farmaya aur jab in logon ne Taurat ke ahkaam manne se inkar kar diya. Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki farmanbardari se bezari zahir ki to un ke saron par Toor pahad ko mu'allaq khada kar diya aur un se kaha ke ab bolo! Pahad gira kar pash-pash kardein ya ahkaam qubul karte ho?

Toh yeh sab sajde mein gir pade aur girya zari shuru ki aur ahkam-e-Ilahi baja lane ka mazboot ahd-o-paiman kiya yahan tak ke dil mein dehshat thi aur sajde mein kankhiyon se upar dekh rahe the ke kahin pahad na gir pade aur dab kar na mar jayen, phir pahad hataya gaya. Un ki dusri kashi ka bayan ho raha hai ke qaul-o-fel dono ko badal diya, hukum mila tha ke Bait-ul-Muqaddas ke darwaze mein sajde karte hue jayen aur "Hittatun" kahein "yani ae Allah hamari khatayen bakhash ke hum ne jihad chhod diya aur thak kar baith rahe jis ki saza mein chalees saal maidan-e-Teeh mein sargashta-o-hairan-o-pareshan rahe" lekin un ki kam zarfi ka yahan bhi muzahira hua aur apni ranon ke bal ghasat-te hue darwaze mein dakhil hone lage aur "Hintatun fi sha'ratin" kehne lage yani gehun ki balen hamein de. Phir un ki aur shararat suniye hafta war din ki ta'zeem-o-takreem karne ka un se wada liya gaya aur mazboot ahd-o-paiman ho gaya lekin unhon ne is ki bhi mukhalifat ki, nafarmani par kamar basta ho kar hurmat ke irtikab ke heele nikal liye. Jaise ke Surah Al-A'raf mein mufassal bayan hai mulahiza ho aayat (وَسْــــَٔـلْهُمْ عَنِ الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِيْ كَانَتْ حَاضِرَةَ الْبَحْرِ) (7. Al-A'raf: 163). Ek hadith mein bhi hai ke Yahudiyon se khastan Allah Ta'ala ne hafta wale din ki ta'zeem ka ahd liya tha. Yeh puri hadith Surah Subhan ki aayat (وَلَقَدْ اٰتَيْنَا مُوْسٰي تِسْعَ اٰيٰتٍۢ بَيِّنٰتٍ فَسْــــَٔـلْ بَنِيْٓ اِسْرَاۗءِيْلَ اِذْ جَاۗءَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهٗ فِرْعَوْنُ اِنِّىْ لَاَظُنُّكَ يٰمُوْسٰي مَسْحُوْرًا) (17. Al-Isra: 101) ki tafsir mein aayegi Insha'Allah!
