Ahl-e-Kitab, Qatilan-e-Anbiya, Isa A.S ki rudad aur marahil-e-Qayamat. Ahl-e-Kitab ke un gunahon ka bayan ho raha hai jin ki wajah se woh Allah ki rehmaton se door daal diye gaye aur mal'oon-o-jala watan kar diye gaye. Awalan un ki ahd shikni yeh thi ke jo wade unhon ne Allah se kiye un par qaim na rahe, dusre Allah ki aayaton yani hujjat-o-daleel aur nabiyon ke mojizon se inkar aur kufr, teesre bila wajah, na-haq Anbiya-e-Kiram ka qatl. Un ke rasoolon ki aik bari jamaat un ke hathon qatl hui. Chauthi un ka yeh khayal aur qaul ke hamare dil ghilafon mein hain yani parde mein hain, jaise mushrikeen ne kaha tha aayat (Wa qalu qulubuna fi akinnatim mimma tad'una ilaihi wa fi azanina waqrun wa mim bainina wa bainika hijabun fa'mal innana amilun) (41. Fussilat: 5) yani "Ae Nabi teri dawat se hamare dil parde mein hain" aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke un ke is qaul ka matlab yeh hai ke "hamare dil ilm ke zuroof hain woh ilm-o-irfan se pur hain." Surah Baqarah mein bhi is ki nazeer guzar chuki hai, Allah Ta'ala un ke is qaul ki tardeed karta hai ke yun nahin balkay un par Allah Ta'ala ne mohar laga di hai kyunke yeh kufr mein pukhta ho chuke thay. Pas pehli tafseer ki bina par yeh matlab hua ke woh uzr karte thay ke hamare dil ba-wajah un par ghilaf hone ke Nabi ki baton ko yaad nahin kar sakte to unhein jawab diya gaya ke aisa nahin balkay tumhare kufr ki wajah se tumhare dil mask ho gaye hain aur dusri tafseer ki bina par to jawab har tarah zahir hai. Surah Baqarah ki tafseer mein is ki poori tafseel-o-tashreeh guzar chuki hai. Pas bator natije ke farma diya ke ab un ke dil kufr-o-sarkashi aur kami-e-iman par hi rahenge, phir un ka panchwan jurm-e-azeem bayan ho raha hai ke unhon ne Sayyida Maryam (Alaihas Salam) par zina kari jaisi badtareen aur sharmanak tohmat lagayi aur isi zina kari ke hamal se Hazrat Isa ko paida shuda bataya, ba'az ne is se bhi aik qadam aage rakha aur kaha ke yeh badkari haiz ki halat mein hui thi. Allah ki un par phitkar ho ke un ki bad-zabani se Allah ke maqbool bande bhi na bach sake. Phir un ka chatha gunah bayan ho raha hai ke yeh bator tamsukhur aur apni barai ke yeh hank bhi lagate hain ke "Hum ne Hazrat Isa ko maar dala" jaise ke bator tamsukhur ke mushrikeen Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kehte hain ke ae woh shakhs jis par Quran utara gaya hai to tu majnoon hai.

Poora waqia yeh hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Isa A.S ko nabuwat de kar bheja aur aap ke haath par bade bade mojze dikhaye maslan bachpan ke andhon ko beena karna, kodhiyon ko achha karna, murdon ko zinda karna, mitti ke parind bana kar phoonk marna aur un ka jandaar ho kar ud jana waghera toh Yahudiyon ko sakht taish aaya aur mukhalifat par kamar basta ho gaye aur har tarah se eeza rasani shuru kar di, aap ki zindagi tang kar di, kisi basti mein chand din aaram karna bhi aap ko naseeb na hua, saari umar janglon aur bayabanon mein apni walida ke saath sayahat mein guzari, phir bhi unhein chain na lene diya, yeh Damishq ke badshah ke paas gaye jo sitara parast mushrik shakhs tha (is mazhab walon ke mulk ko us waqt Yunan kaha jata tha) yeh bahut roye peete aur badshah ko Hazrat Isa ke khilaf uksaya aur kaha ke yeh shakhs bada mufsid hai. Logon ko behka raha hai, roz naye fitne khade karta hai, aman mein khalal dalta hai. Logon ko baghawat pe uksata hai waghera. Badshah ne apne governor ko jo Bait-ul-Muqaddas mein tha, ek farman likha ke woh Hazrat Isa ko giraftar kar le aur sooli par chadha kar us ke sar par kanton ka taj rakh kar logon ko is dukh se nijat dilwaye. Us ne farman-e-shahi padh kar Yahudiyon ke ek giroh ko apne saath le kar us makan ka muhasra kar liya jis mein Roohullah thay, aap ke saath us waqt barah terah ya zyada se zyada sattar aadmi thay, Jumma ke din asr ke baad us ne muhasra kiya aur hafta ki raat tak makan ko ghere mein liye raha jab Hazrat Isa ne yeh mehsoos kar liya ke ab woh makan mein ghus kar aap ko giraftar kar lenge ya aap ko khud bahar nikalna padega toh aap ne sahaba se farmaya tum mein se kaun is baat ko pasand karta hai ke us par meri mushabahat daal di jaye yani us ki surat Allah mujh jaisi bana de aur woh un ke hathon giraftar ho aur mujhe Allah mukhlisi de? Main us ke liye jannat ka zamin hoon. Is par ek naujawan ne kaha mujhe yeh manzoor hai lekin Hazrat Isa ne unhein is qabil na jaan kar dobara yahi kaha, teesri dafa bhi kaha magar har martaba sirf yahi tayyar hue R.A. Ab aap ne yahi manzoor farma liya aur dekhte hi dekhte us ki surat qudratan badal gayi bilkul yeh maloom hone laga ke Hazrat Isa yahi hain aur chhat ki taraf ek rozan namoodar ho gaya aur Hazrat Isa ki oongh ki halat ho gayi aur isi tarah woh aasman par utha liye gaye. Jaise Quran-e-Kareem mein hai aayat (Iz qaalallahu ya Isa inni mutawaffika wa rafi'uka ilayya wa mutahhiruka minallazina kafaru wa ja'ilullazina attaba'uka fawqallazina kafaru ila yawmil qiyamah) (Surah Al-Imran: 55) yani jab Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya "Ae Isa main tum se mukammal ta'awun karne wala hoon aur apni taraf uthane wala hoon.

Hazrat Ruhullah ke soye hue aasman par uthaye jaane ke baad yeh log is ghar se bahar nikle, Yahudiyon ki jamaat ne us buzurg sahabi ko jis par Janab-e-Masih (A.S) ki shabahat daal di gayi thi, Isa samajh kar pakad liya aur raaton raat use sooli par chadha kar us ke sar par kanton ka taaj rakh diya. Ab Yahood khushiyan manane lage ke hum ne Isa bin Maryam ko qatl kar diya aur lutf to yeh hai ke Isaiyon ki kam-aql aur jahil jamaat ne bhi Yahudiyon ki haan mein haan mila di aur haan sirf woh log jo Masih (A.S) ke saath is makaan mein the aur jinhein yaqeeni taur par maloom tha ke Masih aasman par chadha liye gaye aur yeh falan shakhs hai jo dhoke mein un ki jagah kaam aaya. Baqi Isai bhi Yahudiyon ka sa raag alapne lage, yahan tak ke phir yeh bhi ghad liya ke Isa ki walida sooli tale baith kar roti chillati rahin aur yeh bhi kehte hain ke Aap ne un se kuch baatein bhi keen, Wallahu A'lam. Dar-asal yeh sab baatein Allah ki taraf se apne buzurg bandon ka imtehan hain jo us ki hikmat-e-baligha ka taqaza hai, pas is ghalti ko Allah Ta'ala ne wazeh aur zahir kar ke haqeeqat-e-haal se apne bandon ko mutalla farma diya aur apne sab se behtar Rasool aur bade martabe wale Paighambar ki zabani apne paak, sache aur behtareen kalaam mein saaf farma diya ke "Haqeeqatan na kisi ne Hazrat Isa ko qatl kiya, na sooli di balkay un ki shabih jis par dali gayi thi, use Isa hi samajh baithe, jo Yahood-o-Nasara Aap ke qatl ke qail ho gaye woh sab ke sab shak-o-shuba mein hairat-o-zalalat mein mubtala hain. Un ke paas koi daleel nahin na unhein khud kuch ilm hai sirf suni sunai baaton pe yaqeen ke siwa koi un ke paas daleel nahin." Isi liye phir isi ke mutasil farma diya ke "Yeh yaqeeni amr hai ke Ruhullah ko kisi ne qatl nahin kiya balkay Janab-e-Bari Azzasma ne jo ghalib tar hai aur jis ki qudratein bandon ke fehm mein bhi nahin aa saktin aur jis ki hikmaton ki teh tak aur kaamon ki teh tak koi nahin pahunch sakta, apne khaas bande ko jinhein apni rooh kaha tha apne paas utha liya." Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Isa (A.S) ko aasman par uthana chaha tha, Aap ghar mein aaye aur ghar mein barah hawari the, Aap ke baalon se paani ke qatre tapak rahe the, Aap ne farmaya! Tum mein ba'az aise hain jo mujh par imaan la chuke hain magar kuch mujh se kufr karenge. Phir Aap ne farmaya "Tum mein se kaun shakhs ise pasand karta hai ke us par meri shabih dali jaye aur meri jagah woh qatl kar diya jaye aur jannat mein mera rafeeq bane." Is riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Ruhullah ki pesh-goi ke mutabiq ba'az ne Aap se barah barah baar kufr kiya.

Phir un ke teen giroh hogaye, Yaqubiyyah, Nastooriyyah aur Musalman. Yaqubiyyah toh kehne lage khud Allah hum mein tha, jab tak chaha raha, phir aasman par charh gaya. Nastooriyyah ka khayal hogaya ke Allah ka larka hum mein tha, jise ek zamane tak hum mein rakh kar phir Allah ne apni taraf utha liya aur Musalmanon ka yeh aqeeda raha ke Allah ka banda aur Rasool hum mein tha jab tak Allah ne chaha woh hum mein raha aur phir Allah ne use apni taraf utha liya. In pehle do gumrah firqon ka zor hogaya aur unhon ne teesre sachay aur achay firqay ko kuchalna aur dabana shuru kiya, chunancha yeh kamzor hote gaye, yahan tak ke Allah Ta'ala ne Paighambar-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko mab'oos farma kar Islam ko ghalib kiya. Is ki asnaad bilkul sahih hai aur Nasai mein Hazrat Abu Mu'awiyah se bhi yahi manqool hai isi tarah salaf mein se bohat se buzurgon ka qaul hai. Hazrat Wahb bin Munabbah (R.H) farmate hain jis waqt shahi sipahi aur Yahudi Hazrat Isa (A.S) par charh dore aur ghera daal diya us waqt aap ke sath satra aadmi thay. In logon ne jab darwaze khol kar dekha toh dekha ke sab ke sab Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki surat mein hain toh kehne lage tum logon ne hum par jadoo kardiya hai, ab ya toh tum ise jo haqeeqi Isa (A.S) hon hamein sonp do ya ise manzoor karlo ke hum tum sab ko qatl kar dalein. Yeh sun kar Rooh-ullah ne farmaya "Koi hai jo jannat mein mera rafeeq bane aur yahan mere badle sooli par charhna manzoor kare?" Ek sahabi is ke liye tayyar hogaye aur kehne lage Isa (A.S) main tayyar hoon, chunancha dushmanan-e-deen ne unhein giraftar kiya qatl kiya aur sooli charhaya aur baghlein bajane lage ke hum ne Isa (A.S) ko qatl kiya, halankeh darasal aisa nahin hua balkeh woh dhoke mein par gaye aur Allah ne apne Rasool ko usi waqt apne paas charha liya. Tafsir-e-Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Isa (A.S) ko yeh wahi kardiya ke woh duniya se rukhsat hone wale hain toh aap par bohat garan guzra aur maut ki ghabrahat barh gayi toh aap ne hawariyon ki dawat ki, khana tayyar kiya aur sab se keh diya ke aaj raat ko mere paas tum sab zaroor aana, mujhe ek zaroori kaam hai. Jab woh aaye toh khud khana khilaya sab kaam kaaj apne hathon karte rahe, jab woh kha chuke toh khud un ke hath dhulaye aur apne kapron se un ke hath ponchhe yeh un par bhari para aur bura bhi laga lekin aap ne farmaya "Is raat mein jo kuch kar raha hoon, agar tum mein se kisi ne mujhe is se roka toh mera us ka kuch wasta nahin na woh mera na main us ka." Chunancha woh sab khamosh rahe. Jab aap in tamam kamon se farigh hogaye toh farmaya dekho! Tumhare nazdeek main tum sab se bare martabe wala hoon aur main ne tumhari khidmat khud ki hai, yeh is liye ke tum meri is sunnat ke aamil ban jao, khabardar tum mein se koi apne aap ko apne bhaiyon se bara na samjhe, balkeh har bara chote ki khidmat kare, jis tarah khud main ne tumhari khidmat ki hai.

Ab tum se mera jo khaas kaam tha jis ki wajah se aaj main ne tumhein bulaya hai woh bhi sun lo ke "Tum sab mil kar aaj raat bhar khushu-o-khuzu se mere liye duayein karo ke Allah meri ajal ko mu'akhar kar de." Chunancha sab ne duayein shuru keen lekin khushu-o-khuzu ka waqt aane se pehle hi is tarah unhein neend aane lagi ke zaban se ek lafz nikalna mushkil ho gaya, aap ne unhein bedaar karne ki koshish mein ek ek ko jhanjhor jhanjhor kar kaha tumhein kya ho gaya? Ek raat bhi jaag nahin sakte? Meri madad nahin karte? Lekin sab ne jawab diya ae Rasool-e-Allah hum khud hairan hain ke yeh kya ho raha hai? Ek chhor kayi kayi ratein jaagte the, jaagne ke aadi hain lekin Allah jaane, aaj kya baat hai ke buri tarah neend ne gher rakha hai, dua aur hamare darmiyan koi qudrati rukawat paida ho gayi hai to aap ne farmaya! Acha phir charwaha rahega aur bakriyan teen terah ho jayengi, garz isharon kinayon mein apna matlab zahir karte rahe, phir farmaya "Dekho tum mein se ek shakhs subah ka murgh bolne se pehle teen martaba mere sath kufr karega aur tum mein se ek chanda dirhamon ke badle mujhe bech dega aur meri qeemat khayega." Ab yeh log yahan se bahar nikle idhar udhar chale gaye, Yahood jo apni justuju mein the, unhon ne Shamoon hawari ko pehchan kar use pakra aur kaha yeh bhi is ka sathi hai, magar Shamoon ne kaha "Ghalat hai main is ka sathi nahin hoon." Unhon ne yeh bawar kar ke use chhor diya lekin kuch aage ja kar yeh dusri jamaat ke hath lag gaya, wahan se bhi isi tarah inkar kar ke apna aap chhuraya. Itne mein murgh ne baang di ab yeh pachtane lage aur sakht ghamgeen huye. Subah ek hawari Yahudiyon ke paas pahunchta hai aur kehta hai ke agar main tumhein Isa ka pata bata doon to tum mujhe kya dilwaoge? Unhon ne kaha tees dirham, chunancha us ne woh raqam le li, aur Hazrat Isa (A.S) ka pata bata diya. Is se pehle woh shuba mein the, ab unhon ne giraftar kar liya aur rassiyon mein jakar kar ghasit-te huye le chale aur bator-e-ta'ana zani ke kehte jaate the ke aap to murdon ko zinda karte the, jinnaat ko bhaga diya karte the, majnoon ko acha kar diya karte the, ab kya baat hai ke khud apne aap ko nahin bacha sakte in rassiyon ko bhi nahin tor sakte, thoo hai tumhare munh par! Yeh kehte jaate the aur kaante un ke upar daalte jaate the. Isi tarah bedardi se ghasite huye jab is lakri ke paas laye jahan sooli dena thi aur irada kiya ke sooli par charha dein us waqt Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi ko apni taraf charha liya aur unhon ne dusre shakhs ko jo aap ke mushaba tha sooli par charha diya. "Phir saat din ke baad Hazrat Maryam aur woh aurat jis ko Hazrat Isa ne jinn se nijat dilwayi thi, wahan aayin aur rone peetne lagin to un ke paas Hazrat Isa aaye aur un se kaha ke "Kyun roti ho?"

Mujhe toh Allah Ta'ala ne apni taraf buland kar liya hai aur mujhe un ki aziyatein nahin pahunchin, un par toh shuba daal diya gaya hai mere hawariyon se kaho ke mujh se falan jagah milein." Chunancha yeh basharat jab hawariyon ko mili toh woh sab ke sab gyarah aadmi us jagah pahunche, jis hawari ne aap ko becha tha, use unhon ne wahan na paya, daryaft karne par maloom hua ke woh nadamat aur sharmindagi ki wajah se apna gala ghont kar aap hi mar gaya, us ne khudkushi kar li. Aap ne farmaya "Agar woh tauba karta toh Allah us ki tauba qabool farma leta." Phir poocha ke yeh bacha jo tumhare saath hai, is ka naam Yahya hai, ab yeh tumhara sathi hai suno subh ko tumhari zabanen badal di jayengi, har shakhs apni apni qaum ki zaban bolne lage ga, ise chahiye ke usi qaum mein ja kar use meri dawat pahunchaye aur Allah se daraye. Yeh waqia nihayat hi ghareeb hai, Ibn-e-Ishaq ka qaul hai ke Bani Israel ka badshah jis ne Hazrat Isa A.S ke qatl ke liye apni fauj bheji thi us ka naam Dawood tha. Hazrat Isa A.S us waqt sakht ghabrahat mein the, koi shakhs apni maut se is qadar pareshan hawas bakhta aur is qadar wawela karne wala na hoga, jis qadar aap ne us waqt kiya. Yahan tak ke farmaya ya Allah agar tu maut ke pyale ko kisi se bhi taal ne wala hai toh mujh se taal de aur yahan tak ke ghabrahat aur khauf ke mare un ke badan se khoon phoot kar behne laga, us waqt us makan mein aap ke saath barah hawari the, jin ke naam yeh hain Fartus, Yaqubus, Rabda, Yabkhus, (Yaqub ka bhai) Andara Ablis, Felbus, Ibn-e-Yalma, Manta-tum-us, Yaqub bin Halqaya, Nadausis, Qatabiya, Liyodus Wakriya Yota. Baaz kehte hain terah aadmi the aur ek ka naam Sarjis tha. Isi ne apna aap sooli par charhaya jana Hazrat Isa A.S ki basharat par manzoor kiya tha. Jab Hazrat Isa A.S aasman par charha liye gaye aur baqiya log Yahudiyon ke hathon mein aseer ho gaye, ab jo ginti ginte hain toh ek kam nikla. Is ke bare mein un mein aapas mein ikhtilaf hua. Yeh log jab is jamaat par chhapa marte hain aur unhein giraftar karna chahte hain toh Hazrat Isa A.S ko chunke pehchante na the toh Liyodus Wakriya Yota ne tees dirham le kar un se kaha tha ke main sab se pehle jata hoon jise main ja kar bosa doon tum samajh lena ke Isa wahi hai, jab yeh andar pahunchte hain, us waqt Hazrat Isa A.S utha liye gaye the aur Hazrat Sarjis aap ki surat mein bana diye gaye the, us ne ja kar hasb-e-qarardad unhi ka bosa liya aur yeh giraftar kar liye gaye phir toh yeh bahut nadim hua aur apne gale mein rassi daal kar phansi par latak gaya aur Nasraniyon mein maloon bana. Baaz kehte hain is ka naam Yodus Rakriya Bota tha, yeh jaise hi Hazrat Isa A.S ki pehchan karane ke liye is ghar mein dakhil hua, Hazrat Isa A.S toh utha liye gaye aur khud is ki surat Hazrat Isa A.S jaisi ho gayi aur isi ko logon ne pakar liya, yeh hazaar cheekhta chillata raha ke main Isa nahin hoon, main toh tumhara sathi hoon, main ne hi toh tumhein Isa ka pata diya tha lekin kaun sunta?

Aakhir usi ko takhta-e-daar par latka diya, ab Allah hi ko ilm hai ke yahi tha ya woh tha, jis ka zikr pehle hua. Hazrat Mujahid R.H ka qaul hai ke Hazrat Roohullah ki mushabahat jis par daal di gayi thi use saleeb par charhaya aur Hazrat Isa A.S ko Allah Ta'ala ne zinda aasman par utha liya. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H farmate hain "Hazrat Isa A.S ki shabeeh aap ke un tamam sathiyon par daal di gayi thi." Is ke baad zikr hota hai ke Janab Roohullah ki maut se pehle jumla Ahl-e-Kitab aap par imaan layenge aur Qayamat tak aap un ke gawah honge. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H farmate hain is ki tafseer mein kayi qaul hain, ek toh yeh ke Isa A.S maut se pehle yani jab aap Dajjal ko qatl karne ke liye dobara zameen par aayenge us waqt tamam mazahib khatam ho chuke honge aur sirf Millat-e-Islamia jo darasal Ibrahim Hanif ki millat hai reh jayegi. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain (Mautihi) se murad maut-e-Isa A.S hai. Abu Malik R.H farmate hain jab Janab-e-Masih A.S utrenge, us waqt kul Ahl-e-Kitab aap par imaan layenge. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se aur riwayat mein hai khusoosan Yahudi ek bhi baqi nahin rahega. Hasan Basri R.H farmate hain yani Najashi aur un ke sathi. Aap se marvi hai ke qasam Allah ki Hazrat Isa A.S Allah ke paas ab zinda maujood hain. Jab aap zameen par nazil honge, us waqt Ahl-e-Kitab mein se ek bhi aisa na hoga jo aap par imaan na laye. Aap se jab is aayat ki tafseer poochhi jati hai toh aap farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne Masih A.S ko apne paas utha liya hai aur Qayamat se pehle aap ko dobara zameen par is haisiyat se bhejega ke har nek-o-bad aap par imaan laye ga. Hazrat Qatada R.H, Hazrat Abdur Rahman R.H waghera bahut se mufassireen ka yahi faisla hai aur yahi qaul haq hai aur yahi tafseer bilkul theek hai, Insha'Allah-ul-Azeem Allah Ta'ala ki madad aur us ki taufeeq se hum ise ba-dalail sabit karenge. Doosra qaul yeh hai ke har Ahl-e-Kitab aap par apni maut se pehle imaan lata hai. Is liye ke maut ke waqt haq-o-batil sab khul jata hai toh har kitabi Hazrat Isa A.S ki haqaniyat ko zameen se sudharne se pehle yaad kar leta hai. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain koi Yahudi nahin marta jab tak ke woh Hazrat Roohullah par imaan na laye. Hazrat Mujahid R.H ka yahi qaul hai. Balkay Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se toh yahan tak marvi hai ke agar kisi Ahl-e-Kitab ki gardan talwar se uda di jaye toh us ki rooh nahin nikalti jab tak ke woh Hazrat Isa A.S par imaan na laye aur yeh na keh de ke aap Allah ke bande aur us ke Rasool hain. Hazrat Ubay R.A ki toh qira'at mein (Qabla Mautihim) hai. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se poochha jata hai ke farz karo koi deewar se gir kar mar jaye? Farmaya phir bhi is darmiyani faasle mein woh imaan la chukta hai. Ikrama R.H, Muhammad bin Sirin R.H, Muhammad Zahhak R.H, Saeed bin Jubair R.H se bhi yahi marvi hai. Ek qaul Imam Hasan R.H se aisa bhi marvi hai ke jis ka matlab pehle qaul ka sa bhi ho sakta hai aur Hazrat Isa A.S ki maut se pehle ka bhi ho sakta hai.

Teesra qaul yeh hai ke Ahl-e-Kitab mein se koi bhi aisa nahin hoga jo Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par apni maut se pehle imaan layega. Ikrimah yahi farmate hain. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) farmate hain in sab aqwal mein zyada tar sahih qaul pehla hai ke Hazrat Isa (A.S) aasman se Qayamat ke qareeb utrenge, us waqt koi Ahl-e-Kitab aap par imaan laye baghair na rahega. Fi-al-waqai Imam sahab ka yeh faisla haq-ba-janib hai. Is liye ke yahan ki aayaton se saaf zahir hai ke asal maqsood Yahudiyon ke is daawe ko ghalat sabit karna hai ke hum ne Janab-e-Masih ko qatl kiya aur sooli di aur isi tarah jin jahil Isaiyon ne yeh bhi kaha hai un ke qaul ko bhi batil karna hai, Rooh-ullah na maqtool hain, na masloob. Toh Allah Ta'ala khabar deta hai ke fi-al-waqai nafs-ul-amr mein na toh Rooh-ullah maqtool hue, na masloob hue balkeh un ke liye shuba daal diya gaya aur unhon ne Hazrat Isa (A.S) jaise ek shakhs ko qatl kiya lekin khud unhein is haqeeqat ka ilm na ho saka. Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (A.S) ko toh apne paas chadha liya. Woh zinda hain, ab tak baqi hain, Qayamat ke qareeb utrenge. Jaise sahih mutawatir ahadees mein hai Masih har gumrah ko qatl karenge, saleeb ko todenge, khanzeeron ko qatl karenge, jizya qabool nahin karenge, elaan kar denge ke ya toh Islam ko qabool karo ya talwar se muqabla karo. Pas is aayat mein khabar deta hai ke us waqt tamam Ahl-e-Kitab aap ke haath par imaan qabool karenge aur ek bhi aisa na rahega jo Islam ko maane baghair reh jaye ya reh sake. Pas jise yeh gumrah Yahood aur yeh jahil Nasrani mara hua jaante hain aur sooli par chadhaya hua maante hain, yeh un ki haqeeqi maut se pehle hi un par imaan layenge aur jo kaam unhon ne un ki maujoodgi mein kiye hain aur karenge yeh un par Qayamat ke din Allah ke samne gawahi denge yani aasman par uthaye jaane ke qabl zindagi ke mushahida kiye hue kaam aur dobara ki aakhri zindagi jo zameen par guzarenge, is mein un ke samne jitne kaam unhon ne kiye woh sab aap ki nigahon ke samne honge aur unhein Allah ke samne unhein pesh karenge. Haan is ki tafseer mein jo do qaul aur bayan hue hain woh bhi waqia ke aitbar se bilkul sahih aur durust hain. Maut ka farishta aa jaane ke baad ahwal-e-aakhirat, sach jhoot ka muaina ho jata hai, us waqt har shakhs sachai ko sach kehne aur samajhne lagta hai lekin woh imaan Allah ke nazdeek motabar nahin. Isi surat ke shuru mein hai aayat (Walaistut-taubatu lillazeena ya'maloonas-sayyi'ati hatta iza hazara ahadahumul mautu qala inni tubtul-aana wa lallazeena yamootoona wahum kuffar, ulaaika a'tadna lahum azaban aleema) (Surah An-Nisa: 18) aur jagah farman hai aayat (Falamma ra'au ba'sana qaloo aamanna billahi wahdahu wa kafarna bima kunna bihi mushrikeen) (Surah Al-Ghafir: 84).

Ghafir: 84) Ya'ni jo log maut ke aa jaane tak buraiyon mein mashghool rahe unki tauba qabool nahin aur jo log azab-e-Rabb dekh kar imaan layein, unhein bhi unka imaan nafa na dega. Pas in dono aayaton ko samne rakh kar hum kehte hain ke pichle do aqwal jin ki Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ne tardeed ki hai woh theek nahin. Is liye ke Imam sahab farmate hain agar pichle dono qaulon ko is aayat ki tafsir mein sahih mana jaye to lazim aata hai ke kisi Yahudi ya Nasrani ke aqriba uske waris na hon, is liye ke woh to Hazrat Isa A.S par aur Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ par imaan la kar mara aur uske waris Yahood-o-Nasara hain, Musalman ka waris kafir nahin ho sakta. Lekin hum kehte hain yeh us waqt hai jab imaan aise waqt laye ke Allah ke nazdeek motabar ho, na aise waqt imaan lana jo bilkul besood hai. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ke qaul par gehri nazar daliye ke deewar se girte hue, darinde ke jabron mein, talwar ke chalte hue woh imaan lata hai to aisi halat ka imaan mutlaq nafa nahin de sakta. Jaise Quran ki mandarja bala dono aayatein zahir kar rahi hain Wallahu A'lam. Mere khayal se to yeh baat bahut saaf hai ke is aayat ki tafsir ke pichle dono qaul bhi motabar maan lene se koi ishkal pesh nahin aati. Apni jagah woh bhi theek hain. Lekin haan aayat se waqai matlab to yeh nikalta hai jo pehla qaul hai. To is se murad yeh hai ke Isa A.S aasmanon par zinda maujood hain, Qayamat ke qareeb zameen par utrenge aur Yahudiyon-o-Nasraniyon dono ko jhoota batayenge aur jo ifrat-o-tafrit unhone ki hai, use batil qarar denge. Ek taraf maloon jamaat Yahudiyon ki hai, jinhone Aap ko Aap ki izzat se bahut gira diya aur aisi napak baatein Aap ki shaan mein kahein jin se ek bhala insaan nafrat kare. Dusri janib Nasrani hain jinhone Aap ke martabe ko is qadar barhaya ke jo Aap mein na tha uske isbat mein itne barhe ke maqam-e-nabuwwat se maqam-e-rububiyat tak pohancha diya jis se Allah ki zaat bilkul paak hai. Ab in ahadees ko suniye jin mein bayan hai ke Hazrat Isa A.S aakhir zamane mein Qayamat ke qareeb aasman se zameen par utrenge aur Allah Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu ki ibadat ki taraf sab ko bulayenge. Sahih Bukhari Sharif jise sari ummat ne qabool kiya hai us mein Imam Muhammad bin Ismail Bukhari R.H kitab Zikr-e-Ambiya mein yeh hadith laye hain ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya uski qasam jiske hath mein meri jaan hai ke anqareeb tum mein Ibn-e-Maryam nazil honge. Aadil munsif ban kar saleeb ko todenge, khanzeer ko qatl karenge. Jizya hata denge. Maal is qadar barh jayega ke use lena koi manzoor na karega, ek sajda kar lena duniya aur duniya ki sab cheezon se mehboob tar hoga. Is hadith ko bayan farma kar rawi-e-hadith Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ne bator-e-shahadat-e-Qurani ke isi aayat (Wa in min) ki aakhir tak tilawat ki. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein bhi yeh hadith hai aur sanad se yahi riwayat Bukhari Muslim mein marwi hai us mein hai ke sajda us waqt faqat Allah Rabbul Aalameen ke liye hi hoga.

Aur is ayat ki tilawat mein qabl-e-mautihi ke baad yeh farman bhi hai ke qabl-e-mauti Isa bin Maryam, phir ise Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ka teen martaba dohrana bhi hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai Hazrat Isa (A.S) hajj ya umre par ya dono par labbaik kahenge, maidan-e-hajj mein, Rauha mein. Yeh hadith Muslim mein bhi hai. Musnad ki aur hadith mein hai Isa bin Maryam (A.S) utrenge, khanzeer ko qatl karenge, saleeb ko mitayenge, namaz-e-ba-jamaat hogi aur Allah ki rah mein maal is qadar kasrat se diya jayega ke koi qabool na karne wala na milega. Kharaj chhod denge, Rauha mein jayenge aur wahan se hajj ya umra karenge ya dono ek sath karenge. Phir Abu Huraira (R.A) ne yahi ayat padhi lekin aap ke shagird Hazrat Hanzala (R.H) ka khayal hai ke Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ne farmaya "Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke inteqal se pehle aap par iman layenge." Mujhe nahin maloom ke yeh sab hadith ke hi alfaz hain ya Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ke apne.

Sahih Bukhari mein hai us waqt kya hoga, jab tum mein Maseeh bin Maryam utrein ge aur tumhara Imam tumhein mein se hoga. Abu Dawood, Musnad-e-Ahmad waghera mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya " Anbiya-e-Kiram (Alaihimas Salam) sab ek baap ke bete bhai ki tarah hain, maaein juda juda aur deen ek. Isa bin Maryam se zyada tar nazdeek main hoon is liye ke mere aur un ke darmiyan koi aur Nabi nahin, yaqeenan woh utarne wale hain pas tum unhein pehchan rakho. Darmiyan qad hai, surkh safed rang hai. Woh do geruwe rang mein range hue kapre orhay aur bandhay hon ge, baal khushk hone ke bawajood un ke sar se qatray tapak rahe hon ge, khanzeer ko qatl karein ge, jizya qabool na karein ge, logon ko Islam ki taraf bulayein ge, un ke zamane mein tamam millatein mit jayen gi, sirf Islam hi Islam rahe ga, un ke zamane mein Allah Ta'ala Maseeh Dajjal ko halak kare ga. Phir zameen par aman hi aman hoga yahan tak ke kaalay naag oonton ke sath, cheetay gayon ke sath aur bheriye bakriyon ke sath charte phirein ge aur bachay saanpon se khelein ge, unhein koi nuqsan na pohanchayein ge, chalees baras tak thehrein ge, phir faut hon ge aur Musalman aap ke janazay ki namaz ada karein ge. " Ibn-e-Jareer ki isi riwayat mein hai, aap logon se Islam ke liye jihad karein ge, is hadith ka ek tukra Bukhari Sharif mein bhi hai aur riwayat mein hai " Sab se zyada qareeb tar Hazrat Isa se duniya aur aakhirat mein main hoon. " Sahih Muslim mein hai " Qayamat qaim na hogi, jab tak Roomi A'maq ya Dabiq mein na utrein aur un ke muqablay ke liye Madina se Musalmanon ka lashkar na nikle ga, jo us waqt tamam zameen ke logon se zyada Allah ke pasandeeda banday hon ge, jab safein bandh jayen gi to Roomi kahein ge tum se hum larna nahin chahte, hum mein se jo deen badal kar tum mein milay hum un se larna chahte hain tum beech mein se hat jao lekin Musalman kahein ge Wallah yeh ho hi nahin sakta ke hum apne in kamzor bhaiyon ko tumhare hawalay kar dein.

Chunancha ladai shuru hogi musalmanon ke is lashkar ka tihai hissa toh shikast kha kar bhag khada hoga, un ki tauba Allah Ta'ala hargiz qabool na farmaye ga aur tihai hissa shaheed ho jaye ga, jo Allah ke nazdeek sab se afzal shaheed hain lekin aakhri tihai hissa fatah hasil kare ga aur roomiyon par ghalib aa jaye ga, phir yeh kisi fitne mein na padenge, Qustuntuniya ko fatah karenge, abhi toh woh apni talwarein zaitoon ke darakhton par latkaye hue maal-e-ghaneemat taqseem kar hi rahe honge jo shaitan cheekh kar kahe ga ke tumhare baal-bachon mein Dajjal aa gaya, us ke is jhoot ko sach jaan kar musalman yahan se nikal khade honge, Sham mein pahunchenge, dushmanon se jang-azma hone ke liye safein theek kar rahe honge ke dusri janib namaz ki iqamat hogi aur Hazrat Isa bin Maryam nazil honge, un ki imamat karayenge, jab dushman-e-Rabb unhein dekhe ga toh isi tarah ghulne lage ga jis tarah namak pani mein ghulta hai, agar Hazrat Isa A.S use yunhi chhod dein, jab bhi woh ghulte ghulte khatam ho jaye lekin Allah Ta'ala use aap ke hath se qatl karaye ga aur aap apne harbe par us ka khoon logon ko dikhayenge." Musnad-e-Ahmad aur Ibn-e-Majah mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain "Meraj wali raat mein ne Ibrahim, Musa aur Isa (Alaihimas Salam) se mulaqat ki, aapas mein Qayamat ki nisbat baat-cheet hone lagi, Ibrahim A.S ne apni la-ilmi zahir ki, isi tarah Musa A.S ne bhi, lekin Hazrat Isa ne farmaya is ke aane ka theek waqt toh siwaye Allah Azza-wa-Jal ke koi nahin janta, han mujh se mere Rabb ne jo ahd liya hai woh yeh hai ke Dajjal nikle ga us ke hamrah do shakhein hongi, mujhe dekh kar is tarah pighalne lage ga jis tarah seesa pighalta hai, yahan tak ke patthar aur darakht bhi bolne lagenge ke ae musalman yahan mere peeche ek kafir hai aur ise qatl karlein, Allah Ta'ala un sab ko gharat kar de ga aur log aman-o-aman ke sath apne apne watan aur shehron ko laut jayenge, ab Yajuj Majuj niklenge, har taraf se chadh daudenge, tamam shehron ko rondenge, jis jis cheez par guzar hoga use halak kar denge, jis pani ke paas se guzarne lagenge pee jayenge, log phir laut kar mere paas aayenge, mein Allah se dua karunga, Allah un sab ko ek sath fana kar de ga lekin un ke murda jismon se hawa bigad jaye gi, badbu phail jaye gi, phir meena barse ga aur is qadar ke un ki tamam lashon ko baha kar samundar mein daal de ga. Bas us waqt Qayamat ki is tarah aamad-aamad hogi jis tarah poore din ki hamila aurat ho ke us ke ghar wale nahin jante ke subah ko bacha ho jaye ya sham ko, raat ko paida ho ya din ko?

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abu Nazra farmate hain hum Hazrat Usman bin Abul Aas ke paas Jumma wale din aaye ke hum apna likha hua Quran unke Quran se milayein, jab Jumma ka waqt aaya toh aap ne hum se farmaya "Ghusl karlo" phir khushbu le aaye jo hum ne mali, phir hum masjid mein aaye aur ek shakhs ke paas baith gaye jinhon ne hum se Dajjal wali hadith bayan ki phir Hazrat Usman bin Abul Aas aaye, hum khade hogaye, phir sab baith gaye, aap ne farmaya "Main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se suna hai ke Musalman ke teen shehar mein jayenge, ek dono samundar ke milne ki jagah par, dusra Hira mein aur teesra Sham mein, phir teen ghabrahtein logon ko hongi, phir Dajjal niklega, yeh pehle shehar ki taraf jayega, wahan ke log teen hisson mein bat jayenge, ek hissa toh kahega hum iske muqable par thehre rahenge aur dekhenge ke kya hota hai? Dusri jamaat gaon ke logon mein mil jayegi aur teesri jamaat dusre shehar mein chali jayegi jo unse qareeb hoga, Dajjal ke sath sattar hazar log honge, jin ke saron par taaj honge, unki aksariyat Yahudiyon ki aur aurton ki hogi, yahan ke yeh Musalman ek ghati mein simat kar mahsoor hojayenge, unke janwar jo charne chugne ko gaye honge, woh bhi halak hojayenge, is se unke masaib bahut badh jayenge aur bhook ke mare bura haal hojayega, yahan tak ke apni kamanon ki tanen senk senk kar kha lenge, jab sakht tangi ka aalam hoga toh unhein samundar mein se aawaz aayegi ke logo tumhari madad aa gayi, is aawaz ko sun kar yeh log khush honge, kyunke aawaz se jaan lenge ke yeh kisi aasuda shakhs ki aawaz hai, ain subah ki namaz ke waqt Hazrat Isa bin Maryam (A.S) nazil honge, unka ameer aap se kahega ke ae Rooh-ullah aage badhiye aur namaz padhaiye lekin aap kahenge ke is ummat ke baaz baaz ke ameer hain, chunancha unhi ka ameer aage badhega aur namaz padhayega, namaz se farigh ho kar apna harba hath mein le kar Maseeh-e-Dajjal ka rukh karenge, Dajjal aap ko dekh kar seesay ki tarah pighalne lagega, aap uske seena par waar karenge jis se woh halak hojayega aur uske sathi shikast kha kar bhag khade honge, lekin unhein kahin aman nahin milega, yahan tak ke agar woh kisi darakht tale chhipenge toh woh darakht pukar kar kahega ke ae Momin yeh ek kafir mere paas chhipa hua hai aur isi tarah patthar bhi." Ibn-e-Majah mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apne ek khutba ka kam-o-besh hissa Dajjal ka waqia bayan karne aur us se darane mein hi sarf kiya, jis mein yeh bhi farmaya ke duniya ki ibtida se le kar intiha tak koi fitna is se bada nahin, tamam Anbiya apni apni ummaton ko is se aagah karte rahe hain, main sab se aakhri Nabi hoon aur tum sab se aakhri ummat ho, woh yaqeenan tumhein mein aayega, agar meri maujoodgi mein aa gaya toh main aap is se nimat loonga aur agar baad mein aaya toh har shakhs ko apne aap ko is se bachana padega. Main Allah Ta'ala ko har Musalman ka khalifa banata hoon.

Woh Sham-o-Iraq ke darmiyan nikle ga, dayen bayen khoob ghoome ga, logo ae Allah ke bando! Dekho dekho tum sabit qadam rehna, suno main tumhein is ki aisi sifat batata hoon jo kisi Nabi ne apni ummat ko nahin batayi. Woh ibtida mein dawa kare ga ke main Nabi hoon, pas tum yaad rakhna ke mere baad koi Nabi nahin, phir woh is se bhi barh jaye ga aur kahe ga main Allah hoon, pas tum yaad rakhna ke Allah ko in aankhon se koi nahin dekh sakta, han marne ke baad deedar-e-Bari Ta'ala ho sakta hai aur suno woh kana hoga aur tumhara Rabb kana nahin, is ki dono aankhon ke darmiyan "Kafir" likha hoga jise parha likha aur an-parh gharz har iman-dar parh le ga. Is ke sath aag hogi aur bagh hoga is ki aag darasal jannat hogi aur is ka bagh darasal jahannam hoga, suno tum mein se jise woh aag mein dale, woh Allah se faryad-rasi chahe aur Surah Kahf ki ibtidai ayatein parhe, is ki woh aag is par thandak aur salamti ban jaye gi jaise ke Khalilullah (A.S) par Namrood ki aag ho gayi, is ka ek fitna yeh bhi hoga ke woh ek a'arabi se kahe ga ke agar main tere mare hue baap ko zinda kar doon to tu mujhe Rabb maan le ga woh iqrar kare ga, itne mein do shaitan us ki maa aur baap ki shakal mein zahir honge aur un se kahenge bete yahi tera Rabb hai to ise maan le, is ka ek fitna yeh bhi hoga ke woh ek shakhs par musallat kar diya jaye ga use aaray se chirwa kar do tukray karwa de ga, phir logon se kahe ga mere is bande ko dekhna ab main ise zinda kar doon ga, lekin phir bhi yahi kahe ga ke is ka Rabb mere siwa aur hai, chunancha yeh ise utha baithaye ga aur yeh khabeeth is se puche ga ke tera Rabb kaun hai? Woh jawab de ga mera Rabb Allah hai aur tu Allah ka dushman Dajjal hai. Allah ki qasam ab to mujhe pehle se bhi bohat zyada yaqeen ho gaya. Dusri sanad se marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya "Yeh momin meri tamam ummat se zyada buland darja ka jannati hoga." Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri (R.A) farmate hain is hadith ko sun kar hamara khayal tha ke yeh shakhs Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) hi honge aap ki shahadat tak hamara yahi khayal raha, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain is ka ek fitna yeh bhi hoga ke woh aasman ko pani barsane ka hukum de ga aur aasman se barish hogi, woh zameen ko paidawar ugane ka hukum de ga aur zameen se paidawar nikle gi, is ka ek fitna yeh bhi hoga ke woh ek qabeelay ke paas jaye ga woh ise na manenge, isi waqt un ki tamam cheezein barbad aur halak ho jayengi, ek aur qabeelay ke paas jaye ga jo ise Khuda maan le ga, isi waqt is ke hukum se un par aasman se barish barse gi aur zameen phal aur kheti ugaye gi, un ke janwar pehle se zyada motay tazay aur doodh walay ho jayenge. Siwaye Makkah aur Madinah ke tamam ka gasht kare ga, un ke janwar pehle se zyada motay tazay aur doodh walay ho jayenge.

Siwaye Makkah aur Madinah ke tamam zameen ka gasht karega, jab Madinah ka rukh karega toh yahan har har raah par farishton ko khuli talwarein liye hue payega toh Zareeb ki intehai had par Zareeb-e-Ahmar ke paas thehar jayega, phir Madinah mein teen bhunchal aayenge, is wajah se jitne munafiq mard aur jis qadar munafiqah auratein hongi, sab Madinah se nikal kar uske lashkar mein mil jayengi aur Madinah un gande logon ko is tarah apne mein se door phenk dega jis tarah bhatti lohay ke mail kuchail ko alag kar deti hai, us din ka naam Yaum-ul-Khalas hoga. "Umm-e-Shareek (R.A) ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us din Arab kahan honge? Farmaya awwalan toh honge hi bahut kam aur aksariyat unki Bait-ul-Muqaddas mein hogi, unka imam pichle pairon peeche hatega taake aap aage barh kar imamat karayein lekin aap uski kamar par haath rakh kar farmayenge ke aage barho aur namaz parhao, iqamat tumhare liye ki gayi hai pas unka imam hi namaz parhayega, farigh ho kar aap farmayenge, darwaza khol do, pas khol diya jayega, udhar Dajjal sattar hazar Yahudiyon ka lashkar liye hue maujood hoga, jin ke sar par taaj aur jin ki talwaron par sona hoga, Dajjal aap ko dekh kar is tarah ghulne lagega jis tarah namak paani mein ghulta hai aur ek dam peeth pher kar bhagna shuru kar dega lekin aap farmayenge Allah Ta'ala ne yeh faisla kar diya hai ke tu mere haath se ek zarb khaye toh ise taal nahin sakta. Chunancha aap use mashriqi Baab-e-Ludd ke paas pakar lenge aur wahin use qatl karenge, ab Yahudi bad-hawasi se muntashir ho kar bhagenge lekin unhein kahin sar chupane ko jagah na milegi, har patthar har darakht har deewar aur har janwar bolta hoga ke aye Musalman yahan Yahudi hai, aa ise maar daal, haan babool ka darakht Yahudiyon ka darakht hai yeh nahin bolega." Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain iska rehna chalees saal tak hoga, saal aadhe saal ke barabar aur saal mahina bhar jaisa aur mahina jumma jaisa aur baqi din misl sharara ke.

Subh hi ek shakhs shahar ke ek darwaze se chalega, abhi dusre darwaze tak nahin pahuncha toh shaam ho jayegi. Logon ne daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) phir in chhote dinon mein hum namaz kaise padhenge? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya andaza kar liya karo jaise in lambe dinon mein andaze se padha karte the. Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain pas Isa bin Maryam (A.S) meri ummat mein hakim honge, aadil honge, imam honge, ba-insaf honge, saleeb ko todenge, khanzeer ko qatl karenge, jizya ko hata denge, sadaqa chhod diya jayega pas bakri aur oont par koshish na ki jayegi, hasad aur bughz bilkul jata rahega, har zehreele janwar ka zehar hata diya jayega, bachche apni ungli saanp ke munh mein dalenge lekin woh unhein koi zarar nahin pahunchayega, sheron se ladke khelenge nuqsan kuch na hoga, bhediye bakriyon ke galle mein is tarah phirenge jaise rakhwala kutta ho, tamam zameen Islam aur islah se is tarah bhar jayegi jaise koi bartan pani se labalab bhara hua ho, sab ka kalma ek ho jayega, Allah ke siwa kisi ki ibadat na hogi, ladai aur jang bilkul mauqoof ho jayegi, Quraish apna mulk salb kar lenge, zameen misl-e-safed chandi ke munawwar ho jayegi aur jaisi barkatein zamana-e-Adam mein thin laut aayengi, ek jamaat ko ek angoor ka khusha pet bharne ke liye kafi hoga, ek anaar itna hoga ke ek jamaat khaye aur sair ho jaye, bail itni itni qeemat par milega aur ghoda chand dirhamon par milega. Logon ne poocha is ki qeemat gir jaane ki kya wajah? Farmaya is liye ke ladaiyon mein is ki sawari bilkul na li jayegi. Daryaft kiya gaya bail ki qeemat badh jaane ki kya wajah hai? Farmaya is liye ke tamam zameen par khetiyan honi shuru ho jayengi. Dajjal ke aane se teen saal peshtar se sakht qahat-sali hogi, pehle saal barish ka teesra hissa ba-hukm-e-Ilahi rok liya jayega aur zameen ki paidawar ka bhi teesra hissa kam ho jayega, phir dusre saal Allah aasman ko hukm dega ke barish ki do-tihaiyan rok le aur yahi hukm zameen ko apni paidawar ki do-tihaiyan kam kar de, teesre saal aasman barish ka ek qatra na barsega, na zameen se koi rooyidagi paida hogi, tamam janwar is qahat se halak ho jayenge magar jise Allah chahe. Aap (ﷺ) se poocha gaya ke phir us waqt log zinda kaise reh jayenge, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya "Un ki ghiza ke qaim-maqam us waqt un ka La Ilaha Illallah kehna aur Allahu Akbar kehna aur SubhanAllah kehna aur Alhamdulillah kehna hoga." Imam Ibn Majah (R.H) farmate hain mere ustad ne apne ustad se suna woh farmate the yeh hadith is qabil hai ke bachchon ke ustad ise bachchon ko bhi sikha dein balkeh likhwayein taake unhein bhi yaad rahe, yeh hadith is sanad se hai toh ghareeb lekin is ke baaz hisson ki shawahid dusri hadithein hain.

Isi hadith jaisi ek hadith Nawwas bin Sam'an R.A se marwi hai, isay bhi hum yahan zikr karte hain. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai, ek din subh ko Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ne Dajjal ka zikr kiya aur is tarah usay wazeh bayan farmaya ke hum samjhay, kahin Madina ke nakhlistan mein woh majood na ho. Phir jab hum laut kar Aap ki taraf aaye toh hamaray chehron se Aap ne jaan liya aur daryaft farmaya ke kya baat hai? Hum ne dil ki baat keh di toh Aap ne farmaya! Dajjal ke ilawa mujhe toh tum se is se bhi bada khauf hai, agar woh meri majoodgi mein nikla toh main Aap us se samajh loonga aur agar woh mere baad aaya toh har Musalman is se Aap bhugat lega, main apna khalifa har Musalman par Allah ko banata hoon, woh jawan hoga, aankh uski ubhri hui hogi, bas yun samajh lo ke Abdul Uzza bin Qatan jaisa hoga, tum mein jo usay dekhay usay chahiye ke Surah Kahf ki shuru ki aayatein parhay, woh Sham-o-Iraq ke darmiyani goshay se niklay ga aur dayen bayen gasht kare ga, aye Allah ke bando! Khoob sabit qadam rehna. Hum ne poocha Huzoor ﷺ woh rahay ga kitni muddat? Aap ne farmaya chalees din, ek din saal ke barabar, ek din ek mahinay ke barabar, ek din jum'a ke barabar aur baqi din tumharay mamooli dinon jaisay. Phir hum ne daryaft kiya ke jo din saal bhar ke barabar hoga, kya us mein ek hi din ki namaz kaafi hongi? Aap ne farmaya nahin balkay andaza karlo aur namaz ada karlo. Hum ne poocha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ! Iski raftar ki sur'at kaisi hogi? Farmaya aisi jaise badal hawaon se bhagtay hain. Ek qoum ko apni taraf bulaye ga woh maan lenge toh aasman se un par barish barsay gi, zameen se kheti aur phal ugain ge, un ke janwar tar-o-taza aur zyada doodh walay ho jayen ge, ek qoum ke paas jaye ga jo usay jhutlaye gi aur uska inkar kar degi, yeh wahan se lautay ga toh un ke haath mein kuch na rahay ga, woh banjar zameen par kharay ho kar hukum de ga ke aye zameen ke khazano nikal aao toh woh sab nikal ayen ge aur shehad ki makkhiyon ki tarah us ke peechay peechay phirain ge. Yeh ek naujawan ko bulaye ga aur usay qatl kare ga, us ke theek do tukray kar ke itni itni door daal de ga jo kisi teer ki kamaan se niklay huay doori ho, phir usay aawaz de ga toh woh zinda ho kar hansta hua us ke paas aa jaye ga.

Ab Allah Ta'ala Masih bin Maryam A.S ko bhejega aur woh Damishq ke safed sharqi minare ke paas do chadrein orhay do farishton ke paron par bazu rakhe hue utrein ge, jab sar jhukayen ge to qatray tapken ge aur jab uthayen ge to misl motiyon ke woh qatray lurhken ge, jis kafir tak un ka saans pahunch jaye woh mar jaye ga aur Aap ka saans wahan tak pahunche ga jahan tak nigah pahunche, Aap Dajjal ka peecha karen ge aur Bab-e-Lud ke paas use pa kar qatl karen ge, phir un logon ke paas ayen ge, jinhein Allah ne us fitne se bachaya hoga, un ke chehron par haath pheren ge aur Jannat ke darjon ki unhein khabar den ge, ab Allah ki taraf se Hazrat Isa A.S ke paas wahi ayegi ke main apne aise bandon ko bhejta hoon jin ka muqabla koi nahin kar sakta tum mere in khaas bandon ko Toor ki taraf le jao, phir Yajuj, Majuj niklen ge aur woh har taraf se koodte phandte aa jayen ge, Behaira-e-Tabriya par un ka pehla giroh ayega aur us ka sara pani pee jaye ga, jab un ke baad hi dusra giroh ayega to woh use aisa sookha hua paye ga ke woh kahen ge shayad yahan kabhi pani nahin hoga? Hazrat Isa A.S aur Aap ke saathi momin wahan is qadar mahsoor rahen ge ke ek bail ka sar nahin is se bhi achha lage jaise tumhein aaj ek sau dinar mehboob hain, ab Aap aur momin Allah se duayen aur iltijayen karen ge, Allah un par gardan ki ghalti ki bimari bhej de ga, jis mein saare ke saare ek saath ek dam mein fana ho jayen ge, phir Hazrat Isa A.S aur Aap ke saathi zameen par utrein ge magar zameen par balisht bhar bhi aisi na payen ge jo un ki lashon se aur badbu se khali ho, phir Allah Ta'ala se duayen aur iltijayen karen ge to bakhti unton ki gardanon ke barabar ek qisam ke parind Allah Ta'ala bhejega jo un ki lashon ko utha kar jahan Allah chahe daal ayen ge, phir barish hogi, jis se tamam zameen dhul dhula kar hatheli jaisi saaf ho jaye gi, phir zameen ko hukm hoga ke apne phal nikal aur apni barkatein lota, us din ek anar ek jamaat ko kafi hoga aur woh sab us ke chhilke tale aaram hasil kar saken ge, ek untni ka doodh ek pooray qabeelay se nahin piya jaye ga, phir Parwardigar-e-Alam ek latif aur pakeeza hawa chalaye ga jo tamam imandar mardon aurton ki baghal tale se nikal jaye gi aur saath hi un ki rooh bhi parwaz kar jaye gi aur badtareen log baqi reh jayen ge jo aapas mein gadhon ki tarah dhenga mushti mein mashghool ho jayen ge un par Qayamat qaim hogi. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi ek aisi hi hadith hai ise hum Surah Anbiya ki ayat (Hatta iza futihat-e-Yajuju wa Majuju wa hum min kulli hadabin yansilun) (21. Al-Anbiya: 96) ki tafsir mein bayan karen ge Insha'Allah Ta'ala.

Sahih Muslim mein hai ke ek shakhs Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) ke paas aaya aur kaha ke yeh kya baat hai jo mujhe pahunchi hai ke aap farmate hain Qayamat yahan yahan tak aajayegi? Aap ne SubhanAllah ya La ilaha illallah keh kar farmaya mera toh ab jee chahta hai ke tumhein ab koi hadith hi na sunaaun, main ne toh yeh kaha tha ke kuch zamane ke baad tum bade bade amr-e-ilahi dekhoge, Baitullah jala diya jayega aur yeh hoga woh hoga waghera. Phir farmaya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ka farman hai ke Dajjal niklega aur meri ummat mein chalees tak thehrega, mujhe nahin maloom ke chalees din ya chalees mahine ya chalees saal. Phir Allah Ta'ala Isa bin Maryam (A.S) ko bhejega, aap ki surat misl Hazrat Urwah bin Masood (R.A) ke hai. Aap use talash kar ke qatl karenge phir saat saal tak log isi tarah rahenge ke woh bhi kuch adawat hogi, phir thandi hawa Sham ki taraf se chalegi aur sab iman walon ko faut kar degi, jis ke dil mein ek zarre barabar bhi bhalai ya iman hoga agarche woh kisi pahad ke ghaar mein ho woh bhi faut hojayega, phir badtareen log baqi reh jayenge jo parindon jaise halke aur darindon jaise dimaghon wale honge, achhai burai ki koi tameez un mein na hogi, Shaitan un ke paas insani surat mein aa kar unhein but-parasti ki taraf mail karega lekin un ki is halat mein bhi un ki rozi ke darwaze un par khule honge aur zindagi ba-aram guzar rahi hogi, phir Soor phonka jayega, jis se log girne marne lagenge, ek shakhs jo apne unton ko pani pilane ke liye un ka hauz theek kar raha hoga, sab se pehle Soor ki aawaz us ke kaan mein padegi, jis se yeh aur tamam aur log behosh hojayenge. Garz sab kuch fana hochukne ke baad Allah Ta'ala meenh barsayega, jo misl shabnam ke ya misl saye ke hoga, us se dobara jism paida honge phir dusra Soor phonka jayega, sab ke sab jee uthenge, phir kaha jayega logo apne Rab ki taraf chalo, unhein thehra kar un se sawal kiya jayega phir farmaya jayega Jahannam ka hissa nikalo, pucha jayega kitnon se kitne? Jawab milega har hazaar mein se nau sau ninnanve, yeh din hai jo bachon ko budha bana dega aur yahi din hai jis mein pindli kholi jayegi. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Ibn-e-Maryam (A.S) Bab-e-Lud ke paas ya Lud ki janib Maseeh Dajjal ko qatl karenge. Tirmidhi mein Bab-e-Lud hai aur yeh hadith sahih hai. Is ke baad Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) ne chand aur Sahaba (R.A) ke naam bhi liye hain ke un se bhi is bab ki hadithein marwi hain toh is se murad woh hadithein hain jin mein Dajjal ka Maseeh (A.S) ke haath se qatl hona mazkoor hai. Sirf Dajjal ke zikr ki hadithein toh beshumar hain, jinhein jama karna sakht dushwar hai.

Musnad mein hai ke Arafat se aate hue Huzoor ﷺ apne sahaba ke ek majmay ke paas se guzre, us waqt wahan Qayamat ke zikr-o-afkar ho rahe thay, toh Aap ﷺ ne farmaya: Jab tak das baatein na ho lein, Qayamat qaim na hogi: Aaftab ka maghrib ki janib se nikalna, dhuwein ka aana, Dabbatul-Arz ka nikalna, Yajuj Majuj ka aana, Isa bin Maryam (A.S) ka nazil hona, Dajjal ka aana, teen jagah zameen ka dhans jana—sharq mein, gharb mein aur Jazeerat-ul-Arab mein—aur Aden se ek aag ka nikalna jo logon ko hanka kar ek jagah kar degi, woh shab-bashi bhi unhi ke sath karenge aur jab dopahar ko woh aaram karenge, yeh aag unke sath thehri rahegi. Yeh hadith Muslim aur Sunan mein bhi hai aur Hazrat Huzaifa bin Asid Ghifari (R.A) se mauqoofan yahi marwi hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Pas Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ki yeh mutawatir hadithein jo Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A), Hazrat Ibn Mas'ud (R.A), Hazrat Usman bin Abul-Aas (R.A), Hazrat Abu Umamah (R.A), Hazrat Nawwas bin Sam'an (R.A), Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) se marwi hain, un mein yeh mazkoor hai ke Hazrat Isa (A.S) nazil honge, sath hi un mein yeh bhi bayan hai ke kis tarah utrenge aur kahan utrenge aur kis waqt utrenge? Yani subah ki namaz ki iqamat ke waqt Sham ke shehar Damishq ke sharqi minara par Aap (A.S) utrenge. Is zamane mein yani san saat sau iktalis (741) mein Jame-e-Umawi ka minara safed patthar se bahut mazboot banaya gaya hai, is liye ke aag ke shola se yeh jal gaya hai, aag lagane wale ghaliban mal'oon Isai thay, kya ajab ke yahi woh minara ho jis par Masih bin Maryam (A.S) nazil honge aur khanzeeron ko qatl karenge, saleebon ko tod denge, jaziye ko hata denge aur siwaye Deen-e-Islam ke aur koi deen qabool na farmayenge. Jaise ke Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadithein guzar chukin, jin mein Paighambar-e-Sadiq-o-Musaddiq ﷺ ne yeh khabar di hai aur ise sabit bataya hai.

Yeh woh waqt hoga jabke tamam shak-o-shubhe hat jayenge, aur log Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki pairwi ke matahat Islam qabool kar lenge. Jaise is aayat mein hai aur jaise farman hai aayat: (Wa innahu la'ilmul-lis-sa'ah) aur ek qirat mein (la'ilmun) hai. Yani Janab-e-Masih Qayamat ka ek zabardast nishan hain, yani qurb-e-Qayamat ka, is liye ke Aap (A.S) Dajjal ke aa chukne ke baad tashreef layenge aur use qatl karenge. Jaise ke sahih hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne koi bimari aisi nahin paida ki jis ka ilaj na muhayya kiya ho. Aap (A.S) hi ke waqt mein Yajuj Majuj niklenge, jinhein Allah Ta'ala Aap (A.S) ki dua ki barkat se halak karega. Quran-e-Kareem unke nikalne ki khabar bhi deta hai, farman hai aayat: (Hatta iza futihat Yajuju wa Majuju wa hum min kulli hadabin yansilun) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 96). Yani unka nikalna bhi qurb-e-Qayamat ki daleel hai. Ab Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki sifatein mulahiza hon.

Pehle ki do ahadees mein bhi Aap (ﷺ) ki sifat guzar chuki hai, Bukhari Muslim mein hai ke Lailat-ul-Meraj mein maine Hazrat Musa (A.S) se mulaqat ki woh darmiyana qad saaf baalon wale hain, jaisi Shanua qabeelay ke log hote hain aur Hazrat Isa (A.S) se bhi mulaqat ki, woh surkh rang miyana qad hain aisa maloom hota hai goya abhi hammam se niklay hain, Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ko bhi maine dekha bas woh bilkul mujh jaise thay. Bukhari ki aur riwayat mein hai "Hazrat Isa (A.S) surkh rang, ghanghralay baalon wale, choray chaklay seenay wale thay, Hazrat Musa (A.S) gundumi rang ke jism aur seedhay baalon wale thay, jaise Zat ke log hote hain, isi tarah Aap (ﷺ) ne Dajjal ki shakal-o-surat bhi bayan farma di hai ke uski dahni aankh kaafi hogi, jaise phoola hua angoor, Aap (ﷺ) farmatay hain mujhe Kaaba ke paas khwab mein dikhlaya gaya ke ek bahut gundumi rang wale aadmi jin ke sar ke pattay dono kandhon tak thay, saaf baalon wale jin ke sar se paani ke qatray tapak rahay thay, do shakhson ke kandhon par haath rakhay tawaf kar rahay hain, maine poocha yeh kaun hain? Toh mujhe batlaya gaya ke yeh Maseeh bin Maryam (A.S) hain, maine un ke peechay hi ek shakhs ko dekha jis ki dahni aankh kaafi thi, Ibn-e-Qatan se bahut milta julta tha, sakht uljhay huay baal thay, woh bhi do shakhson ke kandhon par haath rakhay Baitullah ka tawaf kar raha hai, maine kaha yeh kaun hai? Kaha gaya yeh Maseeh Dajjal hai." Bukhari ki aur riwayat mein Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) se marwi hai ke Allah ki qasam Huzoor (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Isa (A.S) ko surkh rang nahin bataya balkay Aap (ﷺ) ne gundumi rang bataya hai, phir oopar wali poori hadees hai. Hazrat Zuhri farmatay hain Ibn-e-Qatan qabeela Khuza'a ka ek shakhs tha, jo jahiliyat mein mar chuka tha. Woh hadees bhi guzar chuki jis mein yeh bayan hai ke Janab Maseeh (A.S) apne nuzool ke baad chalees saal yahan rahenge phir faut honge aur musalman Aap (A.S) ke janazay ki namaz ada karenge. Haan Muslim ki ek hadees mein hai ke Aap (A.S) yahan saal-ha-saal rahenge, toh mumkin hai ke chalees saal ka farman us muddat samet ka ho jo Aap (A.S) ne duniya mein apne aasmanon par uthaye janay se pehlay guzari hai. Jis waqt Aap (A.S) uthaye gaye us waqt Aap (A.S) ki umar teentees saal ki thi aur saat saal ab aakhir zamanay ke toh pooray chalees saal ho gaye. Wallahu A'lam (Ibn-e-Asakir). Baaz ka qaul hai ke jab Aap (A.S) aasmanon par charhaye gaye us waqt Aap (A.S) ki umar dedh saal ki thi, yeh bilkul fazool sa qaul hai, haan Hafiz Abu-ul-Qasim (R.H) ne apni tareekh mein baaz salaf se yeh bhi likha hai ke Aan-Hazoor (ﷺ) ke hujray mein Aap (A.S) ke saath dafan kiye jayenge Wallahu A'lam. Phir irshad hai ke yeh Qayamat ke din un par gawah honge yani is baat ke ke Allah ki risalat Aap (A.S) ne unhein pahuncha di thi aur khud Aap (A.S) ne Allah ki uboodiyat ka iqrar kiya tha, jaise Surah Maidah ke aakhir mein aayat (Wa iz qala Allahu) se (Al-Hakeem) tak hai yani Aap (A.S) ki gawahi ka wahan zikr hai aur Allah ke sawal ka.

Yahudiyon ke khud sakhta halal-o-haram. Is ayat ke do matlab ho sakte hain, ek toh yeh ke haram kaam unka muqaddar tha yani Allah ki taraf se likha ja chuka tha ke yeh log apni kitab ko badal dein, is mein tahrif karlein aur halal cheezon ko apne upar haram thahra lein, sirf apne tashaddud aur apni sakht giri ki wajah se. Dusra yeh ke yeh hurmat-e-shar'i hai yani nuzool-e-Taurat se pehle jo ba'az cheezein un par halal thin, Taurat ke utarne ke waqt unki ba'az badkariyon ki wajah se woh haram qarar de di gayin, jaise farman hai ayat (KULLUT TA'AMI KANA HILLAL LI-BANI ISRA'ILA ILLA MA HARRAMA ISRA'ILU 'ALA NAFSIHI MIN QABLI AN TUNAZZALAT TAWRAH, QUL FA'TU BIT-TAWRAATI FATLUHA IN KUNTUM SADIQIN) (3. Al-Imran: 93). Yani oont ka gosht aur doodh jo Hazrat Isra'il (A.S) ne apne upar haram kar liya tha, us ke siwa tamam ta'am Bani Isra'il ke liye halal thay, phir Taurat mein un par ba'az cheezein haram ki gayin, jaise Surah An'am mein farmaya ayat (WA 'ALAL LADZINA HADU HARRAMNA MA QASASNA 'ALAIKA MIN QABLU, WAMA ZALAMNAHUM WA LAKIN KANU ANFUSAHUM YAZLIMUN) (16. An-Nahl: 118). Yahudiyon par hum ne har nakhun-dar janwar haram kar diya aur gaye bakri ki charbi bhi jo alag thalag ho, hum ne un par haram qarar de di, yeh is liye ke yeh baghi, taghi, mukhalif-e-Rasool aur ikhtilaf karne wale log thay. Pehle yahan bhi yahi bayan ho raha hai ke unke zulm-o-ziyadati ke sabab woh khud Allah ke raste se alag ho kar aur dusron ko bhi behkane ke ba'is (jo unki purani aadat thi) Rasoolon ke dushman ban jate thay. Unhein qatl kar dalte thay, unhein jhutlate thay, unka muqabla karte thay aur tarah tarah ke heele kar ke sood khori karte thay jo mahaz haram thi aur bhi jis tarah ban padta logon ke maal ghasab karne ki taak mein lage rehte aur is baat ko jante hue ke Allah ne yeh kaam haram kiye hain jurrat se unhein kar guzre thay, is wajah se un par ba'az halal cheezein bhi hum ne haram kar din, in kuffar ke liye dard-naak azab tayyar hain. In mein jo sachche deen wale aur pukhta ilm wale hain, is jumle ki tafsir Surah Al-Imran mein guzar chuki hai aur jo ba-iman hain woh toh Quran ko aur tamam pehli kitabon ko mante hain, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain is se murad Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam, Hazrat Sa'laba bin Sa'eed, Zaid bin Sa'eed, Hazrat Usaid bin Ubaid (R.A) hain, jo Islam qabool kar chuke thay aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nabuwwat ko maan chuke thay. Aage ka jumla ayat (WAL MUQIMINAS SALAH) tamam a'imma ke Quran mein aur Ubayy bin Ka'ab ke mushaf mein isi tarah hai lekin baqol Allama Ibn-e-Jarir Ibn-e-Mas'ood ke sahifa mein ayat (WAL MUQIMUNAS SALAH) hai. Sahih qira'at agli hai, jin ba'az logon ne ise kitabat ki ghalti bataya hai unka qaul ghalat hai. Ba'az toh kehte hain iski nasbi halat madh ki wajah se hai, jaise ayat (WAL MUFUNA BI-'AHDIHIM IDZA 'AHADU) (2. Al-Baqarah: 177).

Al-Baqarah: 177 mein hai aur kalam-e-Arab mein aur sher-on mein barabar yeh qaida majood paya jata hai. Ba'az kehte hain yeh atf hai agle jumle par yani ayat (Bima unzila ilaika wama unzila min qablika) 2. Al-Baqarah: 4 par yani woh is par bhi iman late hain aur namaz qaim karne par bhi unka iman hai yani use wajib-o-barhaq mante hain, ya yeh matlab hai ke is se murad farishte hain yani unka Quran par aur ilhami kitabon par aur farishton par iman hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) isi ko pasand farmate hain lekin is mein ta'ammul ki zaroorat hai wallahu a'alam, aur zakat ada karne wale hain yani maal ki ya jaan ki aur dono bhi murad ho sakte hain wallahu a'alam aur sirf Allah hi ko laiq-e-ibadat jante hain aur maut ke baad ki zindagani par bhi yaqeen-e-kamil rakhte hain ke har bhale bure amal ki jaza saza us din milegi, yahi log hain jinhein hum ajr-e-azeem yani jannat denge.
