Ba'az kehte hain yeh atf hai agle jumle par yani ayat (Bima unzila ilaika wama unzila min qablika) 2. Al-Baqarah: 4 par yani woh is par bhi iman late hain aur namaz qaim karne par bhi unka iman hai yani use wajib-o-barhaq mante hain, ya yeh matlab hai ke is se murad farishte hain yani unka Quran par aur ilhami kitabon par aur farishton par iman hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) isi ko pasand farmate hain lekin is mein ta'ammul ki zaroorat hai wallahu a'alam, aur zakat ada karne wale hain yani maal ki ya jaan ki aur dono bhi murad ho sakte hain wallahu a'alam aur sirf Allah hi ko laiq-e-ibadat jante hain aur maut ke baad ki zindagani par bhi yaqeen-e-kamil rakhte hain ke har bhale bure amal ki jaza saza us din milegi, yahi log hain jinhein hum ajr-e-azeem yani jannat denge.

Yahudiyon ke khud sakhta halal-o-haram. Is ayat ke do matlab ho sakte hain, ek toh yeh ke haram kaam unka muqaddar tha yani Allah ki taraf se likha ja chuka tha ke yeh log apni kitab ko badal dein, is mein tahrif karlein aur halal cheezon ko apne upar haram thahra lein, sirf apne tashaddud aur apni sakht giri ki wajah se. Dusra yeh ke yeh hurmat-e-shar'i hai yani nuzool-e-Taurat se pehle jo ba'az cheezein un par halal thin, Taurat ke utarne ke waqt unki ba'az badkariyon ki wajah se woh haram qarar de di gayin, jaise farman hai ayat (KULLUT TA'AMI KANA HILLAL LI-BANI ISRA'ILA ILLA MA HARRAMA ISRA'ILU 'ALA NAFSIHI MIN QABLI AN TUNAZZALAT TAWRAH, QUL FA'TU BIT-TAWRAATI FATLUHA IN KUNTUM SADIQIN) (3. Al-Imran: 93). Yani oont ka gosht aur doodh jo Hazrat Isra'il (A.S) ne apne upar haram kar liya tha, us ke siwa tamam ta'am Bani Isra'il ke liye halal thay, phir Taurat mein un par ba'az cheezein haram ki gayin, jaise Surah An'am mein farmaya ayat (WA 'ALAL LADZINA HADU HARRAMNA MA QASASNA 'ALAIKA MIN QABLU, WAMA ZALAMNAHUM WA LAKIN KANU ANFUSAHUM YAZLIMUN) (16. An-Nahl: 118). Yahudiyon par hum ne har nakhun-dar janwar haram kar diya aur gaye bakri ki charbi bhi jo alag thalag ho, hum ne un par haram qarar de di, yeh is liye ke yeh baghi, taghi, mukhalif-e-Rasool aur ikhtilaf karne wale log thay. Pehle yahan bhi yahi bayan ho raha hai ke unke zulm-o-ziyadati ke sabab woh khud Allah ke raste se alag ho kar aur dusron ko bhi behkane ke ba'is (jo unki purani aadat thi) Rasoolon ke dushman ban jate thay. Unhein qatl kar dalte thay, unhein jhutlate thay, unka muqabla karte thay aur tarah tarah ke heele kar ke sood khori karte thay jo mahaz haram thi aur bhi jis tarah ban padta logon ke maal ghasab karne ki taak mein lage rehte aur is baat ko jante hue ke Allah ne yeh kaam haram kiye hain jurrat se unhein kar guzre thay, is wajah se un par ba'az halal cheezein bhi hum ne haram kar din, in kuffar ke liye dard-naak azab tayyar hain. In mein jo sachche deen wale aur pukhta ilm wale hain, is jumle ki tafsir Surah Al-Imran mein guzar chuki hai aur jo ba-iman hain woh toh Quran ko aur tamam pehli kitabon ko mante hain, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain is se murad Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam, Hazrat Sa'laba bin Sa'eed, Zaid bin Sa'eed, Hazrat Usaid bin Ubaid (R.A) hain, jo Islam qabool kar chuke thay aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nabuwwat ko maan chuke thay. Aage ka jumla ayat (WAL MUQIMINAS SALAH) tamam a'imma ke Quran mein aur Ubayy bin Ka'ab ke mushaf mein isi tarah hai lekin baqol Allama Ibn-e-Jarir Ibn-e-Mas'ood ke sahifa mein ayat (WAL MUQIMUNAS SALAH) hai. Sahih qira'at agli hai, jin ba'az logon ne ise kitabat ki ghalti bataya hai unka qaul ghalat hai. Ba'az toh kehte hain iski nasbi halat madh ki wajah se hai, jaise ayat (WAL MUFUNA BI-'AHDIHIM IDZA 'AHADU) (2. Al-Baqarah: 177).

Al-Baqarah: 177 mein hai aur kalam-e-Arab mein aur sher-on mein barabar yeh qaida majood paya jata hai. Ba'az kehte hain yeh atf hai agle jumle par yani ayat (Bima unzila ilaika wama unzila min qablika) 2. Al-Baqarah: 4 par yani woh is par bhi iman late hain aur namaz qaim karne par bhi unka iman hai yani use wajib-o-barhaq mante hain, ya yeh matlab hai ke is se murad farishte hain yani unka Quran par aur ilhami kitabon par aur farishton par iman hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) isi ko pasand farmate hain lekin is mein ta'ammul ki zaroorat hai wallahu a'alam, aur zakat ada karne wale hain yani maal ki ya jaan ki aur dono bhi murad ho sakte hain wallahu a'alam aur sirf Allah hi ko laiq-e-ibadat jante hain aur maut ke baad ki zindagani par bhi yaqeen-e-kamil rakhte hain ke har bhale bure amal ki jaza saza us din milegi, yahi log hain jinhein hum ajr-e-azeem yani jannat denge.

Nuzool-e-Ambiya, Tadaad-e-Ambiya, Sahifa-e-aur un ke markazi mazameen. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke Skeen aur Adi bin Zaid ne kaha "Ae Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum nahin maante ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke baad Allah ne kisi insaan par kuch utara ho." Is par yeh aayatein utrin, Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi farmate hain jab aayat (يَسْــَٔــلُكَ اَهْلُ الْكِتٰبِ اَنْ تُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْهِمْ كِتٰبًا مِّنَ السَّمَاۗءِ فَقَدْ سَاَلُوْا مُوْسٰٓى اَكْبَرَ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ فَقَالُوْٓا اَرِنَا اللّٰهَ جَهْرَةً فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الصّٰعِقَةُ بِظُلْمِهِمْ ۚ ثُمَّ اتَّخَذُوا الْعِجْلَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَاۗءَتْهُمُ الْبَيِّنٰتُ فَعَفَوْنَا عَنْ ذٰلِكَ ۚ وَاٰتَيْنَا مُوْسٰى سُلْطٰنًا مُّبِيْنًا 153 وَرَفَعْنَا فَوْقَھُمُ الطُّوْرَ بِمِيْثَاقِهِمْ وَقُلْنَا لَهُمُ ادْخُلُوا الْبَابَ سُجَّدًا وَّقُلْنَا لَهُمْ لَا تَعْدُوْا فِي السَّبْتِ وَاَخَذْنَا مِنْهُمْ مِّيْثَاقًا غَلِيْظًا 154 فَبِمَا نَقْضِهِمْ مِّيْثَاقَهُمْ وَكُفْرِهِمْ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَقَتْلِهِمُ الْاَنْۢبِيَاۗءَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ وَّقَوْلِهِمْ قُلُوْبُنَا غُلْفٌ ۭ بَلْ طَبَعَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهَا بِكُفْرِهِمْ فَلَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ اِلَّا قَلِيْلًا 155 وَّبِكُفْرِهِمْ وَقَوْلِهِمْ عَلٰي مَرْيَمَ بُهْتَانًا عَظِيْمًا 156) (Surah An-Nisa: 153 se 156) tak utri aur Yahudiyon ke bure a'maal ka aaina un ke saamne rakh diya gaya to unhon ne saaf keh diya ke kisi insaan par Allah ne apna koi kalaam naazil hi nahin farmaya, na Musa (A.S) par, na Isa (A.S) par, na kisi aur Nabi par, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us waqt got lagaye baithe the, ise Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne khol diya aur farmaya kisi par bhi nahin? Pas Allah Ta'ala ne aayat (وَمَا قَدَرُوا اللّٰهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهٖٓ اِذْ قَالُوْا مَآ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰي بَشَرٍ مِّنْ شَيْءٍ) (Surah Al-An'am: 91) naazil farmayi, lekin yeh qaul ghaur talab hai is liye ke yeh aayat Surah An'am mein hai jo Makkiyah hai aur Surah Nisa ki mandarija baala aayat Madaniyah hai jo un ki tardeed mein hai, jab unhon ne kaha tha ke aasman se koi kitaab Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) utaar layein, jis ke jawab mein farmaya gaya ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) se unhon ne is se bhi bada sawaal kiya tha. Phir un ke uyub bayaan farmaye un ki pehli aur maujooda siyah kaariyan wazeh kar dein phir farmaya ke Allah ne apne bande aur Rasool Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf isi tarah wahi naazil farmayi hai jis tarah aur Ambiya (A.S) ki taraf wahi ki. Zaboor us kitaab ka naam hai jo Hazrat Dawood (A.S) par utri thi, in Ambiya (Alaihimas Salam) ke qisse Surah Qasas ki tafseer mein bayaan karenge Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Phir farmaya hai tadaad ikhtiyar aur is aayat yani Makki Surah ki aayat se pehle bahut se Ambiya ka zikr ho chuka hai aur bahut se Ambiya ka zikr nahin bhi hua.

Jin Anbiya-e-Kiram ke naam Quran ke alfaaz mein aa gaye hain woh yeh hain, Adam, Idris, Nuh, Hud, Saleh, Ibrahim, Lut, Ismail, Ishaq, Yaqub, Yusuf, Shoaib, Musa, Harun, Yunus, Daud, Sulaiman, Yusha, Zakariya, Isa, Yahya, aur ba-qaul aksar mufassireen Zul-Kifl aur Ayyub aur Ilyas, aur in sab ke sardar Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ) aur bahut se aise Rasool bhi hain jin ka zikr Quran mein nahin kiya gaya, isi wajah se Anbiya aur Mursaleen ki tadaad mein ikhtilaf hai, is baare mein mashhoor hadith Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) ki hai jo Tafsir Ibn Marduyah mein yun hai ke aap ne poocha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) Anbiya kitne hain? Farmaya teen sau tera, bahut badi jamaat. Main ne phir daryaft kiya, "Sab se pehle kaun se hain?" Farmaya "Adam" main ne kaha "Kya woh bhi Rasool thay?" Farmaya "Haan Allah ne unhein apne haath se paida kiya, phir un mein apni rooh phonki, phir durust aur theek thaak kiya" phir farmaya ae Abu Zar chaar Suryani hain, Adam, Shees, Nuh, Khuzukh jin ka mashhoor naam Idris hai, inhi ne pehle qalam se khat likha, chaar Arabi hain, Hud, Saleh, Shoaib aur tumhare Nabi (ﷺ), ae Abu Zar Bani Israel ke pehle Nabi Hazrat Musa hain aur aakhri Hazrat Isa hain. Tamam Nabiyon mein sab se pehle Nabi Hazrat Adam hain aur sab se aakhri Nabi tumhare Nabi hain." Is poori hadith ko jo bahut taweel hai, Hafiz Abu Hatim ne apni kitab Al-Anwa wal-Taqaseem mein riwayat kiya hai jis par sehat ka nishan diya hai, lekin in ke bar-khilaf Imam Abul Faraj Ibn Jauzi (R.H) ka kehna hai ke aimma-e-jarh-o-tadeel mein se bahut se logon ne in par is hadith ki wajah se kalam kiya hai wallahu a'lam, lekin yeh hadith dusri sanad se Hazrat Abu Umamah se bhi marwi hai, lekin is mein Ma'an bin Rifa'ah Salami za'eef hain aur Ali bin Yazid bhi za'eef hain aur Qasim bin Abdur Rahman bhi za'eef hain, ek aur hadith Abu Ya'la mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne aath hazaar Nabi bheje hain, chaar hazaar Bani Israel ki taraf aur chaar hazaar baqi aur logon ki taraf, yeh hadith bhi za'eef hai is mein Zaidi aur un ke ustad Raqqashi dono za'eef hain, wallahu a'lam, Abu Ya'la ki aur hadith mein hai ke aap ne farmaya aath hazaar Anbiya mere bhai guzar chuke hain un ke baad Hazrat Isa aaye aur un ke baad main aaya hoon aur hadith mein hai main aath hazaar Nabiyon ke baad aaya hoon jin mein se chaar hazaar Nabi Bani Israel mein se thay. Yeh hadith is sanad se ghareeb to zaroor hai lekin is ke tamam rawi maroof hain aur sanad mein koi kami ya ikhtilaf nahin bajuz Ahmad bin Tariq ke ke un ke baare mein mujhe koi alalat ya jarh nahin mili, wallahu a'lam. Abu Zar Ghifari wali taweel hadith jo Anbiya ki ginti ke baare mein hai, ise bhi sun lijiye, aap farmate hain main masjid mein aaya aur us waqt Huzoor (ﷺ) tanha tashreef farma thay, main bhi aap ke paas baith gaya aur kaha aap ne namaz ka hukum diya hai aap ne farmaya "Haan woh behtar cheez hai, chahe koi ziyadati kare chahe kami" main ne kaha "Huzoor (ﷺ) kaun se a'maal afzal hain?"

Farmaya "Allah par iman lana, us ki rah mein jihad karna" main ne kaha "Huzoor ﷺ kaunsa musalman aala hai?" farmaya "Jis ki zaban aur hath se musalman salamat rahein" main ne poocha "Kaunsi hijrat afzal hai?" farmaya "Buraiyon ko chhor dena" main ne poocha kaunsi namaz afzal hai? farmaya "Lambe qunoot wali" main ne kaha kaunsa roza afzal hai? farmaya "Farz kifayat karne wala hai aur Allah ke paas bahut barha charha sawab hai" main ne poocha kaunsa jihad afzal hai? "Farmaya jis ka ghora bhi kaat diya jaye aur khud us ka bhi khoon baha diya jaye." main ne kaha ghulam ko azad karne ke amal mein afzal kya hai? "Farmaya jis qadar garan qeemat ho aur malik ko zyada pasand ho." main ne poocha sadqa kaunsa afzal hai? farmaya "Kam maal wale ka koshish karna aur chupke se mohtaj ko de dena." main ne kaha Quran mein sab se bari ayat kaunsi hai? farmaya "Ayat-ul-Kursi" phir aap ne farmaya "Ae Abu-Zar saton aasman kursi ke muqable mein aise hain jaise koi halqa kisi chatyal maidan ke muqable mein aur Arsh ki fazilat kursi par, bhi aisi hai jaise wasee maidan ki halqe par" main ne arz kiya Huzoor ﷺ ambiya kitne hain? farmaya "Ek lakh chaubees hazar" main ne kaha un mein se rasool kitne hain? farmaya "Teen sau tera ki bahut bari pak jamaat" main ne poocha sab se pehle kaun hain? farmaya "Adam" main ne kaha kya woh bhi nabi rasool thay? farmaya "Haan unhein Allah ne apne hath se paida kiya aur apni rooh un mein phonki aur unhein sahih-tar banaya." phir aap ne farmaya suno char to suryani hain, Adam, Shees, Khanook aur yahi Idris hain, jinhon ne sab se pehle qalam se likha aur Nooh aur char arabi hain Hood, Shoaib, Saleh aur tumhare Nabi, sab se pehle rasool Hazrat Adam hain aur sab se aakhri rasool Hazrat Muhammad hain ﷺ main ne poocha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Allah Ta'ala ne kitabein kis qadar nazil farmayi hain? farmaya ek sau char, Hazrat Shees A.S par pachaas sahifay, Hazrat Khanook A.S par tees sahifay, Hazrat Ibrahim A.S par das sahifay aur Hazrat Moosa A.S par Taurat se pehle das sahifay aur Taurat, Injeel, Zaboor aur Furqan, main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah Hazrat Ibrahim ke sahifon mein kya tha? farmaya is ki markazi taleem jabr se musallat badshah ko us ke iqtidar ka maqsad samjhana tha aur use mazloom ki faryad-rasi karne ka ehsas dilana tha. Jis ki dua ko Allah Ta'ala lazman qabool farmate hain. Chahe woh kafir hi kyun na ho! Duniya ka maal jama karne se rokna tha aur un mein nasaih thin maslan yeh ke aql-mand ke liye zaroori hai ke woh apna nizam-ul-auqat banaye waqt ke ek hissay mein woh apne aamal ka muhasiba kare, dusre hissay mein apne khaliq ki sifat pe gaur-o-fikr kare, baqiya hissay mein tadbeer-e-ma'ash mein mashgool ho.

Aql-mand ko teen cheezon ke siwa kisi aur cheez mein dilchaspi na lena chahiye, ek toh Aakhirat ke zaad-e-rah ki fikr, dusre saman-e-zeest aur teesre Allah Ta'ala ki halal karda nematon se lutf-andoz hona ya fikr-e-ma'ash ya ghair-haram cheezon se suroor-o-lazzat, aql-mand ko apne waqt ko ghaneemat samajh kar sargarm-e-amal rehna chahiye, apni zaban par qabu aur qaul-o-fel mein yaksaniyat barqarar rakhna chahiye, woh bahut kam-go hoga, baat wahi kaho jo tumhein nafa de, main ne poocha Musa (A.S) ke saheefon mein kya tha? Farmaya woh ibrat dilane wali tehreeron ka majmua thay, mujhe ta'ajjub hai us shakhs par jo maut ka yaqeen rakhta hai phir bhi ghafil hai, taqdeer ka yaqeen rakhta hai phir bhi maal-o-daulat ke liye pagal ho raha hai, haye-waye mein pada hua hai, duniya ki be-sabati dekh kar bhi isi ko sab kuch samajhta rahe, Qayamat ke din hisab ko jaanta hai phir be-amal hai, main ne arz kiya Huzoor (ﷺ) agle ambiya ki kitabon mein jo tha us mein se bhi kuch hamari kitab mein hamare hathon mein hai? Aap ne farmaya haan padho aayat (Qad aflaha man tazakka) (Surah Al-A'la: 14) aakhir surat tak, main ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) mujhe wasiyat kijiye. Aap ne farmaya main tujhe Allah se darte rehne ki wasiyat karta hoon, yahi tere a'maal ki rooh hai, main ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) mujhe wasiyat kijiye. Aap ne farmaya main tujhe Allah se darte rehne ki wasiyat karta hoon, yahi tere a'maal ki rooh hai, main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) kuch aur bhi, Aap ne farmaya Quran ki tilawat aur Allah ke zikr mein mashghool reh woh tere liye aasmanon mein zikr aur zameen mein noor ke husool ka sabab hoga, main ne phir kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) kuch mazeed farmayiye, farmaya khabardar zyada hansi se baaz raho zyada hansi dil ko murda aur chehra ka noor door kar deti hai, main ne phir kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) kuch mazeed farmayiye, farmaya khabardar zyada hansi se baaz raho zyada hansi dil ko murda aur chehra ka noor door kar deti hai, main ne kaha aur zyada farmaya jihad mein mashghool raho, meri ummat ki rahbaniyat yani darweshi yahi hai, main ne kaha aur wasiyat kijiye farmaya bhali baat kehne ke siwa zaban band rakhho, is se shaitan bhaag jayega aur deeni kaamon mein badi ta'eed hogi. Main ne kaha kuch aur bhi farma dijiye farmaya apne se neeche darje ke logon ko dekha kar aur apne se a'ala darje ke logon par nazrein na daalo, is se tumhare dil mein Allah ki nematon ki azmat paida hogi, main ne kaha mujhe aur zyada nasihat kijiye farmaya maskeenon se mohabbat rakhho aur un ke saath baitho, is se Allah ki rahmatein tumhein garan-qadr maloom hongi, main ne kaha aur farmayiye farmaya "Qarabat-daron se milte raho, chahe woh tujh se na milein" main ne kaha aur?

Farmaya sach baat kaho chahe woh kisi ko karwi lage, main ne aur bhi nasihat talab ki farmaya Allah ke bare mein malamat karne wale ki malamat ka khauf na kar, main ne kaha aur farmayiye farmaya apne aibon par nazar rakha kar, dusron ki aib joi se baaz raho, phir mere seene par aap ne apna dast-e-mubarak rakh kar farmaya ae Abu Zar tadbeer ke manind koi aql mandi nahin aur haram se ruk jaane se barh kar koi parhezgari nahin aur achhe akhlaq se behtar koi hasb-o-nasab nahin. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi yeh hadith kuch isi mafhoom ki hai. Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri puchte hain kya khariji bhi Dajjal ke qail hain, logon ne kaha nahin farmaya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya hai main ek hazar balkay zyada nabiyon ka khatam karne wala hoon aur har nabi ne apni ummat ko Dajjal se daraya hai lekin mujh se Allah ne us ki woh alamat bayan farmayi hai jo kisi aur ko nahin farmayi "Suno woh bhenga hoga aur Rabb aisa ho nahin sakta us ki dahni aankh kafi bhengi hogi, aankh ka dheela itna utha hua jaise chune ki saaf deewar par kisi ka khankar para ho aur us ki baayin aankh ek jagmagate sitare jaisi hai, woh tamam zabanen bole ga, us ke sath sarsabz-o-shadab jannat siyah dhuan dhaar dozakh nazar aaye ga". Ek hadith mein hai ek lakh nabiyon ko khatam karne wala hoon balkay zyada ka. Phir farmaya hai Musa se khud Allah ne saaf taur par kalam kiya. Yeh un ki khas sifat hai ke woh Kaleemullah thay, ek shakhs Hazrat Abu Bakr bin Ayyash (R.H) ke paas aata hai aur kehta hai ke ek shakhs is jumla ko yun parhta hai aayat (وَكَلَّمَ اللّٰهُ مُوْسٰى تَكْلِــيْمًا) (Surah An-Nisa: 164) yani Musa ne Allah se baat ki hai, is par aap bohat bigre aur farmaya yeh kisi kafir ne parha hoga. Main ne Aamash se, Aamash ne Yahya ne Abdur Rahman se, Abdur Rahman se Ali se, Ali ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se parha hai ke aayat (وَكَلَّمَ اللّٰهُ مُوْسٰى تَكْلِــيْمًا) (Surah An-Nisa: 164). Garz us shakhs ki manwi aur lafzi tehreef par aap bohat zyada naraz hue magar ajab nahin ke yeh koi Mu'tazili ho, is liye ke Mu'tazila ka yeh aqeeda hai ke Allah ne Musa se kalam kiya na kisi aur se. Kisi Mu'tazili ne ek buzurg ke samne isi aayat ko isi tarah parha to unhon ne use daant kar farmaya phir is aayat mein yeh baddiyanati kaise karo ge? Jahan farmaya hai aayat (وَلَمَّا جَاۗءَ مُوْسٰي لِمِيْقَاتِنَا وَكَلَّمَهٗ رَبُّهٗ) (Surah Al-A'raf: 143) yani Musa hamare wade par aaya aur un se un ke Rabb ne kalam kiya, matlab yeh hai ke yahan to yeh taweel-o-tehreef nahin chale gi. Ibn Marduyah ki hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya "Jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Musa se kalam kiya to woh andheri raat mein siyah chunti ka kisi saaf patthar par chalna bhi dekh lete thay." Yeh hadith ghareeb hai aur is ki asnaad sahih nahin aur jab mauqoofan ba-qaul-e-Abi Huraira sabit ho jaye to bohat theek hai. Mustadrak Hakim waghera mein hai.

Ke Kalimullah se jab Allah ne kalam kiya woh soofi ki chadar aur soof ki sardol aur ghair mazbooh gadhe ki khaal ki jootiyan pehne hue thay, Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne ek lakh chalis hazar baatein Hazrat Musa A.S se keen jo sab ki sab wasiyatein thin, natija yeh ke logon ki baatein Hazrat Musa A.S se suni nahin jaati thin kyunke kanon mein Kalam-e-Ilahi ki goonj rehti thi, is ki asnaad bhi zaeef hain. Phir is mein inqita bhi hai. Ek asar Ibn Marduyah mein hai Hazrat Jabir R.A farmate hain jo kalam Allah Ta'ala ne Toor wale din Hazrat Musa A.S se kiya tha yeh toh mere andaze ke mutabiq is ki sifat jis din pukara tha us andaz-e-kalam ki sifat se alag thi. Musa A.S ne is ka raaz maloom karna chaha Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya Musa abhi toh main ne das hazar zabanon ki quwwat se kalam kiya hai halankeh mujhe tamam zabanon ki quwwat hasil hai balkeh un sab se bhi bahut zyada. Bani Israel ne aap se jab kalam-e-zabani ki sifat poochhi aap ne farmaya "Main toh kuch nahin keh sakta" unhon ne kaha kuch tashbeeh toh bayan karo, aap ne farmaya tum ne karake ki aawaz suni hogi, woh is ke mushaba thi lekin waisi na thi, is ke ek rawi Fazl Raqashi zaeef hain aur bahut hi zaeef hain. Hazrat Ka'ab R.H farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne jab Hazrat Musa A.S se kalam kiya toh yeh tamam zabanon pe muheet tha. Hazrat Kalimullah A.S ne poochha "Bari Ta'ala yeh tera kalam hai?" farmaya nahin aur na toh mere kalam ki istiqamat kar sakta hai. Hazrat Musa A.S ne daryaft kiya ke aye Rab teri makhlooq mein se kisi ka kalam tere kalam se mushaba hai? Farmaya nahin siwaye sakht tar karake ke, yeh riwayat bhi mauqoof hai aur yeh zahir hai ke Hazrat Ka'ab R.H agli kitabon se riwayat kiya karte thay jin mein Bani Israel ki hikayatein har tarah sahih aur ghair sahih hoti hain. Yeh Rasool hi hain jo Allah ki ita'at karne walon aur us ki razamandi ke mutalashiyon ko jannaton ki khushkhabariyan dete hain aur us ke aur us ke Rasoolon ko jhutlane walon ko azab aur saza se darate hain. Phir farmata hai Allah Ta'ala ne jo apni kitabein nazil farmayi hain aur apne Rasool bheje hain aur un ke zariye apne awamr-o-nawahi ki taleem dilwayi yeh is liye ke kisi ko koi hujjat ya koi uzr baqi na reh jaye. Jaise aur aayat mein hai aayat (Walao anna ahlaknahum bi-azabim min qablihi laqalu rabbana lawla arsalta ilaina rasulan fanattabi'a ayati-ka min qabli an nazilla wanakhza) (20. Taha: 134) yani agar hum unhein is se pehle hi apne azab se halak kar dete toh woh yeh keh sakte thay ke aye hamare Rab tu ne hamari taraf Rasool kyun nahin bheje jo hum un ki baatein maante aur is zillat-o-ruswayi se bach jaate, isi jaisi yeh aayat bhi hai aayat (Walaola an tuseebahum museebatum bima qaddamat aydihim fayaqulu rabbana lawla arsalta ilaina rasulan fanattabi'a ayati-ka wa nakuna minal mu'mineen) (28. Al-Qasas: 47).

(Al-Qasas: 47) Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah se zyada ghairat-mand koi nahin, isi liye Allah Ta'ala ne tamam buraiyon ko haram kiya hai khwah zahir hon khwah posheeda aur aisa bhi koi nahin jise ba-nisbat Allah ke madh zyada pasand ho, yahi wajah hai ke us ne khud apni madh aap ki hai aur koi aisa nahin jise Allah se zyada dar pasand ho, isi wajah se Allah Ta'ala ne nabiyon ko khush-khabrian sunane wale aur darane wale bana kar bheja. Dusri riwayat mein yeh alfaz hain ke isi wajah se us ne Rasool bheje aur kitabein utarein.

Nuzool-e-Ambiya, Tadaad-e-Ambiya, Sahifa-e-aur un ke markazi mazameen. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke Skeen aur Adi bin Zaid ne kaha "Ae Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum nahin maante ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke baad Allah ne kisi insaan par kuch utara ho." Is par yeh aayatein utrin, Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi farmate hain jab aayat (يَسْــَٔــلُكَ اَهْلُ الْكِتٰبِ اَنْ تُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْهِمْ كِتٰبًا مِّنَ السَّمَاۗءِ فَقَدْ سَاَلُوْا مُوْسٰٓى اَكْبَرَ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ فَقَالُوْٓا اَرِنَا اللّٰهَ جَهْرَةً فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الصّٰعِقَةُ بِظُلْمِهِمْ ۚ ثُمَّ اتَّخَذُوا الْعِجْلَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَاۗءَتْهُمُ الْبَيِّنٰتُ فَعَفَوْنَا عَنْ ذٰلِكَ ۚ وَاٰتَيْنَا مُوْسٰى سُلْطٰنًا مُّبِيْنًا 153 وَرَفَعْنَا فَوْقَھُمُ الطُّوْرَ بِمِيْثَاقِهِمْ وَقُلْنَا لَهُمُ ادْخُلُوا الْبَابَ سُجَّدًا وَّقُلْنَا لَهُمْ لَا تَعْدُوْا فِي السَّبْتِ وَاَخَذْنَا مِنْهُمْ مِّيْثَاقًا غَلِيْظًا 154 فَبِمَا نَقْضِهِمْ مِّيْثَاقَهُمْ وَكُفْرِهِمْ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَقَتْلِهِمُ الْاَنْۢبِيَاۗءَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ وَّقَوْلِهِمْ قُلُوْبُنَا غُلْفٌ ۭ بَلْ طَبَعَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهَا بِكُفْرِهِمْ فَلَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ اِلَّا قَلِيْلًا 155 وَّبِكُفْرِهِمْ وَقَوْلِهِمْ عَلٰي مَرْيَمَ بُهْتَانًا عَظِيْمًا 156) (Surah An-Nisa: 153 se 156) tak utri aur Yahudiyon ke bure a'maal ka aaina un ke saamne rakh diya gaya to unhon ne saaf keh diya ke kisi insaan par Allah ne apna koi kalaam naazil hi nahin farmaya, na Musa (A.S) par, na Isa (A.S) par, na kisi aur Nabi par, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us waqt got lagaye baithe the, ise Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne khol diya aur farmaya kisi par bhi nahin? Pas Allah Ta'ala ne aayat (وَمَا قَدَرُوا اللّٰهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهٖٓ اِذْ قَالُوْا مَآ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰي بَشَرٍ مِّنْ شَيْءٍ) (Surah Al-An'am: 91) naazil farmayi, lekin yeh qaul ghaur talab hai is liye ke yeh aayat Surah An'am mein hai jo Makkiyah hai aur Surah Nisa ki mandarija baala aayat Madaniyah hai jo un ki tardeed mein hai, jab unhon ne kaha tha ke aasman se koi kitaab Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) utaar layein, jis ke jawab mein farmaya gaya ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) se unhon ne is se bhi bada sawaal kiya tha. Phir un ke uyub bayaan farmaye un ki pehli aur maujooda siyah kaariyan wazeh kar dein phir farmaya ke Allah ne apne bande aur Rasool Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf isi tarah wahi naazil farmayi hai jis tarah aur Ambiya (A.S) ki taraf wahi ki. Zaboor us kitaab ka naam hai jo Hazrat Dawood (A.S) par utri thi, in Ambiya (Alaihimas Salam) ke qisse Surah Qasas ki tafseer mein bayaan karenge Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Phir farmaya hai tadaad ikhtiyar aur is aayat yani Makki Surah ki aayat se pehle bahut se Ambiya ka zikr ho chuka hai aur bahut se Ambiya ka zikr nahin bhi hua.

Jin Anbiya-e-Kiram ke naam Quran ke alfaaz mein aa gaye hain woh yeh hain, Adam, Idris, Nuh, Hud, Saleh, Ibrahim, Lut, Ismail, Ishaq, Yaqub, Yusuf, Shoaib, Musa, Harun, Yunus, Daud, Sulaiman, Yusha, Zakariya, Isa, Yahya, aur ba-qaul aksar mufassireen Zul-Kifl aur Ayyub aur Ilyas, aur in sab ke sardar Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ) aur bahut se aise Rasool bhi hain jin ka zikr Quran mein nahin kiya gaya, isi wajah se Anbiya aur Mursaleen ki tadaad mein ikhtilaf hai, is baare mein mashhoor hadith Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) ki hai jo Tafsir Ibn Marduyah mein yun hai ke aap ne poocha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) Anbiya kitne hain? Farmaya teen sau tera, bahut badi jamaat. Main ne phir daryaft kiya, "Sab se pehle kaun se hain?" Farmaya "Adam" main ne kaha "Kya woh bhi Rasool thay?" Farmaya "Haan Allah ne unhein apne haath se paida kiya, phir un mein apni rooh phonki, phir durust aur theek thaak kiya" phir farmaya ae Abu Zar chaar Suryani hain, Adam, Shees, Nuh, Khuzukh jin ka mashhoor naam Idris hai, inhi ne pehle qalam se khat likha, chaar Arabi hain, Hud, Saleh, Shoaib aur tumhare Nabi (ﷺ), ae Abu Zar Bani Israel ke pehle Nabi Hazrat Musa hain aur aakhri Hazrat Isa hain. Tamam Nabiyon mein sab se pehle Nabi Hazrat Adam hain aur sab se aakhri Nabi tumhare Nabi hain." Is poori hadith ko jo bahut taweel hai, Hafiz Abu Hatim ne apni kitab Al-Anwa wal-Taqaseem mein riwayat kiya hai jis par sehat ka nishan diya hai, lekin in ke bar-khilaf Imam Abul Faraj Ibn Jauzi (R.H) ka kehna hai ke aimma-e-jarh-o-tadeel mein se bahut se logon ne in par is hadith ki wajah se kalam kiya hai wallahu a'lam, lekin yeh hadith dusri sanad se Hazrat Abu Umamah se bhi marwi hai, lekin is mein Ma'an bin Rifa'ah Salami za'eef hain aur Ali bin Yazid bhi za'eef hain aur Qasim bin Abdur Rahman bhi za'eef hain, ek aur hadith Abu Ya'la mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne aath hazaar Nabi bheje hain, chaar hazaar Bani Israel ki taraf aur chaar hazaar baqi aur logon ki taraf, yeh hadith bhi za'eef hai is mein Zaidi aur un ke ustad Raqqashi dono za'eef hain, wallahu a'lam, Abu Ya'la ki aur hadith mein hai ke aap ne farmaya aath hazaar Anbiya mere bhai guzar chuke hain un ke baad Hazrat Isa aaye aur un ke baad main aaya hoon aur hadith mein hai main aath hazaar Nabiyon ke baad aaya hoon jin mein se chaar hazaar Nabi Bani Israel mein se thay. Yeh hadith is sanad se ghareeb to zaroor hai lekin is ke tamam rawi maroof hain aur sanad mein koi kami ya ikhtilaf nahin bajuz Ahmad bin Tariq ke ke un ke baare mein mujhe koi alalat ya jarh nahin mili, wallahu a'lam. Abu Zar Ghifari wali taweel hadith jo Anbiya ki ginti ke baare mein hai, ise bhi sun lijiye, aap farmate hain main masjid mein aaya aur us waqt Huzoor (ﷺ) tanha tashreef farma thay, main bhi aap ke paas baith gaya aur kaha aap ne namaz ka hukum diya hai aap ne farmaya "Haan woh behtar cheez hai, chahe koi ziyadati kare chahe kami" main ne kaha "Huzoor (ﷺ) kaun se a'maal afzal hain?"

Farmaya "Allah par iman lana, us ki rah mein jihad karna" main ne kaha "Huzoor ﷺ kaunsa musalman aala hai?" farmaya "Jis ki zaban aur hath se musalman salamat rahein" main ne poocha "Kaunsi hijrat afzal hai?" farmaya "Buraiyon ko chhor dena" main ne poocha kaunsi namaz afzal hai? farmaya "Lambe qunoot wali" main ne kaha kaunsa roza afzal hai? farmaya "Farz kifayat karne wala hai aur Allah ke paas bahut barha charha sawab hai" main ne poocha kaunsa jihad afzal hai? "Farmaya jis ka ghora bhi kaat diya jaye aur khud us ka bhi khoon baha diya jaye." main ne kaha ghulam ko azad karne ke amal mein afzal kya hai? "Farmaya jis qadar garan qeemat ho aur malik ko zyada pasand ho." main ne poocha sadqa kaunsa afzal hai? farmaya "Kam maal wale ka koshish karna aur chupke se mohtaj ko de dena." main ne kaha Quran mein sab se bari ayat kaunsi hai? farmaya "Ayat-ul-Kursi" phir aap ne farmaya "Ae Abu-Zar saton aasman kursi ke muqable mein aise hain jaise koi halqa kisi chatyal maidan ke muqable mein aur Arsh ki fazilat kursi par, bhi aisi hai jaise wasee maidan ki halqe par" main ne arz kiya Huzoor ﷺ ambiya kitne hain? farmaya "Ek lakh chaubees hazar" main ne kaha un mein se rasool kitne hain? farmaya "Teen sau tera ki bahut bari pak jamaat" main ne poocha sab se pehle kaun hain? farmaya "Adam" main ne kaha kya woh bhi nabi rasool thay? farmaya "Haan unhein Allah ne apne hath se paida kiya aur apni rooh un mein phonki aur unhein sahih-tar banaya." phir aap ne farmaya suno char to suryani hain, Adam, Shees, Khanook aur yahi Idris hain, jinhon ne sab se pehle qalam se likha aur Nooh aur char arabi hain Hood, Shoaib, Saleh aur tumhare Nabi, sab se pehle rasool Hazrat Adam hain aur sab se aakhri rasool Hazrat Muhammad hain ﷺ main ne poocha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Allah Ta'ala ne kitabein kis qadar nazil farmayi hain? farmaya ek sau char, Hazrat Shees A.S par pachaas sahifay, Hazrat Khanook A.S par tees sahifay, Hazrat Ibrahim A.S par das sahifay aur Hazrat Moosa A.S par Taurat se pehle das sahifay aur Taurat, Injeel, Zaboor aur Furqan, main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah Hazrat Ibrahim ke sahifon mein kya tha? farmaya is ki markazi taleem jabr se musallat badshah ko us ke iqtidar ka maqsad samjhana tha aur use mazloom ki faryad-rasi karne ka ehsas dilana tha. Jis ki dua ko Allah Ta'ala lazman qabool farmate hain. Chahe woh kafir hi kyun na ho! Duniya ka maal jama karne se rokna tha aur un mein nasaih thin maslan yeh ke aql-mand ke liye zaroori hai ke woh apna nizam-ul-auqat banaye waqt ke ek hissay mein woh apne aamal ka muhasiba kare, dusre hissay mein apne khaliq ki sifat pe gaur-o-fikr kare, baqiya hissay mein tadbeer-e-ma'ash mein mashgool ho.

Aql-mand ko teen cheezon ke siwa kisi aur cheez mein dilchaspi na lena chahiye, ek toh Aakhirat ke zaad-e-rah ki fikr, dusre saman-e-zeest aur teesre Allah Ta'ala ki halal karda nematon se lutf-andoz hona ya fikr-e-ma'ash ya ghair-haram cheezon se suroor-o-lazzat, aql-mand ko apne waqt ko ghaneemat samajh kar sargarm-e-amal rehna chahiye, apni zaban par qabu aur qaul-o-fel mein yaksaniyat barqarar rakhna chahiye, woh bahut kam-go hoga, baat wahi kaho jo tumhein nafa de, main ne poocha Musa (A.S) ke saheefon mein kya tha? Farmaya woh ibrat dilane wali tehreeron ka majmua thay, mujhe ta'ajjub hai us shakhs par jo maut ka yaqeen rakhta hai phir bhi ghafil hai, taqdeer ka yaqeen rakhta hai phir bhi maal-o-daulat ke liye pagal ho raha hai, haye-waye mein pada hua hai, duniya ki be-sabati dekh kar bhi isi ko sab kuch samajhta rahe, Qayamat ke din hisab ko jaanta hai phir be-amal hai, main ne arz kiya Huzoor (ﷺ) agle ambiya ki kitabon mein jo tha us mein se bhi kuch hamari kitab mein hamare hathon mein hai? Aap ne farmaya haan padho aayat (Qad aflaha man tazakka) (Surah Al-A'la: 14) aakhir surat tak, main ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) mujhe wasiyat kijiye. Aap ne farmaya main tujhe Allah se darte rehne ki wasiyat karta hoon, yahi tere a'maal ki rooh hai, main ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) mujhe wasiyat kijiye. Aap ne farmaya main tujhe Allah se darte rehne ki wasiyat karta hoon, yahi tere a'maal ki rooh hai, main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) kuch aur bhi, Aap ne farmaya Quran ki tilawat aur Allah ke zikr mein mashghool reh woh tere liye aasmanon mein zikr aur zameen mein noor ke husool ka sabab hoga, main ne phir kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) kuch mazeed farmayiye, farmaya khabardar zyada hansi se baaz raho zyada hansi dil ko murda aur chehra ka noor door kar deti hai, main ne phir kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) kuch mazeed farmayiye, farmaya khabardar zyada hansi se baaz raho zyada hansi dil ko murda aur chehra ka noor door kar deti hai, main ne kaha aur zyada farmaya jihad mein mashghool raho, meri ummat ki rahbaniyat yani darweshi yahi hai, main ne kaha aur wasiyat kijiye farmaya bhali baat kehne ke siwa zaban band rakhho, is se shaitan bhaag jayega aur deeni kaamon mein badi ta'eed hogi. Main ne kaha kuch aur bhi farma dijiye farmaya apne se neeche darje ke logon ko dekha kar aur apne se a'ala darje ke logon par nazrein na daalo, is se tumhare dil mein Allah ki nematon ki azmat paida hogi, main ne kaha mujhe aur zyada nasihat kijiye farmaya maskeenon se mohabbat rakhho aur un ke saath baitho, is se Allah ki rahmatein tumhein garan-qadr maloom hongi, main ne kaha aur farmayiye farmaya "Qarabat-daron se milte raho, chahe woh tujh se na milein" main ne kaha aur?

Farmaya sach baat kaho chahe woh kisi ko karwi lage, main ne aur bhi nasihat talab ki farmaya Allah ke bare mein malamat karne wale ki malamat ka khauf na kar, main ne kaha aur farmayiye farmaya apne aibon par nazar rakha kar, dusron ki aib joi se baaz raho, phir mere seene par aap ne apna dast-e-mubarak rakh kar farmaya ae Abu Zar tadbeer ke manind koi aql mandi nahin aur haram se ruk jaane se barh kar koi parhezgari nahin aur achhe akhlaq se behtar koi hasb-o-nasab nahin. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi yeh hadith kuch isi mafhoom ki hai. Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri puchte hain kya khariji bhi Dajjal ke qail hain, logon ne kaha nahin farmaya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya hai main ek hazar balkay zyada nabiyon ka khatam karne wala hoon aur har nabi ne apni ummat ko Dajjal se daraya hai lekin mujh se Allah ne us ki woh alamat bayan farmayi hai jo kisi aur ko nahin farmayi "Suno woh bhenga hoga aur Rabb aisa ho nahin sakta us ki dahni aankh kafi bhengi hogi, aankh ka dheela itna utha hua jaise chune ki saaf deewar par kisi ka khankar para ho aur us ki baayin aankh ek jagmagate sitare jaisi hai, woh tamam zabanen bole ga, us ke sath sarsabz-o-shadab jannat siyah dhuan dhaar dozakh nazar aaye ga". Ek hadith mein hai ek lakh nabiyon ko khatam karne wala hoon balkay zyada ka. Phir farmaya hai Musa se khud Allah ne saaf taur par kalam kiya. Yeh un ki khas sifat hai ke woh Kaleemullah thay, ek shakhs Hazrat Abu Bakr bin Ayyash (R.H) ke paas aata hai aur kehta hai ke ek shakhs is jumla ko yun parhta hai aayat (وَكَلَّمَ اللّٰهُ مُوْسٰى تَكْلِــيْمًا) (Surah An-Nisa: 164) yani Musa ne Allah se baat ki hai, is par aap bohat bigre aur farmaya yeh kisi kafir ne parha hoga. Main ne Aamash se, Aamash ne Yahya ne Abdur Rahman se, Abdur Rahman se Ali se, Ali ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se parha hai ke aayat (وَكَلَّمَ اللّٰهُ مُوْسٰى تَكْلِــيْمًا) (Surah An-Nisa: 164). Garz us shakhs ki manwi aur lafzi tehreef par aap bohat zyada naraz hue magar ajab nahin ke yeh koi Mu'tazili ho, is liye ke Mu'tazila ka yeh aqeeda hai ke Allah ne Musa se kalam kiya na kisi aur se. Kisi Mu'tazili ne ek buzurg ke samne isi aayat ko isi tarah parha to unhon ne use daant kar farmaya phir is aayat mein yeh baddiyanati kaise karo ge? Jahan farmaya hai aayat (وَلَمَّا جَاۗءَ مُوْسٰي لِمِيْقَاتِنَا وَكَلَّمَهٗ رَبُّهٗ) (Surah Al-A'raf: 143) yani Musa hamare wade par aaya aur un se un ke Rabb ne kalam kiya, matlab yeh hai ke yahan to yeh taweel-o-tehreef nahin chale gi. Ibn Marduyah ki hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya "Jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Musa se kalam kiya to woh andheri raat mein siyah chunti ka kisi saaf patthar par chalna bhi dekh lete thay." Yeh hadith ghareeb hai aur is ki asnaad sahih nahin aur jab mauqoofan ba-qaul-e-Abi Huraira sabit ho jaye to bohat theek hai. Mustadrak Hakim waghera mein hai.

Ke Kalimullah se jab Allah ne kalam kiya woh soofi ki chadar aur soof ki sardol aur ghair mazbooh gadhe ki khaal ki jootiyan pehne hue thay, Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne ek lakh chalis hazar baatein Hazrat Musa A.S se keen jo sab ki sab wasiyatein thin, natija yeh ke logon ki baatein Hazrat Musa A.S se suni nahin jaati thin kyunke kanon mein Kalam-e-Ilahi ki goonj rehti thi, is ki asnaad bhi zaeef hain. Phir is mein inqita bhi hai. Ek asar Ibn Marduyah mein hai Hazrat Jabir R.A farmate hain jo kalam Allah Ta'ala ne Toor wale din Hazrat Musa A.S se kiya tha yeh toh mere andaze ke mutabiq is ki sifat jis din pukara tha us andaz-e-kalam ki sifat se alag thi. Musa A.S ne is ka raaz maloom karna chaha Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya Musa abhi toh main ne das hazar zabanon ki quwwat se kalam kiya hai halankeh mujhe tamam zabanon ki quwwat hasil hai balkeh un sab se bhi bahut zyada. Bani Israel ne aap se jab kalam-e-zabani ki sifat poochhi aap ne farmaya "Main toh kuch nahin keh sakta" unhon ne kaha kuch tashbeeh toh bayan karo, aap ne farmaya tum ne karake ki aawaz suni hogi, woh is ke mushaba thi lekin waisi na thi, is ke ek rawi Fazl Raqashi zaeef hain aur bahut hi zaeef hain. Hazrat Ka'ab R.H farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne jab Hazrat Musa A.S se kalam kiya toh yeh tamam zabanon pe muheet tha. Hazrat Kalimullah A.S ne poochha "Bari Ta'ala yeh tera kalam hai?" farmaya nahin aur na toh mere kalam ki istiqamat kar sakta hai. Hazrat Musa A.S ne daryaft kiya ke aye Rab teri makhlooq mein se kisi ka kalam tere kalam se mushaba hai? Farmaya nahin siwaye sakht tar karake ke, yeh riwayat bhi mauqoof hai aur yeh zahir hai ke Hazrat Ka'ab R.H agli kitabon se riwayat kiya karte thay jin mein Bani Israel ki hikayatein har tarah sahih aur ghair sahih hoti hain. Yeh Rasool hi hain jo Allah ki ita'at karne walon aur us ki razamandi ke mutalashiyon ko jannaton ki khushkhabariyan dete hain aur us ke aur us ke Rasoolon ko jhutlane walon ko azab aur saza se darate hain. Phir farmata hai Allah Ta'ala ne jo apni kitabein nazil farmayi hain aur apne Rasool bheje hain aur un ke zariye apne awamr-o-nawahi ki taleem dilwayi yeh is liye ke kisi ko koi hujjat ya koi uzr baqi na reh jaye. Jaise aur aayat mein hai aayat (Walao anna ahlaknahum bi-azabim min qablihi laqalu rabbana lawla arsalta ilaina rasulan fanattabi'a ayati-ka min qabli an nazilla wanakhza) (20. Taha: 134) yani agar hum unhein is se pehle hi apne azab se halak kar dete toh woh yeh keh sakte thay ke aye hamare Rab tu ne hamari taraf Rasool kyun nahin bheje jo hum un ki baatein maante aur is zillat-o-ruswayi se bach jaate, isi jaisi yeh aayat bhi hai aayat (Walaola an tuseebahum museebatum bima qaddamat aydihim fayaqulu rabbana lawla arsalta ilaina rasulan fanattabi'a ayati-ka wa nakuna minal mu'mineen) (28. Al-Qasas: 47).

(Al-Qasas: 47) Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah se zyada ghairat-mand koi nahin, isi liye Allah Ta'ala ne tamam buraiyon ko haram kiya hai khwah zahir hon khwah posheeda aur aisa bhi koi nahin jise ba-nisbat Allah ke madh zyada pasand ho, yahi wajah hai ke us ne khud apni madh aap ki hai aur koi aisa nahin jise Allah se zyada dar pasand ho, isi wajah se Allah Ta'ala ne nabiyon ko khush-khabrian sunane wale aur darane wale bana kar bheja. Dusri riwayat mein yeh alfaz hain ke isi wajah se us ne Rasool bheje aur kitabein utarein.

Nuzool-e-Ambiya, Tadaad-e-Ambiya, Sahifa-e-aur un ke markazi mazameen. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke Skeen aur Adi bin Zaid ne kaha "Ae Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum nahin maante ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke baad Allah ne kisi insaan par kuch utara ho." Is par yeh aayatein utrin, Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi farmate hain jab aayat (يَسْــَٔــلُكَ اَهْلُ الْكِتٰبِ اَنْ تُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْهِمْ كِتٰبًا مِّنَ السَّمَاۗءِ فَقَدْ سَاَلُوْا مُوْسٰٓى اَكْبَرَ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ فَقَالُوْٓا اَرِنَا اللّٰهَ جَهْرَةً فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الصّٰعِقَةُ بِظُلْمِهِمْ ۚ ثُمَّ اتَّخَذُوا الْعِجْلَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَاۗءَتْهُمُ الْبَيِّنٰتُ فَعَفَوْنَا عَنْ ذٰلِكَ ۚ وَاٰتَيْنَا مُوْسٰى سُلْطٰنًا مُّبِيْنًا 153 وَرَفَعْنَا فَوْقَھُمُ الطُّوْرَ بِمِيْثَاقِهِمْ وَقُلْنَا لَهُمُ ادْخُلُوا الْبَابَ سُجَّدًا وَّقُلْنَا لَهُمْ لَا تَعْدُوْا فِي السَّبْتِ وَاَخَذْنَا مِنْهُمْ مِّيْثَاقًا غَلِيْظًا 154 فَبِمَا نَقْضِهِمْ مِّيْثَاقَهُمْ وَكُفْرِهِمْ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَقَتْلِهِمُ الْاَنْۢبِيَاۗءَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ وَّقَوْلِهِمْ قُلُوْبُنَا غُلْفٌ ۭ بَلْ طَبَعَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهَا بِكُفْرِهِمْ فَلَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ اِلَّا قَلِيْلًا 155 وَّبِكُفْرِهِمْ وَقَوْلِهِمْ عَلٰي مَرْيَمَ بُهْتَانًا عَظِيْمًا 156) (Surah An-Nisa: 153 se 156) tak utri aur Yahudiyon ke bure a'maal ka aaina un ke saamne rakh diya gaya to unhon ne saaf keh diya ke kisi insaan par Allah ne apna koi kalaam naazil hi nahin farmaya, na Musa (A.S) par, na Isa (A.S) par, na kisi aur Nabi par, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us waqt got lagaye baithe the, ise Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne khol diya aur farmaya kisi par bhi nahin? Pas Allah Ta'ala ne aayat (وَمَا قَدَرُوا اللّٰهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهٖٓ اِذْ قَالُوْا مَآ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰي بَشَرٍ مِّنْ شَيْءٍ) (Surah Al-An'am: 91) naazil farmayi, lekin yeh qaul ghaur talab hai is liye ke yeh aayat Surah An'am mein hai jo Makkiyah hai aur Surah Nisa ki mandarija baala aayat Madaniyah hai jo un ki tardeed mein hai, jab unhon ne kaha tha ke aasman se koi kitaab Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) utaar layein, jis ke jawab mein farmaya gaya ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) se unhon ne is se bhi bada sawaal kiya tha. Phir un ke uyub bayaan farmaye un ki pehli aur maujooda siyah kaariyan wazeh kar dein phir farmaya ke Allah ne apne bande aur Rasool Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf isi tarah wahi naazil farmayi hai jis tarah aur Ambiya (A.S) ki taraf wahi ki. Zaboor us kitaab ka naam hai jo Hazrat Dawood (A.S) par utri thi, in Ambiya (Alaihimas Salam) ke qisse Surah Qasas ki tafseer mein bayaan karenge Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Phir farmaya hai tadaad ikhtiyar aur is aayat yani Makki Surah ki aayat se pehle bahut se Ambiya ka zikr ho chuka hai aur bahut se Ambiya ka zikr nahin bhi hua.

Jin Anbiya-e-Kiram ke naam Quran ke alfaaz mein aa gaye hain woh yeh hain, Adam, Idris, Nuh, Hud, Saleh, Ibrahim, Lut, Ismail, Ishaq, Yaqub, Yusuf, Shoaib, Musa, Harun, Yunus, Daud, Sulaiman, Yusha, Zakariya, Isa, Yahya, aur ba-qaul aksar mufassireen Zul-Kifl aur Ayyub aur Ilyas, aur in sab ke sardar Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ) aur bahut se aise Rasool bhi hain jin ka zikr Quran mein nahin kiya gaya, isi wajah se Anbiya aur Mursaleen ki tadaad mein ikhtilaf hai, is baare mein mashhoor hadith Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) ki hai jo Tafsir Ibn Marduyah mein yun hai ke aap ne poocha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) Anbiya kitne hain? Farmaya teen sau tera, bahut badi jamaat. Main ne phir daryaft kiya, "Sab se pehle kaun se hain?" Farmaya "Adam" main ne kaha "Kya woh bhi Rasool thay?" Farmaya "Haan Allah ne unhein apne haath se paida kiya, phir un mein apni rooh phonki, phir durust aur theek thaak kiya" phir farmaya ae Abu Zar chaar Suryani hain, Adam, Shees, Nuh, Khuzukh jin ka mashhoor naam Idris hai, inhi ne pehle qalam se khat likha, chaar Arabi hain, Hud, Saleh, Shoaib aur tumhare Nabi (ﷺ), ae Abu Zar Bani Israel ke pehle Nabi Hazrat Musa hain aur aakhri Hazrat Isa hain. Tamam Nabiyon mein sab se pehle Nabi Hazrat Adam hain aur sab se aakhri Nabi tumhare Nabi hain." Is poori hadith ko jo bahut taweel hai, Hafiz Abu Hatim ne apni kitab Al-Anwa wal-Taqaseem mein riwayat kiya hai jis par sehat ka nishan diya hai, lekin in ke bar-khilaf Imam Abul Faraj Ibn Jauzi (R.H) ka kehna hai ke aimma-e-jarh-o-tadeel mein se bahut se logon ne in par is hadith ki wajah se kalam kiya hai wallahu a'lam, lekin yeh hadith dusri sanad se Hazrat Abu Umamah se bhi marwi hai, lekin is mein Ma'an bin Rifa'ah Salami za'eef hain aur Ali bin Yazid bhi za'eef hain aur Qasim bin Abdur Rahman bhi za'eef hain, ek aur hadith Abu Ya'la mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne aath hazaar Nabi bheje hain, chaar hazaar Bani Israel ki taraf aur chaar hazaar baqi aur logon ki taraf, yeh hadith bhi za'eef hai is mein Zaidi aur un ke ustad Raqqashi dono za'eef hain, wallahu a'lam, Abu Ya'la ki aur hadith mein hai ke aap ne farmaya aath hazaar Anbiya mere bhai guzar chuke hain un ke baad Hazrat Isa aaye aur un ke baad main aaya hoon aur hadith mein hai main aath hazaar Nabiyon ke baad aaya hoon jin mein se chaar hazaar Nabi Bani Israel mein se thay. Yeh hadith is sanad se ghareeb to zaroor hai lekin is ke tamam rawi maroof hain aur sanad mein koi kami ya ikhtilaf nahin bajuz Ahmad bin Tariq ke ke un ke baare mein mujhe koi alalat ya jarh nahin mili, wallahu a'lam. Abu Zar Ghifari wali taweel hadith jo Anbiya ki ginti ke baare mein hai, ise bhi sun lijiye, aap farmate hain main masjid mein aaya aur us waqt Huzoor (ﷺ) tanha tashreef farma thay, main bhi aap ke paas baith gaya aur kaha aap ne namaz ka hukum diya hai aap ne farmaya "Haan woh behtar cheez hai, chahe koi ziyadati kare chahe kami" main ne kaha "Huzoor (ﷺ) kaun se a'maal afzal hain?"

Farmaya "Allah par iman lana, us ki rah mein jihad karna" main ne kaha "Huzoor ﷺ kaunsa musalman aala hai?" farmaya "Jis ki zaban aur hath se musalman salamat rahein" main ne poocha "Kaunsi hijrat afzal hai?" farmaya "Buraiyon ko chhor dena" main ne poocha kaunsi namaz afzal hai? farmaya "Lambe qunoot wali" main ne kaha kaunsa roza afzal hai? farmaya "Farz kifayat karne wala hai aur Allah ke paas bahut barha charha sawab hai" main ne poocha kaunsa jihad afzal hai? "Farmaya jis ka ghora bhi kaat diya jaye aur khud us ka bhi khoon baha diya jaye." main ne kaha ghulam ko azad karne ke amal mein afzal kya hai? "Farmaya jis qadar garan qeemat ho aur malik ko zyada pasand ho." main ne poocha sadqa kaunsa afzal hai? farmaya "Kam maal wale ka koshish karna aur chupke se mohtaj ko de dena." main ne kaha Quran mein sab se bari ayat kaunsi hai? farmaya "Ayat-ul-Kursi" phir aap ne farmaya "Ae Abu-Zar saton aasman kursi ke muqable mein aise hain jaise koi halqa kisi chatyal maidan ke muqable mein aur Arsh ki fazilat kursi par, bhi aisi hai jaise wasee maidan ki halqe par" main ne arz kiya Huzoor ﷺ ambiya kitne hain? farmaya "Ek lakh chaubees hazar" main ne kaha un mein se rasool kitne hain? farmaya "Teen sau tera ki bahut bari pak jamaat" main ne poocha sab se pehle kaun hain? farmaya "Adam" main ne kaha kya woh bhi nabi rasool thay? farmaya "Haan unhein Allah ne apne hath se paida kiya aur apni rooh un mein phonki aur unhein sahih-tar banaya." phir aap ne farmaya suno char to suryani hain, Adam, Shees, Khanook aur yahi Idris hain, jinhon ne sab se pehle qalam se likha aur Nooh aur char arabi hain Hood, Shoaib, Saleh aur tumhare Nabi, sab se pehle rasool Hazrat Adam hain aur sab se aakhri rasool Hazrat Muhammad hain ﷺ main ne poocha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Allah Ta'ala ne kitabein kis qadar nazil farmayi hain? farmaya ek sau char, Hazrat Shees A.S par pachaas sahifay, Hazrat Khanook A.S par tees sahifay, Hazrat Ibrahim A.S par das sahifay aur Hazrat Moosa A.S par Taurat se pehle das sahifay aur Taurat, Injeel, Zaboor aur Furqan, main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah Hazrat Ibrahim ke sahifon mein kya tha? farmaya is ki markazi taleem jabr se musallat badshah ko us ke iqtidar ka maqsad samjhana tha aur use mazloom ki faryad-rasi karne ka ehsas dilana tha. Jis ki dua ko Allah Ta'ala lazman qabool farmate hain. Chahe woh kafir hi kyun na ho! Duniya ka maal jama karne se rokna tha aur un mein nasaih thin maslan yeh ke aql-mand ke liye zaroori hai ke woh apna nizam-ul-auqat banaye waqt ke ek hissay mein woh apne aamal ka muhasiba kare, dusre hissay mein apne khaliq ki sifat pe gaur-o-fikr kare, baqiya hissay mein tadbeer-e-ma'ash mein mashgool ho.

Aql-mand ko teen cheezon ke siwa kisi aur cheez mein dilchaspi na lena chahiye, ek toh Aakhirat ke zaad-e-rah ki fikr, dusre saman-e-zeest aur teesre Allah Ta'ala ki halal karda nematon se lutf-andoz hona ya fikr-e-ma'ash ya ghair-haram cheezon se suroor-o-lazzat, aql-mand ko apne waqt ko ghaneemat samajh kar sargarm-e-amal rehna chahiye, apni zaban par qabu aur qaul-o-fel mein yaksaniyat barqarar rakhna chahiye, woh bahut kam-go hoga, baat wahi kaho jo tumhein nafa de, main ne poocha Musa (A.S) ke saheefon mein kya tha? Farmaya woh ibrat dilane wali tehreeron ka majmua thay, mujhe ta'ajjub hai us shakhs par jo maut ka yaqeen rakhta hai phir bhi ghafil hai, taqdeer ka yaqeen rakhta hai phir bhi maal-o-daulat ke liye pagal ho raha hai, haye-waye mein pada hua hai, duniya ki be-sabati dekh kar bhi isi ko sab kuch samajhta rahe, Qayamat ke din hisab ko jaanta hai phir be-amal hai, main ne arz kiya Huzoor (ﷺ) agle ambiya ki kitabon mein jo tha us mein se bhi kuch hamari kitab mein hamare hathon mein hai? Aap ne farmaya haan padho aayat (Qad aflaha man tazakka) (Surah Al-A'la: 14) aakhir surat tak, main ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) mujhe wasiyat kijiye. Aap ne farmaya main tujhe Allah se darte rehne ki wasiyat karta hoon, yahi tere a'maal ki rooh hai, main ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) mujhe wasiyat kijiye. Aap ne farmaya main tujhe Allah se darte rehne ki wasiyat karta hoon, yahi tere a'maal ki rooh hai, main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) kuch aur bhi, Aap ne farmaya Quran ki tilawat aur Allah ke zikr mein mashghool reh woh tere liye aasmanon mein zikr aur zameen mein noor ke husool ka sabab hoga, main ne phir kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) kuch mazeed farmayiye, farmaya khabardar zyada hansi se baaz raho zyada hansi dil ko murda aur chehra ka noor door kar deti hai, main ne phir kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) kuch mazeed farmayiye, farmaya khabardar zyada hansi se baaz raho zyada hansi dil ko murda aur chehra ka noor door kar deti hai, main ne kaha aur zyada farmaya jihad mein mashghool raho, meri ummat ki rahbaniyat yani darweshi yahi hai, main ne kaha aur wasiyat kijiye farmaya bhali baat kehne ke siwa zaban band rakhho, is se shaitan bhaag jayega aur deeni kaamon mein badi ta'eed hogi. Main ne kaha kuch aur bhi farma dijiye farmaya apne se neeche darje ke logon ko dekha kar aur apne se a'ala darje ke logon par nazrein na daalo, is se tumhare dil mein Allah ki nematon ki azmat paida hogi, main ne kaha mujhe aur zyada nasihat kijiye farmaya maskeenon se mohabbat rakhho aur un ke saath baitho, is se Allah ki rahmatein tumhein garan-qadr maloom hongi, main ne kaha aur farmayiye farmaya "Qarabat-daron se milte raho, chahe woh tujh se na milein" main ne kaha aur?

Farmaya sach baat kaho chahe woh kisi ko karwi lage, main ne aur bhi nasihat talab ki farmaya Allah ke bare mein malamat karne wale ki malamat ka khauf na kar, main ne kaha aur farmayiye farmaya apne aibon par nazar rakha kar, dusron ki aib joi se baaz raho, phir mere seene par aap ne apna dast-e-mubarak rakh kar farmaya ae Abu Zar tadbeer ke manind koi aql mandi nahin aur haram se ruk jaane se barh kar koi parhezgari nahin aur achhe akhlaq se behtar koi hasb-o-nasab nahin. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi yeh hadith kuch isi mafhoom ki hai. Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri puchte hain kya khariji bhi Dajjal ke qail hain, logon ne kaha nahin farmaya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya hai main ek hazar balkay zyada nabiyon ka khatam karne wala hoon aur har nabi ne apni ummat ko Dajjal se daraya hai lekin mujh se Allah ne us ki woh alamat bayan farmayi hai jo kisi aur ko nahin farmayi "Suno woh bhenga hoga aur Rabb aisa ho nahin sakta us ki dahni aankh kafi bhengi hogi, aankh ka dheela itna utha hua jaise chune ki saaf deewar par kisi ka khankar para ho aur us ki baayin aankh ek jagmagate sitare jaisi hai, woh tamam zabanen bole ga, us ke sath sarsabz-o-shadab jannat siyah dhuan dhaar dozakh nazar aaye ga". Ek hadith mein hai ek lakh nabiyon ko khatam karne wala hoon balkay zyada ka. Phir farmaya hai Musa se khud Allah ne saaf taur par kalam kiya. Yeh un ki khas sifat hai ke woh Kaleemullah thay, ek shakhs Hazrat Abu Bakr bin Ayyash (R.H) ke paas aata hai aur kehta hai ke ek shakhs is jumla ko yun parhta hai aayat (وَكَلَّمَ اللّٰهُ مُوْسٰى تَكْلِــيْمًا) (Surah An-Nisa: 164) yani Musa ne Allah se baat ki hai, is par aap bohat bigre aur farmaya yeh kisi kafir ne parha hoga. Main ne Aamash se, Aamash ne Yahya ne Abdur Rahman se, Abdur Rahman se Ali se, Ali ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se parha hai ke aayat (وَكَلَّمَ اللّٰهُ مُوْسٰى تَكْلِــيْمًا) (Surah An-Nisa: 164). Garz us shakhs ki manwi aur lafzi tehreef par aap bohat zyada naraz hue magar ajab nahin ke yeh koi Mu'tazili ho, is liye ke Mu'tazila ka yeh aqeeda hai ke Allah ne Musa se kalam kiya na kisi aur se. Kisi Mu'tazili ne ek buzurg ke samne isi aayat ko isi tarah parha to unhon ne use daant kar farmaya phir is aayat mein yeh baddiyanati kaise karo ge? Jahan farmaya hai aayat (وَلَمَّا جَاۗءَ مُوْسٰي لِمِيْقَاتِنَا وَكَلَّمَهٗ رَبُّهٗ) (Surah Al-A'raf: 143) yani Musa hamare wade par aaya aur un se un ke Rabb ne kalam kiya, matlab yeh hai ke yahan to yeh taweel-o-tehreef nahin chale gi. Ibn Marduyah ki hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya "Jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Musa se kalam kiya to woh andheri raat mein siyah chunti ka kisi saaf patthar par chalna bhi dekh lete thay." Yeh hadith ghareeb hai aur is ki asnaad sahih nahin aur jab mauqoofan ba-qaul-e-Abi Huraira sabit ho jaye to bohat theek hai. Mustadrak Hakim waghera mein hai.

Ke Kalimullah se jab Allah ne kalam kiya woh soofi ki chadar aur soof ki sardol aur ghair mazbooh gadhe ki khaal ki jootiyan pehne hue thay, Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne ek lakh chalis hazar baatein Hazrat Musa A.S se keen jo sab ki sab wasiyatein thin, natija yeh ke logon ki baatein Hazrat Musa A.S se suni nahin jaati thin kyunke kanon mein Kalam-e-Ilahi ki goonj rehti thi, is ki asnaad bhi zaeef hain. Phir is mein inqita bhi hai. Ek asar Ibn Marduyah mein hai Hazrat Jabir R.A farmate hain jo kalam Allah Ta'ala ne Toor wale din Hazrat Musa A.S se kiya tha yeh toh mere andaze ke mutabiq is ki sifat jis din pukara tha us andaz-e-kalam ki sifat se alag thi. Musa A.S ne is ka raaz maloom karna chaha Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya Musa abhi toh main ne das hazar zabanon ki quwwat se kalam kiya hai halankeh mujhe tamam zabanon ki quwwat hasil hai balkeh un sab se bhi bahut zyada. Bani Israel ne aap se jab kalam-e-zabani ki sifat poochhi aap ne farmaya "Main toh kuch nahin keh sakta" unhon ne kaha kuch tashbeeh toh bayan karo, aap ne farmaya tum ne karake ki aawaz suni hogi, woh is ke mushaba thi lekin waisi na thi, is ke ek rawi Fazl Raqashi zaeef hain aur bahut hi zaeef hain. Hazrat Ka'ab R.H farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne jab Hazrat Musa A.S se kalam kiya toh yeh tamam zabanon pe muheet tha. Hazrat Kalimullah A.S ne poochha "Bari Ta'ala yeh tera kalam hai?" farmaya nahin aur na toh mere kalam ki istiqamat kar sakta hai. Hazrat Musa A.S ne daryaft kiya ke aye Rab teri makhlooq mein se kisi ka kalam tere kalam se mushaba hai? Farmaya nahin siwaye sakht tar karake ke, yeh riwayat bhi mauqoof hai aur yeh zahir hai ke Hazrat Ka'ab R.H agli kitabon se riwayat kiya karte thay jin mein Bani Israel ki hikayatein har tarah sahih aur ghair sahih hoti hain. Yeh Rasool hi hain jo Allah ki ita'at karne walon aur us ki razamandi ke mutalashiyon ko jannaton ki khushkhabariyan dete hain aur us ke aur us ke Rasoolon ko jhutlane walon ko azab aur saza se darate hain. Phir farmata hai Allah Ta'ala ne jo apni kitabein nazil farmayi hain aur apne Rasool bheje hain aur un ke zariye apne awamr-o-nawahi ki taleem dilwayi yeh is liye ke kisi ko koi hujjat ya koi uzr baqi na reh jaye. Jaise aur aayat mein hai aayat (Walao anna ahlaknahum bi-azabim min qablihi laqalu rabbana lawla arsalta ilaina rasulan fanattabi'a ayati-ka min qabli an nazilla wanakhza) (20. Taha: 134) yani agar hum unhein is se pehle hi apne azab se halak kar dete toh woh yeh keh sakte thay ke aye hamare Rab tu ne hamari taraf Rasool kyun nahin bheje jo hum un ki baatein maante aur is zillat-o-ruswayi se bach jaate, isi jaisi yeh aayat bhi hai aayat (Walaola an tuseebahum museebatum bima qaddamat aydihim fayaqulu rabbana lawla arsalta ilaina rasulan fanattabi'a ayati-ka wa nakuna minal mu'mineen) (28. Al-Qasas: 47).

(Al-Qasas: 47) Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah se zyada ghairat-mand koi nahin, isi liye Allah Ta'ala ne tamam buraiyon ko haram kiya hai khwah zahir hon khwah posheeda aur aisa bhi koi nahin jise ba-nisbat Allah ke madh zyada pasand ho, yahi wajah hai ke us ne khud apni madh aap ki hai aur koi aisa nahin jise Allah se zyada dar pasand ho, isi wajah se Allah Ta'ala ne nabiyon ko khush-khabrian sunane wale aur darane wale bana kar bheja. Dusri riwayat mein yeh alfaz hain ke isi wajah se us ne Rasool bheje aur kitabein utarein.

Hamare iman aur kufr se Allah Ta'ala beniyaz hai. Chunki sabqa aayaton mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nabuwwat ka suboot tha aur aap ki nabuwwat ke munkiron ki tardeed thi, is liye yahan farmata hai ke go kuch log tujhe jhutlayein, teri mukhalifat karein lekin Allah khud teri risalat ka shahid hai. Woh farmata hai ke us ne apni pak kitab Quran-e-Majeed-o-Furqan-e-Hameed tujh par nazil farmaya hai jis ke paas batil phatak hi nahin sakta, is kitab mein un cheezon ka ilm hai jin par us ne apne bandon ko muttala farmana chaha yani daleelein, hidayat aur furqan, Allah ki razamandi aur narazgi ke ahkaam aur mazi ki aur mustaqbil ki khabrein hain aur Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ki woh muqaddas sifat-e-hain jinhein na to koi Nabi-e-Mursal jaanta hai aur na koi muqarrab farishta, bajuz is ke ke woh khud maloom karaye. Jaise irshad hai aayat (Wala yuheetoona bishai'im min ilmihi illa bima sha'a) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 255) aur farmata hai aayat (Wala yuheetoona bihi ilma) (Surah Taha: 110). Hazrat Atta bin Sa'ib jab Hazrat Abu Abdur Rahman Sulami se Quran-e-Sharif parh chukte hain to aap farmate hain tu ne Allah ka ilm hasil kiya hai pas aaj tujh se afzal koi nahin, bajuz is ke jo amal mein tujh se barh jaye, phir aap ne aayat (Anzalahu bi-ilmihi) se aakhir tak parhi. Phir farmata hai ke Allah ki shahadat ke sath hi sath farishton ki shahadat bhi hai ke tere paas jo ilm aaya hai, jo wahi tujh par utri hai woh bilkul sach aur sarasar haq hai. Yahudiyon ki ek jamaat Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aati hai to aap farmate hain Khuda ki qasam mujhe pukhta taur par maloom hai ke tum meri risalat ka ilm rakhte ho, un logon ne is ka inkar kar diya pas Allah Azza-o-Jal ne yeh aayat utari. Phir farmata hai jin logon ne kufr kiya, haq ki itteba na ki, balkay aur logon ko bhi rah-e-haq se rokte rahe, yeh sahih rah se hat gaye hain aur haqeeqat se alag ho gaye aur hidayat se hat gaye hain. Yeh log jo hamari aayaton ke munkir hain, hamari kitab ko nahin maante, apni jaan par zulm karte hain, hamari rah se rokte aur rukte hain, hamare mana karda kaam ko kar rahe hain, hamare ahkaam se munh pherte hain, inhe hum bakhshenge na khair-o-bhalai ki taraf un ki rahbari karenge. Haan inhe Jahannam ka rasta dikha denge jis mein woh hamesha pare rahenge. Logo! Tumhare paas tumhare Rabb ki taraf se haq le kar Allah ke Rasool aa gaye, tum is par iman lao aur is ki farmabardari karo, yahi tumhare haq mein achha hai aur agar tum kufr karoge to Allah tum se beniyaz hai, tumhara iman na use nafa pahunchaye, na tumhara kufr use zarar pahunchaye. Zameen-o-Aasman ki tamam cheezein us ki malkiyat mein hain. Yahi qaul Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ka apni qaum se tha ke tum aur roo-e-zameen ke tamam log bhi agar kufr par ijma karlein to Allah ka kuch nahin bigaar sakte. Woh tamam jahan se beparwah hai, woh Aleem hai, jaanta hai ke mustahiq-e-hidayat kaun hai aur mustahiq-e-zalalat kaun hai? Woh Hakeem hai us ke aqwal, us ke af'aal, us ki shar'a us ki taqdeer sab hikmat se pur hain.

Apni auqat mein raho, had se tajawuz na karo! Ahl-e-Kitab ko ziyadati se aur had se aage barh jaane se Allah Ta'ala rok raha hai. Isai Hazrat Isa A.S ke baare mein had se nikal gaye thay aur nabuwwat se barha kar uluhiyat tak pohancha rahe thay. Bajaye unki itaat ke ibadat karne lage thay, balkay aur buzrugan-e-deen ki nisbat bhi unka aqeeda kharab ho chuka tha, woh unhein bhi jo Isai deen ke aalim aur aamil thay masoom-e-mahz jaanne lag gaye thay aur yeh khayal kar liya tha ke jo kuch yeh aimma-e-deen keh dein uska manna hamare liye zaroori hai, sach-o-jhoot, haq-o-batil, hidayat-o-zalalat ke parkhne ka koi haq hamein hasil nahin. Jis ka zikr Quran ki is aayat mein hai aayat (Ittakhazu ahbarahum wa ruhbanahum arbaban min dunillahi wal-masiha-bna maryam) (Surah At-Tawbah: 31). Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya "Mujhe tum aisa na barhana jaisa Nasara ne Isa bin Maryam ko barhaya, main to sirf ek banda hoon pas tum mujhe Abdullah aur Rasoolullah kehna." Yeh hadith Bukhari waghera mein bhi hai, isi ki sanad ek hadith mein hai ke kisi shakhs ne aap se kaha ae Muhammad ﷺ! Ae hamare sardar aur sardar ke larkay, ae hum sab se behtar aur behtar ke larkay! To aap ne farmaya "Logo apni baat ka khud khayal kar liya karo tumhein Shaitan behka na de, main Muhammad bin Abdullah hoon, main Allah ka ghulam aur uska Rasool hoon, qasam Allah ki main nahin chahta ke tum mujhe mere martabey se barha do." Phir farmata hai Allah par iftira na bandho, us se biwi aur aulad ko mansoob na karo, Allah us se pak hai, us se door hai, us se buland-o-bala hai, uski barai aur izzat mein koi uska shareek nahin, us ke siwa na to koi mabood aur na Rabb hai. Maseeh Isa bin Maryam Rasoolullah hain, woh Allah ke ghulamon mein se ek ghulam hain aur uski makhlooq hain, woh sirf kalma 'Kun' ke kehne se paida hue hain, jis kalma ko le kar Hazrat Jibraeel A.S Hazrat Maryam Siddiqa R.A ke paas gaye aur Allah ki ijazat se usey un mein phoonk diya pas Hazrat Isa A.S paida hue. Chunke mahz isi kalma se baghair baap ke aap paida hue, is liye khusoosiyat se Kalimatullah kaha gaya. Quran ki ek aur aayat mein hai aayat (Mal-masihu-bnu maryama illa rasulun qad khalat min qablihir-rusul) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 75) yani Maseeh bin Maryam sirf Rasoolullah hain un se pehle bhi bohat se rasool guzar chuke hain, unki walida sachi hain, yeh dono khana khaya karte thay aur aayat mein hai aayat (Inna masala Isa indallahi kamasali Adama khalaqahu min turabin summa qala lahu kun fayakun) (Surah Al-Imran: 59) Isa ki misaal Allah ke nazdeek Adam A.S ki tarah hai jise mitti se bana kar farmaya hoja pas woh hogaya. Quran-e-Kareem aur jagah farmata hai aayat (Wallati ahsanat farjaha fanafakhna fiha min ruhina wa ja'alnaha wabnaha ayatal-lil'alamin) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 91).

Al-Anbiya: 91) Jis ne apni sharmgah ki hifazat ki aur hum ne apni rooh phonki aur khud usay aur us ke bachay ko logon ke liye apni qudrat ki alamat banaya aur jagah farmaya aayat (Wa Maryamabnata 'Imrana allati ahsanat farjaha fanafakhna fihi min roohina wa saddaqat bi-kalimati Rabbiha wa kutubihi wa kanat minal-qanitin) 66. At-Tahrim: 12) se aakhir soorat tak. Hazrat 'Isa A.S ki babat aik aur aayat mein hai aayat (In huwa illa 'abdun an'amna 'alaihi wa ja'alnahu mathalan li-bani Isra'il) 43. Az-Zukhruf: 59), woh hamara aik banda tha jis par hum ne in'aam kiya. Pas yeh matlab nahin ke khud Kalimat-e-Ilahi 'Isa ban gaya balkay Kalima-e-Ilahi se Hazrat 'Isa paida huay. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H ne aayat (Idh qalatil-mala'ikatu ya Maryamu innallaha yubashiruki bi-kalimatin minhu) 3. Aal-e-'Imran: 45) ki tafseer mein jo kuch kaha hai us se yeh murad theek hai ke Allah Ta'ala ka kalima jo Hazrat Jibra'il A.S ki ma'rifat phonka gaya, us se Hazrat 'Isa A.S paida huay. Sahih Bukhari mein hai "Jis ne bhi Allah ke aik aur la-shareek honay aur Muhammad ﷺ ke 'abd-o-rasool honay ki, 'Isa ke 'abd-o-rasool honay aur yeh ke aap Allah ke kalima se thay jo Maryam ki taraf phonka gaya tha aur Allah ki phonki hui rooh thay aur jis ne jannat dozakh ko bar-haq mana woh khwah kaisay hi a'maal par ho, Allah par haq hai ke usay jannat mein le jaye. Aik riwayat mein itni ziyada bhi hai ke jannat ke aathon darwazon mein se jis se chahay dakhil ho jaye". Jaisay ke Janab 'Isa A.S ko aayat-o-hadees mein (Roohun minhu) kaha hai aisay hi Quran ki aik aayat mein hai aayat (Wa sakhkhara lakum ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ardi jami'an minhu) 45. Al-Jathiya: 13) us ne musakhkhar kiya tumharay liye jo kuch aasmanon mein hai aur jo zameen mein hai, tamam ka tamam apni taraf se hai. Ya'ni apni makhlooq aur apnay paas ki rooh se. Pas lafz 'min' tab'eez (us ka hissa) ke liye nahin jaisay mal'oon nasraniyon ka khayal hai ke Hazrat 'Isa A.S Allah ka aik juz' thay balkay 'min' ibtida ke liye hai. Jaisay ke doosri aayat mein hai, Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmatay hain rooh-e-minhu se murad rasool-e-minhu hai aur log kehtay hain aayat (Mahabbat-e-minhu) lekin ziyada qawi pehla qaul hai ya'ni aap paida kiye gaye hain, rooh se jo khud Allah ki makhlooq hai. Pas aap ko Roohullah kehna aisa hi hai jaisay (Naqatullah) aur Baitullah kaha gaya hai ya'ni sirf us ki azmat ke izhar ke liye apni taraf nisbat ki aur hadees mein bhi hai ke "Main apnay Rab ke paas us ke ghar mein jaunga." Phir farmata hai tum us ka yaqeen kar lo ke Allah wahid hai biwi bachon se paak hai aur yaqeen maan lo ke Janab 'Isa A.S Allah ka kalam, Allah ki makhlooq aur us ke barguzeeda rasool hain. Tum teen na kaho ya'ni 'Isa aur Maryam ko Allah ka shareek na banao, Allah ki uluhiyat shirk se mubarra hai. Surah Ma'idah mein farmaya aayat (Laqad kafaralladhina qalu innallaha thalithu thalathatin) 5.

(Al-Ma'idah: 73) Ya'ni jo kehte hain ke Allah teen mein ka teesra hai woh kafir ho gaye, Allah Ta'ala ek hi hai, us ke siwa koi aur laiq-e-ibadat nahin. Surah Ma'idah ke aakhir mein hai ke Qayamat ke din Hazrat Isa (A.S) se sawal hoga ke apni aur apni walida ki ibadat ka hukum logon ko tum ne diya tha, aap saaf taur par inkar kar denge. Nasraniyon ka is bare mein koi usool hi nahin hai, woh buri tarah bhatak rahe hain aur apne aap ko barbad kar rahe hain. In mein se ba'az toh Hazrat Isa (A.S) ko khud Allah maante hain, ba'az shareek-e-Ilahiya maante aur ba'az Allah ka beta kehte hain. Sach toh yeh hai ke agar das Nasrani jama hon toh un ke khayalat gyarah honge. Saeed bin Batriq Iskandari jo san 400 Hijri ke qareeb guzra hai us ne aur ba'az un ke aur bade ulama ne zikr kiya hai ke Qustuntin bani-e-Qustuntuniya ke zamane mein us waqt ke Nasraniyon ka is badshah ke hukum se ijtima hua, jis mein do hazar se zyada un ke mazhabi peshwa shamil hote the, baham un ke ikhtilaf ka yeh haal tha ke kisi baat par sattar assi aadmiyon ka ittefaq mafqood tha, das ka ek aqeeda hai, bees ka ek khayal hai, chalis aur hi kuch kehte hain, sath aur taraf ja rahe hain, garaz hazar-ha ki tadaad mein se ba-mushkil tamam teen sau athara aadmi ek qaul par jama hue, badshah ne isi aqeede ko le liya, baqi ko chhod diya aur isi ki ta'eed-o-nusrat ki aur un ke liye kaleesa aur girje bana diye aur kitabein likhwa dein, qawaneen zabt kar diye, yahin unhon ne Amanat-e-Kubra ka mas'ala ghada, jo darasal badtareen khayanat hai, in logon ko Malkaniya kehte hain. Phir dobara un ka ijtima hua, us waqt jo firqa bana us ka naam Ya'qoobiya hai. Phir teesri martaba ke ijtima mein jo firqa bana us ka naam Nasturiya hai, yeh teeno firqe Aqaneem-e-Salasa ko Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke liye sabit karte hain, in mein bhi baham deegar ikhtilaf hai aur ek dusre ko kafir kehte hain aur hamare nazdeek toh teeno kafir hain. Allah farmata hai is shirk se baaz aao, baaz rehna hi tumhare liye achha hai, Allah toh ek hi hai, woh Tauheed wala hai, us ki zaat is se paak hai ke us ke han aulad ho. Tamam cheezein us ki makhlooq hain aur us ki malkiyat mein hain, sab us ki ghulami mein hain aur sab us ke qabze mein hain, woh har cheez par Wakeel hai, phir makhlooq mein se koi us ki biwi aur koi us ka bacha kaise ho sakta hai? Dusri aayat mein hai aayat (BADI'US-SAMAWATI WAL-ARD, ANNA YAKUNU LAHU WALADUN WA LAM TAKUN LAHU SAHIBATUN) (6. Al-An'am: 101) ya'ni woh toh aasman-o-zameen ki ibtidai aafreenish karne wala hai, us ka ladka kaise ho sakta hai?

Surah Maryam mein aayat (WAQALU ITTAKHADAR-RAHMANU WALADA 88. LAQAD JI'TUM SHAY'AN IDDA 89. TAKADUS-SAMAWATU YATAFFATARNA MINHU WATANSHAQQUL-ARDU WATAKHIRRUL-JIBALU HADDA 90. AN DA'AW LIR-RAHMANI WALADA 91. WAMA YAMBAGHI LIR-RAHMANI AN YATTAKHIDHA WALADA 92. IN KULLU MAN FIS-SAMAWATI WAL-ARDI ILLA ATIR-RAHMANI ABDA 93. LAQAD AHSYAHUM WA'ADDAHUM ADDA 94. WAKULLUHUM ATIHI YAWMAL-QIYAMATI FARDA 95) (19. Maryam: 88 ta 95) tak bhi is ka mufassalan inkar farmaya hai.

Is ki giraft se farar namumkin hai! Matlab yeh hai ke Masih (A.S) aur aala tareen farishtay bhi Allah ki bandagi se inkar aur farar nahin kar sakte, na yeh un ki shaan ke laiq hai balkay jo jitna martabey mein qareeb hota hai, woh usi qadar Allah ki ibadat mein zyada paband hota hai. Baaz logon ne is aayat se istidlal kiya hai ke farishtay insanon se afzal hain. Lekin darasal is ka koi suboot is aayat mein nahin, is liye yahan malaika ka atf Masih par hai aur istinkaf ka ma'ani rukne ke hain aur farishton mein yeh qudrat ba-nisbat Masih ke zyada hai. Is liye yeh farmaya gaya hai aur ruk jaane par zyada qadir hone se fazeelat sabit nahin hoti aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke jis tarah Hazrat Masih (A.S) ko log poojte thay, isi tarah farishton ki bhi ibadat karte thay. Toh is aayat mein Masih (A.S) ko Allah ki ibadat se rukne wala bata kar farishton ki bhi yahi halat bayan kar di, jis se sabit ho gaya ke jinhein tum poojte ho woh khud Allah ko poojte hain, phir un ki pooja kaisi? Jaise aur aayat mein hai aayat (Wa qalu-ttakhazar-Rahmanu walada, subhanahu bal ibadum mukramun) (21. Al-Anbiya: 26) aur isi liye yahan bhi farmaya ke jo us ki ibadat se rukay, munh moray aur baghawat kare, woh ek waqt usi ke paas lautne wala hai aur apne baare mein us ka faisla sunne wala hai aur jo iman layein, nek aamal karein, unhein un ka poora sawab bhi diya jaye ga, phir Rahmat-e-Izadi apni taraf se bhi inaam ata farmaye gi. Ibn Marduyah ki hadith mein hai ke ajr toh yeh hai ke jannat mein pohancha diya aur zyada fazl yeh hai ke jo log qabil-e-dozakh hon, unhein bhi un ki shafa'at naseeb hogi, jin se unhon ne bhalai aur achai ki thi, lekin is ki sanad sabit shuda nahin, haan agar Ibn Mas'ood ke qaul par hi isay riwayat kiya jaye toh theek hai. Phir farmaya jo log Allah ki ibadat-o-ita'at se ruk jayein aur us se takabbur karein, unhein Parwardigar dard-naak azab kare ga aur yeh Allah ke siwa kisi ko wali-o-madadgar na payein ge. Jaise aur aayat mein hai aayat (Innal-lazina yastakbiruna an ibadati sayadkhuluna jahannama dakhireen) (40. Ghafir: 60) jo log meri ibadat se takabbur karein, woh zaleel-o-haqeer ho kar jahannam mein jayein ge, ya'ni un ke inkar aur un ke takabbur ka yeh badla unhein mile ga ke zaleel-o-haqeer khwar-o-be-bas ho kar jahannam mein dakhil kiye jayein ge.

Quran-e-Majeed Allah Ta'ala ki mukammal daleel aur hujjat-e-tamam hai. Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala tamam insano ko farmata hai ke meri taraf se kamil daleel aur uzr-e-ma'zarat ko tod dene wali, shak-o-shuba ko alag karne wali burhan (daleel) tumhari taraf nazil ho chuki hai aur hum ne tumhari taraf khula noor, saaf roshni, poora ujala utaar diya hai, jis se haq ki raah sahih taur par wazeh ho jati hai. Ibn-e-Jurayj waghera farmate hain is se murad Quran-e-Kareem hai. Ab jo log Allah par iman layein aur tawakkul aur bharosa usi par karein, us se mazboot rabta kar lein, us ki sarkar mein mulazamat kar lein, maqam-e-uboodiyat aur maqam-e-tawakkul mein qaim ho jayein, tamam umoor usi ko sonp dein aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke Allah par iman layein aur mazbooti ke sath Allah ki kitab ko thaam lein, un par Allah apna raham karega, apna fazl un par nazil farmaye ga, ne'maton aur suroor wali jannat mein unhein le jaye ga, un ke sawab badha de ga, un ke darje buland kar de ga aur unhein apni taraf le jane wali seedhi aur saaf raah dikhaye ga, jo kahin se tedhi nahin, kahin se tang nahin. Goya woh duniya mein Sirat-e-Mustaqeem par hota hai. Raah-e-Islam par hota hai aur aakhirat mein raah-e-jannat par aur raah-e-salamti par hota hai. Shuru-e-Tafsir mein ek poori hadith guzar chuki hai jis mein farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ) hai ke Allah ki seedhi raah aur Allah ki mazboot rassi Quran-e-Kareem hai.
