Asba aur Kalala ki wazahat! Masail-e-Wirasat. Hazrat Bara (R.A) farmate hain suraton mein sab se aakhri surat Surah Bara'at utri hai aur aayaton mein sab se aakhri aayat (Yastaftoonaka) utri hai, Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain "Main bimari ke sabab behosh pada tha ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) meri ayadat ke liye tashreef laye, Aap ne wuzu kiya aur wahi pani mujh par dala, jis se mujhe afaqa hua aur main ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) warison ke lihaz se main Kalala hoon, meri miras kaise bate gi? Is par Allah Ta'ala ne aayat-e-faraiz nazil farmayi (Bukhari o Muslim) aur riwayat mein bhi isi aayat ka utarna aaya hai. Pas Allah farmata hai ke log tujh se puchte hain yani Kalala ke bare mein. Pehle yeh bayan guzar chuka hai ke lafz Kalala Ikleel se makhooz hai jo ke sar ko charon taraf se ghere hue hota hai. Aksar ulama ne kaha hai ke Kalala woh hai jis mayyat ke ladke pote na hon aur baaz ka qaul yeh bhi hai ke jis ke ladke na hon, jaise kaha aayat mein hai aayat (Wa laisa lahu walad). Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ke samne jo mushkil masail aaye the, un mein ek yeh masla bhi tha. Chunancha Bukhari o Muslim mein hai ke Aap ne farmaya teen cheezon ki nisbat meri tamanna reh gayi ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) un mein hamari taraf koi aisa ahd karte ke hum isi ki taraf ruju karte dada ki miras, Kalala aur sood ke abwab aur riwayat mein hai, Aap farmate hain ke Kalala ke bare mein main ne jis qadar sawalat Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kiye, utne kisi aur masla mein nahin kiye yahan tak ke Aap ne apni ungli se mere seene mein kachoka laga kar farmaya ke tujhe garmiyon ki woh aayat kafi hai, jo Surah Nisa ke aakhir mein hai aur hadith mein hai agar main ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se mazeed itminan kar liya hota to woh mere liye surkh oonton ke milne se zyada behtar tha. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke is farman ka matlab yeh hai ke yeh aayat mausam-e-garma mein nazil hui hogi Wallahu A'alam aur chunke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is ke samajhne ki taraf rehnumai ki thi aur isi ko masla ka kafi hal bataya tha, lehaza Farooq-e-Azam is ke ma'ani puchne bhool gaye, jis par izhar-e-afsos kar rahe hain. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke Janab-e-Farooq ne Huzoor se Kalala ke bare mein sawal kiya pas farmaya "Kya Allah ne ise bayan nahin farmaya." Pas yeh aayat utri. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) apne khutbe mein farmate hain jo aayat Surah Nisa ke shuru mein faraiz ke bare mein hai, woh walad o walid ke liye hai aur dusri aayat miyan biwi ke liye hai aur maa zaad behnon ke liye aur jis aayat se Surah Nisa ko khatam kiya hai woh sage behan bhaiyon ke bare mein hai jo rehmi rishta Asba mein shumar hota hai (Ibn-e-Jareer). Is aayat ke ma'ani Halaka ke ma'ani hain margaya, jaise farman hai hadith (Kullu shai'in halikun illa wajhah) (28. Al-Qasas: 88) yani har cheez fana hone wali hai siwaye Zaat-e-Ilahi ke jo hamesha baqi rehne wala hai. Jaise aur aayat mein farmaya aayat (Kullu man alaiha fan. Wa yabqa wajhu rabbika zul jalali wal ikram) (55. Ar-Rahman: 26-27).

27) Ya'ni har ek jo is par hai fani hai aur tere Rab ka chehra hi baqi rahega jo Jalal-o-Ikram wala hai. Phir farmaya is ka walad na ho, is se ba'az logon ne daleel li hai ke Kalala ki shart mein baap ka na hona nahin balkay jis ki aulad na ho woh Kalala hai, barwayat Ibn-e-Jarir Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) se bhi yahi marwi hai lekin sahih qaul jamhoor ka hai aur Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) ka faisla bhi yahi hai ke Kalala woh hai jis ka na walad ho, na walid aur is ki daleel aayat mein is ke baad ke alfaaz se bhi sabit hoti hai jo farmaya aayat (Wa lahu ukhtun falaha nisfu ma tarak) (Surah An-Nisa: 176) ya'ni us ki behen ho to us ke liye kul chhore hue maal ka aadhon aadh hai aur agar behen baap ke sath ho to baap usay virsa panay se rok deta hai aur usay kuch bhi ijma'an nahin milta, pas sabit hua ke Kalala woh hai jis ka walad na ho jo nass se sabit hai aur baap bhi na ho yeh bhi nass se sabit hota hai lekin qadray ghaur ke baad, is liye ke behen ka nisf hissa baap ki maujoodgi mein hota hi nahin balkay woh virsay se mehroom hoti hai. Hazrat Zaid bin Sabit (R.A) se mas'ala poocha jata hai ke ek aurat mar gayi hai us ka khawand hai aur ek saghi behen hai to aap ne farmaya aadha behen ko de do aur aadha khawand ko jab aap se is ki daleel poochi gayi to aap ne farmaya meri maujoodgi mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne aisi surat mein yahi faisla sadir farmaya tha (Ahmed). Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Zubair (R.A) se Ibn-e-Jarir mein manqool hai ke in dono ka fatwa is mayyat ke baray mein jo ek larki aur ek behen chhor jaye, yeh tha ke is surat mein behen mehroom rahegi, usay kuch bhi na milay ga, isi liye ke Quran ki is aayat mein behen ko aadha milnay ki surat yeh bayan ki gayi hai ke mayyat ki aulad na ho aur yahan aulad hai. Lekin jamhoor in ke khilaf hain woh kehte hain ke is surat mein bhi aadha larki ko milay ga aur ba-sabab-e-farz aur asaba aadha behen ko bhi milay ga. Ibrahim Aswad kehte hain hum mein Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal (R.A) ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke zamanay mein faisla kiya ke aadha larki ka aur aadha behen ka. Sahih Bukhari ki ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Musa (R.A) ne larki aur poti aur behen ke baray mein fatwa diya ke aadha larki ko aur aadha behen ko phir farmaya zara Ibn-e-Mas'ood (R.A) ke paas bhi ho aao woh bhi meri muwafiqat hi karenge, lekin jab Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood (R.A) se sawal hua aur Hazrat Abu Musa ka faisla bhi unhein sunaya gaya to aap ne farmaya in se ittefaq ki surat mein gumrah ho jaunga aur rah-yafta logon mein mera shumar nahin rahega, suno main is baray mein woh faisla karta hoon jo Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne kiya hai aadha to beti ko aur chatha hissa poti ko to do sulus pooray ho gaye aur jo baqi bacha woh behen ko.

Hum phir wapas aaye aur Hazrat Abu Musa (R.A) ko yeh khabar di toh aap ne farmaya jab tak yeh 'Allama tum mein majood hain, mujh se masail na poocha karo. Phir farman hai ke yeh us ka waris hoga agar us ki aulad na ho, yani bhai apni behen ke kul maal ka waris hai jabke woh kalala mare yani us ki aulad aur baap na ho, is liye ke baap ki majoodgi mein toh bhai ko virse mein se kuch bhi na mile ga. Haan agar bhai ke sath hi aur koi muqarrara hissay wala aur waris ho jaise khawand ya maa jaya bhai toh usay us ka hissa de diya jaye ga aur baqi ka waris bhai hoga. Sahih Bukhari mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain faraiz ko un ke ahl se mila do, phir jo baqi bache woh us mard ka hai jo sab se zyada qareeb ho. Phir farmata hai agar behnein do hon toh unhein maal-e-matrooka ke do sulus milenge. Yehi hukum do se zyada behnon ka bhi hai, yahin se ek jamaat ne do betiyon ka hukum liya hai. Jaise ke do se zyada behnon ka hukum ladkiyon ke hukum se liya hai jis ayat ke alfaaz yeh hain ayat (فَاِنْ كُنَّ نِسَاۗءً فَوْقَ اثْنَتَيْنِ فَلَھُنَّ ثُلُثَا مَا تَرَكَ) (Surah An-Nisa: 11). Phir farmata hai agar behen bhai dono hon toh har mard ka hissa do aurton ke barabar hai, yehi hukum asbaat ka hai khwah ladke hon ya pote hon ya bhai hon, jab ke un mein mard-o-aurat dono majood hon. Toh jitna do aurton ko mile ga utna ek mard ko. Allah apne faraiz bayan farma raha hai, apni hadein muqarrar kar raha hai, apni shariat wazeh kar raha hai. Taake tum behak na jao. Allah Ta'ala tamam kamon ke anjam se waqif aur har maslahat se dana, bandon ki bhalai burai ka janne wala, mustahiq ke istihqaq ko pehchanne wala hai. Ibn-e-Jarir ki riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur sahaba kahin safar mein ja rahe thay. Huzaifa (R.A) ki sawari ke dusre sawar ke paas tha jo yeh ayat utri pas Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) ko sunai aur Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) ne Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ko us ke baad phir Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne jab us ke bare mein sawal kiya toh kaha wallah tum be-samajh ho, is liye ke jaise mujhe Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne sunai waise hi main ne aap ko suna di, wallah main toh is par koi ziyadati nahin kar sakta, pas Hazrat Farooq (R.A) farmaya karte thay Ilahi agarcheh tu ne zahir kar diya ho magar mujh par toh khula nahin. Lekin yeh riwayat munqata hai isi riwayat ki aur sanad mein hai ke Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne dobara yeh sawal apni khilafat ke zamane mein kiya tha aur hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha tha ke kalala ka virsa kis tarah taqseem hoga? Is par Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayat utari lekin chunke Hazrat (R.A) ki poori tashaffi na hui thi, is liye apni sahibzadi zauja-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hazrat Hafsa (R.A) se farmaya ke jab Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khushi mein hon toh tum pooch lena. Chunancha Hazrat Hafsa (R.A) ne ek roz aisa hi mauqa pa kar daryaft kiya toh aap ne farmaya shayad tere baap ne tujhe is ke poochne ki hidayat ki hai mera khayal hai ke woh isay maloom na kar sakenge.

Hazrat Umar R.A ne jab yeh suna toh farmane lage jab Huzoor ﷺ ne yeh farma diya toh bas main ab ise jaan hi nahin sakta aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Umar R.A ke hukum par jab Hazrat Hafsa R.A ne sawal kiya toh aap ne ek kanghay par yeh aayat likhwa di, phir farmaya kya Umar ne tum se is ke poochne ko kaha tha? Mera khayal hai ke woh ise theek thaak na kar sakenge. Kya unhein garmi ki woh aayat jo Surah Nisa mein hai kaafi nahin? Woh aayat (وَاِنْ كَانَ رَجُلٌ يُّوْرَثُ كَلٰلَةً) (Surah An-Nisa: 12) hai phir jab logon ne Huzoor ﷺ se sawal kiya toh woh aayat utri jo Surah Nisa ke khatma par hai aur kanghi phenk di. Yeh hadith mursal hai. Ek martaba Hazrat Umar R.A ne sahaba ko jama kar ke kanghay ke ek tukray ko le kar farmaya main Kalala ke baare mein aaj aisa faisla kar dunga ke parda nasheen aurton tak ko maloom rahe, usi waqt ghar mein se ek saanp nikal aaya aur sab log idhar udhar ho gaye, pas aap ne farmaya agar Allah Azzawajal ka irada is kaam ko poora karne ka hota toh ise poora kar lene deta. Is ki asnaad sahih hai, Mustadrak Hakim mein hai Hazrat Umar R.A ne farmaya kaash main teen maslay Rasool-e-Maqbool ﷺ se daryaft kar leta toh mujhe surkh oonton ke milne se bhi zyada mehboob hota. Ek toh yeh ke aap ke baad Khalifa kaun hoga? Dusre yeh ke jo log Zakat ke toh qail hon lekin kahein ke hum tujhe ada nahin karenge un se ladna halal hai ya nahin? Teesre Kalala ke baare mein ek aur hadith mein bajaye Zakat ada na karne walon ke soodi masail ka bayan hai. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain Hazrat Umar R.A ke aakhri waqt main ne aap se suna farmate the qaul wahi hai jo main ne kaha, toh main ne poocha woh kya? Farmaya yeh ke Kalala woh hai jis ki aulad na ho. Ek aur riwayat mein hai Hazrat Farooq R.A farmate hain mere aur Hazrat Siddiq R.A ke darmiyan Kalala ke baare mein ikhtilaf hua aur baat wahi thi jo main kehta tha. Hazrat Umar R.A ne sagay bhaiyon aur maa zaad bhaiyon ko jabke woh jama hon, saalis mein shareek kiya tha aur Hazrat Abu Bakr R.A is ke khilaf the. Ibn Jarir mein hai ke Khalifatul Momineen Janab Farooq R.A ne ek ruqqa par dada ke wirsay aur Kalala ke baare mein kuch likha phir istikhara kiya aur thehray rahe aur Allah se dua ki ke Parwardigar agar tere ilm mein is mein behtari hai toh tu ise jaari kar de phir jab aap ko zakhm lagaya gaya toh aap ne is ruqqa ko mangwa kar mita diya aur kisi ko ilm na hua ke is mein kya tehreer tha phir khud farmaya ke main ne is mein dada ka aur Kalala ka likha tha aur main ne istikhara kiya tha phir mera khayal yahi hua ke tumhein isi par chhor doon jis par tum ho. Ibn Jarir mein hai main is baare mein Abu Bakr R.A ke khilaf karte hue sharmata hoon aur Abu Bakr R.A ka farman tha ke Kalala woh hai jis ka walad-o-walid na ho.

Aur isi par jamhoor-e-Sahaba aur Tabi'een aur Aimma-e-Deen hain aur yahi charon imamon aur saton fuqaha ka mazhab hai aur isi par Quran-e-Kareem ki dalalat hai jaise ke Bari Ta'ala Azzasmuhu ne ise wazeh kar ke farmaya Allah tumhare liye khol khol kar bayan farma raha hai taake tum gumrah na ho jao aur Allah har cheez ko khoob janne wala hai, Wallahu A'lam.
